
===== src\components\changes\access.js =====

const CHANGE_STAFF_ROLES = new Set(['system_admin', 'it_manager', 'it_support']);

export function canManageChanges(auth) {
  if (!auth || auth.user?.is_active === false) return false;
  if (auth.isStaff || auth.isAdmin) return true;
  const role = auth.role || auth.user?.role;
  return typeof role === 'string' && CHANGE_STAFF_ROLES.has(role);
}

export default canManageChanges;

===== src\components\monitoring\access.js =====

const MONITORING_ROLES = new Set(['system_admin', 'it_manager', 'it_support']);
const KNOWN_ROLES = new Set([...MONITORING_ROLES, 'employee']);

function roleOf(auth) {
  if (!auth) return null;
  return auth.role ?? auth.user?.role ?? null;
}

function isInactive(auth) {
  const active = auth?.user?.is_active;
  return active === false || active === 0 || active === 'false' || active === 'inactive';
}

function hasKnownRole(auth, role) {
  return !role || auth?.isSuperuser === true || KNOWN_ROLES.has(role);
}

export function canAccessMonitoring(auth) {
  if (!auth || isInactive(auth)) return false;
  const role = roleOf(auth);
  if (role === 'employee' || !hasKnownRole(auth, role)) return false;
  return Boolean(auth.isSuperuser || auth.isStaff || auth.isAdmin || auth.isSupportOrAbove);
}

export function canAdministerMonitoring(auth) {
  if (!auth || isInactive(auth)) return false;
  const role = roleOf(auth);
  if (role === 'employee' || !hasKnownRole(auth, role)) return false;
  if (role && role !== 'system_admin' && auth.isSuperuser !== true) return false;
  return Boolean(auth.isAdmin || auth.isSuperuser);
}

/** Safe date formatter â€” never renders raw payloads or internals. */
export function formatDate(value) { // eslint-disable-line react/only-export-components
  if (!value) return 'â€”';
  try {
    const d = new Date(value);
    if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return 'â€”';
    return d.toLocaleString();
  } catch {
    return 'â€”';
  }
}

export function formatRelative(value) { // eslint-disable-line react/only-export-components
  if (!value) return 'â€”';
  try {
    const d = new Date(value);
    if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return 'â€”';
    const now = new Date();
    const diffSec = Math.floor((now - d) / 1000);
    if (diffSec < 60) return 'Just now';
    if (diffSec < 3600) return `${Math.floor(diffSec / 60)}m ago`;
    if (diffSec < 86400) return `${Math.floor(diffSec / 3600)}h ago`;
    return d.toLocaleDateString();
  } catch {
    return 'â€”';
  }
}

/** KPI stat card. */
export function KpiCard({ title, value, tone = 'gray', sub, loading }) {
  const colorMap = {
    green: 'var(--success)',
    red: 'var(--danger)',
    amber: 'var(--warning)',
    blue: 'var(--info)',
    gray: 'var(--neutral-text)',
  };
  return (
    <div className="kpi-card" style={{ border: '1px solid var(--borders)', borderRadius: '8px', padding: 'var(--sp-3)', minWidth: 170, background: 'var(--surface)' }}>
      <div className="kpi-label">{title}</div>
      <div className="kpi-value" style={{ color: colorMap[tone] ?? 'var(--neutral-text)', fontSize: loading ? 0 : 28, visibility: loading ? 'hidden' : 'visible' }}>
        {loading ? 'â€”' : value}
      </div>
      {sub ? <div className="kpi-sub">{sub}</div> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Confirmation dialog wrapper (thin alias for shared ConfirmDialog for
 *  explicit confirmation intent on high-impact actions). */
export function ConfirmPanel({ title, message, confirmLabel = 'Confirm', danger, busy, onConfirm, onCancel, children }) {
  return (
    <div className="confirm-panel panel panel-pad">
      <h4>{title}</h4>
      <p style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>{message}</p>
      {children}
      <div className="row-end">
        <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={onCancel} disabled={busy}>Cancel</button>
        <button type="button" className={danger ? 'btn-danger' : 'btn-primary'} onClick={onConfirm} disabled={busy}>
          {busy ? 'Workingâ€¦' : confirmLabel}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Safe-value stripper: redacts secret-like keys from any object before
 *  rendering. Used so no secret ever reaches the DOM. */
const SECRET_KEYS = ['secret', 'password', 'token', 'authorization', 'api_key', 'apikey', 'private_key', 'client_secret', 'access_token', 'refresh_secret', 'signature', 'cookie'];

export function sanitizeRecord(record) { // eslint-disable-line react/only-export-components
  if (record === null || record === undefined) return record;
  if (Array.isArray(record)) return record.map(sanitizeRecord);
  if (typeof record === 'object') {
    const out = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(record)) {
      const key = String(k).toLowerCase();
      if (SECRET_KEYS.some((s) => key.includes(s))) {
        out[k] = '[REDACTED]';
      } else if (typeof v === 'object' && v !== null) {
        out[k] = sanitizeRecord(v);
      } else {
        out[k] = v;
      }
    }
    return out;
  }
  return record;
}


===== src\features\changes\change-list.jsx =====

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { useApi } from '../../services/api-context';
import { Table, TableRow, TableCell, TableHead, TableBody, Pagination, EmptyState, LoadingState, ErrorState } from '../../components';
import { canManageChanges } from '../../components/changes/access';

/** Change List â€” connects to backend ChangeRequestViewSet at /api/changes/ */
export function ChangeList() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const { request, loading, error } = useApi();
  const [items] = useState([]);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [pageSize] = useState(20);
  const [filter] = useState('');
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoaded(false);
    try {
      const _resp = await request('GET', `/api/changes/?page=${page}&page_size=${pageSize}&filter=${filter}`); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
      setLoaded(true);
    } catch {
      setError('Failed to load changes.');
    } finally {
      setLoaded(true);
    }
  }, [request, page, pageSize, filter]);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect

  if (!canManageChanges(auth)) {
    return (
      <div>
        <h3>Changes</h3>
        <p>Access denied. Change management requires appropriate permissions.</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (loading || !loaded) {
    return <LoadingState title="Changes" />;
  }

  if (error) {
    return <ErrorState title="Changes" message={error} onRetry={load} />;
  }

  if (items.length === 0) {
    return (
      <EmptyState title="No Changes">
        <p>No change requests found. Use the create action to add a new change.</p>
      </EmptyState>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <Table title="Change Requests" aid="changes-table">
        <TableHead>
          <TableRow>
            <TableCell>ID</TableCell>
            <TableCell>Title</TableCell>
            <TableCell>Status</TableCell>
            <TableCell>Priority</TableCell>
            <TableCell>Requested</TableCell>
            <TableCell className="actions">Actions</TableCell>
          </TableRow>
        </TableHead>
        <TableBody>
          {items.map((item) => (
            <TableRow key={item.id}>
              <TableCell>{item.id}</TableCell>
              <TableCell>{item.summary || item.title}</TableCell>
              <TableCell>{item.status}</TableCell>
              <TableCell>{item.priority}</TableCell>
              <TableCell>{item.start_date}</TableCell>
              <TableCell className="actions">
                <a href={`/#/changes/${item.id}`}>Detail</a>
              </TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          ))}
        </TableBody>
      </Table>
      <Pagination
        current={page}
        total={items.length > 0 ? items[0].pagination?.count : 0}
        onChange={setPage}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\features\cmdb\cmdb-item-detail.jsx =====

import { useCallback, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useApi } from '../../services/api-context';
import { PageHeader, LoadingPanel, ErrorPanel, EmptyState } from '../../components';

/** CMDB Item Detail â€” connects to backend ConfigurationItemViewSet at /api/cmdb/<id>/ */
export function CmdbItemDetail({ match }) {
  const { request } = useApi();
  const [item, setItem] = useState(null);
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);
  const [errorState, setErrorState] = useState('');

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const resp = await request('GET', `/api/cmdb/${match.params.id}/`); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
      setItem(resp.data);
      setLoaded(true);
    } catch {
      setErrorState('Failed to load CMDB item detail.');
    }
  }, [request, match.params.id]);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect

  if (!loaded) {
    return <LoadingPanel label="Loading CMDB itemâ€¦"/>;
  }

  if (errorState) {
    return <ErrorPanel message={errorState} onRetry={load} />;
  }

  if (!item) {
    return <EmptyState title="CMDB Item">Item not found.</EmptyState>;
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title={item.name} subtitle={item.configuration_item_type} />
      <dl className="detail-grid">
        <dt>ID</dt><dd>{item.id}</dd>
        <dt>Type</dt><dd>{item.configuration_item_type}</dd>
        <dt>Name</dt><dd>{item.name}</dd>
        <dt>Status</dt><dd>{item.status}</dd>
        <dt>Last Updated</dt><dd>{item.last_updated}</dd>
        <dt>Owner</dt><dd>{item.owner}</dd>
      </dl>
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\features\cmdb\cmdb-item-list.jsx =====

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { useApi } from '../../services/api-context';
import { Table, TableRow, TableCell, TableHead, TableBody, Pagination, EmptyState, LoadingState, ErrorState } from '../../components';
import { canViewCMDB } from '../../components/cmdb/access';

/** CMDB Item List â€” connects to backend ConfigurationItemViewSet at /api/cmdb/ */
export function CmdbItemList() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const { request, loading, error } = useApi();
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [pageSize] = useState(20);
  const [filter] = useState('');

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const resp = await request('GET', `/api/cmdb/items/?page=${page}&page_size=${pageSize}&filter=${filter}`); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
      setItems(resp.data.results ?? resp.data);
    } catch {
      setError('Failed to load CMDB items.');
    }
  }, [request, page, pageSize, filter]);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect

  if (!canViewCMDB(auth)) {
    return (
      <div>
        <h3>CMDB</h3>
        <p>CMDB access requires appropriate permissions.</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (loading) {
    return <LoadingState title="CMDB" />;
  }

  if (error) {
    return <ErrorState title="CMDB" message={error} onRetry={load} />;
  }

  if (items.length === 0) {
    return (
      <EmptyState title="No CMDB Items">
        <p>No configuration items found. Check your CMDB configuration.</p>
      </EmptyState>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <Table title="Configuration Items" aid="cmdb-items-table">
        <TableHead>
          <TableRow>
            <TableCell>ID</TableCell>
            <TableCell>Name</TableCell>
            <TableCell>Type</TableCell>
            <TableCell>Status</TableCell>
            <TableCell>Last Updated</TableCell>
            <TableCell className="actions">Actions</TableCell>
          </TableRow>
        </TableHead>
        <TableBody>
          {items.map((item) => (
            <TableRow key={item.id}>
              <TableCell>{item.id}</TableCell>
              <TableCell>{item.name}</TableCell>
              <TableCell>{item.configuration_item_type}</TableCell>
              <TableCell>{item.status}</TableCell>
              <TableCell>{item.last_updated}</TableCell>
              <TableCell className="actions">
                <a href={`/#/cmdb/${item.id}`}>Detail</a>
              </TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          ))}
        </TableBody>
      </Table>
      <Pagination
        current={page}
        total={items.length > 0 ? items[0].pagination?.count : 0}
        onChange={setPage}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\features\monitoring\AlertDetail.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { PageHeader, Button } from '../../components';
import {
  AccessDeniedPanel, ErrorPanel, LoadingPanel, StatusBadge, SeverityBadge,
} from '../../components/monitoring/MonitoringUI';
import { getAlert, alertAction, parseMonitoringError } from '../../services/monitoring/monitoring-api';
import { canAccessMonitoring } from '../../components/monitoring/access';

/** Alert Detail â€” safe summary from the supported retrieve endpoint only.
 *
 * Backend-supported:
 *   GET    /monitoring/alerts/<id>/          (retrieve)
 *   POST   /monitoring/alerts/<id>/acknowledge/
 *   POST   /monitoring/alerts/<id>/suppress/
 *   POST   /monitoring/alerts/<id>/unsuppress/
 *   POST   /monitoring/alerts/<id>/resolve/
 *   POST   /monitoring/alerts/<id>/close/
 *   POST   /monitoring/alerts/<id>/reopen/
 *   POST   /monitoring/alerts/<id>/assign/
 *
 * Serializer exposes only: alert_number, title, severity, status,
 * source_name, event_count.
 * Fields not exposed by the serializer are not rendered:
 *   environment, target, metric, fingerprint, first/last seen, recovery,
 *   occurrences detail, acknowledgements, linked ticket, automation state.
 * Sub-action endpoints (events, history, ticket) are registered in urls.py
 * but have no corresponding methods on the ViewSet, so they are not called.
 */
export function AlertDetail({ alertId }) {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const [alert, setAlert] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [actionBusy, setActionBusy] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!alertId) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      setError('');
      try {
        const a = await getAlert(alertId);
        if (cancelled) return;
        setAlert(a);
      } catch (e) {
        const parsed = parseMonitoringError(e);
        if (!cancelled) setError(parsed.global || 'Failed to load alert.');
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [alertId]);

  const act = async (action, payload) => {
    setActionBusy(action);
    try {
      await alertAction(alertId, action, payload);
      setAlert(await getAlert(alertId));
    } catch (e) {
      const parsed = parseMonitoringError(e);
      setError(parsed.global || `Alert action failed.`);
    } finally {
      setActionBusy('');
    }
  };

  if (!canAccessMonitoring(auth)) {
    return (
      <div>
        <PageHeader title="Alert detail" sub="Correlated monitoring alert." />
        <AccessDeniedPanel reason="access" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div>
        <PageHeader title="Alert detail" sub="Correlated monitoring alert." />
        <LoadingPanel label="Loading alertâ€¦" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error || !alert) {
    return (
      <div>
        <PageHeader title="Alert detail" sub="Correlated monitoring alert." />
        <ErrorPanel message={error || 'Alert not found.'} onRetry={() => window.location.reload()} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const ack = async () => {
    try { await act('acknowledge', {}); } catch { /* error surfaced in state */ }
  };
  const resolve = async () => {
    try { await act('resolve', {}); } catch { /* error surfaced in state */ }
  };
  const reopen = async () => {
    try { await act('reopen', {}); } catch { /* error surfaced in state */ }
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title={`Alert ${alert.alert_number ?? ''}`}
        sub={alert.title}
        actions={
          <div className="row-gap">
            <Button kind="secondary" onClick={() => window.history.back()}>Back</Button>
            {(alert.status === 'open' || alert.status === 'new') && (
              <Button kind="primary" disabled={actionBusy === 'acknowledge'} onClick={ack}>
                {actionBusy === 'acknowledge' ? 'Workingâ€¦' : 'Acknowledge'}
              </Button>
            )}
            {(alert.status === 'open' || alert.status === 'acknowledged') && (
              <Button kind="primary" disabled={actionBusy === 'resolve'} onClick={resolve}>
                {actionBusy === 'resolve' ? 'Workingâ€¦' : 'Resolve'}
              </Button>
            )}
            {alert.status !== 'open' && (
              <Button kind="primary" disabled={actionBusy === 'reopen'} onClick={reopen}>
                {actionBusy === 'reopen' ? 'Workingâ€¦' : 'Reopen'}
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        }
      />

      {error ? <ErrorPanel message={error} /> : null}

      <div className="panel">
        <div className="panel-head"><h3>Alert summary</h3></div>
        <div className="panel-pad">
          <dl className="detail-grid">
            <dt>Alert</dt><dd>{alert.alert_number}</dd>
            <dt>Title</dt><dd>{alert.title}</dd>
            <dt>Severity</dt><dd><SeverityBadge value={alert.severity} /></dd>
            <dt>Status</dt><dd><StatusBadge value={alert.status} /></dd>
            <dt>Source</dt><dd>{alert.source_name ?? 'â€”'}</dd>
            <dt>Event count</dt><dd>{alert.event_count ?? 'â€”'}</dd>
          </dl>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="panel panel-pad">
        <div className="error-summary" role="status">
          Recovery details, occurrence history, correlation fingerprint,
          first/last seen, linked ticket, automation policy outcome, and retry
          state are not exposed by the alert retrieve serializer or by any
          supported backend endpoint, so they are not displayed here.
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default AlertDetail;


===== src\features\monitoring\AlertList.jsx =====

import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { PageHeader } from '../../components';
import { AccessDeniedPanel } from '../../components/monitoring/MonitoringUI';
import { canAccessMonitoring } from '../../components/monitoring/access';

/** Alert List â€” backend has no Alert collection endpoint
 *  (GET /monitoring/alerts/ is not registered; only retrieve by id).
 *
 *  The page does not issue a request to any unsupported URL. It renders a
 *  clear unavailable state and links to the supported Alert detail workflow
 *  only when an alert identifier is already known from elsewhere.
 */
export function AlertList() {
  const auth = useAuth();

  if (!canAccessMonitoring(auth)) {
    return (
      <div>
        <PageHeader title="Alerts" sub="Correlated operational alerts." />
        <AccessDeniedPanel reason="access" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Alerts"
        sub="Alert list API unavailable on the backend."
      />
      <div className="panel panel-pad" role="status" aria-label="Alert list unavailable">
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">
          The Alert collection endpoint (GET /monitoring/alerts/) is not
          registered on the backend, so the alert list cannot be loaded.
          Individual alert details can still be viewed when an alert
          identifier is already known.
        </div>
        <div className="small cell-muted">
          Supported: alert retrieve and actions (acknowledge, suppress,
          resolve, reopen, etc.) by alert id.
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default AlertList;

===== src\features\monitoring\MonitoringOverview.jsx =====

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { PageHeader } from '../../components';
import { listSources, parseMonitoringError } from '../../services/monitoring/monitoring-api';
import {
  AccessDeniedPanel, ErrorPanel, KpiCard, LoadingPanel, SourceStatusBadge,
  SourceHealthBadge,
} from '../../components/monitoring/MonitoringUI';
import { canAccessMonitoring } from '../../components/monitoring/access';

/** Monitoring Overview â€” operations KPI dashboard. */
export function MonitoringOverview() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const [sources, setSources] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const s = await listSources();
      const items = Array.isArray(s) ? s : (s?.results ?? []);
      setSources(items);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseMonitoringError(e).global || 'Failed to load monitoring sources.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect

  if (!canAccessMonitoring(auth)) {
    return (
      <div>
        <PageHeader title="Monitoring Operations" sub="Alert, source and automation overview." />
        <AccessDeniedPanel reason="access" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div>
        <PageHeader title="Monitoring Operations" sub="Alert, source and automation overview." />
        <LoadingPanel label="Loading monitoring overviewâ€¦" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div>
        <PageHeader title="Monitoring Operations" sub="Alert, source and automation overview." />
        <ErrorPanel message={error} onRetry={load} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const online = sources.filter((s) => s.is_active && s.health_status !== 'unhealthy').length;
  const offline = sources.filter((s) => !s.is_active || s.health_status === 'unhealthy').length;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Monitoring Operations"
        sub="Alert, source and automation overview."
        actions={<button type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={load}>Refresh</button>}
      />

      <div className="panel panel-pad">
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">
          Aggregate alert/automation KPIs are unavailable: the dashboard API
          (GET /monitoring/dashboard/) is not implemented on the backend and is
          not called. Source health below is loaded from the live Sources API.
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="kpi-grid" aria-label="Source health KPIs">
        <KpiCard title="Sources total" tone="blue" value={sources.length} />
        <KpiCard title="Sources online" tone="green" value={online} sub={`${sources.length} total`} />
        <KpiCard title="Sources offline" tone="red" value={offline} sub={`${sources.length} total`} />
        <KpiCard title="Active alerts" tone="gray" value="unavailable" sub="dashboard API not implemented" />
        <KpiCard title="Critical / High alerts" tone="gray" value="unavailable" sub="dashboard API not implemented" />
        <KpiCard title="Recovered alerts" tone="gray" value="unavailable" sub="dashboard API not implemented" />
        <KpiCard title="Acknowledged alerts" tone="gray" value="unavailable" sub="dashboard API not implemented" />
        <KpiCard title="Suppressed alerts" tone="gray" value="unavailable" sub="dashboard API not implemented" />
        <KpiCard title="Automation failures" tone="gray" value="unavailable" sub="dashboard API not implemented" />
        <KpiCard title="Retry pending alerts" tone="gray" value="unavailable" sub="dashboard API not implemented" />
      </div>

      <div className="panel">
        <div className="panel-head"><h3>Source health</h3></div>
        <div className="panel-pad">
          {sources.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="empty-state">
              <div className="empty-title">No monitoring sources configured.</div>
              <div className="small">Source creation requires backend support (POST /monitoring/sources/).</div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="table-wrap">
              <table className="grid">
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th>Source</th><th>Code</th><th>Status</th><th>Health</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {sources.map((s) => (
                    <tr key={s.id}>
                      <td className="row-title">{s.name}</td>
                      <td className="cell-muted small">{s.code}</td>
                      <td><SourceStatusBadge value={s.status} /></td>
                      <td><SourceHealthBadge value={s.health_status} /></td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default MonitoringOverview;

/** Ticket Automation Policy â€” preview only.

 * This panel is a non-submittable policy preview. Save and delete actions

===== src\features\monitoring\SourceManagement.jsx =====

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { PageHeader, Button } from '../../components';
import {
  listSources, getSource, enableSource, disableSource, rotateSourceSecret,
  testSource, parseMonitoringError,
} from '../../services/monitoring/monitoring-api';
import {
  AccessDeniedPanel, ErrorPanel, LoadingPanel, SourceStatusBadge,
  SourceHealthBadge,
} from '../../components/monitoring/MonitoringUI';
import { canAdministerMonitoring } from '../../components/monitoring/access';

/** Source Management â€” read-only listing plus supported actions.
 *
 * Backend-supported:
 *   GET    /monitoring/sources/          (list)
 *   GET    /monitoring/sources/<id>/     (retrieve)
 *   POST   /monitoring/sources/<id>/enable/
 *   POST   /monitoring/sources/<id>/disable/
 *   POST   /monitoring/sources/<id>/rotate-secret/
 *   POST   /monitoring/sources/<id>/test/
 *
 * Unsupported (no backend route): create (POST /monitoring/sources/),
 * edit (PATCH/PUT /monitoring/sources/<id>/).
 */
export function SourceManagement() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const isAdmin = canAdministerMonitoring(auth);
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [detailId, setDetailId] = useState(null);
  const [detail, setDetail] = useState(null);
  const [detailLoading, setDetailLoading] = useState(false);
  const [actionBusy, setActionBusy] = useState(null);
  const [secretBusy, setSecretBusy] = useState(null);
  const [createdSecret, setCreatedSecret] = useState(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true); setError('');
    try {
      const s = await listSources();
      const arr = Array.isArray(s) ? s : (s?.results ?? []);
      setItems(arr);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseMonitoringError(e).global || 'Failed to load sources.');
    } finally { setLoading(false); }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect

  const viewDetail = (id) => { setDetailId(id); setDetailLoading(true); setDetail(null); };
  const closeDetail = () => { setDetailId(null); setDetail(null); };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!detailId) return;
    (async () => {
      try { setDetail(await getSource(detailId)); }
      catch (e) { setError(parseMonitoringError(e).global || 'Failed to load source.'); }
      finally { setDetailLoading(false); }
    })();
  }, [detailId]);

  const toggleSource = async (id, enable) => {
    setActionBusy(id);
    try {
      if (enable) await enableSource(id); else await disableSource(id);
      setItems(items.map((i) => i.id === id ? { ...i, is_active: enable } : i));
    } catch (e) { setError(parseMonitoringError(e).global || 'Source action failed.'); }
    finally { setActionBusy(null); }
  };

  const rotateSecret = async (id) => {
    setSecretBusy(id);
    try {
      const r = await rotateSourceSecret(id);
      setCreatedSecret(r.secret ?? null);
    } catch (e) { setError(parseMonitoringError(e).global || 'Secret rotation failed.'); }
    finally { setSecretBusy(null); }
  };

  const testSourceConfig = async (id) => {
    try { await testSource(id); setError('Configuration valid.'); }
    catch (e) { setError(parseMonitoringError(e).global || 'Test failed.'); }
  };

  if (!isAdmin) {
    return (
      <div>
        <PageHeader title="Sources" sub="Monitoring source management." />
        <AccessDeniedPanel reason="access" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Sources"
        sub="Monitoring sources: read-only listing plus supported enable/disable, rotate-secret, and test actions."
        actions={<button type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={load}>Refresh</button>}
      />

      {error ? <ErrorPanel message={error} onRetry={load} /> : null}

      <div className="panel panel-pad">
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">
          Source creation and editing are not available: the backend does not
          expose POST /monitoring/sources/ or PATCH/PUT /monitoring/sources/{'<id>'}/.{'\n'}
          Only list, retrieve, enable, disable, rotate-secret, and test are supported.
        </div>
      </div>

      {loading ? <LoadingPanel label="Loading sourcesâ€¦" /> : items.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="panel panel-pad">
          <div className="empty-state">
            <div className="empty-title">No monitoring sources configured.</div>
            <div className="small">Add a source requires backend create support.</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="table-wrap">
          <table className="grid">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Source</th><th>Code</th><th>Type</th><th>Status</th><th>Health</th><th>Active</th><th>Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {items.map((s) => (
                <tr key={s.id}>
                  <td className="row-title">
                    {detailId === s.id ? (
                      <Button kind="ghost" size="small" onClick={() => viewDetail(s.id)}>{s.name}</Button>
                    ) : (
                      <a href="#" className="row-title" onClick={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); viewDetail(s.id); }}>{s.name}</a>
                    )}
                  </td>
                  <td className="cell-muted small">{s.code}</td>
                  <td className="cell-muted">{s.source_type}</td>
                  <td><SourceStatusBadge value={s.status} /></td>
                  <td><SourceHealthBadge value={s.health_status} /></td>
                  <td>{s.is_active ? <span className="badge badge-green">Yes</span> : <span className="badge badge-red">No</span>}</td>
                  <td className="cell-actions">
                    <Button kind="small" onClick={() => toggleSource(s.id, !s.is_active)} disabled={actionBusy === s.id}>
                      {s.is_active ? 'Disable' : 'Enable'}
                    </Button>
                    {isAdmin && (
                      <>
                        <Button kind="small" danger onClick={() => rotateSecret(s.id)} disabled={secretBusy === s.id} style={{ marginLeft: 4 }}>
                          Rotate secret
                        </Button>
                        <Button kind="small" onClick={() => testSourceConfig(s.id)} disabled={actionBusy === s.id} style={{ marginLeft: 4 }}>
                          Test
                        </Button>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}

      {detail && (
        <div className="panel" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
          <div className="panel-head">
            <h3>{detail.name}</h3>
            <button type="button" className="btn-ghost btn-small" onClick={closeDetail}>Close</button>
          </div>
          <div className="panel-pad">
            {detailLoading ? <LoadingPanel label="Loadingâ€¦" /> : (
              <>
                  <div className="small cell-muted">Read-only fields returned by the source serializer.</div>
                  <dl className="detail-grid">
                    <dt>Code</dt><dd>{detail.code}</dd>
                    <dt>Type</dt><dd>{detail.source_type}</dd>
                    <dt>Status</dt><dd><SourceStatusBadge value={detail.status} /></dd>
                    <dt>Health</dt><dd><SourceHealthBadge value={detail.health_status} /></dd>
                    <dt>Active</dt><dd>{detail.is_active ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</dd>
                  </dl>
                <div className="row-end" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
                  {detail.is_active ? (
                    <Button kind="small" danger onClick={() => toggleSource(detail.id, false)} disabled={actionBusy === detail.id}>Disable source</Button>
                  ) : (
                    <Button kind="small" onClick={() => toggleSource(detail.id, true)} disabled={actionBusy === detail.id}>Enable source</Button>
                  )}
                  {isAdmin && (
                    <>
                      <Button kind="small" onClick={() => testSourceConfig(detail.id)} disabled={actionBusy === detail.id} style={{ marginLeft: 4 }}>Test config</Button>
                      <Button kind="small" onClick={() => rotateSecret(detail.id)} disabled={secretBusy === detail.id} style={{ marginLeft: 4 }}>Rotate secret</Button>
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {createdSecret && (
        <div className="success-summary" role="status">
          Secret rotated. The plaintext value is shown once â€” copy it now. It is not persisted.
          <div className="small" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
            <code style={{ wordBreak: 'break-all' }}>{createdSecret}</code>
          </div>
          <button type="button" className="btn-small btn-ghost" onClick={() => setCreatedSecret(null)} style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
            Dismiss
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default SourceManagement;


===== src\pages\approvals\ApprovalCenter.jsx =====

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import api from '../../api';
import { DataTable, Badge, EmptyState, PageHeader, Button } from '../../components';

function rowFor(item) {
  const typeLabel = {
    service_request: 'Service Request',
    disposal: 'Disposal',
    purchase_request: 'Purchase Request',
    purchase_order: 'Purchase Order',
    workflow_approval: 'Workflow Approval',
    knowledge_base: 'KB Review',
  }[item.approval_type] || item.approval_type;

  const submitted = item.submitted_at ? new Date(item.submitted_at) : null;
  const age_hours = submitted
    ? Math.max(0, (Date.now() - submitted.getTime()) / 3600000)
    : 0;

  const actions = [];
  if (item.can_approve) actions.push('approve');
  if (item.can_reject) actions.push('reject');

  return {
    id: item.object_id,
    type: typeLabel,
    reference: item.reference,
    title: item.title,
    requester: item.requester,
    age: age_hours,
    actions,
  };
}

export function ApprovalCenter() {
  const { isStaff } = useAuth();
  const [approvals, setApprovals] = useState([]);
  const [counts, setCounts] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const [listRes, countsRes] = await Promise.all([
        api.get('/approvals/'),
        api.get('/approvals/counts/'),
      ]);
      setApprovals(listRes.data.approvals.map(rowFor));
      const c = countsRes.data;
      setCounts({
        total: c.total_pending,
        service_request: c.service_requests,
        disposal: c.disposals,
        purchase_request: c.procurement,
        purchase_order: 0,
        workflow_approval: c.workflow,
        knowledge_base: c.knowledge_base,
      });
    } catch {
      setError('Could not load pending approvals.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isStaff) return;
    load(); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
  }, [isStaff, load]);

  if (!isStaff) return <EmptyState title="Approvals" hint="Only staff can access approvals." />;
  if (loading) return <div className="panel-pad"><div className="muted">Loading approvalsâ€¦</div></div>;
  if (error) return <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>;

  const totalPending = counts?.total ?? 0;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Approvals"
        sub={`${totalPending} pending approval${totalPending !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`}
        actions={
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
            {counts && counts.service_request > 0 && <Badge label={`${counts.service_request} SR`} kind="pending" />}
            {counts && counts.disposal > 0 && <Badge label={`${counts.disposal} Disp`} kind="pending" />}
            {counts && counts.purchase_request > 0 && <Badge label={`${counts.purchase_request} PR`} kind="pending" />}
            {counts && counts.purchase_order > 0 && <Badge label={`${counts.purchase_order} PO`} kind="pending" />}
            {counts && counts.workflow_approval > 0 && <Badge label={`${counts.workflow_approval} WF`} kind="pending" />}
            {counts && counts.knowledge_base > 0 && <Badge label={`${counts.knowledge_base} KB`} kind="pending" />}
          </div>
        }
      />
      {approvals.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState title="No pending approvals" hint="Nothing waiting for your decision right now." />
      ) : (
        <DataTable
          columns={[
            { key: 'type', label: 'Type' },
            { key: 'reference', label: 'Reference' },
            { key: 'title', label: 'Title' },
            { key: 'requester', label: 'Requested by' },
            { key: 'age', label: 'Age (hrs)', render: (v) => v.toFixed(1) },
            {
              key: 'actions',
              label: 'Actions',
              render: (_, r) => (
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6 }}>
                  {r.actions?.includes('approve') && (
                    <Button kind="primary" size="small">Approve</Button>
                  )}
                  {r.actions?.includes('reject') && (
                    <Button kind="danger" size="small">Reject</Button>
                  )}
                  {r.actions?.includes('return_for_correction') && (
                    <Button kind="ghost" size="small">Return</Button>
                  )}
                </div>
              ),
            },
          ]}
          rows={approvals}
          keyOf={(r) => r.id}
          emptyTitle="No approvals"
          emptyHint="Nothing waiting."
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\pages\assets\AssetReportsPage.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import {
  Badge, DataTable, EmptyState, ExportDialog, Link, PageHeader,
} from '../../components';

function Kpi({ label, value, sub }) {
  return (
    <div className="kpi">
      <div className="kpi-label">{label}</div>
      <div className="kpi-value">{value}</div>
      {sub ? <div className="kpi-sub">{sub}</div> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

const DATE_RANGE_IDS = { from: 'ar-from', to: 'ar-to' };

function DateRange({ from, to, onFrom, onTo }) {
  return (
    <div className="date-range">
      <label className="small muted" htmlFor={DATE_RANGE_IDS.from}>From</label>
      <input
        id={DATE_RANGE_IDS.from}
        className="input"
        type="date"
        value={from}
        onChange={(e) => onFrom(e.target.value)}
      />
      <label className="small muted" htmlFor={DATE_RANGE_IDS.to}>To</label>
      <input
        id={DATE_RANGE_IDS.to}
        className="input"
        type="date"
        value={to}
        onChange={(e) => onTo(e.target.value)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function fmtDate(d) {
  if (!d) return 'â€”';
  const dt = d instanceof Date ? d : new Date(d + 'T00:00:00');
  return dt.toLocaleDateString();
}
function fmtMoney(v) {
  const n = Number(v);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return 'â€”';
  return n.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
}

function DistributionChart({ data, valueKey, labelKey, subKey, color }) {
  if (!data || data.length === 0) return null;
  const max = Math.max(...data.map((r) => Number(r[valueKey]) || 0), 1);
  return (
    <div className="distro">
      {data.map((row, i) => {
        const v = Number(row[valueKey]) || 0;
        const pct = Math.round((v / max) * 100);
        return (
          <div key={row.id ?? i} className="distro-row">
            <div className="distro-label">
              {labelKey ? row[labelKey] : row}
              {subKey && row[subKey] != null ? ` Â· ${row[subKey]}` : ''}
            </div>
            <div className="distro-bar">
              <div
                className="distro-fill"
                style={{ width: `${Math.max(pct, 2)}%`, background: color ?? 'var(--accent)' }}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="distro-value">{valueKey ? row[valueKey] : v}</div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

const REPORT_DEFS = [
  { key: 'financial', label: 'Financial' },
  { key: 'maintenance', label: 'Maintenance' },
  { key: 'warranty', label: 'Warranty' },
  { key: 'utilization', label: 'Utilization' },
  { key: 'inventory', label: 'Inventory' },
  { key: 'assets_by_department', label: 'Assets by dept.' },
  { key: 'assets_by_location', label: 'Asset locations' },
  { key: 'assets_with_incomplete_info', label: 'Incomplete info' },
  { key: 'warranty_by_department', label: 'Warranty by dept.' },
  { key: 'warranty_by_category', label: 'Warranty by cat.' },
  { key: 'warranty_by_vendor', label: 'Warranty vendors' },
  { key: 'purchase_cost_by_department', label: 'Cost by dept.' },
  { key: 'purchase_cost_trends', label: 'Cost trends' },
];

const REPORT_URLS = Object.fromEntries(
  REPORT_DEFS.map((r) => [r.key, `/assets/reports/?report=${r.key}`]),
);

function readReportFromHash() {
  try {
    const raw = String(window.location.hash || '').split('?')[1] || '';
    return new URLSearchParams(raw).get('report') || 'financial';
  } catch {
    return 'financial';
  }
}

function SectionHeading({ children }) {
  return <h2 style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>{children}</h2>;
}

export function AssetReportsPage() {
  const { isStaff } = useAuth();
  const [route, setRoute] = useState(readReportFromHash);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState(100);
  const [totalCount, setTotalCount] = useState(0);
  const [hasNext, setHasNext] = useState(false);
  const [hasPrev, setHasPrev] = useState(false);

  // Report-specific filter state
  const [fromDate, setFromDate] = useState('');
  const [toDate, setToDate] = useState('');
  const [resetFilters, setResetFilters] = useState(0);
  const [exportOpen, setExportOpen] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const sync = () => setRoute(readReportFromHash());
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', sync);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('hashchange', sync);
  }, []);

  // Reset pagination whenever filters or the active report change.
  useEffect(() => {
    setPage(1);
  }, [fromDate, toDate, route]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isStaff) return undefined;
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      setError('');
      try {
        const url = REPORT_URLS[route];
        if (!url) {
          if (!cancelled) {
            setError('Unknown report.');
            setData(null);
            setPage(1);
            setPageSize(100);
            setTotalCount(0);
            setHasNext(false);
            setHasPrev(false);
          }
          return;
        }
        const params = {};
        if (fromDate) params.from_date = fromDate;
        if (toDate) params.to_date = toDate;
        if (route === 'inventory') {
          params.page = page;
          params.page_size = pageSize;
        }

        const r = await api.get(url, { params });
        if (!cancelled) {
          setData(r.data);
          if (route === 'inventory') {
            setTotalCount(r.data.count);
            setPage(r.data.page);
            setPageSize(r.data.page_size);
            setHasNext(r.data.has_next);
            setHasPrev(r.data.has_prev);
          } else {
            setPage(1);
            setPageSize(100);
            setTotalCount(0);
            setHasNext(false);
            setHasPrev(false);
          }
        }
      } catch {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setError('Could not load report.');
          setData(null);
          setPage(1);
          setPageSize(100);
          setTotalCount(0);
          setHasNext(false);
          setHasPrev(false);
        }
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [isStaff, route, resetFilters, fromDate, toDate, page]);

  if (!isStaff) {
    return (
      <div className="form-wrap">
        <h1>Asset reports</h1>
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">Only IT staff can view asset reports.</div>
        <p><a className="back-link" href="#/assets">â† Back to assets</a></p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const goTo = (key) => {
    setRoute(key);
    setPage(1);
    setPageSize(100);
    window.location.hash = `#/assets/reports?report=${key}`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="panel panel-pad">
        <p className="page-loading" role="status">
          <span className="spinner" aria-hidden="true" />Loading reportâ€¦
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (error && !data) {
    return (
      <div className="panel panel-pad">
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="panel">
      <PageHeader
        title="Asset reports"
        sub="Financial, maintenance, warranty, utilization, inventory, and asset breakdown reports."
      />

      <div className="tab-row" role="tablist">
        {REPORT_DEFS.map((n) => (
          <button
            key={n.key}
            type="button"
            className={`tab${route === n.key ? ' active' : ''}`}
            role="tab"
            aria-selected={route === n.key}
            onClick={() => goTo(n.key)}
          >
            {n.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {fromDate || toDate ? (
        <div className="row-gap small muted" style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--sp-2)' }}>
          Showing: {fromDate || 'â€”'} to {toDate || 'â€”'}
          {' '}
          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn-ghost btn-small"
            onClick={() => { setFromDate(''); setToDate(''); setResetFilters((n) => n + 1); }}
          >
            Clear date filters
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--sp-2)' }} />
      )}

      {route === 'financial' && <FinancialOverview data={data} />}
      {route === 'maintenance' && <MaintenanceAnalytics data={data} />}
      {route === 'warranty' && (
        <WarrantyMonitoring
          data={data}
          fromDate={fromDate}
          toDate={toDate}
          setFromDate={setFromDate}
          setToDate={setToDate}
        />
      )}
      {route === 'utilization' && <Utilization data={data} />}
      {route === 'inventory' && (
        <InventoryReport
          data={data}
          fromDate={fromDate}
          toDate={toDate}
          exportOpen={exportOpen}
          setExportOpen={setExportOpen}
          page={page}
          pageSize={pageSize}
          totalCount={totalCount}
          hasNext={hasNext}
          hasPrev={hasPrev}
          setPage={setPage}
        />
      )}
      {route === 'assets_by_department' && <AssetsByDepartment data={data} />}
      {route === 'assets_by_location' && <AssetsByLocation data={data} />}
      {route === 'assets_with_incomplete_info' && <AssetsWithIncompleteInfo data={data} />}
      {route === 'warranty_by_department' && (
        <WarrantyBreakdown data={data} dimension="by_department" label="Department" heading="Warranty by department" />
      )}
      {route === 'warranty_by_category' && (
        <WarrantyBreakdown data={data} dimension="by_category" label="Category" heading="Warranty by category" />
      )}
      {route === 'warranty_by_vendor' && (
        <WarrantyBreakdown data={data} dimension="by_vendor" label="Vendor" heading="Warranty by vendor" />
      )}
      {route === 'purchase_cost_by_department' && <PurchaseCostByDepartment data={data} />}
      {route === 'purchase_cost_trends' && <PurchaseCostTrends data={data} />}
    </div>
  );
}

function FinancialOverview({ data }) {
  if (!data) return null;
  const byCategory = data.by_category || [];
  const byVendor = data.by_vendor || [];
  return (
    <div>
      <SectionHeading>Financial overview</SectionHeading>
      <div className="kpi-grid" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
        <Kpi label="Total assets" value={data.total_assets} sub="All assets" />
        <Kpi label="Total purchase cost" value={fmtMoney(data.total_purchase_cost)} sub="Recorded acquisition cost" />
        <Kpi label="Assets without cost" value={data.assets_without_cost} sub="No purchase cost recorded" />
        <Kpi label="Total maintenance" value={fmtMoney(data.total_maintenance_cost)} sub="All maintenance records" />
        <Kpi
          label="Cost-to-value ratio"
          value={data.cost_to_value_ratio != null ? `${data.cost_to_value_ratio}%` : 'â€”'}
          sub="Maintenance Ã· purchase cost"
        />
      </div>

      <div className="row-gap" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
        <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ flex: '1 1 45%' }}>
          <h4 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Purchase cost by category</h4>
          {byCategory.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="muted">No assets with a recorded category.</p>
          ) : (
            <DataTable
              columns={[
                { key: 'category', label: 'Category' },
                { key: 'asset_count', label: 'Asset count' },
                { key: 'purchase_cost', label: 'Purchase cost', render: (r) => fmtMoney(r.purchase_cost) },
              ]}
              rows={byCategory}
              keyOf={(r) => r.category}
            />
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ flex: '1 1 45%' }}>
          <h4 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Purchase cost by vendor</h4>
          {byVendor.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="muted">No assets with a recorded vendor.</p>
          ) : (
            <DataTable
              columns={[
                { key: 'vendor', label: 'Vendor' },
                { key: 'asset_count', label: 'Asset count' },
                { key: 'purchase_cost', label: 'Purchase cost', render: (r) => fmtMoney(r.purchase_cost) },
              ]}
              rows={byVendor}
              keyOf={(r) => r.vendor}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
        <h4 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Note on asset valuation</h4>
        <p className="muted" style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>
          The figures above show <strong>purchase cost</strong> only â€” the amount recorded when each asset was acquired.
          Current market value, depreciation, or book value are not tracked by this system and are therefore not shown.
          To add depreciation or valuation reporting, the asset model would need additional fields (e.g. depreciation method,
          useful life, residual value) and business rules to calculate them.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function MaintenanceAnalytics({ data }) {
  if (!data) return null;
  const byCategory = data.by_category || [];
  const byVendor = data.by_vendor || [];
  const topAssets = data.top_assets || [];
  return (
    <div>
      <SectionHeading>Maintenance analytics</SectionHeading>
      <div className="kpi-grid" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
        <Kpi label="Total records" value={data.total_records} sub="All maintenance events" />
        <Kpi label="Total spend" value={fmtMoney(data.total_cost)} sub="Total maintenance cost" />
        <Kpi label="Completed spend" value={fmtMoney(data.completed_cost)} sub="Completed maintenance" />
        <Kpi label="Pending / in-progress" value={data.pending_count} sub="Open records" />
        <Kpi label="Overdue" value={data.overdue_count} sub="Overdue maintenance" />
        <Kpi
          label="Most recent"
          value={data.most_recent_maintenance ? fmtDate(data.most_recent_maintenance) : 'â€”'}
          sub="Last maintenance date"
        />
      </div>

      {data.total_records === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          title="No maintenance records"
          hint="No maintenance events match the current filters. Adjust the date range or clear filters."
        />
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="row-gap" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
            <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ flex: '1 1 45%' }}>
              <h4 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>By status</h4>
              <DistributionChart
                data={Object.entries(data.by_status || {}).map(([k, v]) => ({ id: k, status: k, count: v }))}
                valueKey="count"
                labelKey="status"
                color="var(--status-available)"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ flex: '1 1 45%' }}>
              <h4 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>By type</h4>
              <DistributionChart
                data={Object.entries(data.by_type || {}).map(([k, v]) => ({ id: k, type: k, count: v }))}

              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="row-gap" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
            <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ flex: '1 1 45%' }}>
              <h4 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Expenditure by category</h4>
              {byCategory.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="muted">No maintenance records with a category.</p>
              ) : (
                <DataTable
                  columns={[
                    { key: 'category', label: 'Category' },
                    { key: 'count', label: 'Records' },
                    { key: 'cost', label: 'Cost', render: (r) => fmtMoney(r.cost) },
                  ]}
                  rows={byCategory}
                  keyOf={(r) => r.category}
                />
              )}
            </div>
            <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ flex: '1 1 45%' }}>
              <h4 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Expenditure by vendor</h4>
              {byVendor.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="muted">No maintenance records with a vendor.</p>
              ) : (
                <DataTable
                  columns={[
                    { key: 'vendor', label: 'Vendor' },
                    { key: 'count', label: 'Records' },
                    { key: 'cost', label: 'Cost', render: (r) => fmtMoney(r.cost) },
                  ]}
                  rows={byVendor}
                  keyOf={(r) => r.vendor}
                />
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
            <h4 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Frequently maintained assets</h4>
            {topAssets.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="muted">No assets with maintenance records.</p>
            ) : (
              <DataTable
                columns={[
                  { key: 'asset_tag', label: 'Asset' },
                  { key: 'name', label: 'Name' },
                  { key: 'count', label: 'Records' },
                  { key: 'cost', label: 'Cost', render: (r) => fmtMoney(r.cost) },
                  {
                    key: 'actions',
                    label: 'Actions',
                    render: (r) => (r.asset_id
                      ? <Link href={`#/assets/${r.asset_id}`} className="btn-ghost btn-small">View</Link>
                      : ''),
                  },
                ]}
                rows={topAssets}
                keyOf={(r) => r.asset_tag}
              />
            )}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function WarrantyMonitoring({ data, fromDate, toDate, setFromDate, setToDate }) {
  if (!data) return null;
  const soon = (days) => {
    const v = data.expiring_soon;
    return v && typeof v === 'object' ? (v[days] ?? 0) : 0;
  };
  const expiringList = data.expiring_list || [];
  return (
    <div>
      <SectionHeading>Warranty monitoring</SectionHeading>
      <div className="kpi-grid" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
        <Kpi label="Expired" value={data.expired_count ?? 0} sub="Warranty past expiry" />
        <Kpi label="Expiring within 30 days" value={soon(30)} sub="Due soon" />
        <Kpi label="Expiring within 90 days" value={soon(90)} sub="Due in 3 months" />
        <Kpi label="Expiring within 180 days" value={soon(180)} sub="Due in 6 months" />
        <Kpi label="Without warranty" value={data.without_warranty ?? 0} sub="No expiry recorded" />
        <Kpi
          label="Total with warranty"
          value={data.total_with_warranty ?? 0}
          sub="Assets with warranty_expiry"
        />
      </div>

      {data.expired_count > 0 || soon(30) > 0 || soon(90) > 0 || soon(180) > 0 ? (
        <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
          <h4 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Warranty status list</h4>
          {(() => {
            const items = [];
            if (data.expired_count > 0) {
              items.push(
                <div key="expired-header" className="distro-section-title">
                  <Badge kind="status" value="overdue" label={`${data.expired_count} expired`} />
                </div>
              );
            }
            [30, 90, 180].forEach((days) => {
              const n = soon(days);
              if (n > 0) {
                items.push(
                  <div key={`soon-${days}`} className="distro-section-title">
                    <Badge kind="status" value="warning" label={`${n} expiring in ${days} days`} />
                  </div>
                );
              }
            });
            return items;
          })()}
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <div className="row-gap" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
        <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ flex: '1 1 45%' }}>
          <h4 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Expiring soon (next 90 days)</h4>
          {expiringList.length > 0 ? (
            <DataTable
              columns={[
                { key: 'asset_tag', label: 'Asset' },
                { key: 'name', label: 'Name' },
                { key: 'category', label: 'Category' },
                { key: 'vendor', label: 'Vendor' },
                { key: 'expiry', label: 'Expiry', render: (r) => fmtDate(r.expiry) },
                { key: 'days_left', label: 'Days left' },
                {
                  key: 'actions',
                  label: 'Actions',
                  render: (r) => (r.asset_tag
                    ? <Link href={`#/assets/${r.asset_tag}`} className="btn-ghost btn-small">View</Link>
                    : ''),
                },
              ]}
              rows={expiringList}
              keyOf={(r) => r.asset_tag}
            />
          ) : (
            <p className="muted">No warranties expiring in the next 90 days.</p>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ flex: '1 1 45%' }}>
          <h4 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Assets without warranty</h4>
          <p className="muted">
            {data.without_warranty ?? 0} asset{(data.without_warranty ?? 0) !== 1 ? 's' : ''} have no warranty_expiry recorded.
            Use the inventory report to find and update them.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
        <h4 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Filter by expiry date</h4>
        <DateRange
          from={fromDate}
          to={toDate}
          onFrom={setFromDate}
          onTo={setToDate}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Utilization({ data }) {
  if (!data) return null;
  const sc = data.status_counts || {};
  const distribution = Array.isArray(data.assignment_distribution) ? data.assignment_distribution : [];
  return (
    <div>
      <SectionHeading>Asset utilization</SectionHeading>
      <div className="kpi-grid" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
        <Kpi label="Total assets" value={data.total_assets} sub="All non-deleted assets" />
        <Kpi label="Available" value={sc.available ?? data.available_count ?? 0} sub="Ready to assign" />
        <Kpi label="Assigned" value={sc.assigned ?? data.assigned_count ?? 0} sub="Currently assigned" />
        <Kpi label="In maintenance" value={sc.in_repair ?? data.maintenance_count ?? 0} sub="Under maintenance" />
        <Kpi label="Retired" value={sc.retired ?? data.retired_count ?? 0} sub="Retired" />
        <Kpi label="Lost" value={sc.lost ?? data.lost_count ?? 0} sub="Marked lost" />
        <Kpi label="Disposed" value={sc.disposed ?? data.disposed_count ?? 0} sub="Disposed" />
      </div>

      <div className="row-gap" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
        <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ flex: '1 1 45%' }}>
          <h4 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Assets by status</h4>
          <DistributionChart
            data={Object.entries(sc).map(([k, v]) => ({ id: k, status: k, count: v }))}
            valueKey="count"
            labelKey="status"
            color="var(--status-available)"
          />
        </div>
        <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ flex: '1 1 45%' }}>
          <h4 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Assignment distribution (top holders)</h4>
          {distribution.length > 0 ? (
            <DataTable
              columns={[
                { key: 'employee_name', label: 'Employee', render: (r) => r.employee_name || r.email },
                { key: 'employee_id', label: 'Employee ID' },
                { key: 'department', label: 'Department' },
                { key: 'asset_count', label: 'Assets held' },
              ]}
              rows={distribution}
              keyOf={(r) => r.employee_id || r.email}
            />
          ) : (
            <p className="muted">No assigned assets to display.</p>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function InventoryReport({ data, fromDate, toDate, exportOpen, setExportOpen, page, pageSize, totalCount, hasNext, hasPrev, setPage }) {
  if (!data) return null;
  const items = data.items || [];
  return (
    <div>
      <SectionHeading>Asset inventory</SectionHeading>
      <div className="row-gap" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-3)', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-end' }}>
        <div>
          <h4 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Inventory results</h4>
          <p className="muted small">
            {totalCount} asset{totalCount !== 1 ? 's' : ''} in result set Â· showing {pageSize} per page
          </p>
        </div>
        <div style={{ marginLeft: 'var(--sp-2)' }}>
          <button
            type="button"
            className={hasPrev ? 'btn-ghost btn-small' : 'btn-ghost btn-small disabled'}
            onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
            disabled={!hasPrev}
            aria-label="Previous page"
          >
            Previous
          </button>
          <span className="small">Page {page} of {Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalCount / pageSize))}</span>
          <button
            type="button"
            className={hasNext ? 'btn-ghost btn-small' : 'btn-ghost btn-small disabled'}
            onClick={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)}
            disabled={!hasNext}
            aria-label="Next page"
          >
            Next
          </button>
        </div>
        <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={() => setExportOpen(true)}>
          Exportâ€¦
        </button>
      </div>

      {exportOpen && (
        <ExportDialog
          dataset="assets"
          open={exportOpen}
          filterParams={{ from_date: fromDate, to_date: toDate }}
          onClose={() => setExportOpen(false)}
        />
      )}

      {items.length > 0 ? (
        <DataTable
          columns={[
            { key: 'asset_tag', label: 'Asset tag' },
            { key: 'name', label: 'Name' },
            { key: 'category', label: 'Category' },
            { key: 'status', label: 'Status' },
            { key: 'assigned_to', label: 'Assigned to', render: (r) => r.assigned_to || 'â€”' },
            { key: 'purchase_cost', label: 'Purchase cost', render: (r) => (r.purchase_cost != null ? fmtMoney(r.purchase_cost) : 'â€”') },
            { key: 'warranty_expiry', label: 'Warranty expiry', render: (r) => (r.warranty_expiry ? fmtDate(r.warranty_expiry) : 'â€”') },
            {
              key: 'actions',
              label: 'Actions',
              render: (r) => (r.id
                ? <Link href={`#/assets/${r.id}`} className="btn-ghost btn-small">View</Link>
                : ''),
            },
          ]}
          rows={items}
          keyOf={(r) => r.id || r.asset_tag}
        />
      ) : (
        <EmptyState
          title="No assets match the current filters"
          hint="Try widening the date range or clearing filters."
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
