import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';import { Badge, CategorySelect, ConfirmDialog, DepartmentSelect, ErrorSummary, Field,
  LoadingRows, Modal, PageHeader, UserSelect,
} from '../../components';
import { fieldMsg, parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';
import { MaintenanceFormModal } from '../maintenance';
import { DisposalFormModal } from '../disposals';

const STATUSES = ['available', 'assigned', 'in_repair', 'retired', 'lost', 'disposed'];
// Generic edits may only move between these two; assigned/retired/lost
// require their dedicated workflows (backend rejects those jumps).
const EDITABLE_STATUSES = ['available', 'in_repair'];
// Mirrors ATTACHMENT_ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS / ATTACHMENT_MAX_SIZE_MB in
// backend/config/settings.py, so an obviously bad file is rejected before
// anything is created. The server always re-validates.
const ATTACHMENT_EXTENSIONS = ['pdf', 'png', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'txt', 'csv', 'log', 'docx', 'xlsx'];
const IMAGE_EXTENSIONS = ['png', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'gif', 'webp', 'bmp'];

function isImageFilename(name) {
  const ext = (name || '').split('.').pop().toLowerCase();
  return IMAGE_EXTENSIONS.includes(ext);
}

/** Display name for an attachment. The asset attachment API omits
 * `original_filename` (ticket attachments include it), so fall back to the
 * stored file's basename instead of showing an opaque "File #id" â€” this also
 * keeps the image check and preview button working for asset images. */
function attachmentName(f) {
  if (f?.original_filename) return f.original_filename;
  const last = typeof f?.file === 'string' ? f.file.split('?')[0].split('/').pop() : '';
  if (last) {
    try { return decodeURIComponent(last); } catch { return last; }
  }
  return `File #${f?.id ?? ''}`;
}
const ATTACHMENT_MAX_MB = 10;

const fmtDate = (d) => (d ? new Date(`${d}T00:00:00`).toLocaleDateString() : 'â€”');
const fmtMoney = (v) => {
  const n = Number(v);
  return Number.isFinite(n)
    ? n.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })
    : String(v);
};

function AssetKpi({ label, value, sub }) {
  return (
    <div className="kpi">
      <div className="kpi-label">{label}</div>
      <div className="kpi-value">{value}</div>
      {sub ? <div className="kpi-sub">{sub}</div> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Warranty expiry alert badge. Returns a Badge element or null. */
const warrantyBadge = (expiry) => {
  if (!expiry) return null;
  const due = new Date(`${expiry}T00:00:00Z`);
  const today = new Date();
  today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const days = Math.round((due - today) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
  if (days < 0) return <Badge kind="status" value="overdue" label="Warranty expired" />;
  if (days <= 30) return <Badge kind="status" value="warning" label="Warranty expiring" />;
  return null;
};

/** Client-side pre-check; returns a human message or '' when acceptable. */
function attachmentProblem(file) {
  if (!file) return '';
  const ext = (file.name.split('.').pop() || '').toLowerCase();
  if (!ATTACHMENT_EXTENSIONS.includes(ext)) {
    return `"${file.name}" is not an allowed file type (.${ext || 'no extension'}). Allowed types: ${ATTACHMENT_EXTENSIONS.join(', ')}.`;
  }
  if (file.size > ATTACHMENT_MAX_MB * 1024 * 1024) {
    return `"${file.name}" is ${(file.size / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB â€” the maximum upload size is ${ATTACHMENT_MAX_MB} MB.`;
  }
  return '';
}

export function AssetForm({ id }) {
  const { isStaff } = useAuth();
  const isEdit = !!id;
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(isEdit);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState('');
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    asset_tag: '', name: '', category: '', status: 'available',
    serial_number: '', description: '', location: '', department: '',
    purchase_date: '', warranty_start: '', warranty_expiry: '',
    purchase_cost: '', vendor: '',
  });
  const [vendors, setVendors] = useState([]);
  const [vendorsLoading, setVendorsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState({});
  const [globalError, setGlobalError] = useState('');
  const [okMsg, setOkMsg] = useState('');
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  // Optional file chosen on the create page. It is sent as a second request
  // (POST /assets/attachments/) right after the asset row is created.
  const [file, setFile] = useState(null);
  // Set only when the asset WAS created but its upload failed:
  // {assetId, assetTag, fileName}. Retrying re-sends just the upload, so a
  // retry can never create a second asset.
  const [partial, setPartial] = useState(null);
  const [partialError, setPartialError] = useState('');
  const [retrying, setRetrying] = useState(false);
  // Status the record had when the form loaded (create starts available).
  // Dedicated statuses stay selectable only so an unchanged value can be
  // resubmitted; the backend rejects actual jumps to them.
  const [initialStatus, setInitialStatus] = useState('available');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isEdit) return;
    (async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      try {
        const r = await api.get(`/assets/${id}/`);
        const a = r.data;
        setInitialStatus(a.status ?? 'available');
        setForm({
          asset_tag: a.asset_tag ?? '', name: a.name ?? '',
          category: a.category ?? '', status: a.status ?? 'available',
          serial_number: a.serial_number ?? '',
          description: a.description ?? '', location: a.location ?? '',
          department: a.department ?? '',
          purchase_date: a.purchase_date ?? '',
          warranty_start: a.warranty_start ?? '',
          warranty_expiry: a.warranty_expiry ?? '',
          purchase_cost: a.purchase_cost ?? '',
          vendor: a.vendor ?? '',
        });
      } catch (e) {
        setLoadError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not load asset.');
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
  }, [id, isEdit]);

  // Load vendors for the vendor dropdown.
  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      setVendorsLoading(true);
      try {
        const r = await api.get('/assets/vendors/');
        setVendors(r.data.results ?? r.data ?? []);
      } catch {
        setVendors([]);
      } finally {
        setVendorsLoading(false);
      }
    })();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => setOkMsg('');
  }, []);

  const set = (k) => (v) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [k]: v }));

  // Create-then-upload: the asset row first (JSON), then the file against
  // the new id. Two separate calls, so each step can fail independently.
  const uploadAttachment = async (assetId, f) => {
    const fd = new FormData();
    fd.append('asset', assetId);
    fd.append('file', f);
    return api.post('/assets/attachments/', fd);
  };

  const submit = async (ev) => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    // After a partial failure the asset already exists: the form stays
    // locked behind the retry banner so submitting cannot create a twin.
    if (submitting || partial) return;
    setFieldErrors({});
    setGlobalError('');
    setOkMsg('');
    if (!isEdit) {
      const problem = attachmentProblem(file);
      if (problem) {
        setGlobalError(problem);
        return;
      }
    }
    // Assignment is never part of create/edit payloads (dedicated endpoints).
    const payload = {
      asset_tag: form.asset_tag.trim(),
      name: form.name.trim(),
      category: form.category === '' ? null : Number(form.category),
      status: form.status,
      serial_number: form.serial_number.trim(),
      description: form.description.trim(),
      location: form.location.trim(),
      department: form.department === '' ? null : Number(form.department),
      vendor: form.vendor === '' ? null : Number(form.vendor),
      purchase_date: form.purchase_date || null,
      warranty_start: form.warranty_start || null,
      warranty_expiry: form.warranty_expiry || null,
    };
    if (form.purchase_cost !== '') payload.purchase_cost = form.purchase_cost;
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      if (isEdit) {
        await api.patch(`/assets/${id}/`, payload);
        setOkMsg('Asset updated.');
        location.hash = `#/assets/${id}`;
        return;
      }
      const created = (await api.post('/assets/', payload)).data;
      if (file) {
        try {
          await uploadAttachment(created.id, file);
        } catch (e) {
          // Asset exists, file does not: report both halves honestly and
          // offer an upload-only retry (no second create).
          const p = parseApiError(e);
          setPartial({
            assetId: created.id,
            assetTag: created.asset_tag || payload.asset_tag,
            fileName: file.name,
          });
          setPartialError(p.fields.file || p.global || 'The upload failed.');
          return;
        }
      }
      setOkMsg('Asset created.');
      location.hash = `#/assets/${created.id}`;
    } catch (e) {
      const p = parseApiError(e);
      setFieldErrors(p.fields);
      setGlobalError(p.global);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // Upload-only retry: re-sends the stored file to the already-created
  // asset. Never calls POST /assets/ again.
  const retryUpload = async () => {
    if (!partial || retrying || !file) return;
    setRetrying(true);
    setPartialError('');
    try {
      await uploadAttachment(partial.assetId, file);
      setPartial(null);
      setOkMsg('Attachment uploaded.');
      location.hash = `#/assets/${partial.assetId}`;
    } catch (e) {
      const p = parseApiError(e);
      setPartialError(p.fields.file || p.global || 'The upload failed again.');
    } finally {
      setRetrying(false);
    }
  };

  if (!isStaff) {
    return (
      <div className="form-wrap">
        <h1>{isEdit ? `Edit asset #${id}` : 'New asset'}</h1>
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">Only IT staff can manage assets.</div>
        <p><a className="back-link" href="#/assets">â† Back to assets</a></p>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <p className="page-loading" role="status">
        <span className="spinner" aria-hidden="true" />Loading assetâ€¦
      </p>
    );
  }
  if (loadError) {
    return (
      <div className="form-wrap">
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{loadError}</div>
        <p><a className="back-link" href="#/assets">â† Back to assets</a></p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="form-wrap">
      <PageHeader
        title={isEdit ? `Edit asset #${id}` : 'New asset'}
        sub={isEdit ? undefined : 'Assignment happens after creation, on the asset page.'}
        actions={
          <a className="back-link" href={isEdit ? `#/assets/${id}` : '#/assets'}>
            â† {isEdit ? `Back to asset #${id}` : 'Back to assets'}
          </a>
        }
      />
      <ErrorSummary parsed={{ global: globalError }} />
      {okMsg && <div className="success-summary" role="status">{okMsg}</div>}
      {partial && (
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">
          <p>
            Asset <strong>#{partial.assetId}</strong> ({partial.assetTag}) was created, but
            the file &ldquo;{partial.fileName}&rdquo; could not be attached: {partialError}
            {' '}The asset exists without the file â€” retrying uploads the file only and will
            not create a second asset.
          </p>
          <div className="row-end">
            <a className="btn-ghost" href={`#/assets/${partial.assetId}`}>Open asset</a>
            <button
              type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={retryUpload}
              disabled={retrying || !file}
            >
              {retrying ? 'Uploadingâ€¦' : 'Retry upload'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      <form onSubmit={submit} noValidate>
        <div className="form-section">
          <h4>Identification</h4>
          <div className="form-grid">
            <Field label="Asset tag" required error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'asset_tag')}>
              <input className="input" value={form.asset_tag} onChange={(e) => set('asset_tag')(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. LT-0001" disabled={submitting} maxLength={50} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Name" required error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'name')}>
              <input className="input" value={form.name} onChange={(e) => set('name')(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. ThinkPad T14" disabled={submitting} maxLength={200} />
            </Field>
          </div>
          <div className="form-grid">
            <Field label="Category" required error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'category')}>
              <CategorySelect kind="asset" value={form.category} onChange={set('category')} disabled={submitting} />
            </Field>
            <Field
              label="Status" required error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'status')}
              hint="Use Assign, Return, Retire, or Mark lost for other statuses."
            >
              <select className="input" value={form.status} onChange={(e) => set('status')(e.target.value)} disabled={submitting}>
                {STATUSES.map((s) => (
                  <option
                    key={s} value={s}
                    disabled={isEdit && !EDITABLE_STATUSES.includes(s) && s !== initialStatus}
                  >
                    {s.replace(/_/g, ' ')}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </Field>
          </div>
          <div className="form-grid">
            <Field label="Serial number" error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'serial_number')}>
              <input className="input" value={form.serial_number} onChange={(e) => set('serial_number')(e.target.value)} disabled={submitting} maxLength={100} />
            </Field>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="form-section">
          <h4>Ownership</h4>
          <div className="form-grid">
            <Field label="Location" error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'location')}>
              <input className="input" value={form.location} onChange={(e) => set('location')(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. HQ Lab" disabled={submitting} maxLength={200} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Department (optional)" error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'department')}>
              <DepartmentSelect value={form.department} onChange={set('department')} disabled={submitting} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Vendor (optional)" error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'vendor')}>
              <select className="input" value={form.vendor} onChange={(e) => set('vendor')(e.target.value)} disabled={submitting || vendorsLoading}>
                <option value="">None</option>
                {vendors.map((v) => (
                  <option key={v.id} value={v.id}>{v.name}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
              {vendorsLoading && <span className="muted small">Loadingâ€¦</span>}
            </Field>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="form-section">
          <h4>Description</h4>
          <Field label="Description" error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'description')}>
            <textarea className="input" rows={3} value={form.description} onChange={(e) => set('description')(e.target.value)} disabled={submitting} />
          </Field>
        </div>
        <div className="form-section">
          <h4>Financials</h4>
          <div className="form-grid">
            <Field label="Purchase date" error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'purchase_date')}>
              <input className="input" type="date" value={form.purchase_date} onChange={(e) => set('purchase_date')(e.target.value)} disabled={submitting} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Warranty start" error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'warranty_start')}>
              <input className="input" type="date" value={form.warranty_start} onChange={(e) => set('warranty_start')(e.target.value)} disabled={submitting} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Warranty expiry" error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'warranty_expiry')}>
              <input className="input" type="date" value={form.warranty_expiry} onChange={(e) => set('warranty_expiry')(e.target.value)} disabled={submitting} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Purchase cost" error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'purchase_cost')}>
              <input className="input" type="number" step="0.01" min="0" value={form.purchase_cost} onChange={(e) => set('purchase_cost')(e.target.value)} placeholder="0.00" disabled={submitting} />
            </Field>
          </div>
        </div>
        {!isEdit && (
          <div className="form-section">
            <h4>Attachment</h4>
            <Field
              label="Attachment (optional)"
              error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'file')}
              hint="Uploaded right after the asset is created. PDF, PNG, JPG, TXT, CSV, LOG, DOCX or XLSX, up to 10 MB."
            >
              <input
                type="file" className="input"
                onChange={(e) => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] ?? null)}
                disabled={submitting || retrying || !!partial}
              />
            </Field>
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="row-end">
          <a className="btn-ghost" href={isEdit ? `#/assets/${id}` : '#/assets'}>Cancel</a>
          <button type="submit" className="btn-primary" disabled={submitting || !!partial}>
            {submitting ? 'Savingâ€¦' : isEdit ? 'Save changes' : 'Create asset'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

export function AssetDetail({ id }) {
  const { isStaff } = useAuth();
  const requestIdRef = useRef(0);
  const mountedRef = useRef(true);
  const activeDownloadUrl = useRef(null);
  // Mirrors the preview object URL so unmount can revoke it: closing the
  // preview modal runs `closeAttachmentPreview`, but unmounting the page with
  // the modal still open does not, which used to leak that one blob URL.
  const previewUrlRef = useRef(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    return () => {
      mountedRef.current = false;
      if (activeDownloadUrl.current) {
        try { URL.revokeObjectURL(activeDownloadUrl.current); } catch { /* ignore */ }
        activeDownloadUrl.current = null;
      }
      if (previewUrlRef.current) {
        try { URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrlRef.current); } catch { /* ignore */ }
        previewUrlRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, []);
  const [asset, setAsset] = useState(null);
  const [assignments, setAssignments] = useState([]);
  const [history, setHistory] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState(null); // 'return' | 'retire' | 'delete'
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [assignOpen, setAssignOpen] = useState(false);
  const [assignUser, setAssignUser] = useState('');
  const [assignNote, setAssignNote] = useState('');
  const [assignBusy, setAssignBusy] = useState(false);
  const [assignError, setAssignError] = useState('');
  const [attachments, setAttachments] = useState([]);
  const [uploadFile, setUploadFile] = useState(null);
  const [uploadBusy, setUploadBusy] = useState(false);
  const [uploadError, setUploadError] = useState('');
  const [uploadMsg, setUploadMsg] = useState('');
  const [dlBusy, setDlBusy] = useState(null);
  const [dlError, setDlError] = useState({});
  const [previewUrl, setPreviewUrl] = useState(null);
  const [previewName, setPreviewName] = useState('');
  const [previewBusy, setPreviewBusy] = useState(false);
  const [previewError, setPreviewError] = useState('');
  const [attToDelete, setAttToDelete] = useState(null);
  const [attBusy, setAttBusy] = useState(false);
  const [lostOpen, setLostOpen] = useState(false);
  const [lostReason, setLostReason] = useState('');
  const [lostBusy, setLostBusy] = useState(false);
  const [lostError, setLostError] = useState('');
  const [maintenance, setMaintenance] = useState([]);
  const [disposals, setDisposals] = useState([]);
  const [maintenanceOpen, setMaintenanceOpen] = useState(false);
  const [disposalOpen, setDisposalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [maintCostSummary, setMaintCostSummary] = useState(null);
  const [maintCostLoading] = useState(false);
  const [maintCostError] = useState('');

  const load = async () => {
    const requestId = ++requestIdRef.current;
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    setAttachments([]);
    try {
      setAsset((await api.get(`/assets/${id}/`)).data);
      if (requestId !== requestIdRef.current) return;
      try {
        const r = await api.get('/assets/assignments/history/', { params: { asset: id } });
        if (requestId !== requestIdRef.current) return;
        setAssignments(r.data.results ?? r.data ?? []);
      } catch { if (requestId === requestIdRef.current) setAssignments([]); }
      try {
        const at = await api.get('/assets/attachments/', { params: { asset: id } });
        if (requestId !== requestIdRef.current) return;
        setAttachments(at.data.results ?? at.data ?? []);
      } catch { if (requestId === requestIdRef.current) setAttachments([]); }
      try {
        const h = await api.get('/assets/histories/', { params: { asset: id } });
        if (requestId !== requestIdRef.current) return;
        setHistory(h.data.results ?? h.data ?? []);
      } catch { if (requestId === requestIdRef.current) setHistory(null); }
      try {
        const m = await api.get('/assets/maintenance/', { params: { asset: id, page_size: 100 } });
        if (requestId !== requestIdRef.current) return;
        setMaintenance(m.data.results ?? m.data ?? []);
      } catch { if (requestId === requestIdRef.current) setMaintenance([]); }
      try {
        const d = await api.get('/assets/disposals/', { params: { asset: id, page_size: 100 } });
        if (requestId !== requestIdRef.current) return;
        setDisposals(d.data.results ?? d.data ?? []);
      } catch { if (requestId === requestIdRef.current) setDisposals([]); }
      try {
        const cs = await api.get('/assets/reports/?report=maintenance', { params: { asset: id, report: 'maintenance' } });
        if (requestId !== requestIdRef.current) return;
        setMaintCostSummary(cs.data);
      } catch { if (requestId === requestIdRef.current) setMaintCostSummary(null); }
    } catch (e) {
      if (requestId !== requestIdRef.current) return;
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not load asset.');
    } finally {
      if (requestId === requestIdRef.current) setLoading(false);
    }
  };
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [id]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, react/set-state-in-effect

  const runAction = async (path, okMsg) => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      setAsset((await api.post(path, {})).data);
      setConfirm(null);
      load();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || okMsg);
      setConfirm(null);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const doDelete = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await api.delete(`/assets/${id}/`);
      location.hash = '#/assets';
    } catch (e) {
      const p = parseApiError(e);
      setError(p.global || JSON.stringify(p.fields) || 'Could not delete asset.');
      setConfirm(null);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const reloadAttachments = async () => {
    const requestId = requestIdRef.current;
    try {
      const at = await api.get('/assets/attachments/', { params: { asset: id } });
      if (requestId !== requestIdRef.current) return;
      setAttachments(at.data.results ?? at.data ?? []);
    } catch {
      if (requestId !== requestIdRef.current) return;
      setAttachments([]);
    }
  };

  const doUpload = async (ev) => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    if (uploadBusy || !uploadFile) return;
    setUploadBusy(true);
    setUploadError('');
    setUploadMsg('');
    try {
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('asset', id);
      fd.append('file', uploadFile);
      const r = await api.post('/assets/attachments/', fd);
      // The upload response may omit original_filename; the picked file's own
      // name is the most useful label in that case.
      const uploadedName = r.data.original_filename || uploadFile.name;
      setUploadFile(null);
      setUploadMsg(`Uploaded "${uploadedName}".`);
      await reloadAttachments();
    } catch (e) {
      const p = parseApiError(e);
      setUploadError(p.global || p.fields.file || 'Upload failed.');
    } finally {
      setUploadBusy(false);
    }
  };

  // One object URL per in-flight download so a rapid click on two files
  // never leaves an old blob pinned in memory.
  const doDownload = async (f) => {
    if (dlBusy) return;
    if (activeDownloadUrl.current) {
      try { URL.revokeObjectURL(activeDownloadUrl.current); } catch { /* ignore */ }
    }
    setDlBusy(f.id);
    setDlError((d) => ({ ...d, [f.id]: '' }));
    try {
      const r = await api.get(`/assets/attachments/${f.id}/download/`, {
        responseType: 'blob',
      });
      const cd = r.headers?.['content-disposition'] || '';
      const m = cd.match(/filename="([^"]+)"/);
      const name = (m && m[1]) || attachmentName(f);
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(r.data);
      activeDownloadUrl.current = url;
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = name;
      a.rel = 'noopener';
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      a.remove();
      setTimeout(() => {
        try { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); } catch { /* ignore */ }
        if (activeDownloadUrl.current === url) activeDownloadUrl.current = null;
      }, 5000);
    } catch (e) {
      const msg = e?.response?.status === 410
        ? 'File is missing from storage.'
        : e?.response?.status === 404
          ? 'Attachment not available (deleted or no access).'
          : e?.response?.status === 403
            ? 'You do not have permission to download this file.'
            : 'Download failed.';
      setDlError((d) => ({ ...d, [f.id]: msg }));
    } finally {
      setDlBusy(null);
    }
  };

  /** Single owner of the preview object URL: revokes the superseded URL
   * exactly once and keeps `previewUrlRef` in sync for unmount cleanup. */
  const setPreviewObjectUrl = (url) => {
    const prev = previewUrlRef.current;
    previewUrlRef.current = url;
    setPreviewUrl(url);
    if (prev && prev !== url) {
      try { URL.revokeObjectURL(prev); } catch { /* ignore */ }
    }
  };

  const closeAttachmentPreview = () => {
    setPreviewObjectUrl(null);
    setPreviewName('');
    setPreviewError('');
  };

  const openAttachmentPreview = async (f) => {
    if (previewBusy) return;
    setPreviewBusy(true);
    setPreviewError('');
    try {
      const r = await api.get(`/assets/attachments/${f.id}/download/`, {
        responseType: 'blob',
      });
      setPreviewObjectUrl(URL.createObjectURL(r.data));
      setPreviewName(attachmentName(f));
    } catch (e) {
      const msg = e?.response?.status === 403
        ? 'You do not have permission to preview this file.'
        : e?.response?.status === 404
          ? 'Attachment not available (deleted or no access).'
          : 'Preview failed.';
      setPreviewError(msg);
    } finally {
      setPreviewBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const doDeleteAttachment = async () => {
    if (!attToDelete || attBusy) return;
    setAttBusy(true);
    try {
      await api.delete(`/assets/attachments/${attToDelete.id}/`);
      setAttToDelete(null);
      await reloadAttachments();
    } catch (e) {
      setUploadError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not delete attachment.');
      setAttToDelete(null);
    } finally {
      setAttBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const doMarkLost = async (ev) => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    if (lostBusy || !lostReason.trim()) return;
    setLostBusy(true);
    setLostError('');
    try {
      const res = await api.post(`/assets/${id}/mark_lost/`, {
        reason: lostReason.trim(),
      });
      setAsset(res.data);
      setLostOpen(false);
      setLostReason('');
      load();
    } catch (e) {
      setLostError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not mark asset lost.');
    } finally {
      setLostBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const doAssign = async (ev) => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    if (assignBusy || !assignUser) return;
    setAssignBusy(true);
    setAssignError('');
    try {
      const res = await api.post(`/assets/${id}/assign/`, {
        assigned_to: Number(assignUser), note: assignNote.trim(),
      });
      setAsset(res.data);
      setAssignOpen(false);
      setAssignUser('');
      setAssignNote('');
      load();
    } catch (e) {
      setAssignError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not assign asset.');
    } finally {
      setAssignBusy(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <p className="page-loading" role="status">
        <span className="spinner" aria-hidden="true" />Loading assetâ€¦
      </p>
    );
  }
  if (error && !asset) {
    return (
      <div className="detail-wrap">
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>
        <p><a className="back-link" href="#/assets">â† Back to assets</a></p>
      </div>
    );
  }
  const a = asset;
  return (
    <div className="detail-wrap">
      <a className="back-link" href="#/assets">â† Assets</a>
      {error && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>}
      <div className="detail-head">
        <div>
          <h1>{a.name || a.asset_tag || 'Asset'}</h1>
          <div className="row-gap detail-badges">
            <Badge kind="status" value={a.status} />
            {a.has_open_maintenance && <Badge kind="status" value="scheduled" label="Open maintenance" />}
            <span className="muted small">{a.category_name ?? ''}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        {isStaff && (
          <div className="row-gap">
            <a className="btn-secondary" href={`#/assets/${a.id}/edit`}>Edit</a>
            {a.status === 'available' && (
              <button
                type="button" className="btn-secondary"
                disabled={a.has_open_maintenance}
                title={a.has_open_maintenance ? 'Complete or cancel open maintenance before assigning.' : undefined}
                onClick={() => { setAssignError(''); setAssignOpen(true); }}
              >Assignâ€¦</button>
            )}
            {a.status === 'assigned' && (
              <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setConfirm('return')}>Returnâ€¦</button>
            )}
            {a.status !== 'retired' && a.status !== 'lost' && a.status !== 'disposed' && (
              <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setConfirm('retire')}>Retireâ€¦</button>
            )}
            <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => { setLostError(''); setLostOpen(true); }}>Mark lostâ€¦</button>
            {a.status !== 'disposed' && (
              <>
                <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setMaintenanceOpen(true)}>Maintenanceâ€¦</button>
                <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setDisposalOpen(true)}>Disposeâ€¦</button>
              </>
            )}
            <button type="button" className="btn-danger" onClick={() => setConfirm('delete')}>Deleteâ€¦</button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <dl className="detail-grid">
        <dt>Assigned to</dt><dd>{a.assigned_to_email ?? (a.assigned_to ? `#${a.assigned_to}` : 'â€”')}</dd>
        <dt>Serial</dt><dd>{a.serial_number || 'â€”'}</dd>
        <dt>Department</dt><dd>{a.department_name || '-'}</dd>
        <dt>Vendor</dt><dd>{a.vendor_name || '-'}</dd>
        <dt>Location</dt><dd>{a.location || '-'}</dd>
        <dt>Purchased</dt><dd>{a.purchase_date ?? 'â€”'}</dd>
        <dt>Warranty until</dt><dd>
          {a.warranty_expiry ? (
            <span className="row-gap" style={{ gap: 'var(--sp-1)', alignItems: 'center' }}>
              {a.warranty_expiry} {warrantyBadge(a.warranty_expiry)}
            </span>
          ) : 'â€”'}
        </dd>
        <dt>Cost</dt><dd>{a.purchase_cost ?? 'â€”'}</dd>
      </dl>
      {a.description && (
        <section className="section">
          <h4>Description</h4>
          <p className="pre-wrap">{a.description}</p>
        </section>
      )}

      <section className="section">
        <h4>Overview</h4>
        <div className="row-gap detail-badges">
          <Badge kind="status" value={a.status} />
          {a.has_open_maintenance && <Badge kind="status" value="scheduled" label="Open maintenance" />}
          <span className="muted small">{a.category_name ?? ''}</span>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="section">
        <h4>Assignment</h4>
        {assignments.length === 0 ? <p className="muted">No assignment records.</p> : (
        <ul className="note-list">
          {assignments.map((x) => (
            <li key={x.id}>
              <div className="muted small">
                #{x.id} Â· {x.assigned_at ? new Date(x.assigned_at).toLocaleString() : ''}
                {x.returned_at ? ` Â· returned ${new Date(x.returned_at).toLocaleString()}` : ' Â· active'}
              </div>
              <div>To user #{x.assigned_to} by #{x.assigned_by}{x.note ? ` â€” ${x.note}` : ''}</div>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      </section>

      {history !== null && (
        <section className="section">
          <h4>History</h4>
          {history.length === 0 ? <p className="muted">No history entries.</p> : (
            <ul className="timeline">
              {history.map((h) => (
                <li key={h.id}>
                  <div className="muted small">{h.actor_email ?? `#${h.actor}`} Â· {h.timestamp ? new Date(h.timestamp).toLocaleString() : ''} Â· {h.action}</div>
                  {h.note && <div className="pre-wrap">{h.note}</div>}
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </section>
      )}

      <section className="section">
        <div className="panel-head">
          <h4>Maintenance cost summary</h4>
        </div>
        {maintCostLoading ? (
          <div className="panel-pad"><LoadingRows n={4} /></div>
        ) : maintCostError ? (
          <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{maintCostError}</div>
        ) : maintCostSummary ? (
          <div className="kpi-grid" style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>
            <AssetKpi label="Total spent" value={fmtMoney(maintCostSummary.total_cost)} sub={`${maintCostSummary.total_records} records`} />
            <AssetKpi label="Completed spend" value={fmtMoney(maintCostSummary.completed_cost)} sub="Completed maintenance" />
            <AssetKpi label="Pending / in-progress" value={maintCostSummary.pending_count} sub="Open maintenance records" />
            <AssetKpi label="Most recent" value={maintCostSummary.most_recent_maintenance ? fmtDate(maintCostSummary.most_recent_maintenance) : 'â€”'} />
          </div>
        ) : (
          <p className="muted">No maintenance records for this asset.</p>
        )}
      </section>

      <section className="section">
        <div className="panel-head">
          <h4>Maintenance</h4>
          {isStaff && a.status !== 'disposed' && (
            <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => setMaintenanceOpen(true)}>
              Schedule maintenanceâ€¦
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
        {maintenance.length === 0 ? <p className="muted">No maintenance records.</p> : (
          <ul className="mini-list">
            {maintenance.map((m) => (
              <li key={m.id} className="mini-item">
                <span className="mini-title">{m.title}</span>
                <span className="muted small">{m.maintenance_type?.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</span>
                <Badge kind="status" value={m.status} />
                {m.is_overdue && m.status !== 'overdue' && <Badge kind="status" value="overdue" label="Overdue" />}
                <span className="spacer" />
                <span className="muted small">
                  {m.scheduled_date ? new Date(m.scheduled_date).toLocaleString() : 'â€”'}
                  {m.assigned_to_email ? ` Â· ${m.assigned_to_email}` : ''}
                  {m.cost != null ? ` Â· ${Number(m.cost).toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}` : ''}
                </span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </section>

      <section className="section">
        <div className="panel-head">
          <h4>Disposals</h4>
          {isStaff && a.status !== 'disposed' && (
            <button
              type="button" className="btn-small"
              disabled={disposals.some((d) => !d.is_completed && ['pending', 'approved'].includes(d.approval_status))}
              onClick={() => setDisposalOpen(true)}
            >
              Request disposalâ€¦
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
        {disposals.length === 0 ? <p className="muted">No disposal requests.</p> : (
          <ul className="mini-list">
            {disposals.map((d) => (
              <li key={d.id} className="mini-item">
                <span className="mini-title">{d.disposal_reason}</span>
                <span className="muted small">{d.disposal_method?.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</span>
                <Badge kind="status" value={d.approval_status} />
                <span className="spacer" />
                <span className="muted small">
                  {d.is_completed && d.disposal_date
                    ? `Disposed ${new Date(d.disposal_date).toLocaleString()}`
                    : `Requested ${new Date(d.created_at).toLocaleString()}`}
                </span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </section>

      <section className="section">
        <h4>Attachments</h4>
        {isStaff && (
          <form onSubmit={doUpload} className="upload-row">
            <input
              type="file" onChange={(e) => setUploadFile(e.target.files?.[0] ?? null)}
              disabled={uploadBusy} aria-label="Choose a file to upload"
            />
            <button type="submit" className="btn-secondary" disabled={uploadBusy || !uploadFile}>
              {uploadBusy ? 'Uploadingâ€¦' : 'Upload'}
            </button>
          </form>
        )}
        {uploadError && <div className="field-error" role="alert">{uploadError}</div>}
        {uploadMsg && <div className="success-summary" role="status">{uploadMsg}</div>}
        {attachments.length === 0 ? <p className="muted">No attachments.</p> : (
          <ul className="file-list">
            {attachments.map((f) => (
              <li key={f.id} className="file-row">
                <div className="file-main">
                  <div className="file-name">{attachmentName(f)}</div>
                  <div className="file-meta">
                    {f.created_at ? new Date(f.created_at).toLocaleString() : ''}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="file-actions">
                  {isImageFilename(attachmentName(f)) && (
                    <button
                      type="button" className="btn-small"
                      onClick={() => openAttachmentPreview(f)}
                      disabled={previewBusy}
                      aria-label={`Preview ${attachmentName(f)}`}
                    >
                      {previewBusy ? 'Loadingâ€¦' : 'Preview'}
                    </button>
                  )}
                  <button
                    type="button" className="btn-small"
                    onClick={() => doDownload(f)} disabled={dlBusy === f.id}
                  >
                    {dlBusy === f.id ? 'Preparingâ€¦' : 'Download'}
                  </button>
                  {isStaff && (
                    <button
                      type="button" className="btn-small btn-danger"
                      onClick={() => setAttToDelete(f)}
                      aria-label={`Delete attachment ${attachmentName(f)}`}
                    >
                      Deleteâ€¦
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
        {Object.entries(dlError).filter(([, msg]) => msg).map(([id, msg]) => (
          <div key={id} className="field-error" role="alert">{msg}</div>
        ))}
        {previewError && <div className="field-error" role="alert">{previewError}</div>}
        {previewUrl && (
          <Modal title={previewName || 'Photo preview'} onClose={closeAttachmentPreview}>
            <div className="preview-media">
              <img
                src={previewUrl}
                alt={previewName || 'Attachment preview'}
              />
            </div>
          </Modal>
        )}
        {attToDelete && (
          <ConfirmDialog
            title="Delete attachment?"
            message={`"${attachmentName(attToDelete)}" will be soft-deleted (kept in storage, restorable by a System Admin).`}
            confirmLabel="Delete attachment" danger busy={attBusy}
            onConfirm={doDeleteAttachment}
            onCancel={() => setAttToDelete(null)}
          />
        )}
      </section>

      {assignOpen && (
        <Modal title={`Assign ${a.asset_tag}`} onClose={() => { if (!assignBusy) setAssignOpen(false); }}>
          <form onSubmit={doAssign}>
            {a.has_open_maintenance && (
              <div className="error-summary" role="alert">
                This asset has open maintenance. Complete or cancel it before assigning the asset.
              </div>
            )}
            <Field label="Employee" required hint="Search by employee ID or email.">
              <UserSelect value={assignUser} onChange={setAssignUser} disabled={assignBusy} label="Assignee" />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Note (optional)">
              <input className="input" value={assignNote} onChange={(e) => setAssignNote(e.target.value)} placeholder="Reasonâ€¦" disabled={assignBusy} />
            </Field>
            {assignError && <div className="field-error" role="alert">{assignError}</div>}
            <div className="row-end">
              <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setAssignOpen(false)} disabled={assignBusy}>Cancel</button>
              <button type="submit" className="btn-primary" disabled={assignBusy || !assignUser || a.has_open_maintenance}>
                {assignBusy ? 'Assigningâ€¦' : 'Assign'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {maintenanceOpen && (
        <MaintenanceFormModal
          asset={a}
          onClose={() => setMaintenanceOpen(false)}
          onSaved={() => load()}
        />
      )}
      {disposalOpen && (
        <DisposalFormModal
          asset={a}
          onClose={() => setDisposalOpen(false)}
          onSaved={() => load()}
        />
      )}

      {confirm === 'return' && (
        <ConfirmDialog
          title={`Return ${a.asset_tag}?`}
          message="This clears the assignee, sets status to available, closes the open assignment, and records history. It cannot be undone except by re-assigning."
          confirmLabel="Return asset" busy={busy}
          onConfirm={() => runAction(`/assets/${id}/return_asset/`, 'Could not return asset.')}
          onCancel={() => setConfirm(null)}
        />
      )}
      {confirm === 'retire' && (
        <ConfirmDialog
          title={`Retire ${a.asset_tag}?`}
          message="This sets status to retired and records history. Prefer retirement over deletion for assets with history."
          confirmLabel="Retire asset" busy={busy}
          onConfirm={() => runAction(`/assets/${id}/retire/`, 'Could not retire asset.')}
          onCancel={() => setConfirm(null)}
        />
      )}
      {confirm === 'delete' && (
        <ConfirmDialog
          title={`Delete ${a.asset_tag}?`}
          message="This soft-deletes the asset (Recycle Bin, restorable by a System Admin). Assets with history are blocked from deletion â€” retire them instead."
          confirmLabel="Delete asset" danger busy={busy}
          onConfirm={doDelete}
          onCancel={() => setConfirm(null)}
        />
      )}

      {lostOpen && (
        <Modal title={`Mark ${a.asset_tag} lost`} onClose={() => { if (!lostBusy) setLostOpen(false); }}>
          <form onSubmit={doMarkLost}>
            <Field label="Reason" required hint="What happened, and when it was last seen. Recorded in history.">
              <textarea
                className="input" rows={3} value={lostReason}
                onChange={(e) => setLostReason(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Not returned after offboarding; last seen HQ Lab on Friday."
                disabled={lostBusy} autoFocus
              />
            </Field>
            {lostError && <div className="field-error" role="alert">{lostError}</div>}
            <div className="row-end">
              <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setLostOpen(false)} disabled={lostBusy}>Cancel</button>
              <button type="submit" className="btn-primary" disabled={lostBusy || !lostReason.trim()}>
                {lostBusy ? 'Markingâ€¦' : 'Mark lost'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\pages\audits\AuditLogPage.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { DataTable, LoadingRows, PageHeader, Pager } from '../../components';
import { fetchPage } from '../../api-utils';

const ACTIONS = [
  '', 'create', 'update', 'soft_delete', 'restore', 'hard_delete',
  'bulk_create', 'bulk_update', 'bulk_soft_delete', 'status_change',
  'assignment', 'deactivate', 'reactivate', 'retire', 'note',
];

const ACTION_LABELS = {
  create: 'Created',
  update: 'Updated',
  soft_delete: 'Soft-deleted',
  restore: 'Restored',
  hard_delete: 'Permanently deleted',
  bulk_create: 'Bulk created',
  bulk_update: 'Bulk updated',
  bulk_soft_delete: 'Bulk soft-deleted',
  status_change: 'Status changed',
  assignment: 'Assignment changed',
  deactivate: 'Deactivated',
  reactivate: 'Reactivated',
  retire: 'Retired',
  note: 'Note added',
};

const ENTITY_LABELS = {
  'tickets.Ticket': 'Ticket',
  'tickets.TicketCategory': 'Ticket category',
  'tickets.TicketAttachment': 'Ticket attachment',
  'assets.Asset': 'Asset',
  'assets.AssetCategory': 'Asset category',
  'assets.AssetAttachment': 'Asset attachment',
  'accounts.User': 'Employee',
  'accounts.Department': 'Department',
  'common.Notification': 'Notification',
};

export function AuditLogPage() {
  const { isAdmin } = useAuth();
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [count, setCount] = useState(null);
  const [next, setNext] = useState(null);
  const [previous, setPrevious] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [listError, setListError] = useState('');
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState(20);
  const [f, setF] = useState({ action: '', entity_type: '', date_from: '', date_to: '' });

  const buildUrl = (over = {}) => {
    const p = new URLSearchParams();
    const merged = { ...f, ...over };
    for (const k of ['action', 'entity_type', 'date_from', 'date_to']) {
      if (merged[k]) p.set(k, merged[k]);
    }
    p.set('page_size', String(pageSize));
    // Client-side guard: an end date before the start date can never match.
    if (merged.date_from && merged.date_to && merged.date_to < merged.date_from) {
      return null;
    }
    const qs = p.toString();
    return `/common/audit-logs/${qs ? `?${qs}` : ''}`;
  };

  const loadUrl = async (url) => {
    if (!url) {
      setListError('End date cannot be earlier than start date.');
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    setListError('');
    try {
      const pg = await fetchPage(url);
      setItems(pg.items);
      setCount(pg.count);
      setNext(pg.next);
      setPrevious(pg.previous);
    } catch (e) {
      setListError(
        e?.response?.data?.action?.join(' ')
        || e?.response?.data?.date_from?.join(' ')
        || e?.response?.data?.date_to?.join(' ')
        || 'Could not load audit log.',
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const applyFilters = (patch) => {
    const merged = { ...f, ...patch };
    setF(merged);
    const p = new URLSearchParams();
    for (const k of ['action', 'entity_type', 'date_from', 'date_to']) {
      if (merged[k]) p.set(k, merged[k]);
    }
    p.set('page_size', String(pageSize));
    if (merged.date_from && merged.date_to && merged.date_to < merged.date_from) {
      setListError('End date cannot be earlier than start date.');
      return;
    }
    const qs = p.toString();
    loadUrl(`/common/audit-logs/${qs ? `?${qs}` : ''}`);
  };

  const resetFilters = () => {
    const cleared = { action: '', entity_type: '', date_from: '', date_to: '' };
    setF(cleared);
    loadUrl(`/common/audit-logs/?page_size=${pageSize}`);
  };

  const changePageSize = (value) => {
    const size = Number(value) || 20;
    setPageSize(size);
    const p = new URLSearchParams();
    for (const k of ['action', 'entity_type', 'date_from', 'date_to']) {
      if (f[k]) p.set(k, f[k]);
    }
    p.set('page_size', String(size));
    loadUrl(`/common/audit-logs/${p.toString() ? `?${p}` : ''}`);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isAdmin) loadUrl('/common/audit-logs/'); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
  }, []); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  if (!isAdmin) {
    return (
      <div>
        <PageHeader title="Audit log" />
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">
          System administrators only.
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Audit log"
        sub={count != null ? `${count} entries` : 'Append-only record of consequential actions.'}
      />
      <div className="filter-bar" role="search">
        <select
          className="input" value={f.action}
          onChange={(e) => applyFilters({ action: e.target.value })}
          aria-label="Filter by action"
        >
          <option value="">All actions</option>
          {ACTIONS.filter(Boolean).map((a) => <option key={a} value={a}>{ACTION_LABELS[a] ?? a}</option>)}
        </select>
        <input
          className="input" value={f.entity_type}
          onChange={(e) => applyFilters({ entity_type: e.target.value })}
          placeholder="Entity type, e.g. tickets.Ticket" aria-label="Filter by entity type"
        />
        <input
          className="input" type="date" value={f.date_from}
          onChange={(e) => applyFilters({ date_from: e.target.value })}
          aria-label="Start date"
        />
        <input
          className="input" type="date" value={f.date_to}
          onChange={(e) => applyFilters({ date_to: e.target.value })}
          aria-label="End date"
        />
        <select className="input" value={pageSize} onChange={(e) => changePageSize(e.target.value)} aria-label="Page size">
          {[10, 20, 50, 100].map((n) => <option key={n} value={n}>{n} per page</option>)}
        </select>
        <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={resetFilters}>Reset</button>
      </div>
      <div className="panel">
        {loading ? <div className="panel-pad"><LoadingRows n={6} /></div>
          : listError ? <div className="panel-pad"><div className="error-summary" role="alert">{listError} <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => loadUrl(buildUrl())}>Retry</button></div></div>
          : (<>
            <DataTable
              columns={[
                { key: 'timestamp', label: 'Time', render: (a) => a.timestamp ? new Date(a.timestamp).toLocaleString() : 'â€”' },
                { key: 'actor', label: 'Actor', render: (a) => <span className="ellipsis" title={a.actor_email ?? ''}>{a.actor_email ?? 'â€”'}</span> },
                { key: 'action', label: 'Action', render: (a) => ACTION_LABELS[a.action] ?? a.action },
                { key: 'entity_type', label: 'Entity', render: (a) => <span className="ellipsis" title={a.entity_type ?? ''}>{ENTITY_LABELS[a.entity_type] ?? a.entity_type}</span> },
                { key: 'object_id', label: 'Object' },
                { key: 'object_repr', label: 'Summary', render: (a) => <span className="ellipsis" title={a.object_repr || a.reason || ''}>{a.object_repr || a.reason || 'â€”'}</span> },
              ]}
              rows={items}
              keyOf={(a) => a.id}
              emptyTitle="No audit entries match."
              emptyHint="Adjust or reset the filters."
            />
            <Pager count={count} hasNext={!!next} hasPrev={!!previous} busy={loading} onPrev={() => previous && loadUrl(previous)} onNext={() => next && loadUrl(next)} />
          </>)}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import {
  Badge, DataTable, Field, Modal, PageHeader, Pager,
} from '../../components';

export function Backup() {
  const { isStaff } = useAuth();
  if (!isStaff) {
    return (
      <div>
        <div className="page-head"><h1>Backup & DR</h1></div>
        <div className="empty-state">
          <div className="empty-title">Access restricted</div>
          <div className="small">Backup & DR is IT staff only.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const hash = location.hash.split('?')[0];
  if (hash === '#/backup/schedules') return <BackupSchedules />;
  if (hash === '#/backup/history') return <BackupHistory />;
  if (hash === '#/backup/restore') return <BackupRestore />;
  return <BackupOverview />;
}

/* ---------------- Overview ---------------- */

function BackupOverview() {
  const [schedules, setSchedules] = useState([]);
  const [lastJobs, setLastJobs] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    setLoading(true); setError(''); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    api.get('/api/backup/schedules/')
      .then((r) => setSchedules(r.data))
      .catch((_e) => setError('Could not load schedules.'))
      .finally(() => {
        api.get('/api/backup/jobs/', { params: { page_size: 30 } })
          .then((r) => setLastJobs(r.data.results))
          .catch((_e) => setError('Could not load jobs.'))
          .finally(() => setLoading(false));
      });
  }, []);

  const enabledCount = schedules.filter((s) => s.enabled).length;
  const failedCount = lastJobs.filter(
    (j) => j.status === 'failed' || j.status === 'backup_failed'
  ).length;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Backup & DR" sub="Backup schedules, job history and restore points."
        actions={(
          <div className="row-gap">
            <a href="#/backup/schedules" className="btn-ghost">Schedules &rarr;</a>
            <a href="#/backup/history" className="btn-ghost">History &rarr;</a>
            <a href="#/backup/restore" className="btn-ghost">Restore &rarr;</a>
          </div>
        )} />
      {error ? <div className="field-error" role="alert">{error}</div> : null}
      <div className="panel" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
        <div className="panel-head"><h3>Summary</h3></div>
        <div className="panel-pad">
          <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Schedules</span><div className="small">{schedules.length} configured &bull; {enabledCount} enabled</div></div>
          <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Last 30 days</span><div className="small">{lastJobs.length} jobs &bull; {failedCount} failed</div></div>
          <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Status</span>
            <span className="small" style={{ color: failedCount ? '#c0392b' : '#27ae60' }}>
              {failedCount ? `Attention needed ({failedCount} failure{s})` : 'All backups healthy'}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
        <DataTable columns={[
          { key: 'name', label: 'Schedule', render: (r) => <span className="row-title">{r.name}</span> },
          { key: 'type', label: 'Type', render: (r) => r.type.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + r.type.slice(1) },
          { key: 'frequency', label: 'Frequency', render: (r) => r.frequency },
          { key: 'time', label: 'Time', render: (r) => r.time },
          { key: 'enabled', label: 'Enabled', render: (r) => <Badge kind={r.enabled ? 'status' : 'neutral'} value={r.enabled ? 'on' : 'off'} label={r.enabled ? 'Enabled' : 'Disabled'} /> },
          { key: 'next', label: 'Next run', render: (r) => <span className="cell-muted">{r.next_run}</span> },
          { key: 'status', label: 'Last status', render: (r) => <Badge kind="status" value={r.last_status || 'available'} label={r.last_status === 'paused' ? 'Paused' : r.last_status.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + r.last_status.slice(1)} /> },
        ]} rows={schedules} keyOf={(r) => `schedule-${r.id}`}
          emptyTitle="No backup schedules." emptyHint="Create a schedule under Schedules." />
      </div>
      <div style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>
        <DataTable columns={[
          { key: 'schedule', label: 'Schedule', render: (r) => <span className="row-title">{r.schedule}</span> },
          { key: 'type', label: 'Type', render: (r) => r.type },
          { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (r) => <Badge kind="status" value={r.status} label={r.status.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + r.status.slice(1)} /> },
          { key: 'started', label: 'Started', render: (r) => r.started ? new Date(r.started).toLocaleString() : 'â€”' },
          { key: 'duration', label: 'Duration', render: (r) => r.duration },
          { key: 'size', label: 'Size', render: (r) => r.size },
          { key: 'target', label: 'Target', render: (r) => <span className="cell-muted">{r.target}</span> },
        ]} rows={lastJobs} keyOf={(r) => `job-${r.id}`} busy={loading}
          emptyTitle="No backup jobs." emptyHint="Run a scheduled backup to record its history here." />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------------- History ---------------- */

function BackupHistory() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    api.get('/api/backup/jobs/', { params: { page_size: 50 } })
      .then((r) => {
        setItems(r.data.results);
        setLoading(false);
      })
      .catch((_e) => {
        setError('Could not load job history.');
        setLoading(false);
      });
  }, []);

  if (loading) return <div className="panel-pad"><div className="muted">Loading job historyâ€¦</div></div>;
  if (error) return <div className="field-error" role="alert">{error}</div>;

  const statusMap = {
    success: 'backup_success', failed: 'backup_failed', running: 'backup_running', skipped: 'backup_skipped',
    cancelled: 'backup_cancelled', restoring: 'backup_restoring', expired: 'backup_expired',
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Backup job history" sub="Outcomes of recent backup runs."
        actions={(
          <div className="row-gap">
            <a href="#/backup" className="btn-ghost">&larr; Back to overview</a>
          </div>
        )} />
      <DataTable columns={[
        { key: 'schedule', label: 'Schedule', render: (r) => <span className="row-title">{r.schedule}</span> },
        { key: 'type', label: 'Type', render: (r) => r.type },
        { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (r) => <Badge kind={statusMap[r.status] || 'status'} value={r.status} /> },
        { key: 'started', label: 'Started', render: (r) => r.started ? new Date(r.started).toLocaleString() : 'â€”' },
        { key: 'duration', label: 'Duration', render: (r) => r.duration },
        { key: 'size', label: 'Size', render: (r) => r.size },
        { key: 'target', label: 'Target', render: (r) => <span className="cell-muted">{r.target}</span> },
        { key: 'error', label: 'Error', render: (r) => <span className="cell-muted">{r.error || 'â€”'}</span> },
      ]} rows={items} keyOf={(r) => `job-${r.id}`}
        emptyTitle="No backup job history." emptyHint="Run a scheduled backup to record its history here." />
      <Pager count={items?.length ?? 0} onPrev={() => setPage((p) => p - 1)} onNext={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)}
             hasPrev={page > 1} hasNext={page < 1} pageLabel="History" />
    </div>
  );
}

function BackupRestore() {

  }, []);

  if (loading) return <div className="panel-pad"><div className="muted">Loading restore pointsâ€¦</div></div>;
  if (error) return <div className="field-error" role="alert">{error}</div>;

  const statusMap = {
    available: 'status', restoring: 'restoring', expired: 'expired', corrupt: 'corrupt',
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Restore from backup" sub="Select a backup point to restore."
        actions={(
          <div className="row-gap">
            <a href="#/backup" className="btn-ghost">&larr; Back to overview</a>
          </div>
        )} />
      <DataTable
        columns={[
          { key: 'schedule', label: 'Source schedule', render: (r) => <span className="row-title">{r.schedule}</span> },
          { key: 'type', label: 'Type', render: (r) => r.type },
          { key: 'created', label: 'Created', render: (r) => r.created ? new Date(r.created).toLocaleString() : 'â€”' },
          { key: 'size', label: 'Size', render: (r) => r.size },
          { key: 'target', label: 'Target', render: (r) => <span className="cell-muted">{r.target}</span> },
          { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (r) => <Badge kind={statusMap[r.status] || 'status'} value={r.status} /> },
          { key: 'action', label: 'Restore', render: (r) => (
            <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" disabled={false} onClick={() => alert(`Restore from point ${r.id} â€” connect real backend to perform restore.`)}>
              {restoring !== r.id ? 'Restore' : 'Restoring...'}
            </button>
          )},
        ]}
        rows={points}
        keyOf={(r) => `point-${r.id}`}
        emptyTitle="No restore points."
        emptyHint="Run a backup to create a restore point."
      />
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\pages\blackout\BlackoutPeriods.jsx =====

/*
 * Blackout Periods - blackout period management
 * Route: #/blackout-periods
 */

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { PageHeader, Row, Col, Badge, Button } from '../../components';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import api from '../../api';
import { fetchPage, parseApiError } from '../../shared/changes-utils';
import { formatDateTime } from '../../shared/changes-utils';

const PERIOD_TYPE_LABELS = {
  financial: 'Financial Closing',
  critical: 'Critical Business Period',
  freeze: 'Organization-wide Freeze',
  infrastructure: 'Infrastructure Freeze',
};

export function BlackoutPeriods() {
  const { isManagerOrAdmin } = useAuth();
  const [periods, setPeriods] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isManagerOrAdmin) {
      setPeriods([]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
      setLoading(false); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
      return;
    }
    fetchPage(`/blackout-periods/`)
      .then((data) => {
        setPeriods(data.items ?? data);
        setLoading(false);
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        setError(parseApiError(e));
        setLoading(false);
      });
  }, [isManagerOrAdmin]);

  const toggleStatus = async (p) => {
    if (saving) return;
    if (!confirm(`${p.status === 'active' ? 'Deactivate' : 'Reactivate'} blackout period "${p.name}"?`)) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await api.patch(`/blackout-periods/${p.id}/`, { status: p.status === 'active' ? 'inactive' : 'active' });
      setMsg(`Blackout period "${p.name}" ${p.status === 'active' ? 'deactivated' : 'reactivated'}.`);
      const updated = periods.map((x) => x.id === p.id ? { ...x, status: p.status === 'active' ? 'inactive' : 'active' } : x);
      setPeriods(updated);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="mt-3"><p>Loading blackout periodsâ€¦</p></div>;
  }

  if (error) {
    return <div className="mt-3"><p className="text-danger">Error: {error.global ?? 'Unknown error'}</p></div>;
  }

  const msgEl = msg ? <div className="success-summary" role="status">{msg}</div> : null;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Blackout Periods" />
      {msgEl}
      <div className="mt-3">
        <p><strong>Total Blackout Periods:</strong> {periods.length}</p>
        {periods.length === 0 ? (
          <p>No blackout periods found</p>
        ) : (
          <div>
            {periods.map((p) => (
              <div key={p.id} className="mt-3 p-2 border rounded">
                <Row>
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Name:</strong> {p.name}</Col>
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Code:</strong> {p.code}</Col>
                </Row>
                <Row className="mt-1">
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Type:</strong> {PERIOD_TYPE_LABELS[p.period_type] ?? p.period_type}</Col>
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Status:</strong> <Badge kind="status" value={p.status} /></Col>
                </Row>
                <Row className="mt-1">
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Start:</strong> {formatDateTime(p.start_at)}</Col>
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>End:</strong> {formatDateTime(p.end_at)}</Col>
                </Row>
                <Row className="mt-1">
                  <Col sm={12}><strong>Description:</strong> {p.description}</Col>
                </Row>
                <Row className="mt-1">
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Department:</strong> {p.scope_department ?? 'â€”'}</Col>
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Service:</strong> {p.scope_service ?? 'â€”'}</Col>
                </Row>
                <Row className="mt-1">
                  <Col sm={12}>
                    {isManagerOrAdmin && (
                      <Button variant={p.status === 'active' ? 'danger' : 'success'} onClick={() => toggleStatus(p)} disabled={saving}>
                        {p.status === 'active' ? 'Deactivate' : 'Reactivate'}
                      </Button>
                    )}
                  </Col>
                </Row>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export { BlackoutPeriods } from './BlackoutPeriods';


===== src\pages\bulk\Bulk.jsx =====

import { useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { DepartmentSelect, Field, Modal } from '../../components';
import {
  blobErrorMessage, downloadBlob, fieldMsg, parseApiError, parseCSV,
} from '../../api-utils';

const ALL_ROLES = [
  ['system_admin', 'System Admin'],
  ['it_manager', 'IT Manager'],
  ['it_support', 'IT Support'],
  ['employee', 'Employee'],
];

/** Bulk ticket creation: CSV/XLSX import, preview, confirm, report. */
export function TicketBulkCreateModal({ onClose, onCreated }) {
  const [file, , pickFile] = useCsvFile();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState(null);
  const [report, setReport] = useState(null);
  const [reportBlob, setReportBlob] = useState(null);
  const [importToken, setImportToken] = useState('');

  const newImportToken = () => {
    try {
      if (globalThis.crypto?.randomUUID) return globalThis.crypto.randomUUID();
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    return `bulk-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`;
  };

  const pick = (e) => {
    pickFile(e);
    setPreview(null);
    setReport(null);
    setReportBlob(null);
    setError('');
    setImportToken('');
  };

  const doPreview = async () => {
    if (!file || busy) return;
    const token = importToken || newImportToken();
    if (!importToken) setImportToken(token);
    setBusy(true);
    setError('');
    setPreview(null);
    setReport(null);
    setReportBlob(null);
    try {
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('file', file);
      fd.append('preview', 'true');
      fd.append('import_token', token);
      const r = await api.post('/tickets/bulk_create/', fd);
      setPreview(r.data);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Preview failed.');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const doConfirm = async () => {
    if (!file || busy) return;
    if (!confirm(`Create ${preview?.affected ?? 0} ticket(s)? Invalid rows will be skipped.`)) return;
    const token = importToken || newImportToken();
    if (!importToken) setImportToken(token);
    setBusy(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('file', file);
      fd.append('preview', 'false');
      fd.append('confirm', 'true');
      fd.append('import_token', token);
      const r = await api.post('/tickets/bulk_create/?download=csv', fd, { responseType: 'blob' });
      const text = await r.data.text();
      const rows = parseCSV(text);
      const [, ...body] = rows;
      setReport(body.map(([row, key, outcome, message]) => ({ row, key, outcome, message })));
      setReportBlob(r.data);
      onCreated();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(await blobErrorMessage(e, 'Bulk create failed.'));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const okCount = preview?.affected ?? 0;
  return (
    <Modal title="Bulk create tickets" size="lg" onClose={() => { if (!busy) onClose(); }}>
      <p className="muted small modal-intro">
        1. Download the template. 2. Upload the filled CSV/XLSX. 3. Preview. 4. Confirm.
        You are recorded as the requester of every ticket.
      </p>
      <div className="row-gap" style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
        <button
          type="button" className="btn-ghost" disabled={busy}
          onClick={() => downloadTemplate('/tickets/bulk_create/?download=csv', 'ticket_import_template.csv', setError)}
        >
          Download template
        </button>
        <input type="file" accept=".csv,.xlsx,.xlsm" onChange={pick} disabled={busy} aria-label="Import file" />
      </div>
      {error && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>}
      <div className="row-gap">
        <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={doPreview} disabled={busy || !file}>
          {busy ? 'Working...' : 'Preview'}
        </button>
        {preview && (
          <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={doConfirm} disabled={busy}>
            {busy ? 'Working...' : `Confirm create (${okCount})`}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
      {preview && (
        <div className="modal-block">
          <p className="muted small">
            {okCount} valid, {(preview.invalid?.length ?? 0)} invalid rows.
          </p>
          {(preview.invalid?.length ?? 0) > 0 && (
            <ReportTable rows={preview.invalid.map((e) => ({
              row: e.row ?? '',
              key: '',
              outcome: 'invalid',
              message: typeof e.errors === 'string' ? e.errors : JSON.stringify(e.errors),
            }))} />
          )}
        </div>
      )}
      {report && (
        <div className="modal-block">
          <div className="row-gap" style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--sp-2)' }}>
            <b>Create result</b>
            <button
              type="button" className="btn-small"
              onClick={() => reportBlob && downloadBlob(reportBlob, 'ticket_import_report.csv')}
            >
              Download report (CSV)
            </button>
          </div>
          <ReportTable rows={report} />
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="row-end">
        <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={onClose} disabled={busy}>Close</button>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
}

/** Single employee creation (POST /api/accounts/users/). */
export function EmployeeCreateModal({ onClose, onCreated }) {
  const { isAdmin } = useAuth();
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    employee_id: '', username: '', email: '', password: '',
    first_name: '', last_name: '', role: 'employee', home_department: '',
    phone: '', job_title: '', can_create_tickets: true,
  });
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState({});
  const [globalError, setGlobalError] = useState('');
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const set = (k) => (v) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [k]: v }));
  const roles = isAdmin ? ALL_ROLES : ALL_ROLES.filter(([v]) => v !== 'system_admin');

  const submit = async (ev) => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    if (saving) return;
    setFieldErrors({});
    setGlobalError('');
    const employeeId = form.employee_id.trim();
    const email = form.email.trim();
    const password = form.password;
    if (!employeeId) {
      setFieldErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, employee_id: ['Employee ID is required.'] }));
      return;
    }
    if (!email) {
      setFieldErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, email: ['Email is required.'] }));
      return;
    }
    if (String(password ?? '').length < 8) {
      setFieldErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, password: ['Password must be at least 8 characters.'] }));
      return;
    }
    const payload = {
      employee_id: employeeId,
      username: form.username.trim() || email,
      email,
      password,
      first_name: form.first_name.trim(),
      last_name: form.last_name.trim(),
      role: form.role,
      phone: form.phone.trim(),
      job_title: form.job_title.trim(),
      can_create_tickets: form.can_create_tickets,
    };
    if (form.home_department !== '') payload.home_department = Number(form.home_department);
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const r = await api.post('/accounts/users/', payload);
      onCreated(r.data);
      onClose();
    } catch (e) {
      const p = parseApiError(e);
      setFieldErrors(p.fields);
      setGlobalError(p.global);
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal title="Add employee" size="lg" onClose={() => { if (!saving) onClose(); }}>
      <form onSubmit={submit} noValidate>
        {globalError && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{globalError}</div>}
        <div className="form-grid">
          <Field label="Employee ID" required error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'employee_id')}>
            <input className="input" value={form.employee_id} onChange={(e) => set('employee_id')(e.target.value)} disabled={saving} maxLength={30} />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Email" required error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'email')}>
            <input className="input" type="email" value={form.email} onChange={(e) => set('email')(e.target.value)} disabled={saving} />
          </Field>
        </div>
        <div className="form-grid">
          <Field label="Username" error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'username')} hint="Defaults to the email address.">
            <input className="input" value={form.username} onChange={(e) => set('username')(e.target.value)} disabled={saving} maxLength={150} />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Password" required error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'password')} hint="Minimum 8 characters.">
            <input className="input" type="password" value={form.password} onChange={(e) => set('password')(e.target.value)} disabled={saving} autoComplete="new-password" />
          </Field>
        </div>
        <div className="form-grid">
          <Field label="First name" error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'first_name')}>
            <input className="input" value={form.first_name} onChange={(e) => set('first_name')(e.target.value)} disabled={saving} />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Last name" error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'last_name')}>
            <input className="input" value={form.last_name} onChange={(e) => set('last_name')(e.target.value)} disabled={saving} />
          </Field>
        </div>
        <div className="form-grid">
          <Field label="Role" error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'role')} hint={!isAdmin ? 'IT Support accounts are always created as employees.' : undefined}>
            <select className="input" value={form.role} onChange={(e) => set('role')(e.target.value)} disabled={saving}>
              {roles.map(([v, label]) => <option key={v} value={v}>{label}</option>)}
            </select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="Department" error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'home_department')}>
            <DepartmentSelect value={form.home_department} onChange={set('home_department')} disabled={saving} />
          </Field>
        </div>
        <div className="form-grid">
          <Field label="Phone" error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'phone')}>
            <input className="input" value={form.phone} onChange={(e) => set('phone')(e.target.value)} disabled={saving} maxLength={30} />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Job title" error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'job_title')}>
            <input className="input" value={form.job_title} onChange={(e) => set('job_title')(e.target.value)} disabled={saving} maxLength={100} />
          </Field>
        </div>
        <label className="check-row">
          <input type="checkbox" checked={form.can_create_tickets} onChange={(e) => set('can_create_tickets')(e.target.checked)} disabled={saving} />
          Can create tickets
        </label>
        <div className="row-end">
          <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={onClose} disabled={saving}>Cancel</button>
          <button type="submit" className="btn-primary" disabled={saving}>
            {saving ? 'Creatingâ€¦' : 'Create employee'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}

/** Per-row outcome table shared by import/bulk-create reports. */
export function ReportTable({ rows }) {
  if (!rows.length) return <p className="muted">No rows to show.</p>;
  return (
    <div className="table-wrap">
      <table className="grid">
        <thead>
          <tr><th>Row</th><th>Key</th><th>Outcome</th><th>Message</th></tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {rows.map((r, i) => (
            <tr key={i}>
              <td>{r.row ?? ''}</td>
              <td>{r.key ?? ''}</td>
              <td>{r.outcome ?? ''}</td>
              <td>{r.message ?? ''}</td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

function useCsvFile() {
  const [file, setFile] = useState(null);
  const pick = (e) => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] ?? null);
  return [file, setFile, pick];
}

async function downloadTemplate(url, filename, setError) {
  try {
    const r = await api.get(url, { responseType: 'blob' });
    downloadBlob(r.data, filename);
    return true;
  } catch {
    setError('Could not download the template.');
    return false;
  }
}

/** Bulk employee import: template â†’ upload â†’ preview â†’ confirm â†’ report. */

          </button>
        )}
      </div>
      {preview && (
        <div className="modal-block">
          <p className="muted small">

          </p>
          {(preview.errors?.length ?? 0) > 0 && (
            <ReportTable rows={preview.errors.map((e) => ({

              key: e.data?.employee_id ?? '',
