            }))} />
          )}

      )}
      {report && (

            <b>Import result</b>
            <button
              type="button" className="btn-small"
              onClick={() => reportBlob && downloadBlob(reportBlob, 'employee_import_report.csv')}
            >

          </div>
          <ReportTable rows={report} />
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="row-end">
        <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={onClose} disabled={busy}>Close</button>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
}

/** Bulk asset creation: template â†’ upload â†’ preview â†’ confirm â†’ report. */
export function AssetBulkCreateModal({ onClose, onImported }) {

    }
  };

  const doConfirm = async () => {

    setBusy(true);
    setError('');
    try {

      const r = await api.post('/assets/bulk_create/?download=csv', fd, { responseType: 'blob' });

      setBusy(false);

  const errCount = preview?.errors?.length ?? 0;

        <button
          type="button" className="btn-ghost" disabled={busy}
          onClick={() => downloadTemplate('/assets/bulk_create/?download=csv', 'asset_import_template.csv', setError)}
        >
          Download template
        </button>
        <input type="file" accept=".csv,.xlsx,.xlsm" onChange={pick} disabled={busy} aria-label="Import file" />
      </div>
      {error && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>}
      <div className="row-gap">
        <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={doPreview} disabled={busy || !file}>
          {busy ? 'Workingâ€¦' : 'Preview'}
        </button>
        {preview && (
          <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={doConfirm} disabled={busy}>
            {busy ? 'Workingâ€¦' : `Confirm create (${okCount} new)`}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
      {preview && (
        <div className="modal-block">
          <p className="muted small">{okCount} would be created Â· {errCount} invalid rows.</p>
          {errCount > 0 && (
            <ReportTable rows={preview.errors.map((e) => ({
              row: e.row ?? '',
              key: e.asset_tag ?? '',
              outcome: 'failed',
              message: typeof e.errors === 'string' ? e.errors : JSON.stringify(e.errors),
            }))} />
          )}
        </div>
      )}
      {report && (
        <div className="modal-block">
          <div className="row-gap" style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--sp-2)' }}>
            <b>Create result</b>
            <button
              type="button" className="btn-small"
              onClick={() => reportBlob && downloadBlob(reportBlob, 'asset_import_report.csv')}
            >
              Download report (CSV)
            </button>
          </div>
          <ReportTable rows={report} />
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="row-end">
        <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={onClose} disabled={busy}>Close</button>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
}

/*

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

);

export function ChangeApprovals({ match }) {

===== src\pages\changes\ChangeCalendar.jsx =====

/* 
 * Change Calendar - bounded calendar of changes
 * Route: #/changes/calendar
 * Uses native Date, no calendar dependency
 */

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { PageHeader, Badge } from '../../components';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { fetchPage } from '../../shared/changes-utils';

const MONTHS = [
  'January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June',
  'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December'
];

export function ChangeCalendar() {
  const { isStaff } = useAuth();
  const [month, setMonth] = useState(new Date()); // eslint-disable-line react/purity // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  const [changes, setChanges] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  const selectedMonth = month.getMonth();
  const selectedYear = month.getFullYear();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isStaff) {
      setChanges([]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
      setLoading(false); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
      return;
    }
    fetchPage(`/changes/calendar/?start=${selectedYear}-${String(selectedMonth + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-01&end=${selectedYear}-${String(selectedMonth + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(new Date(selectedYear, selectedMonth + 1, 0).getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`)
      .then((data) => {
        setChanges(data.items);
        setLoading(false);
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        setError(e);
        setLoading(false);
      });
  }, [selectedMonth, selectedYear, isStaff]);

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="mt-3"><p>Loading calendarâ€¦</p></div>;
  }

  if (error) {
    return <div className="mt-3"><p className="text-danger">Error: {error?.global ?? 'Unknown error'}</p></div>;
  }

  // Generate month grid
  const firstDay = new Date(selectedYear, selectedMonth, 1);
  const lastDay = new Date(selectedYear, selectedMonth + 1, 0);
  const prevMonthLastDay = new Date(selectedYear, selectedMonth, 0).getDate();
  const prevMonth = selectedMonth === 0 ? 11 : selectedMonth - 1;
  const prevYear = selectedMonth === 0 ? selectedYear - 1 : selectedYear;
  const daysInMonth = lastDay.getDate();
  const firstDayIndex = firstDay.getDay();
  const dayCells = [];

  // Previous month days
  for (let i = 0; i < firstDayIndex; i++) {
    dayCells.push({
      day: prevMonthLastDay - firstDayIndex + 1 + i,
      month: prevMonth,
      year: prevYear,
      isOtherMonth: true,
      changeCount: 0
    });
  }

  // Current month days
  for (let i = 1; i <= daysInMonth; i++) {
    const changeCount = changes.filter(c => {
      const planned = new Date(c.planned_start);
      return planned.getMonth() === selectedMonth && planned.getFullYear() === selectedYear;
    }).length;
    dayCells.push({
      day: i,
      month: selectedMonth,
      year: selectedYear,
      isOtherMonth: false,
      changeCount
    });
  }

  // Next month days
  const totalShown = dayCells.length;
  const remaining = 42 - totalShown;
  for (let i = 1; i <= remaining; i++) {
    dayCells.push({
      day: i,
      month: selectedMonth + 1 > 11 ? 0 : selectedMonth + 1,
      year: selectedMonth + 1 > 11 ? selectedYear + 1 : selectedYear,
      isOtherMonth: true,
      changeCount: 0
    });
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Change Calendar" />
      <div className="mt-3">
        <div className="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-3">
          <button onClick={() => setMonth(new Date(selectedYear, selectedMonth - 1, 1))} disabled={selectedMonth === 0} className="btn btn-link">
            Previous
          </button>
          <span>{MONTHS[selectedMonth]} {selectedYear}</span>
          <button onClick={() => setMonth(new Date(selectedYear, selectedMonth + 1, 1))} className="btn btn-link">
            Next
          </button>
        </div>
        <button onClick={() => setMonth(new Date())} className="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary mt-2">Today</button>
        <div className="table-responsive mt-3">
          <table className="table table-sm mb-0">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Sun</th>
                <th>Mon</th>
                <th>Tue</th>
                <th>Wed</th>
                <th>Thu</th>
                <th>Fri</th>
                <th>Sat</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {dayCells.map((cell, i) => (
                <tr key={i}>
                  <td className={cell.isOtherMonth ? 'text-secondary' : ''}>
                    {cell.isOtherMonth ? '' : cell.day}
                    {cell.changeCount > 0 && (
                      <Badge variant="secondary" className="ms-1 small">
                        {cell.changeCount}+
                      </Badge>
                    )}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
        <div className="mt-3 small text-secondary">
          <p>Filters: department â€¢ service â€¢ Asset â€¢ type â€¢ risk â€¢ status â€¢ implementation lead â€¢ maintenance window</p>
          <p>Event fields: Change number â€¢ title â€¢ type â€¢ status â€¢ risk â€¢ planned start â€¢ planned end â€¢ downtime â€¢ department â€¢ conflict count</p>
          <p>Requirements: accessible labels â€¢ status text â€¢ mobile agenda â€¢ loading â€¢ empty â€¢ retry â€¢ no drag-and-drop rescheduling â€¢ explicit link to Change detail</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'warning' : 'secondary'}        />        <KPICard           label="Critical Conflicts"          value={kpi.critical_conflicts}          href="#/changes?has_conflicts=true&severity=critical"          variant={kpi.critical_conflicts > 0 ? 'danger' : 'secondary'}        />        <KPICard           label="Changes with Conflicts"          value={kpi.changes_with_conflicts}          href="#/changes?has_conflicts=true"        />      </Row>      {/* Other */}      <h5 className="mt-4">Other</h5>      <Row className="mt-2">        <KPICard           label="Emergency Changes"          value={kpi.emergency_changes}          href={priorityHref('emergency')}          variant={kpi.emergency_changes > 0 ? 'warning' : 'secondary'}        />        <KPICard           label="Emergency Rate"          value={kpi.emergency_rate.toFixed(1) + '%'}        />      </Row>    </div>  );}


===== src\pages\changes\ChangeDetail.jsx =====

/* 
 * Change Detail - displays detailed information about a change
 * Route: #/changes/:id
 */

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { PageHeader, Badge, Button } from '../../components';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { fetchPage, parseApiError, formatDate, formatDateTime, statusBadgeVariant, riskBadgeVariant, priorityBadgeVariant, actionAvailability, STATUS_LABELS, CHANGE_TYPE_LABELS, RISK_LEVEL_LABELS, PRIORITY_LABELS } from '../../shared/changes-utils';

export function ChangeDetail({ match }) {
  const { isStaff, role } = useAuth();
  const [change, setChange] = useState({});
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('overview');
  const [actionErrors, setActionErrors] = useState(null);

  const tabLabels = {
    overview: 'Overview',
    impact: 'Impact',
    plans: 'Plans',
    assets: 'Assets',
    services: 'Services',
    tasks: 'Tasks',
    risk: 'Risk',
    approvals: 'Approvals',
    schedule: 'Schedule',
    conflicts: 'Conflicts',
    attachments: 'Attachments',
    communications: 'Communications',
    stakeholders: 'Stakeholders',
    implementation: 'Implementation',
    pir: 'PIR',
    related_tickets: 'Related Tickets',
    kb: 'Knowledge Base',
    history: 'History',
  };

  // Action buttons based on user role and change status
  const getActions = () => {
    if (!change || !isStaff) return null;
    const status = change.status;
    const actions = [];
    
    // Draft actions
    if (status === 'draft') {
      if (actionAvailability(role, status, 'submit_draft')) {
        actions.push({ label: 'Submit for Review', onClick: () => submitChange(), variant: 'primary' });
      }
      actions.push({ label: 'Edit', href: `#/changes/${change.id}/edit`, variant: 'secondary' });
    }
    
    // Submitted/Risk Assessment/Technical Review actions
    if (['submitted', 'risk_assessment', 'technical_review'].includes(status)) {
      if (actionAvailability(role, status, 'edit_own_draft')) {
        actions.push({ label: 'Edit', href: `#/changes/${change.id}/edit`, variant: 'secondary' });
      }
      if (actionAvailability(role, status, 'cancel')) {
        actions.push({ label: 'Cancel', onClick: () => cancelChange(), variant: 'danger' });
      }
    }
    
    // Pending approval actions (for approvers)
    if (status === 'pending_approval') {
      if (actionAvailability(role, status, 'approve')) {
        actions.push({ label: 'Approve', onClick: () => approveChange(), variant: 'success' });
      }
      if (actionAvailability(role, status, 'reject')) {
        actions.push({ label: 'Reject', onClick: () => rejectChange(), variant: 'danger' });
      }
      if (actionAvailability(role, status, 'return_correction')) {
        actions.push({ label: 'Return for Correction', onClick: () => returnForCorrection(), variant: 'warning' });
      }
      if (actionAvailability(role, status, 'cancel')) {
        actions.push({ label: 'Cancel', onClick: () => cancelChange(), variant: 'danger' });
      }
    }
    
    // Approved actions
    if (status === 'approved') {
      if (actionAvailability(role, status, 'schedule')) {
        actions.push({ label: 'Schedule', href: `#/changes/${change.id}/implementation`, variant: 'primary' });
      }
      if (actionAvailability(role, status, 'cancel')) {
        actions.push({ label: 'Cancel', onClick: () => cancelChange(), variant: 'danger' });
      }
    }
    
    // Scheduled actions
    if (status === 'scheduled') {
      if (actionAvailability(role, status, 'start_implementation')) {
        actions.push({ label: 'Start Implementation', onClick: () => startImplementation(), variant: 'primary' });
      }
      if (actionAvailability(role, status, 'hold')) {
        actions.push({ label: 'Put on Hold', onClick: () => holdChange(), variant: 'warning' });
      }
      if (actionAvailability(role, status, 'reschedule')) {
        actions.push({ label: 'Reschedule', onClick: () => rescheduleChange(), variant: 'secondary' });
      }
    }
    
    // In Progress actions
    if (status === 'in_progress') {
      if (actionAvailability(role, status, 'begin_validation')) {
        actions.push({ label: 'Begin Validation', onClick: () => beginValidation(), variant: 'success' });
      }
      if (actionAvailability(role, status, 'fail')) {
        actions.push({ label: 'Fail Implementation', onClick: () => failChange(), variant: 'danger' });
      }
      if (actionAvailability(role, status, 'start_rollback')) {
        actions.push({ label: 'Start Rollback', onClick: () => startRollback(), variant: 'warning' });
      }
      if (actionAvailability(role, status, 'hold')) {
        actions.push({ label: 'Put on Hold', onClick: () => holdChange(), variant: 'warning' });
      }
    }
    
    // Validation actions
    if (status === 'validation') {
      if (actionAvailability(role, status, 'complete')) {
        actions.push({ label: 'Complete', onClick: () => completeChange(), variant: 'success' });
      }
      if (actionAvailability(role, status, 'fail')) {
        actions.push({ label: 'Fail', onClick: () => failChange(), variant: 'danger' });
      }
    }
    
    // Completed actions
    if (status === 'completed') {
      if (actionAvailability(role, status, 'request_pir')) {
        actions.push({ label: 'Request PIR', onClick: () => requestPIR(), variant: 'primary' });
      }
    }
    
    // PIR Required actions
    if (status === 'pir_required') {
      if (actionAvailability(role, status, 'close')) {
        actions.push({ label: 'Close Change', onClick: () => closeChange(), variant: 'success' });
      }
    }
    
    // Failed actions
    if (status === 'failed') {
      if (actionAvailability(role, status, 'start_rollback')) {
        actions.push({ label: 'Start Rollback', onClick: () => startRollback(), variant: 'warning' });
      }
      if (actionAvailability(role, status, 'close')) {
        actions.push({ label: 'Close Change', onClick: () => closeChange(), variant: 'secondary' });
      }
    }
    
    // Rolled Back actions
    if (status === 'rolled_back') {
      if (actionAvailability(role, status, 'close')) {
        actions.push({ label: 'Close Change', onClick: () => closeChange(), variant: 'success' });
      }
    }
    
    // On Hold actions
    if (status === 'on_hold') {
      if (actionAvailability(role, status, 'resume')) {
        actions.push({ label: 'Resume', onClick: () => resumeChange(), variant: 'primary' });
      }
      if (actionAvailability(role, status, 'cancel')) {
        actions.push({ label: 'Cancel', onClick: () => cancelChange(), variant: 'danger' });
      }
    }
    
    return actions;
  };

  const handleAction = async (action) => {
    if (action.href) {
      window.location.hash = action.href;
      return;
    }
    setActionErrors(null);
    try {
      const endpoints = {
        submitChange: `/changes/${change.id}/submit/`,
        cancelChange: `/changes/${change.id}/cancel/`,
        approveChange: `/changes/${change.id}/approve/`,
        rejectChange: `/changes/${change.id}/reject/`,
        returnForCorrection: `/changes/${change.id}/return_for_correction/`,
        startImplementation: `/changes/${change.id}/start_implementation/`,
        beginValidation: `/changes/${change.id}/begin_validation/`,
        completeChange: `/changes/${change.id}/complete/`,
        failChange: `/changes/${change.id}/fail/`,
        startRollback: `/changes/${change.id}/start_rollback/`,
        requestPIR: `/changes/${change.id}/request_pir/`,
        closeChange: `/changes/${change.id}/close/`,
        holdChange: `/changes/${change.id}/hold/`,
        resumeChange: `/changes/${change.id}/resume/`,
        rescheduleChange: `/changes/${change.id}/reschedule/`,
      };
      const endpoint = endpoints[action.label.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '_')];
      if (endpoint) {
        const body = action.body || {};
        const response = await fetch(endpoint, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('access')}` },
          body: JSON.stringify(body),
        });
        if (!response.ok) {
          const errorData = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
          setActionErrors(errorData.detail || Object.values(errorData).join(' '));
          return;
        }
        // Refresh the change data
        const refreshed = await fetchPage(`/changes/${change.id}/`);
        setChange(refreshed);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setActionErrors(parseApiError(err));
    }
  };

  const submitChange = () => handleAction({ label: 'Submit for Review' });
  const cancelChange = () => {
    if (window.confirm('Are you sure you want to cancel this change?')) {
      handleAction({ label: 'Cancel' });
    }
  };
  const approveChange = () => {
    const reason = window.prompt('Approval decision reason (optional):');
    handleAction({ label: 'Approve', body: { decision_reason: reason || '' } });
  };
  const rejectChange = () => {
    const reason = window.prompt('Rejection reason (required):');
    if (reason !== null) {
      handleAction({ label: 'Reject', body: { decision_reason: reason } });
    }
  };
  const returnForCorrection = () => handleAction({ label: 'Return for Correction' });
  const startImplementation = () => handleAction({ label: 'Start Implementation' });
  const beginValidation = () => handleAction({ label: 'Begin Validation' });
  const completeChange = () => {
    const notes = window.prompt('Implementation notes (optional):');
    handleAction({ label: 'Complete', body: { implementation_notes: notes || '' } });
  };
  const failChange = () => {
    const reason = window.prompt('Failure reason (required):');
    if (reason !== null) {
      handleAction({ label: 'Fail Implementation', body: { failure_reason: reason } });
    }
  };
  const startRollback = () => handleAction({ label: 'Start Rollback' });
  const requestPIR = () => handleAction({ label: 'Request PIR' });
  const closeChange = () => {
    const summary = window.prompt('Closure summary (optional):');
    handleAction({ label: 'Close Change', body: { closure_summary: summary || '' } });
  };
  const holdChange = () => handleAction({ label: 'Put on Hold' });
  const resumeChange = () => handleAction({ label: 'Resume' });
  const rescheduleChange = () => {
    window.location.hash = `#/changes/${change.id}/implementation`;
  };


  useEffect(() => {
    const id = match.params.id;
    if (!id) return;
    fetchPage(`/changes/${id}/`)
      .then((data) => {
        setChange(data);
        setLoading(false);
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        setError(parseApiError(e));
        setLoading(false);
      });
  }, [match.params.id]);

  const { change_number, title, change_type, status, risk_level, priority,
          change_owner, implementation_lead, planned_start, planned_end,
          version, conflicts_count, description, business_reason,
          customer_impact, business_impact, technical_impact } = change;

  const renderOverview = () =>
  <div>
    <p><strong>Change Number:</strong> {change_number}</p>
    <p><strong>Title:</strong> {title}</p>
    <p><strong>Type:</strong> {CHANGE_TYPE_LABELS[change_type] || change_type}</p>
    <p><strong>Status:</strong> <Badge kind={statusBadgeVariant(status)}>{STATUS_LABELS[status] || status}</Badge></p>
    <p><strong>Risk:</strong> <Badge kind={riskBadgeVariant(risk_level)}>{RISK_LEVEL_LABELS[risk_level] || risk_level}</Badge></p>
    <p><strong>Priority:</strong> <Badge kind={priorityBadgeVariant(priority)}>{PRIORITY_LABELS[priority] || priority}</Badge></p>
    <p><strong>Owner:</strong> {change_owner ? `${change_owner.employee_id} â€” ${change_owner.email}` : 'Unassigned'}</p>
    <p><strong>Implementation Lead:</strong> {implementation_lead ? `${implementation_lead.employee_id} â€” ${implementation_lead.email}` : 'Unassigned'}</p>
    <p><strong>Planned Start:</strong> {formatDate(planned_start)}</p>
    <p><strong>Planned End:</strong> {formatDate(planned_end)}</p>
    <p><strong>Version:</strong> {version}</p>
    <p><strong>Conflict Count:</strong> {conflicts_count || 0}</p>
  </div>;

  const renderImpact = () =>
  <div>
    <p><strong>Description:</strong> {description || ''}</p>
    <p><strong>Business Reason:</strong> {business_reason || ''}</p>
    <p><strong>Customer Impact:</strong> {customer_impact || ''}</p>
    <p><strong>Business Impact:</strong> {business_impact || ''}</p>
    <p><strong>Technical Impact:</strong> {technical_impact || ''}</p>
    <hr />
    <p><strong>Scope:</strong> {change.scope || ''}</p>
    <p><strong>Out of Scope:</strong> {change.out_of_scope || ''}</p>
  </div>;

  const { implementation_plan, validation_plan, rollback_plan,
          communication_plan, success_criteria } = change;

  const renderPlans = () =>
  <div>
    <p><strong>Implementation Plan:</strong> {implementation_plan || ''}</p>
    <p><strong>Validation Plan:</strong> {validation_plan || ''}</p>
    <p><strong>Rollback Plan:</strong> {rollback_plan || ''}</p>
    <p><strong>Communication Plan:</strong> {communication_plan || ''}</p>
    <p><strong>Success Criteria:</strong> {success_criteria || ''}</p>
  </div>;

  const { asset_impacts } = change;

  const renderAssets = () =>
  <div>
    {asset_impacts ? (
      <div>
        {asset_impacts.map((a, i) => (
          <div key={a.id || i} className="mt-1">
            <strong>{a.asset ? a.asset.name : 'Asset'}:</strong> {a.asset?.asset_id || a.name || 'N/A'}
            {a.service ? ` â€” Service: ${a.service.name}` : ''}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    ) : (
      <p>No assets affected</p>
    )}
  </div>;

  const { service_impacts } = change;

  const renderServices = () =>
  <div>
    {service_impacts ? (
      <div>
        {service_impacts.map((s, i) => (
          <div key={s.id || i} className="mt-1">
            <strong>{s.service ? s.service.name : 'Service'}:</strong> {s.service?.name || s.name || 'N/A'}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    ) : (
      <p>No services affected</p>
    )}
  </div>;

  const { tasks } = change;

  const renderTasks = () =>
  <div>
    {tasks ? (
      <div>
        {tasks.map((t, i) => (
          <div key={t.id || i} className="mt-1">
            <strong>{t.title}</strong> â€” Status: {t.status || 'pending'}
            {t.assigned_to ? ` â€” Assigned: ${t.assigned_to.employee_id}` : ''}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    ) : (
      <p>No tasks</p>
    )}
  </div>;

  const { risk_assessment } = change;

  const renderRisk = () =>
  <div>
    {risk_assessment ? (
      <div>
        <p><strong>Calculated Risk:</strong> {risk_assessment.calculated_risk || 'â€”'}</p>
        <p><strong>Assessment Version:</strong> {risk_assessment.version || 'â€”'}</p>
        <p><strong>Assessor:</strong> {risk_assessment.assessor || 'â€”'}</p>
        <p><strong>Date:</strong> {risk_assessment.date || 'â€”'}</p>
        <p><strong>Override:</strong> {risk_assessment.override ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</p>
        {risk_assessment.override_reason && <p><strong>Override Reason:</strong> {risk_assessment.override_reason}</p>}
      </div>
    ) : (
      <p>No risk assessment</p>
    )}
  </div>;

  const { approvals } = change;

  const renderApprovals = () =>
  <div>
    {approvals ? (
      <div>
        {approvals.map((a, i) => (
          <div key={a.id || i} className="mt-1">
            <strong>Level {a.approval_level}:</strong> {a.status} by {a.decided_by || 'â€”'} on {a.decided_date || 'â€”'}
            {a.decision_reason && <p><em>{a.decision_reason}</em></p>}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    ) : (
      <p>No approvals</p>
    )}
  </div>;

  const { scheduled_at, expected_downtime_minutes } = change;

  const renderSchedule = () =>
  <div>
    <p><strong>Planned Start:</strong> {formatDateTime(planned_start)}</p>
    <p><strong>Planned End:</strong> {formatDateTime(planned_end)}</p>
    <p><strong>Expected Downtime:</strong> {expected_downtime_minutes ? `${expected_downtime_minutes} minutes` : 'â€”'}</p>
    <p><strong>Scheduled:</strong> {scheduled_at ? formatDate(scheduled_at) : 'â€”'}</p>
  </div>;

  const { conflicts } = change;

  const renderConflicts = () =>
  <div>
    {conflicts ? (
      <div>
        {conflicts.map((c, i) => (
          <div key={c.id || i} className="mt-1">
            <strong>{c.conflicting_change_number}</strong> â€” {c.severity}
            {c.status && <p>{c.status}</p>}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    ) : (
      <p>No conflicts</p>
    )}
  </div>;

  const { attachments } = change;

  const renderAttachments = () =>
  <div>
    {attachments ? (
      <div>
        {attachments.map((a, i) => (
          <div key={a.id || i} className="mt-1">
            <strong>{a.document_type}</strong>: {a.filename}
            {a.uploader && <p>Uploader: {a.uploader.email}</p>}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    ) : (
      <p>No attachments</p>
    )}
  </div>;

  const { communications } = change;

  const renderCommunications = () =>
  <div>
    {communications ? (
      <div>
        {communications.map((c, i) => (
          <div key={c.id || i} className="mt-1">
            <strong>{c.type}</strong>: {c.subject}
            {c.sent_at && <p>Sent: {formatDateTime(c.sent_at)}</p>}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    ) : (
      <p>No communications</p>
    )}
  </div>;

  const { stakeholders } = change;

  const renderStakeholders = () =>
  <div>
    {stakeholders ? (
      <div>
        {stakeholders.map((s, i) => (
          <div key={s.id || i} className="mt-1">
            <strong>{s.user?.employee_id}:</strong> {s.user?.email}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    ) : (
      <p>No stakeholders</p>
    )}
  </div>;

  const { implementation } = change;

  const renderImplementation = () =>
  <div>
    {implementation ? (
      <div>
        <p><strong>Status:</strong> {implementation.status || 'â€”'}</p>
        <p><strong>Started:</strong> {implementation.started_by ? implementation.started_by.employee_id : 'â€”'}</p>
        <p><strong>Completed:</strong> {implementation.completed_by ? implementation.completed_by.employee_id : 'â€”'}</p>
        <p><strong>Outcome:</strong> {implementation.outcome || 'â€”'}</p>
      </div>
    ) : (
      <p>No implementation record</p>
    )}
  </div>;

  const { post_implementation_review } = change;

  const renderPIR = () =>
  <div>
    {post_implementation_review ? (
      <div>
        <p><strong>Reviewer:</strong> {post_implementation_review.reviewer?.employee_id || 'â€”'}</p>
        <p><strong>Status:</strong> {post_implementation_review.status}</p>
        <p><strong>Outcome:</strong> {post_implementation_review.outcome}</p>
        <p><strong>Objectives Met:</strong> {post_implementation_review.objectives_met ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</p>
      </div>
    ) : (
      <p>No PIR</p>
    )}
  </div>;

  const { related_tickets } = change;

  const renderRelatedTickets = () =>
  <div>
    {related_tickets ? (
      <div>
        {related_tickets.map((t, i) => (
          <div key={t.id || i} className="mt-1">
            <strong>{t.ticket ? t.ticket.ticket_id : 'Ticket'}</strong> â€” {t.role || ''}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    ) : (
      <p>No related tickets</p>
    )}
  </div>;

  const { knowledge_links } = change;

  const renderKnowledgeBase = () =>
  <div>
    {knowledge_links ? (
      <div>
        {knowledge_links.map((l, i) => (
          <div key={l.id || i} className="mt-1">
            <strong>{l.article_title}</strong>: {l.relation_type}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    ) : (
      <p>No knowledge base references</p>
    )}
  </div>;

  const { history } = change;

  const renderHistory = () =>
  <div>
    {history ? (
      <div>
        {history.map((h, i) => (
          <div key={h.id || i} className="mt-1">
            <strong>{h.event_type}</strong>: {h.timestamp}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    ) : (
      <p>No history</p>
    )}
  </div>;

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="mt-3"><p>Loading changeâ€¦</p></div>;
  }

  if (error) {
    return <div className="mt-3"><p className="text-danger">Error: {error.global ?? 'Unknown error'}</p></div>;
  }

  if (!change) {
    return <div className="mt-3"><p>Change not found</p></div>;
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title={change.change_number} subtitle={change.title} />
      <div className="mt-3">
        {Object.entries(tabLabels).map(([key, label]) => (
          <button
            key={key}
            className={`btn ${activeTab === key ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-secondary'}`}
            onClick={() => setActiveTab(key)}
          >
            {label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      {/* Action buttons based on permissions and status */}
      {isStaff && change && (
        <div className="mt-3 action-bar">
          {getActions().map((action, idx) => (
            action.href ? (
              <a key={idx} href={action.href} className={`btn btn-${action.variant || 'secondary'}`}>
                {action.label}
              </a>
            ) : (
              <Button key={idx} kind={action.variant || 'secondary'} onClick={() => handleAction(action)}>
                {action.label}
              </Button>
            )
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
      {/* Action errors */}
      {actionErrors && (
        <div className="mt-3 alert alert-danger">
          <p className="mb-0">{actionErrors}</p>
        </div>
      )}
      {activeTab === 'overview' && renderOverview()}
      {activeTab === 'impact' && renderImpact()}
      {activeTab === 'plans' && renderPlans()}
      {activeTab === 'assets' && renderAssets()}
      {activeTab === 'services' && renderServices()}
      {activeTab === 'tasks' && renderTasks()}
      {activeTab === 'risk' && renderRisk()}
      {activeTab === 'approvals' && renderApprovals()}
      {activeTab === 'schedule' && renderSchedule()}
      {activeTab === 'conflicts' && renderConflicts()}
      {activeTab === 'attachments' && renderAttachments()}
      {activeTab === 'communications' && renderCommunications()}
      {activeTab === 'stakeholders' && renderStakeholders()}
      {activeTab === 'implementation' && renderImplementation()}
      {activeTab === 'pir' && renderPIR()}
      {activeTab === 'related_tickets' && renderRelatedTickets()}
      {activeTab === 'kb' && renderKnowledgeBase()}
      {activeTab === 'history' && renderHistory()}
    </div>
  );
}


===== src\pages\changes\ChangeForm.jsx =====

/*
 * Change Form - multi-step wizard for creating and editing changes
 * Routes: #/changes/new, #/changes/:id/edit
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Form, Input, Select, Textarea, Button, Row, Col } from '../../components';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { CHANGE_TYPE_LABELS, CATEGORY_LABELS, PRIORITY_LABELS } from '../../shared/changes-utils';

const STEP1 = 'classification';
const STEP2 = 'description';
const STEP3 = 'planning';
const STEP4 = 'technical-plans';
const STEP5 = 'affected-records';
const STEP6 = 'review';

export function ChangeForm({ changeId = null }) {
  useAuth();
  const [step, setStep] = useState(STEP1);
  const [change, setChange] = useState({
    title: '',
    change_type: 'normal',
    category: '',
    priority: 'normal',
    risk_level: 'low',
    planned_start: '',
    planned_end: '',
    business_reason: '',
    scope: '',
    out_of_scope: '',
    customer_impact: '',
    business_impact: '',
    technical_impact: '',
    implementation_plan: '',
    validation_plan: '',
    rollback_plan: '',
    communication_plan: '',
    success_criteria: '',
    planned_downtime_minutes: 0,
    department: '',
    change_owner: null,
    implementation_lead: null,
    assets: [],
    services: [],
    related_tickets: [],
    knowledge_base_references: [],
  });
  const [, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (changeId) {
      // TODO: load existing change from API
    }
  }, [changeId]);

  const validate = () => {
    const e = {};
    if (!change.title) e.title = 'Required';
    if (!change.change_type) e.change_type = 'Required';
    if (!change.category) e.category = 'Required';
    if (!change.priority) e.priority = 'Required';
    setErrors(e);
    return Object.keys(e).length === 0;
  };

  const next = () => {
    if (!validate()) return;
    const steps = { [STEP1]: STEP2, [STEP2]: STEP3, [STEP3]: STEP4, [STEP4]: STEP5, [STEP5]: STEP6 };
    setStep(steps[step]);
  };

  const prev = () => {
    const steps = { [STEP6]: STEP5, [STEP5]: STEP4, [STEP4]: STEP3, [STEP3]: STEP2, STEP2: STEP1 };
    setStep(steps[step] || STEP1);
  };

  const handleAssetChange = (assets) => setChange(c => ({ ...c, assets }));
  const handleServiceChange = (services) => setChange(c => ({ ...c, services }));

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    // TODO: submit change to API
    setSubmitting(false);
  };

  if (step === STEP1) {
    return (
      <Form>
        <h2>Classification</h2>
        <Row>
          <Col sm={6}>
            <Select onChange={(e) => setChange(c => ({ ...c, change_type: e.target.value }))} value={change.change_type || ''}>
              <option value="">Select type</option>
              {Object.keys(CHANGE_TYPE_LABELS).map(k => (
                <option key={k} value={k}>{CHANGE_TYPE_LABELS[k]}</option>
              ))}
            </Select>
          </Col>
          <Col sm={6}>
            <Select onChange={(e) => setChange(c => ({ ...c, category: e.target.value }))} value={change.category || ''}>
              <option value="">Select category</option>
              {Object.keys(CATEGORY_LABELS).map(k => (
                <option key={k} value={k}>{CATEGORY_LABELS[k]}</option>
              ))}
            </Select>
          </Col>
        </Row>
        <Row className="mt-3"><Col sm={4}><Select onChange={(e) => setChange(c => ({ ...c, priority: e.target.value }))} value={change.priority || ''}><option value="">Priority</option>{Object.keys(PRIORITY_LABELS).map(k => (
          <option key={k} value={k}>{PRIORITY_LABELS[k]}</option>
        ))}</Select></Col><Col sm={4}><Select onChange={(e) => setChange(c => ({ ...c, risk_level: e.target.value }))} value={change.risk_level || ''}><option value="">Risk</option>{['low','medium','high','critical'].map(l => <option key={l} value={l}>{l}</option>)}</Select></Col><Col sm={4}><Input placeholder="Emergency" value={change.emergency_reason || ''} onChange={(e) => setChange(c => ({ ...c, emergency_reason: e.target }))} /></Col></Row>
        <Button onClick={next}>Next</Button><Button onClick={prev}>Cancel</Button>
      </Form>
    );
  }

  if (step === STEP2) {
    return (
      <Form>
        <h2>Description</h2>
        <Input placeholder="Title" value={change.title || ''} onChange={(e) => setChange(c => ({ ...c, title: e.target.value }))} required />
        <Textarea rows={3} placeholder="Description" value={change.description || ''} onChange={(e) => setChange(c => ({ ...c, description: e.target.value }))} />
        <Button onClick={next}>Next</Button><Button onClick={prev}>Previous</Button>
      </Form>
    );
  }

  if (step === STEP3) {
    return (
      <Form>
        <h2>Planning</h2>
        <Input type="datetime-local" value={change.planned_start || ''} onChange={(e) => setChange(c => ({ ...c, planned_start: e.target.value }))} />
        <Input type="datetime-local" value={change.planned_end || ''} onChange={(e) => setChange(c => ({ ...c, planned_end: e.target.value }))} />
        <Input placeholder="Expected downtime (minutes)" value={change.planned_downtime_minutes || ''} onChange={(e) => setChange(c => ({ ...c, planned_downtime_minutes: Number(e.target.value) || 0 }))} />
        <Button onClick={next}>Next</Button><Button onClick={prev}>Previous</Button>
      </Form>
    );
  }

  if (step === STEP4) {
    return (
      <Form>
        <h2>Technical Plans</h2>
        <Textarea rows={4} placeholder="Implementation plan" value={change.implementation_plan || ''} onChange={(e) => setChange(c => ({ ...c, implementation_plan: e.target.value }))} />
        <Textarea rows={4} placeholder="Validation plan" value={change.validation_plan || ''} onChange={(e) => setChange(c => ({ ...c, validation_plan: e.target.value }))} />
        <Textarea rows={4} placeholder="Rollback plan" value={change.rollback_plan || ''} onChange={(e) => setChange(c => ({ ...c, rollback_plan: e.target.value }))} />
        <Textarea rows={4} placeholder="Communication plan" value={change.communication_plan || ''} onChange={(e) => setChange(c => ({ ...c, communication_plan: e.target.value }))} />
        <Input placeholder="Success criteria" value={change.success_criteria || ''} onChange={(e) => setChange(c => ({ ...c, success_criteria: e.target.value }))} />
        <Button onClick={next}>Next</Button><Button onClick={prev}>Previous</Button>
      </Form>
    );
  }

  if (step === STEP5) {
    return (
      <Form>
        <h2>Affected Records</h2>
        <Row>
          <Col sm={6}><h4>Assets</h4><Select multiple onChange={(e) => handleAssetChange(e.target.value)}>{/* Asset options */}</Select></Col>
          <Col sm={6}><h4>Services</h4><Select multiple onChange={(e) => handleServiceChange(e.target.value)}>{/* Service options */}</Select></Col>
        </Row>
        <Row className="mt-3"><Col sm={12}><Input placeholder="Related Tickets (IDs)" value={change.related_tickets_str || ''} onChange={(e) => setChange(c => ({ ...c, related_tickets_str: e.target.value }))} /></Col></Row>
        <Row className="mt-3"><Col sm={12}><Input placeholder="KB References" value={change.knowledge_base_references_str || ''} onChange={(e) => setChange(c => ({ ...c, knowledge_base_references_str: e.target.value }))} /></Col></Row>
        <Button onClick={next}>Next</Button><Button onClick={prev}>Previous</Button>
      </Form>
    );
  }

  if (step === STEP6) {
    return (
      <Form>
        <h2>Review</h2>
        <p>Please review the change details before submitting.</p>
        <Button onClick={() => setSubmitting(true)} type="primary">Save Draft</Button>
        <Button onClick={handleSubmit} type="success">Save and Submit</Button>
        <Button onClick={prev}>Cancel</Button>
      </Form>
    );
  }

  return null;
}


===== src\pages\changes\ChangeImplementation.jsx =====

/* 
 * Change Implementation - implementation console for a change
 * Route: #/changes/:id/implementation
 */

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { PageHeader, Badge, Form, Button } from '../../components';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { fetchPage, parseApiError } from '../../shared/changes-utils';

export function ChangeImplementation({ match }) {
  const { role } = useAuth();
  const [change, setChange] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [elapsedMinutes, setElapsedMinutes] = useState(0);
  const [startTime, setStartTime] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const id = match.params.id;
    if (!id) return;
    fetchPage(`/changes/${id}/implementation/`)
      .then((data) => {
        setChange(data);
        setLoading(false);
        // Start elapsed timer if change is in progress
        if (data.status === 'in_progress' && data.implementation_start) {
          setStartTime(new Date(data.implementation_start));
          const interval = setInterval(() => {
            setElapsedMinutes(prev => prev + 60);
          }, 60000);
          return () => clearInterval(interval);
        }
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        setError(parseApiError(e));
        setLoading(false);
      });
  }, [match.params.id]);

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="mt-3"><p>Loading implementationâ€¦</p></div>;
  }

  if (error) {
    return <div className="mt-3"><p className="text-danger">Error: {error.global ?? 'Unknown error'}</p></div>;
  }

  if (!change) {
    return <div className="mt-3"><p>Change not found</p></div>;
  }

  // Calculate elapsed time
  const elapsed = startTime ? Math.floor((new Date().getTime() - startTime.getTime()) / 60000) : elapsedMinutes; // eslint-disable-line react/purity // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Implementation" subtitle={change.change_number} />
      <div className="mt-3">
        <p><strong>Change Number:</strong> {change.change_number}</p>
        <p><strong>Title:</strong> {change.title}</p>
        <hr />
        <div className="mt-3">
          <h4>Change Status</h4>
          <Badge kind={change.status ? 'primary' : 'secondary'}>
            {change.status || 'draft'}
          </Badge>
        </div>
        <div className="mt-3">
          <h4>Timing</h4>
          <p><strong>Planned Window:</strong> {change.planned_start ? new Date(change.planned_start).toLocaleString() : 'â€”'}</p>
          <p><strong>Actual Start:</strong> {startTime ? startTime.toLocaleString() : 'Not started'}</p>
          <p><strong>Elapsed:</strong> {elapsed} minutes</p>
        </div>
        {role === 'system_admin' && (
          <Form>
            <Button type="primary">Start Implementation</Button>
            <Button>Start Task</Button>
            <Button>Complete Task</Button>
            <Button>Record Task Failure</Button>
            <Button type="success">Begin Validation</Button>
            <Button>Complete Change</Button>
            <Button type="danger">Fail Change</Button>
            <Button>Start Rollback</Button>
            <Button>Complete Rollback</Button>
          </Form>
        )}
        {!role || role === 'employee' ? (
          <p className="text-muted small">Implementation actions available to privileged roles only</p>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== src\pages\changes\ChangeList.jsx =====

/*
 * Change List - displays paginated, filterable change list
 * Route: #/changes
 */

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Pager, EmptyState, Badge, PageSizeSelector } from '../../components';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { fetchPage, parseApiError, statusBadgeVariant, priorityBadgeVariant, riskBadgeVariant, buildChangeListUrl, formatDate, STATUS_LABELS, CHANGE_TYPE_LABELS, CATEGORY_LABELS, PRIORITY_LABELS, RISK_LEVEL_LABELS } from '../../shared/changes-utils';

const CHANGE_LIST_API = '/changes/';

export function ChangeList({ initialFilters = {} }) {
  const { isStaff, role } = useAuth();
  // Page-size preference persisted in localStorage; fall back to DRF default 20.
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 20;
    try {
      const saved = window.localStorage.getItem('itdesk.pageSize');
      const n = Number(saved);
      return saved && Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 && n <= 100 ? n : 20;
    } catch {
      return 20;
    }
  });
  const [changes, setChanges] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [filters] = useState({ ...initialFilters });
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [refreshKey, setRefreshKey] = useState(0);

  // Persist page-size preference without unnecessary writes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    try {
      if (window.localStorage.getItem('itdesk.pageSize') !== String(pageSize)) {
        window.localStorage.setItem('itdesk.pageSize', String(pageSize));
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore storage failures
    }
  }, [pageSize]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    setLoading(true); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    setError(null); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    const run = async () => {
      try {
        const url = buildChangeListUrl(filters, pageSize, page);
        const fullUrl = url ? `${CHANGE_LIST_API}${url}` : CHANGE_LIST_API;
        const response = await fetchPage(fullUrl);
        if (cancelled) return;
        setChanges(response.items ?? []);
      } catch (e) {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setError(parseApiError(e));
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    run();
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [filters, pageSize, page, refreshKey]);

  if (isStaff === false || role === 'employee') {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div>
      {loading ? (
        <div className="mt-3"><p>Loading changesâ€¦</p></div>
      ) : error ? (
        <div className="mt-3">
          <p className="text-danger">Error: {error.global ?? 'Unknown error'}</p>
          <button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary mt-1" onClick={() => setRefreshKey(prev => prev + 1)}>Retry</button>
        </div>
      ) : changes.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon="info-circle"
          title="No Changes Found"
          text="No changes match the current filters. Adjust the filters above to see changes."
        />
      ) : (
        <table className="table">
          <tbody>
            {changes.map((change) => (
              <tr key={change.id} className="align-middle">
                <td><strong>{change.change_number}</strong></td>
                <td>
                  <a href={`#/changes/${change.id}`} className="text-primary">
                    {change.title}
                  </a>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <Badge kind="status" value={change.change_type || 'standard'}>
                    {CHANGE_TYPE_LABELS[change.change_type] || change.change_type}
                  </Badge>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <Badge kind="status" value={change.category || 'other'}>
                    {CATEGORY_LABELS[change.category] || change.category}
                  </Badge>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <Badge kind={statusBadgeVariant(change.status)}>
                    {STATUS_LABELS[change.status] || change.status}
                  </Badge>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <Badge kind={riskBadgeVariant(change.risk_level)}>
                    {RISK_LEVEL_LABELS[change.risk_level] || change.risk_level}
                  </Badge>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <Badge kind={priorityBadgeVariant(change.priority)}>
                    {PRIORITY_LABELS[change.priority] || change.priority}
                  </Badge>
                </td>
                <td>
                  {change.change_owner_email || change.change_owner?.email || change.change_owner?.employee_id || (
                    change.change_owner ? <span>{change.change_owner}</span> : <span>Unassigned</span>
                  )}
                </td>
                <td>
                  {change.implementation_lead_email || change.implementation_lead?.email || change.implementation_lead?.employee_id || (
                    change.implementation_lead ? <span>{change.implementation_lead}</span> : <span>Unassigned</span>
                  )}
                </td>
                <td>{formatDate(change.planned_start)}</td>
                <td>{formatDate(change.planned_end)}</td>
                <td>
                  {change.conflicts_count !== undefined ? (
                    <Badge kind="low">{change.conflicts_count}</Badge>
                  ) : (
                    '-'
                  )}
                </td>
                <td>
                  {isStaff ? (
                    <div className="btn-group btn-group-sm">
                      <a href={`#/changes/${change.id}`} className="btn btn-link text-primary" title="View">View</a>
                    </div>
                  ) : null}
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      )}
      {changes.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <PageSizeSelector value={pageSize} onChange={setPageSize} />
          <Pager
            count={changes.length}
            page={page}
            pageSize={pageSize}
            onPageChange={(newPage) => setPage(newPage)}
            onPageSizeChange={(newSize) => {
              setPageSize(newSize);
              setPage(1);
              setRefreshKey(prev => prev + 1);
            }}
          />
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


===== src\pages\changes\ChangePIR.jsx =====

/* 
 * Change PIR - Post-Implementation Review
 * Route: #/changes/:id/pir
 */

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { PageHeader, Form, Row, Col, Button } from '../../components';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { fetchPage, parseApiError } from '../../shared/changes-utils';

export function ChangePIR({ match }) {
  const { role } = useAuth();
  const [pir, setPIR] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const id = match.params.id;
    if (!id) return;
    fetchPage(`/changes/${id}/pir/`)
      .then((data) => {
        setPIR(data);
        setLoading(false);
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        setError(parseApiError(e));
        setLoading(false);
      });
  }, [match.params.id]);

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="mt-3"><p>Loading PIRâ€¦</p></div>;
  }

  if (error) {
    return <div className="mt-3"><p className="text-danger">Error: {error.global ?? 'Unknown error'}</p></div>;
  }

  if (!pir) {
    return <div className="mt-3"><p>PIR not found</p></div>;
  }

  // Determine if waiver is allowed
  const canWaiver = role === 'system_admin';

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="PIR & Closure" subtitle={pir.change_number} />
      <div className="mt-3">
        <p><strong>Change Number:</strong> {pir.change_number}</p>
        <hr />
        <div className="mt-3">
          <h4>PIR Details</h4>
          <Row>
            <Col sm={6}><strong>Reviewer:</strong> {pir.reviewer?.employee_id || 'â€”'}</Col>
            <Col sm={6}><strong>Status:</strong> {pir.status}</Col>
          </Row>
          <Row className="mt-1">
            <Col sm={12}><strong>Outcome:</strong> {pir.outcome}</Col>
          </Row>
          <Row className="mt-1">
            <Col sm={6}><strong>Objectives Met:</strong> {pir.objectives_met ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</Col>
            <Col sm={6}><strong>Validation Successful:</strong> {pir.validation_successful ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</Col>
          </Row>
          <Row className="mt-1">
            <Col sm={6}><strong>Downtime Within Estimate:</strong> {pir.downtime_within_estimate ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</Col>
            <Col sm={6}><strong>Rollback Used:</strong> {pir.rollback_used ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</Col>
          </Row>
          <Row className="mt-1">
            <Col sm={12}><strong>Incident Created:</strong> {pir.incident_created ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</Col>
          </Row>
          {pir.lessons_learned && (
            <Row className="mt-3">
              <Col sm={12}><strong>Lessons Learned:</strong> {pir.lessons_learned}</Col>
            </Row>
          )}
          {pir.follow_up_actions && (
            <Row className="mt-3">
              <Col sm={12}><strong>Follow-Up Actions:</strong> {pir.follow_up_actions}</Col>
            </Row>
          )}
          {pir.knowledge_base_article && (
            <Row className="mt-3">
              <Col sm={12}><strong>Knowledge Base Article:</strong> {pir.knowledge_base_article}</Col>
            </Row>
          )}
        </div>
        {canWaiver && (
          <div className="mt-3">
            <h4>Waiver</h4>
            <p>System Admin waiver for PIR requirement</p>
            <Form>
              <Button type="primary">Waive PIR</Button>
            </Form>
          </div>
        )}
        {role === 'system_admin' && (
          <div className="mt-3">
            <h4>Close Change</h4>
            <p>Close the change through the official action</p>
            <Form>
              <Button type="success">Close Change</Button>
            </Form>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== src\pages\changes\ChangeReports.jsx =====

/* 
 * Change Reports - change reports
 * Route: #/changes/reports
 */

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { PageHeader, Card } from '../../components';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { fetchPage, parseApiError } from '../../shared/changes-utils';

export function ChangeReports() {
  const { isStaff, role } = useAuth();
  const [reports, setReports] = useState({
    success_rate: 0,
    emergency_rate: 0,
    failures: 0,
    downtime: 0,
    risk: 0,
    conflicts: 0,
    pir: 0,
    by_service: [],
    by_asset: [],
  });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isStaff && role !== 'it_manager') {
      setReports({ // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
        success_rate: 0, emergency_rate: 0, failures: 0, downtime: 0,
        risk: 0, conflicts: 0, pir: 0, by_service: [], by_asset: [],
      });
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }
    fetchPage(`/changes/reports/`)
      .then((data) => {
        setReports(data);
        setLoading(false);
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        setError(parseApiError(e));
        setLoading(false);
      });
  }, [isStaff, role]);

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="mt-3"><p>Loading reportsâ€¦</p></div>;
  }

  if (error) {
    return <div className="mt-3"><p className="text-danger">Error: {error.global ?? 'Unknown error'}</p></div>;
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Change Reports" />
      <div className="mt-3 row">
        <div className="col-md-4">
          <Card>
            <Card.Body>
              <Card.Title>Success Rate</Card.Title>
              <Card.Text>{reports.success_rate}%</Card.Text>
            </Card.Body>
          </Card>
        </div>
        <div className="col-md-4">
          <Card>
            <Card.Body>
              <Card.Title>Emergency Rate</Card.Title>
              <Card.Text>{reports.emergency_rate}%</Card.Text>
            </Card.Body>
          </Card>
        </div>
        <div className="col-md-4">
          <Card>
            <Card.Body>
              <Card.Title>Failures</Card.Title>
              <Card.Text>{reports.failures}</Card.Text>
            </Card.Body>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-3 row">
        <div className="col-md-6">
          <Card>
            <Card.Body>
              <Card.Title>Total Downtime</Card.Title>
              <Card.Text>{reports.downtime} minutes</Card.Text>
            </Card.Body>
          </Card>
        </div>
        <div className="col-md-6">
          <Card>
            <Card.Body>
              <Card.Title>Risk</Card.Title>
              <Card.Text>{reports.risk}</Card.Text>
            </Card.Body>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-3 row">
        <div className="col-md-6">
          <Card>
            <Card.Body>
              <Card.Title>Open Conflicts</Card.Title>
              <Card.Text>{reports.conflicts}</Card.Text>
            </Card.Body>
          </Card>
        </div>
        <div className="col-md-6">
          <Card>
            <Card.Body>
              <Card.Title>PIR</Card.Title>
              <Card.Text>{reports.pir}</Card.Text>
            </Card.Body>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-3 row">
        <div className="col-md-6">
          <Card>
            <Card.Body>
              <Card.Title>By Service</Card.Title>
              <Card.Text>{JSON.stringify(reports.by_service)}</Card.Text>
            </Card.Body>
          </Card>
        </div>
        <div className="col-md-6">
          <Card>
            <Card.Body>
              <Card.Title>By Asset</Card.Title>
              <Card.Text>{JSON.stringify(reports.by_asset)}</Card.Text>
            </Card.Body>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* 
 * Change Review Meetings - change review meetings
 * Route: #/change-review-meetings
 */

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { PageHeader, Row, Col } from '../../components';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { fetchPage, parseApiError } from '../../shared/changes-utils';

export function ChangeReviewMeetings() {
  const { isStaff, role } = useAuth();
  const [meetings, setMeetings] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isStaff && role !== 'it_manager') {
      setMeetings([]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
      setLoading(false); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
      return;
    }
    fetchPage('/changes/review-meetings/')
      .then((data) => {
        setMeetings(data.items);
        setLoading(false);
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        setError(parseApiError(e));
        setLoading(false);
      });
  }, [isStaff, role]);

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="mt-3"><p>Loading meetingsâ€¦</p></div>;
  }

  if (error) {
    return <div className="mt-3"><p className="text-danger">Error: {error.global ?? 'Unknown error'}</p></div>;
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Review Meetings" />
      <div className="mt-3">
        <p><strong>Total Meetings:</strong> {meetings.length}</p>
        {meetings.length === 0 ? (
          <p>No meetings found</p>
        ) : (
          <div>
            {meetings.map((m, i) => (
              <div key={m.id || i} className="mt-3 p-2 border rounded">
                <Row>
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Meeting Date:</strong> {m.meeting_date}</Col>
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Change:</strong> {m.change?.change_number}</Col>
                </Row>
                <Row className="mt-1">
                  <Col sm={12}>
                    <strong>Agenda:</strong> {m.agenda}
                  </Col>
                </Row>
                <Row className="mt-1">
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Attendees:</strong> {m.attendees || 'â€”'}</Col>
                  <Col sm={6}>
                    {m.recommendation && (
                      <p><strong>Recommendation:</strong> {m.recommendation}</p>
                    )}
                  </Col>
                </Row>
                {m.defer && (
                  <Row className="mt-2">
                    <Col sm={12}><small>Deferred</small></Col>
                  </Row>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

          </Row>
