===== src\pages\changes\ChangeSchedule.jsx =====

/* 
 * Change Scheduling - enhanced scheduling panel for a change
 * Route: #/changes/:id/implementation (or #/changes/:id/schedule)
 * 
 * Displays scheduled changes, conflicts, and scheduling UI.
 */

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { PageHeader, Badge, Button, Form, Input, EmptyState } from '../../components';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { fetchPage, parseApiError, formatDateTime, statusBadgeVariant, riskBadgeVariant, priorityBadgeVariant } from '../../shared/changes-utils';

export function ChangeSchedule({ match }) {
  const { isStaff } = useAuth();
  const [change, setChange] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [readiness, setReadiness] = useState(null);
  const [conflicts, setConflicts] = useState([]);
  const [scheduleConflicts, setScheduleConflicts] = useState([]);
  const [blackoutPeriods, setBlackoutPeriods] = useState([]);
  const [maintenanceWindows, setMaintenanceWindows] = useState([]);
  const [schedulingExceptions, setSchedulingExceptions] = useState([]);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [actionError, setActionError] = useState(null);

  // Scheduling form state
  const [plannedStart, setPlannedStart] = useState('');
  const [plannedEnd, setPlannedEnd] = useState('');
  const [expectedDowntime, setExpectedDowntime] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    const id = match.params.id;
    if (!id) return;
    Promise.all([
      fetchPage(`/changes/${id}/`),
      fetchPage(`/changes/${id}/readiness/`),
      fetchPage(`/changes/${id}/conflicts/`),
      fetchPage(`/changes/${id}/schedule_conflicts/`),
      fetchPage(`/blackout-periods/`),
      fetchPage(`/maintenance-windows/`),
      fetchPage(`/scheduling-exceptions/`),
    ]).then(([changeData, readinessData, conflictsData, scheduleData, blackoutData, maintenanceData, exceptionData]) => {
      setChange(changeData);
      setReadiness(readinessData);
      setConflicts(conflictsData || []);
      setScheduleConflicts(scheduleData || []);
      setBlackoutPeriods((blackoutData && blackoutData.items) || blackoutData || []);
      setMaintenanceWindows((maintenanceData && maintenanceData.items) || maintenanceData || []);
      const exItems = (exceptionData && exceptionData.items) || exceptionData || [];
      setSchedulingExceptions(exItems.filter((ex) => String(ex.change) === String(id) || ex.change === parseInt(id, 10) || (ex.change && ex.change.id === parseInt(id, 10))));
      // Pre-fill form with existing scheduled times
      if (changeData.planned_start) {
        setPlannedStart(formatDateTimeForInput(changeData.planned_start));
      }
      if (changeData.planned_end) {
        setPlannedEnd(formatDateTimeForInput(changeData.planned_end));
      }
      if (changeData.expected_downtime_minutes) {
        setExpectedDowntime(changeData.expected_downtime_minutes);
      }
      setLoading(false);
    }).catch((e) => {
      setError(parseApiError(e));
      setLoading(false);
    });
  }, [match.params.id]);

  function formatDateTimeForInput(dateTimeStr) {
    if (!dateTimeStr) return '';
    const d = new Date(dateTimeStr);
    if (isNaN(d)) return '';
    // Format as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM for datetime-local input
    const pad = (n) => n.toString().padStart(2, '0');
    return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}T${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}`;
  }

  const handleSchedule = async () => {
    if (submitting) return;
    if (!plannedStart || !plannedEnd) {
      setActionError('Planned start and end are required.');
      return;
    }
    setSubmitting(true);
    setActionError(null);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/changes/${match.params.id}/schedule/`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 
          'Content-Type': 'application/json', 
          'Authorization': `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('access')}` 
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          planned_start: plannedStart,
          planned_end: plannedEnd,
          expected_downtime_minutes: expectedDowntime ? parseInt(expectedDowntime) : null,
        }),
      });
      if (!response.ok) {
        const errorData = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
        let msg = errorData.detail || errorData.scheduling_policy || Object.values(errorData).join(' ');
        if (!msg) msg = 'Scheduling failed.';
        setActionError(msg);
        setSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }
      // Refresh data
      const refreshed = await fetchPage(`/changes/${match.params.id}/`);
      setChange(refreshed);
      const scheduleData = await fetchPage(`/changes/${match.params.id}/schedule_conflicts/`);
      setScheduleConflicts(scheduleData || []);
    } catch (err) {
      setActionError(parseApiError(err));
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="mt-3"><p>Loading schedule...</p></div>;
  }

  if (error) {
    return <div className="mt-3"><p className="text-danger">Error: {error.global ?? 'Unknown error'}</p></div>;
  }

  if (!change) {
    return <div className="mt-3"><p>Change not found</p></div>;
  }

  const canSchedule = isStaff && (change.status === 'approved' || change.status === 'on_hold');

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Scheduling" subtitle={change.change_number} />
      
      <div className="mt-3">
        <p><strong>Change Number:</strong> {change.change_number}</p>
        <p><strong>Title:</strong> {change.title}</p>
        <hr />
        
        {/* Current Schedule */}
        <div className="panel panel-default mt-3">
          <div className="panel-heading">Current Schedule</div>
          <div className="panel-body">
            <p><strong>Status:</strong> <Badge kind={statusBadgeVariant(change.status)}>{change.status}</Badge></p>
            {change.planned_start && (
              <p><strong>Planned Start:</strong> {formatDateTime(change.planned_start)}</p>
            )}
            {change.planned_end && (
              <p><strong>Planned End:</strong> {formatDateTime(change.planned_end)}</p>
            )}
            {change.expected_downtime_minutes && (
              <p><strong>Expected Downtime:</strong> {change.expected_downtime_minutes} minutes</p>
            )}
            {change.scheduled_at && (
              <p><strong>Scheduled At:</strong> {formatDateTime(change.scheduled_at)}</p>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Readiness */}
        {readiness && (
          <div className="panel panel-default mt-3">
            <div className="panel-heading">Readiness</div>
            <div className="panel-body">
              <p><strong>Ready:</strong> {readiness.ready ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</p>
              {readiness.blockers && readiness.blockers.length > 0 && (
                <div className="alert alert-warning">
                  <strong>Blockers:</strong>
                  <ul>
                    {readiness.blockers.map((b, i) => <li key={i}>{b}</li>)}
                  </ul>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Schedule Conflicts */}
        {scheduleConflicts.length > 0 && (
          <div className="panel panel-default mt-3">
            <div className="panel-heading">
              Schedule Conflicts ({scheduleConflicts.length})
              <Badge kind="danger" className="pull-right">{scheduleConflicts.length}</Badge>
            </div>
            <div className="panel-body">
              <div className="table-responsive">
                <table className="table table-striped">
                  <thead>
                    <tr>
                      <th>Change</th>
                      <th>Type</th>
                      <th>Risk</th>
                      <th>Priority</th>
                      <th>Planned Start</th>
                      <th>Planned End</th>
                      <th>Conflict</th>
                      <th>Overlap</th>
                      <th></th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {scheduleConflicts.map((c, i) => (
                      <tr key={i} className={c.severity === 'high' ? 'table-danger' : c.severity === 'medium' ? 'table-warning' : ''}>
                        <td>
                          <strong>{c.change_number}</strong><br/>
                          <small className="text-muted">{c.title}</small>
                        </td>
                        <td>{c.change_type}</td>
                        <td><Badge kind={riskBadgeVariant(c.risk_level)}>{c.risk_level}</Badge></td>
                        <td><Badge kind={c.severity === 'high' ? 'danger' : c.severity === 'medium' ? 'warning' : c.severity === 'low' ? 'info' : 'secondary'}>{c.severity}</Badge></td>
                        <td><Badge kind={priorityBadgeVariant(c.priority)}>{c.priority}</Badge></td>
                        <td>{formatDateTime(c.planned_start)}</td>
                        <td>{formatDateTime(c.planned_end)}</td>
                        <td>
                          <Badge kind={c.severity === 'high' ? 'danger' : c.severity === 'medium' ? 'warning' : c.severity === 'low' ? 'info' : 'secondary'}>
                            {c.conflict_type.replace(/_/g, ' ')}
                          </Badge>
                        </td>
                        <td>
                          {c.overlap_minutes != null ? `${Math.round(c.overlap_minutes)} min` : 'â€”'}
                          {c.shared_assets && c.shared_assets.length > 0 && (
                            <span className="text-danger ml-1">
                              <small>{c.shared_assets.length} shared CI(s)</small>
                            </span>
                          )}
                          {c.shared_services && c.shared_services.length > 0 && (
                            <span className="text-warning ml-1">
                              <small>{c.shared_services.length} shared service(s)</small>
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td>
                          <Button 
                            kind="ghost" 
                            size="small"
                            onClick={() => window.location.hash = `/changes/${c.id}`}
                          >
                            View
                          </Button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Existing Conflicts (from conflicts tab) */}
        {conflicts.length > 0 && conflicts !== scheduleConflicts && (
          <div className="panel panel-default mt-3">
            <div className="panel-heading">Registered Conflicts ({conflicts.length})</div>
            <div className="panel-body">
              <div className="table-responsive">
                <table className="table table-striped">
                  <thead>
                    <tr>
                      <th>Change</th>
                      <th>Type</th>
                      <th>Severity</th>
                      <th>Status</th>
                      <th></th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {conflicts.map((c, i) => (
                      <tr key={i}>
                        <td>
                          <strong>{c.change_number}</strong><br/>
                          <small className="text-muted">{c.title || ''}</small>
                        </td>
                        <td>{c.conflicting_change_number}</td>
                        <td>
                          <Badge kind={c.severity === 'critical' ? 'danger' : c.severity === 'high' ? 'warning' : 'secondary'}>
                            {c.severity}
                          </Badge>
                        </td>
                        <td>{c.status}</td>
                        <td>
                          <Button 
                            kind="ghost" 
                            size="small"
                            onClick={() => window.location.hash = `/changes/${c.id}`}
                          >
                            View
                          </Button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Scheduling Policy Feedback */}
        <div className="panel panel-default mt-3">
          <div className="panel-heading">Scheduling Policy Feedback</div>
          <div className="panel-body">
            {(() => {
              const ps = plannedStart ? new Date(plannedStart) : (change.planned_start ? new Date(change.planned_start) : null);
              const pe = plannedEnd ? new Date(plannedEnd) : (change.planned_end ? new Date(change.planned_end) : null);
              const hasWindow = ps && pe && !isNaN(ps) && !isNaN(pe);
              const activeBlackouts = hasWindow ? blackoutPeriods.filter((bp) => {
                if (bp.status !== 'active') return false;
                const bps = new Date(bp.start_at);
                const bpe = new Date(bp.end_at);
                if (isNaN(bps) || isNaN(bpe)) return false;
                if (!(ps <= bpe && bps <= pe)) return false;
                // Scope matching (best-effort)
                if (bp.scope_department && change.department && String(bp.scope_department) !== String(change.department) && String(bp.scope_department) !== String(change.department_id)) return false;
                if (bp.scope_service && change.service && String(bp.scope_service) !== String(change.service) && String(bp.scope_service) !== String(change.service_id)) return false;
                return true;
              }) : [];
              const eligibleWindows = hasWindow ? maintenanceWindows.filter((w) => {
                if (w.status !== 'active') return false;
                const ws = new Date(w.start_at);
                const we = new Date(w.end_at);
                if (isNaN(ws) || isNaN(we)) return false;
                return ws <= pe && ps <= we;
              }) : [];
              const pendingEx = schedulingExceptions.filter((e) => e.status === 'pending');
              const approvedEx = schedulingExceptions.filter((e) => e.status === 'approved');
              const rejectedEx = schedulingExceptions.filter((e) => e.status === 'rejected');
              const blackoutRequiresException = activeBlackouts.length > 0 && !activeBlackouts.every((bp) =>
                approvedEx.some((ex) => String(ex.blackout_period) === String(bp.id) || (ex.blackout_period && String(ex.blackout_period.id) === String(bp.id)))
              );
              return (
                <div>
                  {!hasWindow && (
                    <p className="text-muted">Enter planned start/end to evaluate scheduling policy.</p>
                  )}
                  {hasWindow && (
                    <>
                      {/* Maintenance window eligibility */}
                      {eligibleWindows.length > 0 ? (
                        <div className="alert alert-success">
                          <strong>Maintenance window eligible:</strong> This change falls within active maintenance window(s): {eligibleWindows.map((w) => w.name || w.code).join(', ')}.
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="alert alert-warning">
                          <strong>Maintenance window:</strong> Planned time is not within any active maintenance window.
                        </div>
                      )}
                      {/* Blackout conflicts */}
                      {activeBlackouts.length > 0 ? (
                        <div className="alert alert-danger">
                          <strong>Blackout-period conflict:</strong> Planned time overlaps blackout period(s): {activeBlackouts.map((bp) => bp.name).join(', ')}.
                          {blackoutRequiresException && (
                            <span> An approved scheduling exception is required before scheduling can proceed.</span>
                          )}
                          {!blackoutRequiresException && (
                            <span> An approved exception is on file.</span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="alert alert-success">
                          <strong>No blackout-period conflict:</strong> Planned time does not overlap any active blackout period.
                        </div>
                      )}
                      {/* Exception status summary */}
                      <p>
                        <strong>Scheduling exceptions for this change:</strong>{' '}
                        Pending: {pendingEx.length}, Approved: {approvedEx.length}, Rejected: {rejectedEx.length}.
                      </p>
                      {blackoutRequiresException && (
                        <p className="text-danger">
                          <strong>Exception required:</strong> Submit a scheduling exception request and obtain approval before scheduling.
                        </p>
                      )}
                      {schedulingExceptions.length > 0 && (
                        <ul className="list-unstyled">
                          {schedulingExceptions.map((ex) => (
                            <li key={ex.id}>
                              <Badge kind={ex.status === 'approved' ? 'success' : ex.status === 'rejected' ? 'danger' : 'warning'}>{ex.status}</Badge>{' '}
                              {ex.justification}
                              {ex.blackout_period ? ` (blackout: ${ex.blackout_period})` : ''}
                              {ex.maintenance_window ? ` (window: ${ex.maintenance_window})` : ''}
                            </li>
                          ))}
                        </ul>
                      )}
                    </>
                  )}
                  {actionError && (
                    <div className="alert alert-danger"><strong>Scheduling validation failed:</strong> {actionError}</div>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })()}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Scheduling Form */}
        {canSchedule && (
          <div className="panel panel-default mt-3">
            <div className="panel-heading">Schedule Change</div>
            <div className="panel-body">
              {actionError && (
                <div className="alert alert-danger">{actionError}</div>
              )}
              <Form>
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label>Planned Start</label>
                  <Input
                    type="datetime-local"
                    value={plannedStart}
                    onChange={(e) => setPlannedStart(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label>Planned End</label>
                  <Input
                    type="datetime-local"
                    value={plannedEnd}
                    onChange={(e) => setPlannedEnd(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label>Expected Downtime (minutes)</label>
                  <Input
                    type="number"
                    min="0"
                    value={expectedDowntime}
                    onChange={(e) => setExpectedDowntime(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="0"
                  />
                </div>
                <Button 
                  kind="primary" 
                  onClick={handleSchedule}
                  disabled={submitting || !plannedStart || !plannedEnd}
                >
                  {submitting ? 'Scheduling...' : 'Schedule Change'}
                </Button>
              </Form>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* No conflicts state */}
        {!canSchedule && scheduleConflicts.length === 0 && conflicts.length === 0 && (
          <EmptyState 
            title="No scheduling information"
            hint="This change is not yet scheduled or has no conflicts."
          />
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}



===== src\pages\changes\ChangeScheduleView.jsx =====

/* 
 * Change Schedule View - upcoming scheduled changes view
 * Route: #/changes/schedule
 * 
 * Displays upcoming approved and scheduled changes with conflict highlighting.
 */

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { PageHeader, Badge, Button, DataTable, Pager, Field, Input, Select, Option, EmptyState } from '../../components';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { fetchPage, parseApiError, formatDateTime, statusBadgeVariant, riskBadgeVariant, priorityBadgeVariant, STATUS_LABELS } from '../../shared/changes-utils';

export function ChangeScheduleView() {
  const { isStaff } = useAuth();
  const [changes, setChanges] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [pageSize] = useState(20);
  const [hasNext, setHasNext] = useState(false);
  const [hasPrev, setHasPrev] = useState(false);
  const [count, setCount] = useState(null);
  
  // Filters
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState({
    status: '',
    priority: '',
    risk: '',
    date_from: '',
    date_to: '',
    search: '',
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isStaff) {
      setChanges([]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
      setLoading(false); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
      return;
    }
    
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    params.set('page', page);
    params.set('page_size', pageSize); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    if (filters.status) params.set('status', filters.status);
    if (filters.priority) params.set('priority', filters.priority);
    if (filters.risk) params.set('risk', filters.risk);
    if (filters.date_from) params.set('date_from', filters.date_from);
    if (filters.date_to) params.set('date_to', filters.date_to);
    if (filters.search) params.set('search', filters.search);
    
    fetchPage(`/changes/?${params.toString()}`)
      .then((data) => {
        setChanges(data.results || []);
        setCount(data.count || 0);
        setHasNext(Boolean(data.next));
        setHasPrev(Boolean(data.previous));
        setLoading(false);
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        setError(parseApiError(e));
        setLoading(false);
      });
  }, [page, filters, pageSize, isStaff]);

  const updateFilter = (key, value) => {
    setFilters(prev => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }));
    setPage(1);
  };

  const columns = [
    {
      key: 'change_number',
      label: 'Change',
      render: (row) => (
        <a href={`#/changes/${row.id}`} className="row-title">
          {row.change_number}
        </a>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'title',
      label: 'Title',
      render: (row) => <small className="text-muted">{row.title}</small>,
    },
    {
      key: 'status',
      label: 'Status',
      render: (row) => <Badge kind={statusBadgeVariant(row.status)}>{STATUS_LABELS[row.status] || row.status}</Badge>,
    },
    {
      key: 'risk_level',
      label: 'Risk',
      render: (row) => <Badge kind={riskBadgeVariant(row.risk_level)}>{row.risk_level || 'â€”'}</Badge>,
    },
    {
      key: 'priority',
      label: 'Priority',
      render: (row) => <Badge kind={priorityBadgeVariant(row.priority)}>{row.priority || 'â€”'}</Badge>,
    },
    {
      key: 'change_type',
      label: 'Type',
      render: (row) => <Badge kind="secondary">{row.change_type}</Badge>,
    },
    {
      key: 'planned_start',
      label: 'Planned Start',
      render: (row) => formatDateTime(row.planned_start),
    },
    {
      key: 'planned_end',
      label: 'Planned End',
      render: (row) => formatDateTime(row.planned_end),
    },
    {
      key: 'department',
      label: 'Department',
      render: (row) => row.department || 'â€”',
    },
    {
      key: 'actions',
      label: '',
      thClass: 'text-right',
      render: (row) => (
        <Button kind="ghost" size="small" onClick={() => window.location.hash = `/changes/${row.id}`}>
          View
        </Button>
      ),
    },
  ];

  if (!isStaff) {
    return (
      <div>
        <PageHeader title="Schedule" />
        <EmptyState title="Access Denied" hint="Only IT staff can view the schedule." />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="mt-3"><p>Loading schedule...</p></div>;
  }

  if (error) {
    return <div className="mt-3"><p className="text-danger">Error: {error.global ?? 'Unknown error'}</p></div>;
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader 
        title="Change Schedule" 
        sub={count != null ? `${count} scheduled changes` : undefined}
        actions={
          <Button kind="primary" href="#/changes/new">
            New Change
          </Button>
        }
      />
      
      {/* Filters */}
      <div className="panel panel-default mt-3">
        <div className="panel-body">
          <div className="row">
            <div className="col-sm-3">
              <Field label="Status">
                <Select value={filters.status} onChange={(e) => updateFilter('status', e.target.value)}>
                  <Option value="">All Statuses</Option>
                  <Option value="approved">Approved</Option>
                  <Option value="scheduled">Scheduled</Option>
                  <Option value="in_progress">In Progress</Option>
                  <Option value="validation">Validation</Option>
                  <Option value="on_hold">On Hold</Option>
                </Select>
              </Field>
            </div>
            <div className="col-sm-3">
              <Field label="Priority">
                <Select value={filters.priority} onChange={(e) => updateFilter('priority', e.target.value)}>
                  <Option value="">All Priorities</Option>
                  <Option value="low">Low</Option>
                  <Option value="normal">Normal</Option>
                  <Option value="high">High</Option>
                  <Option value="urgent">Urgent</Option>
                  <Option value="emergency">Emergency</Option>
                </Select>
              </Field>
            </div>
            <div className="col-sm-3">
              <Field label="Risk Level">
                <Select value={filters.risk} onChange={(e) => updateFilter('risk', e.target.value)}>
                  <Option value="">All Risk Levels</Option>
                  <Option value="low">Low</Option>
                  <Option value="medium">Medium</Option>
                  <Option value="high">High</Option>
                  <Option value="critical">Critical</Option>
                </Select>
              </Field>
            </div>
            <div className="col-sm-3">
              <Field label="Search">
                <Input
                  value={filters.search}
                  onChange={(e) => updateFilter('search', e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Search changes..."
                />
              </Field>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="row">
            <div className="col-sm-3">
              <Field label="From Date">
                <Input
                  type="date"
                  value={filters.date_from}
                  onChange={(e) => updateFilter('date_from', e.target.value)}
                />
              </Field>
            </div>
            <div className="col-sm-3">
              <Field label="To Date">
                <Input
                  type="date"
                  value={filters.date_to}
                  onChange={(e) => updateFilter('date_to', e.target.value)}
                />
              </Field>
            </div>
            <div className="col-sm-3">
              <Button kind="ghost" onClick={() => setFilters({ status: '', priority: '', risk: '', date_from: '', date_to: '', search: '' })}>
                Reset Filters
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Changes Table */}
      {changes.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="panel panel-default mt-3">
          <div className="panel-body">
            <DataTable
              columns={columns}
              rows={changes}
              keyOf={(r) => r.id}
              emptyTitle="No changes found"
              emptyHint="Try adjusting the filters."
            />
          </div>
          <div className="panel-footer">
            <Pager
              count={count}
              hasNext={hasNext}
              hasPrev={hasPrev}
              busy={loading}
              pageLabel={count != null ? `Page ${page}` : ''}
              onPrev={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
              onNext={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <EmptyState 
          title="No scheduled changes" 
          hint="No changes match the current filters."
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}



===== src\pages\changes\ChangesPage.jsx =====

/*
 * Change Management - Frontend for IT Ticketing & Asset Management System
 * Routes: #/changes, #/changes/new, #/changes/calendar, #/changes/dashboard,
 * #/changes/:id, #/changes/:id/edit, #/changes/:id/risk, #/changes/:id/tasks,
 * #/changes/:id/approvals, #/changes/:id/conflicts, #/changes/:id/implementation,
 * #/changes/:id/pir, #/change-templates, #/maintenance-windows,
 * #/change-review-meetings, #/outages
 *
 * Connected to the real Change Management API at /api/changes/
 */

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { ChangeList } from './ChangeList';
import { ChangeForm } from './ChangeForm';
import { ChangeDetail } from './ChangeDetail';
import { ChangeRisk } from './ChangeRisk';
import { ChangeTasks } from './ChangeTasks';
import { ChangeApprovals } from './ChangeApprovals';
import { ChangeConflicts } from './ChangeConflicts';
import { ChangeImplementation } from './ChangeImplementation';
import { ChangePIR } from './ChangePIR';
import { ChangeCalendar } from './ChangeCalendar';
import { ChangeScheduleView } from './ChangeScheduleView';
import { ChangeDashboard } from './ChangeDashboard';
import { ChangeTemplates } from './ChangeTemplates';
import { ChangeReviewMeetings as ReviewMeetings } from './ChangeReviewMeetings';
import { EmployeeOutages } from '../outages/Outages';
import { BlackoutPeriods } from '../blackout/BlackoutPeriods';
import { MaintenanceWindows } from '../maintenance/MaintenanceWindows';
import { SchedulingExceptions } from '../procurement/SchedulingExceptions';

export const changeRoutes = [ // eslint-disable-line react/only-export-components
  { path: '#/changes', component: ChangeList, title: 'Changes', breadcrumbs: ['Change Management'] },
  { path: '#/changes/new', component: ChangeForm, title: 'New Change', breadcrumbs: ['Change Management', 'New Change'] },
  { path: '#/changes/calendar', component: ChangeCalendar, title: 'Change Calendar', breadcrumbs: ['Change Management', 'Calendar'] },
  { path: '#/changes/schedule', component: ChangeScheduleView, title: 'Change Schedule', breadcrumbs: ['Change Management', 'Schedule'] },
  { path: '#/changes/dashboard', component: ChangeDashboard, title: 'Change Dashboard', breadcrumbs: ['Change Management', 'Dashboard'] },
  { path: '#/changes/:id', component: ChangeDetail, title: 'Change Detail', breadcrumbs: ['Change Management'] },
  { path: '#/changes/:id/edit', component: ChangeForm, title: 'Edit Change', breadcrumbs: ['Change Management', 'Edit Change'] },
  { path: '#/changes/:id/risk', component: ChangeRisk, title: 'Risk Assessment', breadcrumbs: ['Change Management', 'Risk'] },
  { path: '#/changes/:id/tasks', component: ChangeTasks, title: 'Task Checklist', breadcrumbs: ['Change Management', 'Tasks'] },
  { path: '#/changes/:id/approvals', component: ChangeApprovals, title: 'Approvals', breadcrumbs: ['Change Management', 'Approvals'] },
  { path: '#/changes/:id/conflicts', component: ChangeConflicts, title: 'Conflicts', breadcrumbs: ['Change Management', 'Conflicts'] },
  { path: '#/changes/:id/implementation', component: ChangeImplementation, title: 'Implementation', breadcrumbs: ['Change Management', 'Implementation'] },
  { path: '#/changes/:id/pir', component: ChangePIR, title: 'PIR & Closure', breadcrumbs: ['Change Management', 'PIR'] },
  { path: '#/change-templates', component: ChangeTemplates, title: 'Change Templates', breadcrumbs: ['Change Management', 'Templates'] },
  { path: '#/maintenance-windows', component: MaintenanceWindows, title: 'Maintenance Windows', breadcrumbs: ['Change Management', 'Maintenance'] },
  { path: '#/blackout-periods', component: BlackoutPeriods, title: 'Blackout Periods', breadcrumbs: ['Change Management', 'Blackout'] },
  { path: '#/scheduling-exceptions', component: SchedulingExceptions, title: 'Scheduling Exceptions', breadcrumbs: ['Change Management', 'Exceptions'] },
  { path: '#/change-review-meetings', component: ReviewMeetings, title: 'Review Meetings', breadcrumbs: ['Change Management', 'Meetings'] },
  { path: '#/outages', component: EmployeeOutages, title: 'Outages', breadcrumbs: ['Change Management', 'Outages'] },
];

export function ChangesPage() {
  const hash = window.location.hash || '#/changes';
  const hashNoQuery = hash.split('?')[0];
  let route = null;
  let matchParams = {};

  for (const r of changeRoutes) {
    const regexStr = '^' + r.path
      .replace(/:[^/]+/g, '([^/]+)')
      .replace(/\//g, '\\/')
      + '$';
    const regex = new RegExp(regexStr);
    const m = hashNoQuery.match(regex);
    if (m) {
      route = r;
      const paramNames = r.path.match(/:([^/]+)/g) || [];
      paramNames.forEach((pn, i) => {
        matchParams[pn.slice(1)] = m[i + 1];
      });
      break;
    }
  }

  const Comp = route ? route.component : ChangeList;

  useEffect(() => {
    document.title = `${(route ? route.title : 'Changes')} - IT Change Management`;
  }, [route]);

  return <Comp match={{ params: matchParams }} />;
}

===== src\pages\changes\ChangeTasks.jsx =====

/* 
 * Change Tasks - task checklist for a change
 * Route: #/changes/:id/tasks
 */

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { PageHeader, Select, Row, Col } from '../../components';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import api from '../../api';
import { fetchPage, parseApiError } from '../../shared/changes-utils';

export function ChangeTasks({ match }) {
  useAuth();
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const id = match.params.id;
    if (!id) return;
    fetchPage(`/changes/${id}/tasks/`)
      .then((data) => {
        setTasks(data);
        setLoading(false);
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        setError(parseApiError(e));
        setLoading(false);
      });
  }, [match.params.id]);

  const updateTaskStatus = async (taskId, status) => {
    try {
      await api.patch(`/changes/${match.params.id}/tasks/${taskId}/`, { status });
      setTasks((prev) => prev.map((t) => (t.id === taskId ? { ...t, status } : t)));
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e));
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="mt-3"><p>Loading tasksâ€¦</p></div>;
  }

  if (error) {
    return <div className="mt-3"><p className="text-danger">Error: {error.global ?? 'Unknown error'}</p></div>;
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Task Checklist" subtitle={tasks.length > 0 ? tasks[0].change_number : ''} />
      <div className="mt-3">
        <p><strong>Total Tasks:</strong> {tasks.length}</p>
        <p><strong>Completed:</strong> {tasks.filter(t => t.status === 'completed').length}</p>
        <p><strong>Blocked:</strong> {tasks.filter(t => t.status === 'blocked').length}</p>
        {tasks.length === 0 ? (<p>No tasks found</p>) : (
          <div>
            {tasks.map((t, i) => (
              <div key={t.id || i} className="mt-3 p-2 border rounded">
                <Row>
                  <Col sm={4}><strong>Title:</strong> {t.title}</Col>
                  <Col sm={2}><strong>Status:</strong> {t.status}</Col>
                  <Col sm={4}><strong>Assigned:</strong> {t.assigned_to ? t.assigned_to.employee_id : 'Unassigned'}</Col>
                  <Col sm={2}>
                    {isStaff && (
                      <Select value={t.status} onChange={(e) => updateTaskStatus(t.id, e.target.value)}>
                        <option value="pending">Pending</option>
                        <option value="in_progress">In Progress</option>
                        <option value="completed">Completed</option>
                        <option value="blocked">Blocked</option>
                      </Select>
                    )}
                  </Col>
                </Row>
                <Row className="mt-1">
                  <Col sm={12}><strong>Description:</strong> {t.description || ''}</Col>
                </Row>
                {t.evidence && (
                  <Row className="mt-2">
                    <Col sm={12}><strong>Evidence:</strong> {t.evidence.filename}</Col>
                  </Row>
                )}
                {t.blocks_implementation && (
                  <Row className="mt-2">
                    <Col sm={12}><p className="text-danger"><strong>Blocks implementation</strong></p></Col>
                  </Row>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\pages\cmdb\BaselinesPage.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { DataTable, EmptyState, Field, Input, LoadingRows, PageHeader, Select } from '../../components';
import { parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';
import {
  BASELINE_SCOPE_LABELS,
  BASELINE_STATUS_LABELS,
  formatDateTime,
  safeResults,
} from '../../shared/cmdb-utils';
import { CMDB_API_CONTRACT, CMDB_PERMISSIONS } from '../../shared/cmdb';

function ciLabel(ci) {
  if (!ci) return 'â€”';
  const num = ci.ci_number || `CI #${ci.id}`;
  return ci.name ? `${num} â€” ${ci.name}` : num;
}

function stringifyValue(v) {
  if (v == null || v === '') return 'â€”';
  if (typeof v === 'object') return JSON.stringify(v);
  return String(v);
}

function BaselinesPageInner() {
  const { role: authRole, user } = useAuth();
  const role = authRole ?? user?.role;
  const [baselines, setBaselines] = useState([]);
  const [cis, setCis] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState(null);
  const [compareResult, setCompareResult] = useState(null);
  const [ciSearch, setCiSearch] = useState('');
  const [ciFilter, setCiFilter] = useState('');
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ name: '', description: '', scope_type: 'single_ci', configuration_items: [] });

  const canCreate = CMDB_PERMISSIONS.canCreateBaselines(role);
  const canApprove = CMDB_PERMISSIONS.canApproveBaselines(role);

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const [bRes, ciRes] = await Promise.all([
        api.get(CMDB_API_CONTRACT.baselinesList.endpoint),
        api.get('/cmdb/items/?page_size=500'),
      ]);
      const bRows = safeResults(bRes.data?.results ?? bRes.data);
      setBaselines(bRows);
      setCis(safeResults(ciRes.data?.results ?? ciRes.data));
      if (!selectedId && bRows.length) setSelectedId(bRows[0].id);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not load baselines.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, react/set-state-in-effect

  const selectedBaseline = useMemo(() => baselines.find((b) => Number(b.id) === Number(selectedId)) || null, [baselines, selectedId]);
  const ciById = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map();
    cis.forEach((c) => map.set(Number(c.id), c));
    return map;
  }, [cis]);

  const filteredCis = useMemo(() => {
    const q = (ciSearch || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    return cis.filter((ci) => {
      if (ciFilter && Number(ci.id) !== Number(ciFilter)) return false;
      if (!q) return true;
      const hay = [ci.ci_number, ci.name, ci.status, ci.criticality, ci.environment].filter(Boolean).join(' ').toLowerCase();
      return hay.includes(q);
    });
  }, [cis, ciSearch, ciFilter]);

  const selectedCiDetails = useMemo(() => (form.configuration_items || []).map((id) => ciById.get(Number(id))).filter(Boolean), [form.configuration_items, ciById]);

  const createBaseline = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!canCreate || !form.name || !form.configuration_items.length) return;
    setSaving(true);
    setError('');
    setMsg('');
    try {
      const payload = {
        name: form.name,
        description: form.description || '',
        scope_type: form.scope_type,
        configuration_items: form.configuration_items.map(Number),
      };
      const res = await api.post(CMDB_API_CONTRACT.baselineCreate.endpoint, payload);
      setMsg(`Baseline ${res.data?.code || res.data?.id || ''} created.`);
      setForm({ name: '', description: '', scope_type: 'single_ci', configuration_items: [] });
      await load();
      if (res.data?.id) setSelectedId(res.data.id);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(parseApiError(err).global || 'Could not create baseline.');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const runAction = async (action) => {
    if (!selectedBaseline) return;
    setSaving(true);
    setError('');
    setMsg('');
    try {
      const res = await api.post(`/cmdb/baselines/${selectedBaseline.id}/${action}/`, {});
      setBaselines((prev) => prev.map((b) => (b.id === selectedBaseline.id ? { ...b, status: res.data?.status || b.status } : b)));
      setMsg(`Baseline ${action} action completed.`);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(parseApiError(err).global || `Could not ${action} baseline.`);
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const compareBaseline = async () => {
    if (!selectedBaseline) return;
    setSaving(true);
    setError('');
    setMsg('');
    try {
      const res = await api.get(`/cmdb/baselines/${selectedBaseline.id}/compare/`);
      setCompareResult(res.data || null);
      if (res.data && (res.data.diffs || []).length === 0) setMsg('No differences found for this baseline.');
    } catch (err) {
      setCompareResult(null);
      setError(parseApiError(err).global || 'Could not compare baseline.');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const toggleCi = (ciId, checked) => {
    setForm((f) => {
      const set = new Set((f.configuration_items || []).map(Number));
      if (checked) set.add(Number(ciId)); else set.delete(Number(ciId));
      return { ...f, configuration_items: Array.from(set) };
    });
  };

  if (loading && !baselines.length) return <div className="panel panel-pad"><LoadingRows n={6} /></div>;

  const diffs = safeResults(compareResult?.diffs);
  const diffsByCi = diffs.reduce((acc, d) => {
    const key = d.ci_id ?? d.configuration_item ?? 'unknown';
    if (!acc[key]) acc[key] = [];
    acc[key].push(d);
    return acc;
  }, {});

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Configuration Baselines" sub="Create, review, approve, compare, and supersede configuration baselines" />
      {!canCreate && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">System Admin permission is required to manage baselines.</div>}

      {error && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>}
      {msg && <div className="success-banner" role="status">{msg}</div>}

      <div className="split-grid split-2" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <div className="panel panel-pad">
          <h2 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Baselines</h2>
          <DataTable
            columns={[
              { key: 'name', label: 'Baseline', render: (row) => <button type="button" className="link-button" onClick={() => { setSelectedId(row.id); setCompareResult(null); }}><strong>{row.name || row.code || `Baseline #${row.id}`}</strong><div className="muted">{row.code || 'â€”'}</div></button> },
              { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (row) => BASELINE_STATUS_LABELS[row.status] || row.status || 'â€”' },
              { key: 'scope_type', label: 'Scope', render: (row) => BASELINE_SCOPE_LABELS[row.scope_type] || row.scope_type || 'â€”' },
              { key: 'ci_count', label: 'CIs', render: (row) => row.ci_count ?? (row.configuration_items || []).length ?? 0 },
              { key: 'created_at', label: 'Created', render: (row) => formatDateTime(row.created_at) },
            ]}
            rows={baselines}
            keyOf={(row) => row.id}
            emptyTitle="No baselines found."
            emptyHint="Create a baseline to capture expected configuration state."
          />
        </div>

        <div className="panel panel-pad">
          <h2 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Selected Baseline</h2>
          {!selectedBaseline ? (
            <EmptyState title="No baseline selected." hint="Select a baseline to review status and compare differences." />
          ) : (
            <div>
              <p><strong>{selectedBaseline.name}</strong> ({selectedBaseline.code || `#${selectedBaseline.id}`})</p>
              <p className="muted">Status: {BASELINE_STATUS_LABELS[selectedBaseline.status] || selectedBaseline.status} Â· Scope: {BASELINE_SCOPE_LABELS[selectedBaseline.scope_type] || selectedBaseline.scope_type} Â· CIs: {selectedBaseline.ci_count ?? (selectedBaseline.configuration_items || []).length}</p>
              <p className="muted">Approved: {formatDateTime(selectedBaseline.approved_at)} Â· Updated: {formatDateTime(selectedBaseline.updated_at || selectedBaseline.created_at)}</p>
              <div className="table-actions" style={{ marginBottom: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={compareBaseline} disabled={saving}>Compare (expected vs current)</button>
                {canCreate && selectedBaseline.status === 'draft' && <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => runAction('submit')} disabled={saving}>Submit for Approval</button>}
                {canApprove && selectedBaseline.status === 'pending_approval' && <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => runAction('approve')} disabled={saving}>Approve</button>}
                {canApprove && selectedBaseline.status === 'approved' && <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => runAction('supersede')} disabled={saving}>Supersede</button>}
              </div>
              <p className="muted">Lifecycle actions are enforced by backend permissions and status rules. Compare results show expected baseline values vs current CI values for drifted fields.</p>
              <h3>Scoped Configuration Items</h3>
              {(selectedBaseline.configuration_items || []).length === 0 ? <p className="muted">No CI scope data available.</p> : (
                <ul>
                  {(selectedBaseline.configuration_items || []).slice(0, 20).map((cid) => {
                    const ci = ciById.get(Number(cid));
                    return <li key={cid}><a href={`#/cmdb/items/${cid}`}>{ci ? ciLabel(ci) : `CI #${cid}`}</a> {ci ? <span className="muted">({ci.status}, {ci.criticality})</span> : null}</li>;
                  })}
                  {(selectedBaseline.configuration_items || []).length > 20 && <li className="muted">+ {(selectedBaseline.configuration_items || []).length - 20} more</li>}
                </ul>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {canCreate && (
        <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
          <h2 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Create Baseline</h2>
          <form onSubmit={createBaseline} noValidate>
            <div className="split-grid split-3">
              <Field label="Name" required>
                <Input value={form.name} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, name: e.target.value }))} />
              </Field>
              <Field label="Scope Type">
                <Select value={form.scope_type} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, scope_type: e.target.value }))}>
                  {Object.entries(BASELINE_SCOPE_LABELS).map(([k, label]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{label}</option>)}
                </Select>
              </Field>
              <Field label="Description">
                <Input value={form.description} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, description: e.target.value }))} />
              </Field>
            </div>
            <div className="split-grid split-2" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
              <Field label="Search CIs">
                <Input value={ciSearch} onChange={(e) => setCiSearch(e.target.value)} placeholder="Search by CI number, name, statusâ€¦" />
              </Field>
              <Field label="Quick filter (exact CI)">
                <Select value={ciFilter} onChange={(e) => setCiFilter(e.target.value)}>
                  <option value="">All matching CIs</option>
                  {cis.slice(0, 300).map((ci) => <option key={ci.id} value={String(ci.id)}>{ciLabel(ci)}</option>)}
                </Select>
              </Field>
            </div>
            <div style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
              <p className="muted">Select configuration items (searchable). Selected: {selectedCiDetails.length}. Summaries: {selectedCiDetails.slice(0, 5).map(ciLabel).join('; ')}{selectedCiDetails.length > 5 ? ` (+${selectedCiDetails.length - 5} more)` : ''}</p>
              <div style={{ maxHeight: 260, overflow: 'auto', border: '1px solid var(--border, #ddd)', borderRadius: 6, padding: 8 }}>
                {filteredCis.length === 0 ? <p className="muted">No configuration items match the current search.</p> : filteredCis.map((ci) => {
                  const checked = (form.configuration_items || []).map(Number).includes(Number(ci.id));
                  return (
                    <label key={ci.id} style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center', padding: '4px 0' }}>
                      <input type="checkbox" checked={checked} onChange={(e) => toggleCi(ci.id, e.target.checked)} />
                      <span>{ciLabel(ci)} <span className="muted">â€” {ci.status} / {ci.criticality} / {ci.environment}</span></span>
                    </label>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="row-end" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
              <button type="submit" className="btn-primary" disabled={saving || !form.name || !form.configuration_items.length}>
                {saving ? 'Savingâ€¦' : 'Create Draft Baseline'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="panel panel-pad">
        <h2 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Baseline Comparison (Expected vs Current)</h2>
        {!compareResult ? (
          <EmptyState title="No comparison run yet." hint="Select a baseline and click Compare to see expected versus current differences." />
        ) : diffs.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState title="No differences found." hint="Current CI state matches the selected baseline snapshot for compared fields." />
        ) : (
          <>
            <p className="muted">Baseline {compareResult.baseline_code || compareResult.baseline_id}: {diffs.length} difference{diffs.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} across {Object.keys(diffsByCi).length} CI(s).</p>
            <DataTable
              columns={[
                {
                  key: 'ci',
                  label: 'Affected CI',
                  render: (row) => {
                    const cid = row.ci_id ?? row.configuration_item;
                    const ci = ciById.get(Number(cid));
                    return cid ? <a href={`#/cmdb/items/${cid}`}>{row.ci_number || ci?.ci_number || `CI #${cid}`}{ci?.name ? ` â€” ${ci.name}` : ''}</a> : 'â€”';
                  },
                },
                { key: 'field', label: 'Field', render: (row) => row.field_name || row.field || 'â€”' },
                { key: 'expected', label: 'Expected (baseline)', render: (row) => stringifyValue(row.expected_value ?? row.expected) },
                { key: 'current', label: 'Current', render: (row) => stringifyValue(row.actual_value ?? row.current ?? row.current_value) },
                { key: 'type', label: 'Difference', render: (row) => row.change_type || row.diff_type || (row.expected_value !== row.actual_value ? 'changed' : 'â€”') },
                {
                  key: 'actions',
                  label: 'Navigate',
                  render: (row) => {
                    const cid = row.ci_id ?? row.configuration_item;
                    return cid ? (
                      <div className="table-actions">
                        <a className="btn-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${cid}`}>Open CI</a>
                        <a className="btn-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${cid}/dependencies`}>Dependencies</a>
                      </div>
                    ) : 'â€”';
                  },
                },
              ]}
              rows={diffs}
              keyOf={(row, i) => `${row.ci_id || row.configuration_item}-${row.field_name || i}-${i}`}
              emptyTitle="No differences."
              emptyHint="No drift detected."
            />
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function BaselinesPage() {
  const { role: authRole, user } = useAuth();
  const role = authRole ?? user?.role;
  if (role === 'employee') {
    return <div className="error-summary" role="alert">Employees have no CMDB baseline access.</div>;
  }
  return <BaselinesPageInner />;
}





===== src\pages\cmdb\CiDetail.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import {
  Badge, ConfirmDialog, DataTable, EmptyState, Field, LoadingRows, PageHeader,
} from '../../components';
import { parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';
import {
  CI_LIFECYCLE_LABELS,
  CI_STATUS_LABELS,
  CRITICALITY_LABELS,
  DATA_CLASSIFICATION_LABELS,
  DRIFT_SEVERITY_LABELS,
  DRIFT_STATUS_LABELS,
  ENVIRONMENT_LABELS,
  MONITORING_STATE_LABELS,
  RELATIONSHIP_CONFIDENCE_LABELS,
  RELATIONSHIP_STATUS_LABELS,
  RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_LABELS,
  SOURCE_LABELS,
  VALIDATED_SYSTEM_IMPACT_LABELS,
  formatDateTime,
  safeResults,
} from '../../shared/cmdb-utils';
import { CMDB_API_CONTRACT, CMDB_PERMISSIONS } from '../../shared/cmdb';

function labelOf(map, value) {
  if (value == null || value === '') return 'â€”';
  return map[value] || String(value).replace(/_/g, ' ');
}

function DetailRow({ label, value }) {
  return (
    <div className="detail-row" style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '180px 1fr', gap: 8, padding: '6px 0' }}>
      <div className="muted">{label}</div>
      <div>{value ?? 'â€”'}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function CiDetail({ id: idProp, match }) {
  const id = Number(idProp ?? match?.params?.id);
  const { role: authRole, user } = useAuth();
  const role = authRole ?? user?.role;
  const [ci, setCi] = useState(null);
  const [relationships, setRelationships] = useState([]);
  const [history, setHistory] = useState([]);
  const [drift, setDrift] = useState([]);
  const [baselines, setBaselines] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [actionError, setActionError] = useState('');
  const [actionMsg, setActionMsg] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState('');
  const [verifyNote, setVerifyNote] = useState('');
  const [retireReason, setRetireReason] = useState('');
  const [retireImpact, setRetireImpact] = useState(null);
  const [showRetire, setShowRetire] = useState(false);
  const [showVerify, setShowVerify] = useState(false);
  const [baselineCompare, setBaselineCompare] = useState(null);
  const [baselineCompareError, setBaselineCompareError] = useState('');
  const [baselineCompareBusy, setBaselineCompareBusy] = useState(false);

  const canView = CMDB_PERMISSIONS.canViewCIDetail(role);
  const canEdit = CMDB_PERMISSIONS.canEditCI(role);
  const canVerify = CMDB_PERMISSIONS.canVerifyCI(role) || CMDB_PERMISSIONS.canVerifyCIAction?.(role);
  const canRetire = CMDB_PERMISSIONS.canRetireCI(role) || CMDB_PERMISSIONS.canRetireCIAction?.(role);

  const load = async () => {
    if (!id) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const [ciRes, relRes, histRes, driftRes, baseRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
        api.get(CMDB_API_CONTRACT.ciDetail.endpoint(id)),
        api.get(`/cmdb/items/${id}/relationships/`),
        api.get(`/cmdb/items/${id}/history/`),
        api.get(`/cmdb/drift/?ci=${id}`),
        api.get('/cmdb/baselines/'),
      ]);
      if (ciRes.status === 'fulfilled') setCi(ciRes.value.data);
      else throw ciRes.reason;
      setRelationships(relRes.status === 'fulfilled' ? safeResults(relRes.value.data?.results ?? relRes.value.data) : []);
      setHistory(histRes.status === 'fulfilled' ? safeResults(histRes.value.data?.results ?? histRes.value.data) : safeResults(ciRes.value.data?.history));
      setDrift(driftRes.status === 'fulfilled' ? safeResults(driftRes.value.data?.results ?? driftRes.value.data) : []);
      setBaselines(baseRes.status === 'fulfilled' ? safeResults(baseRes.value.data?.results ?? baseRes.value.data) : []);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not load configuration item details.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [id]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, react/set-state-in-effect

  const relatedId = (r) => (String(r.source_ci) === String(id) ? r.target_ci : r.source_ci);
  const relatedNumber = (r) => (String(r.source_ci) === String(id) ? r.target_ci_number : r.source_ci_number);

  const doVerify = async () => {
    if (!ci) return;
    setBusy('verify');
    setActionError('');
    setActionMsg('');
    try {
      await api.post(`/cmdb/items/${id}/verify/`, {
        verification_note: verifyNote || '',
        expected_record_version: ci.record_version ?? null,
      });
      setActionMsg('Configuration item verified.');
      setShowVerify(false);
      setVerifyNote('');
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      setActionError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not verify configuration item.');
    } finally {
      setBusy('');
    }
  };

  const doRetire = async (acknowledge = false) => {
    if (!ci || !retireReason.trim()) return;
    setBusy('retire');
    setActionError('');
    setActionMsg('');
    try {
      await api.post(`/cmdb/items/${id}/retire/`, {
        reason: retireReason.trim(),
        expected_record_version: ci.record_version ?? null,
        acknowledge_impact: acknowledge,
      });
      setActionMsg('Configuration item retired.');
      setShowRetire(false);
      setRetireReason('');
      setRetireImpact(null);
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      const status = e?.response?.status;
      const data = e?.response?.data || {};
      if (status === 409 && data.impact) {
        setRetireImpact(data.impact);
        setActionError('Retiring this CI affects other records. Review the impact summary and acknowledge it to continue.');
      } else {
        setActionError(parseApiError(e).global || data.detail || 'Could not retire configuration item.');
      }
    } finally {
      setBusy('');
    }
  };

  const compareToBaseline = async () => {
    setBaselineCompareBusy(true);
    setBaselineCompareError('');
    setBaselineCompare(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.get(`/cmdb/items/${id}/compare-baseline/`);
      setBaselineCompare(res.data || null);
    } catch (e) {
      setBaselineCompareError(parseApiError(e).global || e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Could not compare CI to baseline.');
    } finally {
      setBaselineCompareBusy(false);
    }
  };

  if (role === 'employee' || !canView) {
    return <div className="error-summary" role="alert">You do not have permission to view this configuration item.</div>;
  }
  if (loading) return <div className="panel panel-pad"><LoadingRows n={10} /></div>;
  if (error) return <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>;
  if (!ci) return <EmptyState title="Configuration item not found" hint="The requested CI may have been removed or you may not have access." />;

  const isRetired = ['retired', 'disposed'].includes(ci.status);

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title={ci.ci_number || `CI #${ci.id}`}
        sub={`${ci.name || 'Unnamed CI'} Â· ${labelOf(CI_STATUS_LABELS, ci.status)} Â· ${labelOf(CRITICALITY_LABELS, ci.criticality)}`}
        actions={(
          <>
            <a className="btn-small" href="#/cmdb/items">Back to CIs</a>
            <a className="btn-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${id}/relationships`}>Relationships</a>
            <a className="btn-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${id}/dependencies`}>Dependencies</a>
            <a className="btn-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${id}/impact`}>Impact</a>
            {canEdit && <a className="btn-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${id}/edit`}>Edit</a>}
            {canVerify && !isRetired && <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => setShowVerify(true)}>Verify</button>}
            {canRetire && !isRetired && <button type="button" className="btn-danger" onClick={() => setShowRetire(true)}>Retire</button>}
          </>
        )}
      />

      {actionMsg && <div className="alert alert-success" role="status">{actionMsg}</div>}
      {actionError && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{actionError}</div>}

      <div className="split-grid split-2" style={{ alignItems: 'start' }}>
        <div className="panel panel-pad">
          <h3>Overview</h3>
          <DetailRow label="CI Number" value={ci.ci_number || 'â€”'} />
          <DetailRow label="Name" value={ci.name || 'â€”'} />
          <DetailRow label="Type" value={ci.ci_type_name || ci.ci_type || 'â€”'} />
          <DetailRow label="Status" value={<Badge kind="status" value={ci.status} label={labelOf(CI_STATUS_LABELS, ci.status)} />} />
          <DetailRow label="Lifecycle" value={labelOf(CI_LIFECYCLE_LABELS, ci.lifecycle_state)} />
          <DetailRow label="Criticality" value={<Badge kind="priority" value={ci.criticality} label={labelOf(CRITICALITY_LABELS, ci.criticality)} />} />
          <DetailRow label="Environment" value={labelOf(ENVIRONMENT_LABELS, ci.environment)} />
          <DetailRow label="Source" value={labelOf(SOURCE_LABELS, ci.source)} />
          <DetailRow label="Monitoring" value={labelOf(MONITORING_STATE_LABELS, ci.monitoring_state)} />
          <DetailRow label="Data Classification" value={labelOf(DATA_CLASSIFICATION_LABELS, ci.data_classification)} />
          <DetailRow label="Validated Impact" value={labelOf(VALIDATED_SYSTEM_IMPACT_LABELS, ci.validated_system_impact)} />
          <DetailRow label="Record Version" value={ci.record_version ?? 'â€”'} />
          <DetailRow label="Last Verified" value={ci.last_verified_at ? formatDateTime(ci.last_verified_at) : 'Never'} />
          <DetailRow label="Updated" value={ci.updated_at ? formatDateTime(ci.updated_at) : 'â€”'} />
        </div>

        <div className="panel panel-pad">
          <h3>Ownership and links</h3>
          <DetailRow label="Owner" value={ci.owner_username || (ci.owner ? `User #${ci.owner}` : 'â€”')} />
          <DetailRow label="Technical Owner" value={ci.technical_owner ? `User #${ci.technical_owner}` : 'â€”'} />
          <DetailRow label="Department" value={ci.department_name || (ci.department ? `Department #${ci.department}` : 'â€”')} />
          <DetailRow label="Location" value={ci.location || 'â€”'} />
          <DetailRow label="Asset" value={ci.asset_tag ? `${ci.asset_tag}${ci.asset ? ` (#${ci.asset})` : ''}` : (ci.asset ? `Asset #${ci.asset}` : 'â€”')} />
          <DetailRow label="Software Product" value={ci.software_product ? `Software #${ci.software_product}` : 'â€”'} />
          <DetailRow label="Service" value={ci.service_name || (ci.service ? `Service #${ci.service}` : 'â€”')} />
          <DetailRow label="Vendor" value={ci.vendor ? `Vendor #${ci.vendor}` : 'â€”'} />
          <DetailRow label="Manufacturer" value={ci.manufacturer || 'â€”'} />
          <DetailRow label="Model" value={ci.model || 'â€”'} />
          <DetailRow label="Serial Number" value={ci.serial_number || 'â€”'} />
          <DetailRow label="Hostname" value={ci.hostname || 'â€”'} />
          <DetailRow label="IP Address" value={ci.ip_address || 'â€”'} />
          <DetailRow label="DNS Name" value={ci.dns_name || 'â€”'} />
          <DetailRow label="External Reference" value={ci.external_reference || 'â€”'} />
        </div>
      </div>

      {ci.description ? (
        <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
          <h3>Description</h3>
          <p style={{ whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap', marginBottom: 0 }}>{ci.description}</p>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
        <h3>Attributes</h3>
        {ci.attributes && Object.keys(ci.attributes).length ? (
          <DataTable
            columns={[
              { key: 'key', label: 'Attribute' },
              { key: 'value', label: 'Value', render: (r) => (typeof r.value === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(r.value) : String(r.value ?? 'â€”')) },
            ]}
            rows={Object.entries(ci.attributes).map(([key, value]) => ({ key, value }))}
            keyOf={(r) => r.key}
            emptyTitle="No attributes"
          />
        ) : (
          <EmptyState title="No attributes recorded" hint="Schema-defined or custom attributes will appear here when present." />
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="split-grid split-2" style={{ marginTop: 16, alignItems: 'start' }}>
        <div className="panel panel-pad">
          <div className="panel-head"><h3>Relationships</h3><a className="link-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${id}/relationships`}>Manage</a></div>
          {relationships.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState title="No relationships" hint="Create relationships to model dependencies and service impact." action={<a className="btn-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${id}/relationships`}>Add relationship</a>} />
          ) : (
            <DataTable
              columns={[
                { key: 'direction', label: 'Direction', render: (r) => (String(r.source_ci) === String(id) ? 'Outgoing' : 'Incoming') },
                { key: 'relationship_type', label: 'Type', render: (r) => labelOf(RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_LABELS, r.relationship_type) },
                { key: 'related', label: 'Related CI', render: (r) => <a href={`#/cmdb/items/${relatedId(r)}`}>{relatedNumber(r) || `CI #${relatedId(r)}`}</a> },
                { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (r) => labelOf(RELATIONSHIP_STATUS_LABELS, r.status) },
                { key: 'confidence', label: 'Confidence', render: (r) => labelOf(RELATIONSHIP_CONFIDENCE_LABELS, r.confidence) },
              ]}
              rows={relationships}
              keyOf={(r) => r.id}
              emptyTitle="No relationships"
            />
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="panel panel-pad">
          <div className="panel-head"><h3>Drift findings for this CI</h3><a className="link-small" href="#/cmdb/drift">View drift workspace</a></div>
          {drift.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState title="No drift findings for this CI" hint="Drift findings appear when approved baselines differ from the current configuration." />
          ) : (
            <DataTable
              columns={[
                { key: 'severity', label: 'Severity', render: (r) => labelOf(DRIFT_SEVERITY_LABELS, r.severity) },
                { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (r) => labelOf(DRIFT_STATUS_LABELS, r.status) },
                { key: 'finding_type', label: 'Type', render: (r) => String(r.finding_type || 'â€”').replace(/_/g, ' ') },
                { key: 'field_name', label: 'Field', render: (r) => r.field_name || 'â€”' },
                { key: 'expected', label: 'Expected', render: (r) => (r.expected_value == null || r.expected_value === '' ? 'â€”' : String(r.expected_value)) },
                { key: 'actual', label: 'Current', render: (r) => (r.actual_value == null || r.actual_value === '' ? 'â€”' : String(r.actual_value)) },
                { key: 'detected_at', label: 'Detected', render: (r) => r.detected_at ? formatDateTime(r.detected_at) : 'â€”' },
                { key: 'actions', label: 'Actions', render: () => <a className="btn-small" href="#/cmdb/drift">Manage in Drift</a> },
              ]}
              rows={drift.slice(0, 10)}
              keyOf={(r) => r.id}
              emptyTitle="No drift findings"
            />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
        <div className="panel-head"><h3>History and audit</h3><span className="muted">Read-only immutable event trail</span></div>
        {history.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState title="No history recorded" hint="Changes, verification, and lifecycle actions will appear here." />
        ) : (
          <DataTable
            columns={[
              { key: 'created_at', label: 'When', render: (r) => formatDateTime(r.created_at) },
              { key: 'event_type', label: 'Event', render: (r) => String(r.event_type || 'â€”').replace(/_/g, ' ') },
              { key: 'actor', label: 'Actor', render: (r) => r.actor_username || r.actor_email || (r.actor ? `User #${r.actor}` : 'System') },
              { key: 'source', label: 'Source', render: (r) => r.source || 'â€”' },
              { key: 'status', label: 'Status change', render: (r) => (r.previous_status || r.new_status) ? `${r.previous_status || 'â€”'} -> ${r.new_status || 'â€”'}` : 'â€”' },
              { key: 'detail', label: 'Details', render: (r) => r.detail || (r.changed_fields && Object.keys(r.changed_fields).length ? `Changed: ${Object.keys(r.changed_fields).join(', ')}` : 'â€”') },
            ]}
            rows={history}
            keyOf={(r, i) => r.id ?? `${r.created_at}-${i}`}
            emptyTitle="No history recorded"
          />
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
        <div className="panel-head"><h3>Baselines and comparison</h3><a className="link-small" href="#/cmdb/baselines">Manage baselines</a></div>
        <div className="table-actions" style={{ marginBottom: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={compareToBaseline} disabled={baselineCompareBusy}>
            {baselineCompareBusy ? 'Comparingâ€¦' : 'Compare to latest approved baseline'}
          </button>
          <span className="muted">Per-CI shortcut using backend comparison endpoint (latest approved baseline when available).</span>
        </div>
        {baselineCompareError && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{baselineCompareError}</div>}
        {baselineCompare && (
          <div style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
            <p className="muted">Baseline: {baselineCompare.baseline_code || baselineCompare.baseline_id || 'â€”'} Â· Drift detected: {baselineCompare.drift ? 'Yes' : 'No'} Â· Differences: {(baselineCompare.diffs || []).length}</p>
            {(baselineCompare.diffs || []).length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState title="No differences found." hint="This CI matches the compared baseline for checked fields." />
            ) : (
              <DataTable
                columns={[
                  { key: 'field_name', label: 'Field', render: (r) => r.field_name || r.field || 'â€”' },
                  { key: 'expected', label: 'Expected (baseline)', render: (r) => (r.expected_value == null || r.expected_value === '' ? 'â€”' : String(r.expected_value)) },
                  { key: 'actual', label: 'Current', render: (r) => (r.actual_value == null || r.actual_value === '' ? String(r.current_value ?? 'â€”') : String(r.actual_value)) },
                ]}
                rows={baselineCompare.diffs || []}
                keyOf={(r, i) => `${r.field_name || i}-${i}`}
                emptyTitle="No differences."
              />
            )}
          </div>
        )}
        {baselines.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState title="No baselines available" hint="Create and approve a baseline to compare this CI against an expected state." />
        ) : (
          <p className="muted" style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>
            {baselines.length} baseline{baselines.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} exist in the CMDB. Use the Baselines screen for full review, approval, superseding, and multi-CI comparison workflows.
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      {showVerify && (
        <ConfirmDialog
          title="Verify configuration item"
          message={`Mark ${ci.ci_number || ci.name} as verified. You can optionally add a verification note.`}
          confirmLabel={busy === 'verify' ? 'Verifyingâ€¦' : 'Verify CI'}
          busy={busy === 'verify'}
          onCancel={() => { if (!busy) { setShowVerify(false); setVerifyNote(''); } }}
          onConfirm={doVerify}
        >
          <Field label="Verification note">
            <textarea className="input" rows={3} value={verifyNote} onChange={(e) => setVerifyNote(e.target.value)} placeholder="Optional note about what was checked" />
          </Field>
        </ConfirmDialog>
      )}

      {showRetire && (
        <ConfirmDialog
          title="Retire configuration item"
          message="Retiring a CI records a lifecycle change and may affect dependent services or relationships. Provide a reason."
          confirmLabel={busy === 'retire' ? 'Retiringâ€¦' : (retireImpact ? 'Acknowledge impact and retire' : 'Retire CI')}
          danger
          busy={busy === 'retire'}
          onCancel={() => { if (!busy) { setShowRetire(false); setRetireReason(''); setRetireImpact(null); } }}
          onConfirm={() => doRetire(!!retireImpact)}
        >
          <Field label="Reason" required>
            <textarea className="input" rows={3} value={retireReason} onChange={(e) => setRetireReason(e.target.value)} placeholder="Why is this CI being retired?" />
          </Field>
          {retireImpact && (
            <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
              <strong>Impact summary</strong>
              <ul style={{ margin: '8px 0 0 18px' }}>
                {Array.isArray(retireImpact.affected_ci_ids) && <li>Affected CIs: {retireImpact.affected_ci_ids.length}</li>}
                {Array.isArray(retireImpact.affected_services) && <li>Affected services: {retireImpact.affected_services.length}</li>}
                {retireImpact.risk_summary && <li>Risk: {typeof retireImpact.risk_summary === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(retireImpact.risk_summary) : String(retireImpact.risk_summary)}</li>}
              </ul>
            </div>
          )}
        </ConfirmDialog>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}




===== src\pages\cmdb\CiForm.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { ErrorSummary, Field, Input, LoadingRows, PageHeader, Select } from '../../components';
import { parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';
import {
  CI_LIFECYCLE_LABELS,
  CI_STATUS_LABELS,
  CRITICALITY_LABELS,
  DATA_CLASSIFICATION_LABELS,
  ENVIRONMENT_LABELS,
  MONITORING_STATE_LABELS,
  SOURCE_LABELS,
  VALIDATED_SYSTEM_IMPACT_LABELS,
  CMDB_API_CONTRACT,
  CMDB_PERMISSIONS,
  safeResults,
} from '../../shared/cmdb-utils';

const EMPTY_FORM = {
  name: '',
  ci_type: '',
  description: '',
  status: 'planned',
  lifecycle_state: 'proposed',
  criticality: 'medium',
  environment: 'production',
  location: '',
  vendor: '',
  manufacturer: '',
  model: '',
  serial_number: '',
  version: '',
  hostname: '',
  ip_address: '',
  dns_name: '',
  external_reference: '',
  source: 'manual',
  monitoring_state: 'unknown',
  data_classification: 'internal',
  validated_system_impact: 'none',
};

function toPayload(form) {
  const payload = {};
  Object.entries(form).forEach(([k, v]) => {
    if (v === '' || v == null) return;
    payload[k] = v;
  });
  // keep empty-able text fields explicit only when editing is not necessary; avoid sending empty ip_address
  if (payload.ip_address === '') delete payload.ip_address;
  if (payload.ci_type) payload.ci_type = Number(payload.ci_type);
  return payload;
}

export function CiForm({ id: idProp, match, onSaved }) {
  const id = idProp ?? match?.params?.id;
  const { role: authRole, user } = useAuth();
  const role = authRole ?? user?.role;
  const [form, setForm] = useState(EMPTY_FORM);
  const [recordVersion, setRecordVersion] = useState(null);
  const [types, setTypes] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(!!id);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState({});

  const isEdit = !!id;
  const canSave = isEdit ? CMDB_PERMISSIONS.canEditCI(role) : CMDB_PERMISSIONS.canCreateCI(role);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    api.get('/cmdb/types/')
      .then((r) => { if (!cancelled) setTypes(safeResults(r.data?.results ?? r.data)); })
      .catch(() => { if (!cancelled) setTypes([]); });
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id) return undefined;
    let cancelled = false;
    setLoading(true); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    setError(''); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    api.get(CMDB_API_CONTRACT.ciDetail.endpoint(Number(id)))
      .then((r) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        const ci = r.data || {};
        const next = { ...EMPTY_FORM };
        Object.keys(EMPTY_FORM).forEach((k) => {
          if (k === 'ci_type') next[k] = ci.ci_type ? String(ci.ci_type) : '';
          else next[k] = ci[k] ?? '';
        });
        setForm(next);
        setRecordVersion(ci.record_version ?? null);
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (!cancelled) setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not load configuration item.');
      })
      .finally(() => { if (!cancelled) setLoading(false); });
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [id]);

  const setField = (key, value) => setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }));

  const save = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!canSave || !form.name || !form.ci_type) return;
    setSaving(true);
    setError('');
    setFieldErrors({});
    const payload = toPayload(form);
    if (isEdit && recordVersion != null) payload.expected_record_version = recordVersion;
    try {
      let response;
      if (isEdit) {
