===== src\pages\cmdb\CmdbItemsList.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import {
  Badge, DataTable, EmptyState, Field, Input, LoadingRows, PageHeader, Pager, Select,
} from '../../components';
import { parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';
import {
  CI_LIFECYCLE_LABELS,
  CI_STATUS_LABELS,
  CRITICALITY_LABELS,
  ENVIRONMENT_LABELS,
  SOURCE_LABELS,
  buildCIListUrl,
  formatDateTime,
  safeResults,
} from '../../shared/cmdb-utils';
import { CMDB_API_CONTRACT, CMDB_PERMISSIONS } from '../../shared/cmdb';
import { GlobalRelationshipsPage } from './CiRelationshipsPage';

function readHashParams() {
  const raw = window.location.hash.split('?')[1] || '';
  const sp = new URLSearchParams(raw);
  const obj = {};
  sp.forEach((v, k) => { obj[k] = v; });
  return obj;
}

function writeHashParams(next) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  Object.entries(next).forEach(([k, v]) => {
    if (v !== '' && v != null) params.set(k, String(v));
  });
  const qs = params.toString();
  window.location.hash = qs ? `#/cmdb/items?${qs}` : '#/cmdb/items';
}

function CmdbItemsListInner() {
  const { role: authRole, user } = useAuth();
  const role = authRole ?? user?.role;
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [types, setTypes] = useState([]);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState({});
  const [params, setParams] = useState(() => ({ page: '1', ...readHashParams() }));

  useEffect(() => {
    const sync = () => setParams({ page: '1', ...readHashParams() });
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', sync);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('hashchange', sync);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    setDraft({ // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
      search: params.search || '',
      status: params.status || '',
      criticality: params.criticality || '',
      environment: params.environment || '',
      type: params.type || '',
      source: params.source || '',
      verified: params.verified || '',
    });
  }, [params.search, params.status, params.criticality, params.environment, params.type, params.source, params.verified]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    api.get('/cmdb/types/')
      .then((r) => { if (!cancelled) setTypes(safeResults(r.data?.results ?? r.data)); })
      .catch(() => { if (!cancelled) setTypes([]); });
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    setLoading(true); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    setError(''); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    const q = { ...params, page: params.page || '1' };
    api.get(`${CMDB_API_CONTRACT.ciList.endpoint}${buildCIListUrl(q)}`)
      .then((r) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        const data = r.data;
        const rows = Array.isArray(data) ? data : safeResults(data?.results ?? []);
        setItems(rows);
        setCount(Array.isArray(data) ? rows.length : (data?.count ?? rows.length));
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not load configuration items.');
        setItems([]);
        setCount(0);
      })
      .finally(() => { if (!cancelled) setLoading(false); });
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [params]);

  const typeById = useMemo(() => {
    const m = new Map();
    types.forEach((t) => m.set(String(t.id), t));
    return m;
  }, [types]);

  const canCreate = CMDB_PERMISSIONS.canCreateCI(role);
  const canView = CMDB_PERMISSIONS.canViewCIList(role);

  const page = Math.max(1, parseInt(params.page || '1', 10) || 1);
  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((count || 0) / 50));

  const applyFilters = (e) => {
    e?.preventDefault?.();
    writeHashParams({ ...draft, page: 1 });
  };

  const clearFilters = () => {
    writeHashParams({ page: 1 });
  };

  const goToPage = (nextPage) => {
    writeHashParams({ ...params, page: nextPage });
  };

  const columns = useMemo(() => ([
    {
      key: 'ci_number',
      label: 'CI Number',
      render: (row) => (
        <a href={`#/cmdb/items/${row.id}`}>{row.ci_number || `CI #${row.id}`}</a>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'name',
      label: 'Name',
      render: (row) => (
        <a href={`#/cmdb/items/${row.id}`}>{row.name || 'â€”'}</a>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'ci_type',
      label: 'Type',
      render: (row) => row.ci_type_name || typeById.get(String(row.ci_type))?.name || row.ci_type || 'â€”',
    },
    {
      key: 'status',
      label: 'Status',
      render: (row) => <Badge kind="status" value={row.status} label={CI_STATUS_LABELS[row.status] || row.status || 'â€”'} />,
    },
    {
      key: 'lifecycle_state',
      label: 'Lifecycle',
      render: (row) => CI_LIFECYCLE_LABELS[row.lifecycle_state] || row.lifecycle_state || 'â€”',
    },
    {
      key: 'criticality',
      label: 'Criticality',
      render: (row) => <Badge kind="priority" value={row.criticality} label={CRITICALITY_LABELS[row.criticality] || row.criticality || 'â€”'} />,
    },
    {
      key: 'environment',
      label: 'Environment',
      render: (row) => ENVIRONMENT_LABELS[row.environment] || row.environment || 'â€”',
    },
    {
      key: 'department',
      label: 'Department',
      render: (row) => row.department_name || row.department || 'â€”',
    },
    { key: 'location', label: 'Location', render: (row) => row.location || 'â€”' },
    { key: 'owner', label: 'Owner', render: (row) => row.owner_username || row.owner || 'â€”' },
    {
      key: 'last_verified_at',
      label: 'Last Verified',
      render: (row) => (row.last_verified_at ? formatDateTime(row.last_verified_at) : 'Never'),
    },
    {
      key: 'updated_at',
      label: 'Updated',
      render: (row) => (row.updated_at ? formatDateTime(row.updated_at) : 'â€”'),
    },
  ]), [typeById]);

  if (role === 'employee') {
    return <div className="error-summary" role="alert">Employees have no CMDB CI list access.</div>;
  }
  if (!canView) {
    return <div className="error-summary" role="alert">You do not have permission to view configuration items.</div>;
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Configuration Items"
        sub={`${count} item${count === 1 ? '' : 's'} in CMDB`}
        actions={(
          <>
            <a className="btn-small" href="#/cmdb">Dashboard</a>
            <a className="btn-small" href="#/cmdb/types">CI Types</a>
            <a className="btn-small" href="#/cmdb/baselines">Baselines</a>
            <a className="btn-small" href="#/cmdb/drift">Drift</a>
            <a className="btn-small" href="#/cmdb/verification">Verification</a>
            <a className="btn-small" href="#/cmdb/reports">Reports</a>
            {canCreate && <a className="btn-primary" href="#/cmdb/items/new">+ New CI</a>}
          </>
        )}
      />

      <form className="panel panel-pad" onSubmit={applyFilters} style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <h3 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Search and filter</h3>
        <div className="row-gap" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'flex-end' }}>
          <Field label="Search">
            <Input
              value={draft.search || ''}
              onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, search: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="CI number, name, hostname, serial..."
              aria-label="Search configuration items"
            />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Type">
            <Select value={draft.type || ''} onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, type: e.target.value })} aria-label="Filter by type">
              <option value="">All types</option>
              {types.map((t) => <option key={t.id} value={t.id}>{t.name || t.code}</option>)}
            </Select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="Status">
            <Select value={draft.status || ''} onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, status: e.target.value })} aria-label="Filter by status">
              <option value="">All statuses</option>
              {Object.entries(CI_STATUS_LABELS).map(([k, v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}
            </Select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="Criticality">
            <Select value={draft.criticality || ''} onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, criticality: e.target.value })} aria-label="Filter by criticality">
              <option value="">All criticalities</option>
              {Object.entries(CRITICALITY_LABELS).map(([k, v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}
            </Select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="Environment">
            <Select value={draft.environment || ''} onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, environment: e.target.value })} aria-label="Filter by environment">
              <option value="">All environments</option>
              {Object.entries(ENVIRONMENT_LABELS).map(([k, v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}
            </Select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="Source">
            <Select value={draft.source || ''} onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, source: e.target.value })} aria-label="Filter by source">
              <option value="">All sources</option>
              {Object.entries(SOURCE_LABELS).map(([k, v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}
            </Select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="Verified">
            <Select value={draft.verified || ''} onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, verified: e.target.value })} aria-label="Filter by verification">
              <option value="">Any</option>
              <option value="true">Verified</option>
              <option value="false">Not verified</option>
            </Select>
          </Field>
        </div>
        <div className="row-gap" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
          <button type="submit" className="btn-primary">Apply filters</button>
          <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={clearFilters}>Clear</button>
        </div>
      </form>

      {error && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>}

      {loading ? (
        <div className="panel panel-pad"><LoadingRows n={8} /></div>
      ) : items.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          title="No configuration items found"
          hint={Object.keys(params).some((k) => k !== 'page' && params[k]) ? 'Try adjusting or clearing your filters.' : 'Create a configuration item to start building the CMDB.'}
          action={canCreate ? <a className="btn-primary" href="#/cmdb/items/new">Create CI</a> : null}
        />
      ) : (
        <>
          <DataTable
            columns={columns}
            rows={items}
            keyOf={(r) => r.id ?? r.ci_number}
            emptyTitle="No configuration items found."
            emptyHint="Adjust filters to find CIs."
          />
          <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
            <Pager
              count={count}
              hasNext={page < totalPages}
              hasPrev={page > 1}
              onPrev={() => goToPage(page - 1)}
              onNext={() => goToPage(page + 1)}
              busy={loading}
              pageLabel={count ? `Page ${page} of ${totalPages}` : ''}
            />
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
export function CmdbItemsList() {
  const routePath = window.location.hash.split('?')[0];
  if (routePath === '#/cmdb/relationships') {
    return <GlobalRelationshipsPage />;
  }
  return <CmdbItemsListInner />;
}





===== src\pages\cmdb\CmdbReports.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { DataTable, EmptyState, Field, Input, LoadingRows, PageHeader, Select } from '../../components';
import { CMDB_API_CONTRACT, CMDB_PERMISSIONS, buildCIListUrl, formatDateTime, safeResults } from '../../shared/cmdb-utils';

const REPORT_KINDS = [
  ['coverage', 'Coverage / Distribution'],
  ['verification_age', 'Verification Age / Coverage'],
  ['orphans', 'Orphan CIs'],
  ['ownership_gaps', 'Ownership Gaps'],
  ['relationship_coverage', 'Relationship Coverage'],
  ['drift', 'Drift Summary'],
  ['critical_deps', 'Critical Dependencies / SPOFs'],
  ['asset_sync', 'Asset Sync'],
  ['software_sync', 'Software Sync'],
];

export function CmdbReports() {
  const { role: authRole, user } = useAuth();
  const role = authRole ?? user?.role;
  const [kind, setKind] = useState('coverage');
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState({ date_from: '', date_to: '', ci_type: '', status: '', criticality: '', environment: '', department: '' });
  const [report, setReport] = useState(null);
  const [types, setTypes] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const canView = CMDB_PERMISSIONS.canViewReports(role);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    api.get('/cmdb/types/').then((r) => { if (!cancelled) setTypes(safeResults(r.data?.results ?? r.data)); }).catch(() => {});
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, []);

  const load = async () => {
    if (!canView) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const params = new URLSearchParams({ kind });
      Object.entries(filters).forEach(([k, v]) => { if (v !== '' && v != null) params.set(k, String(v)); });
      const res = await api.get(`${CMDB_API_CONTRACT.reports.endpoint}?${params.toString()}`);
      setReport(res.data || null);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Could not load CMDB report.');
      setReport(null);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [kind]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, react/set-state-in-effect

  const summaryEntries = useMemo(() => Object.entries(report?.summary || {}), [report]);
  const rows = safeResults(report?.rows);
  const columns = useMemo(() => {
    const cols = safeResults(report?.columns);
    if (cols.length) {
      return cols.map((c) => ({
        key: c.key || c.field || c.label,
        label: c.label || c.key || c.field || 'Value',
        render: (row) => {
          const val = row[c.key || c.field];
          if (val == null || val === '') return 'â€”';
          return typeof val === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(val) : String(val);
        },
      }));
    }
    if (!rows.length) return [];
    return Object.keys(rows[0]).slice(0, 8).map((k) => ({
      key: k,
      label: k.replace(/_/g, ' '),
      render: (row) => {
        const val = row[k];
        if (val == null || val === '') return 'â€”';
        if (typeof val === 'object') return JSON.stringify(val);
        return String(val);
      },
    }));
  }, [report, rows]);

  const quickLinks = useMemo(() => {
    const links = [];
    links.push({ href: '#/cmdb/items', label: 'All Configuration Items' });
    if (filters.status) links.push({ href: buildCIListUrl({ status: filters.status }), label: `CIs with status ${filters.status}` });
    if (filters.criticality) links.push({ href: buildCIListUrl({ criticality: filters.criticality }), label: `CIs with criticality ${filters.criticality}` });
    if (filters.ci_type) links.push({ href: buildCIListUrl({ ci_type: filters.ci_type }), label: 'CIs of selected type' });
    if (kind === 'drift') links.push({ href: '#/cmdb/drift', label: 'Drift Findings' });
    if (kind === 'verification_age') links.push({ href: '#/cmdb/verification', label: 'Verification Queue' });
    if (kind === 'relationship_coverage' || kind === 'orphans') links.push({ href: '#/cmdb/relationships', label: 'Relationship Browser' });
    return links;
  }, [filters, kind]);

  if (role === 'employee') {
    return <div className="error-summary" role="alert">Employees have no CMDB report access.</div>;
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="CMDB Reports" sub="Backend-backed configuration, verification, relationship, drift, and sync summaries" />

      <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <div className="split-grid split-4">
          <Field label="Report Kind">
            <Select value={kind} onChange={(e) => setKind(e.target.value)}>
              {REPORT_KINDS.map(([k, label]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{label}</option>)}
            </Select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="CI Type">
            <Select value={filters.ci_type} onChange={(e) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, ci_type: e.target.value }))}>
              <option value="">All types</option>
              {types.map((t) => <option key={t.id} value={String(t.id)}>{t.name || t.code || `Type #${t.id}`}</option>)}
            </Select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="Status">
            <Input value={filters.status} onChange={(e) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, status: e.target.value }))} placeholder="e.g. active" />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Criticality">
            <Input value={filters.criticality} onChange={(e) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, criticality: e.target.value }))} placeholder="e.g. critical" />
          </Field>
        </div>
        <div className="split-grid split-4" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
          <Field label="Environment">
            <Input value={filters.environment} onChange={(e) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, environment: e.target.value }))} placeholder="e.g. production" />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Department ID">
            <Input value={filters.department} onChange={(e) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, department: e.target.value }))} placeholder="Department id" />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Date From">
            <Input type="date" value={filters.date_from} onChange={(e) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, date_from: e.target.value }))} />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Date To">
            <Input type="date" value={filters.date_to} onChange={(e) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, date_to: e.target.value }))} />
          </Field>
        </div>
        <div className="row-end" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
          <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={load} disabled={loading}>{loading ? 'Loadingâ€¦' : 'Run Report'}</button>
        </div>
        <p className="muted" style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>Filters are sent to backend report endpoints where supported. If a specific breakdown is not provided by the backend for this kind, the UI shows available authoritative rows/summary only (no fabricated metrics).</p>
      </div>

      {error && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>}

      {loading ? (
        <div className="panel panel-pad"><LoadingRows n={6} /></div>
      ) : !report ? (
        <div className="panel panel-pad"><EmptyState title="No report data." hint="Run a report to view backend-backed CMDB metrics." /></div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
            <h2 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Summary</h2>
            <p className="muted">Kind: <strong>{report.kind || kind}</strong> Â· Generated: {formatDateTime(report.generated_at) || 'â€”'}</p>
            {summaryEntries.length === 0 ? <p className="muted">No summary metrics returned for this report.</p> : (
              <div className="kpi-grid">
                {summaryEntries.map(([k, v]) => (
                  <div className="kpi" key={k}>
                    <div className="kpi-label">{k.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</div>
                    <div className="kpi-value">{typeof v === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(v) : String(v)}</div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="table-actions" style={{ marginTop: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              {quickLinks.map((l) => <a key={l.href + l.label} className="btn-small" href={l.href}>{l.label}</a>)}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="panel panel-pad">
            <h2 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Report Rows</h2>
            {rows.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState title="No rows returned." hint="No matching records for this report/filter combination, or this report kind provides summary-only data." />
            ) : (
              <DataTable
                columns={columns}
                rows={rows}
                keyOf={(row, i) => row.id || row.ci_id || row.label || i}
                emptyTitle="No rows."
                emptyHint="No data."
              />
            )}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}



===== src\pages\cmdb\DependencyMap.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { DataTable, EmptyState, Field, LoadingRows, PageHeader, Select } from '../../components';
import {
  CI_STATUS_LABELS,
  CRITICALITY_LABELS,
  RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_LABELS,
  safeResults,
} from '../../shared/cmdb-utils';

function nodeIdOf(node) { return Number(node?.id ?? node?.ci_id ?? node); }

export function DependencyMap({ id: idProp, match }) {
  const id = Number(idProp ?? match?.params?.id);
  const { role: authRole, user } = useAuth();
  const role = authRole ?? user?.role;
  const [depth, setDepth] = useState(3);
  const [view, setView] = useState('combined');
  const [graph, setGraph] = useState({ nodes: [], edges: [], nodeCount: 0, cycleIndicator: false, truncated: false, max_depth: 3 });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [selectedNodeId, setSelectedNodeId] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    if (!id) return undefined;
    setLoading(true); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    setError(''); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    api.get(`/cmdb/items/${id}/dependencies/?depth=${depth}`)
      .then((r) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        const data = r.data || {};
        setGraph({
          nodes: safeResults(data.nodes),
          edges: safeResults(data.edges),
          nodeCount: data.nodeCount ?? data.nodes?.length ?? 0,
          cycleIndicator: !!data.cycleIndicator,
          truncated: !!data.truncated,
          max_depth: data.max_depth ?? depth,
        });
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (!cancelled) setError(e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Could not load dependency graph.');
      })
      .finally(() => { if (!cancelled) setLoading(false); });
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [id, depth]);

  const nodesById = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map();
    (graph.nodes || []).forEach((n) => map.set(nodeIdOf(n), n));
    return map;
  }, [graph.nodes]);

  const { upstreamEdges, downstreamEdges } = useMemo(() => {
    const edges = graph.edges || [];
    return {
      upstreamEdges: edges.filter((e) => Number(e.target_ci ?? e.target) === id || Number(e.target_id) === id),
      downstreamEdges: edges.filter((e) => Number(e.source_ci ?? e.source) === id || Number(e.source_id) === id),
    };
  }, [graph.edges, id]);

  const upstreamNodeIds = useMemo(() => new Set(upstreamEdges.map((e) => Number(e.source_ci ?? e.source ?? e.source_id))), [upstreamEdges]);
  const downstreamNodeIds = useMemo(() => new Set(downstreamEdges.map((e) => Number(e.target_ci ?? e.target ?? e.target_id))), [downstreamEdges]);

  const visibleNodes = useMemo(() => {
    if (view === 'upstream') return (graph.nodes || []).filter((n) => upstreamNodeIds.has(nodeIdOf(n)) || nodeIdOf(n) === id);
    if (view === 'downstream') return (graph.nodes || []).filter((n) => downstreamNodeIds.has(nodeIdOf(n)) || nodeIdOf(n) === id);
    return graph.nodes || [];
  }, [graph.nodes, view, upstreamNodeIds, downstreamNodeIds, id]);

  const visibleEdges = useMemo(() => {
    if (view === 'upstream') return upstreamEdges;
    if (view === 'downstream') return downstreamEdges;
    return graph.edges || [];
  }, [graph.edges, view, upstreamEdges, downstreamEdges]);

  const selectedNode = selectedNodeId != null ? nodesById.get(Number(selectedNodeId)) : (nodesById.get(id) || null);
  const selectedEdges = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedNode) return { incoming: [], outgoing: [] };
    const nid = nodeIdOf(selectedNode);
    const edges = graph.edges || [];
    return {
      incoming: edges.filter((e) => Number(e.target_ci ?? e.target ?? e.target_id) === nid),
      outgoing: edges.filter((e) => Number(e.source_ci ?? e.source ?? e.source_id) === nid),
    };
  }, [selectedNode, graph.edges]);

  if (role === 'employee') {
    return <div className="error-summary" role="alert">Employees have no dependency map access.</div>;
  }

  const ciLabel = (nodeId) => {
    const n = nodesById.get(Number(nodeId));
    if (!n) return `CI #${nodeId}`;
    return `${n.ci_number || `CI #${n.id}`} â€” ${n.name || 'Unnamed'}`;
  };

  const nodeColumns = [
    {
      key: 'ci',
      label: 'Configuration Item',
      render: (node) => {
        const nid = nodeIdOf(node);
        const critical = String(node.criticality || '').toLowerCase() === 'critical';
        return (
          <button type="button" className="link-button" onClick={() => setSelectedNodeId(nid)} style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>
            <strong>{node.ci_number || `CI #${nid}`}</strong> â€” {node.name || 'Unnamed'}
            {nid === id ? ' (current)' : ''}
            {critical ? <span className="badge" style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}>Critical</span> : null}
          </button>
        );
      },
    },
    { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (n) => CI_STATUS_LABELS[n.status] || n.status || 'â€”' },
    { key: 'criticality', label: 'Criticality', render: (n) => CRITICALITY_LABELS[n.criticality] || n.criticality || 'â€”' },
    { key: 'ci_type_name', label: 'Type', render: (n) => n.ci_type_name || n.ci_type || 'â€”' },
    {
      key: 'direction',
      label: 'Relation to Current CI',
      render: (n) => {
        const nid = nodeIdOf(n);
        if (nid === id) return 'Current CI';
        const up = upstreamNodeIds.has(nid);
        const down = downstreamNodeIds.has(nid);
        if (up && down) return 'Upstream & downstream';
        if (up) return 'Upstream (depends on / feeds into context)';
        if (down) return 'Downstream (impacted by current CI)';
        return 'Connected';
      },
    },
    {
      key: 'actions',
      label: 'Actions',
      render: (n) => (
        <div className="table-actions">
          <a className="btn-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${nodeIdOf(n)}`}>Open CI</a>
          <a className="btn-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${nodeIdOf(n)}/dependencies`}>Dependencies</a>
          <a className="btn-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${nodeIdOf(n)}/impact`}>Impact</a>
        </div>
      ),
    },
  ];

  const edgeColumns = [
    {
      key: 'source',
      label: 'Source CI',
      render: (e) => {
        const sid = Number(e.source_ci ?? e.source ?? e.source_id);
        return <a href={`#/cmdb/items/${sid}`}>{ciLabel(sid)}</a>;
      },
    },
    { key: 'direction', label: 'Direction', render: () => 'â†’' },
    {
      key: 'target',
      label: 'Target CI',
      render: (e) => {
        const tid = Number(e.target_ci ?? e.target ?? e.target_id);
        return <a href={`#/cmdb/items/${tid}`}>{ciLabel(tid)}</a>;
      },
    },
    { key: 'relationship_type', label: 'Relationship', render: (e) => RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_LABELS[e.relationship_type || e.type] || e.relationship_type || e.type || 'â€”' },
  ];

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Dependency Map"
        sub={`Upstream and downstream dependencies for CI #${id}`}
        actions={(
          <>
            <a className="btn-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${id}`}>Back to CI</a>
            <a className="btn-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${id}/impact`}>Impact Analysis</a>
            <a className="btn-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${id}/relationships`}>Relationships</a>
          </>
        )}
      />

      {error && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>}

      <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <div className="split-grid split-4">
          <Field label="Depth">
            <Select value={String(depth)} onChange={(e) => setDepth(Number(e.target.value))} aria-label="Dependency depth">
              {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((d) => <option key={d} value={String(d)}>{d}</option>)}
            </Select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="View">
            <Select value={view} onChange={(e) => setView(e.target.value)} aria-label="Dependency view">
              <option value="combined">Combined (upstream + downstream)</option>
              <option value="upstream">Upstream only</option>
              <option value="downstream">Downstream only</option>
            </Select>
          </Field>
          <div className="muted" style={{ alignSelf: 'end' }}>Nodes: {graph.nodeCount || visibleNodes.length}</div>
          <div className="muted" style={{ alignSelf: 'end' }}>Edges: {visibleEdges.length}</div>
        </div>
        {(graph.cycleIndicator || graph.truncated) && (
          <div style={{ marginTop: 12, display: 'grid', gap: 8 }}>
            {graph.cycleIndicator && <div className="notice">Cycle detected in dependency traversal. Graph is bounded to prevent infinite loops.</div>}
            {graph.truncated && <div className="notice">Results truncated at the backend safety limit. Reduce depth or inspect specific branches to avoid excessively large graphs.</div>}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <div className="panel panel-pad"><LoadingRows n={6} /></div>
      ) : visibleNodes.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="panel panel-pad">
          <EmptyState title="No dependencies found." hint="This CI has no recorded upstream/downstream relationships for the selected view and depth." />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="split-grid split-2" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
            <div className="panel panel-pad">
              <h2 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Connected Configuration Items</h2>
              <p className="muted">Select a node to inspect details. Critical CIs are highlighted. Use actions to navigate to CI detail, dependency, or impact views.</p>
              <DataTable columns={nodeColumns} rows={visibleNodes} keyOf={(n) => nodeIdOf(n)} emptyTitle="No nodes" emptyHint="No nodes for selected view." />
            </div>
            <div className="panel panel-pad">
              <h2 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Selected Node Details</h2>
              {!selectedNode ? (
                <EmptyState title="No node selected." hint="Select a configuration item from the table." />
              ) : (
                <div>
                  <p><strong>{selectedNode.ci_number || `CI #${nodeIdOf(selectedNode)}`}</strong> â€” {selectedNode.name || 'Unnamed'}</p>
                  <p className="muted">Status: {CI_STATUS_LABELS[selectedNode.status] || selectedNode.status || 'â€”'} Â· Criticality: {CRITICALITY_LABELS[selectedNode.criticality] || selectedNode.criticality || 'â€”'} Â· Type: {selectedNode.ci_type_name || selectedNode.ci_type || 'â€”'}</p>
                  <div className="table-actions" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
                    <a className="btn-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${nodeIdOf(selectedNode)}`}>Open CI Detail</a>
                    <a className="btn-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${nodeIdOf(selectedNode)}/dependencies`}>View Dependencies</a>
                    <a className="btn-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${nodeIdOf(selectedNode)}/impact`}>View Impact</a>
                    <a className="btn-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${nodeIdOf(selectedNode)}/relationships`}>Relationships</a>
                  </div>
                  <h3>Incoming (upstream into selected node)</h3>
                  {selectedEdges.incoming.length === 0 ? <p className="muted">None in current graph.</p> : (
                    <ul>
                      {selectedEdges.incoming.map((e, i) => {
                        const sid = Number(e.source_ci ?? e.source ?? e.source_id);
                        return <li key={`in-${i}`}><a href={`#/cmdb/items/${sid}`}>{ciLabel(sid)}</a> â€” {RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_LABELS[e.relationship_type || e.type] || e.relationship_type || e.type || 'relationship'} â†’ selected</li>;
                      })}
                    </ul>
                  )}
                  <h3>Outgoing (downstream from selected node)</h3>
                  {selectedEdges.outgoing.length === 0 ? <p className="muted">None in current graph.</p> : (
                    <ul>
                      {selectedEdges.outgoing.map((e, i) => {
                        const tid = Number(e.target_ci ?? e.target ?? e.target_id);
                        return <li key={`out-${i}`}>selected â†’ <a href={`#/cmdb/items/${tid}`}>{ciLabel(tid)}</a> â€” {RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_LABELS[e.relationship_type || e.type] || e.relationship_type || e.type || 'relationship'}</li>;
                      })}
                    </ul>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="panel panel-pad">
            <h2 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Dependency Edges ({view})</h2>
            <p className="muted">Direction: source CI â†’ target CI. Use this to understand upstream/downstream flow and navigate connected items.</p>
            <DataTable columns={edgeColumns} rows={visibleEdges} keyOf={(e, i) => `${e.id || i}-${e.source_ci || e.source}-${e.target_ci || e.target}`} emptyTitle="No edges" emptyHint="No relationship edges in the selected view." />
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}



===== src\pages\cmdb\DriftFindingsPage.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { DataTable, EmptyState, Field, Input, LoadingRows, PageHeader, Pager, Select } from '../../components';
import { parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';
import {
  DRIFT_SEVERITY_LABELS,
  DRIFT_STATUS_LABELS,
  DRIFT_TYPE_LABELS,
  formatDateTime,
  safeResults,
} from '../../shared/cmdb-utils';
import { CMDB_API_CONTRACT, CMDB_PERMISSIONS } from '../../shared/cmdb';

const DEFAULT_FILTERS = { status: 'open', severity: '', type: '', ci: '', search: '', date_from: '', date_to: '' };

function stringifyValue(v) {
  if (v == null || v === '') return 'â€”';
  if (typeof v === 'object') return JSON.stringify(v);
  return String(v);
}

export function DriftFindingsPage() {
  const { role: authRole, user } = useAuth();
  const role = authRole ?? user?.role;
  const [rows, setRows] = useState([]);
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');
  const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState(null);
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState(DEFAULT_FILTERS);
  const [applied, setApplied] = useState(DEFAULT_FILTERS);
  const pageSize = 25;

  const canView = CMDB_PERMISSIONS.canViewDrift(role);
  const canManage = CMDB_PERMISSIONS.canAcknowledgeDrift(role) || CMDB_PERMISSIONS.canResolveDrift(role);

  const load = async () => {
    if (!canView) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const params = new URLSearchParams();
      params.set('page', String(page));
      if (applied.status) params.set('status', applied.status);
      if (applied.severity) params.set('severity', applied.severity);
      if (applied.type) params.set('type', applied.type);
      if (applied.ci) params.set('ci', applied.ci);
      if (applied.search) params.set('search', applied.search);
      if (applied.date_from) params.set('date_from', applied.date_from);
      if (applied.date_to) params.set('date_to', applied.date_to);
      const res = await api.get(`${CMDB_API_CONTRACT.driftList.endpoint}?${params.toString()}`);
      const data = res.data;
      if (Array.isArray(data)) {
        setRows(data);
        setCount(data.length);
      } else {
        setRows(safeResults(data?.results));
        setCount(data?.count ?? safeResults(data?.results).length);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not load drift findings.');
      setRows([]);
      setCount(0);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [applied, page]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, react/set-state-in-effect

  useEffect(() => { setPage(1); }, [applied]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect

  const runAction = async (row, action) => {
    const needsNote = ['resolve', 'accept', 'false-positive'].includes(action);
    const note = needsNote ? window.prompt(`Enter a note for ${action.replace('-', ' ')} (required):`, '') : '';
    if (needsNote && !String(note || '').trim()) return;
    setBusyId(row.id);
    setError('');
    setMsg('');
    try {
      await api.post(`/cmdb/drift/${row.id}/${action}/`, note ? { note, resolution_note: note } : {});
      setMsg(`Drift finding ${row.id} ${action.replace('-', ' ')} completed.`);
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || `Could not ${action.replace('-', ' ')} drift finding.`);
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null);
    }
  };

  if (role === 'employee') {
    return <div className="error-summary" role="alert">Employees have no CMDB drift access.</div>;
  }

  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((count || 0) / pageSize));

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Drift Findings" sub="Review configuration drift, filter by severity/status/source, and take permitted remediation actions" />

      <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <form onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); setApplied({ ...filters }); }} noValidate>
          <div className="split-grid split-4">
            <Field label="Status">
              <Select value={filters.status} onChange={(e) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, status: e.target.value }))}>
                <option value="">All statuses</option>
                {Object.entries(DRIFT_STATUS_LABELS).map(([k, label]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{label}</option>)}
              </Select>
            </Field>
            <Field label="Severity">
              <Select value={filters.severity} onChange={(e) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, severity: e.target.value }))}>
                <option value="">All severities</option>
                {Object.entries(DRIFT_SEVERITY_LABELS).map(([k, label]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{label}</option>)}
              </Select>
            </Field>
            <Field label="Finding Type">
              <Select value={filters.type} onChange={(e) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, type: e.target.value }))}>
                <option value="">All types</option>
                {Object.entries(DRIFT_TYPE_LABELS).map(([k, label]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{label}</option>)}
              </Select>
            </Field>
            <Field label="CI ID">
              <Input value={filters.ci} onChange={(e) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, ci: e.target.value }))} placeholder="Configuration item id" />
            </Field>
          </div>
          <div className="split-grid split-4" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
            <Field label="Search">
              <Input value={filters.search} onChange={(e) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, search: e.target.value }))} placeholder="Field, CI name/numberâ€¦" />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Detected From">
              <Input type="date" value={filters.date_from} onChange={(e) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, date_from: e.target.value }))} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Detected To">
              <Input type="date" value={filters.date_to} onChange={(e) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, date_to: e.target.value }))} />
            </Field>
            <div className="row-end" style={{ alignItems: 'flex-end' }}>
              <button type="submit" className="btn-primary">Apply</button>
              <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => { setFilters(DEFAULT_FILTERS); setApplied(DEFAULT_FILTERS); }}>Reset</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </form>
        <p className="muted" style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>Actions use backend permissions and immutable finding records. Resolve/accept/false-positive require a note; navigation links go to the affected CI.</p>
      </div>

      {error && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>}
      {msg && <div className="success-banner" role="status">{msg}</div>}

      <div className="panel panel-pad">
        {loading ? (
          <LoadingRows n={6} />
        ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState title="No drift findings found." hint="Adjust filters or run baseline comparisons to detect drift." />
        ) : (
          <>
            <p className="muted" style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Showing {rows.length} of {count} finding(s), page {page} of {totalPages}.</p>
            <DataTable
              columns={[
                { key: 'id', label: 'ID', render: (row) => row.id },
                {
                  key: 'ci',
                  label: 'Affected CI',
                  render: (row) => {
                    const cid = row.configuration_item || row.ci || row.ci_id;
                    const label = row.ci_number ? `${row.ci_number}${row.ci_name ? ` â€” ${row.ci_name}` : ''}` : (cid ? `CI #${cid}` : 'â€”');
                    return cid ? <a href={`#/cmdb/items/${cid}`}>{label}</a> : label;
                  },
                },
                { key: 'field_name', label: 'Field', render: (row) => row.field_name || 'â€”' },
                { key: 'expected', label: 'Expected', render: (row) => stringifyValue(row.expected_value) },
                { key: 'actual', label: 'Current', render: (row) => stringifyValue(row.actual_value) },
                { key: 'severity', label: 'Severity', render: (row) => DRIFT_SEVERITY_LABELS[row.severity] || row.severity || 'â€”' },
                { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (row) => DRIFT_STATUS_LABELS[row.status] || row.status || 'â€”' },
                { key: 'finding_type', label: 'Type', render: (row) => DRIFT_TYPE_LABELS[row.finding_type] || row.finding_type || 'â€”' },
                { key: 'source', label: 'Source', render: (row) => row.source || 'â€”' },
                { key: 'detected_at', label: 'Detected', render: (row) => formatDateTime(row.detected_at || row.created_at) },
                { key: 'resolution_note', label: 'Resolution Note', render: (row) => row.resolution_note || 'â€”' },
                {
                  key: 'actions',
                  label: 'Actions',
                  render: (row) => (
                    <div className="table-actions">
                      {(row.configuration_item || row.ci || row.ci_id) && <a className="btn-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${row.configuration_item || row.ci || row.ci_id}`}>Open CI</a>}
                      {canManage && row.status === 'open' && <button type="button" className="btn-small" disabled={busyId === row.id} onClick={() => runAction(row, 'acknowledge')}>Acknowledge</button>}
                      {canManage && (row.status === 'open' || row.status === 'acknowledged') && <button type="button" className="btn-small" disabled={busyId === row.id} onClick={() => runAction(row, 'resolve')}>Resolve</button>}
                      {canManage && row.status !== 'accepted' && <button type="button" className="btn-small" disabled={busyId === row.id} onClick={() => runAction(row, 'accept')}>Accept</button>}
                      {canManage && row.status !== 'false_positive' && <button type="button" className="btn-small" disabled={busyId === row.id} onClick={() => runAction(row, 'false-positive')}>False Positive</button>}
                    </div>
                  ),
                },
              ]}
              rows={rows}
              keyOf={(row) => row.id}
              emptyTitle="No drift findings."
              emptyHint="No findings match filters."
            />
            <Pager page={page} total={totalPages} count={count} pageSize={pageSize} onPage={setPage} />
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}




===== src\pages\cmdb\ImpactAnalysisPage.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { DataTable, EmptyState, Field, LoadingRows, PageHeader, Select } from '../../components';
import { CI_STATUS_LABELS, CRITICALITY_LABELS, safeResults } from '../../shared/cmdb-utils';

function ciDisplay(row) {
  if (!row) return 'â€”';
  const num = row.ci_number || `CI #${row.id}`;
  return row.name ? `${num} â€” ${row.name}` : num;
}

export function ImpactAnalysisPage({ id: idProp, match }) {
  const id = Number(idProp ?? match?.params?.id);
  const { role: authRole, user } = useAuth();
  const role = authRole ?? user?.role;
  const [impact, setImpact] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [depth, setDepth] = useState(3);
  const [includeTickets, setIncludeTickets] = useState(false);
  const [includeChanges, setIncludeChanges] = useState(false);
  const [selectedCiId, setSelectedCiId] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    if (!id) return undefined;
    setLoading(true); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    setError(''); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    const params = new URLSearchParams({ depth: String(depth) });
    if (includeTickets) params.set('include_tickets', 'true');
    if (includeChanges) params.set('include_changes', 'true');
    api.get(`/cmdb/items/${id}/impact/?${params.toString()}`)
      .then((r) => { if (!cancelled) setImpact(r.data || null); })
      .catch((e) => { if (!cancelled) setError(e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Could not load impact analysis.'); })
      .finally(() => { if (!cancelled) setLoading(false); });
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [id, depth, includeTickets, includeChanges]);

  const affectedCIs = useMemo(() => {
    const ids = safeResults(impact?.affected_ci_ids);
    const details = safeResults(impact?.affected_cis);
    if (details.length) return details;
    return ids.map((cid) => ({ id: cid, ci_number: `CI #${cid}`, name: '' }));
  }, [impact]);

  const selectedCi = useMemo(() => affectedCIs.find((c) => Number(c.id) === Number(selectedCiId)) || null, [affectedCIs, selectedCiId]);

  if (role === 'employee') {
    return <div className="error-summary" role="alert">Employees have no CMDB impact analysis access.</div>;
  }

  const risk = impact?.risk_summary || {};
  const criticalDeps = safeResults(impact?.critical_dependencies);
  const spofs = safeResults(impact?.single_points_of_failure);
  const services = safeResults(impact?.affected_services);
  const departments = safeResults(impact?.affected_departments);
  const owners = safeResults(impact?.affected_owners);
  const tickets = safeResults(impact?.affected_tickets);
  const changes = safeResults(impact?.affected_changes);

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Impact Analysis"
        sub={`Downstream impact for CI #${id}${impact?.ci_number ? ` (${impact.ci_number})` : ''}`}
        actions={(
          <>
            <a className="btn-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${id}`}>Back to CI</a>
            <a className="btn-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${id}/dependencies`}>Dependency Map</a>
            <a className="btn-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${id}/relationships`}>Relationships</a>
          </>
        )}
      />
      <p className="muted">Impact analysis is based on recorded CMDB relationships.</p>

      {error && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>}

      <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <div className="split-grid split-4">
          <Field label="Maximum Depth">
            <Select value={String(depth)} onChange={(e) => setDepth(Number(e.target.value))}>
              {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((d) => <option key={d} value={String(d)}>{d}</option>)}
            </Select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="Include Tickets">
            <Select value={includeTickets ? 'yes' : 'no'} onChange={(e) => setIncludeTickets(e.target.value === 'yes')}>
              <option value="no">No</option>
              <option value="yes">Yes</option>
            </Select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="Include Changes">
            <Select value={includeChanges ? 'yes' : 'no'} onChange={(e) => setIncludeChanges(e.target.value === 'yes')}>
              <option value="no">No</option>
              <option value="yes">Yes</option>
            </Select>
          </Field>
          <div className="muted" style={{ alignSelf: 'end' }}>
            Affected CIs: {impact?.affected_count ?? affectedCIs.length}{impact?.truncated ? ' (truncated)' : ''}
          </div>
        </div>
        {impact?.warning && <div className="notice" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>{impact.warning}</div>}
        {impact?.truncated && <div className="notice" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>Impact results were truncated by backend safety limits. Reduce depth or inspect specific downstream branches.</div>}
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <div className="panel panel-pad"><LoadingRows n={6} /></div>
      ) : !impact ? (
        <div className="panel panel-pad"><EmptyState title="No impact data." hint="Impact analysis could not be loaded for this CI." /></div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="kpi-grid" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
            <div className="kpi"><div className="kpi-label">Affected CIs</div><div className="kpi-value">{impact.affected_count ?? affectedCIs.length}</div></div>
            <div className="kpi"><div className="kpi-label">Affected Services</div><div className="kpi-value">{services.length}</div></div>
            <div className="kpi"><div className="kpi-label">Critical Dependencies</div><div className="kpi-value">{criticalDeps.length}</div></div>
            <div className="kpi"><div className="kpi-label">Single Points of Failure</div><div className="kpi-value">{spofs.length}</div></div>
          </div>

          <div className="split-grid split-2" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
            <div className="panel panel-pad">
              <h2 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Affected Configuration Items</h2>
              {affectedCIs.length === 0 ? (
                <EmptyState title="No downstream CIs affected." hint="No dependent configuration items were found for the selected depth." />
              ) : (
                <DataTable
                  columns={[
                    {
                      key: 'ci',
                      label: 'Configuration Item',
                      render: (row) => (
                        <button type="button" className="link-button" onClick={() => setSelectedCiId(row.id)} style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>
                          {ciDisplay(row)}{String(row.criticality || '').toLowerCase() === 'critical' ? <span className="badge" style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}>Critical</span> : null}
                        </button>
                      ),
                    },
                    { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (row) => CI_STATUS_LABELS[row.status] || row.status || 'â€”' },
                    { key: 'criticality', label: 'Criticality', render: (row) => CRITICALITY_LABELS[row.criticality] || row.criticality || 'â€”' },
                    {
                      key: 'actions',
                      label: 'Navigate',
                      render: (row) => (
                        <div className="table-actions">
                          <a className="btn-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${row.id}`}>Open CI</a>
                          <a className="btn-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${row.id}/dependencies`}>Dependencies</a>
                          <a className="btn-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${row.id}/impact`}>Impact</a>
                        </div>
                      ),
                    },
                  ]}
                  rows={affectedCIs}
                  keyOf={(row) => row.id}
                  emptyTitle="No affected CIs."
                  emptyHint="No downstream configuration items found."
                />
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="panel panel-pad">
              <h2 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Selected Affected CI</h2>
              {!selectedCi ? (
                <EmptyState title="No CI selected." hint="Select an affected CI to view details and navigation actions." />
              ) : (
                <div>
                  <p><strong>{ciDisplay(selectedCi)}</strong></p>
                  <p className="muted">Status: {CI_STATUS_LABELS[selectedCi.status] || selectedCi.status || 'â€”'} Â· Criticality: {CRITICALITY_LABELS[selectedCi.criticality] || selectedCi.criticality || 'â€”'}</p>
                  <div className="table-actions" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
                    <a className="btn-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${selectedCi.id}`}>Open CI Detail</a>
                    <a className="btn-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${selectedCi.id}/dependencies`}>View Dependencies</a>
                    <a className="btn-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${selectedCi.id}/impact`}>Analyze Its Impact</a>
                    <a className="btn-small" href={`#/cmdb/items/${selectedCi.id}/relationships`}>Relationships</a>
                  </div>
                  {selectedCi.environment && <p><strong>Environment:</strong> {selectedCi.environment}</p>}
                  {selectedCi.department_name && <p><strong>Department:</strong> {selectedCi.department_name}</p>}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="split-grid split-2" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
            <div className="panel panel-pad">
              <h2 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Critical Dependencies & SPOFs</h2>
              <h3>Critical Dependencies</h3>
              {criticalDeps.length === 0 ? <p className="muted">None identified.</p> : (
                <ul>
                  {criticalDeps.map((d, i) => {
                    const cid = d.id ?? d.ci_id ?? d.configuration_item;
                    return <li key={`cd-${i}`}>{cid ? <a href={`#/cmdb/items/${cid}`}>{d.ci_number || d.name || `CI #${cid}`}</a> : (d.name || d.ci_number || JSON.stringify(d))} {d.criticality ? `(${d.criticality})` : ''}</li>;
                  })}
                </ul>
              )}
              <h3>Single Points of Failure</h3>
              {spofs.length === 0 ? <p className="muted">None identified.</p> : (
                <ul>
                  {spofs.map((s, i) => {
                    const cid = s.ci_id ?? s.id ?? s.configuration_item;
                    return <li key={`spof-${i}`}>{cid ? <a href={`#/cmdb/items/${cid}`}>{s.ci_number || s.ci_name || s.name || `CI #${cid}`}</a> : (s.name || JSON.stringify(s))} {s.dependent_count != null ? `â€” dependents: ${s.dependent_count}` : ''}</li>;
                  })}
                </ul>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className="panel panel-pad">
              <h2 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Affected Scope</h2>
              <h3>Services</h3>
              {services.length === 0 ? <p className="muted">No affected services reported.</p> : <ul>{services.map((s, i) => <li key={`svc-${i}`}>{s.name || s.service_name || `Service #${s.id || s.service_id || i}`}</li>)}</ul>}
              <h3>Departments</h3>
              {departments.length === 0 ? <p className="muted">No affected departments reported.</p> : <ul>{departments.map((d, i) => <li key={`dep-${i}`}>{d.name || d.department_name || `Department #${d.id || i}`}</li>)}</ul>}
              <h3>Owners</h3>
              {owners.length === 0 ? <p className="muted">No affected owners reported.</p> : <ul>{owners.map((o, i) => <li key={`own-${i}`}>{o.email || o.username || o.name || `User #${o.id || i}`}</li>)}</ul>}
              {(includeTickets || includeChanges) && (
                <>
                  <h3>Affected Tickets</h3>
                  {tickets.length === 0 ? <p className="muted">None or not included.</p> : <ul>{tickets.map((t, i) => <li key={`t-${i}`}>{t.ticket_number || t.id || JSON.stringify(t)} {t.status ? `(${t.status})` : ''}</li>)}</ul>}
                  <h3>Affected Changes</h3>
                  {changes.length === 0 ? <p className="muted">None or not included.</p> : <ul>{changes.map((c, i) => <li key={`c-${i}`}>{c.change_number || c.id || JSON.stringify(c)} {c.status ? `(${c.status})` : ''}</li>)}</ul>}
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="panel panel-pad">
            <h2 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Risk Summary</h2>
            {Object.keys(risk).length === 0 ? (
              <p className="muted">No risk summary provided by backend.</p>
            ) : (
              <div className="split-grid split-3">
                {Object.entries(risk).map(([k, v]) => (
                  <div key={k}><strong>{k.replace(/_/g, ' ')}:</strong> {typeof v === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(v) : String(v)}</div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\pages\cmdb\ServiceMappingPage.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { DataTable, EmptyState, Field, LoadingRows, PageHeader, Select } from '../../components';
import { CMDB_API_CONTRACT, CMDB_PERMISSIONS, CI_STATUS_LABELS, CRITICALITY_LABELS, safeResults } from '../../shared/cmdb-utils';

function ciLabel(ci) {
  if (!ci) return 'â€”';
  const num = ci.ci_number || `CI #${ci.id || ci.ci_id}`;
  const name = ci.name || ci.ci_name || '';
  return name ? `${num} â€” ${name}` : num;
}

export function ServiceMappingPage() {
  const { role: authRole, user } = useAuth();
  const role = authRole ?? user?.role;
  const [profiles, setProfiles] = useState([]);
  const [links, setLinks] = useState([]);
  const [selectedServiceId, setSelectedServiceId] = useState('');
  const [graph, setGraph] = useState(null);
  const [impact, setImpact] = useState(null);
  const [spof, setSpof] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [detailLoading, setDetailLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [detailError, setDetailError] = useState('');

  const canView = CMDB_PERMISSIONS.canViewServiceMapping(role);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    if (!canView) { setLoading(false); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
      return undefined; }
    setLoading(true); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    setError(''); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    Promise.all([
      api.get(CMDB_API_CONTRACT.serviceMapping.endpoint),
      api.get('/cmdb/service-links/'),
    ])
      .then(([pRes, lRes]) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        const p = safeResults(pRes.data?.results ?? pRes.data);
        setProfiles(p);
        setLinks(safeResults(lRes.data?.results ?? lRes.data));
        const firstService = p[0]?.service || p[0]?.service_id;
        if (firstService) setSelectedServiceId(String(firstService));
      })
      .catch((e) => { if (!cancelled) setError(e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Could not load service mapping data.'); })
      .finally(() => { if (!cancelled) setLoading(false); });
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [canView]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    if (!selectedServiceId) { setGraph(null); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
      setImpact(null); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
      setSpof(null); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
      return undefined; }
    setDetailLoading(true); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    setDetailError(''); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    Promise.allSettled([
      api.get(`/cmdb/services/${selectedServiceId}/graph/`),
      api.get(`/cmdb/services/${selectedServiceId}/impact/`),
      api.get(`/cmdb/services/${selectedServiceId}/single-points-of-failure/`),
    ]).then((results) => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      const [g, i, s] = results;
      setGraph(g.status === 'fulfilled' ? g.value.data : null);
      setImpact(i.status === 'fulfilled' ? i.value.data : null);
      setSpof(s.status === 'fulfilled' ? s.value.data : null);
      const firstErr = results.find((r) => r.status === 'rejected');
      if (firstErr && g.status === 'rejected' && i.status === 'rejected' && s.status === 'rejected') {
        setDetailError(firstErr.reason?.response?.data?.detail || 'Could not load service graph/impact details.');
      }
    }).finally(() => { if (!cancelled) setDetailLoading(false); });
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [selectedServiceId]);

  const selectedProfile = useMemo(() => profiles.find((p) => String(p.service || p.service_id) === String(selectedServiceId)) || null, [profiles, selectedServiceId]);
  const serviceLinks = useMemo(() => links.filter((l) => String(l.service || l.service_id) === String(selectedServiceId)), [links, selectedServiceId]);
  const nodes = safeResults(graph?.nodes);
  const edges = safeResults(graph?.edges);
  const affectedCis = safeResults(impact?.affected_cis).length ? safeResults(impact?.affected_cis) : safeResults(impact?.affected_ci_ids).map((id) => ({ id, ci_number: `CI #${id}` }));
  const spofItems = safeResults(spof?.single_points_of_failure);

  if (role === 'employee') {
    return <div className="error-summary" role="alert">Employees have no CMDB service mapping access.</div>;
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Service Mapping"
        sub="Service-to-CI visibility using existing CMDB service profiles, links, dependency graphs, impact, and SPOF data"
        actions={<a className="btn-small" href="#/cmdb/items">Configuration Items</a>}
      />

      {error && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>}

      {loading ? (
        <div className="panel panel-pad"><LoadingRows n={6} /></div>
      ) : profiles.length === 0 && links.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="panel panel-pad">
          <EmptyState title="No service mapping data found." hint="No service profiles or service-CI links are currently available from the backend." />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
            <div className="split-grid split-2">
              <Field label="Service (from profiles)">
                <Select value={selectedServiceId} onChange={(e) => setSelectedServiceId(e.target.value)}>
                  <option value="">Select a service</option>
                  {profiles.map((p) => {
                    const sid = p.service || p.service_id || p.id;
                    return <option key={p.id || sid} value={String(sid)}>{p.service_name || p.name || `Service #${sid}`}</option>;
                  })}
                </Select>
              </Field>
              <div className="muted" style={{ alignSelf: 'end' }}>
                Profiles: {profiles.length} Â· Links: {links.length} Â· Selected service links: {serviceLinks.length}
              </div>
            </div>
            {selectedProfile && (
              <div style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
                <p><strong>{selectedProfile.service_name || selectedProfile.name || `Service #${selectedServiceId}`}</strong></p>
                <p className="muted">Criticality: {CRITICALITY_LABELS[selectedProfile.criticality] || selectedProfile.criticality || 'â€”'} Â· Tier: {selectedProfile.service_tier || 'â€”'} Â· Availability target: {selectedProfile.availability_target || 'â€”'}</p>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

            <DataTable
              columns={[
                { key: 'service_name', label: 'Service', render: (row) => row.service_name || row.name || `Service #${row.service || row.id}` },
                { key: 'criticality', label: 'Criticality', render: (row) => CRITICALITY_LABELS[row.criticality] || row.criticality || 'â€”' },
                { key: 'service_tier', label: 'Tier', render: (row) => row.service_tier || 'â€”' },
                { key: 'owner', label: 'Owners', render: (row) => [row.service_owner_name, row.technical_owner_name].filter(Boolean).join(' / ') || 'â€”' },
                { key: 'actions', label: 'Actions', render: (row) => <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => setSelectedServiceId(String(row.service || row.service_id || ''))}>View Mapping</button> },
              ]}
              rows={profiles}
              keyOf={(row) => row.id || row.service}
              emptyTitle="No service profiles."
              emptyHint="Service profiles are not available."
            />
          </div>

          {detailError && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{detailError}</div>}
          {detailLoading ? (
            <div className="panel panel-pad"><LoadingRows n={5} /></div>
          ) : selectedServiceId ? (
            <>
              <div className="split-grid split-2" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
                <div className="panel panel-pad">
                  <h2 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Linked Configuration Items</h2>
                  {serviceLinks.length === 0 ? (
                    <EmptyState title="No service-CI links." hint="No CI links were returned for the selected service." />
                  ) : (
                    <DataTable

                          return cid ? <a href={`#/cmdb/items/${cid}`}>{row.configuration_item_name || row.ci_number || `CI #${cid}`}</a> : 'â€”';

                        } },
                      ]}
                      rows={serviceLinks}
                      keyOf={(row, i) => row.id || i}
                      emptyTitle="No links."
                      emptyHint="No linked CIs."
                    />
                  )}
                </div>

                  {!impact ? <p className="muted">No impact data available for this service.</p> : (
                    <>
                      <p className="muted">Affected CIs: {impact.affected_count ?? affectedCis.length} Â· SPOFs: {safeResults(impact.single_points_of_failure).length} Â· Truncated: {impact.truncated ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</p>
                      {affectedCis.length === 0 ? <EmptyState title="No affected CIs reported." hint="Service impact endpoint returned no affected CIs." /> : (
                        <ul>
                          {affectedCis.slice(0, 20).map((ci, i) => {
                            const cid = ci.id || ci.ci_id;
                            return <li key={cid || i}>{cid ? <a href={`#/cmdb/items/${cid}`}>{ciLabel(ci)}</a> : ciLabel(ci)}</li>;
                          })}
                          {affectedCis.length > 20 && <li className="muted">+ {affectedCis.length - 20} more</li>}
                        </ul>
                      )}
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="split-grid split-2">
                <div className="panel panel-pad">
                  <h2 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Service Dependency Graph (Nodes/Edges)</h2>
                  {!graph ? <p className="muted">No graph data available for this service.</p> : (
                    <>
                      <p className="muted">Nodes: {nodes.length} Â· Edges: {edges.length} {graph.cycleIndicator ? 'Â· Cycle detected' : ''} {graph.truncated ? 'Â· Truncated' : ''}</p>
                      {nodes.length === 0 ? <EmptyState title="No graph nodes." hint="Service graph returned no nodes." /> : (
                        <DataTable
                          columns={[
                            { key: 'ci', label: 'CI', render: (n) => {
                              const cid = n.id || n.ci_id;
                              return cid ? <a href={`#/cmdb/items/${cid}`}>{n.ci_number || `CI #${cid}`}{n.name ? ` â€” ${n.name}` : ''}</a> : (n.name || 'â€”');
                            } },
                            { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (n) => CI_STATUS_LABELS[n.status] || n.status || 'â€”' },
                            { key: 'criticality', label: 'Criticality', render: (n) => CRITICALITY_LABELS[n.criticality] || n.criticality || 'â€”' },
                          ]}
                          rows={nodes.slice(0, 100)}
                          keyOf={(n, i) => n.id || n.ci_id || i}
                          emptyTitle="No nodes."
                          emptyHint="No nodes."
                        />
                      )}
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="panel panel-pad">
                  <h2 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Single Points of Failure</h2>
                  {spofItems.length === 0 ? (
                    <EmptyState title="No SPOFs identified." hint={spof ? 'No single points of failure reported for this service.' : 'SPOF data unavailable for this service.'} />
                  ) : (
                    <DataTable
                      columns={[
                        { key: 'ci', label: 'CI', render: (row) => {
                          const cid = row.ci_id || row.id;
                          return cid ? <a href={`#/cmdb/items/${cid}`}>{row.ci_number || row.ci_name || row.name || `CI #${cid}`}</a> : (row.name || 'â€”');
                        } },
                        { key: 'dependents', label: 'Dependents', render: (row) => row.dependent_count ?? row.dependents ?? 'â€”' },
                        { key: 'criticality', label: 'Criticality', render: (row) => CRITICALITY_LABELS[row.criticality] || row.criticality || 'â€”' },
                      ]}
                      rows={spofItems}
                      keyOf={(row, i) => row.ci_id || row.id || i}
                      emptyTitle="No SPOFs."
                      emptyHint="None."
                    />
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          ) : (
            <div className="panel panel-pad"><EmptyState title="Select a service." hint="Choose a service profile to view linked CIs, graph, impact, and SPOF data." /></div>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}



===== src\pages\cmdb\VerificationQueuePage.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import {
  DataTable, PageHeader, LoadingRows, Field, Select, Input,
} from '../../components';
import { parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';
import {
  formatDateTime, safeResults, CMDB_API_CONTRACT,
} from '../../shared/cmdb-utils';

export function VerificationQueuePage() {
  const { role: authRole, user } = useAuth();
  const role = authRole ?? user?.role;
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    ci: null, verification_note: '', expected_record_version: null,
  });

  // Load verification queue
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    setLoading(true); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    api.get(CMDB_API_CONTRACT.verificationQueue.endpoint)
      .then((r) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        const data = r.data;
        setItems(Array.isArray(data) ? data : safeResults(data?.results));
      })
      .catch(() => { if (!cancelled) setError('Could not load verification queue.'); })
      .finally(() => { if (!cancelled) setLoading(false); });
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, []);

  // Verify a record
  const handleVerify = async () => {
    if (!form.ci) return;
    setError('');
    try {
      await api.post(`/cmdb/items/${form.ci}/verify/`, {
        verification_note: form.verification_note || '',
        expected_record_version: form.expected_record_version ?? undefined,
      });
      setItems((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== form.ci));
      setForm({ ci: null, verification_note: '', expected_record_version: null });
    } catch (e) {
      const parsed = parseApiError(e);
      setError(parsed.global || 'Could not verify record.');
    }
  };

  // Employees are denied CMDB verification access
  if (role === 'employee') {
    return (
      <div className="error-summary" role="alert">
        Employees have no CMDB verification access.
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Verification Queue" sub="Pending CMDB record verification" />

      {loading && (
        <div className="panel panel-pad">
          <LoadingRows n={4} />
          <p>Loading verification queue...</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {error && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>}

      {/* Verify form */}
      <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}>
        <h4>Verify Record</h4>
        <Form rowGutters={16}>
          <Field label="CI *">
            <Select
              onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, ci: e.target.value ? Number(e.target.value) : null })}
              aria-label="CI"
            >
              <option value="">Select CI</option>
              {items.map((item) => (
                <option key={item.id} value={item.id}>
                  {item.ci_number || item.name || `CI ${item.id}`}
                </option>
              ))}
            </Select>
          </Field>

          <Field label="Expected Record Version">
            <Input
              value={form.expected_record_version ?? ''}
              onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, expected_record_version: Number(e.target.value) || null })}
              type="number"
              placeholder="e.g. 5"
            />
          </Field>

          <Field label="Verification Note">
            <Input
              value={form.verification_note || ''}
              onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, verification_note: e.target.value })}
            />
          </Field>

          <div className="row-end" style={{ marginTop: 20 }}>
            <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={handleVerify} disabled={!form.ci}>
              Verify
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="btn-ghost"
              onClick={() => setForm({ ci: null, verification_note: '', expected_record_version: null })}
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
          </div>
        </Form>
      </div>

      <div className="panel panel-pad">
        <DataTable
          columns={[
            { key: 'id', label: 'ID' },
            { key: 'ci_number', label: 'CI', render: (row) => row.ci_number || row.ci || 'â€”' },
            { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (row) => row.status || 'Pending' },
            { key: 'last_verified_at', label: 'Verified At', render: (row) => row.last_verified_at ? formatDateTime(row.last_verified_at) : 'â€”' },
          ]}
          rows={items}
          keyOf={(r) => r.id}
          emptyTitle="No verification items found."
          emptyHint="Records pending verification appear here."
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Legacy alias kept for existing test compatibility */
export function VerificationQueue() {
  return <VerificationQueuePage />;
}

const Form = ({ rowGutters, children }) => (
  <form
    style={{ display: 'grid', gap: rowGutters + 'px' }}
    noValidate
  >
    {children}
  </form>
);
