===== src\pages\licensing\LicenseAgreementDetail.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { PageHeader } from '../../components';
import api from '../../api';
import { HistoryList } from './LicenseHistory';
import {
  licensingCapabilities,
  formatQuantity,
  formatPercent,
  AGREEMENT_STATUS_LABELS,
  LICENSE_MODEL_LABELS,
} from '../../shared/licensing-utils';

function LicenseAgreementDetail({ id, agreementId }) {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const caps = licensingCapabilities(auth);
  const aid = id || agreementId;
  const [agreement, setAgreement] = useState(null);
  const [utilization, setUtilization] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [historyItems, setHistoryItems] = useState([]);
  const [historyLoading, setHistoryLoading] = useState(true);
  const [historyError, setHistoryError] = useState('');
  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true); setError('');
    try {
      const [agreementResponse, utilizationResponse] = await Promise.all([
        api.get(`/licensing/agreements/${aid}/`),
        api.get(`/licensing/agreements/${aid}/utilization/`).catch(() => null),
      ]);
      setAgreement(agreementResponse.data);
      setUtilization(utilizationResponse?.data || null);
    } catch (e) { setError(e.response?.data?.detail || 'Could not load agreement.'); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  };
  useEffect(() => { if (aid) load(); }, [aid]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, react/set-state-in-effect
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    if (!aid) return undefined;
    setHistoryLoading(true); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    setHistoryError(''); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    api.get(`/licensing/agreements/${aid}/history/`)
      .then((r) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setHistoryItems(Array.isArray(r.data) ? r.data : (r.data?.results || []));
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setHistoryError(e?.response?.status === 403
          ? 'You do not have permission to view this agreement history.'
          : (e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Could not load agreement history.'));
      })
      .finally(() => { if (!cancelled) setHistoryLoading(false); });
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [aid]);
  const doAction = async (action, body = {}) => {
    try { await api.post(`/licensing/agreements/${aid}/${action}/`, body); await load(); } catch (e) { setError(e.response?.data?.detail || 'Action failed.'); }
  };
  if (loading) return <div className="panel-pad">Loading agreementâ€¦</div>;
  if (error) return <div className="alert alert-danger">{error}</div>;
  if (!agreement) return null;
  return (
    <div className="license-agreement-detail">
      <PageHeader title={agreement.agreement_number} />
      <div className="card mb-3"><div className="card-body">
        <div><strong>Product:</strong> {agreement.product_name}</div>
        <div><strong>Status:</strong> {AGREEMENT_STATUS_LABELS[agreement.status]}</div>
        <div><strong>Capacity:</strong> {agreement.is_unlimited ? 'Unlimited' : `${agreement.quantity_allocated}/${agreement.quantity_purchased} (avail ${agreement.quantity_available})`}</div>
        <div><strong>Utilization:</strong> {utilization?.utilization_calculable === false ? (utilization.utilization_note || 'Not calculable') : formatPercent(utilization?.reconciled_utilization_percent ?? agreement.utilization_percent)}</div>
        {caps.canViewCosts && <div><strong>Cost:</strong> {agreement.currency} {agreement.total_cost}</div>}
        <div><strong>Expiry:</strong> {agreement.expiry_date}</div>
        <div><strong>Renewal:</strong> {agreement.renewal_date}</div>
      </div></div>

      {utilization && (
        <div className="card mb-3"><div className="card-body">
          <h5>Entitlement reconciliation</h5>
          {utilization.overallocated_quantity > 0 && (
            <div className="alert alert-danger" role="alert">
              Overallocated by {formatQuantity(utilization.overallocated_quantity)} allocation(s): usage exceeds purchased entitlement.
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="row g-2">
            {[
              ['Metric', LICENSE_MODEL_LABELS[utilization.license_model] || utilization.license_model],
              ['Purchased entitlement', utilization.is_unlimited ? 'Unlimited' : formatQuantity(utilization.purchased_entitlement_quantity)],
              ['Active allocated', utilization.active_allocated_quantity],
              ['Reserved', utilization.consuming_quantity - utilization.active_allocated_quantity],
              ['Available', utilization.is_unlimited ? 'â€”' : formatQuantity(utilization.available_entitlement_quantity)],
              ['Suspended', utilization.suspended_allocation_quantity],
              ['Released/revoked', utilization.released_allocation_quantity],
              ['Expired allocations', utilization.expired_allocation_quantity],
              ['Open findings', utilization.open_findings],
            ].map(([label, value]) => (
              <div className="col-md-4 col-sm-6" key={label}>
                <div className="text-muted small">{label}</div>
                <div className="fw-bold">{value ?? 'â€”'}</div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          {utilization.utilization_note && <p className="text-muted small mt-2 mb-0">{utilization.utilization_note}</p>}
          <div className="mt-2">
            <a className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" href="#/license-compliance">View compliance findings</a>{' '}
            <a className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" href={`#/licenses/${aid}/allocations`}>View allocations</a>
          </div>
        </div></div>
      )}
      {caps.canManageAgreements && (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <a className="btn btn-outline" href={`#/licenses/${aid}/edit`}>Edit</a>
          <button className="btn btn-outline" onClick={() => doAction('activate')}>Activate</button>
          <button className="btn btn-outline" onClick={() => doAction('suspend', { reason: 'suspended' })}>Suspend</button>
          <button className="btn btn-outline" onClick={() => doAction('resume')}>Resume</button>
          <button className="btn btn-outline" onClick={() => doAction('recalculate')}>Recalculate</button>
          <button className="btn btn-outline danger" onClick={() => doAction('terminate', { reason: 'terminated' })}>Terminate</button>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="card mt-3" id="history"><div className="card-body">
        <h5>History</h5>
        <p className="text-muted small">Latest 100 agreement, allocation, and secret lifecycle events.</p>
        <HistoryList
          items={historyItems}
          loading={historyLoading}
          error={historyError}
          emptyText="No history recorded for this agreement."
        />
      </div></div>
      <div className="mt-3">
        <a className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" href={`#/licenses/${aid}/allocations`}>Allocations</a>{' '}
        <a className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" href={`#/licenses/${aid}/installations`}>Installations</a>{' '}
        <a className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" href={`#/licenses/${aid}/documents`}>Documents</a>{' '}
        <a className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" href={`#/licenses/${aid}/history`}>History</a>{' '}
        <a className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" href={`#/licenses/${aid}/renewal`}>Renewal</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
export { LicenseAgreementDetail };
export default LicenseAgreementDetail;



===== src\pages\licensing\LicenseAgreementForm.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { PageHeader, Field, AccessDenied } from '../../components';
import { parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';
import api from '../../api';
import { licensingCapabilities } from '../../shared/licensing-utils';
import { AGREEMENT_TYPE_LABELS, LICENSE_MODEL_LABELS, BILLING_FREQUENCY_LABELS } from '../../shared/licensing-utils';

function LicenseAgreementForm({ id, agreementId, onSave, onClose }) {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const caps = licensingCapabilities(auth);
  const aid = id || agreementId;
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ software_product: '', vendor: '', agreement_type: 'purchase', license_model: 'perpetual', purchase_date: '', start_date: '', expiry_date: '', renewal_date: '', grace_period_days: 0, auto_renew: false, renewal_notice_days: 30, currency: 'USD', unit_cost: '', total_cost: '', quantity_purchased: 1, concurrent_limit: '', maintenance_included: false, support_included: false, support_expiry_date: '', contract_reference: '', invoice_reference: '', external_subscription_id: '', billing_frequency: 'annual', department: '', cost_center: '', owner: '', contract_manager: '', terms_summary: '', internal_notes: '', procurement_purchase_order: '', procurement_purchase_order_line: '' });
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [products, setProducts] = useState([]);
  const [vendors, setVendors] = useState([]);
  useEffect(() => { api.get('/licensing/products/').then((r) => setProducts(r.data.results || r.data || [])).catch(() => {}); api.get('/assets/vendors/?is_deleted=false').then((r) => setVendors(r.data.results || r.data || [])).catch(() => {}); }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (aid) {
      api.get(`/licensing/agreements/${aid}/`).then((r) => {
        const d = r.data;
        setForm({ ...form, ...d, software_product: d.software_product || '', vendor: d.vendor || '', department: d.department || '', owner: d.owner || '', contract_manager: d.contract_manager || '' });
      }).catch((e) => setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not load agreement.'));
    }
  }, [aid]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  if (!caps.canManageAgreements) return <AccessDenied reason="manager" />;
  const set = (k) => (e) => setForm({ ...form, [k]: e.target.type === 'checkbox' ? e.target.checked : e.target.value });
  const submit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault(); setSaving(true); setError('');
    try {
      if (aid) await api.patch(`/licensing/agreements/${aid}/`, form); else await api.post('/licensing/agreements/', form);
      setSaving(false);
      if (onSave) onSave(); else window.location.hash = aid ? `#/licenses/${aid}` : '#/licenses';
    } catch (e) { setSaving(false); setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Save failed.'); }
  };
  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} noValidate>
      <PageHeader title={aid ? 'Edit License Agreement' : 'New License Agreement'} />
      {error && <div className="alert alert-danger">{error}</div>}
      <Field label="Software Product*"><select className="input" value={form.software_product} onChange={set('software_product')} required><option value="">â€”</option>{products.map((p) => <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>{p.name}</option>)}</select></Field>
      <Field label="Vendor"><select className="input" value={form.vendor} onChange={set('vendor')}><option value="">â€”</option>{vendors.map((v) => <option key={v.id} value={v.id}>{v.name}</option>)}</select></Field>
      <Field label="Agreement Type"><select className="input" value={form.agreement_type} onChange={set('agreement_type')}>{Object.entries(AGREEMENT_TYPE_LABELS).map(([k,v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}</select></Field>
      <Field label="License Model"><select className="input" value={form.license_model} onChange={set('license_model')}>{Object.entries(LICENSE_MODEL_LABELS).map(([k,v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}</select></Field>
      <Field label="Purchase Date"><input className="input" type="date" value={form.purchase_date} onChange={set('purchase_date')} /></Field>
      <Field label="Start Date*"><input className="input" type="date" value={form.start_date} onChange={set('start_date')} required /></Field>
      <Field label="Expiry Date"><input className="input" type="date" value={form.expiry_date} onChange={set('expiry_date')} /></Field>
      <Field label="Renewal Date"><input className="input" type="date" value={form.renewal_date} onChange={set('renewal_date')} /></Field>
      <Field label="Currency"><input className="input" value={form.currency} onChange={set('currency')} /></Field>
      <Field label="Unit Cost"><input className="input" type="number" step="0.01" value={form.unit_cost} onChange={set('unit_cost')} /></Field>
      <Field label="Total Cost"><input className="input" type="number" step="0.01" value={form.total_cost} onChange={set('total_cost')} /></Field>
      <Field label="Quantity Purchased"><input className="input" type="number" value={form.quantity_purchased} onChange={set('quantity_purchased')} /></Field>
      <Field label="Concurrent Limit"><input className="input" type="number" value={form.concurrent_limit} onChange={set('concurrent_limit')} /></Field>
      <Field label="Billing Frequency"><select className="input" value={form.billing_frequency} onChange={set('billing_frequency')}>{Object.entries(BILLING_FREQUENCY_LABELS).map(([k,v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}</select></Field>
      <Field label="Contract Reference"><input className="input" value={form.contract_reference} onChange={set('contract_reference')} /></Field>
      <Field label="Invoice Reference"><input className="input" value={form.invoice_reference} onChange={set('invoice_reference')} /></Field>
      <Field label="Terms Summary"><textarea className="input" value={form.terms_summary} onChange={set('terms_summary')} /></Field>
      <Field label="Internal Notes"><textarea className="input" value={form.internal_notes} onChange={set('internal_notes')} /></Field>
      <Field label="Auto Renew"><input type="checkbox" checked={form.auto_renew} onChange={set('auto_renew')} /></Field>
      <Field label="Maintenance Included"><input type="checkbox" checked={form.maintenance_included} onChange={set('maintenance_included')} /></Field>
      <Field label="Support Included"><input type="checkbox" checked={form.support_included} onChange={set('support_included')} /></Field>
      <div className="modal-foot" style={{ marginTop: 16, display: 'flex', gap: 8, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
        <button type="button" className="btn btn-outline" onClick={() => { if (onClose) onClose(); else window.location.hash = '#/licenses'; }}>Cancel</button>
        <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary" disabled={saving}>{saving ? 'Savingâ€¦' : 'Save'}</button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
export { LicenseAgreementForm };
export default LicenseAgreementForm;



===== src\pages\licensing\LicenseAgreements.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { Badge, Field, DataTable, Pager, PageHeader } from '../../components';
import { fetchPage } from '../../api-utils';
import { licensingCapabilities, buildAgreementListUrl } from '../../shared/licensing-utils';
import { AGREEMENT_TYPE_LABELS, AGREEMENT_STATUS_LABELS } from '../../shared/licensing-utils';

function LicenseAgreementsPage() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const caps = licensingCapabilities(auth);
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [count, setCount] = useState(null);
  const [next, setNext] = useState(null);
  const [previous, setPrevious] = useState(null);
  const [page] = useState(1);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [f, setF] = useState({ search: '', status: '', agreement_type: '', license_model: '' });
  const loadUrl = async (url) => {
    setLoading(true); setError('');
    try { const pg = await fetchPage(url); setItems(pg.items); setCount(pg.count); setNext(pg.next); setPrevious(pg.previous); setLastUrl(url); } catch { setError('Could not load agreements.'); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  };
  const builtUrl = useMemo(() => buildAgreementListUrl(f, null, page), [f, page]);
  useEffect(() => { const t = setTimeout(() => loadUrl(builtUrl), 250); return () => clearTimeout(t); }, [builtUrl]);
  const columns = [
    { key: 'agreement_number', label: 'Agreement #' },
    { key: 'product_name', label: 'Product' },
    { key: 'vendor_name', label: 'Vendor' },
    { key: 'agreement_type', label: 'Type', render: (v) => AGREEMENT_TYPE_LABELS[v.agreement_type] || v.agreement_type },
    { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (v) => <Badge kind="status" value={AGREEMENT_STATUS_LABELS[v.status] || v.status} /> },
    { key: 'start_date', label: 'Start', render: (v) => v.start_date },
    { key: 'expiry_date', label: 'Expiry', render: (v) => v.expiry_date },
    { key: 'quantity_purchased', label: 'Purchased' },
    { key: 'quantity_allocated', label: 'Allocated' },
    { key: 'quantity_available', label: 'Available', render: (v) => v.is_unlimited ? 'Unlimited' : v.quantity_available },
    { key: 'total_cost', label: 'Total Cost', render: (v) => caps.canViewCosts ? `${v.currency} ${v.total_cost}` : 'â€”' },
  ];
  if (caps.canManageAgreements) columns.push({ key: 'actions', label: 'Actions', render: (v) => (<div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4 }}><a className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" href={`#/licenses/${v.id}`}>View</a><a className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" href={`#/licenses/${v.id}/edit`}>Edit</a></div>) });
  if (!caps.canView) return <div className="panel-pad">Access denied.</div>;
  return (
    <div className="license-agreements-page">
      <PageHeader title="License Agreements" />
      <div className="page-toolbar" style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap', marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <Field label="Search" required={false}><input className="input" value={f.search} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, search: e.target.value })} /></Field>
        <Field label="Status" required={false}><select className="input" value={f.status} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, status: e.target.value })}><option value="">All</option>{Object.entries(AGREEMENT_STATUS_LABELS).map(([k,v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}</select></Field>
        <Field label="Type" required={false}><select className="input" value={f.agreement_type} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, agreement_type: e.target.value })}><option value="">All</option>{Object.entries(AGREEMENT_TYPE_LABELS).map(([k,v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}</select></Field>
        {caps.canManageAgreements && <a className="btn btn-primary" href="#/licenses/new">New Agreement</a>}
      </div>
      {error && <div className="alert alert-danger">{error}</div>}
      <DataTable columns={columns} rows={items} keyOf={(r) => r.id} loading={loading} emptyTitle="No agreements found" />
      {count !== null && <Pager count={count} hasNext={!!next} hasPrev={!!previous} busy={loading} onPrev={() => previous && loadUrl(previous)} onNext={() => next && loadUrl(next)} />}
    </div>
  );
}
export { LicenseAgreementsPage };
export default LicenseAgreementsPage;



===== src\pages\licensing\LicenseAllocations.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { AccessDenied, Badge, Field, DataTable, Pager, PageHeader, Modal, ConfirmDialog, UserSelect, PageSizeSelector } from '../../components';
import { fetchPage, parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';
import api from '../../api';
import {
  licensingCapabilities,
  buildAllocationListUrl,
  ALLOCATION_TYPE_LABELS,
  ALLOCATION_STATUS_LABELS,
} from '../../shared/licensing-utils';
import { HistoryList } from './LicenseHistory';

const RELEASABLE_STATUSES = ['reserved', 'assigned', 'active', 'suspended', 'expired'];

function LicenseAllocationsPage() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const caps = licensingCapabilities(auth);
  const requestIdRef = useRef(0);
  const mountedRef = useRef(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    return () => { mountedRef.current = false; };
  }, []);
  // Page-size preference persisted in localStorage; fall back to DRF default 20.
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 20;
    try {
      const saved = window.localStorage.getItem('itdesk.pageSize');
      const n = Number(saved);
      return saved && Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 && n <= 100 ? n : 20;
    } catch {
      return 20;
    }
  });
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [count, setCount] = useState(null);
  const [next, setNext] = useState(null);
  const [previous, setPrevious] = useState(null);
  const [page] = useState(1); // pager loads absolute next/previous URLs
  const [lastUrl, setLastUrl] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('');
  const [f, setF] = useState({ search: '', status: '', allocation_type: '', agreement: '' });
  const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState(null);

  // Release state
  const [releaseTarget, setReleaseTarget] = useState(null);
  const [releaseReason, setReleaseReason] = useState('');
  const [releaseBusy, setReleaseBusy] = useState(false);
  const [releaseError, setReleaseError] = useState('');

  // History state
  const [historyTarget, setHistoryTarget] = useState(null);
  const [historyItems, setHistoryItems] = useState([]);
  const [historyLoading, setHistoryLoading] = useState(false);
  const [historyError, setHistoryError] = useState('');

  // Offboarding state
  const [offboardUserId, setOffboardUserId] = useState('');
  const [offboardReason, setOffboardReason] = useState('');
  const [offboardPreview, setOffboardPreview] = useState(null);
  const [offboardPreviewLoading, setOffboardPreviewLoading] = useState(false);
  const [offboardPreviewError, setOffboardPreviewError] = useState('');
  const [offboardBusy, setOffboardBusy] = useState(false);
  const [offboardError, setOffboardError] = useState('');
  const [offboardResult, setOffboardResult] = useState(null);
  const [confirmOffboard, setConfirmOffboard] = useState(false);

  const builtUrl = useMemo(() => buildAllocationListUrl(f, null, page, pageSize), [f, page, pageSize]);

  const loadUrl = async (url) => {
    const requestId = ++requestIdRef.current;
    setLoading(true); setError('');
    try {
      const pg = await fetchPage(url);
      if (!mountedRef.current || requestId !== requestIdRef.current) return;
      setItems(pg.items ?? []); setCount(pg.count ?? 0); setNext(pg.next ?? null); setPrevious(pg.previous ?? null);
      setLastUrl(url);
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mountedRef.current || requestId !== requestIdRef.current) return;
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not load allocations.');
    } finally {
      if (mountedRef.current && requestId === requestIdRef.current) setLoading(false);
    }
  };
  // Reload whichever page the user is actually on (Pager loads absolute
  // next/previous URLs, so rebuilding from `page` would jump back to page 1).
  const reload = () => loadUrl(lastUrl || builtUrl);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!caps.canViewAllocations) return undefined;
    const t = setTimeout(() => loadUrl(builtUrl), 250);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [builtUrl, caps.canViewAllocations]);

  // Persist page-size preference without unnecessary writes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    try {
      if (window.localStorage.getItem('itdesk.pageSize') !== String(pageSize)) {
        window.localStorage.setItem('itdesk.pageSize', String(pageSize));
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore storage failures
    }
  }, [pageSize]);

  const doAction = async (row, action, body = {}) => {
    if (busyId) return;
    const ref = row.allocation_reference || `#${row.id}`;
    setBusyId(row.id); setError(''); setMessage('');
    try {
      await api.post(`/licensing/allocations/${row.id}/${action}/`, body);
      setMessage(`Allocation ${ref}: ${action} completed.`);
      await reload();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Action failed.');
    } finally { setBusyId(null); }
  };

  const openRelease = (row) => {
    setReleaseTarget(row);
    setReleaseReason('');
    setReleaseError('');
  };
  const closeRelease = () => { if (!releaseBusy) { setReleaseTarget(null); setReleaseReason(''); setReleaseError(''); } };
  const submitRelease = async () => {
    if (!releaseTarget || releaseBusy) return;
    setReleaseBusy(true); setReleaseError('');
    try {
      await api.post(`/licensing/allocations/${releaseTarget.id}/release/`, { reason: releaseReason.trim() });
      const ref = releaseTarget.allocation_reference || `#${releaseTarget.id}`;
      setMessage(`Allocation ${ref} released. The seat was returned to ${releaseTarget.agreement_number || 'its agreement'}.`);
      setReleaseTarget(null);
      setReleaseReason('');
      await reload();
    } catch (e) {
      setReleaseError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Release failed.');
    } finally {
      setReleaseBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const openHistory = async (row) => {
    setHistoryTarget(row);
    setHistoryItems([]);
    setHistoryError('');
    setHistoryLoading(true);
    try {
      const r = await api.get(`/licensing/allocations/${row.id}/history/`);
      setHistoryItems(Array.isArray(r.data) ? r.data : (r.data?.results || []));
    } catch (e) {
      setHistoryError(e?.response?.status === 403
        ? 'You do not have permission to view this allocation history.'
        : (parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not load history.'));
    } finally {
      setHistoryLoading(false);
    }
  };
  const closeHistory = () => { setHistoryTarget(null); setHistoryItems([]); setHistoryError(''); };

  const changeOffboardUser = (value) => {
    if (offboardBusy) return;
    setOffboardUserId(value);
    // A preview is only valid for the employee it was requested for: drop any
    // stale preview/result so a different employee can never be offboarded.
    setOffboardPreview(null);
    setOffboardResult(null);
    setOffboardPreviewError('');
    setOffboardError('');
  };

  const requestOffboardPreview = async () => {
    if (!offboardUserId || offboardPreviewLoading) return;
    setOffboardPreviewLoading(true);
    setOffboardPreviewError('');
    setOffboardPreview(null);
    setOffboardResult(null);
    try {
      const r = await api.get(`/licensing/allocations/offboarding-preview/?user=${encodeURIComponent(offboardUserId)}`);
      setOffboardPreview(r.data);
    } catch (e) {
      setOffboardPreviewError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not load the offboarding preview.');
    } finally {
      setOffboardPreviewLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const executeOffboard = async () => {
    // Execution is only allowed right after a preview was loaded for this user;
    // opening a preview alone never revokes anything.
    if (offboardBusy || !offboardPreview) return;
    setOffboardBusy(true);
    setOffboardError('');
    try {
      const body = { user_id: Number(offboardUserId) };
      if (offboardReason.trim()) body.reason = offboardReason.trim();
      const r = await api.post('/licensing/allocations/offboard/', body);
      setOffboardResult(r.data);
      setConfirmOffboard(false);
      setOffboardPreview(null);
      setMessage(`Offboarding finished: ${r.data.revoked_count} of ${r.data.total_active} allocation(s) reclaimed.`);
      await reload();
    } catch (e) {
      setOffboardError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Offboarding failed.');
    } finally {
      setOffboardBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const columns = [
    { key: 'product_name', label: 'Product' },
    { key: 'agreement_number', label: 'Agreement' },
    { key: 'allocation_type', label: 'Type', render: (v) => ALLOCATION_TYPE_LABELS[v.allocation_type] || v.allocation_type },
    { key: 'user_email', label: 'User' },
    { key: 'asset_tag', label: 'Asset' },
    { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (v) => <Badge kind="status" value={ALLOCATION_STATUS_LABELS[v.status] || v.status} /> },
    { key: 'assigned_at', label: 'Assigned' },
    { key: 'last_verified_at', label: 'Verified' },
    { key: 'actions', label: 'Actions', render: (v) => {
      const rowBusy = busyId === v.id;
      const terminal = ['revoked', 'expired'].includes(v.status);
      return (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {!['active', 'revoked', 'expired'].includes(v.status) && (
            <button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" disabled={rowBusy}
              onClick={() => { if (window.confirm('Activate this allocation? Entitlement capacity will be checked and the action is audited.')) doAction(v, 'activate'); }}>
              Activate
            </button>
          )}
          {!['suspended', 'revoked', 'expired'].includes(v.status) && (
            <button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" disabled={rowBusy}
              onClick={() => { const r = window.prompt('Suspension reason (capacity is released):'); if (r && r.trim()) doAction(v, 'suspend', { reason: r.trim() }); }}>
              Suspend
            </button>
          )}
          <button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" disabled={rowBusy} onClick={() => doAction(v, 'verify')}>Verify</button>
          {!terminal && RELEASABLE_STATUSES.includes(v.status) && (
            <button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" disabled={rowBusy} onClick={() => openRelease(v)}>Release</button>
          )}
          <button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" disabled={rowBusy} onClick={() => openHistory(v)}>History</button>
          {v.status !== 'revoked' && (
            <button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline danger" disabled={rowBusy}
              onClick={() => { const r = window.prompt('Revocation reason:'); if (r && r.trim()) doAction(v, 'revoke', { reason: r.trim() }); }}>
              Revoke
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      );
    } },
  ];
  if (!caps.canViewAllocations) return <AccessDenied />;

  const previewAllocations = offboardPreview?.allocations || [];
  const previewCount = offboardPreview?.count ?? previewAllocations.length;
  const offboardFailures = (offboardResult?.results || []).filter((r) => !r.success);

  return (
    <div className="license-allocations-page">
      <PageHeader title="License Allocations" />
      {message && <div className="alert alert-success" role="status">{message}</div>}
      {error && <div className="alert alert-danger" role="alert">{error}</div>}
      <div className="page-toolbar" style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap', marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <Field label="Search" required={false}><input className="input" value={f.search} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, search: e.target.value })} /></Field>
        <Field label="Status" required={false}><select className="input" value={f.status} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, status: e.target.value })}><option value="">All</option>{Object.entries(ALLOCATION_STATUS_LABELS).map(([k, v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}</select></Field>
        <Field label="Type" required={false}><select className="input" value={f.allocation_type} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, allocation_type: e.target.value })}><option value="">All</option>{Object.entries(ALLOCATION_TYPE_LABELS).map(([k, v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}</select></Field>
      </div>
      {loading
        ? <p className="muted" role="status">Loading allocationsâ€¦</p>
        : <DataTable columns={columns} rows={items} keyOf={(r) => r.id} emptyTitle="No allocations found" />}
      <PageSizeSelector value={pageSize} onChange={setPageSize} />{count !== null && <Pager count={count} hasNext={!!next} hasPrev={!!previous} busy={loading} onPrev={() => previous && loadUrl(previous)} onNext={() => next && loadUrl(next)} />}

      {/* Offboarding workflow: preview first, explicit confirmation before execution */}
      <div className="card" style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>
        <div className="card-body">
          <h5>Employee offboarding</h5>
          <p className="text-muted small">
            Preview the seats that would be reclaimed for an employee (named-user seats plus
            device seats on assets assigned to them). Opening a preview does not change anything;
            seats are only revoked when you confirm execution.
          </p>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'flex-end', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <UserSelect value={offboardUserId} onChange={changeOffboardUser} disabled={offboardBusy} label="Employee" />
            <button className="btn btn-outline" onClick={requestOffboardPreview}
              disabled={offboardPreviewLoading || offboardBusy || !offboardUserId}>
              {offboardPreviewLoading ? 'Loading previewâ€¦' : 'Preview affected seats'}
            </button>
          </div>
          {offboardPreviewError && <div className="alert alert-danger" role="alert" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{offboardPreviewError}</div>}
          {offboardPreview && (
            <div style={{ marginTop: 12 }} data-testid="offboarding-preview">
              <p>
                {previewCount === 0
                  ? 'This employee holds no active or reserved allocations.'
                  : `${previewCount} active or reserved allocation(s) would be revoked. Capacity is returned to each agreement and every revocation is audited.`}
              </p>
              {previewAllocations.length > 0 && (
                <table className="table table-sm">
                  <thead><tr><th>Product</th><th>Agreement</th><th>Reference</th><th>Type</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {previewAllocations.map((a) => (
                      <tr key={a.id}>
                        <td>{a.product_name}</td>
                        <td>{a.agreement_number}</td>
                        <td>{a.allocation_reference}</td>
                        <td>{ALLOCATION_TYPE_LABELS[a.allocation_type] || a.allocation_type || 'â€”'}</td>
                        <td>{ALLOCATION_STATUS_LABELS[a.status] || a.status}</td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              )}
              {previewCount > 0 && (
                <>
                  <Field label="Offboarding reason (optional)" hint="Stored on each revoked allocation and in the audit history.">
                    <textarea className="input" rows={2} value={offboardReason}
                      onChange={(e) => setOffboardReason(e.target.value)} disabled={offboardBusy} />
                  </Field>
                  <button className="btn btn-danger" style={{ marginTop: 8 }} onClick={() => setConfirmOffboard(true)}
                    disabled={offboardBusy}>
                    {offboardBusy ? 'Workingâ€¦' : 'Execute offboardingâ€¦'}
                  </button>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
          {offboardError && <div className="alert alert-danger" role="alert" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{offboardError}</div>}
          {offboardResult && (
            <div style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
              <div className="alert alert-success" role="status">
                Revoked {offboardResult.revoked_count} of {offboardResult.total_active} allocation(s).
              </div>
              {offboardFailures.length > 0 && (
                <div className="alert alert-warning" role="alert">
                  {offboardFailures.length} allocation(s) could not be revoked:
                  <ul className="mb-0">
                    {offboardFailures.map((r) => (
                      <li key={r.allocation_id}>{r.product || 'Allocation'} ({r.reference || r.allocation_id}): {r.error}</li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>
              )}
              <p className="text-muted small mb-0">Request a fresh preview before running offboarding again.</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Release modal */}
      {releaseTarget && (
        <Modal title={`Release allocation ${releaseTarget.allocation_reference || `#${releaseTarget.id}`}`} onClose={closeRelease}>
          <p style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>
            This releases the seat on agreement <strong>{releaseTarget.agreement_number || 'â€”'}</strong>
            {releaseTarget.product_name ? ` (${releaseTarget.product_name})` : ''}, returns the seat to the
            agreement&apos;s available entitlement, marks the allocation <strong>Revoked</strong>, and notifies
            the assigned employee. The change is audited and cannot be undone.
          </p>
          <Field label="Release reason (optional)" hint="Recorded on the allocation and in its history." error={releaseError}>
            <textarea className="input" rows={3} value={releaseReason}
              onChange={(e) => setReleaseReason(e.target.value)} disabled={releaseBusy} />
          </Field>
          <div className="row-end" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
            <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={closeRelease} disabled={releaseBusy}>Cancel</button>
            <button type="button" className="btn-danger" onClick={submitRelease} disabled={releaseBusy}>
              {releaseBusy ? 'Releasingâ€¦' : 'Confirm release'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {/* History modal */}
      {historyTarget && (
        <Modal title={`Allocation history ${historyTarget.allocation_reference || `#${historyTarget.id}`}`} onClose={closeHistory} size="lg">
          <HistoryList
            items={historyItems}
            loading={historyLoading}
            error={historyError}
            emptyText="No history recorded for this allocation."
          />
        </Modal>
      )}

      {/* Offboarding confirm */}
      {confirmOffboard && (
        <ConfirmDialog
          title="Confirm employee offboarding"
          message={`Revoke ${previewCount} active or reserved allocation(s) for the selected employee? Their seats are returned to each agreement, they are notified, and the action is audited. This cannot be undone.`}
          confirmLabel="Revoke seats"
          danger
          busy={offboardBusy}
          onConfirm={executeOffboard}
          onCancel={() => { if (!offboardBusy) setConfirmOffboard(false); }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
export { LicenseAllocationsPage };
export default LicenseAllocationsPage;



===== src\pages\licensing\LicenseCalendar.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { PageHeader } from '../../components';
import api from '../../api';

function LicenseCalendarPage() {
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  useEffect(() => {
    setLoading(true); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    api.get('/licensing/renewal-calendar/').then((r) => setData(r.data)).catch((e) => setError(e.response?.data?.detail || 'Could not load calendar.')).finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);
  if (loading) return <div className="panel-pad">Loading calendarâ€¦</div>;
  if (error) return <div className="alert alert-danger">{error}</div>;
  const groups = data?.groups || data || {};
  return (
    <div className="license-calendar-page">
      <PageHeader title="License Renewal Calendar" />
      {Array.isArray(groups) ? groups.map((g, i) => (
        <div className="card mb-3" key={i}><div className="card-body">
          <h5>{g.label || `Group ${i + 1}`}</h5>
          <table className="table table-sm"><tbody>
            {(g.items || []).map((a) => <tr key={a.id}><td>{a.agreement_number}</td><td>{a.product_name}</td><td>{a.expiry_date}</td><td>{a.days_remaining}</td></tr>)}
          </tbody></table>
        </div></div>
      )) : <pre>{JSON.stringify(groups, null, 2)}</pre>}
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\pages\licensing\LicenseCompliance.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { AccessDenied, Badge, Field, DataTable, Pager, PageHeader, Modal, ConfirmDialog } from '../../components';
import { fetchPage, parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';
import api from '../../api';
import {
  licensingCapabilities,
  buildFindingListUrl,
  FINDING_TYPE_LABELS,
  FINDING_SEVERITY_LABELS,
  FINDING_STATUS_LABELS,
} from '../../shared/licensing-utils';

const CLOSED_STATUSES = ['resolved', 'false_positive'];

function LicenseCompliancePage() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const caps = licensingCapabilities(auth);
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [count, setCount] = useState(null);
  const [next, setNext] = useState(null);
  const [previous, setPrevious] = useState(null);
  const [page] = useState(1); // pager loads absolute next/previous URLs
  const [lastUrl, setLastUrl] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('');
  const [f, setF] = useState({ search: '', finding_type: '', severity: '', status: '' });
  const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState(null);

  // Remediation state
  const [remediateTarget, setRemediateTarget] = useState(null);
  const [remediateNote, setRemediateNote] = useState('');
  const [remediateReevaluate, setRemediateReevaluate] = useState(false);
  const [remediateBusy, setRemediateBusy] = useState(false);
  const [remediateError, setRemediateError] = useState('');

  // Resolve / false-positive state
  const [resolveTarget, setResolveTarget] = useState(null);
  const [resolveNote, setResolveNote] = useState('');
  const [resolveBusy, setResolveBusy] = useState(false);
  const [resolveError, setResolveError] = useState('');

  const builtUrl = useMemo(() => buildFindingListUrl(f, null, page), [f, page]);

  const loadUrl = async (url) => {
    setLoading(true); setError('');
    try {
      const pg = await fetchPage(url);
      setItems(pg.items); setCount(pg.count); setNext(pg.next); setPrevious(pg.previous);
      setLastUrl(url);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not load findings.');
    } finally { setLoading(false); }
  };
  const reload = () => loadUrl(lastUrl || builtUrl);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!caps.canViewCompliance) return undefined;
    const t = setTimeout(() => loadUrl(builtUrl), 250);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [builtUrl, caps.canViewCompliance]);

  const doAcknowledge = async (row) => {
    if (busyId) return;
    setBusyId(row.id); setError(''); setMessage('');
    try {
      await api.post(`/licensing/findings/${row.id}/acknowledge/`);
      setMessage(`Finding ${row.id} acknowledged.`);
      await reload();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not acknowledge the finding.');
    } finally { setBusyId(null); }
  };

  const openRemediate = (row) => {
    setRemediateTarget(row);
    setRemediateNote('');
    setRemediateReevaluate(false);
    setRemediateError('');
  };
  const closeRemediate = () => {
    if (!remediateBusy) { setRemediateTarget(null); setRemediateNote(''); setRemediateError(''); }
  };
  const submitRemediate = async () => {
    if (!remediateTarget || remediateBusy) return;
    const note = remediateNote.trim();
    if (!note) { setRemediateError('A remediation note is required.'); return; }
    setRemediateBusy(true); setRemediateError('');
    try {
      const r = await api.post(`/licensing/findings/${remediateTarget.id}/remediate/`, {
        remediation_note: note,
        reevaluate: remediateReevaluate,
      });
      const status = r?.data?.status;
      setMessage(status === 'resolved'
        ? 'Remediation recorded and compliance re-evaluated: the finding is now resolved.'
        : `Remediation recorded. Finding status: ${FINDING_STATUS_LABELS[status] || status || 'Acknowledged'}.`);
      setRemediateTarget(null);
      setRemediateNote('');
      await reload();
    } catch (e) {
      setRemediateError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Remediation failed.');
    } finally {
      setRemediateBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const openResolve = (row, falsePositive) => {
    setResolveTarget({ row, falsePositive });
    setResolveNote('');
    setResolveError('');
  };
  const closeResolve = () => {
    if (!resolveBusy) { setResolveTarget(null); setResolveNote(''); setResolveError(''); }
  };
  const submitResolve = async () => {
    if (!resolveTarget || resolveBusy) return;
    const note = resolveNote.trim();
    if (!note) { setResolveError('A resolution note is required.'); return; }
    const action = resolveTarget.falsePositive ? 'false-positive' : 'resolve';
    setResolveBusy(true); setResolveError('');
    try {
      await api.post(`/licensing/findings/${resolveTarget.row.id}/${action}/`, { resolution_note: note });
      setMessage(resolveTarget.falsePositive
        ? `Finding ${resolveTarget.row.id} marked as a false positive.`
        : `Finding ${resolveTarget.row.id} resolved.`);
      setResolveTarget(null);
      setResolveNote('');
      await reload();
    } catch (e) {
      setResolveError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not update the finding.');
    } finally {
      setResolveBusy(false);
    }
  };

  // Backend LicenseCompliancePermission allows IT Support to view/acknowledge,
  // while resolve/false-positive/remediation require IT Manager or admin.
  if (!caps.canViewCompliance) return <AccessDenied />;

  const canManage = caps.canManageCompliance;

  const columns = [
    { key: 'title', label: 'Title' },
    { key: 'finding_type', label: 'Type', render: (v) => FINDING_TYPE_LABELS[v.finding_type] || v.finding_type },
    { key: 'severity', label: 'Severity', render: (v) => <Badge kind="status" value={FINDING_SEVERITY_LABELS[v.severity] || v.severity} /> },
    { key: 'product_name', label: 'Product' },
    { key: 'agreement_number', label: 'Agreement', render: (v) => (v.agreement_number ? <a href={`#/licenses/${v.agreement}`}>{v.agreement_number}</a> : 'â€”') },
    { key: 'user_email', label: 'User' },
    { key: 'asset_tag', label: 'Asset' },
    { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (v) => FINDING_STATUS_LABELS[v.status] || v.status },
    { key: 'detected_at', label: 'Detected' },
    { key: 'resolved_at', label: 'Resolved At' },
    { key: 'actions', label: 'Actions', render: (v) => {
      if (CLOSED_STATUSES.includes(v.status)) return <span className="text-muted">Closed</span>;
      const rowBusy = busyId === v.id;
      return (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" onClick={() => doAcknowledge(v)} disabled={rowBusy}>
            Acknowledge
          </button>
          {canManage && (
            <>
              <button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" onClick={() => openRemediate(v)} disabled={rowBusy}>Remediate</button>
              <button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" onClick={() => openResolve(v, false)} disabled={rowBusy}>Resolve</button>
              <button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" onClick={() => openResolve(v, true)} disabled={rowBusy}>False Positive</button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      );
    } },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="license-compliance-page">
      <PageHeader title="License Compliance Findings" />
      {!canManage && (
        <p className="text-muted small">
          You can acknowledge findings. Recording remediation or resolving findings requires
          IT Manager or System Admin permission.
        </p>
      )}
      {message && <div className="alert alert-success" role="status">{message}</div>}
      {error && <div className="alert alert-danger" role="alert">{error}</div>}
      <div className="page-toolbar" style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap', marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <Field label="Type" required={false}><select className="input" value={f.finding_type} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, finding_type: e.target.value })}><option value="">All</option>{Object.entries(FINDING_TYPE_LABELS).map(([k, v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}</select></Field>
        <Field label="Severity" required={false}><select className="input" value={f.severity} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, severity: e.target.value })}><option value="">All</option>{Object.entries(FINDING_SEVERITY_LABELS).map(([k, v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}</select></Field>
        <Field label="Status" required={false}><select className="input" value={f.status} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, status: e.target.value })}><option value="">All</option>{Object.entries(FINDING_STATUS_LABELS).map(([k, v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}</select></Field>
      </div>
      {loading
        ? <p className="muted" role="status">Loading findingsâ€¦</p>
        : <DataTable columns={columns} rows={items} keyOf={(r) => r.id} emptyTitle="No findings found" />}
      {count !== null && <Pager count={count} hasNext={!!next} hasPrev={!!previous} busy={loading} onPrev={() => previous && loadUrl(previous)} onNext={() => next && loadUrl(next)} />}

      {remediateTarget && (
        <Modal title={`Remediate Finding ${remediateTarget.id}`} onClose={closeRemediate}>
          <p style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>{remediateTarget.title}</p>
          {remediateTarget.description && <p className="text-muted">{remediateTarget.description}</p>}
          <p className="text-muted small">
            Recording remediation acknowledges the finding. It is only resolved when the
            underlying condition is gone and compliance is re-evaluated.
          </p>
          <Field label="Remediation notes" required error={remediateError}>
            <textarea className="input" rows={4} value={remediateNote}
              onChange={(e) => setRemediateNote(e.target.value)} disabled={remediateBusy} />
          </Field>
          <label style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, alignItems: 'center', marginTop: 8 }}>
            <input type="checkbox" checked={remediateReevaluate}
              onChange={(e) => setRemediateReevaluate(e.target.checked)} disabled={remediateBusy} />
            Re-evaluate compliance after remediation (resolves only if the condition is actually gone)
          </label>
          <div className="row-end" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
            <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={closeRemediate} disabled={remediateBusy}>Cancel</button>
            <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={submitRemediate} disabled={remediateBusy}>
              {remediateBusy ? 'Savingâ€¦' : 'Record Remediation'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {resolveTarget && (
        <ConfirmDialog
          title={resolveTarget.falsePositive ? `Mark Finding ${resolveTarget.row.id} as false positive` : `Resolve Finding ${resolveTarget.row.id}`}
          message={resolveTarget.row.title}
          confirmLabel={resolveTarget.falsePositive ? 'Mark false positive' : 'Resolve finding'}
          danger={!resolveTarget.falsePositive}
          busy={resolveBusy}
          onConfirm={submitResolve}
          onCancel={closeResolve}
        >
          <Field
            label={resolveTarget.falsePositive ? 'Justification' : 'Resolution note'}
            required
            error={resolveError}
            hint={resolveTarget.falsePositive
              ? 'Explains why the finding is not a real compliance issue; kept on the finding.'
              : 'Describes how the finding was resolved; kept on the finding.'}
          >
            <textarea className="input" rows={3} value={resolveNote}
              onChange={(e) => setResolveNote(e.target.value)} disabled={resolveBusy} />
          </Field>
        </ConfirmDialog>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
export { LicenseCompliancePage };
export default LicenseCompliancePage;



===== src\pages\licensing\LicenseDocuments.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { PageHeader, Field, AccessDenied } from '../../components';
import { parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';
import api from '../../api';
import { licensingCapabilities } from '../../shared/licensing-utils';

const DOC_TYPES = ['agreement', 'invoice', 'quotation', 'purchase_order_copy', 'license_certificate', 'support_contract', 'maintenance_agreement', 'renewal_notice', 'deployment_guide', 'compliance_evidence'];

function LicenseDocumentsPage({ agreementId }) {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const caps = licensingCapabilities(auth);
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [showUpload, setShowUpload] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ document_type: 'agreement', description: '', file: null });
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try { const r = await api.get(`/licensing/documents/?agreement=${agreementId}`); setItems(r.data.results || r.data || []); } catch (e) { setError(e.response?.data?.detail || 'Could not load documents.'); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  };
  useEffect(() => { if (agreementId) load(); }, [agreementId]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, react/set-state-in-effect
  if (!caps.canManageDocuments && !caps.canView) return <AccessDenied />;
  const upload = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault(); setSaving(true); setError('');
    const fd = new FormData();
    fd.append('agreement', agreementId);
    fd.append('document_type', form.document_type);
    fd.append('description', form.description);
    if (form.file) fd.append('file', form.file);
    try { await api.post('/licensing/documents/', fd, { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' } }); setShowUpload(false); setForm({ document_type: 'agreement', description: '', file: null }); load(); }
    catch (e) { setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Upload failed.'); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  };
  const download = async (doc) => {
    try {
      const r = await api.get(`/licensing/documents/${doc.id}/download/`, { responseType: 'blob' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(r.data);
      const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download = doc.original_filename || 'document'; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove(); setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 5000);
    } catch { setError('Download failed.'); }
  };
  return (
    <div className="license-documents-page">
      <PageHeader title="License Documents" />
      {error && <div className="alert alert-danger">{error}</div>}
      {caps.canManageDocuments && <button className="btn btn-primary mb-3" onClick={() => setShowUpload(true)}>Upload Document</button>}
      {loading ? <div>Loadingâ€¦</div> : (
        <table className="table table-sm"><thead><tr><th>Type</th><th>Filename</th><th>Size</th><th>Uploaded By</th><th>Date</th><th>Actions</th></tr></thead><tbody>
          {items.map((d) => (
            <tr key={d.id}><td>{d.document_type}</td><td>{d.original_filename}</td><td>{d.size}</td><td>{d.uploaded_by_email}</td><td>{d.created_at}</td><td><button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" onClick={() => download(d)}>Download</button></td></tr>
          ))}
        </tbody></table>
      )}
      {showUpload && (
        <div className="modal-backdrop"><div className="modal">
          <h3>Upload Document</h3>
          <form onSubmit={upload}>
            <Field label="Type"><select className="input" value={form.document_type} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, document_type: e.target.value })}>{DOC_TYPES.map((t) => <option key={t} value={t}>{t}</option>)}</select></Field>
            <Field label="Description"><input className="input" value={form.description} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, description: e.target.value })} /></Field>
            <Field label="File"><input className="input" type="file" onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, file: e.target.files?.[0] })} required /></Field>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
              <button type="button" className="btn btn-outline" onClick={() => setShowUpload(false)}>Cancel</button>
              <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary" disabled={saving}>{saving ? 'Uploadingâ€¦' : 'Upload'}</button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div></div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
export { LicenseDocumentsPage };
export default LicenseDocumentsPage;



===== src\pages\licensing\LicenseHistory.jsx =====

import { formatDateTime, HISTORY_EVENT_LABELS, historyDetailText, historyTransition } from '../../shared/licensing-utils';

/**
 * Read-only license history table shared by the allocation history modal and
 * the agreement detail page. Both backends return a plain array of
 * LicenseHistorySerializer rows (newest first, capped at 100).
 */
export function HistoryList({ items, loading, error, emptyText = 'No history recorded.' }) {
  if (loading) return <p className="muted" role="status">Loading historyâ€¦</p>;
  if (error) return <div className="alert alert-danger" role="alert">{error}</div>;
  if (!items || items.length === 0) return <p className="text-muted" role="status">{emptyText}</p>;
  return (
    <div className="table-wrap">
      <table className="table table-sm grid license-history">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>When</th>
            <th>Event</th>
            <th>Status change</th>
            <th>Actor</th>
            <th>Details</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {items.map((entry) => (
            <tr key={entry.id}>
              <td>{formatDateTime(entry.created_at)}</td>
              <td>{HISTORY_EVENT_LABELS[entry.event_type] || entry.event_type}</td>
              <td>{historyTransition(entry)}</td>
              <td>{entry.actor_email || 'System'}</td>
              <td>{historyDetailText(entry.detail) || 'â€”'}</td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

export default HistoryList;

      {count !== null && <Pager count={count} hasNext={!!next} hasPrev={!!previous} busy={loading} onPrev={() => previous && loadUrl(previous)} onNext={() => next && loadUrl(next)} />}
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\pages\licensing\LicenseRenewals.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { Field, DataTable, Pager, PageHeader } from '../../components';
import { fetchPage, parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';
import { RENEWAL_STATUS_LABELS, AGREEMENT_STATUS_LABELS } from '../../shared/licensing-utils';

function LicenseRenewalsPage() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const caps = licensingCapabilities(auth);
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [count, setCount] = useState(null);
  const [next, setNext] = useState(null);
  const [previous, setPrevious] = useState(null);
  const [page] = useState(1);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [f, setF] = useState({ search: '', status: '' });
  const loadUrl = async (url) => {
    setLoading(true); setError('');
    try { const pg = await fetchPage(url); setItems(pg.items); setCount(pg.count); setNext(pg.next); setPrevious(pg.previous); } catch { setError('Could not load renewals.'); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  };
  useEffect(() => { loadUrl(`/licensing/renewals/?page=${page}${f.status ? '&status=' + f.status : ''}`); }, [page, f.status]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
  const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState(null);
  const doAction = async (id, action, body = {}) => {
    if (busyId) return;
    setBusyId(id); setError('');
    try { await api.post(`/licensing/renewals/${id}/${action}/`, body); await loadUrl(`/licensing/renewals/?page=${page}`); } catch (e) { setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Action failed.'); }
    finally { setBusyId(null); }
  };
  const columns = [
    { key: 'agreement_number', label: 'Agreement' },
    { key: 'product_name', label: 'Product' },
    { key: 'agreement_status', label: 'Agreement Status', render: (v) => AGREEMENT_STATUS_LABELS[v.agreement_status] || v.agreement_status || 'â€”' },
    { key: 'previous_expiry_date', label: 'Current Expiry' },
    { key: 'proposed_expiry_date', label: 'Proposed Expiry' },
    { key: 'proposed_quantity', label: 'Qty' },
    { key: 'proposed_total_cost', label: 'Cost' },
    { key: 'currency', label: 'Currency' },
    { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (v) => RENEWAL_STATUS_LABELS[v.status] || v.status },
    { key: 'requested_by_email', label: 'Requested By' },
    { key: 'actions', label: 'Actions', render: (v) => (
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4 }}>
        {v.status === 'draft' && <button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" disabled={busyId === v.id} onClick={() => doAction(v.id, 'submit')}>Submit</button>}
        {v.status === 'submitted' && caps.canApproveRenewals && <>
          <button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" disabled={busyId === v.id} onClick={() => doAction(v.id, 'approve', { decision: 'approved' })}>Approve</button>
          <button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline danger" disabled={busyId === v.id} onClick={() => doAction(v.id, 'reject', { decision: 'rejected', review_reason: 'rejected' })}>Reject</button>
        </>}
        {v.status === 'approved' && (
          <button
            className="btn btn-sm btn-outline"
            disabled={busyId === v.id || ['draft', 'terminated', 'retired'].includes(v.agreement_status)}
            title={['draft', 'terminated', 'retired'].includes(v.agreement_status) ? 'Agreement is not eligible for renewal application' : ''}
            onClick={() => doAction(v.id, 'apply')}
          >
            Apply
          </button>
        )}
        <button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" disabled={busyId === v.id} onClick={() => doAction(v.id, 'cancel')}>Cancel</button>
      </div>
    ) },
  ];
  if (!caps.canManageRenewals && !caps.canView) return <div className="panel-pad">Access denied.</div>;
  return (
    <div className="license-renewals-page">
      <PageHeader title="License Renewals" />
      <div className="page-toolbar" style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap', marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <Field label="Status" required={false}><select className="input" value={f.status} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, status: e.target.value })}><option value="">All</option>{Object.entries(RENEWAL_STATUS_LABELS).map(([k,v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}</select></Field>
      </div>
      {error && <div className="alert alert-danger">{error}</div>}
      <DataTable columns={columns} rows={items} keyOf={(r) => r.id} loading={loading} emptyTitle="No renewals found" />
      {count !== null && <Pager count={count} hasNext={!!next} hasPrev={!!previous} busy={loading} onPrev={() => previous && loadUrl(previous)} onNext={() => next && loadUrl(next)} />}
    </div>
  );
}
export { LicenseRenewalsPage };
export default LicenseRenewalsPage;



===== src\pages\licensing\LicenseSecrets.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { PageHeader, Field, AccessDenied } from '../../components';
import { parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';
import api from '../../api';
import { licensingCapabilities } from '../../shared/licensing-utils';
import { SECRET_TYPE_LABELS, SECRET_STATUS_LABELS } from '../../shared/licensing-utils';

function LicenseSecretsPage({ agreementId }) {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const caps = licensingCapabilities(auth);
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [showCreate, setShowCreate] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ secret_type: 'license_key', label: '', plaintext_value: '' });
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [revealed, setRevealed] = useState(null);
  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try { const r = await api.get(`/licensing/secrets/?agreement=${agreementId}`); setItems(r.data.results || r.data || []); } catch (e) { setError(e.response?.data?.detail || 'Could not load secrets.'); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  };
  useEffect(() => { if (agreementId) load(); }, [agreementId]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, react/set-state-in-effect
  if (!caps.canViewSecrets) return <AccessDenied />;
  const create = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault(); setSaving(true); setError('');
    try {
      await api.post('/licensing/secrets/', { agreement: agreementId, secret_type: form.secret_type, label: form.label, plaintext_value: form.plaintext_value });
      setShowCreate(false); setForm({ secret_type: 'license_key', label: '', plaintext_value: '' });
      load();
    } catch (e) { setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Create failed.'); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  };
  const reveal = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm('You are about to reveal a protected license secret. This action is audited.')) return;
    try {
      const r = await api.post(`/licensing/secrets/${id}/reveal/`);
      setRevealed(r.data.revealed_value);
      setTimeout(() => setRevealed(null), 30000);
    } catch (e) { setError(e.response?.status === 403 ? 'You do not have permission to reveal this secret.' : (e.response?.data?.detail || 'Reveal failed.')); }
  };
  const revoke = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm('Revoke this secret?')) return;
    try { await api.post(`/licensing/secrets/${id}/revoke/`); load(); } catch (e) { setError(e.response?.data?.detail || 'Revoke failed.'); }
  };
  return (
    <div className="license-secrets-page">
      <PageHeader title="License Secrets" />
      {error && <div className="alert alert-danger">{error}</div>}
      {caps.canViewSecrets && <button className="btn btn-primary mb-3" onClick={() => setShowCreate(true)}>New Secret</button>}
      {loading ? <div>Loadingâ€¦</div> : (
        <table className="table table-sm"><thead><tr><th>Type</th><th>Label</th><th>Last 4</th><th>Status</th><th>Created</th><th>Actions</th></tr></thead><tbody>
          {items.map((s) => (
            <tr key={s.id}>
              <td>{SECRET_TYPE_LABELS[s.secret_type] || s.secret_type}</td>
              <td>{s.label}</td>
              <td>{s.last_four}</td>
              <td>{SECRET_STATUS_LABELS[s.status] || s.status}</td>
              <td>{s.created_at}</td>
              <td>
                {caps.canRevealSecrets && <button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" onClick={() => reveal(s.id)}>Reveal</button>}{' '}
                <button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline danger" onClick={() => revoke(s.id)}>Revoke</button>
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody></table>
      )}
      {revealed && <div className="alert alert-warning">Revealed value (temporary): <code>{revealed}</code></div>}
      {showCreate && (
        <div className="modal-backdrop"><div className="modal">
          <h3>New Secret</h3>
          <form onSubmit={create}>
            <Field label="Type"><select className="input" value={form.secret_type} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, secret_type: e.target.value })}>{Object.entries(SECRET_TYPE_LABELS).map(([k,v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}</select></Field>
            <Field label="Label"><input className="input" value={form.label} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, label: e.target.value })} required /></Field>
            <Field label="Plaintext Value"><input className="input" type="password" value={form.plaintext_value} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, plaintext_value: e.target.value })} required /></Field>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
              <button type="button" className="btn btn-outline" onClick={() => setShowCreate(false)}>Cancel</button>
              <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary" disabled={saving}>{saving ? 'Savingâ€¦' : 'Create'}</button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div></div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
export { LicenseSecretsPage };
export default LicenseSecretsPage;

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { EmptyState, PageHeader, DataTable, Field } from '../../components';
import api from '../../api';
import {
  formatQuantity,
  formatPercent,
  formatUtilization,
  AGREEMENT_STATUS_LABELS,
  LICENSE_MODEL_LABELS,
} from '../../shared/licensing-utils';

const EXPIRY_OPTIONS = [
  ['', 'Any expiry'],
  ['30', 'Expiring in 30 days'],
  ['60', 'Expiring in 60 days'],
  ['90', 'Expiring in 90 days'],
  ['expired', 'Already expired'],
  ['none', 'No expiry date'],
];

function LicenseUtilizationPage() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState({ status: '', vendor: '', license_type: '', expiry: '', overallocated: '' });

  const params = useMemo(() => {
    const out = {};
    Object.entries(filters).forEach(([k, v]) => { if (v) out[k] = v; });
    return out;
  }, [filters]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setLoading(true); setError(''); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    api.get('/licensing/utilization-report/', { params })
      .then((r) => {
        setItems(Array.isArray(r.data) ? r.data : (r.data.results || []));
        setSummary(r.data?.summary || null);
      })
      .catch((e) => setError(e.response?.data?.detail || 'Could not load report.'))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [params]);

  const setFilter = (key, value) => setFilters((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }));
  const clearFilters = () => setFilters({ status: '', vendor: '', license_type: '', expiry: '', overallocated: '' });
  const hasFilters = Object.values(filters).some(Boolean);

  if (loading) return <div className="panel-pad">Loading utilizationâ€¦</div>;
  if (error) return <div className="alert alert-danger">{error}</div>;

  const columns = [
    { key: 'agreement_name', label: 'Agreement', render: (v) => <a href={`#/licenses/${v.id}`}>{v.agreement_name}</a> },
    { key: 'product_name', label: 'Product' },
    { key: 'vendor', label: 'Vendor' },
    { key: 'license_metric', label: 'Metric', render: (v) => LICENSE_MODEL_LABELS[v.license_metric] || v.license_metric },
    { key: 'purchased_entitlement', label: 'Purchased', render: (v) => (v.is_unlimited ? 'Unlimited' : formatQuantity(v.purchased_entitlement)) },
    { key: 'current_usage', label: 'Current usage' },
    { key: 'available_entitlement', label: 'Available', render: (v) => (v.is_unlimited ? 'â€”' : formatQuantity(v.available_entitlement)) },
    {
      key: 'utilization_percent',
      label: 'Utilization',
      render: (v) => (
        <span title={v.utilization_note || undefined}>
          {formatUtilization(v)}
          {v.is_overallocated && <span className="badge bg-danger ms-1">Over</span>}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    { key: 'expiry_date', label: 'Expiry' },
    {
      key: 'open_findings',
      label: 'Open findings',
      render: (v) => (v.open_findings ? <a href="#/license-compliance">{v.open_findings}</a> : '0'),
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="license-utilization-page">
      <PageHeader title="License Utilization" />

      <div className="page-toolbar" style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap', marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <Field label="Agreement status" required={false}>
          <select className="input" value={filters.status} onChange={(e) => setFilter('status', e.target.value)}>
            <option value="">All statuses</option>
            {Object.entries(AGREEMENT_STATUS_LABELS).map(([k, v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}
          </select>
        </Field>
        <Field label="Vendor" required={false}>
          <input className="input" placeholder="Vendor name" value={filters.vendor} onChange={(e) => setFilter('vendor', e.target.value)} />
        </Field>
        <Field label="License metric" required={false}>
          <select className="input" value={filters.license_type} onChange={(e) => setFilter('license_type', e.target.value)}>
            <option value="">All metrics</option>
            {Object.entries(LICENSE_MODEL_LABELS).map(([k, v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}
          </select>
        </Field>
        <Field label="Expiry period" required={false}>
          <select className="input" value={filters.expiry} onChange={(e) => setFilter('expiry', e.target.value)}>
            {EXPIRY_OPTIONS.map(([k, v]) => <option key={k || 'any'} value={k}>{v}</option>)}
          </select>
        </Field>
        <Field label="Over-allocation" required={false}>
          <select className="input" value={filters.overallocated} onChange={(e) => setFilter('overallocated', e.target.value)}>
            <option value="">All agreements</option>
            <option value="true">Only overallocated</option>
          </select>
        </Field>
        {hasFilters && <div style={{ alignSelf: 'flex-end' }}><button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" onClick={clearFilters}>Clear filters</button></div>}
      </div>

      {summary && (
        <div className="row g-3 mb-3">
          {[
            ['Purchased entitlement', formatQuantity(summary.total_entitlement_quantity)],
            ['Current usage', summary.current_usage],
            ['Available', formatQuantity(summary.available_entitlement)],
            ['Overallocated agreements', summary.overallocated_agreements],
            ['Overall utilization', summary.utilization_percent == null ? 'Not calculable' : formatPercent(summary.utilization_percent)],
          ].map(([label, value]) => (
            <div className="col-md-3 col-sm-6" key={label}>
              <div className="card"><div className="card-body">
                <div className="text-muted small">{label}</div>
                <div className="fs-5 fw-bold">{value ?? 'â€”'}</div>
              </div></div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {items.length === 0
        ? <EmptyState title="No agreements match these filters" />
        : <DataTable columns={columns} rows={items} keyOf={(r) => r.id} loading={loading} emptyTitle="No data" />}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';

import {

  formatPercent,
  formatQuantity,

  ['30', 'Expiring in 30 days'],
  ['60', 'Expiring in 60 days'],
  ['90', 'Expiring in 90 days'],
  ['expired', 'Already expired'],
  ['none', 'No expiry date'],
];

export function LicensingDashboard() {
  const { canViewLicenseReports } = useAuth();
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);

    setLoading(true); setError('');

      const params = {};
      Object.entries(filters).forEach(([k, v]) => { if (v) params[k] = v; });
      const r = await api.get('/licensing/dashboard/', { params });
      setData(r.data);
    } catch (e) { setError(e.response?.data?.detail || 'Could not load dashboard.'); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  };
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [filters.status, filters.vendor, filters.license_type, filters.expiry]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, react/set-state-in-effect

  const hasFilters = Object.values(filters).some(Boolean);

  if (loading) return <div className="panel-pad">Loading licensing dashboardâ€¦</div>;

    ['Approaching Expiry', data.approaching_expiry_agreements],
    ['Total Entitlement', formatQuantity(data.total_entitlement_quantity)],
    ['Active Usage', data.active_usage ?? data.allocated_seats],
    ['Available Entitlement', formatQuantity(data.available_entitlements)],
    ['Overallocated Agreements', data.overallocated_agreements],
    ['Pending Renewals', data.pending_renewals],
    ['Open Compliance Findings', data.open_compliance_findings],
    ['Agreements Requiring Attention', data.agreements_requiring_attention],
    ['Utilization', data.utilization_calculable === false ? 'Not calculable' : formatPercent(data.utilization_percent)],
  ];

  return (
    <div className="licensing-dashboard">
      <PageHeader title="Software Licensing Dashboard" />

      <div className="page-toolbar" style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap', marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <Field label="Agreement status" required={false}>
          <select className="input" value={filters.status} onChange={(e) => setFilter('status', e.target.value)}>
            <option value="">All statuses</option>
            {Object.entries(AGREEMENT_STATUS_LABELS).map(([k, v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}
          </select>
        </Field>
        <Field label="Vendor" required={false}>
          <input className="input" placeholder="Vendor name" value={filters.vendor} onChange={(e) => setFilter('vendor', e.target.value)} />
        </Field>
        <Field label="License metric" required={false}>
          <select className="input" value={filters.license_type} onChange={(e) => setFilter('license_type', e.target.value)}>
            <option value="">All metrics</option>
            {Object.entries(LICENSE_MODEL_LABELS).map(([k, v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}
          </select>
        </Field>
        <Field label="Expiry period" required={false}>
          <select className="input" value={filters.expiry} onChange={(e) => setFilter('expiry', e.target.value)}>
            {EXPIRY_OPTIONS.map(([k, v]) => <option key={k || 'any'} value={k}>{v}</option>)}
          </select>
        </Field>
        {hasFilters && <div style={{ alignSelf: 'flex-end' }}><button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" onClick={clearFilters}>Clear filters</button></div>}

      <div className="row g-3 mb-3">
