              <div className="text-muted small">{label}</div>
              <div className="fs-4 fw-bold">{val ?? 'â€”'}</div>
            </div></div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="mb-3" style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
        <a className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" href="#/license-utilization">Entitlement utilization report</a>
        <a className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" href="#/license-compliance">Compliance findings</a>
        <a className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" href="#/license-renewals">Renewals</a>
      </div>

      {canViewLicenseReports && (data.annual_recurring_cost_by_currency || data.annual_cost_by_currency) && (
        <div className="card mb-3"><div className="card-body">
          <h5>Annual Recurring Cost by Currency</h5>
          <ul className="list-unstyled mb-0">
            {Object.entries(data.annual_recurring_cost_by_currency || data.annual_cost_by_currency).map(([c, v]) => (
              <li key={c}>{c}: {formatMoney(v, c)}</li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div></div>
      )}

      <div className="row g-3">
        <div className="col-md-6">
          <div className="card"><div className="card-body">
            <h5>Expiring Agreements</h5>
            {(data.expiring_agreements || []).length === 0 ? <p className="text-muted">None</p> : (
              <table className="table table-sm"><tbody>
                {(data.expiring_agreements || []).map((a) => (
                  <tr key={a.id}>
                    <td><a href={`#/licenses/${a.id}`}>{a.agreement_number}</a></td>
                    <td>{a.product_name}</td>
                    <td>{a.expiry_date}</td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody></table>
            )}
          </div></div>
        </div>
        <div className="col-md-6">
          <div className="card"><div className="card-body">
            <h5>Pending Renewals</h5>
            {(data.pending_renewals_list || []).length === 0 ? <p className="text-muted">None</p> : (
              <table className="table table-sm"><tbody>
                {(data.pending_renewals_list || []).map((r) => <tr key={r.id}><td>{r.agreement_number}</td><td>{r.status}</td></tr>)}
              </tbody></table>
            )}
          </div></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

===== src\pages\licensing\LicensingRouter.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { AccessDenied } from '../../components';
import { licensingCapabilities } from '../../shared/licensing-utils';
import { LicensingDashboard } from './LicensingDashboard';
import { SoftwareProductsPage } from '../software-products/SoftwareProducts';
import { SoftwareProductForm } from '../software-products/SoftwareProductForm';
import { SoftwareProductDetail } from '../software-products/SoftwareProductDetail';
import { LicenseAgreementsPage } from './LicenseAgreements';
import { LicenseAgreementForm } from './LicenseAgreementForm';
import { LicenseAgreementDetail } from './LicenseAgreementDetail';
import { LicenseAllocationsPage } from './LicenseAllocations';
import { LicenseInstallationsPage } from './LicenseInstallations';
import { LicenseRenewalsPage } from './LicenseRenewals';
import { LicenseCalendarPage } from './LicenseCalendar';
import { LicenseCompliancePage } from './LicenseCompliance';
import { LicenseSecretsPage } from './LicenseSecrets';
import { LicenseDocumentsPage } from './LicenseDocuments';
import { LicenseUtilizationPage } from './LicenseUtilization';
import { MySoftwarePage } from '../my-software/MySoftware';

function readHash() {
  const raw = String(window.location.hash || '');
  const path = raw.replace(/^#/, '');
  const [route, query = ''] = path.split('?');
  return { route: route || '/software', query };
}

function NotAvailable({ message }) {
  return <div className="empty-state" role="alert"><div className="empty-title">{message}</div><div className="small"><a href="#/software">Back to licensing</a></div></div>;
}

export function LicensingRouter({ route: routeProp }) {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const caps = licensingCapabilities(auth);
  const [location, setLocation] = useState(() => routeProp ? (() => { const [r, q = ''] = String(routeProp).split('?'); return { route: r || '/software', query: q }; })() : readHash());
  useEffect(() => {
    if (routeProp) { const [r, q = ''] = String(routeProp).split('?'); setLocation({ route: r || '/software', query: q }); return; } // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    const onChange = () => setLocation(readHash());
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', onChange);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('hashchange', onChange);
  }, [routeProp]);

  if (!caps.canView) return <AccessDenied reason="access" />;

  const { route } = location;
  const segments = route.split('/').filter(Boolean);
  const first = segments[0];

  // /software...
  if (first === 'software') {
    if (segments.length === 1) return <LicensingDashboard />;
    if (segments[1] === 'products') {
      if (segments[2] === 'new') return <SoftwareProductForm />;
      if (segments[2] && segments[3] === 'edit') return <SoftwareProductForm productId={segments[2]} />;
      if (segments[2]) return <SoftwareProductDetail id={segments[2]} />;
      return <SoftwareProductsPage />;
    }
    return <LicensingDashboard />;
  }

  // /licenses...
  if (first === 'licenses') {
    if (segments.length === 1) return <LicenseAgreementsPage />;
    if (segments[1] === 'new') return <LicenseAgreementForm />;
    if (segments[1] && segments[2] === 'edit') return <LicenseAgreementForm agreementId={segments[1]} />;
    if (segments[1] && segments[2] === 'allocations') return <LicenseAllocationsPage />;
    if (segments[1] && segments[2] === 'installations') return <LicenseInstallationsPage />;
    if (segments[1] && segments[2] === 'documents') return <LicenseDocumentsPage agreementId={segments[1]} />;
    if (segments[1] && segments[2] === 'history') return <LicenseAgreementDetail id={segments[1]} />;
    if (segments[1] && segments[2] === 'renewal') return <LicenseRenewalsPage />;
    if (segments[1] && segments[2] === 'secrets') return <LicenseSecretsPage agreementId={segments[1]} />;
    if (segments[1]) return <LicenseAgreementDetail id={segments[1]} />;
    return <LicenseAgreementsPage />;
  }

  if (first === 'license-allocations') return <LicenseAllocationsPage />;
  if (first === 'license-installations') return <LicenseInstallationsPage />;
  if (first === 'license-renewals') return <LicenseRenewalsPage />;
  if (first === 'license-compliance') return <LicenseCompliancePage />;
  if (first === 'license-calendar') return <LicenseCalendarPage />;
  if (first === 'license-utilization') return <LicenseUtilizationPage />;
  if (first === 'my-software') return <MySoftwarePage />;

  return <NotAvailable message="This licensing page does not exist." />;
}

export default LicensingRouter;

===== src\pages\lifecycle\LifecycleCases.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import {
  Badge, ConfirmDialog, DataTable, ErrorSummary, Field,
  PageHeader, Pager, UserSelect,
} from '../../components';
import { parseApiError, fetchPage } from '../../api-utils';
import {
  CASE_TYPE_LABELS, CASE_STATUS_LABELS, PRIORITY_LABELS,
  formatDate, formatDateTime, isTerminalCaseStatus,
} from '../../shared/lifecycle-utils';

const STATUS_OPTIONS = [
  'draft', 'planned', 'in_progress', 'ready_for_employee',
  'employee_started', 'blocked', 'completed', 'cancelled',
];
const PRIORITY_OPTIONS = ['low', 'medium', 'high', 'urgent'];
const SOURCE_OPTIONS = ['manual', 'service_request', 'employee_created', 'department_transfer', 'account_deactivation'];

export function LifecycleCases({ caseType }) {
  const { isStaff, isAdmin, isManagerOrAdmin, isEmployee } = useAuth();
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [pageSize] = useState(20);
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState({
    status: '', priority: '', employee: '', department: '', coordinator: '',
    planned_from: '', planned_to: '', effective_from: '', effective_to: '',
    target_from: '', target_to: '', blocked: '', overdue: '', source: '', search: '',
  });
  const [confirmCancelId, setConfirmCancelId] = useState(null);
  const [deleteBusy, setDeleteBusy] = useState(false);
  const [actionBusy, setActionBusy] = useState({});

  const canManage = isAdmin || isManagerOrAdmin;
  const canStaff = isStaff;
  const isEmpView = isEmployee && !isStaff;

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const params = {
        page, page_size: pageSize,
        case_type: caseType,
        ...filters,
      };
      const clean = {};
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) {
        if (v !== '' && v != null) clean[k] = v;
      }
      const r = await fetchPage('/lifecycle/cases/', { params: clean });
      setItems(r.items);
      setCount(r.count);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not load cases.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Reload on mount and whenever filters or pagination change.
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [caseType, page, pageSize, JSON.stringify(filters)]);

  const doRetry = () => load();

  const hasPrev = page > 1;
  const hasNext = (page * pageSize) < count;

  const doTransition = async (id, action) => {
    setActionBusy((s) => ({ ...s, [id]: true }));
    try {
      const c = items.find((i) => i.id === id);
      const payload = { version: c ? c.version : 1 };
      if (action === 'cancel') payload.reason = 'Cancelled from case list.';
      await api.post(`/lifecycle/cases/${id}/${action}/`, payload);
      load();
    } catch (e) {
      const p = parseApiError(e);
      setError(p.global || `Could not ${action} case.`);
    } finally {
      setActionBusy((s) => { const n = { ...s }; delete n[id]; return n; });
    }
  };

  const doCancel = async () => {
    if (!confirmCancelId) return;
    setDeleteBusy(true);
    try {
      const c = items.find((i) => i.id === confirmCancelId);
      await api.post(`/lifecycle/cases/${confirmCancelId}/cancel/`, {
        reason: 'Cancelled from case list.',
        version: c ? c.version : 1,
      });
      setConfirmCancelId(null);
      load();
    } catch (e) {
      const p = parseApiError(e);
      setError(p.global || 'Could not cancel case.');
    } finally {
      setDeleteBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const rowActions = (c) => {
    const isTerminal = isTerminalCaseStatus(c.status);
    const isDraft = c.status === 'draft';
    const isPlanned = c.status === 'planned';
    const isInProgress = c.status === 'in_progress';
    const busy = !!actionBusy[c.id];
    const buttons = [];

    buttons.push(
      <button key="view" type="button" className="btn-small btn-ghost"
        onClick={() => { location.hash = `#/lifecycle/${c.id}`; }}
        disabled={busy}>
        View
      </button>
    );

    if (isDraft && canManage && !busy) {
      buttons.push(
        <button key="plan" type="button" className="btn-small btn-secondary"
          onClick={() => doTransition(c.id, 'plan')}>
          Plan
        </button>
      );
    }
    if (isPlanned && canStaff && !busy) {
      buttons.push(
        <button key="start" type="button" className="btn-small btn-secondary"
          onClick={() => doTransition(c.id, 'start')}>
          Start
        </button>
      );
    }
    if (isInProgress && canStaff && !busy) {
      buttons.push(
        <button key="resume" type="button" className="btn-small btn-secondary"
          onClick={() => doTransition(c.id, 'unblock')}>
          Resume
        </button>
      );
    }
    if (!isTerminal && canManage && !busy) {
      buttons.push(
        <button key="complete" type="button" className="btn-small btn-outline"
          onClick={() => doTransition(c.id, 'complete')}>
          Complete
        </button>
      );
    }
    if (!isTerminal && canStaff && !busy && confirmCancelId !== c.id) {
      buttons.push(
        <button key="cancel" type="button" className="btn-small btn-danger"
          onClick={() => setConfirmCancelId(c.id)}>
          Cancel
        </button>
      );
    }
    if (isDraft && canManage && !busy) {
      buttons.push(
        <button key="edit" type="button" className="btn-small btn-ghost"
          onClick={() => { location.hash = `#/lifecycle/new?edit=${c.id}`; }}>
          Edit Draft
        </button>
      );
    }

    return buttons.length ? (
      <div className="row-gap" style={{ gap: 'var(--sp-05)' }}>{buttons}</div>
    ) : <span className="muted small">â€”</span>;
  };

  const columns = [
    {
      key: 'case_number', label: 'Case Number',
      render: (r) => <a href={`#/lifecycle/${r.id}`}>{r.case_number}</a>,
    },
    {
      key: 'employee', label: 'Employee',
      render: (r) => r.employee_email || r.employee_id || `User #${r.employee}`,
    },
    {
      key: 'department', label: 'Department',
      render: (r) => r.department ? String(r.department) : 'â€”',
    },
    {
      key: 'status', label: 'Status',
      render: (r) => <Badge kind="status" value={r.status} />,
    },
    {
      key: 'priority', label: 'Priority',
      render: (r) => <Badge kind="priority" value={r.priority} />,
    },
    {
      key: 'coordinator', label: 'Coordinator',
      render: (r) => r.assigned_coordinator ? String(r.assigned_coordinator) : 'Unassigned',
    },
    {
      key: 'planned_date', label: 'Planned Date',
      render: (r) => formatDate(r.planned_date),
    },
    {
      key: 'effective_date', label: 'Effective Date',
      render: (r) => formatDate(r.effective_date),
    },
    {
      key: 'completion_target', label: 'Completion Target',
      render: (r) => formatDate(r.completion_target),
    },
    {
      key: 'progress', label: 'Progress',
      render: (r) => <span>{r.checklist_progress != null ? `${Math.round(r.checklist_progress)}%` : '0%'}</span>,
    },
    {
      key: 'overdue_tasks', label: 'Overdue Tasks',
      render: (r) => r.overdue_tasks > 0 ? <span className="badge badge-red">{r.overdue_tasks}</span> : String(r.overdue_tasks),
    },
    {
      key: 'updated', label: 'Updated',
      render: (r) => formatDateTime(r.updated_at),
    },
    {
      key: 'actions', label: 'Actions',
      render: (r) => rowActions(r),
    },
  ];

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="lifecycle-cases">
        <PageHeader title={CASE_TYPE_LABELS[caseType] ?? 'Cases'} />
        <div role="status" aria-label="Loading">
          {Array.from({ length: 5 }).map((_, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="skeleton-row">
              <span className="sk-cell" style={{ width: '14%' }} /><span className="sk-cell" style={{ width: '26%' }} />
              <span className="sk-cell" style={{ width: '14%' }} /><span className="sk-cell" style={{ width: '12%' }} />
              <span className="sk-cell" style={{ width: '10%' }} /><span className="sk-cell" style={{ width: '12%' }} />
              <span className="sk-cell" style={{ width: '12%' }} /><span className="sk-cell" style={{ width: '10%' }} />
              <span className="sk-cell" style={{ width: '10%' }} /><span className="sk-cell" style={{ width: '10%' }} />
              <span className="sk-cell" style={{ width: '10%' }} /><span className="sk-cell" style={{ width: '12%' }} />
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (error && !items.length) {
    return (
      <div className="lifecycle-cases">
        <PageHeader title={CASE_TYPE_LABELS[caseType] ?? 'Cases'} />
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>
        <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={doRetry}>Retry</button>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className="lifecycle-cases">
      <PageHeader
        title={CASE_TYPE_LABELS[caseType] ?? 'Cases'}
        sub={`${count} case${count === 1 ? '' : 's'}`}
        actions={
          <div className="row-gap" style={{ alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--sp-1)' }}>
            {canManage && !isEmpView ? (
              <a className="btn-primary" href="#/lifecycle/new">+ Create Case</a>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        }
      />
      {error && <ErrorSummary parsed={{ global: error }} />}

      <section className="section" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-2)', marginBottom: 'var(--sp-2)' }}>
        <h4 className="section-title">Filters</h4>
        <div className="filter-bar" style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 'var(--sp-2)', alignItems: 'end' }}>
          <Field label="Status">
            <select className="input" value={filters.status} onChange={(e) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, status: e.target.value, page: 1 }))}>
              <option value="">All statuses</option>
              {STATUS_OPTIONS.map((s) => <option key={s} value={s}>{CASE_STATUS_LABELS[s] ?? s}</option>)}
            </select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="Priority">
            <select className="input" value={filters.priority} onChange={(e) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, priority: e.target.value, page: 1 }))}>
              <option value="">All priorities</option>
              {PRIORITY_OPTIONS.map((p) => <option key={p} value={p}>{PRIORITY_LABELS[p] ?? p}</option>)}
            </select>
          </Field>
          {!isEmpView && (
            <Field label="Employee">
              <UserSelect value={filters.employee} onChange={(id) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, employee: id != null ? Number(id) : '', page: 1 }))} />
            </Field>
          )}
          <Field label="Department">
            <select className="input" value={filters.department} onChange={(e) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, department: e.target.value, page: 1 }))}>
              <option value="">All departments</option>
            </select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="Blocked">
            <select className="input" value={filters.blocked} onChange={(e) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, blocked: e.target.value, page: 1 }))}>
              <option value="">All</option>
              <option value="true">Blocked only</option>
              <option value="false">Not blocked</option>
            </select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="Overdue">
            <select className="input" value={filters.overdue} onChange={(e) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, overdue: e.target.value, page: 1 }))}>
              <option value="">All</option>
              <option value="true">Overdue only</option>
              <option value="false">Not overdue</option>
            </select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="Source">
            <select className="input" value={filters.source} onChange={(e) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, source: e.target.value, page: 1 }))}>
              <option value="">All sources</option>
              {SOURCE_OPTIONS.map((s) => <option key={s} value={s}>{s.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</option>)}
            </select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="Search">
            <input className="input" value={filters.search} onChange={(e) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, search: e.target.value, page: 1 }))} placeholder="Case number, employeeâ€¦" />
          </Field>
        </div>
      </section>

      <DataTable
        columns={columns}
        rows={items}
        keyOf={(r) => r.case_number || String(r.id)}
        emptyTitle="No cases"
        emptyHint={isEmpView ? 'You have no lifecycle cases.' : 'No cases match the current filters.'}
      />

      <Pager
        count={count}
        hasPrev={hasPrev}
        hasNext={hasNext}
        onPrev={() => setPage((p) => p - 1)}
        onNext={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)}
        busy={loading}
        pageLabel={`Page ${page} of ${Math.max(1, Math.ceil(count / pageSize))}`}
      />
      {confirmCancelId && (
        <ConfirmDialog
          title="Cancel case?"
          message={`Canceling ${items.find((c) => c.id === confirmCancelId)?.case_number || 'this case'} will mark it as cancelled.`}
          confirmLabel="Cancel case" danger busy={deleteBusy}
          onConfirm={doCancel}
          onCancel={() => setConfirmCancelId(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { ErrorSummary, Field, PageHeader } from '../../components';
import { parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';
import {
  CASE_TYPE_LABELS, formatDate, formatDateTime,
} from '../../shared/lifecycle-utils';

const KPIS = [
  { key: 'onboarding_in_progress', label: 'Onboarding In Progress', tone: 'blue' },
  { key: 'onboarding_due_7d', label: 'Onboarding Due in 7 Days', tone: 'amber' },
  { key: 'onboarding_blocked', label: 'Onboarding Blocked', tone: 'red' },
  { key: 'offboarding_in_progress', label: 'Offboarding In Progress', tone: 'blue' },
  { key: 'offboarding_effective_7d', label: 'Offboarding Effective in 7 Days', tone: 'amber' },
  { key: 'offboarding_unresolved_assets', label: 'Offboarding with Unresolved Assets', tone: 'red' },
  { key: 'offboarding_awaiting_deactivation', label: 'Awaiting Account Deactivation', tone: 'red' },
  { key: 'transfers_in_progress', label: 'Transfers In Progress', tone: 'blue' },
  { key: 'overdue_tasks', label: 'Overdue Tasks', tone: 'red' },
  { key: 'failed_automations', label: 'Failed Automations', tone: 'red' },
];

export function LifecycleDashboard() {
  const { isStaff, isAdmin, isManagerOrAdmin, isEmployee } = useAuth();
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [refreshBusy, setRefreshBusy] = useState(false);
  const [lastRefreshed, setLastRefreshed] = useState(null);

  // Filters (UI only; passed through to list views when user navigates).
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState({
    case_type: '', department: '', coordinator: '', date_from: '', date_to: '',
  });

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const r = await api.get('/lifecycle/dashboard/');
      setData(r.data);
      setLastRefreshed(new Date());
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not load the Lifecycle dashboard.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const doRefresh = async () => {
    setRefreshBusy(true);
    try {
      const r = await api.get('/lifecycle/dashboard/');
      setData(r.data);
      setLastRefreshed(new Date());
      setError('');
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Refresh failed.');
    } finally {
      setRefreshBusy(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, react/set-state-in-effect

  const canManage = isAdmin || isManagerOrAdmin || isStaff;

  const renderKpi = (key, label, tone) => {
    const value = data ? Number(data[key] || 0) : 0;
    return (
      <div key={key} className="kpi-card">
        <div className="kpi-value">{value}</div>
        <div className="kpi-label">{label}</div>
        <span className={`badge badge-${tone}`}>{label}</span>
      </div>
    );
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <p className="page-loading" role="status">
        <span className="spinner" aria-hidden="true" />Loading Lifecycle dashboardâ€¦
      </p>
    );
  }
  if (error && !data) {
    return (
      <div className="detail-wrap">
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>
        <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={doRefresh}>Retry</button>
        <p><a className="back-link" href="#/dashboard">â† Back to Dashboard</a></p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const isEmployeeView = isEmployee && !isStaff;
  const d = data || {};

  return (
    <div className="lifecycle-dashboard">
      <PageHeader
        title="Lifecycle Dashboard"
        sub={isEmployeeView ? 'Your own active case and assigned tasks.' : 'Management overview of onboarding, offboarding and transfer cases.'}
        actions={
          <div className="row-gap" style={{ alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--sp-1)' }}>
            {lastRefreshed && (
              <span className="muted small">Last refreshed {formatDateTime(lastRefreshed)}</span>
            )}
            <button
              type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={doRefresh}
              disabled={refreshBusy}
              aria-label="Refresh dashboard"
            >
              {refreshBusy ? 'Refreshingâ€¦' : 'Refresh'}
            </button>
          </div>
        }
      />
      {error && <ErrorSummary parsed={{ global: error }} />}

      <section className="section" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
        <h3 className="section-title">
          {isEmployeeView ? 'Your Lifecycle Case' : 'Management KPIs'}
        </h3>
        <div className="kpi-grid">
          {isEmployeeView
            ? (() => {
                const own = {
                  onboarding_in_progress: d.onboarding_in_progress ?? 0,
                  overdue_tasks: d.overdue_tasks ?? 0,
                  failed_automations: d.failed_automations ?? 0,
                };
                return [
                  { key: 'onboarding_in_progress', label: 'Active Cases', value: own.onboarding_in_progress },
                  { key: 'overdue_tasks', label: 'Overdue Tasks', value: own.overdue_tasks },
                  { key: 'failed_automations', label: 'Failed Automations', value: own.failed_automations },
                ].map((k) => (
                  <div key={k.key} className="kpi-card">
                    <div className="kpi-value">{k.value}</div>
                    <div className="kpi-label">{k.label}</div>
                  </div>
                ));
              })()
            : KPIS.map((k) => renderKpi(k.key, k.label, k.tone))}
        </div>

      {canManage && (
        <>
          <section className="section" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
            <h3 className="section-title">Filters</h3>
            <div className="filter-bar" style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 'var(--sp-2)', alignItems: 'end' }}>
              <Field label="Case Type">
                <select className="input" value={filters.case_type} onChange={(e) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, case_type: e.target.value }))}>
                  <option value="">All case types</option>
                  {Object.entries(CASE_TYPE_LABELS).map(([v, l]) => (
                    <option key={v} value={v}>{l}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </Field>
              <Field label="Department">
                <select className="input" value={filters.department} onChange={(e) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, department: e.target.value }))}>
                  <option value="">All departments</option>
                </select>
              </Field>
              <Field label="Coordinator">
                <select className="input" value={filters.coordinator} onChange={(e) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, coordinator: e.target.value }))}>
                  <option value="">All coordinators</option>
                </select>
              </Field>
              <Field label="Date From">
                <input className="input" type="date" value={filters.date_from} onChange={(e) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, date_from: e.target.value }))} />
              </Field>
              <Field label="Date To">
                <input className="input" type="date" value={filters.date_to} onChange={(e) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, date_to: e.target.value }))} />

                    <a href={`#/lifecycle/${c.id}`} className="mini-link">{c.case_number}</a>
                    <span className="mini-desc">{CASE_TYPE_LABELS[c.case_type] ?? c.case_type} Â· {c.status}</span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            ) : (
              <p className="muted">No recent cases.</p>
            )}
          </section>

          <section className="section" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
            <h3 className="section-title">Urgent Cases</h3>
            {d.urgent_cases && d.urgent_cases.length ? (
              <ul className="note-list">
                {d.urgent_cases.map((c) => (
                  <li key={c.case_number || c.id} className="mini-item">
                    <a href={`#/lifecycle/${c.id}`} className="mini-link">{c.case_number}</a>
                    <span className="mini-desc">{CASE_TYPE_LABELS[c.case_type] ?? c.case_type} Â· <span className="badge badge-red">Urgent</span></span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            ) : (
              <p className="muted">No urgent cases.</p>
            )}
          </section>

          <section className="section" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
            <h3 className="section-title">Assigned Tasks</h3>
            {d.tasks_assigned_to_me && d.tasks_assigned_to_me.length ? (
              <ul className="note-list">
                {d.tasks_assigned_to_me.map((t) => (
                  <li key={t.id} className="mini-item">
                    <a href={`#/lifecycle/${t.case__case_number}`} className="mini-link">{t.title}</a>
                    <span className="mini-desc">{t.case__case_number} Â· {t.status} Â· {t.due_date ? formatDate(t.due_date) : 'â€”'}</span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            ) : (
              <p className="muted">No tasks assigned to you.</p>
            )}
          </section>
        </>
      )}

      {!canManage && (
        <section className="section" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
          <h3 className="section-title">Your Active Case</h3>
          <p className="muted">
            You have {d.onboarding_in_progress ?? 0} active onboarding case(s) and
            {d.overdue_tasks ?? 0} overdue task(s). Open your case from the
            navigation to view its checklist and progress.
          </p>
        </section>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}



===== src\pages\lifecycle\LifecycleDetail.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import {
  Badge, ErrorSummary, Field, PageHeader,
} from '../../components';
import { parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';
import {
  CASE_TYPE_LABELS, formatDate, formatDateTime, isTerminalCaseStatus,
  actionAvailability, getActionLabel, isActionReasonRequired,
} from '../../shared/lifecycle-utils';

const ACTION_SUFFIX = {
  plan: 'plan/',
  start: 'start/',
  mark_ready: 'mark_ready/',
  confirm_start: 'confirm_start/',
  complete: 'complete/',
  block: 'block/',
  unblock: 'unblock/',
  cancel: 'cancel/',
};

export function LifecycleDetail({ id }) {
  const { user, isStaff, isAdmin, isManagerOrAdmin, role } = useAuth();
  const [caseData, setCaseData] = useState(null);
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState(null);
  const [history, setHistory] = useState([]);
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [refreshBusy, setRefreshBusy] = useState(false);
  const [actionBusy, setActionBusy] = useState({});
  const [transitionErr, setTransitionErr] = useState('');
  const [blockReason, setBlockReason] = useState('');
  const [cancelReason, setCancelReason] = useState('');
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(null);
  const [staleMsg, setStaleMsg] = useState(null);

  const safeResults = (data) => {
    if (!data) return [];
    if (Array.isArray(data)) return data;
    return Array.isArray(data.results) ? data.results : [];
  };

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const [cRes, sRes, hRes, tRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
        api.get(`/lifecycle/cases/${id}/`),
        api.get(`/lifecycle/cases/${id}/summary/`),
        api.get(`/lifecycle/cases/${id}/history/`, { params: { page_size: 20 } }),
        api.get('/lifecycle/tasks/', { params: { case: id, page_size: 50 } }),
      ]);
      if (cRes.status === 'fulfilled') setCaseData(cRes.value.data);
      else setError('Could not load case details.');
      if (sRes.status === 'fulfilled') setSummary(sRes.value.data);
      if (hRes.status === 'fulfilled') setHistory(safeResults(hRes.value.data));
      if (tRes.status === 'fulfilled') setTasks(safeResults(tRes.value.data));
      if (cRes.status === 'fulfilled') setVersion(cRes.value.data.version);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not load case details.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [id]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, react/set-state-in-effect

  const doRefresh = async () => {
    setRefreshBusy(true);
    setStaleMsg(null);
    try {
      await load();
    } finally {
      setRefreshBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const c = caseData;
  const canSee = c ? (
    isAdmin || isManagerOrAdmin || isStaff || c.employee === (user?.id || user?.employee_id)
  ) : false;

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <p className="page-loading" role="status">
        <span className="spinner" aria-hidden="true" />Loading caseâ€¦
      </p>
    );
  }
  if (error && !c) {
    const is404 = error.includes('404') || error.includes('not found');
    return (
      <div className="detail-wrap">
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">
          {is404 ? 'This lifecycle case is unavailable or you no longer have access.' : error}
        </div>
        <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={doRefresh}>Retry</button>
        <p><a className="back-link" href="#/lifecycle">â† Back to Lifecycle</a></p>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (!canSee) {
    return (
      <div className="detail-wrap">
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">
          You do not have permission to access this case.
        </div>
        <p><a className="back-link" href="#/lifecycle">â† Back to Lifecycle</a></p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const actions = actionAvailability(c.case_type, c.status, role);
  const isTerminal = isTerminalCaseStatus(c.status);

  const runTransition = async (action) => {
    if (!ACTION_SUFFIX[action]) return;
    if (actionBusy[action]) return;

    // Reason prompt for Block/Cancel.
    let reason = '';
    if (isActionReasonRequired(action)) {
      if (action === 'block') reason = blockReason.trim();
      if (action === 'cancel') reason = cancelReason.trim();
      if (!reason) {
        setTransitionErr(`A reason is required to ${getActionLabel(action).toLowerCase()} this case.`);
        return;
      }
    }

    setActionBusy((s) => ({ ...s, [action]: true }));
    setTransitionErr('');
    setStaleMsg(null);

    try {
      const payload = {
        version: c.version || 1,
        ...(reason ? { reason } : {}),
      };
      await api.post(`/lifecycle/cases/${c.id}/${ACTION_SUFFIX[action]}`, payload);
      if (action === 'block') setBlockReason('');
      if (action === 'cancel') setCancelReason('');
      setConfirming(null);
      await load(); // refresh case, summary, history, tasks
    } catch (e) {
      const p = parseApiError(e);
      if (e?.response?.status === 409) {
        setStaleMsg('This case changed while you were working. The latest version has been loaded.');
        setFieldErrors(p.fields);
        await load();
      } else if (e?.response?.status === 403) {
        setTransitionErr('You do not have permission to perform this action.');
      } else if (e?.response?.status === 404) {
        setTransitionErr('This case is no longer available.');
        await load();
      } else {
        setTransitionErr(p.global || `Could not ${def.label.toLowerCase()} the case.`);
      }
    } finally {
      setActionBusy((s) => { const n = { ...s }; delete n[action]; return n; });
    }
  };

  const handleBlockChange = (e) => setBlockReason(e.target.value);
  const handleCancelChange = (e) => setCancelReason(e.target.value);

  return (
    <div className="lifecycle-detail">
      <PageHeader
        title={`Case {c.case_number}`}
        sub={`${CASE_TYPE_LABELS[c.case_type] ?? c.case_type} Â· #${c.id}`}
        actions={
          <div className="row-gap" style={{ alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--sp-1)' }}>
            <button
              type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={doRefresh}
              disabled={refreshBusy}
              aria-label="Refresh case">
              {refreshBusy ? 'Refreshingâ€¦' : 'Refresh'}
            </button>
          </div>
        }
      />
      {transitionErr && <div className="field-error" role="alert">{transitionErr}</div>}
      {staleMsg && <div className="alert alert-warning" role="status">{staleMsg}</div>}
      {error && <ErrorSummary parsed={{ global: error }} />}

      {/* Header info */}
      <section className="section" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-2)' }}>
        <h3 className="section-title">Case Header</h3>
        <dl className="detail-grid">
          <dt>Case Number</dt><dd>{c.case_number}</dd>
          <dt>Employee</dt><dd>{c.employee_email || `User #${c.employee}`}</dd>
          <dt>Case Type</dt><dd>{CASE_TYPE_LABELS[c.case_type] ?? c.case_type}</dd>
          <dt>Status</dt><dd><Badge kind="status" value={c.status} /></dd>
          <dt>Priority</dt><dd><Badge kind="priority" value={c.priority} /></dd>
          <dt>Department</dt><dd>{c.department ? String(c.department) : 'â€”'}</dd>
          <dt>Coordinator</dt><dd>{c.assigned_coordinator ? String(c.assigned_coordinator) : 'Unassigned'}</dd>
          <dt>Planned Date</dt><dd>{formatDate(c.planned_date)}</dd>
          <dt>Effective Date</dt><dd>{formatDate(c.effective_date)}</dd>
          <dt>Completion Target</dt><dd>{formatDate(c.completion_target)}</dd>
          <dt>Progress</dt><dd>
            <span className="badge badge-blue">{c.checklist_progress != null ? `${Math.round(c.checklist_progress)}%` : '0%'}</span>
          </dd>
          <dt>Overdue Tasks</dt><dd>{c.overdue_tasks || 0}</dd>
          <dt>Version</dt><dd>{c.version || 1}</dd>
        </dl>
      </section>

      {/* 1. Overview */}
      <section className="section" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
        <h3 className="section-title">Overview</h3>
        <p className="muted">
          {c.case_number} is a {CASE_TYPE_LABELS[c.case_type] ?? c.case_type} case for
          {c.employee_email || 'the employee'}, currently <strong>{c.status}</strong>.
          {c.notes && (
            <span>
              <br />
              <span className="pre-wrap">Notes: {c.notes}</span>
            </span>
          )}
        </p>
        <p className="muted small">
          Created {formatDateTime(c.created_at)} &middot;
          Last updated {formatDateTime(c.updated_at)} &middot;
          {c.started_at && `Started ${formatDateTime(c.started_at)}`} &middot;
          {c.completed_at && `Completed ${formatDateTime(c.completed_at)}`}
        </p>
      </section>

      {/* 2. Checklist Summary */}
      <section className="section" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
        <h3 className="section-title">Checklist Summary</h3>
        {summary ? (
          <>
            <div className="kpi-grid" style={{ gap: 'var(--sp-2)' }}>
              <div className="kpi-card">
                <div className="kpi-value">{summary.total_tasks || 0}</div>
                <div className="kpi-label">Total Tasks</div>
              </div>
              <div className="kpi-card">
                <div className="kpi-value">{summary.completed_tasks || 0}</div>
                <div className="kpi-label">Completed Tasks</div>
              </div>
              <div className="kpi-card">
                <div className="kpi-value">{summary.overdue_tasks || 0}</div>
                <div className="kpi-label">Overdue Tasks</div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <table className="grid" style={{ width: '100%', marginTop: 'var(--sp-2)' }}>
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th>Seq.</th><th>Title</th><th>Category</th><th>Responsibility</th>
                  <th>Status</th><th>Due</th><th>Required</th><th>Blocking</th><th>Evidence</th><th>Automation</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {tasks.map((t) => (
                  <tr key={t.id} style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid #eee' }}>
                    <td>{t.sequence}</td>
                    <td>{t.title}</td>
                    <td>{t.category || 'other'}</td>
                    <td>{t.responsibility || 'it'}</td>
                    <td><Badge kind="status" value={t.status} /></td>
                    <td>{formatDate(t.due_date)}</td>
                    <td>{t.required ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</td>
                    <td>{t.blocks_completion ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</td>
                    <td>{t.requires_evidence ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</td>
                    <td><span className={`badge badge-${t.automation_status === 'failed' ? 'red' : 'gray'}`}>{t.automation_status || 'not_applicable'}</span></td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </>
        ) : (
          <p className="muted">Checklist summary unavailable.</p>
        )}
        <p className="muted small" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-1)' }}>
          Task management (start, complete, block, evidence) is planned for O2.2.
          This summary is read-only in O2.1.
        </p>
      </section>

      {/* 3. History Summary */}
      <section className="section" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
        <h3 className="section-title">History</h3>
        {history.length ? (
          <ul className="timeline">
            {history.map((h) => (
              <li key={h.id} className="history-item">
                <div className="muted small">
                  {h.actor_email || `#${h.actor}`} Â· {h.created_at ? formatDateTime(h.created_at) : ''} Â· {h.event_type}
                </div>
                {h.detail && <div className="pre-wrap t-note">{h.detail}</div>}
                {h.previous_status || h.new_status && (
                  <div className="muted small">
                    {h.previous_status ? `from ${h.previous_status}` : ''}
                    {h.previous_status && h.new_status ? ' â†’ ' : ''}
                    {h.new_status ? `to ${h.new_status}` : ''}
                  </div>
                )}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        ) : (
          <p className="muted">No history entries.</p>
        )}
      </section>

      {/* 4. Completion Readiness Summary */}
      <section className="section" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
        <h3 className="section-title">Completion Readiness</h3>
        {summary ? (
          <>
            <p className="muted small">
              Progress: {summary.checklist_progress != null ? `${Math.round(summary.checklist_progress)}%` : '0%'} &middot;
              Completed: {summary.completed_tasks || 0} of {summary.total_tasks || 0} tasks &middot;
              Overdue: {summary.overdue_tasks || 0} tasks
            </p>
            <ul className="note-list">
              {summary.required_tasks_remaining != null && (
                <li>Required tasks remaining: <strong>{summary.required_tasks_remaining}</strong></li>
              )}
              {summary.blocking_tasks != null && (
                <li>Blocking tasks: <strong>{summary.blocking_tasks}</strong></li>
              )}
              {summary.failed_automations != null && (
                <li>Failed automations: <strong>{summary.failed_automations}</strong></li>
              )}
              {summary.unresolved_assets != null && (
                <li>Unresolved assets: <strong>{summary.unresolved_assets}</strong></li>
              )}
              {summary.access_revocation_pending != null && (
                <li>Access revocation pending: <strong>{summary.access_revocation_pending ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</strong></li>
              )}
              {summary.account_deactivation_pending != null && (
                <li>Account deactivation pending: <strong>{summary.account_deactivation_pending ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</strong></li>
              )}
              {summary.transfer_pending != null && (
                <li>Transfer pending: <strong>{summary.transfer_pending ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</strong></li>
              )}
              {summary.missing_evidence != null && (
                <li>Missing evidence: <strong>{summary.missing_evidence}</strong></li>
              )}
            </ul>
            <p className="muted small">
              Backend readiness is authoritative. Completion is enabled only when
              the backend accepts the transition.
            </p>
          </>
        ) : (
          <p className="muted">Readiness summary unavailable.</p>
        )}
      </section>

      {/* 5. Onboarding Actions */}
      <section className="section" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
        <h3 className="section-title">Onboarding Actions</h3>
        <p className="muted small">
          Actions are gated by your role ({role ?? 'â€”'}) and the case's current
          status. The backend remains authoritative for all transitions.
        </p>
        <div className="action-grid" style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(180px, 1fr))', gap: 'var(--sp-1)', marginTop: 'var(--sp-1)' }}>
          {Object.entries(actions).map(([actionKey, allowed]) => {
            if (!allowed || isTerminal) return null;
            const isOnboardingOnly = (actionKey === 'mark_ready' || actionKey === 'confirm_start') && c.case_type !== 'onboarding';
            if (isOnboardingOnly) return null;
            const needsReason = isActionReasonRequired(actionKey);
            const reasonField = needsReason ? (
              confirming === actionKey && (
                <Field label="Reason" required error={!blockReason && !cancelReason ? 'A reason is required.' : ''}>
                  <textarea className="input" rows={2}
                    value={actionKey === 'block' ? blockReason : cancelReason}
                    onChange={actionKey === 'block' ? handleBlockChange : handleCancelChange}
                    placeholder={`Reason for ${getActionLabel(actionKey).toLowerCase()}â€¦`}
                    disabled={actionBusy[actionKey]}
                  />
                </Field>
              )
            ) : null;
            return (
              <div key={actionKey} className="action-card">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className={`btn ${needsReason ? 'btn-outline' : 'btn-primary'} btn-block`}
                  onClick={() => setConfirming(actionKey)}
                  disabled={actionBusy[actionKey]}>
                  {actionBusy[actionKey] ? 'Workingâ€¦' : getActionLabel(actionKey)}
                </button>
                {confirming === actionKey && (
                  <div className="action-confirm" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-1)' }}>
                    {reasonField}
                    <div className="row-end" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-1)' }}>
                      <button type="button" className="btn-ghost btn-small" onClick={() => setConfirming(null)}>
                        Cancel
                      </button>
                      <button type="button" className="btn-primary btn-small" onClick={() => runTransition(actionKey)} disabled={actionBusy[actionKey]}>
                        Confirm
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
          {Object.keys(actions).length === 0 || isTerminal && (
            <p className="muted">No actions available for this case in its current status.</p>
          )}
        </div>
      </section>

      <style>{`
        .lifecycle-detail .detail-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 170px 1fr; gap: var(--sp-1) var(--sp-2); margin: var(--sp-2) 0; }
        .lifecycle-detail .detail-grid dt { margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: #495057; }
        .lifecycle-detail .detail-grid dd { margin: 0 0 var(--sp-1) 0; padding: 0; }
        .lifecycle-detail .kpi-grid { display: flex; gap: var(--sp-1); }
        .lifecycle-detail .kpi-card { flex: 1; background: #f8f9fa; padding: var(--sp-2); border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #dee2e6; }
        .lifecycle-detail .kpi-value { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; color: #0d6efd; }
        .lifecycle-detail .kpi-label { font-size: 0.85rem; color: #6c757d; }
        .lifecycle-detail .action-card { border: 1px solid #dee2e6; border-radius: 6px; padding: var(--sp-1); background: #fff; }
        .lifecycle-detail .action-card button.btn-block { width: 100%; }
        .lifecycle-detail .action-confirm { padding: var(--sp-1); background: #f8f9fa; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px dashed #ced4da; }
        .lifecycle-detail .history-item { padding: var(--sp-1) 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee; }
        .lifecycle-detail .t-note { margin-top: var(--sp-05); font-size: 0.9rem; }
        .lifecycle-detail .pre-wrap { white-space: pre-wrap; }
      `}</style>
    </div>
  );
}



===== src\pages\lifecycle\LifecycleForm.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import {
  ErrorSummary, Field, PageHeader, UserSelect,
} from '../../components';
import { fieldMsg, parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';
import {
  CASE_TYPE_LABELS, PRIORITY_LABELS,
  RESPONSIBILITY_LABELS, CATEGORY_LABELS, DEFAULT_ASSIGNEE_ROLE_LABELS,
  formatDate,
} from '../../shared/lifecycle-utils';
// Re-exported label maps used by the wizard steps.
export {
  CASE_TYPE_LABELS, PRIORITY_LABELS, RESPONSIBILITY_LABELS,
  CATEGORY_LABELS, DEFAULT_ASSIGNEE_ROLE_LABELS,
};

const STEP_TITLES = {
  1: 'Case Basics',
  2: 'Dates & Organization',
  3: 'Checklist Preview',
  4: 'Review & Create',
};

const DEFAULT_FORM = {
  case_type: '',
  employee: '',
  template_id: '',
  priority: 'medium',
  planned_date: '',
  effective_date: '',
  completion_target: '',
  department: '',
  assigned_coordinator: '',
  new_department: '',
  notes: '',
};

export function LifecycleForm() {
  const { isEmployee } = useAuth();
  const [step, setStep] = useState(1);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ ...DEFAULT_FORM });
  const [templates, setTemplates] = useState([]);
  const [templateItems, setTemplateItems] = useState([]);
  const [employees, setEmployees] = useState([]);
  const [departments, setDepartments] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState('');
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState({});
  const [globalError, setGlobalError] = useState('');
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [okMsg, setOkMsg] = useState('');
  const [editCaseId, setEditCaseId] = useState(null);

  // Parse ?edit=<id> from hash for draft editing.
  useEffect(() => {
    const m = location.hash.match(/[?&]edit=(\d+)/);
    if (m && !editCaseId) setEditCaseId(m[1]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
  }, [editCaseId]);

  const loadLookup = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setLoadError('');
    try {
      const [tRes, eRes, dRes] = await Promise.all([
        api.get('/lifecycle/templates/', { params: { page_size: 100 } }),
        api.get('/accounts/users/', { params: { page_size: 100 } }),
        api.get('/accounts/departments/', { params: { page_size: 100 } }),
      ]);
      setTemplates(tRes.data.results ?? tRes.data ?? []);
      setEmployees((eRes.data.results ?? eRes.data ?? []).filter(
        (u) => u.is_active !== false && u.is_deleted !== true));
      setDepartments((dRes.data.results ?? dRes.data ?? []).filter(
        (d) => d.is_active !== false && d.is_deleted !== true));
    } catch (e) {
      setLoadError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not load lookup data.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isEmployee) {
      setLoadError('Employees cannot create lifecycle cases.'); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
      setLoading(false); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
      return;
    }
    loadLookup();
  }, []); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  const loadTemplateItems = async (templateId) => {
    if (!templateId) { setTemplateItems([]); return; }
    try {
      const r = await api.get('/lifecycle/template-items/', {
        params: { template: templateId, page_size: 100 },
      });
      setTemplateItems(r.data.results ?? r.data ?? []);
    } catch {
      setTemplateItems([]);
    }
  };

  const isTransfer = form.case_type === 'transfer';

  const selectedTemplate = templates.find((t) => String(t.id) === String(form.template_id));
  const selectedEmployee = employees.find((e) => String(e.id) === String(form.employee));
  const selectedDepartment = departments.find((d) => String(d.id) === String(form.department));

  // ---- Step navigation ----
  const nextStep = () => { if (step < 4) setStep((s) => s + 1); };
  const prevStep = () => { if (step > 1) setStep((s) => s - 1); };

  // ---- Step 1 validation ----
  const step1Valid = () => {
    const errs = {};
    if (!form.case_type) errs.case_type = 'Case type is required.';
    if (!form.employee) errs.employee = 'Employee is required.';
    else if (selectedEmployee && selectedEmployee.is_deleted) {
      errs.employee = 'Selected employee is not active.';
    }
    if (!form.template_id) errs.template_id = 'Template is required.';
    else if (selectedTemplate && selectedTemplate.case_type !== form.case_type) {
      errs.template_id = 'Template case type does not match the selected case type.';
    }
    if (!form.priority) errs.priority = 'Priority is required.';
    return errs;
  };

  // ---- Step 2 validation ----
  const step2Valid = () => {
    const errs = {};
    if (isTransfer && !form.new_department) {
      errs.new_department = 'A new department is required for transfers.';
    }
    if (form.planned_date && form.effective_date && form.effective_date < form.planned_date) {
      errs.effective_date = 'Effective date should not precede the planned date.';
    }
    if (form.completion_target && form.planned_date && form.completion_target < form.planned_date) {
      errs.completion_target = 'Completion target should not precede the planned date.';
    }
    return errs;
  };

  const canProceed = (s) => {
    const v = s === 1 ? step1Valid() : s === 2 ? step2Valid() : {};
    return Object.keys(v).length === 0;
  };

  const submit = async (ev) => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    if (submitting) return;
    const v = step1Valid();
    if (Object.keys(v).length) { setFieldErrors(v); return; }
    setFieldErrors({});
    setGlobalError('');
    setOkMsg('');
    setSubmitting(true);

    const payload = {
      template_id: Number(form.template_id),
      employee: Number(form.employee),
      priority: form.priority,
      department: form.department ? Number(form.department) : null,
      planned_date: form.planned_date || null,
      effective_date: form.effective_date || null,
      completion_target: form.completion_target || null,
      source: 'manual',
      source_reference: '',
      notes: form.notes || '',
      assigned_coordinator: form.assigned_coordinator ? Number(form.assigned_coordinator) : null,
    };

    try {
      const r = await api.post('/lifecycle/cases/', payload);
      setOkMsg(`Case ${r.data.case_number} created.`);
      setSubmitting(false);
      setTimeout(() => { location.hash = `#/lifecycle/${r.data.id}`; }, 600);
    } catch (e) {
      const p = parseApiError(e);
      setFieldErrors(p.fields);
      setGlobalError(p.global || 'Could not create the case.');
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <p className="page-loading" role="status">
        <span className="spinner" aria-hidden="true" />Loading case creation formâ€¦
      </p>
    );
  }
  if (loadError && !templates.length) {
    return (
      <div className="form-wrap">
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{loadError}</div>
        <p><a className="back-link" href="#/lifecycle">â† Back to Lifecycle</a></p>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (isEmployee) {
    return (
      <div className="form-wrap">
        <h1>New Lifecycle Case</h1>
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">
          Case creation is not available to employees. Only IT staff and above
          can create lifecycle cases.
        </div>
        <p><a className="back-link" href="#/lifecycle">â† Back to Lifecycle</a></p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const progressPct = (step - 1) / 3 * 100;

  return (
    <div className="lifecycle-form">
      <PageHeader
        title={`New Lifecycle Case â€” Step ${step} of 4`}
        sub={STEP_TITLES[step]}
        actions={
          <div className="row-gap" style={{ alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--sp-1)' }}>
            <span className="muted small">{Math.round(progressPct)}% complete</span>
          </div>
        }
      />
      {globalError && <ErrorSummary parsed={{ global: globalError }} />}
      {okMsg && <div className="success-summary" role="status">{okMsg}</div>}

      {/* Step indicator */}
      <div className="stepper" role="navigation" aria-label="Wizard steps">
        {[1, 2, 3, 4].map((n) => (
          <div key={n} className={`step ${n === step ? 'current' : n < step ? 'done' : 'todo'}`}>
            <span className="step-badge">{n}</span>
            <span className="step-label">{STEP_TITLES[n]}</span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <form onSubmit={submit} noValidate>
        {/* ===== STEP 1: Case Basics ===== */}
        <div className={`wizard-step ${step === 1 ? '' : 'hidden'}`}>
          <Field label="Case Type" required error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'case_type')}>
            <select className="input" data-testid="case-type-select" value={form.case_type} onChange={(e) => {
              setForm((f) => ({ ...f, case_type: e.target.value, template_id: '', department: '' }));
            }} disabled={submitting}>
              <option value="">Select a case typeâ€¦</option>
              {Object.entries(CASE_TYPE_LABELS).map(([v, l]) => (
                <option key={v} value={v}>{l}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="Employee" required error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'employee')}>
            <UserSelect value={form.employee} onChange={(val) => {
              const id = val != null ? Number(val) : '';
              setForm((f) => ({ ...f, employee: id }));
            }} disabled={submitting} label="Select the employee this case is for" />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Template" required error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'template_id')}>
            <select className="input" data-testid="template-select" value={form.template_id} onChange={(e) => {
              const id = e.target.value ? Number(e.target.value) : '';
              setForm((f) => ({ ...f, template_id: id }));
              loadTemplateItems(id);
            }} disabled={submitting}>
              <option value="">Select a templateâ€¦</option>
              {templates.filter((t) => !form.case_type || t.case_type === form.case_type)
                .filter((t) => t.is_active !== false && t.is_deleted !== true)
                .map((t) => (
                  <option key={t.id} value={t.id}>
                    {t.code} â€” {t.name} ({t.item_count || 0} items)
                  </option>
                ))}
            </select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="Priority" required error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'priority')}>
            <select className="input" value={form.priority} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, priority: e.target.value }))} disabled={submitting}>
              {Object.entries(PRIORITY_LABELS).map(([v, l]) => (
                <option key={v} value={v}>{l}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </Field>
          {Object.keys(step1Valid()).length && (
            <div className="field-error" role="alert">
              Please fix the errors above before continuing.
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* ===== STEP 2: Dates & Organization ===== */}
        <div className={`wizard-step ${step === 2 ? '' : 'hidden'}`}>
          <Field label="Planned Date">
            <input className="input" type="date" value={form.planned_date || ''}
              onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, planned_date: e.target.value }))} disabled={submitting} />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Effective Date">
            <input className="input" type="date" value={form.effective_date || ''}
              onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, effective_date: e.target.value }))} disabled={submitting} />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Completion Target">
            <input className="input" type="date" value={form.completion_target || ''}
              onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, completion_target: e.target.value }))} disabled={submitting} />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Department">
            <select className="input" value={form.department || ''} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, department: e.target.value || null }))} disabled={submitting}>
              <option value="">Same as employee home department</option>
              {departments.map((d) => (
                <option key={d.id} value={d.id}>{d.name}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="Coordinator">
            <UserSelect value={form.assigned_coordinator} onChange={(id) => {
              setForm((f) => ({ ...f, assigned_coordinator: id != null ? Number(id) : '' }));
            }} disabled={submitting} label="Case coordinator" />
          </Field>
          {isTransfer && (
            <>
              <Field label="Previous Department" hint="Read-only â€” employee's current home department.">
                <input className="input" value={selectedEmployee?.home_department_name || ''} readOnly disabled={true} />
              </Field>
              <Field label="New Department" required error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'new_department')}>
                <select className="input" value={form.new_department || ''} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, new_department: e.target.value || null }))} disabled={submitting}>
                  <option value="">Select a new departmentâ€¦</option>
                  {departments.map((d) => (
                    <option key={d.id} value={d.id}>{d.name}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
                {selectedEmployee && selectedDepartment && String(selectedDepartment.id) === String(form.new_department) && (
                  <div className="field-error" role="alert">
                    The new department must differ from the employee's current department.
                  </div>
                )}
              </Field>
            </>
          )}
          {Object.keys(step2Valid()).length && (
            <div className="field-error" role="alert">
              Please fix the errors above before continuing.
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* ===== STEP 3: Checklist Preview ===== */}
        <div className={`wizard-step ${step === 3 ? '' : 'hidden'}`}>
          <p className="muted small">
            Tasks below are copied from the selected template at case creation.
            They are read-only in O2.1; task management comes in O2.2.
          </p>
          {selectedTemplate && templateItems.length ? (
            <div>
              <table className="grid" style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse' }}>
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>Seq.</th>
                    <th style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>Title</th>
                    <th style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>Category</th>
                    <th style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>Responsibility</th>
                    <th style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>Default Assignee</th>
                    <th style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>Required</th>
                    <th style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>Blocks Completion</th>
                    <th style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>Evidence</th>
                    <th style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>Due Offset</th>
                    <th style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>Automation</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {templateItems.map((t) => (
                    <tr key={t.id} style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid #ddd' }}>
                      <td>{t.sequence}</td>
                      <td>{t.title}</td>
                      <td>{CATEGORY_LABELS[t.category] ?? t.category}</td>
                      <td>{RESPONSIBILITY_LABELS[t.responsibility] ?? t.responsibility}</td>
                      <td>{DEFAULT_ASSIGNEE_ROLE_LABELS[t.default_assignee_role] ?? t.default_assignee_role}</td>
                      <td>{t.required ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</td>
                      <td>{t.blocks_completion ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</td>
                      <td>{t.requires_evidence ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</td>
                      <td>{t.due_offset_days != null ? `${t.due_offset_days} days` : 'â€”'}</td>
                      <td>{t.automation_type === 'none' ? 'None' : t.automation_type.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
              <div className="table-summary">
                <p className="muted small">
                  Total tasks: {templateItems.length} &middot;
                  Required: {templateItems.filter((t) => t.required).length} &middot;
                  Blocking: {templateItems.filter((t) => t.blocks_completion).length} &middot;
                  Evidence required: {templateItems.filter((t) => t.requires_evidence).length}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (!selectedTemplate && form.template_id ? (
            <p className="muted">No checklist items found for this template.</p>
          ) : (
            <p className="muted">Select a template on Step 1 to preview its checklist.</p>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* ===== STEP 4: Review ===== */}
        <div className={`wizard-step ${step === 4 ? '' : 'hidden'}`}>
          <dl className="detail-grid">
            <dt>Case Type</dt><dd>{CASE_TYPE_LABELS[form.case_type] ?? form.case_type}</dd>
            <dt>Employee</dt><dd>{selectedEmployee ? `${selectedEmployee.employee_id} â€” ${selectedEmployee.email}` : 'â€”'}</dd>
            <dt>Template</dt><dd>{selectedTemplate ? `${selectedTemplate.code} â€” ${selectedTemplate.name}` : 'â€”'}</dd>
            <dt>Priority</dt><dd>{PRIORITY_LABELS[form.priority] ?? form.priority}</dd>
            <dt>Planned Date</dt><dd>{formatDate(form.planned_date)}</dd>
            <dt>Effective Date</dt><dd>{formatDate(form.effective_date)}</dd>
            <dt>Completion Target</dt><dd>{formatDate(form.completion_target)}</dd>
            <dt>Department</dt><dd>{selectedDepartment ? selectedDepartment.name : 'Employee home department'}</dd>
            <dt>Coordinator</dt><dd>{form.assigned_coordinator ? String(form.assigned_coordinator) : 'Unassigned'}</dd>
            {isTransfer && <><dt>New Department</dt><dd>{form.new_department ? String(form.new_department) : 'â€”'}</dd></>}
            <dt>Task Count</dt><dd>{templateItems.length}</dd>
            <dt>Required Tasks</dt><dd>{templateItems.filter((t) => t.required).length}</dd>
            <dt>Blocking Tasks</dt><dd>{templateItems.filter((t) => t.blocks_completion).length}</dd>
            <dt>Evidence Requirements</dt><dd>{templateItems.filter((t) => t.requires_evidence).length} task(s) require evidence</dd>
            <dt>Automation Warnings</dt>
            <dd>
              {templateItems.some((t) => t.automation_type !== 'none')
                ? 'Some tasks have automation configured. Automations run server-side when tasks complete.'
                : 'No automation configured.'}
            </dd>
          </dl>
          <div className="alert alert-info" role="status">
            <strong>Read-only fields:</strong> case number, status, progress, and
            version are set by the server and cannot be specified in this form.
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="row-end" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
          {step > 1 && (
            <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={prevStep} disabled={submitting}>
              â† Back
            </button>
          )}
          {step < 4 ? (
            <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={() => {
              if (canProceed(step)) nextStep();
            }} disabled={submitting || !canProceed(step)}>
              {step === 3 ? 'Review' : 'Next'}
            </button>
          ) : (
            <>
              <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={prevStep} disabled={submitting}>
                â† Back
              </button>
              <button type="submit" className="btn-primary" disabled={submitting}>
                {submitting ? 'Creatingâ€¦' : 'Create Case'}
              </button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </form>

      <style>{`
        .lifecycle-form .hidden { display: none; }
        .lifecycle-form .stepper { display: flex; gap: var(--sp-1); margin: var(--sp-2) 0; }
        .lifecycle-form .step { flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--sp-05); font-size: 0.9rem; }
        .lifecycle-form .step-badge { width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 600; flex-shrink: 0; }
        .lifecycle-form .step.todo .step-badge { background: #e9ecef; color: #6c757d; border: 1px solid #ced4da; }
        .lifecycle-form .step.done .step-badge { background: #198754; color: #fff; }
        .lifecycle-form .step.current .step-badge { background: #0d6efd; color: #fff; }
        .lifecycle-form .step.done .step-label { color: #6c757d; text-decoration: line-through; }
        .lifecycle-form .step.current .step-label { color: #0d6efd; font-weight: 600; }
        .lifecycle-form .detail-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 180px 1fr; gap: var(--sp-1) var(--sp-2); margin: var(--sp-2) 0; }
        .lifecycle-form .detail-grid dt { margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: #495057; }
        .lifecycle-form .detail-grid dd { margin: 0 0 var(--sp-1) 0; padding: 0; }
        .wizard-step { margin-top: var(--sp-2); }
      `}</style>
    </div>
  );
}

export const MAINTENANCE_TYPES = [ // eslint-disable-line react/only-export-components
  ['preventive', 'Preventive'],
  ['corrective', 'Corrective'],
  ['inspection', 'Inspection'],
  ['upgrade', 'Upgrade'],

export const MAINTENANCE_STATUSES = [ // eslint-disable-line react/only-export-components

  ['in_progress', 'In progress'],
