function toLocalInput(iso) {
  if (!iso) return '';
  const d = new Date(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
  const pad = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}T${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}`;
}

function fromLocalInput(value) {
  if (!value) return null;
  const d = new Date(value);
  return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d.toISOString();
}

function defaultScheduled() {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setMinutes(0, 0, 0);
  return toLocalInput(d.toISOString());
}

const fmtDateTime = (v) => (v ? new Date(v).toLocaleString() : 'â€”');
const fmtMoney = (v) => {
  const n = Number(v);
  return Number.isFinite(n)
    ? n.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })
    : String(v);
};

/**
 * Create/edit maintenance record. Pass `asset` to lock the asset (used from
 * the asset detail page) or `record` to edit an existing maintenance.
 */
export function MaintenanceFormModal({ asset = null, record = null, onClose, onSaved }) {
  const isEdit = !!record;
  const [form, setForm] = useState(() => ({
    asset: asset?.id ?? record?.asset ?? '',
    title: record?.title ?? '',
    maintenance_type: record?.maintenance_type ?? 'preventive',
    status: record?.status ?? 'scheduled',
    scheduled_date: toLocalInput(record?.scheduled_date) || defaultScheduled(),
    start_date: toLocalInput(record?.start_date),
    completion_date: toLocalInput(record?.completion_date),
    assigned_to: record?.assigned_to ?? '',
    vendor: record?.vendor ?? '',
    cost: record?.cost ?? '',
    description: record?.description ?? '',
    resolution_notes: record?.resolution_notes ?? '',
  }));
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState({});

  const set = (k) => (v) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [k]: v }));

  const submit = async (ev) => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    if (busy) return;
    setError('');
    setFieldErrors({});
    // ... validation
    const payload = {
      asset: form.asset === '' ? null : Number(form.asset),
      title: form.title.trim(),
      maintenance_type: form.maintenance_type,
      status: form.status,
      scheduled_date: fromLocalInput(form.scheduled_date),
      start_date: fromLocalInput(form.start_date),
      completion_date: fromLocalInput(form.completion_date),
      assigned_to: form.assigned_to === '' ? null : Number(form.assigned_to),
      vendor: form.vendor.trim(),
      cost: form.cost === '' ? null : form.cost,
      resolution_notes: form.resolution_notes.trim(),
    };
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      if (isEdit) {
        await api.patch(`/assets/maintenance/${record.id}/`, payload);
      } else {
        await api.post('/assets/maintenance/', payload);
      }
      onSaved?.();
      onClose();  // Always close on success - busy state is managed separately
    } catch (e) {
      const p = parseApiError(e);
      setFieldErrors(p.fields);
      setError(p.global);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      title={isEdit ? `Update maintenance â€” ${record.title}` : 'Schedule maintenance'}
      onClose={() => onClose()}
      size="lg"
    >
      <form onSubmit={submit} noValidate>
        {error && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>}
        <div className="form-grid">
          <Field label="Asset" required error={fieldErrors.asset}>
            {asset ? (
              <input className="input" value={`${asset.asset_tag} â€” ${asset.name}`} disabled />
            ) : (
              <AssetSelect value={form.asset} onChange={set('asset')} disabled={busy || isEdit} />
            )}
          </Field>
          <Field label="Title" required error={fieldErrors.title}>
            <input
              className="input" value={form.title} maxLength={200}
              onChange={(e) => set('title')(e.target.value)} disabled={busy}
              placeholder="e.g. Replace thermal paste"
            />
          </Field>
        </div>
        <div className="form-grid">
          <Field label="Type" error={fieldErrors.maintenance_type}>
            <select className="input" value={form.maintenance_type}
              onChange={(e) => set('maintenance_type')(e.target.value)} disabled={busy}>
              {MAINTENANCE_TYPES.map(([v, l]) => <option key={v} value={v}>{l}</option>)}
            </select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="Status" error={fieldErrors.status}>
            <select className="input" value={form.status}
              onChange={(e) => set('status')(e.target.value)} disabled={busy}>
              {MAINTENANCE_STATUSES.map(([v, l]) => <option key={v} value={v}>{l}</option>)}
            </select>
          </Field>
        </div>
        <div className="form-grid">
          <Field label="Scheduled date" required error={fieldErrors.scheduled_date}>
            <input className="input" type="datetime-local" value={form.scheduled_date}
              onChange={(e) => set('scheduled_date')(e.target.value)} disabled={busy} />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Technician" error={fieldErrors.assigned_to}>
            <UserSelect value={form.assigned_to} onChange={set('assigned_to')} disabled={busy} label="Technician" />
          </Field>
        </div>
        <div className="form-grid">
          <Field label="Start date" error={fieldErrors.start_date}>
            <input className="input" type="datetime-local" value={form.start_date}
              onChange={(e) => set('start_date')(e.target.value)} disabled={busy} />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Completion date" error={fieldErrors.completion_date}
            hint="Required when the status is completed.">
            <input className="input" type="datetime-local" value={form.completion_date}
              onChange={(e) => set('completion_date')(e.target.value)} disabled={busy} />
          </Field>
        </div>
        <div className="form-grid">
          <Field label="Vendor" error={fieldErrors.vendor}>
            <input className="input" value={form.vendor} maxLength={200}
              onChange={(e) => set('vendor')(e.target.value)} disabled={busy} placeholder="External provider (optional)" />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Cost" error={fieldErrors.cost}>
            <input className="input" type="number" step="0.01" min="0" value={form.cost}
              onChange={(e) => set('cost')(e.target.value)} disabled={busy} placeholder="0.00" />
          </Field>
        </div>
        <Field label="Description" error={fieldErrors.description}>
          <textarea className="input" rows={2} value={form.description}
            onChange={(e) => set('description')(e.target.value)} disabled={busy} />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Resolution notes" error={fieldErrors.resolution_notes}
          hint="What was done, parts used, follow-up needed.">
          <textarea className="input" rows={2} value={form.resolution_notes}
            onChange={(e) => set('resolution_notes')(e.target.value)} disabled={busy} />
        </Field>
        <div className="row-end">
          <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={onClose} disabled={busy}>Cancel</button>
          <button type="submit" className="btn-primary" disabled={busy}>
            {busy ? 'Savingâ€¦' : isEdit ? 'Save maintenance' : 'Schedule maintenance'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}

function buildMaintenanceUrl(filters) {
  const p = new URLSearchParams();
  for (const k of ['q', 'status', 'maintenance_type']) {
    if (filters[k]) p.set(k, filters[k]);
  }
  if (filters.open) p.set('open', 'true');
  p.set('page_size', '50');
  return `/assets/maintenance/?${p.toString()}`;
}

export function Maintenance() {
  const { isStaff } = useAuth();
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [count, setCount] = useState(null);
  const [next, setNext] = useState(null);
  const [previous, setPrevious] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');
  const [f, setF] = useState({ q: '', status: '', maintenance_type: '', open: false });
  const [modal, setModal] = useState(null); // {asset?, record?}
  const [exportOpen, setExportOpen] = useState(false);
  const [busyRow, setBusyRow] = useState(null);
  const [cancelTarget, setCancelTarget] = useState(null);

  const url = useMemo(() => buildMaintenanceUrl(f), [f]);

  const load = async (target = url) => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const pg = await fetchPage(target);
      setItems(pg.items);
      setCount(pg.count);
      setNext(pg.next);
      setPrevious(pg.previous);
    } catch {
      setError('Could not load maintenance records.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => { load(url); }, [url]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, react/set-state-in-effect

  const start = async (m) => {
    setBusyRow(m.id);
    setMsg('');
    setError('');
    try {
      await api.patch(`/assets/maintenance/${m.id}/`, { status: 'in_progress' });
      setMsg(`Maintenance "${m.title}" started.`);
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not start maintenance.');
    } finally {
      setBusyRow(null);
    }
  };

  const cancel = async () => {
    if (!cancelTarget) return;
    setBusyRow(cancelTarget.id);
    setMsg('');
    setError('');
    try {
      await api.patch(`/assets/maintenance/${cancelTarget.id}/`, { status: 'cancelled' });
      setMsg(`Maintenance "${cancelTarget.title}" cancelled.`);
      setCancelTarget(null);
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not cancel maintenance.');
      setCancelTarget(null);
    } finally {
      setBusyRow(null);
    }
  };

  if (!isStaff) {
    return <div className="error-summary" role="alert">Only IT staff can manage asset maintenance.</div>;
  }

  const columns = [
    { key: 'asset', label: 'Asset', render: (m) => (
      <a className="row-title" href={`#/assets/${m.asset}`}>{m.asset_tag}</a>
    ) },
    { key: 'title', label: 'Maintenance', render: (m) => (
      <span className="ellipsis" title={m.title}>{m.title}</span>
    ) },
    { key: 'maintenance_type', label: 'Type', render: (m) => (
      <span className="muted small">{m.maintenance_type?.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</span>
    ) },
    { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (m) => (
      <span className="row-gap" style={{ gap: 'var(--sp-1)', alignItems: 'center' }}>
        <Badge kind="status" value={m.status} />
        {m.is_overdue && m.status !== 'overdue' && <Badge kind="status" value="overdue" label="Overdue" />}
      </span>
    ) },
    { key: 'scheduled_date', label: 'Scheduled', render: (m) => fmtDateTime(m.scheduled_date) },
    { key: 'assigned_to', label: 'Technician', render: (m) => m.assigned_to_email || <span className="cell-muted">â€”</span> },
    { key: 'vendor', label: 'Vendor', render: (m) => m.vendor || <span className="cell-muted">â€”</span> },
    { key: 'cost', label: 'Cost', render: (m) => (m.cost != null ? fmtMoney(m.cost) : <span className="cell-muted">â€”</span>) },
    { key: 'completion_date', label: 'Completed', render: (m) => (m.completion_date ? fmtDateTime(m.completion_date) : <span className="cell-muted">â€”</span>) },
    { key: 'actions', label: 'Actions', thClass: 'table-actions', render: (m) => (
      <span className="row-gap" style={{ gap: 'var(--sp-1)' }}>
        {['scheduled', 'overdue'].includes(m.status) && (
          <button type="button" className="btn-small" disabled={busyRow === m.id}
            onClick={() => start(m)}>Start</button>
        )}
        {!['completed', 'cancelled'].includes(m.status) && (
          <button type="button" className="btn-small" disabled={busyRow === m.id}
            onClick={() => setModal({ record: m })}>Updateâ€¦</button>
        )}
        {['scheduled', 'in_progress', 'overdue'].includes(m.status) && (
          <button type="button" className="btn-small btn-danger" disabled={busyRow === m.id}
            onClick={() => setCancelTarget(m)}>Cancelâ€¦</button>
        )}
      </span>
    ) },
  ];

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Asset maintenance"
        sub={count != null ? `${count} maintenance ${count === 1 ? 'record' : 'records'}` : undefined}
        actions={<>
          <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={() => setModal({})}>+ Schedule maintenance</button>
          <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={() => setExportOpen(true)}>Exportâ€¦</button>
        </>}
      />
      {exportOpen && (
        <ExportDialog
          dataset="maintenance" open={exportOpen}
          filterParams={{ q: f.q, status: f.status, maintenance_type: f.maintenance_type }}
          onClose={() => setExportOpen(false)}
        />
      )}
      {error && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>}
      {msg && <div className="success-summary" role="status">{msg}</div>}
      <div className="filter-bar" role="search">
        <input
          className="input grow" value={f.q}
          onChange={(e) => setF((prev) => ({ ...prev, q: e.target.value }))}
          placeholder="Search title, asset tag, vendorâ€¦" aria-label="Search maintenance"
        />
        <select className="input" value={f.status}
          onChange={(e) => setF((prev) => ({ ...prev, status: e.target.value }))}
          aria-label="Filter by maintenance status">
          <option value="">All statuses</option>
          {MAINTENANCE_STATUSES.map(([v, l]) => <option key={v} value={v}>{l}</option>)}
        </select>
        <select className="input" value={f.maintenance_type}
          onChange={(e) => setF((prev) => ({ ...prev, maintenance_type: e.target.value }))}
          aria-label="Filter by maintenance type">
          <option value="">All types</option>
          {MAINTENANCE_TYPES.map(([v, l]) => <option key={v} value={v}>{l}</option>)}
        </select>
        <label className="check-row" style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>
          <input type="checkbox" checked={f.open}
            onChange={(e) => setF((prev) => ({ ...prev, open: e.target.checked }))} />
          Open only
        </label>
      </div>
      <div className="panel">
        {loading ? <div className="panel-pad"><LoadingRows n={6} /></div>
          : (
            <>
              <DataTable
                columns={columns} rows={items} keyOf={(m) => m.id}
                emptyTitle="No maintenance records match."
                emptyHint="Schedule maintenance for an asset, or clear the filters."
              />
              <Pager
                count={count} hasNext={!!next} hasPrev={!!previous} busy={loading}
                onPrev={() => previous && load(previous)}
                onNext={() => next && load(next)}
              />
            </>
          )}
      </div>
      <p className="page-footnote">
        Assets with open maintenance cannot be assigned until the maintenance is completed or cancelled.
      </p>
      {modal && (
        <MaintenanceFormModal
          asset={modal.asset ?? null}
          record={modal.record ?? null}
          onClose={() => setModal(null)}
          onSaved={() => load()}
        />
      )}
      {cancelTarget && (
        <ConfirmDialog
          title={`Cancel maintenance "${cancelTarget.title}"?`}
          message="The record is kept for history; the asset can be assigned again once no other maintenance is open."
          confirmLabel="Cancel maintenance" danger busy={busyRow === cancelTarget.id}
          onConfirm={cancel}
          onCancel={() => setCancelTarget(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}



===== src\pages\maintenance\MaintenanceWindows.jsx =====

/*
 * Maintenance Windows - maintenance window management
 * Route: #/maintenance-windows
 */

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { PageHeader, Row, Col, Badge, Button } from '../../components';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import api from '../../api';
import { fetchPage, parseApiError } from '../../shared/changes-utils';
import { formatDateTime } from '../../shared/changes-utils';

const WINDOW_TYPE_LABELS = {
  scheduled: 'Scheduled',
  emergency: 'Emergency',
};

export function MaintenanceWindows() {
  const { isManagerOrAdmin } = useAuth();
  const [windows, setWindows] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isManagerOrAdmin) {
      setWindows([]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
      setLoading(false); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
      return;
    }
    fetchPage(`/changes/maintenance-windows/`)
      .then((data) => {
        setWindows(data.items ?? data);
        setLoading(false);
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        setError(parseApiError(e));
        setLoading(false);
      });
  }, [isManagerOrAdmin]);

  const toggleStatus = async (w) => {
    if (saving) return;
    if (!confirm(`${w.status === 'active' ? 'Deactivate' : 'Reactivate'} maintenance window "${w.name}"?`)) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await api.patch(`/changes/maintenance-windows/${w.id}/`, { status: w.status === 'active' ? 'inactive' : 'active' });
      setMsg(`Maintenance window "${w.name}" ${w.status === 'active' ? 'deactivated' : 'reactivated'}.`);
      const updated = windows.map((x) => x.id === w.id ? { ...x, status: w.status === 'active' ? 'inactive' : 'active' } : x);
      setWindows(updated);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="mt-3"><p>Loading maintenance windowsâ€¦</p></div>;
  }

  if (error) {
    return <div className="mt-3"><p className="text-danger">Error: {error.global ?? 'Unknown error'}</p></div>;
  }

  const msgEl = msg ? <div className="success-summary" role="status">{msg}</div> : null;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Maintenance Windows" />
      {msgEl}
      <div className="mt-3">
        <p><strong>Total Windows:</strong> {windows.length}</p>
        {windows.length === 0 ? (
          <p>No maintenance windows found</p>
        ) : (
          <div>
            {windows.map((w) => (
              <div key={w.id} className="mt-3 p-2 border rounded">
                <Row>
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Name:</strong> {w.name}</Col>
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Code:</strong> {w.code}</Col>
                </Row>
                <Row className="mt-1">
                  <Col sm={12}><strong>Description:</strong> {w.description}</Col>
                </Row>
                <Row className="mt-1">
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Type:</strong> {WINDOW_TYPE_LABELS[w.window_type] ?? w.window_type}</Col>
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Status:</strong> <Badge kind="status" value={w.status} /></Col>
                </Row>
                <Row className="mt-1">
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Start:</strong> {formatDateTime(w.start_at)}</Col>
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>End:</strong> {formatDateTime(w.end_at)}</Col>
                </Row>
                <Row className="mt-1">
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Timezone:</strong> {w.timezone_name ?? 'UTC'}</Col>
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Recurrence:</strong> {w.recurrence_rule ?? 'None'}</Col>
                </Row>
                <Row className="mt-1">
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Department:</strong> {w.department ?? 'â€”'}</Col>
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Service:</strong> {w.service ?? 'â€”'}</Col>
                </Row>
                <Row className="mt-1">
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Max Parallel Changes:</strong> {w.maximum_parallel_changes ?? 1}</Col>
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Blackout:</strong> {w.blackout ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</Col>
                </Row>
                <Row className="mt-1">
                  <Col sm={12}>
                    {isManagerOrAdmin && (
                      <Button variant={w.status === 'active' ? 'danger' : 'success'} onClick={() => toggleStatus(w)} disabled={saving}>
                        {w.status === 'active' ? 'Deactivate' : 'Reactivate'}
                      </Button>
                    )}
                  </Col>
                </Row>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { Badge, DataTable, Field, Modal, PageHeader } from '../../components';
import { fetchPage, parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';
import { canAccessMonitoring, canAdministerMonitoring } from '../../components/monitoring/access';
import { MonitoringOverview } from '../../features/monitoring/MonitoringOverview';
import { AlertList } from '../../features/monitoring/AlertList';
import { AlertDetail } from '../../features/monitoring/AlertDetail';
import { SourceManagement } from '../../features/monitoring/SourceManagement';
import { PolicyManagement } from '../../features/monitoring/PolicyManagement';

const STATE_TONE = {
  healthy: 'green', degraded: 'amber', unavailable: 'red',
  unknown: 'gray', 'not_configured': 'gray',
};
const STATE_LABEL = {
  healthy: 'Healthy', degraded: 'Degraded', unavailable: 'Unavailable',
  unknown: 'Unknown', 'not_configured': 'Not configured',
};
const SAFE_RETRY_TASKS = new Set([
  'common.tasks.process_inbound_mailbox',
  'common.tasks.process_inbound_email_task',
  'common.tasks.run_scheduled_reports',
  'common.tasks.evaluate_retention_policies',
  'common.tasks.execute_retention_policy',
]);
/** Phase 26 â€” operational monitoring dashboard (System Admin / IT staff).
 *
 * Hash-based sub-views:
 *   #/monitoring                health dashboard
 *   #/monitoring/tasks          background task history + safe retry
 *   #/monitoring/errors         application errors
 *   #/monitoring/alerts         common operational alerts + ack/resolve
 *   #/monitoring/alerts/list    monitoring alert list unavailable state
 *   #/monitoring/alerts/:id     monitoring alert detail + supported actions
 *   #/monitoring/incidents      operational incidents
 *   #/monitoring/performance    API performance summary
 *   #/monitoring/email-storage  email & storage health
 */
export function Monitoring() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  if (!canAccessMonitoring(auth)) {
    return (
      <div>
        <div className="page-head"><h1>Operational Monitoring</h1></div>
        <div className="empty-state">
          <div className="empty-title">Access restricted</div>
          <div className="small">Operational monitoring is IT staff only.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const hash = location.hash.split('?')[0];
  const alertDetail = hash.match(/^#\/monitoring\/alerts\/([^/]+)$/);
  if (alertDetail && alertDetail[1] !== 'list') return <AlertDetail alertId={decodeURIComponent(alertDetail[1])} />;
  if (hash === '#/monitoring/alerts') return <AlertMonitor />;
  if (hash === '#/monitoring/alerts/list') return <AlertList />;
  if (hash === '#/monitoring/tasks') return <TaskMonitor />;
  if (hash === '#/monitoring/errors') return <ErrorMonitor />;
  if (hash === '#/monitoring/incidents') return <IncidentMonitor />;
  if (hash === '#/monitoring/performance') return <PerfMonitor />;
  if (hash === '#/monitoring/email-storage') return <EmailStorageMonitor />;
  if (hash === '#/monitoring/health') return <HealthMonitor />;
  if (hash === '#/monitoring/overview') return <MonitoringOverview />;
  if (hash === '#/monitoring/sources') return <SourceManagement />;
  if (hash === '#/monitoring/policies') return <PolicyManagement />;
  return <HealthDashboard />;
}

/* ---------------- Health dashboard ---------------- */

function HealthDashboard() {
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        const r = await api.get('/common/health/');
        if (!cancelled) setData(r.data);
      } catch (e) {
        if (!cancelled) setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Health check failed.');
      } finally { if (!cancelled) setLoading(false); }
    })();
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, []);

  if (loading) return (
    <>
      <div className="page-head"><h1>System Health</h1></div>

        <span className="spinner" aria-hidden="true" /> Loadingâ€¦
      </div>
    </>
  );

  const comps = data ? data.components : {};
  const overallLabel = STATE_LABEL[data?.overall ?? 'unknown'] ?? 'Unknown';
  const lastEvaluated = data?.components?.backend?.evaluated_at;

  return (
    <div>

        actions={(

              {Object.entries(comps).map(([key, c]) => (
                <tr key={key}>
                  <td>{key.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</td>

                    <Badge kind="status" value={c.state}
                           label={STATE_LABEL[c.state] ?? c.state} />
                  </td>
                  <td className="cell-muted small">{c.diagnostic || 'â€”'}</td>
                  <td className="cell-muted small">
                    {c.evaluated_at ? new Date(c.evaluated_at).toLocaleString() : 'â€”'}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="panel">
        <div className="panel-head"><h3>Quick links</h3></div>
        <div className="panel-pad" style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <a href="#/monitoring/tasks" className="btn-secondary">Background tasks</a>
          <a href="#/monitoring/errors" className="btn-secondary">Application errors</a>
          <a href="#/monitoring/alerts" className="btn-secondary">Alerts</a>
          <a href="#/monitoring/incidents" className="btn-secondary">Incidents</a>
          <a href="#/monitoring/performance" className="btn-secondary">API performance</a>
          <a href="#/monitoring/email-storage" className="btn-secondary">Email &amp; storage</a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function HealthMonitor() {
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        const r = await api.get('/common/health/results/');
        if (!cancelled) setData(r.data);
      } catch (e) {
        if (!cancelled) setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Failed to load health history.');
      } finally { if (!cancelled) setLoading(false); }
    })();
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, []);

  const rows = data || [];
  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Component health history" sub="Recent health check results."
        actions={(
          <div className="row-gap">
            <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={() => window.location.reload()}>Refresh</button>
            <a href="#/monitoring" className="btn-ghost">&larr; Back to dashboard</a>
          </div>
        )} />
      {error ? <div className="field-error" role="alert">{error}</div> : null}
      <DataTable columns={[
        { key: 'component', label: 'Component', render: (r) => r.component.replace(/_/g, ' ') },
        { key: 'state', label: 'Status', render: (r) => <Badge kind="status" value={r.state} label={STATE_LABEL[r.state] ?? r.state} /> },
        { key: 'evaluated_at', label: 'Evaluated', render: (r) => r.evaluated_at ? new Date(r.evaluated_at).toLocaleString() : 'â€”' },
        { key: 'last_success', label: 'Last success', render: (r) => r.last_successful_at ? new Date(r.last_successful_at).toLocaleString() : <span className="cell-muted">â€”</span> },
        { key: 'last_failure', label: 'Last failure', render: (r) => r.last_failure_at ? new Date(r.last_failure_at).toLocaleString() : <span className="cell-muted">â€”</span> },
        { key: 'diagnostic', label: 'Diagnostic', render: (r) => <span className="cell-muted small">{r.diagnostic || 'â€”'}</span> },
      ]} rows={rows} keyOf={(r)=>String(r.id)+r.component+(r.evaluated_at||'')}
        emptyTitle="No health check history." emptyHint="Run a health check to populate history." />
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------------- Background task monitor ---------------- */

function TaskMonitor() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [f, setF] = useState({ task_name: '', status: '' });
  const [retryBusy, setRetryBusy] = useState(null);

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true); setError('');
    try {
      const p = new URLSearchParams();
      if (f.task_name) p.set('task_name', f.task_name);
      if (f.status) p.set('status', f.status);
      p.set('limit', '100');
      const r = await api.get(`/common/tasks/?${p.toString()}`);
      setItems(r.data);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Failed to load tasks.');
    } finally { setLoading(false); }
  };
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [f.task_name, f.status]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, react/set-state-in-effect

  const retry = async (taskName) => {
    setRetryBusy(taskName);
    try {
      const r = await api.post('/common/tasks/retry_task/', { task_name: taskName });
      if (r.data.retried) {
        setError('');
        load();
      } else {
        setError(r.data.detail || 'Retry failed.');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Retry failed.');
    } finally { setRetryBusy(null); }
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Background tasks" sub="Celery task execution history and authorized retry."
        actions={(
          <div className="row-gap">
            <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={load}>Refresh</button>
            <a href="#/monitoring" className="btn-ghost">&larr; Back to dashboard</a>
          </div>
        )} />
      {error ? <div className="field-error" role="alert">{error}</div> : null}
      <div className="panel" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <div className="panel-pad" style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'end' }}>
          <Field label="Task"><input className="input input-auto" value={f.task_name} onChange={(e)=>setF({...f, task_name:e.target.value})} placeholder="e.g. common.tasks.run_scheduled_reports" /></Field>
          <Field label="Status"><select className="input" value={f.status} onChange={(e)=>setF({...f, status:e.target.value})}>
            <option value="">All</option>
            <option value="running">Running</option>
            <option value="succeeded">Succeeded</option>
            <option value="failed">Failed</option>
            <option value="skipped">Skipped</option>
          </select></Field>
          <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={load}>Filter</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <DataTable columns={[
        { key: 'task_name', label: 'Task', render: (r) => r.task_name },
        { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (r) => <Badge kind="status" value={r.status} label={r.status} /> },
        { key: 'started_at', label: 'Started', render: (r) => r.started_at ? new Date(r.started_at).toLocaleString() : 'â€”' },
        { key: 'finished_at', label: 'Finished', render: (r) => r.finished_at ? new Date(r.finished_at).toLocaleString() : <span className="cell-muted">â€”</span> },
        { key: 'success', label: 'Success', render: (r) => r.success ? <span className="badge badge-green">Yes</span> : <span className="badge badge-red">No</span> },
        { key: 'error', label: 'Error', render: (r) => <span className="cell-muted small">{r.error_summary || 'â€”'}</span> },
        { key: 'actions', label: 'Actions', thClass: 'cell-actions', render: (r) => (
          <div className="cell-actions">
            {r.status === 'failed' && SAFE_RETRY_TASKS.has(r.task_name) && (
              <button type="button" className="btn-small btn-primary"
                onClick={() => retry(r.task_name)}
                disabled={retryBusy === r.task_name}>
                {retryBusy === r.task_name ? 'â€¦' : 'Retry'}
              </button>
            )}
            {r.status === 'failed' && !SAFE_RETRY_TASKS.has(r.task_name) && (
              <span className="cell-muted small">Retry not available for this task</span>
            )}
          </div>
        )},
      ]} rows={items} keyOf={(r)=>String(r.id)}
        emptyTitle="No background tasks." emptyHint="Task runs appear here after Celery executes them." />
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------------- Application errors ---------------- */

function ErrorMonitor() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [f, setF] = useState({ component: '', resolved: '' });

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true); setError('');
    try {
      const p = new URLSearchParams();
      if (f.component) p.set('component', f.component);
      if (f.resolved) p.set('resolved', f.resolved);
      const r = await fetchPage(`/common/errors/?${p.toString()}`);
      setItems(r.items);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Failed to load errors.');
    } finally { setLoading(false); }
  };
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [f.component, f.resolved]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, react/set-state-in-effect

  const resolve = async (id) => {
    try {
      await api.post(`/common/errors/${id}/resolve/`);
      load();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Resolve failed.');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Application errors" sub="Sanitized, deduplicated operational errors."
        actions={(
          <div className="row-gap">
            <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={load}>Refresh</button>
            <a href="#/monitoring" className="btn-ghost">&larr; Back to dashboard</a>
          </div>
        )} />
      {error ? <div className="field-error" role="alert">{error}</div> : null}
      <div className="panel" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <div className="panel-pad" style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'end' }}>
          <Field label="Component"><select className="input" value={f.component} onChange={(e)=>setF({...f, component:e.target.value})}>
            <option value="">All</option>
            <option value="api">API</option>
            <option value="auth">Authentication</option>
            <option value="database">Database</option>
            <option value="background_task">Background task</option>
            <option value="email">Email</option>
            <option value="storage">Storage</option>
            <option value="other">Other</option>
          </select></Field>
          <Field label="Resolved"><select className="input" value={f.resolved} onChange={(e)=>setF({...f, resolved:e.target.value})}>
            <option value="">All</option>
            <option value="true">Resolved</option>
            <option value="false">Unresolved</option>
          </select></Field>
          <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={load}>Filter</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <DataTable columns={[
        { key: 'title', label: 'Title', render: (r) => <span className="row-title">{r.title}</span> },
        { key: 'component', label: 'Component', render: (r) => r.component },
        { key: 'severity', label: 'Severity', render: (r) => <Badge kind="status" value={r.severity} label={r.severity} /> },
        { key: 'count', label: 'Occurrences', render: (r) => r.occurrence_count },
        { key: 'last', label: 'Last occurrence', render: (r) => r.last_occurred ? new Date(r.last_occurred).toLocaleString() : 'â€”' },
        { key: 'resolved', label: 'Resolved', render: (r) => r.resolved ? <span className="badge badge-green">Yes</span> : <span className="badge badge-amber">No</span> },
        { key: 'actions', label: 'Actions', thClass: 'cell-actions', render: (r) => (
          <div className="cell-actions">
            {!r.resolved && (
              <button type="button" className="btn-small btn-primary" onClick={() => resolve(r.id)}>Resolve</button>
            )}
          </div>
        )},
      ]} rows={items} keyOf={(r)=>String(r.id)}
        emptyTitle="No application errors." emptyHint="Errors appear here when record_error() is called or failures occur." />
    </div>

/* ---------------- Alerts ---------------- */

function AlertMonitor() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [f, setF] = useState({ component: '', severity: '', status: '' });
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState({});

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true); setError('');
    try {
      const p = new URLSearchParams();
      if (f.component) p.set('component', f.component);
      if (f.severity) p.set('severity', f.severity);
      if (f.status) p.set('status', f.status);
      const r = await fetchPage(`/common/alerts/?${p.toString()}`);
      setItems(r.items);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Failed to load alerts.');
    } finally { setLoading(false); }
  };
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [f.component, f.severity, f.status]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, react/set-state-in-effect

  const act = async (id, action) => {
    setBusy({ ...busy, [id]: action });
    try {
      await api.post(`/common/alerts/${id}/${action}/`);
      load();

      setError(parseApiError(e).global || `${action} failed.`);

/* ---------------- Incidents ---------------- */

function IncidentMonitor() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const canCreateIncident = canAdministerMonitoring(auth);
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [openForm, setOpenForm] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ title: '', description: '', severity: 'warning', affected_component: '', assigned_to: '', internal_notes: '' });
  const [formBusy, setFormBusy] = useState(false);

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true); setError('');
    try {
      const r = await fetchPage('/common/incidents/');
      setItems(r.items);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Failed to load incidents.');
    } finally { setLoading(false); }
  };
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect

  const save = async (ev) => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    if (!canCreateIncident) {
      setError('Incident creation requires System Admin permission.');
      return;
    }
    setFormBusy(true); setError('');
    try {
      await api.post('/common/incidents/', {
        title: form.title, description: form.description, severity: form.severity,
        affected_component: form.affected_component,
        assigned_to: form.assigned_to || null,
        internal_notes: form.internal_notes,
      });
      setOpenForm(false);
      setForm({ title: '', description: '', severity: 'warning', affected_component: '', assigned_to: '', internal_notes: '' });
      load();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Failed to create incident.');
    } finally { setFormBusy(false); }
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Operational incidents" sub="System-level incidents (distinct from support tickets)."
        actions={(
          <div className="row-gap">
            <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={load}>Refresh</button>
            {canCreateIncident && (
              <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={() => setOpenForm(true)}>+ New incident</button>
            )}
            <a href="#/monitoring" className="btn-ghost">&larr; Back to dashboard</a>
          </div>
        )} />
      {error ? <div className="field-error" role="alert">{error}</div> : null}
      <DataTable columns={[
        { key: 'title', label: 'Title', render: (r) => <span className="row-title">{r.title}</span> },
        { key: 'severity', label: 'Severity', render: (r) => <Badge kind="status" value={r.severity} label={r.severity} /> },
        { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (r) => <Badge kind="status" value={r.status} label={r.status} /> },
        { key: 'component', label: 'Component', render: (r) => r.affected_component || 'â€”' },
        { key: 'assignee', label: 'Assigned to', render: (r) => r.assigned_to_email || 'â€”' },
        { key: 'created', label: 'Created', render: (r) => r.created_at ? new Date(r.created_at).toLocaleString() : 'â€”' },
      ]} rows={items} keyOf={(r)=>String(r.id)}
        emptyTitle="No incidents." emptyHint="Incidents track system-level operational issues." />
      {openForm && (
        <Modal title="New operational incident" onClose={() => setOpenForm(false)} size="lg">
          <form onSubmit={save} noValidate>
            <Field label="Title" required>
              <input className="input input-auto" value={form.title} onChange={(e)=>setForm({...form, title:e.target.value})} disabled={formBusy} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Description" required>
              <textarea className="input input-auto" value={form.description} onChange={(e)=>setForm({...form, description:e.target.value})} rows={3} disabled={formBusy} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Severity">
              <select className="input" value={form.severity} onChange={(e)=>setForm({...form, severity:e.target.value})} disabled={formBusy}>
                <option value="informational">Informational</option>
                <option value="warning">Warning</option>
                <option value="critical">Critical</option>
              </select>
            </Field>
            <Field label="Affected component"><input className="input input-auto" value={form.affected_component} onChange={(e)=>setForm({...form, affected_component:e.target.value})} placeholder="e.g. database" disabled={formBusy} /></Field>
            <Field label="Assignee (user ID)"><input className="input input-auto" type="number" value={form.assigned_to} onChange={(e)=>setForm({...form, assigned_to:e.target.value})} disabled={formBusy} /></Field>
            <Field label="Internal notes"><textarea className="input input-auto" value={form.internal_notes} onChange={(e)=>setForm({...form, internal_notes:e.target.value})} rows={2} disabled={formBusy} /></Field>
            <div className="row-end">
              <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setOpenForm(false)} disabled={formBusy}>Cancel</button>
              <button type="submit" className="btn-primary" disabled={formBusy}>{formBusy ? 'Creatingâ€¦' : 'Create'}</button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------------- Email & storage ---------------- */

function EmailStorageMonitor() {
  const [data, setData] = useState({ components: {} });
  const [, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        const r = await api.get('/common/email-storage/');
        if (!cancelled) setData(r.data);
      } catch (e) {
        if (!cancelled) setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Failed to load email/storage health.');
      } finally { if (!cancelled) setLoading(false); }
    })();
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, []);

  const comps = data ? data.components : {};
  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Email &amp; storage health" sub="Email backend and file storage availability."
        actions={(
          <div className="row-gap">
            <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={() => window.location.reload()}>Refresh</button>
            <a href="#/monitoring" className="btn-ghost">&larr; Back to dashboard</a>
          </div>
        )} />
      {error ? <div className="field-error" role="alert">{error}</div> : null}
      <table className="grid">
        <thead>
          <tr><th>Component</th><th>Status</th><th>Diagnostic</th><th>Checked</th></tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {['email', 'storage'].map((key) => {
            const c = comps[key];
            if (!c) return null;
            return (
              <tr key={key}>
                <td>{key === 'email' ? 'Email' : 'Storage'}</td>
                <td><Badge kind="status" value={c.state} label={STATE_LABEL[c.state] ?? c.state} /></td>
                <td className="cell-muted small">{c.diagnostic || 'â€”'}</td>
                <td className="cell-muted small">{c.evaluated_at ? new Date(c.evaluated_at).toLocaleString() : 'â€”'}</td>
              </tr>
            );
          })}
        </tbody>
      </table>
      {comps.storage && comps.storage.details && comps.storage.details.storage_total_bytes != null && (
        <div className="panel" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
          <div className="panel-head"><h3>Storage usage</h3></div>
          <div className="panel-pad">
            <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Total</span><div className="small">{formatBytes(comps.storage.details.storage_total_bytes)}</div></div>
            <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Used</span><div className="small">{formatBytes(comps.storage.details.storage_used_bytes)}</div></div>
            <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Free</span><div className="small">{formatBytes(comps.storage.details.storage_free_bytes)}</div></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function formatBytes(bytes) {
  if (!bytes && bytes !== 0) return 'â€”';
  const sizes = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'];
  let i = 0;
  let b = bytes;
  while (b >= 1024 && i < sizes.length - 1) { b /= 1024; i++; }
  return `${b.toFixed(2)} ${sizes[i]}`;
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { PageHeader, DataTable, AccessDenied } from '../../components';
import api from '../../api';
import { licensingCapabilities } from '../../shared/licensing-utils';

function MySoftwarePage() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const caps = licensingCapabilities(auth);
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  useEffect(() => {
    setLoading(true); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    api.get('/licensing/allocations/my-software/').then((r) => setItems(r.data.results || r.data || [])).catch((e) => setError(e.response?.data?.detail || 'Could not load.')).finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);
  if (!caps.canViewMySoftware) return <AccessDenied />;
  const columns = [
    { key: 'product_name', label: 'Product' },
    { key: 'publisher', label: 'Publisher' },
    { key: 'edition', label: 'Edition' },
    { key: 'version', label: 'Version' },
    { key: 'allocation_type', label: 'Type' },
    { key: 'status', label: 'Status' },
    { key: 'assigned_at', label: 'Assigned' },
    { key: 'expected_release_date', label: 'Expiry' },
    { key: 'asset_tag', label: 'Asset' },
    { key: 'last_verified_at', label: 'Verified' },
  ];
  return (
    <div className="my-software-page">
      <PageHeader title="My Software" />
      {error && <div className="alert alert-danger">{error}</div>}
      <DataTable columns={columns} rows={items} keyOf={(r) => r.id} loading={loading} emptyTitle="No software allocated" />
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { ConfirmDialog, EmptyState, PageHeader } from '../../components';

export function Notifications() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [busyAll, setBusyAll] = useState(false);
  const [allMsg, setAllMsg] = useState('');
  const [dismissTarget, setDismissTarget] = useState(null);
  const [dismissBusy, setDismissBusy] = useState(false);

  const [filter, setFilter] = useState('all'); // 'all'|'unread'
  const [entity, setEntity] = useState(''); // ''|'tickets.Ticket'|'assets.Asset'|'assets.Maintenance'|'assets.Disposal'

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const p = new URLSearchParams();
      if (filter !== 'all') p.set('is_read', filter === 'unread' ? 'false' : 'true');
      if (entity) p.set('entity_type', entity);
      const r = await api.get(`/common/notifications/?${p.toString()}`);
      const list = r.data.results ?? r.data ?? [];
      setItems(Array.isArray(list) ? list : []);
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('notif-change'));
    } catch {
      setError('Could not load notifications.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [filter, entity]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, react/set-state-in-effect

  const unread = items.filter((n) => !n.is_read).length;

  const markOneRead = async (n) => {
    try {
      const r = await api.patch(`/common/notifications/${n.id}/`, { is_read: true });
      setItems((xs) => xs.map((x) => (x.id === n.id ? r.data : x)));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('notif-change'));
    } catch {
      setError(`Could not mark notification #${n.id} as read.`);
    }
  };

  const markAllRead = async () => {
    if (busyAll || unread === 0) return;
    setBusyAll(true);
    setAllMsg('');
    setError('');
    try {
      const r = await api.post('/common/notifications/mark_all_read/', {});
      setAllMsg(`Marked ${r.data.updated ?? 0} notification(s) as read.`);
      await load();
    } catch {
      setError('Could not mark all as read.');
    } finally {
      setBusyAll(false);
    }
  };

  const dismiss = async () => {
    if (!dismissTarget || dismissBusy) return;
    setDismissBusy(true);
    try {
      await api.delete(`/common/notifications/${dismissTarget.id}/`);
      setItems((xs) => xs.filter((x) => x.id !== dismissTarget.id));
      setDismissTarget(null);
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('notif-change'));
    } catch {
      setError(`Could not dismiss notification #${dismissTarget.id}.`);
    } finally {
      setDismissBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const entityLinks = {
    'tickets.Ticket': (id) => ({ href: `#/tickets/${id}`, label: 'Open ticket' }),
    'assets.Asset': (id) => ({ href: `#/assets/${id}`, label: 'Open asset' }),
    'assets.Maintenance': () => ({ href: '#/maintenance', label: 'Open maintenance' }),
    'assets.Disposal': () => ({ href: '#/disposals', label: 'Open disposals' }),
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Notifications"
        sub={unread > 0 ? `${unread} unread` : 'All caught up.'}
        actions={<>
          <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={load}>Refresh</button>
          <button
            type="button" className="btn-secondary"
            onClick={markAllRead} disabled={busyAll || unread === 0}
            title={unread === 0 ? 'Nothing unread' : 'Mark all as read'}
          >
            {busyAll ? 'Workingâ€¦' : 'Mark all as read'}
          </button>
        </>}
      />
      <div className="filter-bar" role="search">
        <select
          className="input"
          value={filter}
          onChange={(e) => setFilter(e.target.value)}
          aria-label="Filter by read status"
        >
          <option value="all">All</option>
          <option value="unread">Unread only</option>
          <option value="read">Read only</option>
        </select>
        <select
          className="input"
          value={entity}
          onChange={(e) => setEntity(e.target.value)}
          aria-label="Filter by entity type"
        >
          <option value="">All types</option>
          <option value="tickets.Ticket">Tickets</option>
          <option value="assets.Asset">Assets</option>
          <option value="assets.Maintenance">Maintenance</option>
          <option value="assets.Disposal">Disposals</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      {error && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>}
      {allMsg && <div className="success-summary" role="status">{allMsg}</div>}
      {items.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState title="No notifications." hint="Ticket and asset events that involve you will show up here." />
      ) : (
        <ul className="note-list">
          {items.map((n) => (
            <li key={n.id} className={n.is_read ? undefined : 'is-unread'}>
              <div className={n.is_read ? 'notif-title' : 'notif-title is-strong'}>{n.title}</div>
              {n.body && <div className="pre-wrap">{n.body}</div>}
              <div className="muted small">
                {n.created_at ? new Date(n.created_at).toLocaleString() : ''}
                {n.entity_type ? ` Â· ${n.entity_type}:${n.object_id}` : ''}
                {entityLinks[n.entity_type] && n.object_id
  ? <a href={entityLinks[n.entity_type](n.object_id).href}>
      {entityLinks[n.entity_type](n.object_id).label}
    </a>
  : null}
              </div>
              <div className="notif-actions">
                {!n.is_read && (
                  <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => markOneRead(n)}>
                    Mark as read
                  </button>
                )}
                <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setDismissTarget(n)}>
                  Dismissâ€¦
                </button>
              </div>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      {dismissTarget && (
        <ConfirmDialog
          title="Dismiss notification?"
          message={`"${dismissTarget.title}" will be removed from your list. This cannot be undone from here.`}
          confirmLabel="Dismiss"
          busy={dismissBusy}
          onConfirm={dismiss}
          onCancel={() => setDismissTarget(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function NotifBadge() {
  const [unread, setUnread] = useState(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    const fetchCount = async () => {
      try {
        const r = await api.get('/common/notifications/unread_count/');
        const data = r.data || r;
        if (!cancelled) setUnread(data.count ?? data ?? 0);
      } catch {
        if (!cancelled) setUnread(null);
      }
    };
    fetchCount();
    const onHash = () => fetchCount();
    const onChange = () => fetchCount();
    addEventListener('hashchange', onHash);
    addEventListener('notif-change', onChange);
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      removeEventListener('hashchange', onHash);
      removeEventListener('notif-change', onChange);
    };
  }, []);
  if (!unread) return null;
  return <span className="count-badge">{unread}</span>;
}
