===== src\pages\privacy\Privacy.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import {
  Badge, ConfirmDialog, DataTable, Field, PageHeader, Pager,
} from '../../components';
import { fetchPage, parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';

const STATUS_ORDER = [
  'pending_review', 'approved', 'rejected',
  'execution_pending', 'executing', 'completed', 'failed', 'cancelled',
];

const STATUS_LABEL = {
  pending_review: 'Pending review', approved: 'Approved', rejected: 'Rejected',
  execution_pending: 'Execution pending', executing: 'Executing',
  completed: 'Completed', failed: 'Failed', cancelled: 'Cancelled',
};

function statusBadge(status) {
  return (
    <Badge kind="status" value={status}
           label={STATUS_LABEL[status] || status} />
  );
}

/** Privacy-erasure governance page.
 *
 * Hash-based sub-views:
 *   #/privacy            dashboard
 *   #/privacy/requests   request list
 *   #/privacy/requests/new   create request
 *   #/privacy/requests/:id   request detail (+ approve/reject/execute/cancel)
 *
 * Backend enforces two-person approval: the requester cannot approve their
 * own request, and execution requires independent reviewer approval.
 */
export function Privacy() {
  const { isAdmin } = useAuth();
  if (!isAdmin) {
    return (
      <div>
        <div className="page-head"><h1>Privacy Erasure</h1></div>
        <div className="empty-state">
          <div className="empty-title">Access restricted</div>
          <div className="small">Privacy-erasure governance is System Admin only.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const hash = location.hash;
  const view = hash.split('?')[0];

  if (view === '#/privacy/requests/new') return <PrivacyCreate />;
  if (view.match(/^#\/privacy\/requests\/\d+($|\/)/)) {
    const m = view.match(/^#\/privacy\/requests\/(\d+)/);
    return <PrivacyDetail id={m[1]} />;
  }
  if (view === '#/privacy/requests' || view === '#/privacy') {
    return view === '#/privacy/requests' ? <PrivacyList /> : <PrivacyDashboard />;
  }
  return <PrivacyDashboard />;
}

/* ---------------- Dashboard ---------------- */

function PrivacyDashboard() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        const r = await api.get('/common/privacy-erasures/?page_size=100');
        const d = r.data;
        const rows = Array.isArray(d) ? d : (d.results ?? []);
        if (!cancelled) {
          setItems(rows);
          setCount(d.count ?? rows.length);
          setError('');
        }
      } catch (e) {
        if (!cancelled) setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Failed to load dashboard.');
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, []);

  const byStatus = {};
  for (const s of STATUS_ORDER) byStatus[s] = 0;
  for (const it of items) byStatus[it.status] = (byStatus[it.status] || 0) + 1;

  const KPI = [
    { key: 'pending_review', label: 'Pending review', tone: 'amber' },
    { key: 'approved', label: 'Approved', tone: 'green' },
    { key: 'rejected', label: 'Rejected', tone: 'red' },
    { key: 'execution_pending', label: 'Execution pending', tone: 'blue' },
    { key: 'completed', label: 'Completed', tone: 'green' },
    { key: 'failed', label: 'Failed', tone: 'red' },
  ];

  if (loading) return (
    <>
      <div className="page-head"><h1>Privacy Erasure</h1></div>
      <div className="panel panel-pad" role="status" aria-label="Loading">
        <span className="spinner" aria-hidden="true" /> Loadingâ€¦
      </div>
    </>
  );

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Privacy Erasure" sub="Two-person-approval data lifecycle governance" />
      {error ? <div className="field-error" role="alert">{error}</div> : null}
      <div className="row-gap" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
        {KPI.map((k) => (
          <div key={k.key} className="kpi-card">
            <div className="kpi-value">{byStatus[k.key] ?? 0}</div>
            <div className="kpi-label">{k.label}</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="panel">
        <div className="panel-head"><h3>Requests</h3></div>
        <div className="panel-pad">
          <a href="#/privacy/requests" className="btn-primary">View all requests &rarr;</a>
          <span className="muted"> &middot; </span>
          <a href="#/privacy/requests/new" className="btn-secondary">Create request</a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------------- Request list ---------------- */

function PrivacyList() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [count, setCount] = useState(null);
  const [next, setNext] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [f, setF] = useState({ q: '', status: '', entity_type: '', requested_by: '', date_from: '', date_to: '' });
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);

  const params = {
    ...f,
    page,
    page_size: 20,
  };

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true); setError('');
    try {
      const p = new URLSearchParams();
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) {
        if (v !== '' && v != null) p.set(k, v);
      }
      const d = await fetchPage(`/common/privacy-erasures/?${p.toString()}`);
      setItems(d.items); setCount(d.count); setNext(d.next); setPrevious(d.previous);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Failed to load requests.');
    } finally { setLoading(false); }
  };
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [page, f.q, f.status, f.entity_type, f.requested_by, f.date_from, f.date_to]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, react/set-state-in-effect

  const setField = (k) => (e) => setF((s) => ({ ...s, [k]: e.target.value }));

  const ROWS = [
    { key: 'id', label: 'ID', sortable: 'id', render: (r) => <span className="cell-muted">#{r.id}</span> },
    { key: 'entity_type', label: 'Entity', render: (r) => r.entity_type },
    { key: 'object_id', label: 'Object ID', render: (r) => r.object_id },
    { key: 'scope', label: 'Scope', render: (r) => r.scope },
    { key: 'reason', label: 'Reason', render: (r) => String(r.reason || '').slice(0, 80) },
    { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (r) => statusBadge(r.status) },
    { key: 'requested_by', label: 'Requester', render: (r) => r.requested_by_email || r.requested_by || 'â€”' },
    { key: 'reviewer', label: 'Reviewer', render: (r) => r.reviewer_email || 'â€”' },
    { key: 'created_at', label: 'Created', render: (r) => r.created_at ? new Date(r.created_at).toLocaleString() : 'â€”' },
    { key: 'actions', label: 'Actions', thClass: 'cell-actions', render: (r) => (
      <div className="cell-actions">
        <a href={`#/privacy/requests/${r.id}`} className="btn-small">Detail</a>
      </div>
    )},
  ];

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Erasure requests" sub="List, filter and open privacy-erasure requests."
        actions={(
          <div className="row-gap">
            <a href="#/privacy/requests/new" className="btn-primary">+ Create request</a>
          </div>
        )} />
      {error ? <div className="field-error" role="alert">{error}</div> : null}
      <div className="panel">
        <div className="panel-head"><h3>Filter</h3></div>
        <div className="panel-pad" style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'end' }}>
          <Field label="Search"><input className="input input-auto" value={f.q} onChange={setField('q')} placeholder="scope, reason, IDâ€¦" /></Field>
          <Field label="Status"><select className="input" value={f.status} onChange={setField('status')}>
            <option value="">All</option>
            {STATUS_ORDER.map((s) => <option key={s} value={s}>{STATUS_LABEL[s]}</option>)}
          </select></Field>
          <Field label="Entity type"><input className="input input-auto" value={f.entity_type} onChange={setField('entity_type')} placeholder="e.g. accounts.User" /></Field>
          <Field label="Date from"><input className="input input-auto" type="date" value={f.date_from} onChange={setField('date_from')} /></Field>
          <Field label="Date to"><input className="input input-auto" type="date" value={f.date_to} onChange={setField('date_to')} /></Field>
          <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={load}>Apply</button>
          <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => { setF({ q: '', status: '', entity_type: '', requested_by: '', date_from: '', date_to: '' }); setPage(1); load(); }}>Reset</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <DataTable columns={ROWS} rows={items} keyOf={(r) => String(r.id)} emptyTitle="No erasure requests." emptyHint="Create your first privacy-erasure request." />
      <Pager count={count} onPrev={() => setPage(p => p - 1)} onNext={() => setPage(p => p + 1)}
             hasPrev={page > 1} hasNext={!!next} busy={loading} />
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------------- Create request ---------------- */

function PrivacyCreate() {
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ entity_type: 'accounts.User', object_id: '', scope: '', reason: '', confirm: '' });
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');
  const [parsed, setParsed] = useState(null);

  const setField = (k) => (e) => setForm((s) => ({ ...s, [k]: e.target.value }));

  const submit = async (ev) => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true); setError(''); setMsg(''); setParsed(null);
    try {
      const r = await api.post('/common/privacy-erasures/', {
        entity_type: form.entity_type, object_id: form.object_id,
        scope: form.scope, reason: form.reason, confirm: form.confirm,
      });
      setParsed(r.data);
      setMsg(`Request #${r.data.id} created (status: ${r.data.status}). Awaiting independent review.`);
    } catch (e) {
      const p = parseApiError(e);
      setError(p.global || 'Failed to create request.');
      setParsed(p);
    } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Create erasure request" sub="Request privacy erasure for a record. An independent System Admin must approve before execution." />
      {error ? <div className="field-error" role="alert">{error}</div> : null}
      {msg ? <div className="success-summary" role="status">{msg}</div> : null}
      <form onSubmit={submit} noValidate>
        <Field label="Entity type" required>
          <input className="input input-auto" value={form.entity_type} onChange={setField('entity_type')} placeholder="accounts.User" />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Object ID" required>
          <input className="input input-auto" value={form.object_id} onChange={setField('object_id')} placeholder="Primary key of the record" />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Scope" required hint="Which data to erase, e.g. email, name, phone">
          <input className="input input-auto" value={form.scope} onChange={setField('scope')} />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Reason" required hint="Business justification (audited, never PII)">
          <textarea className="input input-auto" value={form.reason} onChange={setField('reason')} rows={3} />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Confirm Object ID" required hint="Re-enter the object ID to confirm.">
          <input className="input input-auto" value={form.confirm} onChange={setField('confirm')} />
        </Field>
        <div className="row-end">
          <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => historyBack()}>Cancel</button>
          <button type="submit" className="btn-primary" disabled={busy}>{busy ? 'Creatingâ€¦' : 'Create request'}</button>
        </div>
      </form>
      {parsed && (
        <div className="success-summary" role="status">
          <strong>Created.</strong> Request #{parsed.id} &mdash; status: <em>{parsed.status}</em>.
          {' '}<a href={`#/privacy/requests/${parsed.id}`}>View detail &rarr;</a>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function historyBack() {
  window.history.back();
}

/* ---------------- Request detail ---------------- */

function PrivacyDetail({ id }) {
  const [req, setReq] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [busyActions, setBusyActions] = useState({});
  const [openApprove, setOpenApprove] = useState(false);
  const [openReject, setOpenReject] = useState(false);
  const [openExecute, setOpenExecute] = useState(false);
  const [openCancel, setOpenCancel] = useState(false);
  const [reviewForm, setReviewForm] = useState({ decision: 'approve', reason: '' });

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        const r = await api.get(`/common/privacy-erasures/${id}/`);
        if (!cancelled) setReq(r.data);
      } catch (e) {
        if (!cancelled) setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Failed to load request.');
      } finally { if (!cancelled) setLoading(false); }
    })();
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [id]);

  const actionBusy = (k) => busyActions[k] === id;
  const run = async (k, fn) => {
    setBusyActions({ ...busyActions, [k]: id });
    try { await fn(); } finally { setBusyActions({ ...busyActions, [k]: null }); }
  };

  const approve = async () => {
    await run('approve', async () => {
      await api.post(`/common/privacy-erasures/${id}/approve/`,
        { decision: reviewForm.decision, reason: reviewForm.reason });
      setOpenApprove(false); setReviewForm({ decision: 'approve', reason: '' });
      load();
    }).catch(() => {});
  };
  const reject = async () => {
    await run('reject', async () => {
      await api.post(`/common/privacy-erasures/${id}/reject/`,
        { decision: 'reject', reason: reviewForm.reason });
      setOpenReject(false); setReviewForm({ decision: 'reject', reason: '' });
      load();
    }).catch(() => {});
  };
  const exec = async () => {
    await run('execute', async () => {
      await api.post(`/common/privacy-erasures/${id}/execute/`, { confirm: String(req.object_id) });
      setOpenExecute(false); load();
    }).catch(() => {});
  };
  const cancelReq = async (reason) => {
    await run('cancel', async () => {
      await api.post(`/common/privacy-erasures/${id}/cancel/`, { reason });
      setOpenCancel(false); load();
    }).catch(() => {});
  };
  const load = () => {
    window.location.hash = `#/privacy/requests/${id}`;
  };

  if (loading) return (
    <>
      <div className="page-head"><h1>Request #{id}</h1></div>
      <div className="panel panel-pad" role="status" aria-label="Loading"><span className="spinner" aria-hidden="true" /> Loadingâ€¦</div>
    </>
  );
  if (error) return (
    <>
      <div className="page-head"><h1>Request #{id}</h1></div>
      <div className="field-error" role="alert">{error}</div>
    </>
  );

  const r = req;
  const canReview = r.status === 'pending_review';
  const canExecute = r.status === 'approved';
  const canCancel = r.status === 'pending_review' || r.status === 'approved' || r.status === 'execution_pending';

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title={`Erasure request #${r.id}`} sub={`${r.entity_type}:${r.object_id}`}
        actions={(
          <div className="row-gap">
            <a href="#/privacy/requests" className="btn-ghost">&larr; Back to list</a>
          </div>
        )} />
      <div className="panel">
        <div className="panel-head"><h3>Request</h3></div>
        <div className="panel-pad">
          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 16 }}>
            <div>
              <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Status</span>{' '}{statusBadge(r.status)}</div>
              <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Scope</span><div className="small">{r.scope}</div></div>
              <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Reason</span><div className="small">{r.reason}</div></div>
              <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Entity / Object</span><div className="small">{r.entity_type}:{r.object_id}</div></div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Requested by</span><div className="small">{r.requested_by_email || r.requested_by || 'â€”'}</div></div>
              <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Independent reviewer</span><div className="small">{r.reviewer_email || 'â€”'}</div></div>
              <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Reviewed at</span><div className="small">{r.reviewed_at ? new Date(r.reviewed_at).toLocaleString() : 'â€”'}</div></div>
              <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Decision</span><div className="small">{r.review_decision || 'â€”'}</div></div>
              {r.review_reason && <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Review reason</span><div className="small">{r.review_reason}</div></div>}
              <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Created</span><div className="small">{r.created_at ? new Date(r.created_at).toLocaleString() : 'â€”'}</div></div>
              {r.decided_at && <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Decided</span><div className="small">{new Date(r.decided_at).toLocaleString()}</div></div>}
              {r.executed_by && <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Executed by</span><div className="small">{r.executor_email || r.executed_by}</div></div>}
              {r.executed_at && <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Executed at</span><div className="small">{new Date(r.executed_at).toLocaleString()}</div></div>}
              {r.cancellation_reason && <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Cancellation reason</span><div className="small">{r.cancellation_reason}</div></div>}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="panel">
        <div className="panel-head"><h3>Dependency &amp; retention analysis</h3></div>
        <div className="panel-pad">
          {r.dependency_check && (
            <div>
              <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Target exists</span>{' '}
                {r.dependency_check.exists ? <span className="badge badge-green">Yes</span> : <span className="badge badge-red">No</span>}</div>
              <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Can proceed (automated)</span>{' '}
                {r.dependency_check.can_proceed ? <span className="badge badge-green">Yes</span> : <span className="badge badge-red">No</span>}</div>
              {r.dependency_check.requires_manual_review && (
                <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Manual review</span><span className="badge badge-amber">Required</span></div>
              )}
              <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Related records</span>
                <ul className="small-list">
                  {Object.entries(r.dependency_check.related || {}).map(([k, v]) => (
                    <li key={k}>{k.replace(/_/g, ' ')}: <span className="cell-muted">{v}</span></li>
                  ))}
                  {Object.keys(r.dependency_check.related || {}).length === 0 && <li className="muted">None recorded.</li>}
                </ul>
              </div>
              <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Retention notes</span>
                <ul className="small-list">
                  {(r.dependency_check.retention || []).map((n, i) => <li key={i}>{n}</li>)}
                </ul>
              </div>
              <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Assessment</span>
                <ul className="small-list">
                  {(r.dependency_check.assessment || []).map((a, i) => (
                    <li key={i}><strong>{a.category}:</strong> {a.action} &mdash; {a.reason}</li>
                  ))}
                  {(r.dependency_check.assessment || []).length === 0 && <li className="muted">None.</li>}
                </ul>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="panel">
        <div className="panel-head"><h3>Actions</h3></div>
        <div className="panel-pad">
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            {canReview && (
              <>
                <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={() => setOpenApprove(true)} disabled={actionBusy('approve')}>Approve (independent review)</button>
                <button type="button" className="btn-danger" onClick={() => setOpenReject(true)} disabled={actionBusy('reject')}>Reject</button>
              </>
            )}
            {canExecute && (
              <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={() => setOpenExecute(true)} disabled={actionBusy('execute')}>Execute erasure</button>
            )}
            {canCancel && (
              <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setOpenCancel(true)}>Cancel request</button>
            )}
            <div className="muted small">
              {r.status === 'pending_review' && 'Awaiting independent approval. The requester cannot approve their own request.'}
              {r.status === 'approved' && 'Independently approved. Ready for execution.'}
              {r.status === 'rejected' && 'Rejected. Cannot be executed.'}
              {r.status === 'completed' && 'Completed. PII was anonymized; de-identified history preserved.'}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="panel">
        <div className="panel-head"><h3>Audit history</h3></div>
        <div className="panel-pad">
          {(r.audit_history || []).length > 0 ? (
            <table className="grid">
              <thead><tr><th>When</th><th>Actor</th><th>Action</th><th>Reason</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>
                {r.audit_history.map((a) => (
                  <tr key={a.id}>
                    <td className="cell-muted">{a.timestamp ? new Date(a.timestamp).toLocaleString() : 'â€”'}</td>
                    <td className="cell-muted">{a.actor_email || a.actor || 'â€”'}</td>
                    <td>{a.action}</td>
                    <td className="cell-muted small">{a.reason || 'â€”'}</td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          ) : (
            <div className="muted">No audit entries yet.</div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {openApprove && (
        <ConfirmDialog title="Approve erasure request?"
          message="Independently approve this request so it can be executed. You cannot approve your own request."
          confirmLabel="Approve" onConfirm={approve} onCancel={() => setOpenApprove(false)}
          busy={actionBusy('approve')}>
          <Field label="Decision"><select className="input" value={reviewForm.decision} onChange={(e)=>setReviewForm({...reviewForm, decision:e.target.value})}>
            <option value="approve">Approve</option>
            <option value="reject">Reject</option>
          </select></Field>
          <Field label="Reason (required on rejection)"><input className="input input-auto" value={reviewForm.reason} onChange={(e)=>setReviewForm({...reviewForm, reason:e.target.value})} placeholder="Optional unless rejecting" /></Field>
        </ConfirmDialog>
      )}

      {openReject && (
        <ConfirmDialog title="Reject erasure request?"
          message="Rejection requires a reason and is recorded permanently. The request cannot be executed after rejection."
          confirmLabel="Reject" danger onConfirm={reject} onCancel={() => setOpenReject(false)}
          busy={actionBusy('reject')}>
          <Field label="Reason" required><textarea className="input input-auto" value={reviewForm.reason} onChange={(e)=>setReviewForm({...reviewForm, reason:e.target.value})} rows={2} /></Field>
        </ConfirmDialog>
      )}

      {openExecute && (
        <ConfirmDialog title="Execute erasure?"
          message="This will anonymize the target record's personal data (email, name, phone, job title) and preserve de-identified history. This cannot be undone. Execution requires independent approval (already granted)."
          confirmLabel="Execute" danger onConfirm={exec} onCancel={() => setOpenExecute(false)}
          busy={actionBusy('execute')}>
          <Field label="Confirm object ID" required hint="Re-enter the object ID to confirm.">
            <input className="input input-auto" value={String(r.object_id || '')} readOnly />
            <div className="small">Confirmed target: {r.entity_type}:{r.object_id}</div>
          </Field>
        </ConfirmDialog>
      )}

      {openCancel && (
        <ConfirmDialog title="Cancel erasure request?"
          message="Cancel this request. A cancelled request cannot be executed."
          confirmLabel="Cancel" onConfirm={() => cancelReq(prompt('Cancellation reason (optional):') || '')} onCancel={() => setOpenCancel(false)}
          busy={actionBusy('cancel')} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Badge, LoadingRows, PageHeader, Panel, PanelPad } from '../../components';
import {
  fiveWhys, getRCA, linkedAssets, linkedCIs, linkedKBs, linkedProducts,
  linkedServices, linkedTickets, listEvidence, listExceptions, listTasks,
  listValidations, listWorkarounds, problemDetail, problemHistory, problemReadiness,
  rootCauseFactors, createKbLink, deleteKbLink,
} from '../../services/problem-management';

function Section({ title, state, children }) {
  return (
    <Panel>
      <PanelPad>
        <h3>{title}</h3>
        {state?.ok === false ? <p className="muted">Section unavailable.</p> : children}
      </PanelPad>
    </Panel>
  );
}

function listOf(value) {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value;
  return value?.results ?? [];
}

const PROBLEM_ROWS = [
  ['status', 'Status'],
  ['priority', 'Priority'],
  ['problem_type', 'Type'],
  ['owner_username', 'Owner'],
  ['service_name', 'Service'],
  ['category_name', 'Category'],
  ['environment', 'Environment'],
];

export function ProblemDetail({ problemId: problemIdProp }) {
  const params = useParams();
  const problemId = problemIdProp ?? params.id;
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [sections, setSections] = useState({});
  const [rca, setRca] = useState(null);
  const [kbForm, setKbForm] = useState({
    article: '', relation_type: 'reference', relevance: 'medium', note: '',
  });
  const [kbAdding, setKbAdding] = useState(false);
  const [kbRemoving, setKbRemoving] = useState(new Set());
  const [kbMessage, setKbMessage] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    setLoading(true); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    setError(''); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    problemDetail(problemId)
      .then((data) => { if (active) setProblem(data?.data ?? data); })
      .catch(() => { if (active) setError('Could not load problem detail.'); })
      .finally(() => { if (active) setLoading(false); });
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, [problemId]);

  // Each section loads independently: one failing endpoint degrades that
  // section only and never blanks the page.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!problemId) return () => {};
    let active = true;
    const loaders = [
      ['tasks', () => listTasks(problemId)],
      ['evidence', () => listEvidence(problemId)],
      ['validations', () => listValidations(problemId)],
      ['exceptions', () => listExceptions(problemId)],
      ['workarounds', () => listWorkarounds(problemId)],
      ['whys', () => fiveWhys(problemId)],
      ['factors', () => rootCauseFactors(problemId)],
      ['history', () => problemHistory(problemId)],
      ['readiness', () => problemReadiness(problemId)],
      ['tickets', () => linkedTickets(problemId)],
      ['cis', () => linkedCIs(problemId)],
      ['assets', () => linkedAssets(problemId)],
      ['services', () => linkedServices(problemId)],
      ['products', () => linkedProducts(problemId)],
      ['kbs', () => linkedKBs(problemId)],
    ];
    loaders.forEach(([key, fn]) => {
      Promise.resolve()
        .then(fn)
        .then((data) => { if (active) setSections((s) => ({ ...s, [key]: { ok: true, data } })); })
        .catch(() => { if (active) setSections((s) => ({ ...s, [key]: { ok: false, data: null } })); });
    });
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, [problemId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const rootCauseId = problem?.root_cause_analysis;
    if (!rootCauseId) { setRca(null); return () => {}; } // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    let active = true;
    getRCA(rootCauseId)
      .then((data) => { if (active) setRca(data?.data ?? data); })
      .catch(() => { if (active) setRca(null); });
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, [problem?.root_cause_analysis]);

  const handleAddKbLink = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!problemId) return;
    setKbAdding(true);
    setKbMessage('');
    try {
      await createKbLink({ problem: Number(problemId), ...kbForm });
      setKbForm({ article: '', relation_type: 'reference', relevance: 'medium', note: '' });
      setKbMessage('Article linked.');
      const data = await linkedKBs(problemId);
      setSections((s) => ({ ...s, kbs: { ok: true, data } }));
    } catch (err) {
      setKbMessage(err?.message || 'Failed to link article.');
    } finally {
      setKbAdding(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveKbLink = async (linkId) => {
    if (!problemId) return;
    setKbRemoving((s) => new Set([...s, linkId]));
    setKbMessage('');
    try {
      await deleteKbLink(linkId);
      const data = await linkedKBs(problemId);
      setSections((s) => ({ ...s, kbs: { ok: true, data } }));
      setKbMessage('Link removed.');
    } catch (err) {
      setKbMessage(err?.message || 'Failed to remove link.');
    } finally {
      setKbRemoving((s) => { const n = new Set(s); n.delete(linkId); return n; });
    }
  };

  if (loading) return <LoadingRows n={6} />;
  if (error) return <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>;
  if (!problem) return <div className="error-summary" role="alert">Problem not available.</div>;

  const readiness = sections.readiness?.data;
  const counts = readiness?.counts ?? {};

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title={problem.problem_number} sub={problem.title} />

      <Section title="Overview">
        {PROBLEM_ROWS.map(([key, label]) => (
          <p key={key}>{label}: {key === 'status' || key === 'priority'
            ? <Badge kind="status-warning" value={problem[key]} />
            : (problem[key] || 'â€”')}</p>
        ))}
        {problem.description && <p>{problem.description}</p>}
      </Section>

      <Section title="Tasks" state={sections.tasks}>
        {listOf(sections.tasks?.data).length === 0
          ? <p className="muted">No tasks.</p>
          : listOf(sections.tasks?.data).map((t) => <p key={t.id}>{t.title} â€” {t.status}</p>)}
      </Section>

      <Section title="Evidence" state={sections.evidence}>
        {listOf(sections.evidence?.data).length === 0
          ? <p className="muted">No evidence.</p>
          : listOf(sections.evidence?.data).map((e) => (
            <p key={e.id}>{e.original_filename}{e.archived ? ' (Archived)' : ''}</p>
          ))}
      </Section>

      <Section title="RCA Workflow">
        {rca
          ? <p>{rca.title} â€” {rca.status}</p>
          : <p className="muted">No root-cause analysis linked.</p>}
      </Section>

      <Section title="Five Whys" state={sections.whys}>
        {listOf(sections.whys?.data).length === 0
          ? <p className="muted">No Five Whys recorded.</p>
          : listOf(sections.whys?.data).map((w) => <p key={w.id}>{w.question_number}. {w.question_text}</p>)}
      </Section>

      <Section title="Root-Cause Factors" state={sections.factors}>
        {listOf(sections.factors?.data).length === 0
          ? <p className="muted">No factors recorded.</p>
          : listOf(sections.factors?.data).map((f) => <p key={f.id}>{f.category}: {f.factor}</p>)}
      </Section>

      <Section title="Timeline">
        {(problem.timeline_events ?? []).length === 0
          ? <p className="muted">No timeline events.</p>
          : problem.timeline_events.map((e) => <p key={e.id}>{e.title}</p>)}
      </Section>

      <Section title="Actions">
        <p className="muted">Corrective and preventive actions are tracked as tasks above.</p>
      </Section>

      <Section title="Workarounds" state={sections.workarounds}>
        {listOf(sections.workarounds?.data).length === 0
          ? <p className="muted">No workarounds.</p>
          : listOf(sections.workarounds?.data).map((w) => <p key={w.id}>{w.title}</p>)}
      </Section>

      <Section title="Validations" state={sections.validations}>
        {listOf(sections.validations?.data).length === 0
          ? <p className="muted">No validations.</p>
          : listOf(sections.validations?.data).map((v) => (
            <p key={v.id}>{v.title} â€” {v.status}</p>
          ))}
      </Section>

      <Section title="Exceptions" state={sections.exceptions}>
        {listOf(sections.exceptions?.data).length === 0
          ? <p className="muted">No exceptions.</p>
          : listOf(sections.exceptions?.data).map((e) => <p key={e.id}>{e.title} â€” {e.exception_type}</p>)}
      </Section>

      <Section title="Readiness State" state={sections.readiness}>
        <p>Ready for resolution: {readiness?.ready_for_resolution ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</p>
        <p>Ready for closure: {readiness?.ready_for_closure ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</p>
        <p>Blockers: {(readiness?.blockers ?? []).join(', ') || 'None'}</p>
        <p>Warnings: {(readiness?.warnings ?? []).join(', ') || 'None'}</p>
        <p>Open blocking tasks: {counts.open_blocking_tasks ?? 0}</p>
        <p>Open required actions: {counts.open_required_actions ?? 0}</p>
        <p>Failed validations: {counts.failed_validations ?? 0}</p>
        <p>Open critical tickets: {counts.open_critical_tickets ?? 0}</p>
        <p>Active exceptions: {counts.active_exceptions ?? 0}</p>
      </Section>

      <Section title="Problem History" state={sections.history}>
        {listOf(sections.history?.data).length === 0
          ? <p className="muted">No history events.</p>
          : listOf(sections.history?.data).map((h) => (
            <p key={h.id}>{h.event_type}: {h.previous_status || 'â€”'} â†’ {h.new_status || 'â€”'}</p>
          ))}
      </Section>

      <Section title="Linked Records">
        <p>Tickets: {listOf(sections.tickets?.data).length}</p>
        <p>Configuration items: {listOf(sections.cis?.data).length}</p>
        <p>Assets: {listOf(sections.assets?.data).length}</p>
        <p>Services: {listOf(sections.services?.data).length}</p>
        <p>Software products: {listOf(sections.products?.data).length}</p>
        <p>KB articles: {listOf(sections.kbs?.data).length}</p>
        <p className="muted">Linked Changes are not supported by the backend.</p>
      </Section>

      <Section title="Linked Knowledge-Base Articles">
        <form onSubmit={handleAddKbLink} className="kb-add-form">
          <label htmlFor="kb-article">Article (ID or slug)</label>
          <input
            id="kb-article"
            value={kbForm.article}
            onChange={(e) => setKbForm((f) => ({ ...f, article: e.target.value }))}
            placeholder="e.g. vpn-reset"
            disabled={kbAdding}
          />
          <label htmlFor="kb-relation">Relation</label>
          <select
            id="kb-relation"
            value={kbForm.relation_type}
            onChange={(e) => setKbForm((f) => ({ ...f, relation_type: e.target.value }))}
            disabled={kbAdding}
          >
            <option value="reference">Reference</option>
            <option value="workaround_source">Workaround Source</option>
            <option value="root_cause_reference">Root-Cause Reference</option>
            <option value="known_error_reference">Known-Error Reference</option>
            <option value="procedure">Procedure</option>
            <option value="other">Other</option>
          </select>
          <label htmlFor="kb-relevance">Relevance</label>
          <select
            id="kb-relevance"
            value={kbForm.relevance}
            onChange={(e) => setKbForm((f) => ({ ...f, relevance: e.target.value }))}
            disabled={kbAdding}
          >
            <option value="confirmed">Confirmed</option>
            <option value="high">High</option>
            <option value="medium">Medium</option>
            <option value="low">Low</option>
            <option value="candidate">Candidate</option>
          </select>
          <label htmlFor="kb-note">Note</label>
          <input
            id="kb-note"
            value={kbForm.note}
            onChange={(e) => setKbForm((f) => ({ ...f, note: e.target.value }))}
            disabled={kbAdding}
          />
          <button type="submit" disabled={kbAdding || !kbForm.article}>
            {kbAdding ? 'Linkingâ€¦' : 'Link article'}
          </button>
        </form>
        {kbMessage && <p className={kbMessage.startsWith('Failed') ? 'error' : 'success'}>{kbMessage}</p>}
        {sections.kbs?.ok === false
          ? <p className="muted">Unable to load linked articles.</p>
          : listOf(sections.kbs?.data).length === 0
            ? <p className="muted">No KB articles linked.</p>
            : listOf(sections.kbs?.data).map((a) => (
                <div key={a.id} className="kb-link-row">
                  <span>{a.article_title || a.article}</span>
                  <Badge kind="status-warning" value={a.article_status} />
                  <span>{a.relation_type}</span>
                  <span>{a.relevance}</span>
                  {a.note && <span>{a.note}</span>}
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleRemoveKbLink(a.id)}
                    disabled={kbRemoving.has(a.id)}
                    className="btn btn-sm btn-danger"
                  >
                    {kbRemoving.has(a.id) ? 'Removingâ€¦' : 'Remove'}
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))}
      </Section>

      <Section title="Permissions">
        <p>Problem management actions follow your role permissions.</p>
      </Section>
    </div>
  );
}


===== src\pages\problem-management\ProblemList.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { Badge, Button, DataTable, Field, Input, Option, PageHeader, Pager, Select, PageSizeSelector } from '../../components';
import { problemList } from '../../services/problem-management';
import { PRIORITY_CHOICES, PROBLEM_STATUS_CHOICES, PROBLEM_TYPE_CHOICES } from '../../types/problem-management';

const EMPTY_FILTERS = {
  status: '',
  priority: '',
  problem_type: '',
  owner: '',
  service: '',
  category: '',
  search: '',
  is_open: false,
  // Recurrence filter: show problems with linked tickets above this count
  min_ticket_count: '',
};

const toLabel = (value) => String(value).replaceAll('_', ' ').replace(/^./, (c) => c.toUpperCase());

function statusKind(status) {
  if (status === 'resolved' || status === 'closed') return 'status-success';
  if (status === 'rejected') return 'status-danger';
  if (status === 'cancelled') return 'status-muted';
  return 'status-warning';
}

export function ProblemList() {
  const { isStaff } = useAuth();
  // Page-size preference persisted in localStorage; fall back to DRF default 20.
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 20;
    try {
      const saved = window.localStorage.getItem('itdesk.pageSize');
      const n = Number(saved);
      return saved && Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 && n <= 100 ? n : 20;
    } catch {
      return 20;
    }
  });
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState(EMPTY_FILTERS);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [rows, setRows] = useState([]);
  const [count, setCount] = useState(null);
  const [hasNext, setHasNext] = useState(false);
  const [hasPrev, setHasPrev] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  // Stable serialization: blank filters are dropped and keys are ordered, so
  // the same filter state always produces exactly one query shape.
  const queryKey = useMemo(() => {
    const entries = Object.entries(filters)
      .filter(([, value]) => value !== '' && value !== false && value != null)
      .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b));
    return JSON.stringify(entries);
  }, [filters]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    const params = Object.fromEntries(JSON.parse(queryKey));
    setLoading(true); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    setError(''); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    problemList({ ...params, page, page_size: pageSize })
      .then((data) => {
        if (!active) return;
        const result = Array.isArray(data) ? { results: data, count: data.length } : data;
        setRows(result.results ?? []);
        setCount(result.count ?? null);
        setHasNext(Boolean(result.next));
        setHasPrev(Boolean(result.previous));
      })
      .catch(() => { if (active) setError('Could not load problems.'); })
      .finally(() => { if (active) setLoading(false); });
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, [queryKey, page, pageSize]);

  // Reset to page 1 when page size changes
  useEffect(() => {
    setPage(1); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
  }, [pageSize]);

  // Persist page-size preference without unnecessary writes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    try {
      if (window.localStorage.getItem('itdesk.pageSize') !== String(pageSize)) {
        window.localStorage.setItem('itdesk.pageSize', String(pageSize));
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore storage failures
    }
  }, [pageSize]);

  const update = (patch) => {
    setPage(1);
    setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, ...patch }));
  };

  const columns = [
    {
      key: 'problem_number',
      label: 'Problem',
      render: (r) => <Link className="row-title" to={`/problem-management/${r.id}`}>{r.problem_number}</Link>,
    },
    { key: 'title', label: 'Title' },
    { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (r) => <Badge kind={statusKind(r.status)} value={r.status} /> },
    { key: 'priority', label: 'Priority', render: (r) => <Badge kind={`status-${r.priority || 'muted'}`} value={r.priority} /> },
    { key: 'problem_type', label: 'Type', render: (r) => (r.problem_type ? toLabel(r.problem_type) : 'â€”') },
    { key: 'owner_username', label: 'Owner', render: (r) => r.owner_username || 'â€”' },
    { key: 'service_name', label: 'Service', render: (r) => r.service_name || 'â€”' },
    { key: 'category_name', label: 'Category', render: (r) => r.category_name || 'â€”' },
    {
      key: 'linked_ticket_count',
      label: 'Tickets',
      render: (r) => {
        const count = r.linked_ticket_count || 0;
        if (count === 0) return <span className="muted">â€”</span>;
        return <span>{count}</span>;
      },
    },
    {
      key: 'recurrence_risk',
      label: 'Risk',
      render: (r) => {
        const count = r.linked_ticket_count || 0;
        if (count === 0) return <span className="muted">â€”</span>;
        if (count >= 5) return <Badge kind="critical">High recurrence</Badge>
        if (count >= 3) return <Badge kind="warning">Medium recurrence</Badge>;
        if (count >= 1) return <Badge kind="info">Low recurrence</Badge>;
        return <span className="muted">â€”</span>;
      },
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Problems"
        sub={count != null ? `${count} ${count === 1 ? 'problem' : 'problems'} in scope` : undefined}
        actions={isStaff ? <Link className="btn-primary" to="/problem-management/new">Create Problem</Link> : null}
      />
      <div className="filter-bar row-gap">
        <Field label="Status">
          <Select value={filters.status} onChange={(e) => update({ status: e.target.value })}>
            <Option value="">All</Option>
            {PROBLEM_STATUS_CHOICES.map((s) => <Option key={s} value={s}>{toLabel(s)}</Option>)}
          </Select>
        </Field>
        <Field label="Priority">
          <Select value={filters.priority} onChange={(e) => update({ priority: e.target.value })}>
            <Option value="">All</Option>
            {PRIORITY_CHOICES.map((p) => <Option key={p} value={p}>{toLabel(p)}</Option>)}
          </Select>
        </Field>
        <Field label="Problem type">
          <Select value={filters.problem_type} onChange={(e) => update({ problem_type: e.target.value })}>
            <Option value="">All</Option>
            {PROBLEM_TYPE_CHOICES.map((t) => <Option key={t} value={t}>{toLabel(t)}</Option>)}
          </Select>
        </Field>
        <Field label="Owner">
          <Input value={filters.owner} onChange={(e) => update({ owner: e.target.value })} placeholder="Owner id" />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Service">
          <Input value={filters.service} onChange={(e) => update({ service: e.target.value })} placeholder="Service id" />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Category">
          <Input value={filters.category} onChange={(e) => update({ category: e.target.value })} placeholder="Category id" />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Search">
          <Input placeholder="Searchâ€¦" value={filters.search} onChange={(e) => update({ search: e.target.value })} />
        </Field>
        <label className="check-inline">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={filters.is_open}
            onChange={(e) => update({ is_open: e.target.checked })}
          />
          {' '}Open only
        </label>
        <Button kind="ghost" onClick={() => { setPage(1); setFilters(EMPTY_FILTERS); }}>Reset</Button>
      </div>

      {error && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>}
      {loading
        ? <p className="page-loading" role="status">Loading problemsâ€¦</p>
        : (
          <DataTable
            columns={columns}
            rows={rows}
            keyOf={(r) => r.id}
            emptyTitle="No problems found"
            emptyHint="Adjust the filters or create the first problem."
          />
        )}
      <PageSizeSelector value={pageSize} onChange={setPageSize} />
      <Pager
        count={count}
        hasNext={hasNext}
        hasPrev={hasPrev}
        busy={loading}
        pageLabel={count != null ? `Page ${page}` : ''}
        onPrev={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
        onNext={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { ProcurementAttachments } from './ProcurementAttachments';
import {
  ConfirmDialog, DataTable, EmptyState, ErrorSummary, Field, LoadingRows, PageHeader,
} from '../../components';
import {
  buildAssetReceiptItemsUrl,
  buildPurchaseOrderListUrl,
  fetchAll,
  formatDate,
  formatDateTime,
  formatMoney,
  formatQuantity,
  parseFieldErrors,
  procurementCapabilities,
  receiptSummary,
  remainingQuantity,
} from '../../shared/procurement-utils';

const RECEIVABLE_STATUSES = ['approved', 'sent_to_vendor', 'partially_received'];
const QUANTITY_FIELDS = ['received', 'rejected', 'damaged'];

function blankLine(line) {
  return {
    id: line.id,
    item_name: line.item_name,
    description: line.description,
    ordered: Number(line.quantity || 0),
    alreadyAccepted: Number(line.received_qty || 0),
    alreadyRejected: Number(line.rejected_qty || 0),
    alreadyDamaged: Number(line.damaged_qty || 0),
    remaining: remainingQuantity(line),
    stock_item: line.stock_item,
    is_serialized: !!line.is_serialized,
    received: '',
    rejected: '',
    damaged: '',
    rejection_reason: '',
    damage_notes: '',
  };
}

function validateLine(line) {
  const errors = {};
  const received = line.received === '' ? 0 : Number(line.received);
  const rejected = line.rejected === '' ? 0 : Number(line.rejected);
  const damaged = line.damaged === '' ? 0 : Number(line.damaged);
  for (const [field, value] of [['received', received], ['rejected', rejected], ['damaged', damaged]]) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(value) || value < 0) errors[field] = 'Enter a whole number of zero or more.';
  }
  if (rejected + damaged > received) {
    errors.rejected = 'Rejected plus damaged cannot exceed the quantity received.';
  }
  if (received > line.remaining) {
    errors.received = `Only ${line.remaining} unit(s) remain to be received on this line.`;
  }
  if (rejected > 0 && !line.rejection_reason.trim()) {
    errors.rejection_reason = 'A reason is required for rejected units.';
  }
  if (damaged > 0 && !line.damage_notes.trim()) {
    errors.damage_notes = 'Describe the damage for damaged units.';
  }
  return errors;
}

/** Goods receipt form: choose an issued order, enter arrivals, then post. */
export function GoodsReceiptForm({ id, poId }) {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const caps = procurementCapabilities(auth);
  const isView = !!id;
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState([]);
  const [orderId, setOrderId] = useState(poId ? String(poId) : '');
  const [order, setOrder] = useState(null);
  const [receipt, setReceipt] = useState(null);
  const [assetItems, setAssetItems] = useState([]);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState([]);
  const [meta, setMeta] = useState({ delivery_note_number: '', invoice_number: '', notes: '' });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [lineErrors, setLineErrors] = useState({});
  const [globalError, setGlobalError] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false);
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const [submittedReceipt, setSubmittedReceipt] = useState(null);

  const loadOrders = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const rows = await fetchAll(buildPurchaseOrderListUrl());
      setOrders(rows.filter((po) => RECEIVABLE_STATUSES.includes(po.status)));
    } catch {
      setOrders([]);
    }
  }, []);

  const loadOrder = useCallback(async (selectedId) => {
    if (!selectedId) { setOrder(null); setLines([]); return; }
    try {
      const res = await api.get(`/procurement/purchase-orders/${selectedId}/`);
      setOrder(res.data);
      setLines((res.data.items || []).map(blankLine));
      setLineErrors({});
    } catch (e) {
      setGlobalError(parseFieldErrors(e).global || 'Could not load the purchase order.');
    }
  }, []);

  const loadReceipt = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const res = await api.get(`/procurement/goods-receipts/${id}/`);
      setReceipt(res.data);
      const [poRes, assetRes] = await Promise.all([
        api.get(`/procurement/purchase-orders/${res.data.purchase_order}/`),
        api.get(buildAssetReceiptItemsUrl({ goods_receipt: id, page_size: 100 }))
          .catch(() => ({ data: { results: [] } })),
      ]);
      setOrder(poRes.data);
      setAssetItems(assetRes.data?.results ?? assetRes.data ?? []);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseFieldErrors(e).global || 'This goods receipt is unavailable.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isView) { loadReceipt(); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
      return; }
    setLoading(true); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    (async () => {
      await loadOrders();
      if (poId) await loadOrder(poId);
      setLoading(false);
    })();
  }, [isView, loadReceipt, loadOrders, loadOrder, poId]);

  const setLine = (lineId, field, value) => {
    setLines((rows) => rows.map((row) => (row.id === lineId ? { ...row, [field]: value } : row)));
  };

  const planned = useMemo(() => lines
    .map((line) => {
      const received = line.received === '' ? 0 : Number(line.received);
      const rejected = line.rejected === '' ? 0 : Number(line.rejected);
      const damaged = line.damaged === '' ? 0 : Number(line.damaged);
      return { ...line, received, rejected, damaged, accepted: Math.max(0, received - rejected - damaged) };
    })
    .filter((line) => line.received > 0), [lines]);

  const anyPlanned = planned.length > 0;

  /** Validate every line, then open the confirmation for a clean receipt. */
  const review = () => {
    const errors = {};
    for (const line of lines) {
      const problems = validateLine(line);
      if (Object.keys(problems).length) errors[line.id] = problems;
    }
    setLineErrors(errors);
    if (Object.keys(errors).length) {
      setGlobalError('Fix the highlighted receipt lines before posting.');
      return;
    }
    if (!anyPlanned) {
      setGlobalError('Enter the quantity received for at least one line.');
      return;
    }
    setGlobalError('');
    setConfirming(true);
  };

  const post = async () => {
    if (busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setGlobalError('');
    let created = null;
    try {
      const grRes = await api.post('/procurement/goods-receipts/', {
        purchase_order: Number(orderId),
        delivery_note_number: meta.delivery_note_number.trim(),
        invoice_number: meta.invoice_number.trim(),
        notes: meta.notes.trim(),
      });
      created = grRes.data;
      for (const line of planned) {
        const noteParts = [];
        if (line.rejection_reason.trim()) noteParts.push(`Rejection reason: ${line.rejection_reason.trim()}`);
        if (line.damage_notes.trim()) noteParts.push(`Damage: ${line.damage_notes.trim()}`);
        await api.post('/procurement/goods-receipt-items/', {
          goods_receipt: created.id,
          purchase_order_item: line.id,
          quantity_received: line.received,
          quantity_rejected: line.rejected,
          quantity_damaged: line.damaged,
          accepted_quantity: line.accepted,
          rejection_reason: line.rejection_reason.trim(),
          damage_notes: line.damage_notes.trim(),
          notes: noteParts.join(' Â· '),
        });
      }
      setConfirming(false);
      setSubmitted(true);
      setSubmittedReceipt(created);
      window.location.hash = `#/procurement/receipts/${created.id}`;
    } catch (e) {
      const status = e?.response?.status;
      const parsed = parseFieldErrors(e);
      if (status === 409) {
        await loadOrder(orderId);
        setGlobalError('This order changed while you were working. Balances were reloaded â€” review the quantities before posting again.');
      } else if (status === 403) {
        setGlobalError('You do not have permission to perform this action.');
      } else if (created) {
        setGlobalError(`Receipt ${created.gr_number} was created but some lines could not be booked: ${parsed.global || Object.values(parsed.fields)[0] || 'unknown error'}. Open the receipt to review it.`);
      } else {
        setGlobalError(parsed.global || Object.values(parsed.fields)[0] || 'Could not record the goods receipt.');
      }
      setConfirming(false);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  if (!caps.canViewProcurement) {
    return <EmptyState title="Access restricted" hint="Procurement is available to IT staff only." />;
  }

  if (loading) return <LoadingRows />;

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div>
        <PageHeader title="Goods receipt" />
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>
        <div className="row-gap">
          <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={loadReceipt}>Retry</button>
          <a className="btn-ghost" href="#/procurement/receipts">Back to receipts</a>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (isView) {
    if (!receipt) return null;
    const summary = receiptSummary(receipt);
    const discrepancyLines = (receipt.items || []).filter(
      (line) => Number(line.quantity_rejected) > 0 || Number(line.quantity_damaged) > 0,
    );
    return (
      <div>
        <PageHeader
          title={receipt.gr_number}
          sub={order ? `Purchase order ${order.po_number}` : undefined}
          actions={(
            <div className="row-gap">
              <a className="btn-ghost" href="#/procurement/receipts">All receipts</a>
              {order ? <a className="btn-ghost" href={`#/procurement/orders/${order.id}`}>Purchase order</a> : null}
            </div>
          )}
        />

        <div className="panel">
          <div className="panel-head"><h3>Receipt details</h3></div>
          <div className="panel-pad">
            <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Received</span><div className="small">{formatDateTime(receipt.received_at)}</div></div>
            <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Received by</span><div className="small">{receipt.received_by_name || 'â€”'}</div></div>
            <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Delivery note</span><div className="small">{receipt.delivery_note_number || 'â€”'}</div></div>
            <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Invoice</span><div className="small">{receipt.invoice_number || 'â€”'}</div></div>
            <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Notes</span><div className="small">{receipt.notes || 'â€”'}</div></div>
            <div className="field">
              <span className="form-label">Quantities</span>
              <div className="small">
                {summary.accepted} accepted Â· {summary.rejected} rejected Â· {summary.damaged} damaged
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
          <h3>Receipt lines</h3>
          <DataTable
            columns={[
              {
                key: 'line',
                label: 'Purchase order line',
                render: (r) => order?.items?.find((line) => line.id === r.purchase_order_item)?.item_name
                  ?? `Line ${r.purchase_order_item}`,
              },
              { key: 'quantity_received', label: 'Received', render: (r) => formatQuantity(r.quantity_received) },
              {
                key: 'accepted',
                label: 'Accepted',
                render: (r) => formatQuantity(
                  r.accepted_quantity
                  ?? Math.max(0, Number(r.quantity_received) - Number(r.quantity_rejected) - Number(r.quantity_damaged)),
                ),
              },
              { key: 'quantity_rejected', label: 'Rejected', render: (r) => formatQuantity(r.quantity_rejected) },
              { key: 'quantity_damaged', label: 'Damaged', render: (r) => formatQuantity(r.quantity_damaged) },
              { key: 'discrepancy_status', label: 'Discrepancy', render: (r) => (r.discrepancy_status || 'none').replace(/_/g, ' ') },
              { key: 'inspection_status', label: 'Inspection', render: (r) => (r.inspection_status || 'â€”').replace(/_/g, ' ') },
              { key: 'notes', label: 'Legacy notes', render: (r) => r.notes || 'â€”' },
            ]}
            rows={receipt.items || []}
            keyOf={(r) => `gr-line-${r.id}`}
            emptyTitle="No receipt lines."
            emptyHint=""
          />
        </div>

        <div style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>

          ) : (

                      ?? `Line ${r.purchase_order_item}`,
                  },
                  { key: 'quantity_rejected', label: 'Rejected', render: (r) => formatQuantity(r.quantity_rejected) },
                  { key: 'quantity_damaged', label: 'Damaged', render: (r) => formatQuantity(r.quantity_damaged) },
                  { key: 'rejection_reason', label: 'Rejection reason', render: (r) => r.rejection_reason || 'â€”' },
                  { key: 'damage_notes', label: 'Damage notes', render: (r) => r.damage_notes || 'â€”' },
                  { key: 'notes', label: 'Legacy notes', render: (r) => r.notes || 'â€”' },
                  { key: 'vendor', label: 'Vendor', render: () => order?.vendor_detail?.name ?? 'â€”' },
                ]}
                rows={discrepancyLines}
                keyOf={(r) => `disc-${r.id}`}
                emptyTitle="No discrepancies."
                emptyHint=""
              />
              <p className="small muted">
                Discrepancy recorded for follow-up. Vendor return processing is not included in this release.
              </p>

          )}

          <h3>Inventory and asset results</h3>
          <DataTable
            columns={[
              {
                key: 'item',
                label: 'PO line',
                render: (r) => order?.items?.find((line) => line.id === r.purchase_order_item)?.item_name
                  ?? `Line ${r.purchase_order_item}`,
              },
              {
                key: 'type',
                label: 'Item type',
                render: (r) => {
                  const poLine = order?.items?.find((line) => line.id === r.purchase_order_item);
                  return poLine ? (poLine.is_serialized ? 'Serialized asset' : 'Item') : 'â€”';
                },

              },
              {
                key: 'stock',
                label: 'Linked stock item',
                render: (r) => {
                  const poLine = order?.items?.find((line) => line.id === r.purchase_order_item);
                  return poLine?.stock_item
                    ? <a href={`#/inventory/items/${poLine.stock_item}`}>Stock item #{poLine.stock_item}</a>
                    : 'Not linked';
                },
              },
            ]}
            rows={receipt.items || []}
            keyOf={(r) => `inv-${r.id}`}
            emptyTitle="No lines."
            emptyHint=""
          />
          <p className="small muted">
            Only accepted quantities enter normal inventory. Rejected and damaged units never
            enter available stock, and accepted serialized units create pending asset
            registration records.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>
          <h3>Pending asset registration</h3>
          {assetItems.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              title="No pending asset units from this receipt."
              hint="Pending rows appear for accepted serialized units only."
            />
          ) : (
            <DataTable
              columns={[
                { key: 'item_name', label: 'Item' },
