                { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (r) => (r.status || '').replace(/_/g, ' ') },
                { key: 'purchase_cost', label: 'Unit cost', render: (r) => formatMoney(r.purchase_cost, order?.currency) },
                {
                  key: 'asset',
                  label: 'Registered asset',
                  render: (r) => (r.asset
                    ? <a href={`#/assets/${r.asset}`}>{r.asset_tag || `Asset ${r.asset}`}</a>
                    : 'â€”'),
                },
              ]}
              rows={assetItems}
              keyOf={(r) => `asset-item-${r.id}`}
              emptyTitle="No pending units."
              emptyHint=""
            />
          )}
          <p className="small muted">
            <a href="#/procurement/assets">Open asset registration â†’</a>
            {' '}to register one asset per accepted serialized unit.
          </p>
        </div>

        <ProcurementAttachments
          parentType="goods_receipt"
          parentId={receipt.id}
          canUpload={caps.canViewProcurement}
          title="Receipt attachments"
        />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const selectableOrders = orders;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Record goods receipt"
        sub="Book what actually arrived against an issued purchase order."
        actions={<a className="btn-ghost" href="#/procurement/receipts">Cancel</a>}
      />

      {globalError ? <ErrorSummary parsed={{ global: globalError }} /> : null}

      {submitted && submittedReceipt ? (
        <div className="panel" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
          <div className="panel-head"><h3>Receipt recorded</h3></div>
          <div className="panel-pad">
            <p className="small">
              Goods receipt <strong>{submittedReceipt.gr_number}</strong> was recorded against{' '}
              <strong>{order?.po_number}</strong>. The receipt is now read-only.
            </p>
            <div className="row-gap" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
              <a className="btn-primary" href={`#/procurement/receipts/${submittedReceipt.id}`}>View receipt</a>
              <a className="btn-ghost" href="#/procurement/receipts">All receipts</a>
              <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => { setSubmitted(false); setSubmittedReceipt(null); setGlobalError(''); }}>Record another receipt</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <div className="panel">
        <div className="panel-head"><h3>Receipt details</h3></div>
        <div className="panel-pad">
          <Field label="Purchase order" required>
            <select
              className="input" value={orderId}
              onChange={(e) => { setOrderId(e.target.value); loadOrder(e.target.value); }}
              aria-label="Purchase order"
            >
              <option value="">Select a purchase orderâ€¦</option>
              {selectableOrders.map((po) => (
                <option key={po.id} value={po.id}>
                  {po.po_number} â€” {po.vendor_detail?.name} ({po.status.replace(/_/g, ' ')})
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="Delivery note number">
            <input
              className="input" value={meta.delivery_note_number}
              onChange={(e) => setMeta((m) => ({ ...m, delivery_note_number: e.target.value }))}
              aria-label="Delivery note number"
            />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Invoice number">
            <input
              className="input" value={meta.invoice_number}
              onChange={(e) => setMeta((m) => ({ ...m, invoice_number: e.target.value }))}
              aria-label="Invoice number"
            />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Notes">
            <textarea
              className="input" rows={2} value={meta.notes}
              onChange={(e) => setMeta((m) => ({ ...m, notes: e.target.value }))}
              aria-label="Receipt notes"
            />
          </Field>
        </div>
      </div>

      {!order ? (
        <EmptyState
          title="Select a purchase order."
          hint="Only approved, issued or partially received orders can accept a new receipt."
        />
      ) : (
        <div style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
          <h3>Lines on {order.po_number}</h3>
          <p className="small muted">
            Vendor {order.vendor_detail?.name} Â· total {formatMoney(order.total, order.currency)} Â· ordered{' '}
            {formatDate(order.created_at)}
          </p>
          {lines.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState title="This order has no lines." hint="A receipt needs at least one order line." />
          ) : (
            lines.map((line) => {
              const problems = lineErrors[line.id] || {};
              return (
                <div key={line.id} className="panel" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
                  <div className="panel-head">
                    <h4>{line.item_name}</h4>
                  </div>
                  <div className="panel-pad">
                    <p className="small" style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>
                      Ordered {formatQuantity(line.ordered)} Â· previously accepted {formatQuantity(line.alreadyAccepted)}
                      {' Â· previously rejected '}{formatQuantity(line.alreadyRejected)}
                      {' Â· previously damaged '}{formatQuantity(line.alreadyDamaged)}
                      {' Â· remaining '}{formatQuantity(line.remaining)}
                      {line.stock_item ? <> Â· <a href={`#/inventory/items/${line.stock_item}`}>linked stock item</a></> : null}
                    </p>
                    <div className="row-gap">
                      {QUANTITY_FIELDS.map((field) => (
                        <Field
                          key={field}
                          label={field === 'received' ? 'Quantity received' : field === 'rejected' ? 'Rejected' : 'Damaged'}
                          error={problems[field]}
                        >
                          <input
                            type="number" min="0" step="1" className="input"
                            value={line[field]}
                            onChange={(e) => setLine(line.id, field, e.target.value)}
                            aria-label={`${field} quantity for ${line.item_name}`}
                            disabled={line.remaining === 0}
                          />
                        </Field>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                    {Number(line.rejected) > 0 ? (
                      <Field label="Rejection reason" required error={problems.rejection_reason}>
                        <input
                          className="input" value={line.rejection_reason}
                          onChange={(e) => setLine(line.id, 'rejection_reason', e.target.value)}
                          aria-label={`Rejection reason for ${line.item_name}`}
                        />
                      </Field>
                    ) : null}
                    {Number(line.damaged) > 0 ? (
                      <Field label="Damage notes" required error={problems.damage_notes}>
                        <input
                          className="input" value={line.damage_notes}
                          onChange={(e) => setLine(line.id, 'damage_notes', e.target.value)}
                          aria-label={`Damage notes for ${line.item_name}`}
                        />
                      </Field>
                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })
          )}
          <div className="row-gap">
            <button
              type="button" className="btn-primary"
              onClick={review}
              disabled={busy || submitted || lines.length === 0 || !anyPlanned}
            >
              Review and record receipt
            </button>
            <span className="small muted">The procurement API records the receipt immediately â€” there is no draft receipt.</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {confirming ? (
        <ConfirmDialog
          title="Record this goods receipt?"
          message="Review the arrivals below. Recording books the receipt against the purchase order and updates the outstanding balances."
          confirmLabel={busy ? 'Recordingâ€¦' : 'Record receipt'}
          busy={busy}
          onCancel={() => setConfirming(false)}
          onConfirm={post}
        >
          <ul className="small">
            {planned.map((line) => (
              <li key={`planned-${line.id}`}>
                {line.item_name}: {line.accepted} accepted, {line.rejected} rejected, {line.damaged} damaged
                {line.stock_item ? ' (linked stock item will keep its own balance)' : ''}
                {line.is_serialized ? ' â€” serialized item ready for asset registration' : ''}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          <p className="small muted">
            Rejected and damaged quantities are recorded as discrepancies and are not accepted.
            Recording this receipt updates accepted Inventory and creates pending Asset
            registration records. The receipt becomes read-only once posted.
          </p>
        </ConfirmDialog>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}



===== src\pages\procurement\GoodsReceipts.jsx =====

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import api from '../../api';
import {
  DataTable, Field, LoadingRows, PageHeader, Pager,
} from '../../components';
import {
  buildGoodsReceiptListUrl,
  formatDate,
  parseFieldErrors,
  procurementCapabilities,
  receiptSummary,
  safeResults,
} from '../../shared/procurement-utils';

const PAGE_SIZE = 20;

/** Goods receipt list with server-side search, filters and pagination. */
export function GoodsReceiptsPage({ purchaseOrderId }) {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const caps = procurementCapabilities(auth);
  const [receipts, setReceipts] = useState([]);
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState({
    q: '', from: '', to: '', discrepancy: '', ordering: '-received_at',
  });

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const response = await api.get(buildGoodsReceiptListUrl({
        page,
        page_size: PAGE_SIZE,
        search: filters.q,
        received_from: filters.from,
        received_to: filters.to,
        discrepancy: filters.discrepancy,
        purchase_order: purchaseOrderId || '',
        ordering: filters.ordering,
      }));
      setReceipts(safeResults(response.data));
      setCount(Number(response.data?.count ?? safeResults(response.data).length));
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseFieldErrors(e).global || 'Could not load goods receipts.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [page, filters, purchaseOrderId]);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect

  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(count / PAGE_SIZE));
  const currentPage = Math.min(page, pageCount);
  const update = (key, value) => { setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, [key]: value })); setPage(1); };

  if (!caps.canViewProcurement) {
    return <div className="empty-state"><div className="empty-title">Access restricted</div><div className="small">Procurement is available to IT staff only.</div></div>;
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title={purchaseOrderId ? 'Goods receipts for this order' : 'Goods receipts'}
        sub="Recorded deliveries, accepted quantities and discrepancies."
        actions={(
          <div className="row-gap">
            <a className="btn-ghost" href="#/procurement">Overview</a>
            {caps.canCreateGoodsReceipt ? (
              <a className="btn-primary" href={purchaseOrderId ? `#/procurement/receipts/new?po=${purchaseOrderId}` : '#/procurement/receipts/new'}>
                Record receipt
              </a>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        )}
      />

      <div className="panel">
        <div className="panel-head"><h3>Filters</h3></div>
        <div className="panel-pad">
          <div className="row-gap">
            <Field label="Search">
              <input
                className="input" value={filters.q}
                onChange={(e) => update('q', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Receipt, PO, delivery note, invoice"
              />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Received from">
              <input type="date" className="input" value={filters.from} onChange={(e) => update('from', e.target.value)} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Received to">
              <input type="date" className="input" value={filters.to} onChange={(e) => update('to', e.target.value)} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Discrepancies">
              <select className="input" value={filters.discrepancy} onChange={(e) => update('discrepancy', e.target.value)} aria-label="Discrepancies">
                <option value="">Any</option>
                <option value="true">With rejected or damaged units</option>
                <option value="false">Without discrepancies</option>
              </select>
            </Field>
            <Field label="Order by">
              <select className="input" value={filters.ordering} onChange={(e) => update('ordering', e.target.value)} aria-label="Order by">
                <option value="-received_at">Newest received</option>
                <option value="received_at">Oldest received</option>
                <option value="gr_number">Receipt number</option>
              </select>
            </Field>
          </div>
          <div className="row-gap" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
            <span className="small muted">{count} receipt(s)</span>
            <button type="button" className="btn-ghost btn-small" onClick={load} disabled={loading}>Refresh</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {loading ? <LoadingRows /> : null}
      {error ? (
        <div>
          <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>
          <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={load}>Retry</button>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {!loading && !error ? (
        <>
          <DataTable
            columns={[
              { key: 'gr_number', label: 'Receipt', render: (r) => <a className="row-title" href={`#/procurement/receipts/${r.id}`}>{r.gr_number}</a> },
              {
                key: 'po',
                label: 'Purchase order',
                render: (r) => (
                  <a href={`#/procurement/orders/${r.purchase_order}`}>
                    {r.purchase_order_number || `#${r.purchase_order}`}
                  </a>
                ),
              },
              { key: 'vendor', label: 'Vendor', render: (r) => r.vendor_name ?? 'â€”' },
              { key: 'received_at', label: 'Received', render: (r) => formatDate(r.received_at) },
              { key: 'received_by_name', label: 'Received by', render: (r) => r.received_by_name || 'â€”' },
              { key: 'delivery_note_number', label: 'Delivery note', render: (r) => r.delivery_note_number || 'â€”' },
              { key: 'invoice_number', label: 'Invoice', render: (r) => r.invoice_number || 'â€”' },
              { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: () => <span className="badge badge-green">Recorded</span> },
              { key: 'accepted', label: 'Accepted', render: (r) => receiptSummary(r).accepted },
              { key: 'rejected', label: 'Rejected', render: (r) => receiptSummary(r).rejected },
              { key: 'damaged', label: 'Damaged', render: (r) => receiptSummary(r).damaged },
              {
                key: 'actions',
                label: 'Actions',
                render: (r) => (
                  <div className="row-gap">
                    <a className="btn-ghost btn-small" href={`#/procurement/receipts/${r.id}`}>View</a>
                    <a className="btn-ghost btn-small" href={`#/procurement/orders/${r.purchase_order}`}>Purchase order</a>
                  </div>
                ),
              },
            ]}
            rows={receipts}
            keyOf={(r) => `gr-${r.id}`}
            emptyTitle="No goods receipts recorded."
            emptyHint="Book a delivery against an issued purchase order."
          />
          <Pager
            count={count}
            hasPrev={currentPage > 1}
            hasNext={currentPage < pageCount}
            onPrev={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
            onNext={() => setPage((p) => Math.min(pageCount, p + 1))}
            busy={loading}
            pageLabel={`Page ${currentPage} of ${pageCount}`}
          />
        </>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\pages\procurement\ProcurementAssets.jsx =====

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import {
  DataTable, EmptyState, ErrorSummary, Field, LoadingRows, Modal, PageHeader, Pager,
} from '../../components';
import {
  PROCUREMENT_ASSET_STATUS_LABELS,
  buildAssetReceiptItemsUrl,
  fetchAll,
  formatDate,
  formatMoney,
  parseFieldErrors,
  procurementCapabilities,
  safeResults,
} from '../../shared/procurement-utils';

const PAGE_SIZE = 20;

function blankForm(item) {
  return {
    asset_tag: '',
    serial_number: '',
    name: item?.item_name || '',
    category: item?.asset_category ? String(item.asset_category) : '',
    model: '',
    manufacturer: '',
    purchase_date: item?.expected_purchase_date || '',
    purchase_cost: item?.purchase_cost != null ? String(item.purchase_cost) : '',
    warranty_expiry: '',
    location: '',
    department: '',
    notes: '',
  };
}

/**
 * Pending serialized asset registration.
 *
 * Each row is a real `ProcurementAssetReceiptItem` created from an accepted
 * serialized receipt unit. Registration calls the atomic register-asset
 * action; the backend creates and links the Asset, so the source receipt and
 * purchase order are always traceable.
 */
export function ProcurementAssetsPage() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const caps = procurementCapabilities(auth);
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [active, setActive] = useState(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState(blankForm(null));
  const [formErrors, setFormErrors] = useState({});
  const [globalError, setGlobalError] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState('');

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const [response, categoryRows] = await Promise.all([
        api.get(buildAssetReceiptItemsUrl({
          page, page_size: PAGE_SIZE, status: 'pending_registration',
        })),
        fetchAll('/assets/categories/?page_size=100').catch(() => []),
      ]);
      setItems(safeResults(response.data));
      setCount(Number(response.data?.count ?? safeResults(response.data).length));
      setCategories(categoryRows);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseFieldErrors(e).global || 'Could not load pending serialized deliveries.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [page]);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect

  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(count / PAGE_SIZE));
  const currentPage = Math.min(page, pageCount);

  const openRegister = (item) => {
    setActive(item);
    setForm(blankForm(item));
    setFormErrors({});
    setGlobalError('');
  };

  const submit = async () => {
    if (busy || !active) return;
    const errors = {};
    if (!form.asset_tag.trim()) errors.asset_tag = 'Asset tag is required.';
    if (!form.name.trim()) errors.name = 'Asset name is required.';
    if (!form.category) errors.category = 'Select an asset category.';
    if (form.purchase_cost !== '' && Number(form.purchase_cost) < 0) {
      errors.purchase_cost = 'Purchase cost must be zero or more.';
    }
    setFormErrors(errors);
    if (Object.keys(errors).length) return;

    setBusy(true);
    setGlobalError('');
    try {
      const payload = {
        asset_tag: form.asset_tag.trim(),
        serial_number: form.serial_number.trim(),
        name: form.name.trim(),
        model: form.model.trim(),
        manufacturer: form.manufacturer.trim(),
        location: form.location.trim(),
        notes: form.notes.trim(),
        category: form.category ? Number(form.category) : null,
        department: form.department ? Number(form.department) : null,
        purchase_cost: form.purchase_cost === ''
          ? null : Number(form.purchase_cost).toFixed(2),
        warranty_expiry: form.warranty_expiry || null,
      };
      const response = await api.post(
        `/procurement/asset-receipt-items/${active.id}/register-asset/`, payload,
      );
      setNotice(`Asset ${response.data.asset_tag || form.asset_tag.trim()} registered.`);
      setActive(null);
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      const status = e?.response?.status;
      const parsed = parseFieldErrors(e);
      if (status === 409) {
        setGlobalError('This unit was already registered. The list has been refreshed.');
        setActive(null);
        await load();
      } else {
        setFormErrors(parsed.fields || {});
        setGlobalError(parsed.global || Object.values(parsed.fields || {})[0] || 'Could not register the asset.');
      }
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  if (!caps.canViewProcurement) {
    return <EmptyState title="Access restricted" hint="Procurement is available to IT staff only." />;
  }

  if (loading) return <LoadingRows />;

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div>
        <PageHeader title="Asset registration" />
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>
        <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={load}>Retry</button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Pending asset registration"
        sub="One asset per accepted serialized unit, linked to its receipt and purchase order."
        actions={(
          <div className="row-gap">
            <a className="btn-ghost" href="#/procurement">Overview</a>
            <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={load}>Refresh</button>
          </div>
        )}
      />

      {notice ? <div className="success-summary" role="status">{notice}</div> : null}
      {!caps.canRegisterProcurementAssets ? (
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">
          Your role can view pending assets but cannot register them.
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <p className="small muted">
        Pending units come from accepted serialized quantities on recorded goods receipts.
        Vendor, purchase date and purchase cost are inherited from the order and receipt.
      </p>

      {items.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          title="Nothing awaiting asset registration."
          hint="Accepted serialized deliveries will appear here."
        />
      ) : (
        <>
          <DataTable
            columns={[
              { key: 'po', label: 'Purchase order', render: (r) => <a href={`#/procurement/orders/${r.purchase_order}`}>{r.po_number}</a> },
              { key: 'receipt', label: 'Goods receipt', render: (r) => <a href={`#/procurement/receipts/${r.goods_receipt}`}>{r.gr_number}</a> },
              { key: 'vendor', label: 'Vendor', render: (r) => r.vendor_name ?? 'â€”' },
              { key: 'item', label: 'Asset item', render: (r) => <span className="row-title">{r.item_name}</span> },
              { key: 'sequence', label: 'Unit' },
              { key: 'purchase_cost', label: 'Unit cost', render: (r) => formatMoney(r.purchase_cost) },
              { key: 'expected_purchase_date', label: 'Received', render: (r) => formatDate(r.expected_purchase_date) },
              { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (r) => PROCUREMENT_ASSET_STATUS_LABELS[r.status] ?? r.status },
              {
                key: 'actions',
                label: 'Actions',
                render: (r) => (
                  <button
                    type="button" className="btn-small"
                    onClick={() => openRegister(r)}
                    disabled={!caps.canRegisterProcurementAssets}
                  >
                    Register asset
                  </button>
                ),
              },
            ]}
            rows={items}
            keyOf={(r) => `asset-item-${r.id}`}
            emptyTitle="Nothing pending."
            emptyHint=""
          />
          <Pager
            count={count}
            hasPrev={currentPage > 1}
            hasNext={currentPage < pageCount}
            onPrev={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
            onNext={() => setPage((p) => Math.min(pageCount, p + 1))}
            busy={loading}
            pageLabel={`Page ${currentPage} of ${pageCount}`}
          />
        </>
      )}

      {active ? (
        <Modal title="Register asset" onClose={() => { if (!busy) setActive(null); }} size="wide">
          <p className="small" style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>
            From {active.po_number} Â· {active.gr_number} Â· vendor {active.vendor_name ?? 'â€”'}
            {' '}Â· unit {active.sequence}.
          </p>
          <div className="row-gap">
            <Field label="Asset tag" required error={formErrors.asset_tag}>
              <input className="input" value={form.asset_tag} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, asset_tag: e.target.value }))} aria-label="Asset tag" />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Serial number" error={formErrors.serial_number}>
              <input className="input" value={form.serial_number} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, serial_number: e.target.value }))} aria-label="Serial number" />
            </Field>
          </div>
          <Field label="Asset name" required error={formErrors.name}>
            <input className="input" value={form.name} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, name: e.target.value }))} aria-label="Asset name" />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Category" required error={formErrors.category}>
            <select className="input" value={form.category} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, category: e.target.value }))} aria-label="Category">
              <option value="">Select a categoryâ€¦</option>
              {categories.filter((c) => c.is_active !== false).map((c) => (
                <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.name}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </Field>
          <div className="row-gap">
            <Field label="Manufacturer">
              <input className="input" value={form.manufacturer} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, manufacturer: e.target.value }))} aria-label="Manufacturer" />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Model">
              <input className="input" value={form.model} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, model: e.target.value }))} aria-label="Model" />
            </Field>
          </div>
          <div className="row-gap">
            <Field label="Purchase cost" error={formErrors.purchase_cost}>
              <input type="number" min="0" step="0.01" className="input" value={form.purchase_cost} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, purchase_cost: e.target.value }))} aria-label="Purchase cost" />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Warranty expiry" error={formErrors.warranty_expiry}>
              <input type="date" className="input" value={form.warranty_expiry} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, warranty_expiry: e.target.value }))} aria-label="Warranty expiry" />
            </Field>
          </div>
          <div className="row-gap">
            <Field label="Location">
              <input className="input" value={form.location} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, location: e.target.value }))} aria-label="Location" />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Department ID">
              <input type="number" min="1" className="input" value={form.department} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, department: e.target.value }))} aria-label="Department ID" />
            </Field>
          </div>
          <Field label="Notes">
            <textarea className="input" rows={3} value={form.notes} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, notes: e.target.value }))} aria-label="Notes" />
          </Field>
          <p className="small muted">
            Vendor, purchase date and purchase cost are inherited from the purchase order and
            receipt. Serial numbers and asset tags must be unique â€” the backend rejects duplicates.
          </p>
          {globalError ? <ErrorSummary parsed={{ global: globalError }} /> : null}
          <div className="row-end">
            <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setActive(null)} disabled={busy}>Cancel</button>
            <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={submit} disabled={busy}>
              {busy ? 'Registeringâ€¦' : 'Register asset'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}



===== src\pages\procurement\ProcurementAttachments.jsx =====

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import {
  DataTable, Field, LoadingRows,
} from '../../components';
import {
  ATTACHMENT_DOCUMENT_TYPES,
  buildAttachmentListUrl,
  filenameFromContentDisposition,
  formatDateTime,
  parseFieldErrors,
  safeResults,
} from '../../shared/procurement-utils';

/**
 * Protected attachment panel for one procurement record.
 *
 * Downloads go through the authenticated API as a blob; the object URL is
 * always revoked, and no token is ever placed in a query string.
 */
export function ProcurementAttachments({
  parentType, parentId, canUpload = false, title = 'Attachments',
}) {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState('');
  const [documentType, setDocumentType] = useState('other');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [file, setFile] = useState(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [downloading, setDownloading] = useState(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const response = await api.get(buildAttachmentListUrl(parentType, parentId));
      setRows(safeResults(response.data));
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseFieldErrors(e).global || 'Could not load attachments.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [parentType, parentId]);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect

  const upload = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!file) {
      setError('Choose a file to upload.');
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    setError('');
    setNotice('');
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append(parentType, String(parentId));
    formData.append('document_type', documentType);
    formData.append('description', description.trim());
    formData.append('file', file);
    try {
      await api.post('/procurement/attachments/', formData);
      setNotice('Attachment uploaded.');
      setFile(null);
      setDescription('');
      setDocumentType('other');
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      const parsed = parseFieldErrors(e);
      setError(parsed.global || Object.values(parsed.fields)[0] || 'Upload failed.');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const download = async (row) => {
    setDownloading(row.id);
    setError('');
    try {
      const response = await api.get(
        `/procurement/attachments/${row.id}/download/`, { responseType: 'blob' },
      );
      const filename = filenameFromContentDisposition(
        response.headers?.['content-disposition'], row.original_filename || 'download',
      );
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(response.data);
      try {
        const anchor = document.createElement('a');
        anchor.href = url;
        anchor.download = filename;
        document.body.appendChild(anchor);
        anchor.click();
        anchor.remove();
      } finally {
        window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      const status = e?.response?.status;
      if (status === 404) {
        setError('This attachment is unavailable or you no longer have access.');
      } else {
        setError(parseFieldErrors(e).global || 'Could not download the attachment.');
      }
    } finally {
      setDownloading(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="panel" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
      <div className="panel-head"><h3>{title}</h3></div>
      <div className="panel-pad">
        {error ? <div className="field-error" role="alert">{error}</div> : null}
        {notice ? <div className="success-summary" role="status">{notice}</div> : null}
        {loading ? <LoadingRows /> : (
          <DataTable
            columns={[
              { key: 'original_filename', label: 'File' },
              { key: 'document_type', label: 'Type', render: (r) => String(r.document_type || '').replace(/_/g, ' ') },
              { key: 'description', label: 'Description', render: (r) => r.description || 'â€”' },
              { key: 'uploaded_by_name', label: 'Uploaded by', render: (r) => r.uploaded_by_name || 'â€”' },
              { key: 'created_at', label: 'Uploaded', render: (r) => formatDateTime(r.created_at) },
              { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (r) => r.status || 'active' },
              {
                key: 'actions',
                label: 'Actions',
                render: (r) => (
                  <button
                    type="button" className="btn-ghost btn-small"
                    onClick={() => download(r)}
                    disabled={downloading === r.id || r.status === 'archived'}
                  >
                    {downloading === r.id ? 'Downloadingâ€¦' : 'Download'}
                  </button>
                ),
              },
            ]}
            rows={rows}
            keyOf={(r) => `attachment-${r.id}`}
            emptyTitle="No attachments."
            emptyHint="Supporting documents appear here."
          />
        )}

        {canUpload ? (
          <form onSubmit={upload} style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
            <div className="row-gap">
              <Field label="Document type">
                <select
                  className="input" value={documentType}
                  onChange={(e) => setDocumentType(e.target.value)}
                  aria-label="Document type"
                >
                  {ATTACHMENT_DOCUMENT_TYPES.map((type) => (
                    <option key={type} value={type}>{type.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </Field>
              <Field label="File">
                <input
                  type="file" className="input" aria-label="Attachment file"
                  onChange={(e) => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}
                />
              </Field>
            </div>
            <Field label="Description">
              <input
                className="input" value={description}
                onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
                aria-label="Attachment description"
              />
            </Field>
            <button type="submit" className="btn-primary" disabled={busy || !file}>
              {busy ? 'Uploadingâ€¦' : 'Upload attachment'}
            </button>
          </form>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}



===== src\pages\procurement\ProcurementCreditNotes.jsx =====

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import {
  safeResults, formatMoney, statusLabel, parseFieldErrors, procurementCapabilities,
  vendorCreditNoteActionState, procurementErrorText, recordConflictText,
} from '../../shared/procurement-utils';

function Table({ columns, rows, empty = 'No records.' }) {
  if (!rows?.length) return <div className="empty-state"><div className="empty-title">{empty}</div></div>;
  return <div className="table-wrap"><table className="table"><thead><tr>{columns.map(c => <th key={c.key || c.label}>{c.label}</th>)}</tr></thead><tbody>{rows.map((row, i) => <tr key={row.id ?? i}>{columns.map(c => <td key={c.key || c.label}>{typeof c.render === 'function' ? c.render(row) : row[c.key]}</td>)}</tr>)}</tbody></table></div>;
}

function FormError({ error }) {
  if (!error) return null;
  const parsed = (error && ('global' in error || 'fields' in error)) ? error : parseFieldErrors(error);
  const fields = Object.entries(parsed?.fields || {});
  return (
    <div role="alert" className="error">
      {parsed?.global && <div>{parsed.global}</div>}
      {fields.length > 0 && <ul>{fields.map(([field, message]) => <li key={field}><strong>{field.replace(/_/g, ' ')}:</strong> {message}</li>)}</ul>}
    </div>
  );
}

export function ProcurementCreditNotesPage() {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const load = useCallback(() => {
    setLoading(true); setError('');
    return api.get('/procurement/credit-notes/?page_size=50')
      .then(r => setRows(safeResults(r.data)))
      .catch(e => setError(procurementErrorText(e, 'Failed to load credit notes.')))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect

  if (loading) return <p className="page-loading" role="status">Loading credit notesâ€¦</p>;
  return (
    <div>
      <div className="page-header"><h1>Credit Notes</h1><a className="btn" href="#/procurement/credit-notes/new">New Credit Note</a></div>
      {error && <div role="alert" className="error">{error} <button className="btn" onClick={load}>Retry</button></div>}
      <Table columns={[
        { label: 'Credit Note Number', render: r => <a href={`#/procurement/credit-notes/${r.id}`}>{r.credit_note_number}</a> },
        { label: 'Vendor', render: r => r.vendor_name || r.vendor },
        { label: 'Invoice', render: r => r.invoice_number || r.supplier_invoice },
        { label: 'Return', render: r => r.return_number || r.vendor_return || 'â€”' },
        { label: 'Date', key: 'credit_date' },
        { label: 'Status', render: r => statusLabel(r.status) },
        { label: 'Total', render: r => formatMoney(r.total, r.currency) },
        { label: 'Currency', key: 'currency' },
        { label: 'Applied Amount', render: r => formatMoney(r.applied_amount, r.currency) },
      ]} rows={rows} empty="No credit notes." />
    </div>
  );
}

export function ProcurementCreditNoteForm() {
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ credit_note_number: '', vendor: '', supplier_invoice: '', vendor_return: '', credit_date: '', currency: 'NPR', subtotal: '0.00', tax_total: '0.00', total: '0.00', reason: '', external_reference: '' });
  const [error, setError] = useState(null); const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  function set(k, v) { setForm(f => ({ ...f, [k]: v })); }
  async function save(e) {
    e.preventDefault(); if (saving) return;
    setSaving(true); setError(null);
    try {
      const r = await api.post('/procurement/credit-notes/', { ...form, vendor_return: form.vendor_return || null });
      if (!r.data?.id) { setError({ global: 'The server did not return the new credit note id.' }); return; }
      window.location.hash = `#/procurement/credit-notes/${r.data.id}`;
    } catch (err) {
      const p = parseFieldErrors(err);
      const status = err?.response?.status;
      const hasFields = Object.keys(p?.fields || {}).length > 0;
      setError(status === 403 || status === 404 || (!p?.global && !hasFields) ? { global: procurementErrorText(err, 'Failed to create credit note.') } : p);
    } finally { setSaving(false); }
  }
  return (
    <div>
      <h1>New Credit Note</h1>
      <FormError error={error} />
      <form onSubmit={save} className="form-grid">
        <label>Credit Note Number<input value={form.credit_note_number} onChange={e => set('credit_note_number', e.target.value)} required /></label>
        <label>Vendor ID<input value={form.vendor} onChange={e => set('vendor', e.target.value)} required /></label>
        <label>Supplier Invoice ID<input value={form.supplier_invoice} onChange={e => set('supplier_invoice', e.target.value)} required /></label>
        <label>Vendor Return ID<input value={form.vendor_return} onChange={e => set('vendor_return', e.target.value)} /></label>
        <label>Credit Date<input type="date" value={form.credit_date} onChange={e => set('credit_date', e.target.value)} required /></label>
        <label>Currency<input value={form.currency} onChange={e => set('currency', e.target.value)} required /></label>
        <label>Subtotal<input value={form.subtotal} onChange={e => set('subtotal', e.target.value)} /></label>
        <label>Tax Total<input value={form.tax_total} onChange={e => set('tax_total', e.target.value)} /></label>
        <label>Total<input value={form.total} onChange={e => set('total', e.target.value)} /></label>
        <label>Reason<textarea value={form.reason} onChange={e => set('reason', e.target.value)} /></label>
        <label>External Reference<input value={form.external_reference} onChange={e => set('external_reference', e.target.value)} /></label>
        <button className="btn primary" disabled={saving}>{saving ? 'Savingâ€¦' : 'Create'}</button>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

export function ProcurementCreditNoteDetail({ id }) {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const caps = procurementCapabilities(auth);
  const userId = auth?.user?.id;
  const [cn, setCn] = useState(null);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState('');

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try { const r = await api.get(`/procurement/credit-notes/${id}/`); setCn(r.data); }
    catch (e) { setLoadError(procurementErrorText(e, 'Failed to load.')); }
  }, [id]);
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect

  async function act(action, body = {}) {
    setBusy(action); setError('');
    try { await api.post(`/procurement/credit-notes/${id}/${action}/`, body); await load(); }
    catch (e) {
      if (e?.response?.status === 409) { setError(recordConflictText('credit note')); await load(); }
      else setError(procurementErrorText(e, 'Action failed.'));
    }
    finally { setBusy(''); }
  }

  if (!cn) return <p className="page-loading">{loadError ? <span role="alert">{loadError}</span> : 'Loadingâ€¦'}</p>;
  const isSystemAdmin = !!(auth?.isSystemAdmin || auth?.role === 'system_admin' || auth?.isSuperuser);
  const actions = vendorCreditNoteActionState(cn, caps, userId, isSystemAdmin);
  return (
    <div>
      <h1>Credit Note {cn.credit_note_number}</h1>
      {error && <div role="alert" className="error">{error}</div>}
      <div className="button-row" style={{flexWrap:'wrap',gap:'8px'}}>
        {actions.canSubmit && <button disabled={!!busy} onClick={() => act('submit')}>Submit</button>}
        {actions.canApprove && <button disabled={!!busy} onClick={() => act('approve')}>Approve</button>}
        {actions.canReject && <button disabled={!!busy} onClick={() => { const r = prompt('Reason'); if (r) act('reject', { reason: r }); }}>Reject</button>}
        {actions.canApply && <button disabled={!!busy} onClick={() => act('apply')}>Apply</button>}
        {actions.canCancel && <button disabled={!!busy} onClick={() => { const r = prompt('Reason'); if (r) act('cancel', { reason: r }); }}>Cancel</button>}
      </div>
      <dl className="detail-grid">
        <dt>Status</dt><dd>{statusLabel(cn.status)}</dd>
        <dt>Vendor</dt><dd>{cn.vendor_name || cn.vendor}</dd>
        <dt>Invoice</dt><dd>{cn.invoice_number || cn.supplier_invoice}</dd>
        <dt>Return</dt><dd>{cn.return_number || cn.vendor_return || 'â€”'}</dd>
        <dt>Currency</dt><dd>{cn.currency}</dd>
        <dt>Total</dt><dd>{formatMoney(cn.total, cn.currency)}</dd>
        <dt>Applied Amount</dt><dd>{formatMoney(cn.applied_amount, cn.currency)} â€” Credit applied to tracked Invoice balance.</dd>
      </dl>
      <h2>Lines</h2>
      <Table columns={[{ label: 'Description', key: 'description' }, { label: 'Quantity', key: 'quantity' }, { label: 'Amount', key: 'amount' }]} rows={cn.lines || []} empty="No lines." />
    </div>
  );
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import {
  DataTable, EmptyState, Field, LoadingRows, PageHeader,
} from '../../components';
import {
  PURCHASE_ORDER_STATUS_LABELS,
  PURCHASE_REQUEST_STATUS_LABELS,
  buildDashboardUrl,
  buildGoodsReceiptListUrl,
  buildPurchaseOrderListUrl,
  buildPurchaseRequestListUrl,
  fetchAll,
  formatDate,
  formatDateTime,

  formatQuantity,
  parseFieldErrors,
  procurementCapabilities,
  procurementOverview,

function Kpi({ label, value, hint }) {
  return (
    <div className="panel" style={{ minWidth: 170, flex: '1 1 170px' }}>
      <div className="panel-pad">
        <div className="small muted">{label}</div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 26, fontWeight: 600 }}>{value}</div>
        {hint ? <div className="small muted">{hint}</div> : null}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Legacy list aggregation, used only if the aggregate endpoint is missing
 *  during a rolling deployment. Never a permanent code path. */
async function loadLegacyDashboard() {
  const [requests, orders, receipts] = await Promise.all([
    fetchAll(buildPurchaseRequestListUrl()),
    fetchAll(buildPurchaseOrderListUrl()),
    fetchAll(buildGoodsReceiptListUrl()),
  ]);
  const overview = procurementOverview({ requests, orders, receipts });
  return {
    purchase_requests: {
      draft: overview.draftRequests,
      pending_manager_approval: overview.pendingRequestApprovals,
      pending_system_admin_approval: requests.filter(
        (r) => r.status === 'pending_approval' && r.requires_system_admin_approval).length,
      approved: requests.filter((r) => r.status === 'approved').length,
      rejected: requests.filter((r) => r.status === 'rejected').length,
      returned_for_correction: requests.filter(
        (r) => r.status === 'returned_for_correction').length,
    },
    quotations: {
      awaiting_collection: overview.approvedAwaitingQuotations,
      awaiting_selection: overview.quotationsAwaitingSelection,
      selected: requests.filter((r) => (r.quotations || []).some((q) => q.is_selected)).length,
    },
    purchase_orders: {
      pending_approval: overview.pendingOrderApprovals,
      sent_to_vendor: orders.filter((o) => o.status === 'sent_to_vendor').length,
      partially_received: overview.partiallyReceived,
      overdue_delivery: 0,
      closed: orders.filter((o) => o.status === 'closed').length,
      cancelled: orders.filter((o) => o.status === 'cancelled').length,
    },
    goods_receipts: {
      recent: receipts.length,
      with_rejections: overview.discrepancies,
      with_damage: 0,
      with_short_delivery: 0,
    },
    asset_registration: { pending: overview.pendingAssets, completed: 0 },
    values_by_currency: overview.orderValueByCurrency.map((row) => ({
      currency: row.currency,
      ordered_total: row.amount,
      received_total: '0.00',
      outstanding_total: row.amount,
    })),
    recent_purchase_requests: requests.slice(0, 10),
    recent_purchase_orders: orders.slice(0, 10),
    recent_receipts: receipts.slice(0, 10),
    upcoming_deliveries: [],
    overdue_deliveries: [],
    pending_asset_registration: overview.pendingAssetDetail.slice(0, 10),
    receipt_discrepancies: overview.discrepanciesDetail.slice(0, 10).map(({ receipt, line }) => ({
      id: line.id,
      goods_receipt: receipt.id,
      gr_number: receipt.gr_number,
      item_name: `Line ${line.purchase_order_item}`,
      quantity_rejected: line.quantity_rejected,
      quantity_damaged: line.quantity_damaged,
      rejection_reason: line.rejection_reason,
      damage_notes: line.damage_notes,
    })),
    _legacy: true,
  };
}

function useDashboard(filters, enabled) {
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(!!enabled);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [refreshedAt, setRefreshedAt] = useState(null);
  const [legacy, setLegacy] = useState(false);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const response = await api.get(buildDashboardUrl(filters));
      setData(response.data);
      setLegacy(false);
      setRefreshedAt(new Date());
    } catch (e) {
      const status = e?.response?.status;
      // Only an unavailable endpoint during a rolling deploy triggers the
      // fallback; auth/permission/server errors are surfaced honestly.
      if (!status || status === 404) {
        try {
          setData(await loadLegacyDashboard());
          setLegacy(true);
          setRefreshedAt(new Date());
        } catch (fallbackError) {
          setError(parseFieldErrors(fallbackError).global || 'Could not load procurement data.');
        }
      } else if (status === 403) {
        setError('You do not have access to the procurement dashboard.');
      } else {
        setError(parseFieldErrors(e).global || 'Could not load procurement data.');
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [filters]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (enabled) load(); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
  }, [enabled, load]);

  return { data, loading, error, refreshedAt, legacy, load };
}

/** Procurement overview from the server aggregate endpoint. */
export function ProcurementDashboard() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const caps = procurementCapabilities(auth);
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState({
    date_from: '', date_to: '', department: '', vendor: '', currency: '',
  });
  const queryFilters = useMemo(() => ({ ...filters }), [filters]);
  const {
    data, loading, error, refreshedAt, legacy, load,
  } = useDashboard(queryFilters, caps.canViewProcurement);

  if (!caps.canViewProcurement) {
    return (
      <div>
        <PageHeader title="Procurement" />
        <EmptyState
          title="Procurement is not available to your role"
          hint="Procurement is administered by IT Support, IT Manager and System Admin users."
        />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const requests = data?.purchase_requests || {};
  const quotations = data?.quotations || {};
  const orders = data?.purchase_orders || {};
  const receipts = data?.goods_receipts || {};
  const assets = data?.asset_registration || {};
  const currencies = data?.values_by_currency || [];
  const recentRequests = data?.recent_purchase_requests || [];
  const recentOrders = data?.recent_purchase_orders || [];
  const recentReceipts = data?.recent_receipts || [];
  const pendingAssets = data?.pending_asset_registration || [];
  const discrepancies = data?.receipt_discrepancies || [];
  const vendors = new Map();
  for (const order of [...recentOrders, ...(data?.upcoming_deliveries || [])]) {
    if (order.vendor) vendors.set(String(order.vendor), order.vendor_detail?.name ?? `Vendor ${order.vendor}`);
  }
  const pendingApprovalRequests = recentRequests.filter(
    (r) => r.status === 'pending_approval').slice(0, 6);
  const setFilter = (key, value) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, [key]: value }));

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Procurement"
        sub="Purchase requests, vendor quotations, orders and deliveries."
        actions={(
          <div className="row-gap">
            <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={load} disabled={loading}>Refresh</button>
            <a className="btn-ghost" href="#/procurement/requests">Purchase requests</a>
            <a className="btn-ghost" href="#/procurement/orders">Purchase orders</a>
            <a className="btn-ghost" href="#/procurement/receipts">Goods receipts</a>
          </div>
        )}
      />

      <div className="panel">
        <div className="panel-head"><h3>Filters</h3></div>
        <div className="panel-pad">
          <div className="row-gap">
            <Field label="Created from">
              <input type="date" className="input" value={filters.date_from} onChange={(e) => setFilter('date_from', e.target.value)} aria-label="Created from" />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Created to">
              <input type="date" className="input" value={filters.date_to} onChange={(e) => setFilter('date_to', e.target.value)} aria-label="Created to" />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Department ID">
              <input type="number" min="1" className="input" value={filters.department} onChange={(e) => setFilter('department', e.target.value)} aria-label="Department ID" />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Currency">
              <select className="input" value={filters.currency} onChange={(e) => setFilter('currency', e.target.value)} aria-label="Currency">
                <option value="">All currencies</option>
                {currencies.map((row) => <option key={row.currency} value={row.currency}>{row.currency}</option>)}
              </select>
            </Field>
            <Field label="Vendor">

function useProcurementData(enabled) {
  const [requests, setRequests] = useState([]);
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState([]);
  const [receipts, setReceipts] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(!!enabled);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [refreshedAt, setRefreshedAt] = useState(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const [requestRows, orderRows, receiptRows] = await Promise.all([
        fetchAll(buildPurchaseRequestListUrl()),
        fetchAll(buildPurchaseOrderListUrl()),
        fetchAll(buildGoodsReceiptListUrl()),
      ]);
      setRequests(requestRows);
      setOrders(orderRows);
      setReceipts(receiptRows);
      setRefreshedAt(new Date());
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseFieldErrors(e).global || 'Could not load procurement data.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (enabled) load(); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
  }, [enabled, load]);

  return {
    requests, orders, receipts, loading, error, refreshedAt, load,
  };
}

/** Reporting view aggregated from the same real list endpoints. */
export function ProcurementReports() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const caps = procurementCapabilities(auth);

    requests, orders, receipts, loading, error, refreshedAt, load,
  } = useProcurementData(caps.canViewProcurementReports);

  const overview = useMemo(
    () => procurementOverview({ requests, orders, receipts }),
    [requests, orders, receipts],
  );

    .map(([status, label]) => ({
      status,
      label,
      count: orders.filter((order) => order.status === status).length,
      value: orders.filter((order) => order.status === status)
        .reduce((sum, order) => sum + Number(order.total || 0), 0),
    }))
    .filter((row) => row.count > 0), [orders]);

  const requestStatusRows = useMemo(() => Object.entries(PURCHASE_REQUEST_STATUS_LABELS)
    .map(([status, label]) => ({
      status,

      value: requests.filter((request) => request.status === status)
        .reduce((sum, request) => sum + Number(request.estimated_total || 0), 0),

function Table({ columns, rows, empty = 'No records.' }) {
  if (!rows?.length) return <div className="empty-state"><div className="empty-title">{empty}</div></div>;
  return <div className="table-wrap"><table className="table"><thead><tr>{columns.map(c => <th key={c.key || c.label}>{c.label}</th>)}</tr></thead><tbody>{rows.map((row, i) => <tr key={row.id ?? i}>{columns.map(c => <td key={c.key || c.label}>{typeof c.render === 'function' ? c.render(row) : row[c.key]}</td>)}</tr>)}</tbody></table></div>;
}

function moneyOrDash(value) {
  return value === null || value === undefined ? 'â€”' : formatMoney(value);
}

export function ProcurementFinancialDashboard() {

  }, []);
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect

  if (loading) return <p className="page-loading" role="status">Loading financial dashboardâ€¦</p>;
  if (error) return <div role="alert" className="error">{error} <button className="btn" onClick={load}>Retry</button></div>;
  const c = data?.cards || {};

  return (

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import {
  safeResults, formatMoney, statusLabel, parseFieldErrors,
  procurementCapabilities, invoiceActionState, procurementErrorText, recordConflictText,
} from '../../shared/procurement-utils';

function Table({ columns, rows, empty = 'No records.' }) {
  if (!rows?.length) return <div className="empty-state"><div className="empty-title">{empty}</div></div>;
  return <div className="table-wrap"><table className="table"><thead><tr>{columns.map(c => <th key={c.key || c.label}>{c.label}</th>)}</tr></thead><tbody>{rows.map((row, i) => <tr key={row.id ?? i}>{columns.map(c => <td key={c.key || c.label}>{typeof c.render === 'function' ? c.render(row) : row[c.key]}</td>)}</tr>)}</tbody></table></div>;
}

function ActionError({ error }) {
  if (!error) return null;
  return (
    <div role="alert" className="error">
      {error.global && <div>{error.global}</div>}
      {Object.keys(error.fields || {}).length > 0 && (
        <ul>
          {Object.entries(error.fields).map(([field, message]) => (
            <li key={field}><strong>{field.replace(/_/g, ' ')}:</strong> {message}</li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

const EMPTY_LINE = { purchase_order_item: '', goods_receipt_item: '', description: '', invoiced_quantity: '1', unit_price: '0.00', discount_amount: '0.00', tax_rate: '0', tax_amount: '0.00' };

export function ProcurementInvoiceDetail({ id }) {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const caps = procurementCapabilities(auth);
  const userId = auth?.user?.id;
  const [inv, setInv] = useState(null);
  const [readiness, setReadiness] = useState(null);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState('');
  const [line, setLine] = useState(EMPTY_LINE);
  const [poItems, setPoItems] = useState([]);
  const [grItems, setGrItems] = useState([]);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const r = await api.get(`/procurement/supplier-invoices/${id}/`);
      setInv(r.data);
      const rd = await api.get(`/procurement/supplier-invoices/${id}/readiness/`);
      setReadiness(rd.data);
      return r.data;
    } catch (e) {
      setLoadError(procurementErrorText(e, 'Failed to load invoice.'));
      return null;
    }
  }, [id]);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!inv?.purchase_order) return;
    api.get(`/procurement/purchase-order-items/?purchase_order=${inv.purchase_order}`).then(r => setPoItems(safeResults(r.data))).catch(() => {});
    api.get('/procurement/goods-receipt-items/?page_size=200').then(r => setGrItems(safeResults(r.data))).catch(() => {});
  }, [inv?.purchase_order]);

  function errorFrom(e) {
    const parsed = parseFieldErrors(e);
    const status = e?.response?.status;
    if (status === 403 || status === 404 || (!parsed?.global && !Object.keys(parsed?.fields || {}).length)) {
      return { global: procurementErrorText(e, 'Action failed.') };
    }
    return parsed;
  }

  async function act(action, body = {}) {
    setBusy(action); setError(null);
    try {
      await api.post(`/procurement/supplier-invoices/${id}/${action}/`, body);
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      if (e?.response?.status === 409) {
        setError({ global: recordConflictText('invoice') });
        await load();
      } else {
        setError(errorFrom(e));
      }
    } finally { setBusy(''); }
  }

  async function addLine(e) {
    e.preventDefault(); setBusy('line'); setError(null);
    try {
      await api.post('/procurement/supplier-invoice-lines/', { ...line, invoice: id, goods_receipt_item: line.goods_receipt_item || null });
      setLine(EMPTY_LINE);
      await load();
    } catch (e2) {
      setError(errorFrom(e2));
    } finally { setBusy(''); }
  }

  if (!inv) return <p className="page-loading">{loadError ? <span role="alert">{loadError}</span> : 'Loading invoiceâ€¦'}</p>;
  const actions = invoiceActionState(inv, caps, userId);
  const isSystemAdmin = !!(auth?.isSystemAdmin || auth?.role === 'system_admin' || auth?.isSuperuser);
  const systemAdminRequired = !!inv.requires_system_admin_approval && !isSystemAdmin;
  return (
    <div>
      <div className="page-header"><h1>Invoice {inv.invoice_number}</h1><div className="small">Status: {statusLabel(inv.status)} | Match: {statusLabel(inv.latest_match?.overall_status || 'unmatched')} | Payment: {statusLabel(inv.payment_status)}</div></div>
      <ActionError error={error} />
      {systemAdminRequired && <div className="small" role="note">This invoice requires System Admin approval (high value, currency, or variance threshold).</div>}
      <div className="button-row" style={{flexWrap:'wrap',gap:'8px'}}>
        {actions.canSubmit && <button disabled={!!busy} onClick={() => act('submit')}>Submit</button>}
        {actions.canMatch && <button disabled={!!busy} onClick={() => act('match')}>Run Match</button>}
        {actions.canApprove && <button disabled={!!busy} onClick={() => act('approve')}>Approve</button>}
        {actions.canReject && <button disabled={!!busy} onClick={() => { const r = prompt('Rejection reason'); if (r) act('reject', { reason: r }); }}>Reject</button>}
        {actions.canReturnForCorrection && <button disabled={!!busy} onClick={() => { const r = prompt('Correction reason'); if (r) act('return-for-correction', { reason: r }); }}>Return for Correction</button>}
        {actions.canPlaceHold && <button disabled={!!busy} onClick={() => { const r = prompt('Hold reason'); if (r) act('place-hold', { reason: r }); }}>Place Hold</button>}
        {actions.canReleaseHold && <button disabled={!!busy} onClick={() => act('release-hold')}>Release Hold</button>}
        {actions.canMarkPaymentReady && (
          <button disabled={!!busy || !readiness?.ready} title={readiness?.ready ? undefined : 'Backend payment readiness is false; resolve the blockers first.'} onClick={() => act('mark-payment-ready')}>Mark Payment Ready</button>
        )}
        {actions.canRecordPayment && <button disabled={!!busy} onClick={() => { const ref = prompt('Payment reference'); if (!ref) return; const dt = prompt('Payment date (YYYY-MM-DD)'); if (dt) act('mark-paid', { payment_reference: ref, payment_date: dt }); }}>Mark Paid</button>}
        {actions.canCancel && <button disabled={!!busy} onClick={() => { const r = prompt('Cancel reason'); if (r) act('cancel', { reason: r, version: inv.version }); }}>Cancel</button>}
        {actions.canClose && <button disabled={!!busy} onClick={() => act('close')}>Close</button>}
        <a className="btn" href={`#/procurement/invoices/${id}/match`}>Matching View</a>
      </div>
      <dl className="detail-grid">
        <dt>Vendor</dt><dd>{inv.vendor_name || inv.vendor}</dd>
        <dt>Purchase Order</dt><dd>{inv.po_number || inv.purchase_order}</dd>
        <dt>Invoice Date</dt><dd>{inv.invoice_date}</dd>
        <dt>Due Date</dt><dd>{inv.due_date || 'â€”'}</dd>
        <dt>Currency</dt><dd>{inv.currency}</dd>
        <dt>Subtotal</dt><dd>{formatMoney(inv.subtotal, inv.currency)}</dd>
        <dt>Grand Total</dt><dd>{formatMoney(inv.grand_total, inv.currency)}</dd>
        <dt>Variance Total</dt><dd>{formatMoney(inv.variance_total, inv.currency)}</dd>
        <dt>Payment Hold</dt><dd>{inv.payment_hold ? `Yes: ${inv.payment_hold_reason}` : 'No'}</dd>
      </dl>
      <h2>Payment Readiness</h2>
      {readiness && (readiness.ready
        ? <div className="badge green">Ready for payment tracking</div>
        : <div><strong>Not ready</strong><ul>{(readiness.blockers || []).map((b, i) => <li key={i}><strong>{b.code}:</strong> {b.message} ({b.severity})</li>)}</ul></div>)}
      <h2>Invoice Lines</h2>
      <Table
        columns={[
          { label: 'PO Line', render: r => r.po_item_name || r.purchase_order_item },
          { label: 'Receipt Line', render: r => r.goods_receipt_number || r.goods_receipt_item || 'â€”' },
          { label: 'Description', key: 'description' },
          { label: 'Invoiced Qty', key: 'invoiced_quantity' },
          { label: 'Unit Price', key: 'unit_price' },
          { label: 'Tax', key: 'tax_amount' },
          { label: 'Line Total', key: 'line_total' },
          { label: 'Match Status', render: r => statusLabel(r.match_status) },
        ]}
        rows={inv.lines || []}
        empty="No invoice lines."
      />
      {actions.canAddLine && (
        <form onSubmit={addLine} className="form-grid">
          <h3>Add Invoice Line</h3>
          <label>PO Item<select value={line.purchase_order_item} onChange={e => setLine(l => ({ ...l, purchase_order_item: e.target.value }))} required><option value="">Select</option>{poItems.map(i => <option key={i.id} value={i.id}>{i.item_name} (ordered {i.quantity}, received {i.received_qty}, rejected {i.rejected_qty}, damaged {i.damaged_qty})</option>)}</select></label>
          <label>Goods Receipt Item<select value={line.goods_receipt_item} onChange={e => setLine(l => ({ ...l, goods_receipt_item: e.target.value }))}><option value="">None</option>{grItems.map(i => <option key={i.id} value={i.id}>GR Item {i.id} - PO line {i.purchase_order_item} (accepted {i.accepted_quantity})</option>)}</select></label>
          <label>Description<input value={line.description} onChange={e => setLine(l => ({ ...l, description: e.target.value }))} /></label>
          <label>Invoiced Quantity<input value={line.invoiced_quantity} onChange={e => setLine(l => ({ ...l, invoiced_quantity: e.target.value }))} required /></label>
          <label>Unit Price<input value={line.unit_price} onChange={e => setLine(l => ({ ...l, unit_price: e.target.value }))} required /></label>
          <label>Discount Amount<input value={line.discount_amount} onChange={e => setLine(l => ({ ...l, discount_amount: e.target.value }))} /></label>
          <label>Tax Rate<input value={line.tax_rate} onChange={e => setLine(l => ({ ...l, tax_rate: e.target.value }))} /></label>
          <label>Tax Amount<input value={line.tax_amount} onChange={e => setLine(l => ({ ...l, tax_amount: e.target.value }))} /></label>
          <button className="btn" type="submit" disabled={busy === 'line'}>Add Line</button>
        </form>
      )}

  );

===== src\pages\procurement\ProcurementInvoiceForm.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { safeResults, parseFieldErrors, procurementErrorText } from '../../shared/procurement-utils';

function ErrorList({ error }) {
  if (!error) return null;
  const parsed = (error && ('global' in error || 'fields' in error)) ? error : parseFieldErrors(error);
  const global = parsed?.global;
  const fields = Object.entries(parsed?.fields || {});
  if (!global && fields.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <div role="alert" className="error">
      {global && <div>{global}</div>}
      {fields.length > 0 && (
        <ul>
          {fields.map(([field, message]) => (
            <li key={field}><strong>{field.replace(/_/g, ' ')}:</strong> {message}</li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function ProcurementInvoiceForm() {
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    invoice_number: '', vendor: '', purchase_order: '', invoice_date: '',
    received_date: '', due_date: '', currency: 'NPR', freight_total: '0.00',
    other_charge_total: '0.00', discount_total: '0.00', notes: '',
  });
  const [pos, setPos] = useState([]);
  const [vendors, setVendors] = useState([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    api.get('/procurement/purchase-orders/?page_size=100').then(r => setPos(safeResults(r.data))).catch(() => {});
    api.get('/assets/vendors/?page_size=100').then(r => setVendors(safeResults(r.data))).catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  function set(k, v) { setForm(f => ({ ...f, [k]: v })); }

  const visiblePos = form.vendor
    ? pos.filter(p => String(p.vendor) === String(form.vendor) || String(p.vendor_detail?.id) === String(form.vendor))
    : pos;

  async function save(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (saving) return;
    setSaving(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      // Totals, status and the normalized invoice number stay backend-authoritative.
      const payload = { ...form, due_date: form.due_date || null };
      const r = await api.post('/procurement/supplier-invoices/', payload);
      if (!r.data?.id) {
        setError({ global: 'The server did not return the new invoice id. The invoice was not opened.' });
        return;
      }
      window.location.hash = `#/procurement/invoices/${r.data.id}`;
    } catch (err) {
      const p = parseFieldErrors(err);
      const status = err?.response?.status;
      const hasFieldErrors = Object.keys(p?.fields || {}).length > 0;
      if (status === 403 || status === 404 || (!p?.global && !hasFieldErrors)) {
        setError({ global: procurementErrorText(err, 'Failed to create invoice.') });
      } else {
        setError(p);
      }
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="page-header"><h1>New Supplier Invoice</h1></div>
      <ErrorList error={error} />
      <form onSubmit={save} className="form-grid">
        <label>Invoice Number<input value={form.invoice_number} onChange={e => set('invoice_number', e.target.value)} required /></label>
        <label>Vendor<select value={form.vendor} onChange={e => { set('vendor', e.target.value); set('purchase_order', ''); }} required><option value="">Select vendor</option>{vendors.map(v => <option key={v.id} value={v.id}>{v.name}</option>)}</select></label>
        <label>Purchase Order<select value={form.purchase_order} onChange={e => set('purchase_order', e.target.value)} required><option value="">Select PO</option>{visiblePos.map(p => <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>{p.po_number} - {p.vendor_detail?.name || p.vendor}</option>)}</select></label>
        <label>Invoice Date<input type="date" value={form.invoice_date} onChange={e => set('invoice_date', e.target.value)} required /></label>
        <label>Received Date<input type="date" value={form.received_date} onChange={e => set('received_date', e.target.value)} required /></label>
        <label>Due Date<input type="date" value={form.due_date} onChange={e => set('due_date', e.target.value)} /></label>
        <label>Currency<input value={form.currency} onChange={e => set('currency', e.target.value)} required /></label>
        <label>Freight<input value={form.freight_total} onChange={e => set('freight_total', e.target.value)} /></label>
        <label>Other Charges<input value={form.other_charge_total} onChange={e => set('other_charge_total', e.target.value)} /></label>
        <label>Discount<input value={form.discount_total} onChange={e => set('discount_total', e.target.value)} /></label>
        <label>Notes<textarea value={form.notes} onChange={e => set('notes', e.target.value)} /></label>
        <div><button className="btn primary" type="submit" disabled={saving}>{saving ? 'Savingâ€¦' : 'Create Invoice'}</button></div>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

export default ProcurementInvoiceForm;

function Table({ columns, rows, empty = 'No records.' }) {
  if (!rows?.length) return <div className="empty-state"><div className="empty-title">{empty}</div></div>;
  return <div className="table-wrap"><table className="table"><thead><tr>{columns.map(c => <th key={c.key || c.label}>{c.label}</th>)}</tr></thead><tbody>{rows.map((row, i) => <tr key={row.id ?? i}>{columns.map(c => <td key={c.key || c.label}>{typeof c.render === 'function' ? c.render(row) : row[c.key]}</td>)}</tr>)}</tbody></table></div>;
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { safeResults, formatMoney, formatDateTime, statusLabel, procurementErrorText } from '../../shared/procurement-utils';

function Table({ columns, rows, empty = 'No records.' }) {
  if (!rows?.length) return <div className="empty-state"><div className="empty-title">{empty}</div></div>;
  return <div className="table-wrap"><table className="table"><thead><tr>{columns.map(c => <th key={c.key || c.label}>{c.label}</th>)}</tr></thead><tbody>{rows.map((row, i) => <tr key={row.id ?? i}>{columns.map(c => <td key={c.key || c.label}>{typeof c.render === 'function' ? c.render(row) : row[c.key]}</td>)}</tr>)}</tbody></table></div>;
}

export function ProcurementMatchingPage({ id }) {
  const [inv, setInv] = useState(null);
  const [history, setHistory] = useState([]);
  const [exceptions, setExceptions] = useState([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const [a, b, c] = await Promise.all([
        api.get(`/procurement/supplier-invoices/${id}/`),
        api.get(`/procurement/supplier-invoices/${id}/match-history/`),
        api.get(`/procurement/supplier-invoices/${id}/exceptions/`),
      ]);
      setInv(a.data); setHistory(safeResults(b.data)); setExceptions(safeResults(c.data));
    } catch (e) { setError(procurementErrorText(e, 'Failed to load match data.')); }
  }, [id]);
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect

  async function runMatch() {
    setBusy(true); setError('');
    try { await api.post(`/procurement/supplier-invoices/${id}/match/`, {}); await load(); }
    catch (e) { setError(procurementErrorText(e, 'Match failed.')); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }

  if (!inv) return <p className="page-loading">{error ? <span role="alert">{error}</span> : 'Loadingâ€¦'}</p>;
  const latest = history[0];
  return (
    <div>
      <div className="page-header"><h1>Three-Way Match: {inv.invoice_number}</h1><div><button className="btn" onClick={runMatch} disabled={busy}>{busy ? 'Matchingâ€¦' : 'Run Match'}</button> <a className="btn" href={`#/procurement/invoices/${id}`}>Back to Invoice</a></div></div>
      {error && <div role="alert" className="error">{error}</div>}
      {latest && (
        <div className="card">
          <strong>Latest Overall Status:</strong> {statusLabel(latest.overall_status)} (version {latest.match_version}) |
          {' '}<strong>Invoice Total:</strong> {formatMoney(latest.invoice_total_snapshot, inv.currency)} |
          {' '}<strong>PO Total:</strong> {formatMoney(latest.po_total_snapshot, inv.currency)} |
          {' '}<strong>Accepted Receipt Total:</strong> {formatMoney(latest.accepted_receipt_total_snapshot, inv.currency)} |
          {' '}<strong>Total Variance:</strong> {formatMoney(latest.total_variance, inv.currency)}
          <div className="small">
            Quantity variance {formatMoney(latest.quantity_variance_total, inv.currency)} Â·
            {' '}Price variance {formatMoney(latest.price_variance_total, inv.currency)} Â·
            {' '}Tax variance {formatMoney(latest.tax_variance_total, inv.currency)} Â·
            {' '}Tolerance {latest.tolerance_snapshot && Object.keys(latest.tolerance_snapshot).length ? JSON.stringify(latest.tolerance_snapshot) : 'â€”'} Â·
            {' '}Checksum {latest.checksum || 'â€”'} Â·
            {' '}Matched {formatDateTime(latest.matched_at)} by {latest.matched_by_name || 'â€”'}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      <h2>Side-by-side Line Comparison</h2>
      <Table
        columns={[
          { label: 'PO Line', render: r => r.po_item_name || r.purchase_order_item },
          { label: 'Invoiced Qty', key: 'invoiced_quantity' },
          { label: 'Accepted Received (snapshot)', key: 'accepted_quantity_snapshot' },
          { label: 'Matched Qty', key: 'matched_quantity' },
          { label: 'Invoice Unit Price', key: 'unit_price' },
          { label: 'Invoice Tax', key: 'tax_amount' },
          { label: 'Line Total', key: 'line_total' },
          { label: 'Qty Variance', key: 'quantity_variance' },
          { label: 'Price Variance', key: 'price_variance' },
          { label: 'Tax Variance', key: 'tax_variance' },
          { label: 'Total Variance', key: 'total_variance' },
          { label: 'Match Status', render: r => statusLabel(r.match_status) },
          { label: 'Exception Reason', render: r => r.exception_reason || 'â€”' },
        ]}
        rows={inv.lines || []}
        empty="No invoice lines."
      />
      <h2>Exceptions</h2>
      <Table
        columns={[
          { label: 'Type', key: 'exception_type' },
          { label: 'Severity', key: 'severity' },
          { label: 'Status', render: r => statusLabel(r.status) },
          { label: 'Expected', key: 'expected_value' },
          { label: 'Actual', key: 'actual_value' },
          { label: 'Variance', key: 'variance' },
          { label: 'Reason', key: 'reason' },
        ]}
        rows={exceptions}
        empty="No exceptions."
      />
      <h2>Match History</h2>
      <Table
        columns={[
          { label: 'Version', key: 'match_version' },
          { label: 'Overall Status', render: r => statusLabel(r.overall_status) },
          { label: 'PO Total', key: 'po_total_snapshot' },
          { label: 'Accepted Receipt Total', key: 'accepted_receipt_total_snapshot' },
          { label: 'Invoice Total', key: 'invoice_total_snapshot' },
          { label: 'Total Variance', key: 'total_variance' },
          { label: 'Checksum', key: 'checksum' },
          { label: 'Matched By', render: r => r.matched_by_name || 'â€”' },
          { label: 'Matched At', render: r => formatDateTime(r.matched_at) },
        ]}
        rows={history}
        empty="No match results."
      />
      <p className="small">Matching is performed by the backend and is authoritative. Frontend does not infer payment readiness or match results.</p>
    </div>
  );
}

function blankQuotation() {
