    vendor: '',
    quoted_amount: '',
    delivery_days: '',
    warranty: '',
    terms: '',
    notes: '',
  };
}

/** Quotation capture, side-by-side comparison and vendor selection. */
export function PurchaseRequestQuotations({ id }) {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const caps = procurementCapabilities(auth);
  const [request, setRequest] = useState(null);
  const [vendors, setVendors] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState(blankQuotation());
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [globalError, setGlobalError] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [selecting, setSelecting] = useState(null);
  const [selectionReason, setSelectionReason] = useState('');
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState('');
  const [attachmentQuoteId, setAttachmentQuoteId] = useState('');

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const [requestRes, vendorRows] = await Promise.all([
        api.get(`/procurement/purchase-requests/${id}/`),
        fetchAll('/assets/vendors/?page_size=100').catch(() => []),
      ]);
      setRequest(requestRes.data);
      setVendors(vendorRows.filter((v) => v.is_active !== false));
    } catch (e) {
      const parsed = parseFieldErrors(e);
      setError(parsed.global || 'This purchase request is unavailable.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [id]);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect

  const comparison = (request?.quotations || []).map((quote) => ({
    ...quote,
    vendor_name: quote.vendor_detail?.name ?? `Vendor ${quote.vendor}`,
  }));

  const lowest = useMemo(() => {
    if (!comparison.length) return null;
    return comparison.reduce((best, row) => (
      Number(row.quoted_amount) < Number(best.quoted_amount) ? row : best
    ));
  }, [comparison]);

  const fastest = useMemo(() => {
    const withDays = comparison.filter((row) => row.delivery_days !== null && row.delivery_days !== undefined);
    if (!withDays.length) return null;
    return withDays.reduce((best, row) => (
      Number(row.delivery_days) < Number(best.delivery_days) ? row : best
    ));
  }, [comparison]);

  const selected = comparison.find((row) => row.is_selected) || null;
  const attachmentQuote = comparison.find(
    (row) => String(row.id) === String(attachmentQuoteId),
  ) || selected || comparison[0] || null;

  const openCreate = () => {
    setForm(blankQuotation());
    setErrors({});
    setGlobalError('');
    setEditing('new');
  };

  const openEdit = (quote) => {
    setForm({
      vendor: String(quote.vendor ?? ''),
      quoted_amount: String(quote.quoted_amount ?? ''),
      delivery_days: quote.delivery_days ?? '',
      warranty: quote.warranty || '',
      terms: quote.terms || '',
      notes: quote.notes || '',
    });
    setErrors({});
    setGlobalError('');
    setEditing(quote.id);
  };

  const validate = () => {
    const next = {};
    if (!form.vendor) next.vendor = 'Select an active vendor.';
    const amount = Number(form.quoted_amount);
    if (!form.quoted_amount || !Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) {
      next.quoted_amount = 'Quoted amount must be greater than zero.';
    }
    if (form.delivery_days !== '') {
      const days = Number(form.delivery_days);
      if (!Number.isInteger(days) || days < 0) next.delivery_days = 'Delivery days must be zero or more.';
    }
    setErrors(next);
    return Object.keys(next).length === 0;
  };

  const save = async () => {
    if (busy) return;
    if (!validate()) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setGlobalError('');
    try {
      const payload = {
        purchase_request: Number(id),
        vendor: Number(form.vendor),
        quoted_amount: Number(form.quoted_amount).toFixed(2),
        delivery_days: form.delivery_days === '' ? null : Number(form.delivery_days),
        warranty: form.warranty.trim(),
        terms: form.terms.trim(),
        notes: form.notes.trim(),
      };
      if (editing === 'new') {
        await api.post('/procurement/quotations/', payload);
        setNotice('Quotation recorded.');
      } else {
        await api.patch(`/procurement/quotations/${editing}/`, payload);
        setNotice('Quotation updated.');
      }
      setEditing(null);
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      const parsed = parseFieldErrors(e);
      setErrors(parsed.fields || {});
      setGlobalError(parsed.global || 'Could not save the quotation.');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const selectVendor = async () => {
    if (busy || !selecting) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setGlobalError('');
    try {
      await api.post(`/procurement/quotations/${selecting.id}/select/`, { reason: selectionReason.trim() });
      setSelecting(null);
      setSelectionReason('');
      setNotice('Vendor selected.');
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      const parsed = parseFieldErrors(e);
      const status = e?.response?.status;
      setGlobalError(
        status === 403
          ? 'You do not have permission to perform this action.'
          : parsed.global || 'Could not select this vendor.',
      );
      if (status === 409) await load();
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) return <LoadingRows />;

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div>
        <PageHeader title="Quotations" />
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>
        <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={load}>Retry</button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!request) return null;

  if (!caps.canViewProcurement) {
    return <EmptyState title="Access restricted" hint="Procurement is available to IT staff only." />;
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title={`Quotations Â· ${request.pr_number}`}
        sub="Record vendor offers, compare them and select the winning vendor."
        actions={(
          <div className="row-gap">
            <a className="btn-ghost" href={`#/procurement/requests/${request.id}`}>Back to request</a>
            {caps.canManageQuotations && request.status === 'approved' ? (
              <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={openCreate}>Add quotation</button>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        )}
      />

      {request.status !== 'approved' ? (
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">
          Quotations can only be recorded for an approved request. This request is {request.status.replace(/_/g, ' ')}.
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {notice ? <div className="success-summary" role="status">{notice}</div> : null}
      {globalError && !editing && !selecting ? <ErrorSummary parsed={{ global: globalError }} /> : null}

      {comparison.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          title="No quotations recorded."
          hint="Add each vendor's offer, then compare price, delivery and warranty before selecting."
        />
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="panel">
            <div className="panel-head"><h3>Summary</h3></div>
            <div className="panel-pad">
              <p className="small" style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>
                Lowest total: <strong>{lowest ? `${lowest.vendor_name} â€” ${formatMoney(lowest.quoted_amount)}` : 'â€”'}</strong>
              </p>
              <p className="small">
                Fastest delivery: <strong>{fastest ? `${fastest.vendor_name} â€” ${fastest.delivery_days} day(s)` : 'â€”'}</strong>
              </p>
              <p className="small">
                Selected vendor: <strong>{selected ? selected.vendor_name : 'None selected'}</strong>
              </p>
              {selected?.selection_reason ? (
                <p className="small muted">Selection reason: {selected.selection_reason}</p>
              ) : null}
              <p className="small muted">
                Price is only one selection factor. Delivery, compatibility, warranty, support and
                approved specifications should also be reviewed.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
            <h3>Comparison</h3>
            <DataTable
              columns={[
                { key: 'vendor_name', label: 'Vendor', render: (r) => <span className="row-title">{r.vendor_name}</span> },
                { key: 'quoted_amount', label: 'Quoted amount', render: (r) => formatMoney(r.quoted_amount) },
                { key: 'delivery_days', label: 'Delivery days', render: (r) => r.delivery_days ?? 'â€”' },
                { key: 'warranty', label: 'Warranty', render: (r) => r.warranty || 'â€”' },
                { key: 'terms', label: 'Payment / delivery terms', render: (r) => r.terms || 'â€”' },
                {
                  key: 'state',
                  label: 'Selection',
                  render: (r) => (r.is_selected
                    ? <Badge kind="status" value="approved" label="Selected" />
                    : 'Not selected'),
                },
                {
                  key: 'actions',
                  label: 'Actions',
                  render: (r) => (
                    <div className="row-gap">
                      {caps.canManageQuotations ? (
                        <button type="button" className="btn-ghost btn-small" onClick={() => openEdit(r)}>Edit</button>
                      ) : null}
                      {caps.canSelectProcurementVendor && request.status === 'approved' ? (
                        <button
                          type="button" className="btn-small"
                          onClick={() => { setSelectionReason(''); setGlobalError(''); setSelecting(r); }}
                          disabled={r.is_selected}
                        >
                          Select vendor
                        </button>
                      ) : null}
                    </div>
                  ),
                },
              ]}
              rows={comparison}
              keyOf={(r) => `quote-${r.id}`}
              emptyTitle="No quotations."
              emptyHint=""
            />
          </div>

          <div style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>
            <h3>Quotation documents</h3>
            <Field label="Quotation">
              <select
                className="input"
                value={attachmentQuote ? String(attachmentQuote.id) : ''}
                onChange={(e) => setAttachmentQuoteId(e.target.value)}
                aria-label="Quotation for attachments"
              >
                {comparison.map((row) => (
                  <option key={row.id} value={row.id}>{row.vendor_name} â€” {row.quoted_amount}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </Field>
            {attachmentQuote ? (
              <ProcurementAttachments
                parentType="quotation"
                parentId={attachmentQuote.id}
                canUpload={caps.canManageQuotations}
                title={`Attachments Â· ${attachmentQuote.vendor_name}`}
              />
            ) : null}
          </div>

          <div style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>
            <h3>Quotation amounts by vendor</h3>
            <div role="img" aria-label="Quotation amount comparison bars">
              {comparison.map((row) => {
                const max = Math.max(...comparison.map((q) => Number(q.quoted_amount) || 0), 1);
                const width = `${Math.round(((Number(row.quoted_amount) || 0) / max) * 100)}%`;
                return (
                  <div key={`bar-${row.id}`} className="field" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
                    <span className="form-label">{row.vendor_name}</span>
                    <div style={{ background: 'var(--neutral-bg, #eee)', height: 10, borderRadius: 4 }}>
                      <div style={{ width, background: 'var(--info, #3b82f6)', height: 10, borderRadius: 4 }} />
                    </div>
                    <div className="small muted">{formatMoney(row.quoted_amount)}</div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      {editing ? (
        <Modal
          title={editing === 'new' ? 'Add quotation' : 'Edit quotation'}
          onClose={() => { if (!busy) setEditing(null); }}
          size="wide"
        >
          <Field label="Vendor" required error={errors.vendor}>
            <select
              className="input" value={form.vendor}
              onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, vendor: e.target.value }))}
              aria-label="Vendor"
            >
              <option value="">Select an active vendorâ€¦</option>
              {vendors.map((v) => <option key={v.id} value={v.id}>{v.name}</option>)}
            </select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="Quoted amount" required error={errors.quoted_amount}>
            <input
              type="number" min="0" step="0.01" className="input" value={form.quoted_amount}
              onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, quoted_amount: e.target.value }))}
              aria-label="Quoted amount"
            />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Delivery days" error={errors.delivery_days}>
            <input
              type="number" min="0" step="1" className="input" value={form.delivery_days}
              onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, delivery_days: e.target.value }))}
              aria-label="Delivery days"
            />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Warranty">
            <input
              className="input" value={form.warranty}
              onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, warranty: e.target.value }))}
              aria-label="Warranty"
            />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Payment / delivery terms">
            <textarea
              className="input" rows={2} value={form.terms}
              onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, terms: e.target.value }))}
              aria-label="Terms"
            />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Notes">
            <textarea
              className="input" rows={2} value={form.notes}
              onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, notes: e.target.value }))}
              aria-label="Quotation notes"
            />
          </Field>
          <p className="small muted">
            Totals are recorded exactly as quoted by the vendor. The backend keeps the
            authoritative amount for the purchase order.
          </p>
          {globalError ? <ErrorSummary parsed={{ global: globalError }} /> : null}
          <div className="row-end">
            <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setEditing(null)} disabled={busy}>Cancel</button>
            <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={save} disabled={busy}>
              {busy ? 'Savingâ€¦' : 'Save quotation'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      ) : null}

      {selecting ? (
        <Modal
          title={`Select ${selecting.vendor_detail?.name ?? 'vendor'}`}
          onClose={() => { if (!busy) setSelecting(null); }}
        >
          <p style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>
            Selecting a vendor records your decision with the reason below. Other quotations stay
            recorded but are no longer selected.
          </p>
          <Field label="Selection reason" required>
            <textarea
              className="input" rows={3} value={selectionReason}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectionReason(e.target.value)}
              aria-label="Selection reason"
            />
          </Field>
          {globalError ? <ErrorSummary parsed={{ global: globalError }} /> : null}
          <div className="row-end">
            <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setSelecting(null)} disabled={busy}>Cancel</button>
            <button
              type="button" className="btn-primary"
              disabled={busy || !selectionReason.trim()}
              onClick={selectVendor}
            >
              {busy ? 'Selectingâ€¦' : 'Confirm selection'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import {
  safeResults, statusLabel, parseFieldErrors, procurementCapabilities,
  vendorReturnActionState, procurementErrorText, recordConflictText,
} from '../../shared/procurement-utils';

function Table({ columns, rows, empty = 'No records.' }) {
  if (!rows?.length) return <div className="empty-state"><div className="empty-title">{empty}</div></div>;
  return <div className="table-wrap"><table className="table"><thead><tr>{columns.map(c => <th key={c.key || c.label}>{c.label}</th>)}</tr></thead><tbody>{rows.map((row, i) => <tr key={row.id ?? i}>{columns.map(c => <td key={c.key || c.label}>{typeof c.render === 'function' ? c.render(row) : row[c.key]}</td>)}</tr>)}</tbody></table></div>;
}

function FormError({ error }) {
  if (!error) return null;
  const parsed = (error && ('global' in error || 'fields' in error)) ? error : parseFieldErrors(error);
  const fields = Object.entries(parsed?.fields || {});
  return (
    <div role="alert" className="error">
      {parsed?.global && <div>{parsed.global}</div>}
      {fields.length > 0 && <ul>{fields.map(([field, message]) => <li key={field}><strong>{field.replace(/_/g, ' ')}:</strong> {message}</li>)}</ul>}
    </div>
  );
}

export function ProcurementReturnsPage() {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const load = useCallback(() => {
    setLoading(true); setError('');
    return api.get('/procurement/vendor-returns/?page_size=50')
      .then(r => setRows(safeResults(r.data)))
      .catch(e => setError(procurementErrorText(e, 'Failed to load returns.')))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect

  if (loading) return <p className="page-loading" role="status">Loading vendor returnsâ€¦</p>;
  return (
    <div>
      <div className="page-header"><h1>Vendor Returns</h1><a className="btn" href="#/procurement/returns/new">New Return</a></div>
      {error && <div role="alert" className="error">{error} <button className="btn" onClick={load}>Retry</button></div>}
      <Table columns={[
        { label: 'Return Number', render: r => <a href={`#/procurement/returns/${r.id}`}>{r.return_number}</a> },
        { label: 'Vendor', render: r => r.vendor_name || r.vendor },
        { label: 'Purchase Order', render: r => r.po_number || r.purchase_order },
        { label: 'Goods Receipt', render: r => r.gr_number || r.goods_receipt || 'â€”' },
        { label: 'Invoice', render: r => r.invoice_number || r.supplier_invoice || 'â€”' },
        { label: 'Status', render: r => statusLabel(r.status) },
        { label: 'Reason', key: 'reason' },
        { label: 'Method', key: 'return_method' },
      ]} rows={rows} empty="No vendor returns." />
    </div>
  );
}

export function ProcurementReturnForm() {
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ vendor: '', purchase_order: '', goods_receipt: '', supplier_invoice: '', reason: 'damaged', return_method: 'physical_return', authorization_reference: '', shipping_reference: '', expected_resolution: '', replacement_expected: false, replacement_due_date: '', return_date: '' });
  const [error, setError] = useState(null); const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  function set(k, v) { setForm(f => ({ ...f, [k]: v })); }
  async function save(e) {
    e.preventDefault(); if (saving) return;
    setSaving(true); setError(null);
    try {
      const payload = {
        ...form,
        goods_receipt: form.goods_receipt || null,
        supplier_invoice: form.supplier_invoice || null,
        replacement_due_date: form.replacement_due_date || null,
        return_date: form.return_date || null,
      };
      const r = await api.post('/procurement/vendor-returns/', payload);
      if (!r.data?.id) { setError({ global: 'The server did not return the new return id.' }); return; }
      window.location.hash = `#/procurement/returns/${r.data.id}`;
    } catch (err) {
      const p = parseFieldErrors(err);
      const status = err?.response?.status;
      const hasFields = Object.keys(p?.fields || {}).length > 0;
      setError(status === 403 || status === 404 || (!p?.global && !hasFields) ? { global: procurementErrorText(err, 'Failed to create return.') } : p);
    } finally { setSaving(false); }
  }
  return (
    <div>
      <h1>New Vendor Return</h1>
      <FormError error={error} />
      <form onSubmit={save} className="form-grid">
        <label>Vendor ID<input value={form.vendor} onChange={e => set('vendor', e.target.value)} required /></label>
        <label>Purchase Order ID<input value={form.purchase_order} onChange={e => set('purchase_order', e.target.value)} required /></label>
        <label>Goods Receipt ID<input value={form.goods_receipt} onChange={e => set('goods_receipt', e.target.value)} /></label>
        <label>Supplier Invoice ID<input value={form.supplier_invoice} onChange={e => set('supplier_invoice', e.target.value)} /></label>
        <label>Return Date<input type="date" value={form.return_date} onChange={e => set('return_date', e.target.value)} /></label>
        <label>Reason<select value={form.reason} onChange={e => set('reason', e.target.value)}>{['damaged','rejected','incorrect_item','wrong_specification','excess_delivery','quality_failure','warranty','other'].map(v => <option key={v} value={v}>{v}</option>)}</select></label>
        <label>Return Method<select value={form.return_method} onChange={e => set('return_method', e.target.value)}>{['physical_return','vendor_pickup','onsite_disposal','replacement_without_return','credit_only','other'].map(v => <option key={v} value={v}>{v}</option>)}</select></label>
        <label>Authorization Reference<input value={form.authorization_reference} onChange={e => set('authorization_reference', e.target.value)} /></label>
        <label>Expected Resolution<textarea value={form.expected_resolution} onChange={e => set('expected_resolution', e.target.value)} /></label>
        <label><input type="checkbox" checked={form.replacement_expected} onChange={e => set('replacement_expected', e.target.checked)} /> Replacement Expected</label>
        <label>Replacement Due Date<input type="date" value={form.replacement_due_date} onChange={e => set('replacement_due_date', e.target.value)} /></label>
        <button className="btn primary" disabled={saving}>{saving ? 'Savingâ€¦' : 'Create Return'}</button>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

const EMPTY_RETURN_LINE = { goods_receipt_item: '', purchase_order_item: '', quantity: 1, disposition: 'pending_vendor_decision', condition: 'damaged', reason: '', notes: '' };

export function ProcurementReturnDetail({ id }) {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const caps = procurementCapabilities(auth);
  const userId = auth?.user?.id;
  const [vr, setVr] = useState(null);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState('');
  const [line, setLine] = useState(EMPTY_RETURN_LINE);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try { const r = await api.get(`/procurement/vendor-returns/${id}/`); setVr(r.data); }
    catch (e) { setLoadError(procurementErrorText(e, 'Failed to load return.')); }
  }, [id]);
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect

  async function act(action, body = {}) {
    setBusy(action); setError('');
    try { await api.post(`/procurement/vendor-returns/${id}/${action}/`, body); await load(); }
    catch (e) {
      if (e?.response?.status === 409) { setError(recordConflictText('return')); await load(); }
      else setError(procurementErrorText(e, 'Action failed.'));
    }
    finally { setBusy(''); }
  }
  async function addLine(e) {
    e.preventDefault(); setBusy('line'); setError('');
    try {
      await api.post('/procurement/vendor-return-lines/', { ...line, vendor_return: id });
      setLine(EMPTY_RETURN_LINE);
      await load();
    } catch (err) { setError(procurementErrorText(err, 'Failed to add line.')); }
    finally { setBusy(''); }
  }

  if (!vr) return <p className="page-loading">{loadError ? <span role="alert">{loadError}</span> : 'Loadingâ€¦'}</p>;
  const isSystemAdmin = !!(auth?.isSystemAdmin || auth?.role === 'system_admin' || auth?.isSuperuser);
  const actions = vendorReturnActionState(vr, caps, userId, isSystemAdmin);
  return (
    <div>
      <h1>Return {vr.return_number}</h1>
      {error && <div role="alert" className="error">{error}</div>}
      <div className="button-row" style={{flexWrap:'wrap',gap:'8px'}}>
        {actions.canSubmit && <button disabled={!!busy} onClick={() => act('submit')}>Submit</button>}
        {actions.canApprove && <button disabled={!!busy} onClick={() => act('approve', { authorization_reference: prompt('Authorization reference') || vr.authorization_reference || '' })}>Approve</button>}
        {actions.canReject && <button disabled={!!busy} onClick={() => { const r = prompt('Reason'); if (r) act('reject', { reason: r }); }}>Reject</button>}
        {actions.canShip && <button disabled={!!busy} onClick={() => act('ship', { shipping_reference: prompt('Shipping reference') || '' })}>Ship</button>}
        {actions.canRecordReplacement && <button disabled={!!busy} onClick={() => act('record-replacement')}>Record Replacement</button>}
        {actions.canComplete && <button disabled={!!busy} onClick={() => act('complete')}>Complete</button>}
        {actions.canCancel && <button disabled={!!busy} onClick={() => { const r = prompt('Reason'); if (r) act('cancel', { reason: r }); }}>Cancel</button>}
      </div>
      <dl className="detail-grid"><dt>Status</dt><dd>{statusLabel(vr.status)}</dd><dt>Vendor</dt><dd>{vr.vendor_name || vr.vendor}</dd><dt>PO</dt><dd>{vr.po_number || vr.purchase_order}</dd><dt>Receipt</dt><dd>{vr.gr_number || vr.goods_receipt || 'â€”'}</dd><dt>Invoice</dt><dd>{vr.invoice_number || vr.supplier_invoice || 'â€”'}</dd><dt>Reason</dt><dd>{vr.reason}</dd><dt>Method</dt><dd>{vr.return_method}</dd></dl>
      <p className="small">Inventory reversal and asset consequences are processed by the backend according to item disposition and receipt status. Returning goods does not automatically create a refund; credit notes are tracked separately.</p>
      <h2>Return Lines</h2>
      <Table columns={[{ label: 'GR Item', key: 'goods_receipt_item' }, { label: 'PO Item', key: 'purchase_order_item' }, { label: 'Asset Receipt Item', render: r => r.asset_receipt_item || 'â€”' }, { label: 'Asset', render: r => r.asset_tag || r.asset || 'â€”' }, { label: 'Qty', key: 'quantity' }, { label: 'Disposition', key: 'disposition' }, { label: 'Condition', key: 'condition' }, { label: 'Reason', key: 'reason' }]} rows={vr.lines || []} empty="No return lines." />
      {actions.canAddLine && (
        <form onSubmit={addLine} className="form-grid">
          <h3>Add Return Line</h3>
          <label>Goods Receipt Item ID<input value={line.goods_receipt_item} onChange={e => setLine(l => ({ ...l, goods_receipt_item: e.target.value }))} required /></label>
          <label>Purchase Order Item ID<input value={line.purchase_order_item} onChange={e => setLine(l => ({ ...l, purchase_order_item: e.target.value }))} required /></label>
          <label>Quantity<input type="number" value={line.quantity} onChange={e => setLine(l => ({ ...l, quantity: e.target.value }))} required /></label>
          <label>Condition<select value={line.condition} onChange={e => setLine(l => ({ ...l, condition: e.target.value }))}>{['rejected','damaged','defective','incorrect','excess','other'].map(v => <option key={v} value={v}>{v}</option>)}</select></label>
          <label>Disposition<select value={line.disposition} onChange={e => setLine(l => ({ ...l, disposition: e.target.value }))}>{['refund','credit_note','replacement','repair','exchange','write_off','pending_vendor_decision'].map(v => <option key={v} value={v}>{v}</option>)}</select></label>
          <label>Reason<input value={line.reason} onChange={e => setLine(l => ({ ...l, reason: e.target.value }))} /></label>
          <label>Notes<textarea value={line.notes} onChange={e => setLine(l => ({ ...l, notes: e.target.value }))} /></label>
          <button className="btn" disabled={busy === 'line'}>Add Line</button>
        </form>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default ProcurementReturnsPage;



===== src\pages\procurement\ProcurementRouter.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { AccessDenied, EmptyState } from '../../components';
import { ProcurementAssetsPage } from './ProcurementAssets';
import { ProcurementDashboard, ProcurementReports } from './ProcurementDashboard';
import { GoodsReceiptForm } from './GoodsReceiptForm';
import { GoodsReceiptsPage } from './GoodsReceipts';
import { procurementCapabilities } from '../../shared/procurement-utils';
import { PurchaseOrderDetail } from './PurchaseOrderDetail';
import { PurchaseOrdersPage } from './PurchaseOrders';
import { PurchaseRequestDetail } from './PurchaseRequestDetail';
import { PurchaseRequestForm } from './PurchaseRequestForm';
import { PurchaseRequestQuotations } from './ProcurementQuotations';
import { PurchaseRequestsPage } from './PurchaseRequests';
import { ProcurementInvoicesPage, ProcurementInvoiceExceptionsPage } from './ProcurementInvoices';
import { ProcurementInvoiceForm } from './ProcurementInvoiceForm';
import { ProcurementInvoiceDetail } from './ProcurementInvoiceDetail';
import { ProcurementMatchingPage } from './ProcurementMatching';
import { ProcurementReturnsPage, ProcurementReturnForm, ProcurementReturnDetail } from './ProcurementReturns';
import { ProcurementCreditNotesPage, ProcurementCreditNoteForm, ProcurementCreditNoteDetail } from './ProcurementCreditNotes';
import { ProcurementFinancialDashboard } from './ProcurementFinancialDashboard';
import { ProcurementVendorPerformance } from './ProcurementVendorPerformance';

function readHash() {
  const raw = String(window.location.hash || '');
  const path = raw.replace(/^#/, '');
  const [route, query = ''] = path.split('?');
  return { route: route || '/procurement', query };
}
const NUMERIC = /^\d+$/;
function NotAvailable({ message }) {
  return (
    <div className="empty-state" role="alert">
      <div className="empty-title">{message}</div>
      <div className="small"><a href="#/procurement">Back to procurement</a></div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function ProcurementRouter({ route: routeProp }) {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const caps = procurementCapabilities(auth);
  const [location, setLocation] = useState(() => {
    if (routeProp) {
      const clean = String(routeProp).replace(/^#/, '');
      const [route, query = ''] = clean.split('?');
      return { route: route || '/procurement', query };
    }
    return readHash();
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    if (routeProp) {
      const clean = String(routeProp).replace(/^#/, '');
      const [route, query = ''] = clean.split('?');
      setLocation({ route: route || '/procurement', query }); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
      return undefined;
    }
    const onChange = () => setLocation(readHash());
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', onChange);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('hashchange', onChange);
  }, [routeProp]);

  if (!caps.canViewProcurement) return <AccessDenied reason="access" />;
  const { route } = location;
  const params = new URLSearchParams(location.query);
  const segments = route.split('/').filter(Boolean);
  if (segments[0] !== 'procurement') return <NotAvailable message="This procurement page does not exist." />;
  const rest = segments.slice(1);
  if (rest.length === 0) return <ProcurementDashboard />;
  const [first, second, third] = rest;

  if (first === 'requests') {
    if (!second) return <PurchaseRequestsPage />;
    if (second === 'new') return <PurchaseRequestForm />;
    if (!NUMERIC.test(second)) return <NotAvailable message="This purchase request does not exist." />;
    if (!third) return <PurchaseRequestDetail id={second} />;
    if (third === 'edit') return <PurchaseRequestForm id={second} />;
    if (third === 'quotations') return <PurchaseRequestQuotations id={second} />;
    return <NotAvailable message="This procurement page does not exist." />;
  }
  if (first === 'orders') {
    if (!second) return <PurchaseOrdersPage />;
    if (!NUMERIC.test(second)) return <NotAvailable message="This purchase order does not exist." />;
    return <PurchaseOrderDetail id={second} />;
  }
  if (first === 'receipts') {
    if (!second) return <GoodsReceiptsPage />;
    if (second === 'new') return <GoodsReceiptForm poId={params.get('po')} />;
    if (!NUMERIC.test(second)) return <NotAvailable message="This goods receipt does not exist." />;
    return <GoodsReceiptForm id={second} />;
  }
  if (first === 'invoices') {
    if (!second) return <ProcurementInvoicesPage />;
    if (second === 'new') return <ProcurementInvoiceForm />;
    if (!NUMERIC.test(second)) return <NotAvailable message="This invoice does not exist." />;
    if (!third) return <ProcurementInvoiceDetail id={second} />;
    if (third === 'match') return <ProcurementMatchingPage id={second} />;
    return <NotAvailable message="This procurement page does not exist." />;
  }
  if (first === 'exceptions') return <ProcurementInvoiceExceptionsPage />;
  if (first === 'returns') {
    if (!second) return <ProcurementReturnsPage />;
    if (second === 'new') return <ProcurementReturnForm />;
    if (!NUMERIC.test(second)) return <NotAvailable message="This return does not exist." />;
    return <ProcurementReturnDetail id={second} />;
  }
  if (first === 'credit-notes') {
    if (!second) return <ProcurementCreditNotesPage />;
    if (second === 'new') return <ProcurementCreditNoteForm />;
    if (!NUMERIC.test(second)) return <NotAvailable message="This credit note does not exist." />;
    return <ProcurementCreditNoteDetail id={second} />;
  }
  if (first === 'financial-dashboard') return caps.canViewProcurementReports ? <ProcurementFinancialDashboard /> : <AccessDenied reason="manager" />;
  if (first === 'vendor-performance') return caps.canViewProcurementReports ? <ProcurementVendorPerformance /> : <AccessDenied reason="manager" />;
  if (first === 'assets') return <ProcurementAssetsPage />;
  if (first === 'reports') return caps.canViewProcurementReports ? <ProcurementReports /> : <EmptyState title="Reports are restricted" hint="Procurement reports are available to IT Manager and System Admin users." />;
  return <NotAvailable message="This procurement page does not exist." />;
}

export default ProcurementRouter;



===== src\pages\procurement\ProcurementVendorPerformance.jsx =====

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { safeResults, procurementErrorText } from '../../shared/procurement-utils';

function Table({ columns, rows, empty = 'No records.' }) {
  if (!rows?.length) return <div className="empty-state"><div className="empty-title">{empty}</div></div>;
  return <div className="table-wrap"><table className="table"><thead><tr>{columns.map(c => <th key={c.key || c.label}>{c.label}</th>)}</tr></thead><tbody>{rows.map((row, i) => <tr key={row.id ?? row.vendor_id ?? i}>{columns.map(c => <td key={c.key || c.label}>{typeof c.render === 'function' ? c.render(row) : row[c.key]}</td>)}</tr>)}</tbody></table></div>;
}

function valueOrDash(value) {
  return value === null || value === undefined || value === '' ? 'â€”' : value;
}

export function ProcurementVendorPerformance() {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const load = useCallback(() => {
    setLoading(true); setError('');
    return api.get('/procurement/reports/vendor-performance/')
      .then(r => setRows(safeResults(r.data)))
      .catch(e => setError(procurementErrorText(e, 'Failed to load vendor performance.')))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect

  if (loading) return <p className="page-loading" role="status">Loading vendor performanceâ€¦</p>;
  if (error) return <div role="alert" className="error">{error} <button className="btn" onClick={load}>Retry</button></div>;
  return (
    <div>
      <h1>Vendor Performance</h1>
      <p className="small">Operational metrics are shown separately. No composite vendor score is calculated.</p>
      <Table
        columns={[
          { label: 'Vendor', key: 'vendor_name' },
          { label: 'POs', render: r => valueOrDash(r.purchase_orders) },
          { label: 'On-Time Delivery %', render: r => valueOrDash(r.on_time_delivery_rate) },
          { label: 'Complete Delivery %', render: r => valueOrDash(r.complete_delivery_rate) },
          { label: 'Rejected Qty %', render: r => valueOrDash(r.rejected_quantity_rate) },
          { label: 'Damaged Qty %', render: r => valueOrDash(r.damaged_quantity_rate) },
          { label: 'Invoice Match %', render: r => valueOrDash(r.invoice_match_rate) },
          { label: 'Avg Price Variance', render: r => valueOrDash(r.average_price_variance) },
          { label: 'Open Returns', render: r => valueOrDash(r.open_returns) },
          { label: 'Sample', render: r => r.sample_note || 'â€”' },
        ]}
        rows={rows}
        empty="No vendor performance data."
      />
    </div>
  );
}

export default ProcurementVendorPerformance;



===== src\pages\procurement\PurchaseOrderDetail.jsx =====

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { ProcurementAttachments } from './ProcurementAttachments';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import {
  ConfirmDialog, DataTable, EmptyState, ErrorSummary, Field, LoadingRows, Modal, PageHeader,
} from '../../components';
import {
  APPROVAL_STATUS_LABELS,
  ITEM_TYPE_LABELS,
  PURCHASE_ORDER_STATUS_LABELS,
  actionAvailability,
  filenameFromContentDisposition,
  formatDate,
  formatDateTime,
  formatMoney,
  formatQuantity,
  itemTypeOf,
  parseFieldErrors,
  procurementCapabilities,
  receiptSummary,
  remainingQuantity,

} from '../../shared/procurement-utils';

function Info({ label, children }) {
  return (
    <div className="field">
      <span className="form-label">{label}</span>
      <div className="small">{children ?? 'â€”'}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Purchase order detail: terms, lines, delivery progress, receipts and
 *  approval trail. */
export function PurchaseOrderDetail({ id }) {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const caps = procurementCapabilities(auth);
  const [order, setOrder] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [dialog, setDialog] = useState(null);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [actionError, setActionError] = useState('');
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState('');
  const [downloading, setDownloading] = useState(false);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const res = await api.get(`/procurement/purchase-orders/${id}/`);
      setOrder(res.data);
    } catch (e) {
      const parsed = parseFieldErrors(e);
      setError(parsed.global || 'This purchase order is unavailable.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [id]);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect

  const runAction = async (action) => {
    setBusy(true);
    setActionError('');
    try {
      const payload = { reason: reason.trim() };
      if (action === 'cancel' || action === 'close') payload.version = order?.version;
      await api.post(`/procurement/purchase-orders/${id}/${action}/`, payload);
      setDialog(null);
      setReason('');
      setNotice('Purchase order updated.');
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      const status = e?.response?.status;
      const parsed = parseFieldErrors(e);
      if (status === 403) {
        setActionError('You do not have permission to perform this action.');
      } else if (status === 409) {
        await load();
        setActionError('This order changed while you were working. The latest data is loaded; review before retrying.');
      } else if (status === 404) {
        setActionError('This procurement record is unavailable or you no longer have access.');
      } else {
        setActionError(parsed.global || Object.values(parsed.fields)[0] || 'Action failed.');
      }
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) return <LoadingRows />;

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div>
        <PageHeader title="Purchase order" />
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>
        <div className="row-gap">
          <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={load}>Retry</button>
          <a className="btn-ghost" href="#/procurement/orders">Back to orders</a>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!order) return null;

  const manager = !!caps.canApprovePurchaseOrder;
  const available = actionAvailability({ purchaseOrder: order, caps, userId: auth?.user?.id });
  const lines = order.items || [];
  const orderedUnits = lines.reduce((sum, l) => sum + Number(l.quantity || 0), 0);
  const acceptedUnits = lines.reduce((sum, l) => sum + Number(l.received_qty || 0), 0);
  const rejectedUnits = lines.reduce((sum, l) => sum + Number(l.rejected_qty || 0), 0);
  const damagedUnits = lines.reduce((sum, l) => sum + Number(l.damaged_qty || 0), 0);
  const bookedUnits = acceptedUnits + rejectedUnits + damagedUnits;
  const cancelBlocked = bookedUnits > 0;
  const canCancel = manager && !cancelBlocked
    && ['draft', 'pending_approval', 'approved', 'sent_to_vendor'].includes(order.status);
  const canClose = manager
    && ['approved', 'sent_to_vendor', 'partially_received', 'received'].includes(order.status);

  const downloadPdf = async () => {
    setDownloading(true);
    setActionError('');
    try {
      const response = await api.get(
        `/procurement/purchase-orders/${id}/pdf/`, { responseType: 'blob' },
      );
      const filename = filenameFromContentDisposition(
        response.headers?.['content-disposition'], `PO-${order.po_number}.pdf`,
      );
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(response.data);
      try {
        const anchor = document.createElement('a');
        anchor.href = url;
        anchor.download = filename;
        document.body.appendChild(anchor);
        anchor.click();
        anchor.remove();
      } finally {
        window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      const status = e?.response?.status;
      setActionError(status === 403
        ? 'You do not have permission to download this purchase order.'
        : 'Could not download the purchase order PDF.');
    } finally {
      setDownloading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title={order.po_number}
        sub={order.vendor_detail?.name ? `Vendor: ${order.vendor_detail.name}` : undefined}
        actions={(
          <div className="row-gap">
            <a className="btn-ghost" href="#/procurement/orders">All orders</a>
            {order.purchase_request ? (
              <a className="btn-ghost" href={`#/procurement/requests/${order.purchase_request}`}>View request</a>
            ) : null}
            <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={downloadPdf} disabled={downloading}>
              {downloading ? 'Preparing PDFâ€¦' : 'Download PDF'}
            </button>
            {available.createReceipt ? (
              <a className="btn-primary" href={`#/procurement/receipts/new?po=${order.id}`}>Create goods receipt</a>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        )}
      />

      <div className="row-gap">
        <span className={`badge badge-${statusBadgeVariant(order.status)}`}>
          {PURCHASE_ORDER_STATUS_LABELS[order.status] ?? order.status}
        </span>
        {order.requires_system_admin_approval
          ? <span className="badge badge-amber">System Admin approval required</span> : null}
      </div>

      {notice ? <div className="success-summary" role="status">{notice}</div> : null}

      <div className="panel" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
        <div className="panel-head"><h3>Order</h3></div>
        <div className="panel-pad">
          <Info label="Vendor">{order.vendor_detail?.name}</Info>
          <Info label="Delivery address">{order.delivery_address || 'â€”'}</Info>
          <Info label="Currency">{order.currency}</Info>
          <Info label="Subtotal">{formatMoney(order.subtotal, order.currency)}</Info>
          <Info label="Tax">{formatMoney(order.tax, order.currency)}</Info>
          <Info label="Discount">{formatMoney(order.discount, order.currency)}</Info>
          <Info label="Shipping">{formatMoney(order.shipping, order.currency)}</Info>
          <Info label="Total">{formatMoney(order.total, order.currency)}</Info>
          <Info label="Terms">{order.terms || 'â€”'}</Info>
          <Info label="Notes">{order.notes || 'â€”'}</Info>
          <Info label="Created by">{order.created_by_name || order.created_by}</Info>
          <Info label="Order date">{formatDateTime(order.created_at)}</Info>
          <Info label="Expected delivery">{formatDate(order.expected_delivery_date)}</Info>
          <Info label="Sent to vendor">{formatDateTime(order.sent_at)}</Info>
          <Info label="Closed at">{formatDateTime(order.closed_at)}</Info>
          <Info label="Closure reason">{order.closure_reason || 'â€”'}</Info>
          <Info label="Cancellation reason">{order.cancellation_reason || 'â€”'}</Info>
          <Info label="Last updated">{formatDateTime(order.updated_at)}</Info>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="panel" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
        <div className="panel-head"><h3>Approval</h3></div>
        <div className="panel-pad">
          <Info label="Decision">
            {order.approval_decision
              ? (APPROVAL_STATUS_LABELS[order.approval_decision] ?? order.approval_decision)
              : 'Not decided'}
          </Info>
          <Info label="Approver">{order.approver_name || 'â€”'}</Info>
          <Info label="Reason">{order.approval_reason || 'â€”'}</Info>
          <Info label="Approved at">{formatDateTime(order.approved_at)}</Info>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="panel" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
        <div className="panel-head"><h3>Delivery progress</h3></div>
        <div className="panel-pad">
          <p className="small" style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>
            {formatQuantity(acceptedUnits)} accepted Â· {formatQuantity(rejectedUnits)} rejected Â·{' '}
            {formatQuantity(damagedUnits)} damaged Â· {formatQuantity(orderedUnits)} ordered
          </p>
          <div
            role="img"
            aria-label={`${bookedUnits} of ${orderedUnits} ordered units booked`}
            style={{ background: 'var(--neutral-bg, #eee)', height: 12, borderRadius: 6 }}
          >
            <div style={{
              width: `${orderedUnits ? Math.min(100, Math.round((bookedUnits / orderedUnits) * 100)) : 0}%`,
              background: 'var(--success, #16a34a)',
              height: 12,
              borderRadius: 6,

            />

      </div>

        <h3>Line items</h3>
        <DataTable

            { key: 'item_name', label: 'Item', render: (r) => <span className="row-title">{r.item_name}</span> },
            { key: 'type', label: 'Item type', render: (r) => ITEM_TYPE_LABELS[itemTypeOf(r)] },

            { key: 'remaining', label: 'Remaining', render: (r) => formatQuantity(remainingQuantity(r)) },

            { key: 'tax', label: 'Tax', render: (r) => formatMoney(r.tax, order.currency) },
            { key: 'discount', label: 'Discount', render: (r) => formatMoney(r.discount, order.currency) },

        )}
      </div>

      <div style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>

        {(order.history || []).length === 0 ? (

        ) : (
