          />
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="row-gap" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
        {available.approveOrder ? (
          <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={() => { setReason(''); setActionError(''); setDialog('approve'); }}>Approve</button>
        ) : null}
        {available.rejectOrder ? (
          <button type="button" className="btn-danger" onClick={() => { setReason(''); setActionError(''); setDialog('reject'); }}>Reject</button>
        ) : null}
        {available.issueOrder ? (
          <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={() => { setActionError(''); setDialog('issue'); }}>Issue to vendor</button>
        ) : null}
        {canCancel ? (
          <button type="button" className="btn-danger" onClick={() => { setReason(''); setActionError(''); setDialog('cancel'); }}>Cancel order</button>
        ) : null}
        {canClose ? (
          <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => { setReason(''); setActionError(''); setDialog('close'); }}>Close order</button>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      {cancelBlocked && ['draft', 'pending_approval', 'approved', 'sent_to_vendor', 'partially_received'].includes(order.status) ? (
        <p className="small muted">
          This order already has receipt activity, so it cannot be cancelled.
          Close the remaining balance instead.
        </p>
      ) : null}

      <ProcurementAttachments
        parentType="purchase_order"
        parentId={order.id}
        canUpload={caps.canViewProcurement}
        title="Order attachments"
      />

      {dialog === 'cancel' || dialog === 'close' ? (
        <Modal
          title={`${dialog === 'cancel' ? 'Cancel' : 'Close'} ${order.po_number}`}
          onClose={() => { if (!busy) setDialog(null); }}
        >
          <p style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>
            {dialog === 'cancel'
              ? 'Cancelling keeps the order and every line. It cannot be undone and no further receipts are accepted.'
              : 'Closing stops further receipts. Ordered, received, rejected, damaged and outstanding quantities stay as they are.'}
          </p>
          <Field label={dialog === 'cancel' ? 'Cancellation reason' : 'Closure reason'} required={dialog === 'close' ? bookedUnits < orderedUnits : true}>
            <textarea
              className="input" rows={3} value={reason}
              onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
              aria-label={dialog === 'cancel' ? 'Cancellation reason' : 'Closure reason'}
            />
          </Field>
          {actionError ? <ErrorSummary parsed={{ global: actionError }} /> : null}
          <div className="row-end">
            <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setDialog(null)} disabled={busy}>Keep order</button>
            <button
              type="button" className={dialog === 'cancel' ? 'btn-danger' : 'btn-primary'}
              disabled={busy || !reason.trim()}
              onClick={() => runAction(dialog)}
            >
              {busy ? 'Workingâ€¦' : dialog === 'cancel' ? 'Cancel order' : 'Close order'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      ) : null}

      {dialog === 'issue' ? (
        <ConfirmDialog
          title={`Issue ${order.po_number}`}
          message="The order is marked as sent to the vendor. Goods receipts can be booked after this step."
          confirmLabel="Issue to vendor"
          busy={busy}
          onCancel={() => setDialog(null)}
          onConfirm={() => runAction('send_to_vendor')}
        >
          {actionError ? <ErrorSummary parsed={{ global: actionError }} /> : null}
        </ConfirmDialog>
      ) : null}

      {dialog && dialog !== 'issue' && dialog !== 'cancel' && dialog !== 'close' ? (
        <Modal
          title={`${dialog === 'approve' ? 'Approve' : 'Reject'} ${order.po_number}`}
          onClose={() => { if (!busy) setDialog(null); }}
        >
          <Field label="Reason" required={dialog === 'reject'}>
            <textarea
              className="input" rows={3} value={reason}
              onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)} aria-label="Reason"
            />
          </Field>
          {actionError ? <ErrorSummary parsed={{ global: actionError }} /> : null}
          <div className="row-end">
            <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setDialog(null)} disabled={busy}>Cancel</button>
            <button
              type="button" className="btn-primary"
              disabled={busy || (dialog === 'reject' && !reason.trim())}
              onClick={() => runAction(dialog)}
            >
              {busy ? 'Workingâ€¦' : 'Confirm'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}



===== src\pages\procurement\PurchaseOrders.jsx =====

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import {
  ConfirmDialog, DataTable, ErrorSummary, Field, LoadingRows, Modal, PageHeader, Pager, PageSizeSelector,
} from '../../components';
import {
  PURCHASE_ORDER_STATUS_LABELS,
  actionAvailability,
  buildPurchaseOrderListUrl,
  formatDateTime,
  formatMoney,
  parseFieldErrors,
  procurementCapabilities,
  safeResults,
  statusBadgeVariant,
} from '../../shared/procurement-utils';

function StatusPill({ status }) {
  return (
    <span className={`badge badge-${statusBadgeVariant(status)}`}>
      {PURCHASE_ORDER_STATUS_LABELS[status] ?? status}
    </span>
  );
}

/** Purchase order list with server-side filters, search and pagination. */
export function PurchaseOrdersPage() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const caps = procurementCapabilities(auth);
  const requestIdRef = useRef(0);
  const mountedRef = useRef(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    return () => { mountedRef.current = false; };
  }, []);
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState([]);
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState({
    q: '', status: '', createdFrom: '', createdTo: '', receiptStatus: '', ordering: '-created_at',
  });
  const [dialog, setDialog] = useState(null);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [actionError, setActionError] = useState('');
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState('');

  // Page-size preference persisted in localStorage; fall back to DRF default 20.
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 20;
    try {
      const saved = window.localStorage.getItem('itdesk.pageSize');
      const n = Number(saved);
      return saved && Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? n : 20;
    } catch {
      return 20;
    }
  });

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    const requestId = ++requestIdRef.current;
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const response = await api.get(buildPurchaseOrderListUrl({
        page,
        page_size: pageSize,
        search: filters.q,
        status: filters.status,
        created_from: filters.createdFrom,
        created_to: filters.createdTo,
        receipt_status: filters.receiptStatus,
        ordering: filters.ordering,
      }));
      if (!mountedRef.current || requestId !== requestIdRef.current) return;
      setOrders(safeResults(response.data));
      setCount(Number(response.data?.count ?? safeResults(response.data).length));
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mountedRef.current || requestId !== requestIdRef.current) return;
      setError(parseFieldErrors(e).global || 'Could not load purchase orders.');
    } finally {
      if (mountedRef.current && requestId === requestIdRef.current) setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [page, filters, pageSize]);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect

  // Reset to page 1 when page size changes
  useEffect(() => {
    setPage(1); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
  }, [pageSize]);

  // Persist page-size preference without unnecessary writes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    try {
      if (window.localStorage.getItem('itdesk.pageSize') !== String(pageSize)) {
        window.localStorage.setItem('itdesk.pageSize', String(pageSize));
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore storage failures
    }
  }, [pageSize]);

  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(count / pageSize));
  const currentPage = Math.min(page, pageCount);
  const update = (key, value) => { setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, [key]: value })); setPage(1); };

  const runAction = async (po, action) => {
    setBusy(true);
    setActionError('');
    try {
      const payload = { reason: reason.trim() };
      if (action === 'cancel') payload.version = po.version;
      await api.post(`/procurement/purchase-orders/${po.id}/${action}/`, payload);
      setDialog(null);
      setReason('');
      setNotice('Purchase order updated.');
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      const status = e?.response?.status;
      const parsed = parseFieldErrors(e);
      if (status === 403) {
        setActionError('You do not have permission to perform this action.');
      } else if (status === 409) {
        await load();
        setActionError('This order changed while you were working. Reload and review before retrying.');
      } else {
        setActionError(parsed.global || Object.values(parsed.fields)[0] || 'Action failed.');
      }
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  if (!caps.canViewProcurement) {
    return <div className="empty-state"><div className="empty-title">Access restricted</div><div className="small">Procurement is available to IT staff only.</div></div>;
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Purchase orders"
        sub="Approval, issue and receipt for vendor orders."
        actions={<a className="btn-ghost" href="#/procurement">Overview</a>}
      />

      <div className="panel">
        <div className="panel-head"><h3>Filters</h3></div>
        <div className="panel-pad">
          <div className="row-gap">
            <Field label="Search">
              <input className="input" value={filters.q} onChange={(e) => update('q', e.target.value)} placeholder="PO number, vendor, request" />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Status">
              <select className="input" value={filters.status} onChange={(e) => update('status', e.target.value)}>
                <option value="">Any status</option>
                {Object.entries(PURCHASE_ORDER_STATUS_LABELS).map(([value, label]) => (
                  <option key={value} value={value}>{label}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </Field>
            <Field label="Receipt status">
              <select className="input" value={filters.receiptStatus} onChange={(e) => update('receiptStatus', e.target.value)}>
                <option value="">Any</option>
                <option value="unreceived">Not yet received</option>
                <option value="partially_received">Partially received</option>
                <option value="received">Fully received</option>
              </select>
            </Field>
            <Field label="Order by">
              <select className="input" value={filters.ordering} onChange={(e) => update('ordering', e.target.value)} aria-label="Order by">
                <option value="-created_at">Newest first</option>
                <option value="created_at">Oldest first</option>
                <option value="expected_delivery_date">Expected delivery</option>
                <option value="total">Total</option>
                <option value="po_number">PO number</option>
              </select>
            </Field>
            <Field label="Ordered from">
              <input type="date" className="input" value={filters.createdFrom} onChange={(e) => update('createdFrom', e.target.value)} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Ordered to">
              <input type="date" className="input" value={filters.createdTo} onChange={(e) => update('createdTo', e.target.value)} />
            </Field>
          </div>
          <div className="row-gap" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
            <span className="small muted">{count} order(s)</span>
            <button type="button" className="btn-ghost btn-small" onClick={load} disabled={loading}>Refresh</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {notice ? <div className="success-summary" role="status">{notice}</div> : null}
      {actionError && !dialog ? <ErrorSummary parsed={{ global: actionError }} /> : null}

      {loading ? <LoadingRows /> : null}
      {error ? (
        <div>
          <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>
          <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={load}>Retry</button>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {!loading && !error ? (
        <>
          <DataTable
            columns={[
              { key: 'po_number', label: 'PO', render: (r) => <a className="row-title" href={`#/procurement/orders/${r.id}`}>{r.po_number}</a> },
              {
                key: 'request',
                label: 'Request',
                render: (r) => (r.purchase_request
                  ? <a href={`#/procurement/requests/${r.purchase_request}`}>{r.purchase_request_number || `Request ${r.purchase_request}`}</a>
                  : 'â€”'),
              },
              { key: 'vendor', label: 'Vendor', render: (r) => r.vendor_detail?.name ?? 'â€”' },
              { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (r) => <StatusPill status={r.status} /> },
              { key: 'created_at', label: 'Order date', render: (r) => formatDateTime(r.created_at) },
              { key: 'expected_delivery_date', label: 'Expected delivery', render: (r) => r.expected_delivery_date || 'â€”' },
              { key: 'total', label: 'Total', render: (r) => formatMoney(r.total, r.currency) },
              { key: 'currency', label: 'Currency', render: (r) => r.currency || 'â€”' },
              {
                key: 'receipt',
                label: 'Receipt status',
                render: (r) => {
                  const lines = r.items || [];
                  const booked = lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum
                    + Number(line.received_qty || 0)
                    + Number(line.rejected_qty || 0)
                    + Number(line.damaged_qty || 0), 0);
                  if (!booked) return <span className="small muted">Nothing received</span>;
                  return <span className="small">{booked} of {lines.reduce((s, l) => s + Number(l.quantity || 0), 0)} units booked</span>;
                },
              },
              { key: 'updated_at', label: 'Updated', render: (r) => formatDateTime(r.updated_at) },
              {
                key: 'actions',
                label: 'Actions',
                render: (r) => {
                  const available = actionAvailability({ purchaseOrder: r, caps, userId: auth?.user?.id });
                  const booked = (r.items || []).some((line) => (
                    Number(line.received_qty || 0) + Number(line.rejected_qty || 0) + Number(line.damaged_qty || 0)) > 0);
                  return (
                    <div className="row-gap">
                      <a className="btn-ghost btn-small" href={`#/procurement/orders/${r.id}`}>View</a>
                      {available.approveOrder ? (
                        <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => { setReason(''); setActionError(''); setDialog({ kind: 'approve', po: r }); }}>Approve</button>
                      ) : null}
                      {available.rejectOrder ? (
                        <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => { setReason(''); setActionError(''); setDialog({ kind: 'reject', po: r }); }}>Reject</button>
                      ) : null}
                      {available.issueOrder ? (
                        <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => { setActionError(''); setDialog({ kind: 'issue', po: r }); }}>Issue to vendor</button>
                      ) : null}
                      {available.createReceipt ? (
                        <a className="btn-ghost btn-small" href={`#/procurement/receipts/new?po=${r.id}`}>Create receipt</a>
                      ) : null}
                      {caps.canApprovePurchaseOrder && !booked
                        && ['draft', 'pending_approval', 'approved', 'sent_to_vendor'].includes(r.status) ? (
                          <button type="button" className="btn-danger btn-small" onClick={() => { setReason(''); setActionError(''); setDialog({ kind: 'cancel', po: r }); }}>Cancel</button>
                        ) : null}
                    </div>
                  );
                },
              },
            ]}
            rows={orders}
            keyOf={(r) => `po-${r.id}`}
            emptyTitle="No purchase orders match these filters."
            emptyHint="Purchase orders are generated from an approved request with a selected vendor."
          />
          <PageSizeSelector value={pageSize} onChange={setPageSize} />
          <Pager
            count={count}
            hasPrev={currentPage > 1}
            hasNext={currentPage < pageCount}
            onPrev={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
            onNext={() => setPage((p) => Math.min(pageCount, p + 1))}
            busy={loading}
            pageLabel={`Page ${currentPage} of ${pageCount}`}
          />
        </>
      ) : null}

      {dialog?.kind === 'issue' ? (
        <ConfirmDialog
          title={`Issue ${dialog.po.po_number} to the vendor`}
          message="The order is marked as sent to the vendor. Receipts can be booked after this step."
          confirmLabel="Issue to vendor"
          busy={busy}
          onCancel={() => setDialog(null)}
          onConfirm={() => runAction(dialog.po, 'send_to_vendor')}
        >
          {actionError ? <ErrorSummary parsed={{ global: actionError }} /> : null}
        </ConfirmDialog>
      ) : null}

      {dialog && ['approve', 'reject', 'cancel'].includes(dialog.kind) ? (
        <Modal
          title={`${dialog.kind === 'approve' ? 'Approve' : dialog.kind === 'reject' ? 'Reject' : 'Cancel'} ${dialog.po.po_number}`}
          onClose={() => { if (!busy) setDialog(null); }}
        >
          <Field label={dialog.kind === 'cancel' ? 'Cancellation reason' : 'Reason'} required={dialog.kind !== 'approve'}>
            <textarea
              className="input" rows={3} value={reason}
              onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
              aria-label={dialog.kind === 'cancel' ? 'Cancellation reason' : 'Reason'}
            />
          </Field>
          {actionError ? <ErrorSummary parsed={{ global: actionError }} /> : null}
          <div className="row-end">
            <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setDialog(null)} disabled={busy}>Cancel</button>
            <button
              type="button" className={dialog.kind === 'cancel' ? 'btn-danger' : 'btn-primary'}
              disabled={busy || (dialog.kind !== 'approve' && !reason.trim())}
              onClick={() => runAction(dialog.po, dialog.kind)}
            >
              {busy ? 'Workingâ€¦' : 'Confirm'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}



===== src\pages\procurement\PurchaseRequestDetail.jsx =====

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import {
  Badge, ConfirmDialog, DataTable, EmptyState, ErrorSummary, Field, LoadingRows, Modal, PageHeader,
} from '../../components';
import { ProcurementAttachments } from './ProcurementAttachments';
import {
  APPROVAL_STATUS_LABELS,
  PURCHASE_REQUEST_STATUS_LABELS,
  actionAvailability,
  buildGoodsReceiptListUrl,
  buildPurchaseOrderListUrl,
  fetchAll,
  formatDate,
  formatDateTime,
  formatMoney,
  parseFieldErrors,
  procurementCapabilities,
  receiptSummary,
  statusBadgeVariant,
} from '../../shared/procurement-utils';

function Row({ label, children }) {
  return (
    <div className="field">
      <span className="form-label">{label}</span>
      <div className="small">{children ?? 'â€”'}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Purchase request detail: overview, lines, approval trail, quotations,
 *  resulting purchase order and receipts. */
export function PurchaseRequestDetail({ id }) {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const caps = procurementCapabilities(auth);
  const [request, setRequest] = useState(null);
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState([]);
  const [receipts, setReceipts] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [secondaryError, setSecondaryError] = useState('');
  const [dialog, setDialog] = useState(null);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [actionError, setActionError] = useState('');
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState('');
  const [refreshAt, setRefreshAt] = useState(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    setSecondaryError('');
    try {
      const res = await api.get(`/procurement/purchase-requests/${id}/`);
      setRequest(res.data);
      setRefreshAt(new Date());
    } catch (e) {
      const parsed = parseFieldErrors(e);
      setError(parsed.global || 'This purchase request is unavailable.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [id]);

  const loadSecondary = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const [poRows, grRows] = await Promise.all([
        fetchAll(buildPurchaseOrderListUrl({ purchase_request: id, page_size: 100 })),
        fetchAll(buildGoodsReceiptListUrl({ purchase_request: id, page_size: 100 })),
      ]);
      setOrders(poRows);
      setReceipts(grRows);
    } catch {
      setSecondaryError('Purchase orders and receipts could not be loaded.');
    }
  }, [id]);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
  useEffect(() => { loadSecondary(); }, [loadSecondary]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect

  const runAction = async (action) => {
    setBusy(true);
    setActionError('');
    try {
      const payload = { reason: reason.trim() };
      if (action === 'cancel') payload.version = request?.version;
      await api.post(`/procurement/purchase-requests/${id}/${action}/`, payload);
      setDialog(null);
      setReason('');
      setNotice('Purchase request updated.');
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      const parsed = parseFieldErrors(e);
      const status = e?.response?.status;
      if (status === 409) {
        await load();
        setActionError('This request changed while you were working. The latest data is shown; review before retrying.');
      } else if (status === 403) {
        setActionError('You do not have permission to perform this action.');
      } else if (status === 404) {
        setActionError('This procurement record is unavailable or you no longer have access.');
      } else {
        setActionError(parsed.global || Object.values(parsed.fields)[0] || 'Action failed.');
      }
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) return <LoadingRows />;

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div>
        <PageHeader title="Purchase request" />
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>
        <div className="row-gap">
          <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={load}>Retry</button>
          <a className="btn-ghost" href="#/procurement/requests">Back to requests</a>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!request) return null;

  const available = actionAvailability({ request, caps, userId: auth?.user?.id });
  const canCancel = !request.purchase_order_ref
    && ['draft', 'pending_approval', 'returned_for_correction', 'rejected', 'approved'].includes(request.status)
    && (request.requester === auth?.user?.id || caps.canApprovePurchaseRequest);
  const requestOrders = orders.filter((po) => po.purchase_request === request.id);
  const requestReceipts = receipts.filter((gr) => requestOrders.some((po) => po.id === gr.purchase_order));
  const selectedQuotation = (request.quotations || []).find((q) => q.is_selected);
  const history = request.history || [];

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title={request.pr_number}
        sub={request.reason}
        actions={(
          <div className="row-gap">
            <a className="btn-ghost" href="#/procurement/requests">All requests</a>
            {available.editRequest ? (
              <a className="btn-ghost" href={`#/procurement/requests/${request.id}/edit`}>Edit draft</a>
            ) : null}
            {caps.canManageQuotations ? (
              <a className="btn-ghost" href={`#/procurement/requests/${request.id}/quotations`}>Quotations</a>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        )}
      />

      <div className="row-gap" aria-label="Request status">
        <span className={`badge badge-${statusBadgeVariant(request.status)}`}>
          {PURCHASE_REQUEST_STATUS_LABELS[request.status] ?? request.status}
        </span>
        {request.requires_system_admin_approval
          ? <span className="badge badge-amber">System Admin approval required</span> : null}
      </div>

      {notice ? <div className="success-summary" role="status">{notice}</div> : null}

      <div className="panel" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
        <div className="panel-head"><h3>Overview</h3></div>
        <div className="panel-pad">
          <Row label="Requester">{request.requester_name || request.requester}</Row>
          <Row label="Department">{request.department ?? 'â€”'}</Row>
          <Row label="Estimated total">{formatMoney(request.estimated_total)}</Row>
          <Row label="Approval state">
            {request.approver_name
              ? `${APPROVAL_STATUS_LABELS[request.approval_decision] ?? request.approval_decision} by ${request.approver_name}`
              : (APPROVAL_STATUS_LABELS[request.approval_decision] ?? 'Not decided')}
          </Row>
          <Row label="Approval note">{request.approval_reason || 'â€”'}</Row>
          <Row label="Approved at">{formatDateTime(request.approved_at)}</Row>
          <Row label="Created">{formatDateTime(request.created_at)}</Row>
          <Row label="Last updated">{formatDateTime(request.updated_at)}</Row>
          <Row label="Data as of">{formatDateTime(refreshAt)}</Row>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="panel" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
        <div className="panel-head"><h3>Business justification</h3></div>
        <div className="panel-pad">
          <p style={{ whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap', marginTop: 0 }}>{request.reason || 'â€”'}</p>
          {request.notes ? <p className="small muted" style={{ whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap' }}>{request.notes}</p> : null}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
        <h3>Line items</h3>
        <DataTable
          columns={[
            { key: 'item_name', label: 'Item' },
            { key: 'description', label: 'Description', render: (r) => r.description || 'â€”' },
            { key: 'quantity', label: 'Quantity' },
            { key: 'estimated_unit_price', label: 'Unit estimate', render: (r) => formatMoney(r.estimated_unit_price) },
            { key: 'estimated_total', label: 'Line estimate', render: (r) => formatMoney(r.estimated_total) },
            { key: 'suggested_vendor', label: 'Suggested vendor', render: (r) => r.suggested_vendor ?? 'â€”' },
          ]}
          rows={request.items || []}
          keyOf={(r) => `item-${r.id}`}
          emptyTitle="No line items recorded."
          emptyHint="A request needs at least one line before it can be approved."
        />
      </div>

      <div style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>
        <h3>Quotations and vendor selection</h3>
        {secondaryError ? <div className="field-error" role="alert">{secondaryError}</div> : null}
        {(request.quotations || []).length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            title="No quotations recorded."
            hint={request.status === 'approved'
              ? 'Add vendor quotations, then select the winning offer.'
              : 'Quotations can be collected once the request is approved.'}
            action={caps.canManageQuotations && request.status === 'approved'
              ? <a className="btn-primary" href={`#/procurement/requests/${request.id}/quotations`}>Manage quotations</a>
              : null}
          />
        ) : (
          <DataTable
            columns={[
              { key: 'vendor', label: 'Vendor', render: (r) => r.vendor_detail?.name ?? 'â€”' },
              { key: 'quoted_amount', label: 'Quoted amount', render: (r) => formatMoney(r.quoted_amount) },
              { key: 'delivery_days', label: 'Delivery days', render: (r) => r.delivery_days ?? 'â€”' },
              { key: 'warranty', label: 'Warranty', render: (r) => r.warranty || 'â€”' },
              {
                key: 'selection',
                label: 'Selection',
                render: (r) => (r.is_selected
                  ? <Badge kind="status" value="approved" label="Selected" />
                  : <span className="small muted">Not selected</span>),
              },
            ]}
            rows={request.quotations}
            keyOf={(r) => `quotation-${r.id}`}
            emptyTitle="No quotations."
            emptyHint=""
          />
        )}
        {selectedQuotation ? (
          <p className="small">
            Selected vendor: <strong>{selectedQuotation.vendor_detail?.name}</strong>
            {selectedQuotation.selection_reason ? ` â€” ${selectedQuotation.selection_reason}` : ''}
          </p>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <div style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>
        <h3>Purchase order</h3>
        {requestOrders.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            title="No purchase order yet."
            hint="An order is generated from an approved request with a selected vendor quotation."
          />
        ) : (
          <DataTable
            columns={[
              { key: 'po_number', label: 'PO', render: (r) => <a className="row-title" href={`#/procurement/orders/${r.id}`}>{r.po_number}</a> },
              { key: 'vendor', label: 'Vendor', render: (r) => r.vendor_detail?.name ?? 'â€”' },
              { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (r) => r.status },
              { key: 'total', label: 'Total', render: (r) => formatMoney(r.total, r.currency) },
            ]}
            rows={requestOrders}
            keyOf={(r) => `po-${r.id}`}
            emptyTitle="No purchase order."
            emptyHint=""
          />
        )}
      </div>

      <div style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>
        <h3>Goods receipts</h3>
        {requestReceipts.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState title="No goods receipts yet." hint="Receipts appear here once deliveries are booked against the purchase order." />
        ) : (
          <DataTable
            columns={[
              { key: 'gr_number', label: 'Receipt', render: (r) => <a className="row-title" href={`#/procurement/receipts/${r.id}`}>{r.gr_number}</a> },
              { key: 'received_at', label: 'Received', render: (r) => formatDate(r.received_at) },
              { key: 'received_by_name', label: 'Received by', render: (r) => r.received_by_name || 'â€”' },
              { key: 'accepted', label: 'Accepted', render: (r) => receiptSummary(r).accepted },
              { key: 'rejected', label: 'Rejected', render: (r) => receiptSummary(r).rejected },
              { key: 'damaged', label: 'Damaged', render: (r) => receiptSummary(r).damaged },
            ]}
            rows={requestReceipts}
            keyOf={(r) => `gr-${r.id}`}
            emptyTitle="No receipts."
            emptyHint=""
          />
        )}
      </div>

      <div style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>
        <h3>History</h3>
        {history.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState title="No history recorded." hint="Actions on this request will be listed here." />
        ) : (
          <DataTable
            columns={[
              { key: 'created_at', label: 'When', render: (r) => formatDateTime(r.created_at) },
              { key: 'action', label: 'Event', render: (r) => r.action },
              { key: 'actor_name', label: 'Actor', render: (r) => r.actor_name || 'â€”' },
              { key: 'detail', label: 'Detail', render: (r) => r.detail || 'â€”' },
            ]}
            rows={history}
            keyOf={(r) => `history-${r.id}`}
            emptyTitle="No history."
            emptyHint=""
          />
        )}
        <p className="small muted">History is read-only and cannot be edited from the interface.</p>
      </div>

      <div className="row-gap" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
        {available.submitRequest ? (
          <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={() => { setReason(''); setActionError(''); setDialog('submit'); }}>
            Submit for approval
          </button>
        ) : null}
        {available.approveRequest ? (
          <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={() => { setReason(''); setActionError(''); setDialog('approve'); }}>
            Approve
          </button>
        ) : null}
        {available.rejectRequest ? (
          <button type="button" className="btn-danger" onClick={() => { setReason(''); setActionError(''); setDialog('reject'); }}>
            Reject
          </button>
        ) : null}
        {available.returnRequest ? (
          <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => { setReason(''); setActionError(''); setDialog('return'); }}>
            Return for correction
          </button>
        ) : null}
        {canCancel ? (
          <button type="button" className="btn-danger" onClick={() => { setReason(''); setActionError(''); setDialog('cancel'); }}>
            Cancel request
          </button>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <ProcurementAttachments
        parentType="purchase_request"
        parentId={request.id}
        canUpload={caps.canViewProcurement}
        title="Request attachments"
      />

      {dialog === 'submit' ? (
        <ConfirmDialog
          title={`Submit ${request.pr_number}`}
          message="This sends the request for approval. It cannot be edited while pending."
          confirmLabel="Submit"
          busy={busy}
          onCancel={() => setDialog(null)}
          onConfirm={() => runAction('submit')}
        >
          {actionError ? <ErrorSummary parsed={{ global: actionError }} /> : null}
        </ConfirmDialog>
      ) : null}

      {dialog === 'cancel' ? (
        <Modal
          title={`Cancel ${request.pr_number}`}
          onClose={() => { if (!busy) setDialog(null); }}
        >
          <p style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>
            Cancelling keeps the request and its history. It cannot be undone.
          </p>
          <Field label="Cancellation reason" required>
            <textarea
              className="input" rows={3} value={reason}
              onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
              aria-label="Cancellation reason"
            />
          </Field>
          {actionError ? <ErrorSummary parsed={{ global: actionError }} /> : null}
          <div className="row-end">
            <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setDialog(null)} disabled={busy}>Keep request</button>
            <button
              type="button" className="btn-danger"
              disabled={busy || !reason.trim()}
              onClick={() => runAction('cancel')}
            >
              {busy ? 'Workingâ€¦' : 'Cancel request'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      ) : null}

      {dialog && dialog !== 'submit' && dialog !== 'cancel' ? (
        <Modal
          title={`${dialog === 'approve' ? 'Approve' : dialog === 'reject' ? 'Reject' : 'Return for correction'} ${request.pr_number}`}
          onClose={() => { if (!busy) setDialog(null); }}
        >
          <Field label="Reason" required={dialog !== 'approve'}>
            <textarea
              className="input" rows={3} value={reason}
              onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)} aria-label="Reason"
            />
          </Field>
          {actionError ? <ErrorSummary parsed={{ global: actionError }} /> : null}
          <div className="row-end">
            <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setDialog(null)} disabled={busy}>Cancel</button>
            <button
              type="button" className="btn-primary"
              disabled={busy || (dialog !== 'approve' && !reason.trim())}
              onClick={() => runAction(dialog === 'return' ? 'return_for_correction' : dialog)}
            >
              {busy ? 'Workingâ€¦' : 'Confirm'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}



===== src\pages\procurement\PurchaseRequestForm.jsx =====

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import {
  DataTable, EmptyState, ErrorSummary, Field, LoadingRows, PageHeader,
} from '../../components';
import {
  calculateDisplaySubtotal,
  estimateRequestTotal,
  fetchAll,
  formatMoney,
  parseFieldErrors,
  procurementCapabilities,
} from '../../shared/procurement-utils';

const STEPS = ['Request information', 'Line items', 'Review and save'];

function blankLine() {
  return {
    key: `line-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`,
    id: null,
    item_name: '',
    description: '',
    quantity: '1',
    estimated_unit_price: '',
    suggested_vendor: '',
    notes: '',
  };
}

function lineErrors(line) {
  const errors = {};
  if (!line.item_name.trim()) errors.item_name = 'Item name is required.';
  const quantity = Number(line.quantity);
  if (!Number.isInteger(quantity) || quantity <= 0) errors.quantity = 'Quantity must be a whole number greater than zero.';
  if (line.estimated_unit_price !== '') {
    const price = Number(line.estimated_unit_price);
    if (!Number.isFinite(price) || price < 0) errors.estimated_unit_price = 'Unit price must be zero or more.';
  }
  return errors;
}

/** Multi-step purchase request wizard. Creates the request first, then its
 *  line items through the real item endpoint. */
export function PurchaseRequestForm({ id }) {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const caps = procurementCapabilities(auth);
  const isEdit = !!id;
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(isEdit);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState('');
  const [vendors, setVendors] = useState([]);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ reason: '', notes: '' });
  const [lines, setLines] = useState([blankLine()]);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('draft');
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [lineFieldErrors, setLineFieldErrors] = useState({});
  const [globalError, setGlobalError] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!isEdit) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setLoadError('');
    try {
      const [requestRes, vendorRows] = await Promise.all([
        api.get(`/procurement/purchase-requests/${id}/`),
        fetchAll('/assets/vendors/?page_size=100').catch(() => []),
      ]);
      const request = requestRes.data;
      setForm({ reason: request.reason || '', notes: request.notes || '' });
      setStatus(request.status);
      setLines((request.items || []).length
        ? request.items.map((item) => ({
          key: `line-${item.id}`,
          id: item.id,
          item_name: item.item_name || '',
          description: item.description || '',
          quantity: String(item.quantity ?? 1),
          estimated_unit_price: item.estimated_unit_price ?? '',
          suggested_vendor: item.suggested_vendor ?? '',
          notes: item.notes || '',
        }))
        : [blankLine()]);
      setVendors(vendorRows.filter((v) => v.is_active !== false));
    } catch (e) {
      setLoadError(parseFieldErrors(e).global || 'Could not load this purchase request.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [id, isEdit]);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isEdit) return;
    fetchAll('/assets/vendors/?page_size=100')
      .then((rows) => setVendors(rows.filter((v) => v.is_active !== false)))
      .catch(() => setVendors([]));
  }, [isEdit]);

  const estimate = useMemo(() => estimateRequestTotal(lines.map((line) => ({
    quantity: line.quantity,
    estimated_unit_price: line.estimated_unit_price,
    estimated_total: line.estimated_unit_price === ''
      ? ''
      : (Number(line.quantity) * Number(line.estimated_unit_price)).toFixed(2),
  }))), [lines]);

  const lineProblems = useMemo(() => lines.map(lineErrors), [lines]);

  const setLine = (key, field, value) => {
    setLines((rows) => rows.map((row) => (row.key === key ? { ...row, [field]: value } : row)));
  };

  const addLine = () => setLines((rows) => [...rows, blankLine()]);
  const removeLine = (key) => setLines((rows) => (rows.length > 1 ? rows.filter((row) => row.key !== key) : rows));

  const validateRequestInfo = () => {
    const next = {};
    if (!form.reason.trim()) next.reason = 'Business justification is required.';
    setErrors(next);
    return Object.keys(next).length === 0;
  };

  const validateLines = () => {
    const problems = lines.map(lineErrors);
    const hasProblem = problems.some((p) => Object.keys(p).length > 0);
    setErrors(hasProblem ? { lines: 'Fix the highlighted line items.' } : {});
    return !hasProblem;
  };

  const goNext = () => {
    if (step === 0 && !validateRequestInfo()) return;
    if (step === 1 && !validateLines()) return;
    setStep((s) => Math.min(STEPS.length - 1, s + 1));
  };

  const save = async (submitAfter) => {
    if (busy) return;
    if (!validateRequestInfo()) { setStep(0); return; }
    if (!validateLines()) { setStep(1); return; }
    setBusy(true);
    setGlobalError('');
    setErrors({});
    setLineFieldErrors({});
    try {
      const payload = {
        reason: form.reason.trim(),
        notes: form.notes.trim(),
        estimated_total: estimate,
      };
      let requestId = id ? Number(id) : null;
      if (requestId) {
        await api.patch(`/procurement/purchase-requests/${requestId}/`, payload);
      } else {
        const created = await api.post('/procurement/purchase-requests/', payload);
        requestId = created.data.id;
      }

      for (const line of lines) {
        const linePayload = {
          purchase_request: requestId,
          item_name: line.item_name.trim(),
          description: line.description.trim(),
          quantity: Number(line.quantity),
          estimated_unit_price: line.estimated_unit_price === '' ? null : Number(line.estimated_unit_price),
          estimated_total: (Number(line.quantity) * Number(line.estimated_unit_price || 0)).toFixed(2),
          suggested_vendor: line.suggested_vendor === '' ? null : Number(line.suggested_vendor),
          notes: line.notes.trim(),
        };
        if (line.id) {
          await api.patch(`/procurement/purchase-request-items/${line.id}/`, linePayload);
        } else {
          await api.post('/procurement/purchase-request-items/', linePayload);
        }
      }

      if (submitAfter) {
        await api.post(`/procurement/purchase-requests/${requestId}/submit/`, {});
      }
      window.location.hash = `#/procurement/requests/${requestId}`;
    } catch (e) {
      const parsed = parseFieldErrors(e);
      setGlobalError(parsed.global || 'Could not save the purchase request.');
      const fields = parsed.fields || {};
      if (fields.reason || fields.notes || fields.estimated_total) {
        setErrors(fields);
        setStep(0);
      } else if (Object.keys(fields).length) {
        setLineFieldErrors(fields);
        setStep(1);
      }
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  if (!caps.canViewProcurement) {
    return <EmptyState title="Access restricted" hint="Procurement is available to IT staff only." />;
  }

  if (loading) return <LoadingRows />;

  if (loadError) {
    return (
      <div>
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{loadError}</div>
        <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={load}>Retry</button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (isEdit && !['draft', 'returned_for_correction'].includes(status)) {
    return (
      <div>
        <PageHeader title="Edit purchase request" />
        <EmptyState
          title="This request can no longer be edited"
          hint="Only draft requests, or requests returned for correction, can be changed. Create a new request instead."
          action={<a className="btn-primary" href={`#/procurement/requests/${id}`}>Back to request</a>}
        />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const vendorOptions = vendors;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title={isEdit ? 'Edit purchase request' : 'New purchase request'}
        sub={STEPS[step]}
        actions={<a className="btn-ghost" href={isEdit ? `#/procurement/requests/${id}` : '#/procurement/requests'}>Cancel</a>}
      />

      <ol className="row-gap" aria-label="Wizard steps">
        {STEPS.map((label, index) => (
          <li key={label} className={index === step ? 'row-title' : 'small muted'}>
            Step {index + 1}: {label}{index === step ? ' (current)' : ''}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>

      {globalError ? <ErrorSummary parsed={{ global: globalError }} /> : null}

      {step === 0 ? (
        <div className="panel">
          <div className="panel-head"><h3>Request information</h3></div>
          <div className="panel-pad">
            <Field label="Business justification" required error={errors.reason}>
              <textarea
                className="input" rows={4} value={form.reason}
                onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, reason: e.target.value }))}
                aria-label="Business justification"
              />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Notes" error={errors.notes} hint="Optional context for approvers and vendors.">
              <textarea
                className="input" rows={3} value={form.notes}
                onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, notes: e.target.value }))}
                aria-label="Notes"
              />
            </Field>
            <p className="small muted">
              The request number, requester and approval state are set by the server.
              Department comes from your profile.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {step === 1 ? (
        <div className="panel">
          <div className="panel-head"><h3>Line items</h3></div>
          <div className="panel-pad">
            {errors.lines ? <div className="field-error" role="alert">{errors.lines}</div> : null}
            {lines.map((line, index) => {
              const problems = lineProblems[index] || {};
              return (
                <div key={line.key} className="panel" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
                  <div className="panel-head"><h4>Line {index + 1}</h4></div>
                  <div className="panel-pad">
                    <Field label="Item name" required error={problems.item_name}>
                      <input
                        className="input" value={line.item_name}
                        onChange={(e) => setLine(line.key, 'item_name', e.target.value)}
                        aria-label={`Item name line ${index + 1}`}
                      />
                    </Field>
                    <Field label="Description">
                      <textarea
                        className="input" rows={2} value={line.description}
                        onChange={(e) => setLine(line.key, 'description', e.target.value)}
                        aria-label={`Description line ${index + 1}`}
                      />
                    </Field>
                    <div className="row-gap">
                      <Field label="Quantity" required error={problems.quantity}>
                        <input
                          type="number" min="1" step="1" className="input" value={line.quantity}
                          onChange={(e) => setLine(line.key, 'quantity', e.target.value)}
                          aria-label={`Quantity line ${index + 1}`}
                        />
                      </Field>
                      <Field label="Estimated unit price" error={problems.estimated_unit_price}>
                        <input
                          type="number" min="0" step="0.01" className="input" value={line.estimated_unit_price}
                          onChange={(e) => setLine(line.key, 'estimated_unit_price', e.target.value)}
                          aria-label={`Estimated unit price line ${index + 1}`}
                        />
                      </Field>
                      <Field label="Suggested vendor">
                        <select
                          className="input" value={line.suggested_vendor}
                          onChange={(e) => setLine(line.key, 'suggested_vendor', e.target.value)}
                          aria-label={`Suggested vendor line ${index + 1}`}
                        >
                          <option value="">No preference</option>
                          {vendorOptions.map((v) => (
                            <option key={v.id} value={v.id}>{v.name}</option>
                          ))}
                        </select>
                      </Field>
                    </div>
                    <Field label="Line notes">
                      <input
                        className="input" value={line.notes}
                        onChange={(e) => setLine(line.key, 'notes', e.target.value)}
                        aria-label={`Line notes ${index + 1}`}
                      />
                    </Field>
                    {lines.length > 1 ? (
                      <button type="button" className="btn-ghost btn-small" onClick={() => removeLine(line.key)}>
                        Remove line
                      </button>
                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
            {Object.entries(lineFieldErrors).length ? (
              <div className="field-error" role="alert">
                {Object.entries(lineFieldErrors).map(([field, msg]) => `${field}: ${msg}`).join(' ')}
              </div>
            ) : null}
            <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={addLine}>Add another line</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {step === 2 ? (
        <div className="panel">
          <div className="panel-head"><h3>Review</h3></div>
          <div className="panel-pad">
            <div className="field">
              <span className="form-label">Business justification</span>
              <div className="small">{form.reason || 'â€”'}</div>
            </div>
            <div className="field">
              <span className="form-label">Notes</span>
              <div className="small">{form.notes || 'â€”'}</div>
            </div>
            <div className="field">
              <span className="form-label">Estimated total</span>
              <div>{formatMoney(estimate)} <span className="small muted">(informational â€” the server stores the request total)</span></div>
            </div>
            <div style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
              <DataTable
                columns={[
                  { key: 'item_name', label: 'Item' },
                  { key: 'quantity', label: 'Quantity' },
                  { key: 'estimated_unit_price', label: 'Unit price', render: (r) => formatMoney(r.estimated_unit_price) },
                  { key: 'line_total', label: 'Line estimate', render: (r) => formatMoney((Number(r.quantity) * Number(r.estimated_unit_price || 0)).toFixed(2)) },
                  {
                    key: 'vendor',
                    label: 'Suggested vendor',
                    render: (r) => vendorOptions.find((v) => String(v.id) === String(r.suggested_vendor))?.name ?? 'â€”',
                  },
                ]}
                rows={lines}
                keyOf={(r) => r.key}
                emptyTitle="No line items."
                emptyHint="Go back and add at least one line."
              />
            </div>
            <p className="small muted">
              Informational line subtotal {formatMoney(calculateDisplaySubtotal(
                lines.map((l) => ({ quantity: l.quantity, estimated_unit_price: l.estimated_unit_price })),
              ))}
              . The backend total remains authoritative.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <div className="row-end" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
        <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setStep((s) => Math.max(0, s - 1))} disabled={step === 0 || busy}>
          Back
        </button>
        {step < STEPS.length - 1 ? (
          <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={goNext}>Continue</button>
        ) : (
          <>
            <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => save(false)} disabled={busy}>
              {busy ? 'Savingâ€¦' : 'Save draft'}
            </button>
            {caps.canCreatePurchaseRequest ? (
              <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={() => save(true)} disabled={busy}>
                {busy ? 'Savingâ€¦' : 'Save and submit for approval'}
              </button>
            ) : null}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}



===== src\pages\procurement\PurchaseRequests.jsx =====

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import {
  Badge, ConfirmDialog, DataTable, ErrorSummary, Field, LoadingRows, Modal, PageHeader, Pager, PageSizeSelector,
} from '../../components';
import {
  PURCHASE_REQUEST_STATUS_LABELS,
  actionAvailability,
  buildPurchaseRequestListUrl,
  formatDateTime,
  formatMoney,
  parseFieldErrors,
  procurementCapabilities,
  safeResults,
  statusBadgeVariant,
} from '../../shared/procurement-utils';

// Page-size preference persisted in localStorage; fall back to DRF default 20.

function StatusPill({ status }) {
  return (
    <span className={`badge badge-${statusBadgeVariant(status)}`}>
      {PURCHASE_REQUEST_STATUS_LABELS[status] ?? status}
    </span>
  );
}

const STATUS_OPTIONS = Object.entries(PURCHASE_REQUEST_STATUS_LABELS);

/** Purchase request list: server-side search, filters, ordering, pagination. */
export function PurchaseRequestsPage() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const caps = procurementCapabilities(auth);
  const requestIdRef = useRef(0);
  const mountedRef = useRef(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    return () => { mountedRef.current = false; };
  }, []);
  const [requests, setRequests] = useState([]);
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState({
    q: '', status: '', approval: '', hasPo: '', createdFrom: '', createdTo: '', ordering: '-created_at',
  });
  const [dialog, setDialog] = useState(null);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [actionError, setActionError] = useState('');
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState('');

  // Page-size preference persisted in localStorage; fall back to DRF default 20.
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 20;
    try {
      const saved = window.localStorage.getItem('itdesk.pageSize');
      const n = Number(saved);
      return saved && Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 && n <= 100 ? n : 20;
    } catch {
      return 20;
    }
  });

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    const requestId = ++requestIdRef.current;
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const response = await api.get(buildPurchaseRequestListUrl({
        page,
        page_size: pageSize,
        search: filters.q,
        status: filters.status,
        approval: filters.approval,
        has_po: filters.hasPo === 'yes' ? 'true' : filters.hasPo === 'no' ? 'false' : '',
        created_from: filters.createdFrom,
        created_to: filters.createdTo,
        ordering: filters.ordering,
      }));
      if (!mountedRef.current || requestId !== requestIdRef.current) return;
      setRequests(safeResults(response.data));
      setCount(Number(response.data?.count ?? safeResults(response.data).length));
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mountedRef.current || requestId !== requestIdRef.current) return;
      setError(parseFieldErrors(e).global || 'Could not load purchase requests.');
    } finally {
      if (mountedRef.current && requestId === requestIdRef.current) setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [page, filters, pageSize]);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect

  // Reset to page 1 when page size changes
  useEffect(() => {
    setPage(1); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
  }, [pageSize]);

  // Persist page-size preference without unnecessary writes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    try {
      if (window.localStorage.getItem('itdesk.pageSize') !== String(pageSize)) {
        window.localStorage.setItem('itdesk.pageSize', String(pageSize));
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore storage failures
    }
  }, [pageSize]);

  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(count / pageSize));
  const currentPage = Math.min(page, pageCount);

  const update = (key, value) => {
    setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, [key]: value }));
    setPage(1);
  };

  const runAction = async (request, action) => {
    setBusy(true);
    setActionError('');
    try {
      const payload = { reason: reason.trim() };
      if (action === 'cancel') payload.version = request.version;
      await api.post(`/procurement/purchase-requests/${request.id}/${action}/`, payload);
      setDialog(null);
      setReason('');
      setNotice('Purchase request updated.');
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      const status = e?.response?.status;
      const parsed = parseFieldErrors(e);
      if (status === 409) {
        await load();
        setActionError('This request changed while you were working. Reload and review before retrying.');
      } else if (status === 403) {
        setActionError('You do not have permission to perform this action.');
      } else {
        setActionError(parsed.global || Object.values(parsed.fields)[0] || 'Action failed.');
      }
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const generateOrder = async (request) => {
    setBusy(true);
    setActionError('');
    try {
      const r = await api.post(`/procurement/purchase-orders/${request.id}/generate_from_pr/`, {});
      setDialog(null);
      setNotice(`Purchase order ${r.data.po_number} created.`);
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      setActionError(parseFieldErrors(e).global || 'Could not create the purchase order.');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const canCancel = (request) => !request.purchase_order_ref
    && ['draft', 'pending_approval', 'returned_for_correction', 'rejected', 'approved'].includes(request.status)
    && (request.requester === auth?.user?.id || caps.canApprovePurchaseRequest);

  const columns = [
    {
      key: 'pr_number',
      label: 'Request',
      render: (r) => <a className="row-title" href={`#/procurement/requests/${r.id}`}>{r.pr_number}</a>,
    },
    {
      key: 'reason',
      label: 'Business justification',
      render: (r) => <span title={r.reason}>{(r.reason || '').slice(0, 60)}{(r.reason || '').length > 60 ? 'â€¦' : ''}</span>,
    },
    { key: 'requester_name', label: 'Requester', render: (r) => r.requester_name || 'â€”' },
    { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (r) => <StatusPill status={r.status} /> },
    { key: 'estimated_total', label: 'Estimated total', render: (r) => formatMoney(r.estimated_total) },
    {
      key: 'approval',
      label: 'Approval',
      render: (r) => (
        <span>
          {r.approval_decision ? <Badge kind="status" value={r.approval_decision} /> : 'Not decided'}
          {r.requires_system_admin_approval
            ? <span className="small"> Â· System Admin required</span> : null}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'vendor',
      label: 'Selected vendor',
      render: (r) => (r.quotations || []).find((q) => q.is_selected)?.vendor_detail?.name ?? 'â€”',
    },
    {
      key: 'po',
      label: 'Purchase order',
      render: (r) => (r.purchase_order_ref
        ? <a href={`#/procurement/orders/${r.purchase_order_ref.id}`}>{r.purchase_order_ref.po_number}</a>
        : 'â€”'),
    },
    { key: 'updated_at', label: 'Updated', render: (r) => formatDateTime(r.updated_at) },
    {
      key: 'actions',
      label: 'Actions',
      render: (r) => {
        const available = actionAvailability({ request: r, caps, userId: auth?.user?.id });
        const selected = (r.quotations || []).some((q) => q.is_selected);
        return (
          <div className="row-gap">
            <a className="btn-ghost btn-small" href={`#/procurement/requests/${r.id}`}>View</a>
            {available.editRequest ? (
              <a className="btn-ghost btn-small" href={`#/procurement/requests/${r.id}/edit`}>Edit</a>
            ) : null}
            {available.submitRequest ? (
              <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => { setReason(''); setActionError(''); setDialog({ kind: 'submit', request: r }); }}>
                Submit
              </button>
            ) : null}
            {available.approveRequest ? (
              <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => { setReason(''); setActionError(''); setDialog({ kind: 'approve', request: r }); }}>
                Approve
              </button>
            ) : null}
            {available.rejectRequest ? (
              <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => { setReason(''); setActionError(''); setDialog({ kind: 'reject', request: r }); }}>
                Reject
              </button>
            ) : null}
            {available.returnRequest ? (
              <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => { setReason(''); setActionError(''); setDialog({ kind: 'return', request: r }); }}>
                Return
              </button>
            ) : null}
            {caps.canManageQuotations && r.status === 'approved' ? (
              <a className="btn-ghost btn-small" href={`#/procurement/requests/${r.id}/quotations`}>Quotations</a>
            ) : null}
            {available.generateOrder && selected ? (
              <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => { setActionError(''); setDialog({ kind: 'generate', request: r }); }}>
                Create PO
              </button>
            ) : null}
            {canCancel(r) ? (
              <button type="button" className="btn-danger btn-small" onClick={() => { setReason(''); setActionError(''); setDialog({ kind: 'cancel', request: r }); }}>
                Cancel
              </button>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        );
      },

  ];

  if (!caps.canViewProcurement) {
    return (

        <PageHeader title="Purchase requests" />
        <div className="empty-state">
          <div className="empty-title">Access restricted</div>
          <div className="small">Procurement is available to IT staff only.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const reasonRequired = dialog && dialog.kind !== 'approve';

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Purchase requests"
        sub="Requests, approvals and the route to a purchase order."
        actions={(
          <div className="row-gap">

            {caps.canCreatePurchaseRequest ? <a className="btn-primary" href="#/procurement/requests/new">New request</a> : null}
          </div>
        )}
      />

      <div className="panel">
        <div className="panel-head"><h3>Filters</h3></div>
        <div className="panel-pad">
          <div className="row-gap">

                className="input" value={filters.q} placeholder="Number, justification, requester"
                onChange={(e) => update('q', e.target.value)}
              />

            <Field label="Status">
              <select className="input" value={filters.status} onChange={(e) => update('status', e.target.value)}>

          </div>
        </div>

      {notice ? <div className="success-summary" role="status">{notice}</div> : null}
      {actionError && !dialog ? <div className="field-error" role="alert">{actionError}</div> : null}

      {loading ? <LoadingRows /> : null}
      {error ? (
        <div>
          <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>
          <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={load}>Retry</button>
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {!loading && !error ? (
        <>
          <DataTable
            columns={columns}
            rows={requests}
            keyOf={(r) => `request-${r.id}`}
            emptyTitle="No purchase requests match these filters."
            emptyHint="Adjust the filters or create a new request."
          />
          <PageSizeSelector value={pageSize} onChange={setPageSize} />
          <Pager
            count={count}
            hasPrev={currentPage > 1}
            hasNext={currentPage < pageCount}
            onPrev={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
            onNext={() => setPage((p) => Math.min(pageCount, p + 1))}
            busy={loading}
            pageLabel={`Page ${currentPage} of ${pageCount}`}
          />
        </>
      ) : null}

      {dialog?.kind === 'submit' ? (
        <ConfirmDialog
          title={`Submit ${dialog.request.pr_number}`}

        />
      ) : null}

      {dialog && ['approve', 'reject', 'return', 'cancel'].includes(dialog.kind) ? (
        <Modal
          title={`${dialog.kind === 'approve' ? 'Approve' : dialog.kind === 'reject' ? 'Reject' : dialog.kind === 'cancel' ? 'Cancel' : 'Return for correction'} ${dialog.request.pr_number}`}
          onClose={() => { if (!busy) setDialog(null); }}
        >
          <p style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>
            {dialog.kind === 'approve'
              ? 'Approval is recorded against your account and cannot be undone from this screen.'
              : dialog.kind === 'cancel'
                ? 'Cancelling keeps the request and its history. It cannot be undone.'
                : 'The requester will see this reason in the request history.'}
          </p>
          <Field
            label={dialog.kind === 'cancel' ? 'Cancellation reason' : 'Reason'}
            required={reasonRequired}
            error={reasonRequired && actionError ? actionError : ''}
          >
            <textarea
              className="input" rows={3} value={reason}
              onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
              aria-label={dialog.kind === 'cancel' ? 'Cancellation reason' : 'Reason'}
            />
          </Field>
          {actionError ? <ErrorSummary parsed={{ global: actionError }} /> : null}
          <div className="row-end">
            <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setDialog(null)} disabled={busy}>Cancel</button>
            <button
              type="button" className={dialog.kind === 'cancel' ? 'btn-danger' : 'btn-primary'}
              disabled={busy || (reasonRequired && !reason.trim())}
              onClick={() => runAction(dialog.request, dialog.kind === 'return' ? 'return_for_correction' : dialog.kind)}
            >
              {busy ? 'Workingâ€¦' : dialog.kind === 'cancel' ? 'Cancel request' : 'Confirm'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      ) : null}

      {dialog?.kind === 'generate' ? (
        <ConfirmDialog
          title={`Create purchase order for ${dialog.request.pr_number}`}
          message="The selected quotation's vendor is used and the order is created pending approval."
          confirmLabel="Create purchase order"
          busy={busy}
          onCancel={() => setDialog(null)}
          onConfirm={() => generateOrder(dialog.request)}
        >
          {actionError ? <div className="field-error" role="alert">{actionError}</div> : null}
        </ConfirmDialog>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}



===== src\pages\procurement\SchedulingExceptions.jsx =====

/*
 * Scheduling Exceptions - exception request and decision workflow
 * Route: #/scheduling-exceptions
 */

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { PageHeader, Row, Col, Badge, Button, Field } from '../../components';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import api from '../../api';
import { fetchPage, parseApiError } from '../../shared/changes-utils';
import { formatDateTime } from '../../shared/changes-utils';

export function SchedulingExceptions() {
  const { isManagerOrAdmin, role, user } = useAuth();
  const [exceptions, setExceptions] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
  const [newEx, setNewEx] = useState({
    change: '',
    justification: '',
    blackout_period: '',
    maintenance_window: '',
  });
  const [newExErrors, setNewExErrors] = useState({});

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isManagerOrAdmin && role !== 'employee') {
      setExceptions([]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
      setLoading(false); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
      return;
    }
    fetchPage(`/changes/scheduling-exceptions/`)
      .then((data) => {
        setExceptions(data.items ?? data);
        setLoading(false);
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        setError(parseApiError(e));
        setLoading(false);
      });
  }, [isManagerOrAdmin, role]);

  const handleNewExChange = (e) => {
    setNewEx({ ...newEx, [e.target.name]: e.target.value });
  };

  const createException = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (creating) return; // duplicate-submit prevention
    setNewExErrors({});
    // Required-field validation
    const errors = {};
    if (!String(newEx.change || '').trim()) errors.change = 'Change is required.';
    if (!String(newEx.justification || '').trim()) errors.justification = 'Justification is required.';
    if (Object.keys(errors).length) {
      setNewExErrors(errors);
      setMsg('Please fix the highlighted fields.');
      return;
    }
    setCreating(true);
    try {
      // Normalize references to backend PKs (empty -> null)
      const payload = {
        change: parseInt(newEx.change, 10),
        justification: String(newEx.justification).trim(),
        blackout_period: newEx.blackout_period ? parseInt(newEx.blackout_period, 10) : null,
        maintenance_window: newEx.maintenance_window ? parseInt(newEx.maintenance_window, 10) : null,
      };
      const response = await api.post('/changes/scheduling-exceptions/', payload);
      setMsg('Scheduling exception request submitted.');
      setExceptions([response.data, ...exceptions]);
      setNewEx({ change: '', justification: '', blackout_period: '', maintenance_window: '' });
      setCreating(false);
    } catch (err) {
      const parsed = parseApiError(err);
      setNewExErrors(parsed.fields);
      setMsg(parsed.global || 'Failed to submit exception request.');
    } finally {
      setCreating(false);
    }
  };

  const decideException = async (ex, status) => {
    if (!confirm(`${status.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + status.slice(1)} this scheduling exception?`)) return;
    try {
      const res = await api.patch(`/changes/scheduling-exceptions/${ex.id}/`, { status });
      setMsg(`Exception ${status}.`);
      const updated = exceptions.map((x) => x.id === ex.id ? { ...x, ...res.data, status } : x);
      setExceptions(updated);
    } catch (err) {
      const parsed = parseApiError(err);
      setMsg(parsed.global || `Failed to ${status} exception.`);
    }
  };

  if (loading) return <div className="mt-3"><p>Loading scheduling exceptionsâ€¦</p></div>;
  if (error) return <div className="mt-3"><p className="text-danger">Error: {error.global ?? 'Unknown error'}</p></div>;

  const msgEl = msg ? <div className="success-summary" role="status">{msg}</div> : null;

  const pendingExceptions = exceptions.filter((e) => e.status === 'pending');
  const approvedExceptions = exceptions.filter((e) => e.status === 'approved');
  const rejectedExceptions = exceptions.filter((e) => e.status === 'rejected');

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Scheduling Exceptions" />
      {msgEl}

      {!isManagerOrAdmin && role === 'employee' && (
        <div className="mt-4">
          <h3>Request Scheduling Exception</h3>
          <form onSubmit={createException} className="mt-2">
            <Row className="mt-2">
              <Col sm={6}>
                <Field label="Change" name="change" required>
                  <input className="form-control" name="change" value={newEx.change} onChange={handleNewExChange} />
                </Field>
              </Col>
              <Col sm={6}>
                <Field label="Maintenance Window" name="maintenance_window">
                  <input className="form-control" name="maintenance_window" value={newEx.maintenance_window} onChange={handleNewExChange} />
                </Field>
              </Col>
            </Row>
            <Row className="mt-2">
              <Col sm={6}>
                <Field label="Blackout Period" name="blackout_period">
                  <input className="form-control" name="blackout_period" value={newEx.blackout_period} onChange={handleNewExChange} />
                </Field>
              </Col>
              <Col sm={6}>
                <Field label="Justification" name="justification" required>
                  <input className="form-control" name="justification" value={newEx.justification} onChange={handleNewExChange} />
                </Field>
              </Col>
            </Row>
            {newExErrors.justification && <p className="text-danger">{newExErrors.justification}</p>}
            {newExErrors.change && <p className="text-danger">{newExErrors.change}</p>}
            {newExErrors.blackout_period && <p className="text-danger">{newExErrors.blackout_period}</p>}
            {newExErrors.maintenance_window && <p className="text-danger">{newExErrors.maintenance_window}</p>}
            <Button kind="primary" type="submit" disabled={creating}>{creating ? 'Submittingâ€¦' : 'Submit Exception Request'}</Button>
            {creating && <span className="ml-2">Submittingâ€¦</span>}
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="mt-4">
        <h3>Pending Exception Requests</h3>
        {pendingExceptions.length === 0 ? <p>No pending exceptions</p> : (
          <div>
            {pendingExceptions.map((ex) => (
              <div key={ex.id} className="mt-2 p-2 border rounded">
                <Row>
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Change:</strong> {ex.change}</Col>
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Requested by:</strong> {ex.requesting_user_email ?? ex.requesting_user}</Col>
                </Row>
                <Row className="mt-1">
                  <Col sm={12}><strong>Justification:</strong> {ex.justification}</Col>
                </Row>
                <Row className="mt-1">
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Blackout Period:</strong> {ex.blackout_period ?? 'â€”'}</Col>
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Maintenance Window:</strong> {ex.maintenance_window ?? 'â€”'}</Col>
                </Row>
                <Row className="mt-1">
                  <Col sm={12}>
                    {isManagerOrAdmin && !(ex.requesting_user_email && user && ex.requesting_user_email === user.email) && (
                      <>
                        <Button variant="success" onClick={() => decideException(ex, 'approved')} className="me-2">Approve</Button>
                        <Button variant="danger" onClick={() => decideException(ex, 'rejected')}>Reject</Button>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </Col>
                </Row>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4">
        <h3>Approved Exceptions</h3>
        {approvedExceptions.length === 0 ? <p>No approved exceptions</p> : (
          <div>
            {approvedExceptions.map((ex) => (
              <div key={ex.id} className="mt-2 p-2 border rounded bg-success bg-opacity-10">
                <Row>
                  <Col sm={4}><strong>Change:</strong> {ex.change}</Col>
                  <Col sm={4}><strong>Requested by:</strong> {ex.requesting_user_email ?? ex.requesting_user}</Col>
                  <Col sm={4}><strong>Decided by:</strong> {ex.decided_by_email ?? ex.decided_by ?? 'â€”'}</Col>
                </Row>
                <Row className="mt-1">
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Decision:</strong> <Badge kind="status" value="approved" /></Col>
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Decision time:</strong> {ex.decision_timestamp ? formatDateTime(ex.decision_timestamp) : 'â€”'}</Col>
                </Row>
                <Row className="mt-1">
                  <Col sm={12}><strong>Justification:</strong> {ex.justification}</Col>
                </Row>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4">
        <h3>Rejected Exceptions</h3>
        {rejectedExceptions.length === 0 ? <p>No rejected exceptions</p> : (
          <div>
            {rejectedExceptions.map((ex) => (
              <div key={ex.id} className="mt-2 p-2 border rounded bg-danger bg-opacity-10">
                <Row>
                  <Col sm={4}><strong>Change:</strong> {ex.change}</Col>
                  <Col sm={4}><strong>Requested by:</strong> {ex.requesting_user_email ?? ex.requesting_user}</Col>
                  <Col sm={4}><strong>Decided by:</strong> {ex.decided_by_email ?? ex.decided_by ?? 'â€”'}</Col>
                </Row>
                <Row className="mt-1">
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Decision:</strong> <Badge kind="status" value="rejected" /></Col>
                  <Col sm={6}><strong>Decision time:</strong> {ex.decision_timestamp ? formatDateTime(ex.decision_timestamp) : 'â€”'}</Col>
                </Row>
                <Row className="mt-1">
                  <Col sm={12}><strong>Justification:</strong> {ex.justification}</Col>
                </Row>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
