===== src\pages\reports\SavedReports.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import {
  Badge, DataTable, EmptyState, Field, Modal, PageHeader, Pager,
  TableControls, useSort, useTableColumns,
} from '../../components';
import { fetchPage, parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';

const REPORT_TYPES = [
  { value: 'ticket_category', label: 'Tickets by category' },
  { value: 'ticket_sla', label: 'SLA health' },
];

/** Saved report management page.
 *
 * Users can create, edit, duplicate, and delete their own saved reports.
 * IT staff / admins see all reports (including shared ones).
 * Running a saved report redirects to the existing report API with the
 * persisted filters applied.
 */
export function SavedReports() {
  useAuth();
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [count, setCount] = useState(null);
  const [next, setNext] = useState(null);
  const [previous, setPrevious] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [listError, setListError] = useState('');
  const [f, setF] = useState({ q: '', report_type: '' });
  const [sort, changeSort, orderingParam] = useSort();
  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(null); // {id} or null
  const [formBusy, setFormBusy] = useState(false);
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState('');
  const [formMsg, setFormMsg] = useState('');
  const [runBusy, setRunBusy] = useState(null);
  const [delFor, setDelFor] = useState(null);
  const [delBusy, setDelBusy] = useState(false);

  const SR_COLUMNS = [
    { key: 'name', label: 'Name', render: (r) => <span className="row-title">{r.name}</span> },
    { key: 'report_type', label: 'Type', sortable: 'report_type', render: (r) => <Badge kind="status" value={r.report_type} /> },
    { key: 'description', label: 'Description', render: (r) => r.description || <span className="cell-muted">â€”</span> },
    { key: 'is_shared', label: 'Shared', sortable: 'is_shared', render: (r) => r.is_shared ? <Badge kind="status" value="shared" label="Yes" /> : 'No' },
    { key: 'schedule_count', label: 'Schedules', sortable: 'schedule_count', render: (r) => String(r.schedule_count ?? 0) },
    { key: 'updated', label: 'Updated', sortable: 'updated_at', render: (r) => r.updated_at ? new Date(r.updated_at).toLocaleDateString() : '-' },
  ];

  const { visibleColumns: visibleSrColumns, toggleColumn: toggleSrColumn, resetColumns: resetSrColumns, tableVisible: srTableVisible, toggleTable: toggleSrTable } = useTableColumns(
    'saved-reports',
    SR_COLUMNS.map((c) => c.key),
    ['name', 'report_type', 'description', 'is_shared', 'schedule_count', 'updated'],
  );
  const srColumns = SR_COLUMNS.filter((c) => visibleSrColumns.has(c.key));

  const buildUrl = (over = {}, sortOverride) => {
    const p = new URLSearchParams();
    const merged = { ...f, ...over };
    for (const k of ['q', 'report_type']) {
      if (merged[k] !== '' && merged[k] != null) p.set(k, merged[k]);
    }
    const ord = orderingParam(sortOverride);
    if (ord) p.set('ordering', ord);
    const qs = p.toString();
    return `/common/saved-reports/${qs ? `?${qs}` : ''}`;
  };

  const loadUrl = async (url) => {
    setLoading(true);
    setListError('');
    try {
      const pg = await fetchPage(url);
      setItems(pg.items);
      setCount(pg.count);
      setNext(pg.next);
      setPrevious(pg.previous);
    } catch {
      setListError('Could not load saved reports.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const applyFilters = (patch) => {
    const merged = { ...f, ...patch };
    setF(merged);
    const p = new URLSearchParams();
    for (const k of ['q', 'report_type']) {
      if (merged[k] !== '' && merged[k] != null) p.set(k, merged[k]);
    }
    const ord = orderingParam();
    if (ord) p.set('ordering', ord);
    const qs = p.toString();
    loadUrl(`/common/saved-reports/${qs ? `?${qs}` : ''}`);
  };

  // ---- Saved report create/edit form ----

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    report_type: 'ticket_category', name: '', description: '', filters: '{}', is_shared: false,
  });
  const setField = (k) => (e) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, [k]: e?.target?.value ?? e }));

  const openForm = (report = null) => {
    setEditing(report ? { id: report.id } : null);
    setForm(report ? {
      report_type: report.report_type ?? 'ticket_category',
      name: report.name ?? '',
      description: report.description ?? '',
      filters: typeof report.filters === 'string' ? report.filters : JSON.stringify(report.filters ?? {}),
      is_shared: !!report.is_shared,
    } : { report_type: 'ticket_category', name: '', description: '', filters: '{}', is_shared: false });
    setFormError('');
    setFormMsg('');
    setShowForm(true);
  };

  const closeForm = () => { setShowForm(false); setEditing(null); };

  const saveReport = async (ev) => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    if (formBusy) return;
    setFormBusy(true);
    setFormError('');
    setFormMsg('');
    let parsedFilters = {};
    try {
      parsedFilters = JSON.parse(form.filters || '{}');
    } catch {
      setFormError('Filters must be valid JSON.');
      setFormBusy(false);
      return;
    }
    const url = editing ? `/common/saved-reports/${editing.id}/` : '/common/saved-reports/';
    const method = editing ? 'patch' : 'post';
    try {
      const r = await api[method](url, {
        report_type: form.report_type,
        name: form.name.trim(),
        description: form.description.trim(),
        filters: parsedFilters,
        is_shared: form.is_shared === true || form.is_shared === 'true',
      });
      setFormMsg(`Saved report "${r.data.name}" saved.`);
      setEditing(null);
      setShowForm(false);
      await loadUrl(buildUrl());
    } catch (e) {
      setFormError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not save report.');
    } finally {
      setFormBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const doDelete = async (report) => {
    setDelFor(report.id);
    setDelBusy(true);
    try {
      await api.delete(`/common/saved-reports/${report.id}/`);
      setItems(items.filter((r) => r.id !== report.id));
      setCount(Math.max(0, (count ?? 1) - 1));
    } catch (e) {
      setListError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not delete saved report.');
    } finally {
      setDelFor(null);
      setDelBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const doRun = async (report) => {
    if (runBusy) return;
    setRunBusy(report.id);
    try {
      const filters = typeof report.filters === 'object' ? report.filters : JSON.parse(report.filters || '{}');
      const p = new URLSearchParams(filters);
      let url = '';
      if (report.report_type === 'ticket_category') {
        url = `/tickets/reports/by-category/${p.toString() ? `?${p.toString()}` : ''}`;
      } else if (report.report_type === 'ticket_sla') {
        url = `/tickets/reports/sla/${p.toString() ? `?${p.toString()}` : ''}`;
      }
      if (!url) {
        setFormError(`Unknown report type: ${report.report_type}`);
        return;
      }
      // Fetch through the axios client so the JWT (and its 401 refresh) is
      // applied â€” window.open() would hit the protected endpoint without the
      // Authorization header and always 401.
      const r = await api.get(url);
      const data = typeof r.data === 'string' ? r.data : JSON.stringify(r.data, null, 2);
      const blob = new Blob([data], { type: 'application/json' });
      const objUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = objUrl;
      a.download = `${report.name || report.report_type}-report.json`;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      a.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(objUrl), 5000);
      setFormMsg(`Report "${report.name}" downloaded.`);
    } catch (e) {
      setFormError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not run report.');
    } finally {
      setRunBusy(null);
    }
  };

  const duplicate = (report) => {
    openForm({
      ...report,
      name: `(Copy) ${report.name}`,
      id: null,
    });
  };

  useEffect(() => { loadUrl('/common/saved-reports/'); }, []); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, react/set-state-in-effect

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Saved Reports"
        sub={count != null ? `${count} saved report${count === 1 ? '' : 's'}` : undefined}
        actions={<>
          <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={() => openForm()}>+ New report</button>
        </>}
      />
      {listError && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{listError}</div>}
      {formMsg && <div className="success-summary" role="status">{formMsg}</div>}
      {formError && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{formError}</div>}

      {showForm && (
        <Modal title={editing ? 'Edit saved report' : 'New saved report'} onClose={closeForm} size="wide">
          <form onSubmit={saveReport} noValidate>
            <Field label="Name" required error={formError}>
              <input className="input" value={form.name} onChange={setField('name')} placeholder="e.g. Weekly ticket volume" disabled={formBusy} maxLength={200} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Report type" required>
              <select className="input" value={form.report_type} onChange={setField('report_type')} disabled={formBusy}>
                {REPORT_TYPES.map((rt) => <option key={rt.value} value={rt.value}>{rt.label}</option>)}
              </select>
            </Field>
            <Field label="Description">
              <textarea className="input" rows={3} value={form.description} onChange={setField('description')} placeholder="What this report showsâ€¦" disabled={formBusy} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Filters (JSON)" hint='Filter parameters persisted with the report (valid JSON object).'>
              <textarea className="input" rows={4} value={form.filters} onChange={setField('filters')} placeholder="{}" disabled={formBusy} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Share with IT staff">
              <label className="check-row">
                <input type="checkbox" checked={form.is_shared === true || form.is_shared === 'true'} onChange={(e) => setField('is_shared')(e.target.checked)} disabled={formBusy} />
                IT staff and admins can see this saved report.
              </label>
            </Field>
            <div className="row-end">
              <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={closeForm} disabled={formBusy}>Cancel</button>
              <button type="submit" className="btn-primary" disabled={formBusy || !form.name.trim()}>
                {formBusy ? 'Savingâ€¦' : (editing ? 'Save changes' : 'Create report')}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Modal>
      )}

      <div className="filter-bar" role="search">
        <input
          className="input grow" value={f.q} onChange={(e) => applyFilters({ q: e.target.value })}
          placeholder="Search report name or descriptionâ€¦" aria-label="Search saved reports"
        />
        <select className="input" value={f.report_type} onChange={(e) => applyFilters({ report_type: e.target.value })} aria-label="Filter by report type">
          <option value="">All types</option>
          {REPORT_TYPES.map((rt) => <option key={rt.value} value={rt.value}>{rt.label}</option>)}
        </select>
        {filtersActive() && (
          <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setF({ q: '', report_type: '' })}>Clear filters</button>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="panel">
        {loading ? <div className="panel-pad"><div className="muted">Loadingâ€¦</div></div>
          : listError ? <div className="panel-pad"><div className="error-summary" role="alert">{listError} <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => loadUrl(buildUrl())}>Retry</button></div></div>
          : count === 0 ? <EmptyState title="No saved reports yet." hint="Create your first saved report with + New report." />
          : (<>
            <TableControls tableVisible={srTableVisible} onToggleTable={toggleSrTable} columns={SR_COLUMNS} visible={visibleSrColumns} onToggleColumn={toggleSrColumn} onReset={resetSrColumns} />
            {srTableVisible ? (
              <DataTable
                columns={srColumns}
                rows={items}
                keyOf={(r) => r.id}
                sort={sort}
                onSort={changeSort}
                emptyTitle="No reports match."
                emptyHint="Adjust the search or type filter."
              />
            ) : (
              <p className="muted">Table hidden.</p>
            )}
            <div className="row-gap" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-2)' }}>
              {items.map((r) => (
                <div key={r.id} className="report-card">
                  <div className="report-card-head">
                    <div>
                      <strong>{r.name}</strong>
                      <span className="muted small"> Â· {r.report_type}</span>
                      {r.is_shared && <span className="badge badge-gray" style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}>Shared</span>}
                    </div>
                    <div className="row-end">
                      <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => doRun(r)} disabled={runBusy === r.id}>
                        {runBusy === r.id ? 'Runningâ€¦' : 'Run'}
                      </button>
                      <button type="button" className="btn-ghost btn-small" onClick={() => openForm(r)}>Edit</button>
                      <button type="button" className="btn-ghost btn-small" onClick={() => duplicate(r)}>Duplicate</button>
                      <button type="button" className="btn-small btn-danger" onClick={() => doDelete(r)} disabled={delBusy || delFor === r.id}>
                        {delFor === r.id ? 'Deletingâ€¦' : 'Delete'}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="report-card-body">
                    <p className="muted">{r.description || 'No description.'}</p>
                    <div className="muted small" style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: '0.85rem', whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap', wordBreak: 'break-all' }}>
                      {JSON.stringify(r.filters ?? {}, null, 2) || '{}'}
                    </div>
                    <div className="muted small" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-1)' }}>
                      Updated {r.updated_at ? new Date(r.updated_at).toLocaleString() : 'â€”'} Â· {r.schedule_count ?? 0} schedule{(r.schedule_count ?? 0) !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            <Pager count={count} hasNext={!!next} hasPrev={!!previous} busy={loading} onPrev={() => previous && loadUrl(previous)} onNext={() => next && loadUrl(next)} />
          </>)}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  function filtersActive() {
    return !!(f.q || f.report_type);
  }
}

export default SavedReports;



===== src\pages\reports\ScheduledReports.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import {
  Badge, ConfirmDialog, DataTable, EmptyState, Field, Modal, PageHeader, Pager,
  TableControls, useSort, useTableColumns,
} from '../../components';
import { fetchPage, parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';

const SCHEDULES = [
  { value: 'daily', label: 'Daily' },
  { value: 'weekly', label: 'Weekly' },
  { value: 'monthly', label: 'Monthly' },
];

const FORMATS = [
  { value: 'csv', label: 'CSV' },
  { value: 'xlsx', label: 'Excel (XLSX)' },
  { value: 'pdf', label: 'PDF' },
  { value: 'docx', label: 'Word (DOCX)' },
];

/** Scheduled report management (IT staff / admins).
 *
 * Lists scheduled reports, lets staff create/edit/enable/disable/delete
 * schedules built from saved reports, and shows per-schedule execution
 * history with retry for failed runs.
 */
export function ScheduledReports() {
  const { canManageScheduledReports } = useAuth();

  // ---------- scheduled reports list ----------
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [count, setCount] = useState(null);
  const [next, setNext] = useState(null);
  const [previous, setPrevious] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [listError, setListError] = useState('');
  const [f, setF] = useState({ q: '', schedule: '', format: '', enabled: '' });
  const [sort, changeSort, orderingParam] = useSort();

  // ---------- saved reports (for create/edit picker) ----------
  const [savedReports, setSavedReports] = useState([]);
  const [savedLoading, setSavedLoading] = useState(false);

  // ---------- create / edit form ----------
  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(null); // {id} or null
  const [formBusy, setFormBusy] = useState(false);
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState('');
  const [formMsg, setFormMsg] = useState('');
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    saved_report: '', schedule: 'weekly', recipients: '', format: 'csv', enabled: true,
  });
  const setField = (k) => (e) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, [k]: e?.target?.value ?? e }));

  // ---------- per-schedule history ----------
  const [historyFor, setHistoryFor] = useState(null); // scheduled report id
  const [history, setHistory] = useState([]);
  const [historyLoading, setHistoryLoading] = useState(false);

  // ---------- enable/disable ----------
  const [toggleBusy, setToggleBusy] = useState(null);

  // ---------- delete ----------
  const [delFor, setDelFor] = useState(null);
  const [delBusy, setDelBusy] = useState(false);

  // ---------- retry ----------
  const [retryBusy, setRetryBusy] = useState(null);

  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');

  const SR_COLUMNS = [
    { key: 'name', label: 'Report', sortable: 'saved_report_name', render: (r) => <span className="row-title">{r.saved_report_name || r.name}</span> },
    { key: 'type', label: 'Type', sortable: 'saved_report_type', render: (r) => <Badge kind="status" value={r.saved_report_type || 'ticket_category'} label={r.saved_report_type || 'ticket_category'} /> },
    { key: 'schedule', label: 'Schedule', sortable: 'schedule', render: (r) => <span>{r.schedule}</span> },
    { key: 'format', label: 'Format', sortable: 'format', render: (r) => <Badge kind="status" value={r.format} label={r.format.toUpperCase()} /> },
    { key: 'recipients', label: 'Recipients', render: (r) => <span className="ellipsis" title={Array.isArray(r.recipients) ? r.recipients.join(', ') : String(r.recipients)}>{Array.isArray(r.recipients) ? r.recipients.join(', ') : String(r.recipients || '')}</span> },
    { key: 'enabled', label: 'Enabled', sortable: 'enabled', render: (r) => r.enabled ? <Badge kind="status" value="resolved" label="On" /> : <Badge kind="status" value="reopened" label="Off" /> },
    { key: 'next_run', label: 'Next run', sortable: 'next_run_at', render: (r) => r.next_run_at ? new Date(r.next_run_at).toLocaleString() : <span className="cell-muted">â€”</span> },
    { key: 'actions', label: 'Actions', thClass: 'cell-actions', render: (r) => (
      <div className="cell-actions">
        <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => openForm(r)} disabled={formBusy}>Editâ€¦</button>
        <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => toggleEnabled(r)} disabled={toggleBusy === r.id || formBusy}>
          {toggleBusy === r.id ? 'â€¦' : (r.enabled ? 'Disable' : 'Enable')}
        </button>
        <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => openHistory(r)} disabled={historyLoading}>History</button>
        <button type="button" className="btn-small btn-danger" onClick={() => setDelFor(r.id)} disabled={delBusy || delFor === r.id}>Deleteâ€¦</button>
      </div>
    ) },
  ];

  const { visibleColumns: visibleSrColumns, toggleColumn: toggleSrColumn, resetColumns: resetSrColumns, tableVisible: srTableVisible, toggleTable: toggleSrTable } = useTableColumns(
    'scheduled-reports',
    SR_COLUMNS.map((c) => c.key),
    ['name', 'type', 'schedule', 'format', 'recipients', 'enabled', 'next_run', 'actions'],
  );
  const srColumns = SR_COLUMNS.filter((c) => visibleSrColumns.has(c.key));

  const buildUrl = (over = {}, sortOverride) => {
    const p = new URLSearchParams();
    const merged = { ...f, ...over };
    for (const k of ['q', 'schedule', 'format', 'enabled']) {
      if (merged[k] !== '' && merged[k] != null) p.set(k, merged[k]);
    }
    const ord = orderingParam(sortOverride);
    if (ord) p.set('ordering', ord);
    const qs = p.toString();
    return `/common/scheduled-reports/${qs ? `?${qs}` : ''}`;
  };

  const loadUrl = async (url) => {
    setLoading(true);
    setListError('');
    try {
      const pg = await fetchPage(url);
      setItems(pg.items);
      setCount(pg.count);
      setNext(pg.next);
      setPrevious(pg.previous);
    } catch {
      setListError('Could not load scheduled reports.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const applyFilters = (patch) => {
    const merged = { ...f, ...patch };
    setF(merged);
    const p = new URLSearchParams();
    for (const k of ['q', 'schedule', 'format', 'enabled']) {
      if (merged[k] !== '' && merged[k] != null) p.set(k, merged[k]);
    }
    const ord = orderingParam();
    if (ord) p.set('ordering', ord);
    const qs = p.toString();
    loadUrl(`/common/scheduled-reports/${qs ? `?${qs}` : ''}`);
  };

  const loadSavedReports = async () => {
    setSavedLoading(true);
    try {
      const r = await api.get('/common/saved-reports/');
      const data = r.data;
      const rows = data?.results ?? data ?? [];
      setSavedReports(rows);
    } catch {
      setListError('Could not load saved reports for scheduling.');
    } finally {
      setSavedLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const openForm = (report = null) => {
    setEditing(report ? { id: report.id } : null);
    setForm(report ? {
      saved_report: String(report.saved_report ?? ''),
      schedule: report.schedule ?? 'weekly',
      recipients: Array.isArray(report.recipients) ? report.recipients.join(', ') : String(report.recipients ?? ''),
      format: report.format ?? 'csv',
      enabled: !!report.enabled,
    } : { saved_report: '', schedule: 'weekly', recipients: '', format: 'csv', enabled: true });
    setFormError('');
    setFormMsg('');
    setShowForm(true);
  };

  const closeForm = () => { setShowForm(false); setEditing(null); };

  const saveSchedule = async (ev) => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    if (formBusy) return;
    setFormBusy(true);
    setFormError('');
    setFormMsg('');
    const recipients = form.recipients.split(',').map((e) => e.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    if (!recipients.length) {
      setFormError('Provide at least one recipient email.');
      setFormBusy(false);
      return;
    }
    const url = editing ? `/common/scheduled-reports/${editing.id}/` : '/common/scheduled-reports/';
    const method = editing ? 'patch' : 'post';
    try {
      const r = await api[method](url, {
        saved_report: Number(form.saved_report),
        schedule: form.schedule,
        recipients,
        format: form.format,
        enabled: form.enabled === true || form.enabled === 'true',
      });
      setFormMsg(`Schedule "${r.data.saved_report_name || r.data.name}" saved.`);
      setEditing(null);
      setShowForm(false);
      await loadUrl(buildUrl());
    } catch (e) {
      setFormError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not save schedule.');
    } finally {
      setFormBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const toggleEnabled = async (r) => {
    if (toggleBusy === r.id) return;
    setToggleBusy(r.id);
    try {
      await api.patch(`/common/scheduled-reports/${r.id}/`, { enabled: !r.enabled });
      setMsg(`Schedule "${r.saved_report_name || r.name}" ${r.enabled ? 'disabled' : 'enabled'}.`);
      await loadUrl(buildUrl());
    } catch (e) {
      setListError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not update schedule.');
    } finally {
      setToggleBusy(null);
    }
  };

  const doDelete = async (report) => {
    setDelFor(report.id);
    setDelBusy(true);
    try {
      await api.delete(`/common/scheduled-reports/${report.id}/`);
      setItems(items.filter((r) => r.id !== report.id));
      setCount(Math.max(0, (count ?? 1) - 1));
      setMsg(`Schedule "${report.saved_report_name || report.name}" deleted.`);
    } catch (e) {
      setListError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not delete schedule.');
    } finally {
      setDelFor(null);
      setDelBusy(false);
    }
  };

  // ---------- history ----------
  const loadHistory = async (id = historyFor) => {
    if (!id) return;
    setHistoryLoading(true);
    try {
      const r = await api.get('/common/scheduled-report-runs/');
      const data = r.data;
      const all = data?.results ?? data ?? [];
      setHistory(all.filter((run) => run.scheduled_report === id).sort((a, b) => new Date(b.started_at || 0) - new Date(a.started_at || 0)));
    } catch {
      setListError('Could not load run history.');
    } finally {
      setHistoryLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const openHistory = (r) => {
    setHistoryFor(r.id);
    setHistory([]);
    loadHistory(r.id);
  };
  const closeHistory = () => { setHistoryFor(null); setHistory([]); };

  const doRetry = async (run) => {
    if (retryBusy === run.id) return;
    setRetryBusy(run.id);
    try {
      const res = await api.post(`/common/scheduled-report-runs/${run.id}/retry/`, {}, { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
      if (res.data.retried) {
        setMsg(`Retry dispatched for schedule "${run.scheduled_report}".`);
      } else {
        setListError(`Retry failed: ${res.data.error || 'unknown error'}.`);
      }
      loadHistory();
      await loadUrl(buildUrl());
    } catch (e) {
      const p = parseApiError(e);
      setListError(p.global || 'Retry failed.');
    } finally {
      setRetryBusy(null);
    }
  };

  const historyActions = (run) => {
    if (run.status !== 'failed') return '-';
    return (
      <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => doRetry(run)} disabled={retryBusy === run.id}>
        {retryBusy === run.id ? 'Retryingâ€¦' : 'Retry'}
      </button>
    );
  };

  useEffect(() => { loadUrl('/common/scheduled-reports/'); }, []); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, react/set-state-in-effect
  useEffect(() => { loadSavedReports(); }, []); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, react/set-state-in-effect

  const restrictedView = (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Scheduled reports" sub="IT Manager or System Admin only." />
      <div className="panel">
        <div className="panel-pad"><div className="error-summary" role="alert">
          Scheduled report management is restricted to IT Managers and System Admins.
        </div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  if (!canManageScheduledReports) return restrictedView;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Scheduled reports"
        sub={count != null ? `${count} schedule${count === 1 ? '' : 's'}` : undefined}
        actions={<button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={() => openForm()} disabled={formBusy || savedLoading}>
          {savedLoading ? 'Loadingâ€¦' : '+ New schedule'}
        </button>}
      />
      {listError && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{listError}</div>}
      {msg && <div className="success-summary" role="status">{msg}</div>}
      {formMsg && <div className="success-summary" role="status">{formMsg}</div>}
      {formError && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{formError}</div>}

      {showForm && (
        <Modal title={editing ? 'Edit schedule' : 'New schedule'} onClose={closeForm} size="wide">
          <form onSubmit={saveSchedule} noValidate>
            <Field label="Saved report" required error={formError}>
              <select className="input" value={form.saved_report} onChange={setField('saved_report')} disabled={formBusy || savedLoading}>
                <option value="">Select a saved reportâ€¦</option>
                {savedReports.map((sr) => (
                  <option key={sr.id} value={sr.id}>
                    {sr.name} ({sr.report_type})
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
              {savedLoading && <span className="muted small"> loadingâ€¦</span>}
            </Field>
            <Field label="Schedule" required>
              <select className="input" value={form.schedule} onChange={setField('schedule')} disabled={formBusy}>
                {SCHEDULES.map((s) => <option key={s.value} value={s.value}>{s.label}</option>)}
              </select>
            </Field>
            <Field label="Recipients" hint="Comma-separated email addresses that will receive the report." required>
              <input className="input" value={form.recipients} onChange={setField('recipients')} placeholder="ops@example.com, it@example.com" disabled={formBusy} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Format" required>
              <select className="input" value={form.format} onChange={setField('format')} disabled={formBusy}>
                {FORMATS.map((fmt) => <option key={fmt.value} value={fmt.value}>{fmt.label}</option>)}
              </select>
            </Field>
            <Field label="Enabled">
              <label className="check-row">
                <input type="checkbox" checked={form.enabled === true || form.enabled === 'true'} onChange={(e) => setField('enabled')(e.target.checked)} disabled={formBusy} />
                Schedule is active and will run at its next due time.
              </label>
            </Field>
            <div className="row-end">
              <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={closeForm} disabled={formBusy}>Cancel</button>
              <button type="submit" className="btn-primary" disabled={formBusy || !form.saved_report}>
                {formBusy ? 'Savingâ€¦' : (editing ? 'Save changes' : 'Create schedule')}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Modal>
      )}

      <div className="filter-bar" role="search">
        <input
          className="input grow" value={f.q} onChange={(e) => applyFilters({ q: e.target.value })}
          placeholder="Search report nameâ€¦" aria-label="Search scheduled reports"
        />
        <select className="input" value={f.schedule} onChange={(e) => applyFilters({ schedule: e.target.value })} aria-label="Filter by schedule">
          <option value="">All schedules</option>
          {SCHEDULES.map((s) => <option key={s.value} value={s.value}>{s.label}</option>)}
        </select>
        <select className="input" value={f.format} onChange={(e) => applyFilters({ format: e.target.value })} aria-label="Filter by format">
          <option value="">All formats</option>
          {FORMATS.map((fmt) => <option key={fmt.value} value={fmt.value}>{fmt.label}</option>)}
        </select>
        <select className="input" value={f.enabled} onChange={(e) => applyFilters({ enabled: e.target.value })} aria-label="Filter by enabled">
          <option value="">All</option>
          <option value="true">Enabled</option>
          <option value="false">Disabled</option>
        </select>
        {(f.q || f.schedule || f.format || f.enabled) && (
          <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setF({ q: '', schedule: '', format: '', enabled: '' })}>Clear filters</button>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="panel">
        {loading ? <div className="panel-pad"><div className="muted">Loadingâ€¦</div></div>
          : listError ? <div className="panel-pad"><div className="error-summary" role="alert">{listError} <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => loadUrl(buildUrl())}>Retry</button></div></div>
          : count === 0 ? <EmptyState title="No scheduled reports yet." hint="Create your first schedule with + New schedule." />
          : (<>
            <TableControls tableVisible={srTableVisible} onToggleTable={toggleSrTable} columns={SR_COLUMNS} visible={visibleSrColumns} onToggleColumn={toggleSrColumn} onReset={resetSrColumns} />
            {srTableVisible ? (
              <DataTable
                columns={srColumns}
                rows={items}
                keyOf={(r) => r.id}
                sort={sort}
                onSort={changeSort}
                emptyTitle="No schedules match."
                emptyHint="Adjust the filters or create a new schedule."
              />
            ) : (
              <p className="muted">Table hidden.</p>
            )}
            <Pager count={count} hasNext={!!next} hasPrev={!!previous} busy={loading} onPrev={() => previous && loadUrl(previous)} onNext={() => next && loadUrl(next)} />
          </>)}
      </div>

      {historyFor && (
        <Modal title="Execution history" onClose={closeHistory} size="wide">
          <div className="panel-pad">
            {historyLoading ? <div className="muted">Loading historyâ€¦</div>
              : history.length === 0 ? <EmptyState title="No runs yet." hint="Executions for this schedule will appear here." />
              : (
                <DataTable
                  columns={[
                    { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (run) => run.status === 'failed' ? <Badge kind="status" value="reopened" label="Failed" /> : (run.status === 'succeeded' ? <Badge kind="status" value="resolved" label="Succeeded" /> : <span>{run.status}</span>) },
                    { key: 'started', label: 'Started', render: (run) => run.started_at ? new Date(run.started_at).toLocaleString() : 'â€”' },
                    { key: 'finished', label: 'Finished', render: (run) => run.finished_at ? new Date(run.finished_at).toLocaleString() : 'â€”' },
                    { key: 'recipients', label: 'Recipients', render: (run) => String(run.recipient_count ?? 0) },
                    { key: 'error', label: 'Error', render: (run) => run.error_summary ? <span className="ellipsis" title={run.error_summary}>{run.error_summary}</span> : <span className="cell-muted">â€”</span> },
                    { key: 'actions', label: 'Actions', thClass: 'cell-actions', render: historyActions },
                  ]}
                  rows={history}
                  keyOf={(run) => run.id}
                  emptyTitle="No runs."
                  emptyHint="No execution history for this schedule."
                />
              )}
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {delFor && (
        <ConfirmDialog
          title={`Delete schedule "${items.find((r) => r.id === delFor)?.saved_report_name ?? ''}"?`}
          message="Deleting a schedule stops future deliveries. Execution history is kept."
          confirmLabel="Delete schedule" danger busy={delBusy}
          onConfirm={() => doDelete(items.find((r) => r.id === delFor))}
          onCancel={() => setDelFor(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default ScheduledReports;



===== src\pages\retention\index.js =====

export { Retention } from './Retention';


===== src\pages\retention\Retention.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import {
  Badge, DataTable, Field, Modal, PageHeader, Pager,
} from '../../components';
import { fetchPage, parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';

const CATEGORIES = [
  { value: 'security_events', label: 'Security events' },
  { value: 'notifications', label: 'Notifications' },
  { value: 'background_task_runs', label: 'Background task runs' },
  { value: 'temporary_import_reports', label: 'Temporary import reports' },
  { value: 'expired_temporary_records', label: 'Expired temporary records' },
  { value: 'other', label: 'Other operational data' },
];

/** Data-retention governance page.
 *
 * Hash-based sub-views:
 *   #/retention             policy list + create/edit/enable-disable
 *   #/retention/policies    same as #/retention
 *   #/retention/executions  execution history
 *
 * Retention policies are System Admin only. Audit logs (security events)
 * are never automatically deleted by a retention policy.
 */
export function Retention() {
  const { isAdmin } = useAuth();
  if (!isAdmin) {
    return (
      <div>
        <div className="page-head"><h1>Data Retention</h1></div>
        <div className="empty-state">
          <div className="empty-title">Access restricted</div>
          <div className="small">Data-retention governance is System Admin only.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const hash = location.hash.split('?')[0];
  if (hash === '#/retention/executions') return <RetentionExecutions />;
  return <RetentionPolicies />;
}

/* ---------------- Policies ---------------- */

function RetentionPolicies() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [count, setCount] = useState(null);
  const [next, setNext] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);

  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    name: '', data_category: 'notifications', retention_duration: 30,
    enabled: true, conditions: {}, description: '', responsible_admin: '',
  });
  const [formBusy, setFormBusy] = useState(false);
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState('');
  const [formMsg, setFormMsg] = useState('');

  const [previewFor, setPreviewFor] = useState(null);
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState(null);
  const [previewLoading, setPreviewLoading] = useState(false);

  const [execBusy, setExecBusy] = useState(null);
  const [execMsg, setExecMsg] = useState('');

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true); setError('');
    try {
      const p = new URLSearchParams({ page, page_size: 20 });
      const d = await fetchPage(`/common/retention-policies/?${p.toString()}`);
      setItems(d.items); setCount(d.count); setNext(d.next);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Failed to load policies.');
    } finally { setLoading(false); }
  };
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [page]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, react/set-state-in-effect

  const setField = (k) => (e) => {
    const v = e.target.type === 'checkbox' ? e.target.checked : e.target.value;
    setForm((s) => ({ ...s, [k]: v }));
  };

  const openForm = (p = null) => {
    setEditing(p);
    if (p) {
      setForm({
        name: p.name, data_category: p.data_category,
        retention_duration: p.retention_duration, enabled: p.enabled,
        conditions: p.conditions || {}, description: p.description || '',
        responsible_admin: p.responsible_admin || '',
      });
    } else {
      setForm({ name: '', data_category: 'notifications', retention_duration: 30, enabled: true, conditions: {}, description: '', responsible_admin: '' });
    }
    setFormError(''); setFormMsg('');
    setShowForm(true);
  };

  const saveForm = async (ev) => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    setFormBusy(true); setFormError(''); setFormMsg('');
    try {
      const payload = {
        name: form.name, data_category: form.data_category,
        retention_duration: Number(form.retention_duration),
        enabled: form.enabled, conditions: form.conditions,
        description: form.description,
        responsible_admin: form.responsible_admin ? Number(form.responsible_admin) : null,
      };
      if (editing) {
        await api.patch(`/common/retention-policies/${editing.id}/`, payload);
        setFormMsg('Policy updated.');
      } else {
        await api.post('/common/retention-policies/', payload);
        setFormMsg('Policy created.');
      }
      setShowForm(false); load();
    } catch (e) {
      const p = parseApiError(e);
      setFormError(p.global || p.fields.data_category || 'Failed to save policy.');
    } finally { setFormBusy(false); }
  };

  const toggleEnabled = async (policy) => {
    setExecBusy(policy.id);
    try {
      await api.patch(`/common/retention-policies/${policy.id}/`, { enabled: !policy.enabled });
      setExecMsg(`${policy.name} ${policy.enabled ? 'disabled' : 'enabled'}.`);
      load();
    } catch (e) {
      setExecMsg(parseApiError(e).global || 'Failed to update policy.');
    } finally { setExecBusy(null); }
  };

  const removePolicy = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm('Delete this retention policy?')) return;
    setExecBusy(id);
    try {
      await api.delete(`/common/retention-policies/${id}/`);
      load();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Failed to delete policy.');
    } finally { setExecBusy(null); }
  };

  const showPreview = async (policy) => {
    setPreviewFor(policy.id); setPreview(null); setPreviewLoading(true);
    try {
      const r = await api.get(`/common/retention-policies/${policy.id}/preview/`);
      setPreview(r.data);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Preview failed.');
    } finally { setPreviewLoading(false); }
  };

  const execute = async (policy) => {
    setExecBusy(policy.id); setExecMsg('');
    try {
      const r = await api.post(`/common/retention-policies/${policy.id}/execute/`, {});
      setExecMsg(`Executed: ${r.data.records_affected || 0} record(s) affected, ${r.data.records_excluded || 0} excluded.`);
      load();
    } catch (e) {
      setExecMsg(parseApiError(e).global || 'Execution failed.');
    } finally { setExecBusy(null); }
  };

  const POLICY_COLUMNS = [
    { key: 'name', label: 'Name', render: (r) => <span className="row-title">{r.name}</span> },
    { key: 'category', label: 'Category', render: (r) => r.data_category },
    { key: 'duration', label: 'Retention (days)', render: (r) => r.retention_duration },
    { key: 'enabled', label: 'Enabled', render: (r) => r.enabled ? <Badge kind="status" value="resolved" label="On" /> : <Badge kind="status" value="reopened" label="Off" /> },
    { key: 'last_run', label: 'Last run', render: (r) => r.last_run_at ? new Date(r.last_run_at).toLocaleString() : <span className="cell-muted">â€”</span> },
    { key: 'actions', label: 'Actions', thClass: 'cell-actions', render: (r) => (
      <div className="cell-actions">
        <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => openForm(r)} disabled={formBusy}>Edit</button>
        <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => toggleEnabled(r)} disabled={execBusy === r.id || formBusy}>
          {execBusy === r.id ? 'â€¦' : (r.enabled ? 'Disable' : 'Enable')}
        </button>
        <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => showPreview(r)} disabled={previewLoading}>Preview</button>
        <button type="button" className="btn-small btn-primary" onClick={() => execute(r)} disabled={execBusy === r.id || !r.enabled || formBusy}>
          {execBusy === r.id ? 'â€¦' : 'Execute'}
        </button>
        <button type="button" className="btn-small btn-danger" onClick={() => removePolicy(r.id)} disabled={execBusy === r.id || formBusy}>Delete</button>
      </div>
    )},
  ];

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Data retention policies" sub="Configure, preview and execute retention policies. System Admin only."
        actions={(
          <div className="row-gap">
            <a href="#/retention/executions" className="btn-secondary">Execution history</a>
            <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={() => openForm()}>+ Add policy</button>
          </div>
        )} />
      {error ? <div className="field-error" role="alert">{error}</div> : null}
      <DataTable columns={POLICY_COLUMNS} rows={items} keyOf={(r) => String(r.id)}
        emptyTitle="No retention policies." emptyHint="Create your first retention policy." />
      <Pager count={count} onPrev={() => setPage(p => p - 1)} onNext={() => setPage(p => p + 1)}
             hasPrev={page > 1} hasNext={!!next} busy={loading} />

      {showForm && (
        <Modal title={editing ? 'Edit retention policy' : 'Add retention policy'} onClose={() => setShowForm(false)} size="lg">
          <form onSubmit={saveForm} noValidate>
            <Field label="Name" required>
              <input className="input input-auto" value={form.name} onChange={setField('name')} disabled={formBusy} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Data category">
              <select className="input" value={form.data_category} onChange={setField('data_category')} disabled={formBusy}>
                {CATEGORIES.map((c) => <option key={c.value} value={c.value}>{c.label}</option>)}
              </select>
              <div className="small">Audit logs (security events) are never automatically deleted.</div>
            </Field>
            <Field label="Retention duration (days)" required>
              <input className="input input-auto" type="number" value={form.retention_duration || ''} onChange={setField('retention_duration')} disabled={formBusy} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Enabled">
              <input type="checkbox" checked={form.enabled} onChange={setField('enabled')} disabled={formBusy} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Description">
              <input className="input input-auto" value={form.description} onChange={setField('description')} disabled={formBusy} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Responsible admin (ID)">
              <input className="input input-auto" value={form.responsible_admin} onChange={setField('responsible_admin')} disabled={formBusy} />
            </Field>
            {formError && <div className="field-error" role="alert">{formError}</div>}
            {formMsg && <div className="success-summary" role="status">{formMsg}</div>}
            <div className="row-end">
              <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setShowForm(false)} disabled={formBusy}>Cancel</button>
              <button type="submit" className="btn-primary" disabled={formBusy}>{formBusy ? 'Savingâ€¦' : 'Save'}</button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {previewFor && preview !== null && (
        <Modal title={`Preview: ${preview.policy_name}`} onClose={() => setPreviewFor(null)} size="lg">
          <div className="panel-pad">
            <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Category</span><div className="small">{preview.data_category}</div></div>
            <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Retention (days)</span><div className="small">{preview.retention_duration_days}</div></div>
            <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Eligible records</span><div className="small">{preview.total_eligible}</div></div>
            <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Can execute</span>{' '}
              {preview.can_execute ? <span className="badge badge-green">Yes</span> : <span className="badge badge-red">No</span>}</div>
            {preview.excluded && preview.excluded.length > 0 && (
              <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Excluded</span>
                <ul className="small-list">
                  {preview.excluded.map((e, i) => <li key={i}>{e.model}: {e.reason}</li>)}
                </ul>
              </div>
            )}
            {(preview.notes || []).length > 0 && (
              <div className="field"><span className="form-label">Notes</span>
                <ul className="small-list">
                  {preview.notes.map((n, i) => <li key={i}>{n}</li>)}
                </ul>
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="row-end">
              <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setPreviewFor(null)}>Close</button>
              {preview.can_execute && (
                <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={() => { setPreviewFor(null); execute(preview.policy_id ? { id: preview.policy_id, name: preview.policy_name, enabled: true } : null); }}>
                  Execute now
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {execMsg && <div className={`field-error ${execMsg.startsWith('Executed') ? 'success-summary' : ''}`} role="status">{execMsg}</div>}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------------- Execution history ---------------- */

function RetentionExecutions() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [count, setCount] = useState(null);
  const [next, setNext] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true); setError('');
    try {
      const p = new URLSearchParams({ page, page_size: 20 });
      const d = await fetchPage(`/common/retention-executions/?${p.toString()}`);
      setItems(d.items); setCount(d.count); setNext(d.next);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Failed to load execution history.');
    } finally { setLoading(false); }
  };
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [page]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, react/set-state-in-effect

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Retention execution history" sub="Per-policy retention execution outcomes and failure reporting."
        actions={(
          <div className="row-gap">
            <a href="#/retention" className="btn-ghost">&larr; Back to policies</a>
          </div>
        )} />
      {error ? <div className="field-error" role="alert">{error}</div> : null}
      <DataTable columns={[
        { key: 'policy', label: 'Policy', render: (r) => <span className="row-title">Policy #{r.policy}</span> },
        { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (r) => <Badge kind="status" value={r.status} label={r.status} /> },
        { key: 'eligible', label: 'Eligible', render: (r) => r.records_eligible },
        { key: 'affected', label: 'Affected', render: (r) => r.records_affected },
        { key: 'excluded', label: 'Excluded', render: (r) => r.records_excluded },
        { key: 'started', label: 'Started', render: (r) => r.started_at ? new Date(r.started_at).toLocaleString() : 'â€”' },
        { key: 'error', label: 'Error', render: (r) => <span className="cell-muted">{r.error_summary || 'â€”'}</span> },
      ]} rows={items} keyOf={(r) => String(r.id)}
        emptyTitle="No retention executions." emptyHint="Run a retention policy to record its execution here." />
      <Pager count={count} onPrev={() => setPage(p => p - 1)} onNext={() => setPage(p => p + 1)}
             hasPrev={page > 1} hasNext={!!next} busy={loading} />
    </div>
  );
}

export function SelfService() {
  const { user } = useAuth();

  // ---- Ticket list (own tickets) ----
  const [tickets, setTickets] = useState([]);

  const [ticketError, setTicketError] = useState('');

    setTicketLoading(true);
    setTicketError('');
    try {
      const r = await api.get('/tickets/');
      setTickets(r.data.results ?? r.data ?? []);
    } catch {
      setTicketError('Could not load your tickets.');
    } finally {
      setTicketLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  // ---- Assigned assets ----
  const [assets, setAssets] = useState([]);
  const [assetLoading, setAssetLoading] = useState(true);
  const [assetError, setAssetError] = useState('');

  const loadAssets = useCallback(async () => {
    setAssetLoading(true);
    setAssetError('');
    try {
      const r = await api.get('/assets/');
      const myAssets = (r.data.results ?? r.data ?? []).filter(
        (a) => a.assigned_to_id === user.id || a.created_by_id === user.id
      );
      setAssets(myAssets);
    } catch {
      setAssetError('Could not load your assets.');
    } finally {
      setAssetLoading(false);
    }
  }, [user.id]);

  // ---- Knowledgeâ€‘base search ----
  const [kbQuery, setKbQuery] = useState('');
  const [kbResults, setKbResults] = useState([]);
  const [kbLoading, setKbLoading] = useState(false);
  const [kbError, setKbError] = useState('');
  const [exportOpen, setExportOpen] = useState(false);

  const loadKb = async (query = kbQuery) => {
    if (!query.trim()) {
      setKbResults([]);
      return;
    }
    setKbLoading(true);
    setKbError('');
    try {
      const r = await api.get('/common/knowledge-base/', {
        params: { q: query },
      });
      setKbResults(r.data.results ?? r.data ?? []);
    } catch {
      setKbError('Could not search knowledge base.');
    } finally {
      setKbLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadTickets(); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    loadAssets(); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
  }, [loadTickets, loadAssets]);

  // ---- Helper: render tickets section ----
  function renderTickets() {
    if (ticketLoading) {
      return <EmptyState title="Loading tickets..." hint="Please waitâ€¦" />;
    }
    if (ticketError) {
      return <EmptyState title="Error" hint={ticketError} />;
    }
    if (tickets.length === 0) {
      return <EmptyState
        title="No tickets"
        hint="You have no tickets. Create a new ticket if you need help."
      />;
    }
    return (
      <ul className="note-list">
        {tickets.map((t) => (
          <li key={t.id} className={t.is_read ? undefined : 'is-unread'}>
            <div className="muted small">
              {t.priority ? t.priority[0].toUpperCase() + t.priority.slice(1) : 'â€”'}
              Â·
              {t.status ? t.status[0].toUpperCase() + t.status.slice(1) : 'â€”'}
              Â·
              {t.sla_due_at ? new Date(t.sla_due_at).toLocaleDateString() : 'â€”'}
            </div>
            <a href={`#/tickets/${t.id}`} className="row-title">
              {t.title}
            </a>
            <div className="muted small">
              Created {new Date(t.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}
            </div>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    );
  }

  // ---- Helper: render assets section ----
  function renderAssets() {
    if (assetLoading) {
      return <EmptyState title="Loading assets..." hint="Please waitâ€¦" />;
    }
    if (assetError) {
      return <EmptyState title="Error" hint={assetError} />;
    }
    if (assets.length === 0) {
      return <EmptyState
        title="No assets"
        hint="You have no assigned assets. Contact IT if you need one."
      />;
    }
    return (
      <ul className="mini-list">
        {assets.map((a) => (
          <li key={a.id} className="mini-item">
            <a href={`#/assets/${a.id}`} className="mini-link">
              {a.asset_tag} â€“ {a.name || 'â€”'}
            </a>
            <div className="mini-desc">
              Status: {a.status || 'â€”'}
            </div>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    );
  }

  // ---- Helper: render knowledge-base section ----
  function renderKb() {
    if (kbLoading) {
      return <EmptyState title="Loading articles..." hint="Please waitâ€¦" />;
    }
    if (kbError) {
      return <EmptyState title="Error" hint={kbError} />;
    }
    if (kbResults.length === 0) {
      return <EmptyState
        title="No articles found"
        hint="Try a different keyword or browse categories."
      />;
    }
    return (
      <ul className="note-list">
        {kbResults.map((a) => (
          <li key={a.id} className="is-unread">
            <div className="notif-title is-strong">{a.title}</div>
            <div className="muted small">
              {a.category ? `Category: ${a.category.name}` : ''}
              {a.tags?.length && (
                <span>
                  {Array.from(a.tags.values() || []).map((t) => (
                    <span key={t.slug} className="muted small tag"
                      >#{t.name}</span
                    >
                  ))}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className="muted small">
              Created {new Date(a.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}
            </div>
            <a
              href={`#/kb/${a.id}`}
              className="row-title"
            >
              Read article
            </a>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Panel>
      <PanelHeader>
        <h3>Selfâ€‘Service</h3>
        <p className="muted small">
          Welcome, {user.employee_id} ({user.role.replace(/_/g, ' ')}).
        </p>
      </PanelHeader>

      <PanelPad>
        {/* Notification area */}
        <div className="mb-4">
          <NotifBadge />
          <button
            className="btn-ghost"
            onClick={loadTickets}
            title="Refresh tickets"
            style={{ marginLeft: 'var(--sp-2)' }}
          >
            Refresh
          </button>
          <button
            className="btn-secondary"
            disabled={true}
            style={{ marginLeft: 'var(--sp-2)' }}
            title="Mark all as read"
          >

          </button>

        {/* My Tickets */}
        <Panel>
          <PanelHeader>
            <h4>My Tickets</h4>
            <Link
              className="link-small"
              href="#/tickets"
              style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--sp-2)' }}
              title="View all tickets in the system"
            >
              Browse all tickets
            </Link>
          </PanelHeader>
          {renderTickets()}
        </Panel>

        {/* My Assets */}
        <Panel>
          <PanelHeader>
            <h4>My Assets</h4>
            <Link
              className="link-small"
              href="#/assets"
              style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--sp-2)' }}
              title="View all assets in the system"

        </Panel>

        {/* Knowledge Base */}
        <Panel>

                className="input grow"

                  loadKb(e.target.value);
                }}

              />

            dataset="knowledge_base"
            open={exportOpen}
            onClose={() => setExportOpen(false)}
          />

      </PanelPad>

}
