import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import api from '../../api';
import { fetchPage, parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';
import {
  Badge, ConfirmDialog, DataTable, EmptyState, Field, Modal, PageHeader, Pager, UserSelect,
} from '../../components';

const PRIORITIES = [
  { value: 'low', label: 'Low' },
  { value: 'medium', label: 'Medium' },
  { value: 'high', label: 'High' },
  { value: 'urgent', label: 'Urgent' },
];

/** Coerce an API page payload into rows across DRF page / plain list shapes. */
function rowsOf(payload) {
  const d = payload?.data ?? payload;
  if (Array.isArray(d)) return d;
  return d?.results ?? d?.data ?? [];
}

/** Simple paginated loader shared by the staff queues below. */
function usePagedLoader(base) {
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [count, setCount] = useState(null);
  const [next, setNext] = useState(null);
  const [previous, setPrevious] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const loadUrl = useCallback(async (url) => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const pg = await fetchPage(url);
      setItems(pg.items);
      setCount(pg.count);
      setNext(pg.next);
      setPrevious(pg.previous);
    } catch {
      setError('Could not load.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => { loadUrl(base); }, [base, loadUrl]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
  return { items, setItems, count, next, previous, loading, error, loadUrl };
}

function CatalogueCard({ item, onRequest, staff, onEdit, onToggleActive, onDelete }) {
  return (
    <div className="panel" style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', height: '100%' }}>
      <div className="panel-pad" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <strong>{item.name}</strong>
          <Badge kind="status" value="open" label={item.category || 'other'} />
          {!item.is_active && <Badge kind="status" value="inactive" label="Inactive" />}
          {item.requires_approval && <Badge kind="status" value="pending" label="Approval required" />}
          {item.creates_ticket && <Badge kind="status" value="scheduled" label="Ticket automation not yet enabled" />}
        </div>
        <p className="muted" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{item.description || 'No description.'}</p>
        {item.instructions && <p className="small" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{item.instructions}</p>}
        {item.estimated_fulfilment_hours != null && (
          <div className="small muted">Est. fulfilment: {item.estimated_fulfilment_hours}h</div>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="panel-pad" style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
        <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={() => onRequest(item)} disabled={!item.is_active}>
          Request
        </button>
        {staff && (
          <>
            <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => onEdit(item)}>Editâ€¦</button>
            <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => onToggleActive(item)}>
              {item.is_active ? 'Deactivate' : 'Activate'}
            </button>
            <button type="button" className="btn-small btn-danger" onClick={() => onDelete(item)}>Deleteâ€¦</button>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function ServicesCatalogue() {
  const { isStaff, canManageServiceCatalogue } = useAuth();
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');

  const [showRequest, setShowRequest] = useState(null); // catalogue item
  const [reqForm, setReqForm] = useState({ description: '', priority: 'medium', answers: {} });
  const [reqBusy, setReqBusy] = useState(false);
  const [reqError, setReqError] = useState('');

  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(null);
  const [catForm, setCatForm] = useState({ name: '', description: '', category: 'other', is_active: true, requires_approval: false, creates_ticket: false, estimated_fulfilment_hours: '', instructions: '' });
  const [catBusy, setCatBusy] = useState(false);
  const [catError, setCatError] = useState('');

  const [delFor, setDelFor] = useState(null);
  const [delBusy, setDelBusy] = useState(false);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const r = await api.get('/services/catalogue/');
      setItems(rowsOf(r));
    } catch {
      setError('Could not load the service catalogue.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect

  const visible = isStaff ? items : items.filter((i) => i.is_active);

  const openRequest = (item) => {
    setShowRequest(item);
    setReqForm({ description: '', priority: 'medium', answers: {} });
    setReqError('');
  };
  const setAnswer = (k, v) => setReqForm((p) => ({ ...p, answers: { ...p.answers, [k]: v } }));
  const setReqField = (k) => (e) => setReqForm((p) => ({ ...p, [k]: e.target.value }));

  const submitRequest = async (ev) => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    if (reqBusy || !showRequest) return;
    setReqBusy(true);
    setReqError('');
    try {
      const r = await api.post('/services/requests/', {
        catalogue_item: showRequest.id,
        description: reqForm.description.trim(),
        priority: reqForm.priority,
        answers: reqForm.answers,
      });
      setMsg(`Submitted ${r.data.request_number || 'request'}.`);
      setShowRequest(null);
    } catch (e) {
      setReqError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not submit request.');
    } finally {
      setReqBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const openForm = (item = null) => {
    setEditing(item ? { id: item.id } : null);
    setCatForm(item ? {
      name: item.name ?? '', description: item.description ?? '', category: item.category ?? 'other',
      is_active: !!item.is_active, requires_approval: !!item.requires_approval,
      creates_ticket: !!item.creates_ticket,
      estimated_fulfilment_hours: item.estimated_fulfilment_hours ?? '',
      instructions: item.instructions ?? '',
    } : { name: '', description: '', category: 'other', is_active: true, requires_approval: false, creates_ticket: false, estimated_fulfilment_hours: '', instructions: '' });
    setCatError('');
    setShowForm(true);
  };
  const setCat = (k) => (e) => setCatForm((p) => ({ ...p, [k]: e?.target?.value ?? e }));
  const setCatCheck = (k) => (e) => setCatForm((p) => ({ ...p, [k]: e.target.checked }));

  const saveCatalogue = async (ev) => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    if (catBusy) return;
    setCatBusy(true);
    setCatError('');
    const payload = {
      name: catForm.name.trim(),
      description: catForm.description.trim(),
      category: catForm.category,
      is_active: catForm.is_active === true || catForm.is_active === 'true',
      requires_approval: catForm.requires_approval === true || catForm.requires_approval === 'true',
      creates_ticket: catForm.creates_ticket === true || catForm.creates_ticket === 'true',
      estimated_fulfilment_hours: catForm.estimated_fulfilment_hours === '' ? null : Number(catForm.estimated_fulfilment_hours),
      instructions: catForm.instructions.trim(),
    };
    if (!payload.name) {
      setCatError('Name is required.');
      setCatBusy(false);
      return;
    }
    const url = editing ? `/services/catalogue/${editing.id}/` : '/services/catalogue/';
    try {
      await api[editing ? 'patch' : 'post'](url, payload);
      setShowForm(false);
      setEditing(null);
      await load();
      setMsg(editing ? 'Service updated.' : 'Service created.');
    } catch (e) {
      setCatError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not save service.');
    } finally {
      setCatBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const toggleActive = async (item) => {
    try {
      await api.patch(`/services/catalogue/${item.id}/`, { is_active: !item.is_active });
      await load();
      setMsg(`"${item.name}" ${item.is_active ? 'deactivated' : 'activated'}.`);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not update service.');
    }
  };

  const doDelete = async (item) => {
    if (!item) return;
    setDelBusy(true);
    try {
      await api.delete(`/services/catalogue/${item.id}/`);
      setItems(items.filter((r) => r.id !== item.id));
      setMsg(`"${item.name}" deleted.`);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not delete service.');
    } finally {
      setDelBusy(false);
      setDelFor(null);
    }
  };

  if (loading) return <div className="panel-pad"><div className="muted">Loadingâ€¦</div></div>;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Service Catalogue"
        sub={`${visible.length} service${visible.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} available.`}
        actions={canManageServiceCatalogue ? <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={() => openForm()} disabled={catBusy}>+ New service</button> : null}
      />
      {error && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>}
      {msg && <div className="success-summary" role="status">{msg}</div>}
      {visible.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState title="No services available." hint={isStaff ? 'Create your first service with + New service.' : 'Ask IT staff to publish services.'} />
      ) : (
        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr))', gap: 12 }}>
          {visible.map((item) => (
            <CatalogueCard key={item.id} item={item} onRequest={openRequest} staff={canManageServiceCatalogue}
              onEdit={openForm} onToggleActive={toggleActive} onDelete={setDelFor} />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {showRequest && (
        <Modal title={`Request: ${showRequest.name}`} onClose={() => setShowRequest(null)} size="wide">
          <form onSubmit={submitRequest} noValidate>
            {Array.isArray(showRequest.form_fields) && showRequest.form_fields.length > 0 && (
              <>
                <Field label="Details">{''}</Field>
                {showRequest.form_fields.map((fld, idx) => {
                  const key = fld.key || fld.name || `field_${idx}`;
                  const label = fld.label || fld.name || key;
                  const required = !!fld.required;
                  const value = reqForm.answers[key] ?? '';
                  const common = {
                    className: 'input',
                    value,
                    disabled: reqBusy,
                    'aria-label': label,
                    onChange: (e) => setAnswer(key, e.target.value),
                  };
                  return (
                    <Field key={key} label={label} required={required}>
                      {fld.type === 'textarea'
                        ? <textarea rows={3} {...common} />
                        : fld.type === 'select' && Array.isArray(fld.options)
                          ? (
                            <select {...common}>
                              <option value="">Selectâ€¦</option>
                              {fld.options.map((o) => <option key={String(o.value ?? o)} value={String(o.value ?? o)}>{o.label ?? o}</option>)}
                            </select>
                          )
                          : <input {...common} type={fld.type === 'number' ? 'number' : 'text'} />}
                    </Field>
                  );
                })}
              </>
            )}
            <Field label="Description">
              <textarea className="input" rows={3} value={reqForm.description} onChange={setReqField('description')}
                placeholder="What do you need?" disabled={reqBusy} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Priority" required>
              <select className="input" value={reqForm.priority} onChange={setReqField('priority')} disabled={reqBusy}>
                {PRIORITIES.map((p) => <option key={p.value} value={p.value}>{p.label}</option>)}
              </select>
            </Field>
            {reqError && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{reqError}</div>}
            <div className="row-end">
              <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setShowRequest(null)} disabled={reqBusy}>Cancel</button>
              <button type="submit" className="btn-primary" disabled={reqBusy}>
                {reqBusy ? 'Submittingâ€¦' : 'Submit request'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {showForm && (
        <Modal title={editing ? 'Edit service' : 'New service'} onClose={() => setShowForm(false)} size="wide">
          <form onSubmit={saveCatalogue} noValidate>
            <Field label="Name" required error={catError}>
              <input className="input" value={catForm.name} onChange={setCat('name')} disabled={catBusy} maxLength={120} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Category" required>
              <select className="input" value={catForm.category} onChange={setCat('category')} disabled={catBusy}>
                {['hardware', 'software', 'account', 'access', 'network', 'email', 'onboarding', 'other'].map((c) => (
                  <option key={c} value={c}>{c}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </Field>
            <Field label="Description">
              <textarea className="input" rows={3} value={catForm.description} onChange={setCat('description')} disabled={catBusy} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Instructions">
              <textarea className="input" rows={3} value={catForm.instructions} onChange={setCat('instructions')} disabled={catBusy} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Estimated fulfilment (hours)">
              <input className="input" type="number" min="0" value={catForm.estimated_fulfilment_hours}
                onChange={setCat('estimated_fulfilment_hours')} disabled={catBusy} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Flags">
              <label className="check-row">
                <input type="checkbox" checked={catForm.is_active === true || catForm.is_active === 'true'} onChange={setCatCheck('is_active')} disabled={catBusy} />
                Active (visible to employees)
              </label>
              <label className="check-row">
                <input type="checkbox" checked={catForm.requires_approval === true || catForm.requires_approval === 'true'} onChange={setCatCheck('requires_approval')} disabled={catBusy} />
                Requires approval
              </label>
              <label className="check-row">
                <input type="checkbox" checked={catForm.creates_ticket === true || catForm.creates_ticket === 'true'} onChange={setCatCheck('creates_ticket')} disabled={catBusy} />
                Creates a fulfilment ticket
              </label>
            </Field>
            {catError && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{catError}</div>}
            <div className="row-end">
              <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setShowForm(false)} disabled={catBusy}>Cancel</button>
              <button type="submit" className="btn-primary" disabled={catBusy || !catForm.name.trim()}>
                {catBusy ? 'Savingâ€¦' : (editing ? 'Save changes' : 'Create service')}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {delFor && (
        <ConfirmDialog
          title={`Delete service "${delFor.name}"?`}
          message="This soft-deletes the catalogue item. Existing requests are kept."
          confirmLabel="Delete service" danger busy={delBusy}
          onConfirm={() => doDelete(delFor)} onCancel={() => setDelFor(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function MyServiceRequests() {
  const { isStaff } = useAuth();
  const { items, count, next, previous, loading, error, loadUrl } = usePagedLoader('/services/requests/');

  const columns = [
    { key: 'number', label: 'Number', render: (r) => <a href={`#/service-requests/${r.id}`}>{r.request_number}</a> },
    { key: 'service', label: 'Service', render: (r) => <span className="row-title">{r.catalogue_item_name || 'â€”'}</span> },
    { key: 'status', label: 'Status', render: (r) => <Badge kind="status" value={r.status} /> },
    { key: 'priority', label: 'Priority', render: (r) => <Badge kind="priority" value={r.priority} /> },
    ...(isStaff ? [{ key: 'requester', label: 'Requester', render: (r) => <span className="ellipsis">{r.requester_name || r.requester}</span> }] : []),
    { key: 'submitted', label: 'Submitted', render: (r) => (r.submitted_at ? new Date(r.submitted_at).toLocaleDateString() : 'â€”') },
  ];

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title={isStaff ? 'Service requests' : 'My Service Requests'}
        sub={count != null ? `${count} request${count === 1 ? '' : 's'}` : undefined}
        actions={<a className="btn-primary" href="#/services">Browse catalogue</a>}
      />
      {error && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>}
      <div className="panel">
        {loading ? <div className="panel-pad"><div className="muted">Loadingâ€¦</div></div>
          : count === 0 ? <EmptyState title="No service requests yet." hint="Request something from the Service Catalogue." />
          : (
            <>
              <DataTable columns={columns} rows={items} keyOf={(r) => r.id}
                emptyTitle="No requests match." emptyHint="Adjust the filters." />
              <Pager count={count} hasNext={!!next} hasPrev={!!previous} busy={loading}
                onPrev={() => previous && loadUrl(previous)} onNext={() => next && loadUrl(next)} />
            </>
          )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function ServiceRequestDetail({ id }) {
  const { isStaff, canApproveServiceRequests } = useAuth();
  const [req, setReq] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(null);

  const [commentBody, setCommentBody] = useState('');
  const [commentInternal, setCommentInternal] = useState(false);

  const [assignOpen, setAssignOpen] = useState(false);
  const [assignUser, setAssignUser] = useState('');

  const [decisionOpen, setDecisionOpen] = useState(null); // 'approve' | 'reject'
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const r = await api.get(`/services/requests/${id}/`);
      setReq(r.data);
    } catch {
      setError('Could not load this request.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [id]);
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect

  const act = async (url, payload, done) => {
    setBusy(url);
    setError('');
    try {
      await api.post(url, payload ?? {});
      setMsg(done);
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Action failed.');
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  };

  const doCancel = () => act(`/services/requests/${id}/cancel/`, {}, `Request ${req.request_number} cancelled.`);
  const doApprove = () => act(`/services/requests/${id}/approve/`, { reason: reason.trim() }, `Request ${req.request_number} approved.`);
  const doReject = () => act(`/services/requests/${id}/reject/`, { reason: reason.trim() }, `Request ${req.request_number} rejected.`);
  const doAssign = () => act(`/services/requests/${id}/assign/`, { assigned_to: assignUser ? Number(assignUser) : null }, `Request ${req.request_number} assigned.`);
  const doComment = async (ev) => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    if (!commentBody.trim() || busy === 'comment') return;
    setBusy('comment');
    setError('');
    try {
      await api.post(`/services/requests/${id}/comment/`, {
        body: commentBody.trim(), is_internal: isStaff && commentInternal,
      });
      setCommentBody('');
      setCommentInternal(false);
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not add comment.');
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  };

  if (loading) return <div className="panel-pad"><div className="muted">Loadingâ€¦</div></div>;
  if (!req) return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Request" />
      {error && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>}
    </div>
  );

  const canCancel = !['fulfilled', 'cancelled', 'rejected'].includes(req.status);
  const canDecide = canApproveServiceRequests && req.status === 'pending_approval';
  const comments = Array.isArray(req.comments) ? req.comments : [];
  const history = Array.isArray(req.history) ? req.history : [];
  const visibleComments = isStaff ? comments : comments.filter((c) => !c.is_internal);

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title={req.request_number}
        sub={`${req.catalogue_item_name || 'Service'} Â· ${req.status?.replace(/_/g, ' ')}`}
        actions={<a className="btn-small" href="#/service-requests">â† All requests</a>}
      />
      {error && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>}
      {msg && <div className="success-summary" role="status">{msg}</div>}

      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '2fr 1fr', gap: 12 }}>
        <div>
          <div className="panel">
            <div className="panel-pad">
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap', marginBottom: 8 }}>
                <Badge kind="status" value={req.status} />
                <Badge kind="priority" value={req.priority} />
                {req.approval_required && <Badge kind="status" value="pending" label="Approval required" />}
              </div>
              <dl className="detail-grid">
                <dt>Requester</dt><dd>{req.requester_name || req.requester}</dd>
                <dt>Department</dt><dd>{req.department ?? 'â€”'}</dd>
                <dt>Assigned to</dt><dd>{req.assigned_to_name || req.assigned_to || 'Unassigned'}</dd>
                <dt>Submitted</dt><dd>{req.submitted_at ? new Date(req.submitted_at).toLocaleString() : 'â€”'}</dd>
                {req.approved_at && <><dt>Decided</dt><dd>{new Date(req.approved_at).toLocaleString()}</dd></>}
                {req.approval_reason && <><dt>Decision note</dt><dd>{req.approval_reason}</dd></>}
                {req.fulfilment_ticket && <><dt>Fulfilment ticket</dt><dd>#{req.fulfilment_ticket}</dd></>}
                {req.fulfilment_details && <><dt>Fulfilment</dt><dd>{req.fulfilment_details}</dd></>}
              </dl>
              {req.description && <p style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{req.description}</p>}
              {req.answers && typeof req.answers === 'object' && Object.keys(req.answers).length > 0 && (
                <>
                  <h4 style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>Answers</h4>
                  <dl className="detail-grid">
                    {Object.entries(req.answers).map(([k, v]) => (
                      <span key={k} style={{ display: 'contents' }}>
                        <dt>{k}</dt><dd>{typeof v === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(v) : String(v)}</dd>
                      </span>
                    ))}
                  </dl>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="panel" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
            <div className="panel-head"><strong>Comments</strong></div>
            <div className="panel-pad">
              {visibleComments.length === 0
                ? <EmptyState title="No comments yet." />
                : (
                  <ul style={{ listStyle: 'none', padding: 0 }}>
                    {visibleComments.map((c) => (
                      <li key={c.id} style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
                        <span className="small muted">{c.author_name || c.author} Â· {c.created_at ? new Date(c.created_at).toLocaleString() : ''}{c.is_internal ? ' Â· Internal' : ''}</span>
                        <div>{c.body}</div>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                )}
              <form onSubmit={doComment} noValidate style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
                <Field label="Add a comment">
                  <textarea className="input" rows={2} value={commentBody}
                    onChange={(e) => setCommentBody(e.target.value)} disabled={busy === 'comment'} />
                </Field>
                {isStaff && (
                  <label className="check-row">
                    <input type="checkbox" checked={commentInternal}
                      onChange={(e) => setCommentInternal(e.target.checked)} disabled={busy === 'comment'} />
                    Internal note (hidden from the requester)
                  </label>
                )}
                <div className="row-end">
                  <button type="submit" className="btn-small" disabled={busy === 'comment' || !commentBody.trim()}>
                    {busy === 'comment' ? 'Postingâ€¦' : 'Post comment'}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </form>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="panel" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
            <div className="panel-head"><strong>History</strong></div>
            <div className="panel-pad">
              {history.length === 0 ? <EmptyState title="No history yet." /> : (
                <ul style={{ listStyle: 'none', padding: 0 }}>
                  {history.map((h) => (
                    <li key={h.id} className="small">
                      <strong>{h.event}</strong> â€” {h.detail || ''}{' '}
                      <span className="muted">{h.actor_name || h.actor || ''} Â· {h.created_at ? new Date(h.created_at).toLocaleString() : ''}</span>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div>
          <div className="panel">
            <div className="panel-head"><strong>Actions</strong></div>
            <div className="panel-pad" style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
              {canDecide && (
                <>
                  <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={() => { setDecisionOpen('approve'); setReason(''); }}
                    disabled={busy === `/services/requests/${id}/approve/`}>Approveâ€¦</button>
                  <button type="button" className="btn-danger" onClick={() => { setDecisionOpen('reject'); setReason(''); }}
                    disabled={busy === `/services/requests/${id}/reject/`}>Rejectâ€¦</button>
                </>
              )}
              {isStaff && (
                <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => setAssignOpen(true)}
                  disabled={busy === `/services/requests/${id}/assign/`}>Assignâ€¦</button>
              )}
              {canCancel && (
                <button type="button" className="btn-small btn-danger"
                  onClick={doCancel} disabled={busy === `/services/requests/${id}/cancel/`}>
                  {busy === `/services/requests/${id}/cancel/` ? 'Cancellingâ€¦' : 'Cancel request'}
                </button>
              )}
              {!canDecide && !isStaff && !canCancel && <span className="muted small">No actions available.</span>}
              {!canDecide && !isStaff && canCancel && <span className="muted small">You can cancel this request while it is open.</span>}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {assignOpen && (
        <Modal title={`Assign ${req.request_number}`} onClose={() => setAssignOpen(false)}>
          <div className="panel-pad">
            <Field label="Assign to (staff user)">
              <UserSelect value={assignUser} onChange={setAssignUser} />
            </Field>
            <div className="row-end">
              <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setAssignOpen(false)}>Cancel</button>
              <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={async () => { await doAssign(); setAssignOpen(false); }}
                disabled={busy === `/services/requests/${id}/assign/`}>
                {busy === `/services/requests/${id}/assign/` ? 'Assigningâ€¦' : 'Assign'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {decisionOpen && (
        <Modal title={`${decisionOpen === 'approve' ? 'Approve' : 'Reject'} ${req.request_number}`}
          onClose={() => setDecisionOpen(null)}>
          <form onSubmit={(ev) => { ev.preventDefault(); if (decisionOpen === 'approve') doApprove(); else doReject(); setDecisionOpen(null); }} noValidate>
            <div className="panel-pad">
              <Field label="Reason (optional)">
                <textarea className="input" rows={3} value={reason} onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)} />
              </Field>
              <div className="row-end">
                <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setDecisionOpen(null)}>Cancel</button>
                <button type="submit" className={decisionOpen === 'approve' ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-danger'}
                  disabled={busy === `/services/requests/${id}/${decisionOpen}/`}>
                  {decisionOpen === 'approve' ? 'Approve request' : 'Reject request'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { PageHeader } from '../../components';
import { parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';

/** Fallback category list + opt-in defaults (backend source of truth). */
const DEFAULT_CATEGORIES = [
  { key: 'ticket_assignment', label: 'Ticket assigned to me' },
  { key: 'ticket_status_change', label: 'Ticket status changed' },
  { key: 'ticket_reply', label: 'New reply or note on my ticket' },
  { key: 'sla_escalation', label: 'SLA escalation / breach' },
  { key: 'maintenance_reminder', label: 'Maintenance reminder' },
  { key: 'asset_assignment', label: 'Asset assigned or returned' },
  { key: 'system_alert', label: 'System alerts' },
];

const DEFAULT_ENABLED = {
  ticket_assignment: true,
  ticket_status_change: true,
  ticket_reply: true,
  sla_escalation: true,
  maintenance_reminder: true,
  asset_assignment: true,
  system_alert: true,
};

function prefsToState(pref) {
  const categories = { ...DEFAULT_ENABLED };
  const raw = pref?.categories;
  if (raw && typeof raw === 'object') {
    for (const key of Object.keys(DEFAULT_ENABLED)) {
      if (typeof raw[key] === 'boolean') categories[key] = raw[key];
    }
  }
  return {
    email_enabled: pref?.email_enabled !== false,
    categories,
  };
}

/** Notification preferences settings page (backed by /api/common/notification-preferences/). */
export function NotificationSettings() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');
  const [, setHasRecord] = useState(false);
  const [recordId, setRecordId] = useState(null);
  const [emailEnabled, setEmailEnabled] = useState(true);
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState({ ...DEFAULT_ENABLED });
  const [emailCategories, setEmailCategories] = useState(DEFAULT_CATEGORIES);

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const r = await api.get('/common/notification-preferences/');
      const data = r.data;
      const rows = data?.results ?? data ?? [];
      const mine = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : []).filter(
        (p) => !p?.user || String(p.user) === String(user?.id),
      );
      if (mine.length > 0) {
        const pref = mine[0];
        setHasRecord(true);
        setRecordId(pref.id ?? null);
        const st = prefsToState(pref);
        setEmailEnabled(st.email_enabled);
        setCategories(st.categories);
        setEmailCategories(
          pref.email_categories?.length
            ? pref.email_categories
            : DEFAULT_CATEGORIES,
        );
      } else {
        // No preference record yet -> sensible defaults (all email on).
        setHasRecord(false);
        setRecordId(null);
        setEmailEnabled(true);
        setCategories({ ...DEFAULT_ENABLED });
        setEmailCategories(DEFAULT_CATEGORIES);
      }
    } catch {
      setError('Could not load notification preferences. Please retry.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, react/set-state-in-effect

  const toggleCategory = (key, checked) => {
    setCategories((p) => ({ ...p, [key]: checked }));
    setMsg('');
  };

  const toggleEmailEnabled = () => {
    setEmailEnabled((v) => !v);
    setMsg('');
  };

  const save = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    setError('');
    setMsg('');
    const payload = { email_enabled: emailEnabled, categories };
    try {
      if (recordId) {
        await api.patch(`/common/notification-preferences/${recordId}/`, payload);
      } else {
        const r = await api.post('/common/notification-preferences/', payload);
        setRecordId(r.data.id);
      }
      setHasRecord(true);
      setMsg('Notification preferences saved.');
    } catch (e) {
      // Keep the unsaved edits in place; surface the API error.
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not save notification preferences.');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const enabledFor = (key) => !!categories[key];

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Notification settings"
        sub="Control which ticket and system emails you receive."
        actions={
          <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={save} disabled={saving || loading}>
            {saving ? 'Savingâ€¦' : 'Save changes'}
          </button>
        }
      />
      {loading ? (
        <div className="panel"><div className="panel-pad"><span className="spinner" /> Loading notification preferencesâ€¦</div></div>
      ) : (
        <>
          {error && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>}
          {msg && <div className="success-summary" role="status">{msg}</div>}

          <div className="panel">
            <div className="panel-title"><h4>Email notifications</h4></div>
            <div className="panel-pad">
              <label className="check-row">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={emailEnabled}
                  onChange={toggleEmailEnabled}
                  disabled={saving}
                />
                Enable email notifications
              </label>
              <p className="muted small" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-2)' }}>
                Master switch for all email notifications. Turn off to stop all
                (non-essential) email notifications. In-app notifications and
                security / password / verification emails are always delivered.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="panel">
            <div className="panel-title"><h4>Notification categories</h4></div>
            <div className="panel-pad">
              {emailCategories.map((c) => (
                <div key={c.key} className="check-row" style={{ justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                  <span>
                    {c.label}
                    <span className="muted small" style={{ display: 'block' }}>{c.key}</span>
                  </span>
                  <label className="row-gap" style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>
                    <span className="muted small">Off</span>
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={enabledFor(c.key)}
                      onChange={(e) => toggleCategory(c.key, e.target.checked)}
                      disabled={saving}
                      aria-label={`Email notifications for ${c.label}`}
                    />
                    <span className="muted small">On</span>
                  </label>
                </div>
              ))}
              <p className="muted small" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-2)' }}>
                Choose which notification categories you receive by email. A
                disabled category never blocks unrelated categories, and users
                without a preference record receive all categories by default.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default NotificationSettings;

===== src\pages\skeleton\Skeleton.jsx =====

/** Standardized loading primitives.
 *
 * Skeleton: animated placeholder for text/lines while content loads.
 * PageLoading: full-page loading indicator used between route changes.
 * ListSkeleton: rows of skeletons for table/list loading.
 */

import { memo, useMemo } from 'react';
import { EmptyState } from '../../components';

/** Single animated line skeleton. */
const SkeletonLine = memo(({ width = '100%', className = '' }) => (
  <span
    className={`skeleton-line ${className}`}
    style={{ width }}
    aria-hidden="true"
  />
));

/** Text skeleton: renders N lines of placeholder text. */
export const Skeleton = memo(({ lines = 3, width = '100%', className = '' }) => {
  const lineEls = useMemo(
    () => Array.from({ length: lines }, (_, i) => (
      <span key={i} className="skeleton-lines">
        <SkeletonLine width={i === lines - 1 ? '60%' : width} />
      </span>
    )),
    [lines, width]
  );
  return (
    <div className={`skeleton ${className}`} aria-label="Loading" role="status">
      {lineEls}
    </div>
  );
});

/** List/table skeleton: renders N row skeletons. */
export const ListSkeleton = memo(({ rows = 5, className = '' }) => {
  const rowEls = useMemo(
    () => Array.from({ length: rows }, (_, i) => (
      <div key={i} className="skeleton-row">
        <SkeletonLine width="10%" />
        <SkeletonLine width="40%" />
        <SkeletonLine width="35%" />
        <SkeletonLine width="20%" />
        <SkeletonLine width="25%" />
      </div>
    )),
    [rows]
  );
  return (
    <div className={`skeleton-list ${className}`} aria-label="Loading list" role="status">
      {rowEls}
    </div>
  );
});

/** Full-page loading indicator used between route changes. */
export const PageLoading = memo(({ message = 'Loading pageâ€¦' }) => (
  <p className="page-loading" role="status">
    <span className="spinner" aria-hidden="true" />
    {message}
  </p>
));

/** Page-level empty state wrapper with a primary action. */
export const PageEmpty = memo(({ title, hint, action }) => (
    <div className="panel panel-pad">
      <EmptyState title={title} hint={hint} action={action} />
    </div>
  ));

===== src\pages\software-products\SoftwareProductDetail.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { PageHeader } from '../../components';
import api from '../../api';
import { licensingCapabilities } from '../../shared/licensing-utils';
import { PRODUCT_APPROVAL_STATUS_LABELS, RISK_LEVEL_LABELS, SUPPORT_STATUS_LABELS } from '../../shared/licensing-utils';

function SoftwareProductDetail({ id, productId }) {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const caps = licensingCapabilities(auth);
  const pid = id || productId;
  const [product, setProduct] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pid) return;
    setLoading(true); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    api.get(`/licensing/products/${pid}/`).then((r) => setProduct(r.data)).catch((e) => setError(e.response?.data?.detail || 'Could not load product.')).finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [pid]);
  const doAction = async (action) => {
    try { await api.post(`/licensing/products/${pid}/${action}/`); const r = await api.get(`/licensing/products/${pid}/`); setProduct(r.data); } catch (e) { setError(e.response?.data?.detail || 'Action failed.'); }
  };
  if (loading) return <div className="panel-pad">Loading productâ€¦</div>;
  if (error) return <div className="alert alert-danger">{error}</div>;
  if (!product) return null;
  return (
    <div className="software-product-detail">
      <PageHeader title={product.name} />
      <div className="card mb-3"><div className="card-body">
        <div><strong>Publisher:</strong> {product.publisher}</div>
        <div><strong>Version:</strong> {product.version}</div>
        <div><strong>Platform:</strong> {product.platform}</div>
        <div><strong>Approval:</strong> {PRODUCT_APPROVAL_STATUS_LABELS[product.approved_status]}</div>
        <div><strong>Risk:</strong> {RISK_LEVEL_LABELS[product.risk_level]}</div>
        <div><strong>Support:</strong> {SUPPORT_STATUS_LABELS[product.support_status]}</div>
        <div><strong>Active:</strong> {product.is_active ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</div>
        <div>{product.description}</div>
      </div></div>
      {caps.canManageProducts && (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
          <a className="btn btn-outline" href={`#/software/products/${pid}/edit`}>Edit</a>
          <button className="btn btn-outline" onClick={() => doAction('approve')}>Approve</button>
          <button className="btn btn-outline" onClick={() => doAction('restrict')}>Restrict</button>
          <button className="btn btn-outline danger" onClick={() => doAction('prohibit')}>Prohibit</button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
export { SoftwareProductDetail };
export default SoftwareProductDetail;

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

function SoftwareProductForm({ vendorId, onSave, onClose, productId }) {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const caps = licensingCapabilities(auth);
  const id = productId || vendorId;
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ name: '', code: '', publisher: '', vendor: '', product_family: '', edition: '', version: '', category: 'other', description: '', website: '', platform: 'cross_platform', license_required: true, license_model: 'perpetual', approved_status: 'pending', risk_level: 'low', support_status: 'supported', support_end_date: '', end_of_life_date: '', is_active: true, notes: '' });
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => { api.get('/assets/vendors/?is_deleted=false').then((r) => setVendors(r.data.results || r.data || [])).catch(() => {}); }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) {
      api.get(`/licensing/products/${id}/`).then((r) => {
        const d = r.data;
        setForm({ name: d.name || '', code: d.code || '', publisher: d.publisher || '', vendor: d.vendor || '', product_family: d.product_family || '', edition: d.edition || '', version: d.version || '', category: d.category || 'other', description: d.description || '', website: d.website || '', platform: d.platform || 'cross_platform', license_required: d.license_required !== false, license_model: d.license_model || 'perpetual', approved_status: d.approved_status || 'pending', risk_level: d.risk_level || 'low', support_status: d.support_status || 'supported', support_end_date: d.support_end_date || '', end_of_life_date: d.end_of_life_date || '', is_active: d.is_active !== false, notes: d.notes || '' });
      }).catch((e) => setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not load product.'));
    }
  }, [id]);
  if (!caps.canManageProducts) return <AccessDenied reason="manager" />;
  const submit = async (e) => {

===== src\pages\software-products\SoftwareProducts.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { useSort } from '../../components';
import { Badge, Field, DataTable, Pager, PageHeader, AccessDenied } from '../../components';
import { fetchPage } from '../../api-utils';
import { licensingCapabilities } from '../../shared/licensing-utils';
import { PRODUCT_APPROVAL_STATUS_LABELS, PLATFORM_LABELS, LICENSE_MODEL_LABELS, PRODUCT_CATEGORY_LABELS, RISK_LEVEL_LABELS, SUPPORT_STATUS_LABELS, buildProductListUrl } from '../../shared/licensing-utils';

function SoftwareProductsPage() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const caps = licensingCapabilities(auth);
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [count, setCount] = useState(null);
  const [next, setNext] = useState(null);
  const [previous, setPrevious] = useState(null);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [f, setF] = useState({ search: '', category: '', platform: '', license_model: '', approved_status: '', risk_level: '', support_status: '', is_active: '' });
  const [sort, , orderingParam] = useSort();

  const loadUrl = async (url) => {
    setLoading(true); setError('');
    try {
      const pg = await fetchPage(url);
      setItems(pg.items); setCount(pg.count); setNext(pg.next); setPrevious(pg.previous); setPage(1);
    } catch { setError('Could not load products.'); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  };
  const builtUrl = useMemo(() => buildProductListUrl(f, orderingParam(sort), page), [f, sort, page]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  useEffect(() => { const t = setTimeout(() => loadUrl(builtUrl), 250); return () => clearTimeout(t); }, [builtUrl]);

  const columns = [
    { key: 'name', label: 'Product', sortable: 'name' },
    { key: 'code', label: 'Code' },
    { key: 'publisher', label: 'Publisher' },
    { key: 'category', label: 'Category', render: (v) => PRODUCT_CATEGORY_LABELS[v.category] || v.category },
    { key: 'platform', label: 'Platform', render: (v) => PLATFORM_LABELS[v.platform] || v.platform },
    { key: 'license_model', label: 'License Model', render: (v) => LICENSE_MODEL_LABELS[v.license_model] || v.license_model },
    { key: 'approved_status', label: 'Approval', render: (v) => <Badge kind="status" value={PRODUCT_APPROVAL_STATUS_LABELS[v.approved_status] || v.approved_status} /> },
    { key: 'risk_level', label: 'Risk', render: (v) => RISK_LEVEL_LABELS[v.risk_level] || v.risk_level },
    { key: 'support_status', label: 'Support', render: (v) => SUPPORT_STATUS_LABELS[v.support_status] || v.support_status },
    { key: 'is_active', label: 'Active', render: (v) => v.is_active ? 'Yes' : 'No' },
  ];
  if (caps.canManageProducts) columns.push({ key: 'actions', label: 'Actions', render: (v) => (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4 }}>
      <a className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" href={`#/software/products/${v.id}`}>View</a>
      <a className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" href={`#/software/products/${v.id}/edit`}>Edit</a>
    </div>
  ) });

  if (!caps.canView) return <AccessDenied />;
  return (
    <div className="software-products-page">
      <PageHeader title="Software Products" />
      <div className="page-toolbar" style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap', marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <Field label="Search" required={false}><input className="input" value={f.search} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, search: e.target.value })} /></Field>
        <Field label="Category" required={false}><select className="input" value={f.category} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, category: e.target.value })}><option value="">All</option>{Object.entries(PRODUCT_CATEGORY_LABELS).map(([k,v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}</select></Field>
        <Field label="Platform" required={false}><select className="input" value={f.platform} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, platform: e.target.value })}><option value="">All</option>{Object.entries(PLATFORM_LABELS).map(([k,v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}</select></Field>
        <Field label="Approval" required={false}><select className="input" value={f.approved_status} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, approved_status: e.target.value })}><option value="">All</option>{Object.entries(PRODUCT_APPROVAL_STATUS_LABELS).map(([k,v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}</select></Field>
        {caps.canManageProducts && <a className="btn btn-primary" href="#/software/products/new">New Product</a>}
      </div>
      {error && <div className="alert alert-danger">{error}</div>}
      <DataTable columns={columns} rows={items} keyOf={(r) => r.id} loading={loading} emptyTitle="No products found" />
      {count !== null && <Pager count={count} hasNext={!!next} hasPrev={!!previous} busy={loading} onPrev={() => previous && loadUrl(previous)} onNext={() => next && loadUrl(next)} />}
    </div>
  );
}

export { SoftwareProductsPage };
export default SoftwareProductsPage;



===== src\pages\tickets\CannedResponsesPage.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { Badge, Button, Input, Select, Alert, DataTable, EmptyState, PageHeader } from '../../components';
import { parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';

/** Canned Responses Management Page
 * Route: #/tickets/canned-responses
 */
export function CannedResponsesPage() {
  useAuth();
  const [responses, setResponses] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [, setError] = useState('');
  const [filterCategory, setFilterCategory] = useState('');
  const [filterVisibility, setFilterVisibility] = useState('');
  const [pageSize] = useState(20);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);

  const fetchResponses = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      let url = '/api/canned-responses/';
      if (filterCategory) url += '?category=' + filterCategory;
      if (filterVisibility) url += (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '') + 'visibility=' + filterVisibility;
      if (searchQuery) url += (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '') + 'q=' + searchQuery;
      url += '&page=' + page + '&page_size=' + pageSize;
      const r = await api.get(url);
      setResponses(r.data.results ?? r.data ?? []);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Failed to load canned responses.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchResponses(); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
  }, [filterCategory, filterVisibility, searchQuery, page, pageSize]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  if (isEmployee) {
    return <div className="py-4"><Alert variant="danger">Access denied. Employees cannot manage canned responses.</Alert></div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-4">
      <PageHeader title="Canned Responses" subtitle="Manage shared and personal canned responses" />
      <div className="mb-4">
        <Select label="Category" value={filterCategory} onChange={(e) => setFilterCategory(e.target.value)}>
          <option value="">All categories</option>
          <option value="general">General</option>
          <option value="technical">Technical</option>
          <option value="hardware">Hardware</option>
        </Select>
        <Select label="Visibility" value={filterVisibility} onChange={(e) => setFilterVisibility(e.target.value)}>
          <option value="">All</option>
          <option value="internal">Internal</option>
          <option value="public">Public</option>
        </Select>
        <Input placeholder="Search..." value={searchQuery} onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)} />
      </div>

      {creating ? (
        <div className="mb-4">
          <PageHeader title="Create Canned Response" subtitle="Creating new canned response" />
          <textarea className="input" rows={4} placeholder="Enter canned response text..." />
          <div className="mb-2">
            <Select label="Visibility">
              <option value="internal">Internal</option>
              <option value="public">Public</option>
            </Select>
          </div>
          <Button onClick={() => setCreating(false)}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => setCreating(false)}>Save</Button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div>
          {loading ? (
            <p className="page-loading">Loading canned responses...</p>
          ) : responses.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState icon="ðŸ’¬" title="No Responses" text="No canned responses found." />
          ) : (
            <DataTable
              items={responses}
              pageSize={pageSize}
              columns={[
                { key: 'name', label: 'Name', render: (r) => <strong>{r.name}</strong> },
                { key: 'visibility', label: 'Visibility', render: (r) => <Badge kind="status" value={r.visibility} /> },
                { key: 'usage_count', label: 'Uses', render: (r) => r.usage_count ?? 0 },
                { key: 'actions', label: 'Actions', render: () => (
                  <div className="row-gap">
                    <Button variant="secondary" size="small">Edit</Button>
                    <Button variant="danger" size="small">Delete</Button>
                  </div>
                ) }
              ]}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {creating && (
        <div className="mt-4">
          <Button onClick={() => setCreating(false)}>Cancel creating</Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
