===== src\pages\tickets\TicketBulkImportsPage.jsx =====

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { fetchPage, parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { Badge, EmptyState, Field, LoadingRows, Modal, PageHeader, Pager } from '../../components';

const STATUS_LABELS = {
  previewed: 'Previewed',
  processing: 'Processing',
  completed: 'Completed',
  failed: 'Failed',
};

const STATUS_OPTIONS = ['', 'previewed', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed'];

function fmtDate(value) {
  if (!value) return 'â€”';
  const d = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(value);
  return d.toLocaleString();
}

function shortDigest(value) {
  if (!value) return 'â€”';
  const s = String(value);
  return s.length > 16 ? `${s.slice(0, 12)}â€¦${s.slice(-8)}` : s;
}

function reasonLabel(code) {
  const map = {
    invalid_outcome_status: 'Invalid outcome status recorded.',
    duplicate_or_inconsistent_evidence: 'Duplicate or inconsistent row evidence.',
    unexpected_extra_outcomes: 'Unexpected extra row outcomes.',
    unprocessed_or_unrecorded_rows: 'Some expected rows are unprocessed or unrecorded.',
    missing_ticket_reference: 'A succeeded outcome is missing its ticket reference.',
    invalid_failure_evidence: 'A failed outcome is missing failure evidence.',
    result_conflict: 'Stored result conflicts with durable evidence.',
    legacy_or_ambiguous_evidence: 'Legacy or ambiguous evidence; row-level proof is incomplete.',
    not_processed: 'Operation has not been processed.',
    already_finalized: 'Operation is already finalized.',
    stale_or_interrupted: 'Processing appears stale or interrupted.',
    completed_without_stored_result: 'Completed without a stored result.',
    counter_inconsistency: 'Stored counters do not match durable row evidence.',
  };
  return map[code] || code.replace(/_/g, ' ');
}

function assessmentState(assessment) {
  if (!assessment) return 'unavailable';
  if (assessment.eligible_for_finalization) return 'eligible';
  const reasons = assessment.reasons || [];
  if (reasons.includes('already_finalized')) return 'already_finalized';
  return 'ineligible';
}

function useBulkImportList(enabled = true) {
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [count, setCount] = useState(null);
  const [next, setNext] = useState(null);
  const [previous, setPrevious] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(!!enabled);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('');
  const [currentUrl, setCurrentUrl] = useState('/tickets/bulk-imports/');

  const buildUrl = useCallback((status = statusFilter) => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    if (status) params.set('status', status);
    const qs = params.toString();
    return `/tickets/bulk-imports/${qs ? `?${qs}` : ''}`;
  }, [statusFilter]);

  const load = useCallback(async (url) => {
    if (!enabled) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const page = await fetchPage(url);
      setItems(page.items);
      setCount(page.count);
      setNext(page.next);
      setPrevious(page.previous);
      setCurrentUrl(url);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not load bulk import operations.');
      setItems([]);
      setCount(null);
      setNext(null);
      setPrevious(null);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [enabled]);

  useEffect(() => { if (enabled) load(buildUrl(statusFilter)); }, [enabled, statusFilter]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, react/set-state-in-effect

  return {
    items, count, next, previous, loading, error, statusFilter,
    setStatusFilter: (v) => { setStatusFilter(v); },
    refresh: () => load(currentUrl),
    goNext: () => next && load(next),
    goPrev: () => previous && load(previous),
  };
}

export function TicketBulkImportsPage() {
  const { isStaff } = useAuth();
  const list = useBulkImportList(isStaff);

  if (!isStaff) {
    return <div className="access-denied" role="alert">You do not have permission to access this page.</div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="page">
      <PageHeader
        title="Ticket bulk import operations"
        sub="Staff-only inspection of tokenized ticket bulk imports. Reconciliation and finalization use durable backend evidence only."
      />
      <div className="panel panel-pad">
        <div className="row-gap" style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--sp-3)', alignItems: 'end' }}>
          <Field label="Status">
            <select className="input" value={list.statusFilter} onChange={(e) => list.setStatusFilter(e.target.value)} aria-label="Filter by status">
              {STATUS_OPTIONS.map((s) => (
                <option key={s || 'all'} value={s}>{s ? STATUS_LABELS[s] : 'All statuses'}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </Field>
          <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={list.refresh} disabled={list.loading}>Refresh</button>
        </div>

        {list.error && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{list.error}</div>}
        {list.loading ? <LoadingRows n={6} /> : list.items.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState title="No bulk import operations" hint="Tokenized bulk imports will appear here for staff inspection." />
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="table-wrap">
              <table className="grid">
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th>ID</th>
                    <th>User</th>
                    <th>Status</th>
                    <th>Rows</th>
                    <th>Counts</th>
                    <th>Created</th>
                    <th>Completed</th>
                    <th>Error</th>
                    <th></th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {list.items.map((op) => (
                    <tr key={op.id}>
                      <td>#{op.id}</td>
                      <td>{op.user_email || op.user || 'â€”'}</td>
                      <td><Badge kind="status" value={op.status} label={STATUS_LABELS[op.status] || op.status} /></td>
                      <td>{op.total_rows ?? 0}</td>
                      <td className="small muted">ok {op.successful_count ?? 0} / failed {op.failed_count ?? 0} / processed {op.processed_count ?? 0}</td>
                      <td className="small">{fmtDate(op.created_at)}</td>
                      <td className="small">{fmtDate(op.completed_at)}</td>
                      <td className="small" title={op.error_detail || ''}>{op.error_detail ? String(op.error_detail).slice(0, 60) : 'â€”'}</td>
                      <td><a className="btn-small" href={`#/tickets/bulk-imports/${op.id}`}>Inspect</a></td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
            <Pager
              count={list.count}
              hasNext={!!list.next}
              hasPrev={!!list.previous}
              onNext={list.goNext}
              onPrev={list.goPrev}
              busy={list.loading}
            />
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function AssessmentWarnings({ assessment }) {
  if (!assessment) return null;
  const reasons = assessment.reasons || [];
  const missing = assessment.missing_ticket_references || [];
  const counters = assessment.counter_inconsistencies || [];
  const dupes = assessment.duplicate_or_inconsistent_evidence || [];
  const conflicts = assessment.result_conflicts || [];
  const legacy = assessment.legacy_or_ambiguous_indicators || [];
  const hasAny = reasons.length || missing.length || counters.length || dupes.length || conflicts.length || legacy.length;
  if (!hasAny) return <p className="muted small">No integrity warnings reported.</p>;
  return (
    <div className="stack-gap-sm">
      {missing.length > 0 && (
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">
          <strong>Missing ticket references (finalization blocked)</strong>
          <div className="small" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-1)' }}>
            One or more succeeded outcomes no longer reference an existing ticket. This is an integrity issue.
            The operation cannot be safely finalized, and tickets will not be recreated or replayed.
          </div>
          <ul style={{ margin: 'var(--sp-2) 0 0', paddingLeft: '1.2rem' }}>
            {missing.map((m, i) => (
              <li key={i} className="small">Row index {m.row_index}, outcome #{m.outcome_id}: {m.issue || 'missing ticket reference'}{m.ticket_id == null ? ' (ticket_id is null)' : ` (ticket ${m.ticket_id})`}</li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      )}
      {counters.length > 0 && (
        <div className="alert-warning" role="status" style={{ padding: 'var(--sp-2)', border: '1px solid var(--border, #d0d7de)', borderRadius: 6 }}>
          <strong>Counter discrepancies reported</strong>
          <div className="small" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-1)' }}>
            Stored counters differ from durable row evidence. If the operation is otherwise eligible, explicit audited finalization may set counters to evidence-derived values. Counters are not repaired silently.
          </div>
          <ul style={{ margin: 'var(--sp-2) 0 0', paddingLeft: '1.2rem' }}>
            {counters.map((c, i) => <li key={i} className="small">{c}</li>)}
          </ul>
        </div>
      )}
      {dupes.length > 0 && (
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">
          <strong>Duplicate/inconsistent evidence</strong>
          <ul style={{ margin: 'var(--sp-2) 0 0', paddingLeft: '1.2rem' }}>{dupes.map((d, i) => <li key={i} className="small">{d}</li>)}</ul>
        </div>
      )}
      {conflicts.length > 0 && (
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">
          <strong>Result conflicts</strong>
          <ul style={{ margin: 'var(--sp-2) 0 0', paddingLeft: '1.2rem' }}>{conflicts.map((c, i) => <li key={i} className="small">{c}</li>)}</ul>
        </div>
      )}
      {legacy.length > 0 && (
        <div className="alert-warning" role="status" style={{ padding: 'var(--sp-2)', border: '1px solid var(--border, #d0d7de)', borderRadius: 6 }}>
          <strong>Legacy/ambiguous evidence</strong>
          <ul style={{ margin: 'var(--sp-2) 0 0', paddingLeft: '1.2rem' }}>{legacy.map((c, i) => <li key={i} className="small">{c}</li>)}</ul>
        </div>
      )}
      {reasons.length > 0 && (
        <div>
          <strong className="small">Assessment reasons</strong>
          <ul style={{ margin: 'var(--sp-1) 0 0', paddingLeft: '1.2rem' }}>
            {reasons.map((r, i) => <li key={i} className="small"><code>{r}</code> â€” {reasonLabel(r)}</li>)}
          </ul>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function FinalizeModal({ operation, assessment, onClose, onFinalized }) {
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [stale, setStale] = useState(false);

  const submit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (busy || stale) return;
    const trimmed = reason.trim();
    if (!trimmed) {
      setError('A reason is required for finalization.');
      return;
    }
    const digest = assessment?.evidence_digest;
    if (!digest) {
      setError('Current evidence digest is missing. Refresh the reconciliation assessment.');
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const payload = {
        reason: trimmed,
        evidence_digest: digest,
      };
      if (assessment.current_status) payload.expected_status = assessment.current_status;
      const res = await api.post(`/tickets/bulk-imports/${operation.id}/reconciliation/finalize/`, payload);
      onFinalized(res.data);
    } catch (err) {
      const status = err?.response?.status;
      const data = err?.response?.data;
      const code = data?.code;
      if (status === 409 || code === 'stale_evidence' || code === 'not_eligible' || code === 'conflict') {
        setStale(true);
        setError(parseApiError(err).global || 'Evidence changed or the operation is no longer eligible. Refresh and review the latest assessment before confirming again.');
        onFinalized(null, { stale: true, error: err });
        return;
      }
      setError(parseApiError(err).global || 'Finalization failed.');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal title={`Finalize import operation #${operation.id}`} size="lg" onClose={() => { if (!busy) onClose(); }}>
      <form onSubmit={submit} noValidate>
        <p className="muted small modal-intro">
          This is an explicit, audited administrative action. It does not create tickets, replay rows, or fabricate evidence.
          The backend will re-evaluate durable row evidence under lock before finalizing.
        </p>
        <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
          <div className="small"><strong>Current status:</strong> {STATUS_LABELS[assessment.current_status] || assessment.current_status}</div>
          <div className="small"><strong>Proposed status:</strong> {STATUS_LABELS[assessment.proposed_status] || assessment.proposed_status || 'â€”'}</div>
          <div className="small"><strong>Expected rows:</strong> {assessment.expected_row_count ?? 0}</div>
          <div className="small"><strong>Succeeded rows:</strong> {assessment.succeeded_outcome_count ?? 0}</div>
          <div className="small"><strong>Failed rows:</strong> {assessment.failed_outcome_count ?? 0}</div>
          <div className="small"><strong>Evidence digest:</strong> <code>{assessment.evidence_digest}</code></div>
        </div>
        {(assessment.counter_inconsistencies || []).length > 0 && (
          <div className="alert-warning" role="status" style={{ padding: 'var(--sp-2)', marginBottom: 'var(--sp-3)', border: '1px solid var(--border, #d0d7de)', borderRadius: 6 }}>
            <strong>Counter discrepancies will be recorded</strong>
            <div className="small">Finalization will use durable row evidence and may set stored counters to evidence-derived values. This is audited.</div>
          </div>
        )}
        {error && !( !reason.trim() && error === 'A reason is required for finalization.') && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>}
        {stale && (
          <div className="alert-warning" role="status" style={{ padding: 'var(--sp-2)', marginBottom: 'var(--sp-3)', border: '1px solid var(--border, #d0d7de)', borderRadius: 6 }}>
            The assessment is stale or no longer eligible. Review the refreshed assessment before taking any further action. Do not resubmit with an old digest.
          </div>
        )}
        <Field label="Reason for finalization" required error={!reason.trim() && error === 'A reason is required for finalization.' ? error : ''}>
          <textarea
            className="input"
            rows={4}
            value={reason}
            onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
            disabled={busy || stale}
            aria-label="Reason for finalization"
            placeholder="Explain why this operation is being finalized"
          />
        </Field>
        <div className="row-end">
          <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={onClose} disabled={busy}>Cancel</button>
          <button type="submit" className="btn-primary" disabled={busy || stale}>
            {busy ? 'Finalizingâ€¦' : 'Confirm finalization'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}

export function TicketBulkImportDetailPage({ id }) {
  const { isStaff } = useAuth();
  const [operation, setOperation] = useState(null);
  const [assessment, setAssessment] = useState(null);
  const [audit, setAudit] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [assessLoading, setAssessLoading] = useState(false);
  const [auditLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [assessError, setAssessError] = useState('');
  const [auditError, setAuditError] = useState('');
  const [showFinalize, setShowFinalize] = useState(false);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState('');

  const loadAll = useCallback(async ({ silent = false } = {}) => {
    if (!isStaff) return;
    if (!silent) setLoading(true);
    setError(''); setAssessError(''); setAuditError(''); setNotice('');
    try {
      const [opRes, assessRes, auditRes] = await Promise.all([
        api.get(`/tickets/bulk-imports/${id}/`),
        api.get(`/tickets/bulk-imports/${id}/reconciliation/`),
        api.get(`/tickets/bulk-imports/${id}/reconciliation/audit/`),
      ]);
      setOperation(opRes.data);
      setAssessment(assessRes.data);
      setAudit(Array.isArray(auditRes.data?.audit) ? auditRes.data.audit : []);
    } catch (e) {
      const msg = parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not load import operation.';
      setError(msg);
    } finally {
      if (!silent) setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [id, isStaff]);

  const refreshAssessment = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!isStaff) return;
    setAssessLoading(true); setAssessError('');
    try {
      const [opRes, assessRes, auditRes] = await Promise.all([
        api.get(`/tickets/bulk-imports/${id}/`),
        api.get(`/tickets/bulk-imports/${id}/reconciliation/`),
        api.get(`/tickets/bulk-imports/${id}/reconciliation/audit/`),
      ]);
      setOperation(opRes.data);
      setAssessment(assessRes.data);
      setAudit(Array.isArray(auditRes.data?.audit) ? auditRes.data.audit : []);
    } catch (e) {
      setAssessError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not refresh reconciliation assessment.');
    } finally {
      setAssessLoading(false);
    }
  }, [id, isStaff]);

  useEffect(() => { if (isStaff) loadAll(); else setLoading(false); }, [isStaff, loadAll]); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect

  if (!isStaff) {
    return <div className="access-denied" role="alert">You do not have permission to access this page.</div>;
  }

  if (loading) return <p className="page-loading" role="status"><span className="spinner" aria-hidden="true" />Loading import operationâ€¦</p>;
  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="page">
        <PageHeader title={`Import operation #${id}`} />
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>
        <p><a href="#/tickets/bulk-imports">Back to import operations</a></p>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (!operation) return null;

  const state = assessmentState(assessment);
  const canFinalize = state === 'eligible' && !assessLoading;

  const onFinalized = async (result, meta) => {
    if (meta?.stale) {
      setShowFinalize(false);
      setNotice('The finalization was not applied because evidence changed or the operation is no longer eligible. The latest assessment has been refreshed.');
      await refreshAssessment();
      return;
    }
    setShowFinalize(false);
    if (result?.idempotent) {
      setNotice('Operation was already finalized. Showing the current recorded state.');
    } else {
      setNotice('Finalization completed. The operation, assessment, and audit history have been refreshed.');
    }
    await refreshAssessment();
  };

  return (
    <div className="page">
      <PageHeader
        title={`Import operation #${operation.id}`}
        sub={(
          <span>
            <Badge kind="status" value={operation.status} label={STATUS_LABELS[operation.status] || operation.status} />{' '}
            <span className="muted small">User: {operation.user_email || operation.user || 'â€”'}</span>
          </span>
        )}
        actions={<a className="btn-ghost" href="#/tickets/bulk-imports">Back to operations</a>}
      />
      {notice && <div className="alert-warning" role="status" style={{ padding: 'var(--sp-2)', marginBottom: 'var(--sp-3)', border: '1px solid var(--border, #d0d7de)', borderRadius: 6 }}>{notice}</div>}
      {assessError && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{assessError}</div>}

      <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
        <h3>Operation details</h3>
        <div className="detail-grid" style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr))', gap: 'var(--sp-2)' }}>
          <div className="small"><strong>Status:</strong> {STATUS_LABELS[operation.status] || operation.status}</div>
          <div className="small"><strong>User:</strong> {operation.user_email || operation.user || 'â€”'}</div>
          <div className="small"><strong>Created:</strong> {fmtDate(operation.created_at)}</div>
          <div className="small"><strong>Started:</strong> {fmtDate(operation.started_at)}</div>
          <div className="small"><strong>Completed:</strong> {fmtDate(operation.completed_at)}</div>
          <div className="small"><strong>Expires:</strong> {fmtDate(operation.expires_at)}</div>
          <div className="small"><strong>Total rows:</strong> {operation.total_rows ?? 0}</div>
          <div className="small"><strong>Processed:</strong> {operation.processed_count ?? 0}</div>
          <div className="small"><strong>Successful:</strong> {operation.successful_count ?? 0}</div>
          <div className="small"><strong>Failed:</strong> {operation.failed_count ?? 0}</div>
          <div className="small"><strong>Result available:</strong> {operation.result_available ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</div>
          <div className="small"><strong>Stale processing:</strong> {operation.is_stale_processing ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</div>
        </div>
        {operation.error_detail ? <div className="small" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-2)' }}><strong>Error:</strong> {operation.error_detail}</div> : null}
      </div>

      <div className="panel panel-pad" style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
        <div className="row-gap" style={{ justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 'var(--sp-2)' }}>
          <h3 style={{ margin: 0 }}>Reconciliation assessment</h3>
          <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={refreshAssessment} disabled={assessLoading}>{assessLoading ? 'Refreshingâ€¦' : 'Refresh assessment'}</button>
        </div>
        {!assessment ? (
          <p className="muted">Assessment unavailable.</p>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="row-gap" style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--sp-2)', alignItems: 'center' }}>
              <strong>Eligibility:</strong>
              {state === 'eligible' && <span className="badge badge-green">Eligible for finalization</span>}
              {state === 'ineligible' && <span className="badge badge-red">Ineligible for finalization</span>}
              {state === 'already_finalized' && <span className="badge badge-blue">Already finalized</span>}
              {state === 'unavailable' && <span className="badge badge-gray">Assessment unavailable</span>}
            </div>
            <div className="detail-grid" style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr))', gap: 'var(--sp-2)', marginBottom: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
              <div className="small"><strong>Current status:</strong> {STATUS_LABELS[assessment.current_status] || assessment.current_status}</div>
              <div className="small"><strong>Proposed status:</strong> {STATUS_LABELS[assessment.proposed_status] || assessment.proposed_status || 'â€”'}</div>
              <div className="small"><strong>Expected rows:</strong> {assessment.expected_row_count ?? 0}</div>
              <div className="small"><strong>Actual outcomes:</strong> {assessment.actual_outcome_count ?? 0}</div>
              <div className="small"><strong>Succeeded:</strong> {assessment.succeeded_outcome_count ?? 0}</div>
              <div className="small"><strong>Failed:</strong> {assessment.failed_outcome_count ?? 0}</div>
              <div className="small"><strong>Unprocessed/unrecorded:</strong> {assessment.unprocessed_row_count ?? 0}</div>
              <div className="small"><strong>Result stored:</strong> {assessment.result_stored ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</div>
              <div className="small"><strong>Row-level evidence:</strong> {assessment.has_row_level_evidence ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</div>
              <div className="small"><strong>Stale processing:</strong> {assessment.is_stale_processing ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</div>
            </div>
            <div className="small" style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
              <strong>Evidence digest:</strong> <code title={assessment.evidence_digest}>{shortDigest(assessment.evidence_digest)}</code>
              {assessment.evidence_digest ? <span className="muted"> (used for confirmation binding)</span> : null}
            </div>
            <AssessmentWarnings assessment={assessment} />
            <div style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
              {canFinalize ? (
                <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={() => { setNotice(''); setShowFinalize(true); }}>
                  Finalize operation
                </button>
              ) : (
                <p className="muted small" style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>
                  {state === 'already_finalized'
                    ? 'This operation is already finalized. No further finalization action is available.'
                    : 'Finalization is unavailable because the backend assessment is not eligible.'}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="panel panel-pad">
        <h3>Finalization audit history</h3>
        {auditError ? <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{auditError}</div> : null}
        {auditLoading ? <LoadingRows n={3} /> : audit.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState title="No finalization audit records" hint="Finalization audit entries appear after a staff finalization action." />
        ) : (
          <div className="table-wrap">
            <table className="grid">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th>Time</th>
                  <th>Actor</th>
                  <th>Action</th>
                  <th>Outcome</th>
                  <th>State</th>
                  <th>Counts</th>
                  <th>Reason</th>
                  <th>Digest</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {audit.map((a) => (
                  <tr key={a.id}>
                    <td className="small">{fmtDate(a.timestamp)}</td>
                    <td className="small">{a.actor_email || a.actor || 'â€”'}</td>
                    <td className="small">{a.action || 'â€”'}</td>
                    <td className="small">{a.finalization_outcome || 'â€”'}</td>
                    <td className="small">{a.previous_operation_state || 'â€”'} â†’ {a.resulting_operation_state || 'â€”'}</td>
                    <td className="small">exp {a.expected_row_count ?? 'â€”'} / ok {a.succeeded_row_count ?? 'â€”'} / failed {a.failed_row_count ?? 'â€”'}</td>
                    <td className="small">{a.reason || 'â€”'}</td>
                    <td className="small"><code title={a.evidence_digest || ''}>{shortDigest(a.evidence_digest)}</code></td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {showFinalize && assessment && (
        <FinalizeModal
          operation={operation}
          assessment={assessment}
          onClose={() => setShowFinalize(false)}
          onFinalized={onFinalized}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\pages\tickets\TicketOperationsDashboard.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { Badge, Button, Input, Select, Alert, DataTable, EmptyState, PageHeader } from '../../components';
import { parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';

/**
 * Ticket Operations Dashboard Page
 * Route: #/tickets/operations
 */
export function TicketOperationsDashboard() {
  useAuth();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [, setError] = useState('');
  const [kpiActive, setKPIActive] = useState(0);
  const [kpiUnassigned, setKPIUnassigned] = useState(0);
  const [kpiInProgress, setKPIInProgress] = useState(0);
  const [kpiWaiting, setKPIWaiting] = useState(0);
  const [kpiSLABreach, setKPISLA] = useState(0);
  const [kpiUrgent, setKPIUrgent] = useState(0);
  const [queues, setQueues] = useState([]);
  const [filterQueue, setFilterQueue] = useState('');
  const [filterDept] = useState('');
  const [dateFrom, setDateFrom] = useState('');
  const [dateTo, setDateTo] = useState('');

  const fetchData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      let url = '/api/operations/';
      if (dateFrom) url += '?date_from=' + dateFrom;
      if (dateTo) url += (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '') + 'date_to=' + dateTo;
      if (filterQueue) url += (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '') + 'queue=' + filterQueue;
      if (filterDept) url += (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '') + 'department=' + filterDept;

      const r = await api.get(url);
      setKPIActive(r.data.active_tickets ?? 0);
      setKPIUnassigned(r.data.unassigned ?? 0);
      setKPIInProgress(r.data.in_progress ?? 0);
      setKPIWaiting(r.data.waiting_requester ?? 0);
      setKPISLA(r.data.sla_breached ?? 0);
      setKPIUrgent(r.data.urgent ?? 0);
      setQueues(r.data.queues ?? []);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Failed to load operations dashboard.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchData(); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
  }, [dateFrom, dateTo, filterQueue, filterDept]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  if (isEmployee) {
    return (
      <div className="py-4">
        <Alert variant="danger">
          Access denied. Employees cannot view operations dashboard.
        </Alert>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-4">
      <PageHeader title="Operations Dashboard" subtitle="Service desk metrics" />

      <div className="mb-4">
        <div className="row g-3">
          <div className="col-md-3">
            <Input placeholder="From" value={dateFrom} onChange={(e) => setDateFrom(e.target.value)} />
          </div>
          <div className="col-md-3">
            <Input placeholder="To" value={dateTo} onChange={(e) => setDateTo(e.target.value)} />
          </div>
          <div className="col-md-2">
            <Select
              label="Queue"
              value={filterQueue}
              onChange={(e) => setFilterQueue(e.target.value)}
            >
              <option value="">All queues</option>
              {queues.map(q => (
                <option key={q.id} value={q.code || q.id}>
                  {q.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </Select>
          </div>
          <div className="col-md-2">
            <Button onClick={() => fetchData()}>Refresh</Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="row mb-4">
        <div className="col-md-2">
          <Badge variant="primary">{kpiActive || 0}</Badge>
          <small>Active</small>
        </div>
        <div className="col-md-2">
          <Badge variant="secondary">{kpiUnassigned || 0}</Badge>
          <small>Unassigned</small>
        </div>
        <div className="col-md-2">
          <Badge variant="success">{kpiInProgress || 0}</Badge>
          <small>In Progress</small>
        </div>
        <div className="col-md-2">
          <Badge variant="info">{kpiWaiting || 0}</Badge>
          <small>Waiting Requester</small>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="row mb-4">
        <div className="col-md-2">
          <Badge variant="danger">{kpiSLABreach || 0}</Badge>
          <small>SLA Breached</small>
        </div>
        <div className="col-md-2">
          <Badge variant="warning">{kpiUrgent || 0}</Badge>
          <small>Urgent</small>
        </div>
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <p className="page-loading">Loading operations dashboard...</p>
      ) : kpiActive === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState icon="ðŸ“Š" title="No Data" text="Dashboard data will appear here." />
      ) : (
        <DataTable
          columns={[
            { key: 'name', label: 'Queue', render: (q) => <strong>{q.name}</strong> },
            { key: 'ticket_count', label: 'Tickets', render: (q) => q.ticket_count ?? 0 },
            { key: 'is_active', label: 'Status', render: (q) => (
              <Badge kind="status" value={q.is_active ? 'active' : 'inactive'}>
                {q.is_active ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'}
              </Badge>
            ) },
          ]}
          items={queues}
          pageSize={20}
          noDataText="No queues found"
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


===== src\pages\tickets\TicketQueuesPage.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { Badge, Button, Alert, DataTable, EmptyState, PageHeader } from '../../components';
import { parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';

export function TicketQueuesPage() {
  const { isEmployee } = useAuth();
  const [queues, setQueues] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [refresh, setRefresh] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      setError('');
      try {
        const r = await api.get('/tickets/queues/');
        if (!cancelled) setQueues(r.data.results ?? r.data ?? []);
      } catch (e) {
        if (!cancelled) setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Failed to load queues.');
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [refresh]);

  if (isEmployee) {
    return <div className="py-4"><Alert variant="danger">Access denied. Employees cannot manage queues.</Alert></div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-4">
      <PageHeader title="Ticket queues" subtitle="Operational queue configuration" />
      {error && <Alert variant="danger">{error}</Alert>}
      <div className="mb-3"><Button onClick={() => setRefresh((r) => r + 1)}>Refresh</Button></div>
      {loading ? (
        <p className="page-loading">Loading queues...</p>
      ) : queues.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState icon="ðŸ“‹" title="No queues" text="No queues are configured." />
      ) : (
        <DataTable
          columns={[
            { key: 'name', label: 'Queue', render: (q) => <strong>{q.name}</strong> },
            { key: 'is_active', label: 'Status', render: (q) => <Badge kind="status" value={q.is_active ? 'active' : 'inactive'}>{q.is_active ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'}</Badge> },
          ]}
          items={queues}
          pageSize={20}
          noDataText="No queues found"
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\pages\tickets\Tickets.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import {
  AssetSelect, Badge, CategorySelect, ConfirmDialog, DepartmentSelect, ErrorSummary,
  Field, PageHeader, UserSelect,
} from '../../components';
import { fieldMsg, parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';

const PRIORITIES = ['low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical'];
const STATUSES = ['open', 'in_progress', 'resolved', 'closed', 'reopened', 'archived'];

// Mirrors Ticket.VALID_TRANSITIONS in backend/tickets/models.py so the
// dropdown only offers moves the server accepts. The backend stays the
// authority (it still returns a 400 for anything invalid) - this just
// stops the UI from advertising rejected options.
const VALID_TRANSITIONS = {
  open: ["in_progress", "waiting_requester", "waiting_third_party", "resolved", "closed", "cancelled", "merged", "archived"],
  in_progress: ["waiting_requester", "waiting_third_party", "resolved", "closed", "cancelled", "merged", "open", "archived"],
  waiting_requester: ["in_progress", "resolved", "cancelled", "merged"],
  waiting_third_party: ["in_progress", "waiting_requester", "resolved", "closed", "cancelled", "merged"],
  resolved: ["closed", "reopened", "merged"],
  closed: ["reopened", "archived", "merged"],
  reopened: ["in_progress", "resolved", "closed"],
  cancelled: [],
  merged: [],
  archived: [],
};

export function TicketForm({ id }) {
  const { user, isStaff, canCreateTickets } = useAuth();
  const isEdit = !!id;
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(isEdit);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState('');
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    title: '', description: '', priority: 'medium', category: '',
    department: '', on_behalf_reason: '', asset: '', assignee: '', status: 'open',
    resolution_notes: '',
  });
  const [kbSuggestions, setKbSuggestions] = useState([]);
  const kbSearchTimer = useRef(null);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState({});
  const [globalError, setGlobalError] = useState('');
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [okMsg, setOkMsg] = useState('');
  // Status the ticket had when the form loaded; the status dropdown only
  // offers this state plus its valid successors (create starts at open).
  const [initialStatus, setInitialStatus] = useState('open');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isEdit) {
      if (user?.home_department) setForm((f) => ({ ...f, department: user.home_department })); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
      return;
    }
    let active = true;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    (async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      try {
        const r = await api.get(`/tickets/${id}/`, { signal: controller.signal });
        if (!active) return;
        const t = r.data;
        setInitialStatus(t.status ?? 'open');
        setForm({
          title: t.title ?? '', description: t.description ?? '',
          priority: t.priority ?? 'medium', category: t.category ?? '',
          department: t.department ?? '', on_behalf_reason: t.on_behalf_reason ?? '',
          asset: t.asset ?? '', assignee: t.assignee ?? '', status: t.status ?? 'open',
          resolution_notes: t.resolution_notes ?? '',
        });
      } catch (e) {
        if (active && !controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoadError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not load ticket.');
        }
      } finally {
        if (active) setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      active = false;
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, [id, isEdit, user]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => setOkMsg('');
  }, []);

  const set = (k) => (v) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [k]: v }));
  const crossDept = user?.home_department && form.department && Number(form.department) !== Number(user.home_department);

  // Debounced KB article search while typing title/description.
  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    if (!isEdit) {
      clearTimeout(kbSearchTimer.current);
      kbSearchTimer.current = setTimeout(async () => {
        const query = (form.title.trim() + ' ' + form.description.trim()).trim();
        if (query.length < 3) {
          if (active) setKbSuggestions([]);
          return;
        }
        try {
          const r = await api.get('/assets/knowledge-base/', {
            params: { q: query, page_size: 5 },
            signal: controller.signal,
          });
          if (active) setKbSuggestions(r.data.results ?? r.data ?? []);
        } catch {
          if (active && !controller.signal.aborted) setKbSuggestions([]);
        }
      }, 300);
    }
    return () => {
      active = false;
      clearTimeout(kbSearchTimer.current);
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, [form.title, form.description, isEdit]);

  const submit = async (ev) => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    if (submitting) return;
    setFieldErrors({});
    setGlobalError('');
    setOkMsg('');
    const payload = {
      title: form.title.trim(),
      description: form.description.trim(),
      department: form.department === '' ? null : Number(form.department),
    };
    // Priority/category are settable by anyone at creation, but on edit
    // they are staff-only server-side: non-staff simply omit them (the
    // controls are disabled) so the request can never trip the 403.
    if (!isEdit || isStaff) {
      payload.priority = form.priority;
      payload.category = form.category === '' ? null : Number(form.category);
    }
    if (!isEdit) {
      if (form.on_behalf_reason.trim()) payload.on_behalf_reason = form.on_behalf_reason.trim();
      if (form.asset !== '') payload.asset = Number(form.asset);
      if (isStaff && form.assignee !== '') payload.assignee = Number(form.assignee);
    } else {
      payload.on_behalf_reason = form.on_behalf_reason;
      payload.asset = form.asset === '' ? null : Number(form.asset);
      if (isStaff) {
        payload.assignee = form.assignee === '' ? null : Number(form.assignee);
        payload.status = form.status;
        payload.resolution_notes = form.resolution_notes;
      }
    }
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const res = isEdit
        ? await api.patch(`/tickets/${id}/`, payload)
        : await api.post('/tickets/', payload);
      setOkMsg(isEdit ? 'Ticket updated.' : 'Ticket created.');
      location.hash = `#/tickets/${res.data.id}`;
    } catch (e) {
      const p = parseApiError(e);
      setFieldErrors(p.fields);
      setGlobalError(p.global);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  if (!isEdit && !canCreateTickets) {
    return (
      <div className="form-wrap">
        <h1>New ticket</h1>
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">
          Ticket creation is disabled for your account. Contact an administrator.
        </div>
        <p><a className="back-link" href="#/tickets">â† Back to tickets</a></p>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <p className="page-loading" role="status">
        <span className="spinner" aria-hidden="true" />Loading ticketâ€¦
      </p>
    );
  }
  if (loadError) {
    return (
      <div className="form-wrap">
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{loadError}</div>
        <p><a className="back-link" href="#/tickets">â† Back to tickets</a></p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="form-wrap">
      <PageHeader
        title={isEdit ? `Edit ticket #${id}` : 'New ticket'}
        sub={isEdit ? undefined : 'Fields marked * are required.'}
        actions={
          <a className="back-link" href={isEdit ? `#/tickets/${id}` : '#/tickets'}>
            â† {isEdit ? `Back to ticket #${id}` : 'Back to tickets'}
          </a>
        }
      />
      <ErrorSummary parsed={{ global: globalError }} />
      {okMsg && <div className="success-summary" role="status">{okMsg}</div>}
      <form onSubmit={submit} noValidate>
        <Field label="Subject" required error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'title')}>
          <input className="input" value={form.title} onChange={(e) => set('title')(e.target.value)} placeholder="Brief summary of the issue" disabled={submitting} maxLength={255} />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Description" required error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'description')}>
          <textarea className="input" rows={5} value={form.description} onChange={(e) => set('description')(e.target.value)} placeholder="Steps to reproduce, impact, environmentâ€¦" disabled={submitting} />
        </Field>
        <div className="form-grid">
          <Field
            label="Priority" required error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'priority')}
            hint={isEdit && !isStaff ? 'Only IT staff can change priority.' : undefined}
          >
            <select
              className="input" value={form.priority}
              onChange={(e) => set('priority')(e.target.value)}
              disabled={submitting || (isEdit && !isStaff)}
            >
              {PRIORITIES.map((p) => <option key={p} value={p}>{p[0].toUpperCase() + p.slice(1)}</option>)}
            </select>
          </Field>
          <Field
            label="Category" required error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'category')}
            hint={isEdit && !isStaff ? 'Only IT staff can change the category.' : undefined}
          >
            <CategorySelect
              kind="ticket" value={form.category} onChange={set('category')}
              disabled={submitting || (isEdit && !isStaff)}
            />
          </Field>
        </div>
        <div className="form-grid">
          <Field label="Department" error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'department')} hint="Defaults to your home department.">
            <DepartmentSelect value={form.department} onChange={set('department')} disabled={submitting} />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Related asset (optional)" error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'asset')}>
            <AssetSelect value={form.asset} onChange={set('asset')} disabled={submitting} />
          </Field>
        </div>
        {!isEdit && kbSuggestions.length > 0 && (
          <Field label="Related knowledge-base articles">
            <p className="muted small">
              Published articles that may help (click to open in a new tab):
            </p>
            <div className="row-gap" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 'var(--sp-1)' }}>
              {kbSuggestions.map((a) => (
                <button
                  key={a.id}
                  type="button"
                  className="btn-ghost btn-small"
                  onClick={() => window.open(`#/kb/${a.id}`, '_blank')}
                >
                  {a.title}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </Field>
        )}
        {(crossDept || form.on_behalf_reason) && (
          <Field
            label="On-behalf-of reason"
            required={!!crossDept}
            error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'on_behalf_reason')}
            hint="Required when filing for a department other than your own."
          >
            <textarea className="input" rows={2} value={form.on_behalf_reason} onChange={(e) => set('on_behalf_reason')(e.target.value)} disabled={submitting} />
          </Field>
        )}
        {isStaff && (
          <div className="form-grid">
            <Field label="Assignee" error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'assignee')}>
              <UserSelect value={form.assignee} onChange={set('assignee')} disabled={submitting} />
            </Field>
            {isEdit && (
              <Field
                label="Status" error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'status')}
                hint="Only valid next states are listed; the server still verifies the transition."
              >
                <select className="input" value={form.status} onChange={(e) => set('status')(e.target.value)} disabled={submitting}>
                  {STATUSES
                    .filter((s) => s === form.status
                      || s === initialStatus
                      || (VALID_TRANSITIONS[initialStatus] || []).includes(s))
                    .map((s) => <option key={s} value={s}>{s.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</option>)}
                </select>
              </Field>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
        {isStaff && isEdit && (form.status === 'resolved' || form.status === 'closed' || form.resolution_notes) && (
          <Field
            label="Resolution notes" error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'resolution_notes')}
            hint="Recorded when resolving or closing. Preserved on unrelated edits."
          >
            <textarea className="input" rows={3} value={form.resolution_notes} onChange={(e) => set('resolution_notes')(e.target.value)} placeholder="What fixed it, and any follow-upâ€¦" disabled={submitting} />
          </Field>
        )}
        <div className="row-end">
          <a className="btn-ghost" href={isEdit ? `#/tickets/${id}` : '#/tickets'}>Cancel</a>
          <button type="submit" className="btn-primary" disabled={submitting}>
            {submitting ? 'Savingâ€¦' : isEdit ? 'Save changes' : 'Create ticket'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Keep only this ticket's attachment rows. The list endpoint can return
 * rows for every ticket when the `ticket` filter is not honored server-side;
 * a detail page must never list (or offer to download) another ticket's file.
 * Explicit ticket ownership is enforced when present; orphaned rows
 * (`ticket: null`) are never shown. */
function onlyTicketAttachments(rows, ticketId) {
  const list = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : [];
  const want = Number(ticketId);
  return list.filter((a) => {
    if (a?.ticket == null) return typeof a?.ticket === 'undefined';
    return Number(a.ticket) === want;
  });
}

export function TicketDetail({ id }) {
  const { isStaff, user } = useAuth();
  const [ticket, setTicket] = useState(null);
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState([]);
  const [history, setHistory] = useState(null);
  const [kbArticles, setKbArticles] = useState([]);
  const [approvals, setApprovals] = useState([]);
  const [executions, setExecutions] = useState(isStaff ? [] : null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [noteBody, setNoteBody] = useState('');
  const [noteInternal, setNoteInternal] = useState(false);
  const [noteBusy, setNoteBusy] = useState(false);
  const [noteError, setNoteError] = useState('');
  const [confirmingDelete, setConfirmingDelete] = useState(false);
  const [deleteBusy, setDeleteBusy] = useState(false);
  const [attachments, setAttachments] = useState([]);
  const [uploadFile, setUploadFile] = useState(null);
  const [uploadBusy, setUploadBusy] = useState(false);
  const [uploadError, setUploadError] = useState('');
  const [uploadMsg, setUploadMsg] = useState('');
  const [dlBusy, setDlBusy] = useState(null);
  const [dlError, setDlError] = useState({});
  const [attToDelete, setAttToDelete] = useState(null);
  const [attBusy, setAttBusy] = useState(false);
  const [newKbSlug, setNewKbSlug] = useState('');
  const [kbLinkBusy] = useState(false);
  const [, setWatchers] = useState([]);

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const t = (await api.get(`/tickets/${id}/`)).data;
      setTicket(t);
      try {
        setNotes((await api.get(`/tickets/${id}/notes/`)).data ?? []);
      } catch { setNotes([]); }
      try {
        const at = await api.get('/tickets/attachments/', { params: { ticket: id } });
        setAttachments(onlyTicketAttachments(at.data.results ?? at.data, id));
      } catch { setAttachments([]); }
      try {
        setWatchers((await api.get(`/tickets/${id}/watchers/`)).data ?? []);
      } catch { setWatchers([]); }
      if (isStaff) {
        try {
          const h = await api.get('/tickets/histories/', { params: { ticket: id } });
          setHistory(h.data.results ?? h.data ?? []);
        } catch { setHistory(null); }
      }
      try {
        const k = await api.get('/tickets/kb-articles/', { params: { ticket: id } });
        setKbArticles(k.data.results ?? k.data ?? []);
      } catch { setKbArticles([]); }
      try {
        const ap = await api.get('/workflow/approval-requests/', { params: { ticket: id } });
        setApprovals(ap.data.results ?? ap.data ?? []);
      } catch { setApprovals([]); }
      if (isStaff) {
        try {
          const ex = await api.get('/workflow/rule-executions/', {
            params: { ticket: id, page_size: 10 },
          });
          setExecutions(ex.data.results ?? ex.data ?? []);
        } catch { setExecutions([]); }
      } else {
        setExecutions(null);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not load ticket.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [id]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, react/set-state-in-effect

  const addNote = async (ev) => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    if (noteBusy || !noteBody.trim()) return;
    setNoteBusy(true);
    setNoteError('');
    try {
      const r = await api.post(`/tickets/${id}/notes/`, {
        body: noteBody.trim(),
        is_internal: isStaff ? noteInternal : false,
      });
      setNotes((n) => [...n, r.data]);
      setNoteBody('');
    } catch (e) {
      setNoteError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not add note.');
    } finally {
      setNoteBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const doDelete = async () => {
    setDeleteBusy(true);
    try {
      await api.delete(`/tickets/${id}/`);
      location.hash = '#/tickets';
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not delete ticket.');
      setConfirmingDelete(false);
    } finally {
      setDeleteBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const reloadAttachments = async () => {
    try {
      const at = await api.get('/tickets/attachments/', { params: { ticket: id } });
      setAttachments(onlyTicketAttachments(at.data.results ?? at.data, id));
    } catch {
      setAttachments([]);
    }
  };

  const doUpload = async (ev) => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    if (uploadBusy || !uploadFile) return;
    setUploadBusy(true);
    setUploadError('');
    setUploadMsg('');
    try {
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('ticket', id);
      fd.append('file', uploadFile);
      const r = await api.post('/tickets/attachments/', fd);
      setUploadFile(null);
      setUploadMsg(`Uploaded "${r.data.original_filename || 'file'}".`);
      await reloadAttachments();
    } catch (e) {
      const p = parseApiError(e);
      setUploadError(p.global || p.fields.file || 'Upload failed.');
    } finally {
      setUploadBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const doDownload = async (f) => {
    if (dlBusy) return;
    setDlBusy(f.id);
    setDlError((d) => ({ ...d, [f.id]: '' }));
    try {
      const r = await api.get(`/tickets/attachments/${f.id}/download/`, {
        responseType: 'blob',
      });
      const cd = r.headers?.['content-disposition'] || '';
      const m = cd.match(/filename="([^"]+)"/);
      const name = (m && m[1]) || f.original_filename || `attachment-${f.id}`;
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(r.data);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = name;
      // Same-origin blob URL: never let the synthetic link gain an opener.
      a.rel = 'noopener';
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      a.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 5000);
    } catch (e) {
      const msg = e?.response?.status === 410
        ? 'File is missing from storage.'
        : e?.response?.status === 404
          ? 'Attachment not available (deleted or no access).'
          : 'Download failed.';
      setDlError((d) => ({ ...d, [f.id]: msg }));
    } finally {
      setDlBusy(null);
    }
  };

  const doDeleteAttachment = async () => {
    if (!attToDelete || attBusy) return;
    setAttBusy(true);
    try {
      await api.delete(`/tickets/attachments/${attToDelete.id}/`);
      setAttToDelete(null);
      await reloadAttachments();
    } catch (e) {
      setUploadError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not delete attachment.');
      setAttToDelete(null);
    } finally {
      setAttBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const voteKb = async (linkId, helpful) => {
    try {
      await api.patch(`/tickets/kb-articles/${linkId}/`, { helpful });
      setKbArticles(kbArticles.map((l) => l.id === linkId ? { ...l, helpful } : l));
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not record feedback.');
    }
  };

  const unlinkKb = async (linkId) => {
    if (!confirm('Unlink this KB article from the ticket?')) return;
    try {
      await api.delete(`/tickets/kb-articles/${linkId}/`);
      setKbArticles(kbArticles.filter((l) => l.id !== linkId));
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not unlink article.');
    }
  };

  const linkKb = async (ev) => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    if (kbLinkBusy || !newKbSlug.trim()) return;
    setKbLinkBusy(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      await api.post('/tickets/kb-articles/', { article: newKbSlug.trim(), ticket: id });
      setNewKbSlug('');
      // reload to get the full link with article details
      const k = await api.get('/tickets/kb-articles/', { params: { ticket: id } });
      setKbArticles(k.data.results ?? k.data ?? []);
    } catch (e) {
      const p = parseApiError(e);
      setError(p.global || 'Could not link article.');
    } finally {
      setKbLinkBusy(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <p className="page-loading" role="status">
        <span className="spinner" aria-hidden="true" />Loading ticketâ€¦
      </p>
    );
  }
  if (error && !ticket) {
    return (
      <div className="detail-wrap">
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>
        <p><a className="back-link" href="#/tickets">â† Back to tickets</a></p>
      </div>
    );
  }
  const t = ticket;
  return (
    <div className="detail-wrap">
      <a className="back-link" href="#/tickets">â† Tickets</a>
      {error && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>}
      <div className="detail-head">
        <div>
          <h1>#{t.id} {t.title}</h1>
          <div className="row-gap detail-badges">
            <Badge kind="status" value={t.status} />
            <Badge kind="priority" value={t.priority} />
            {t.is_overdue && <Badge kind="status" value="overdue" label="Overdue" />}
            {t.sla_breached && !t.is_overdue && <Badge kind="status" value="overdue" label="SLA breached" />}
            <span className="muted small">{t.category_name ?? ''}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="row-gap">
          <a className="btn-secondary" href={`#/tickets/${t.id}/edit`}>Edit</a>
          {isStaff && <button type="button" className="btn-danger" onClick={() => setConfirmingDelete(true)}>Deleteâ€¦</button>}
        </div>
      </div>
      <dl className="detail-grid">
        <dt>Department</dt><dd>{t.department_name ?? t.department ?? 'â€”'}</dd>
        <dt>Requester</dt><dd>{t.requester_email ?? t.requester}</dd>
        <dt>Assignee</dt><dd>{t.assignee_email ?? (t.assignee ? `#${t.assignee}` : 'Unassigned')}</dd>
        <dt>Asset</dt>
        <dd>
          {t.asset ? <a href={`#/assets/${t.asset}`}>Asset #{t.asset}</a> : 'â€”'}
        </dd>
        <dt>Created</dt><dd>{t.created_at ? new Date(t.created_at).toLocaleString() : 'â€”'}</dd>
        <dt>SLA due</dt><dd>{t.sla_due_at ? new Date(t.sla_due_at).toLocaleString() : 'No SLA target'}</dd>
        <dt>SLA status</dt>
        <dd>
          {!t.sla_due_at ? <span className="muted">â€”</span>
            : t.sla_breached ? <Badge kind="status" value="overdue" label="Breached" />
              : ['resolved', 'closed', 'archived'].includes(t.status)
                ? <Badge kind="status" value="resolved" label="Met" />
                : <Badge kind="status" value="open" label="On track" />}
        </dd>
        {t.resolved_at && <><dt>Resolved</dt><dd>{new Date(t.resolved_at).toLocaleString()}</dd></>}
        {t.closed_at && <><dt>Closed</dt><dd>{new Date(t.closed_at).toLocaleString()}</dd></>}
      </dl>
      {t.on_behalf_reason && (
        <section className="section">
          <h4>On-behalf-of reason</h4>
          <p>{t.on_behalf_reason}</p>
        </section>
      )}
      <section className="section">
        <h4>Description</h4>
        <p className="pre-wrap">{t.description}</p>
      </section>
      {t.resolution_notes && (
        <section className="section">
          <h4>Resolution notes</h4>
          <p className="pre-wrap">{t.resolution_notes}</p>
        </section>
      )}

      <section className="section">
        <h4>Notes</h4>
        {notes.length === 0 ? <p className="muted">No notes yet.</p> : (
          <ul className="note-list">
            {notes.map((n) => (
              <li key={n.id}>
                <div className="muted small">{n.author_email ?? `#${n.author}`} Â· {n.created_at ? new Date(n.created_at).toLocaleString() : ''}{n.is_internal ? ' Â· internal' : ''}</div>
                <div className="pre-wrap">{n.body}</div>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
        <form onSubmit={addNote} className="note-form">
          <textarea className="input" rows={3} value={noteBody} onChange={(e) => setNoteBody(e.target.value)} placeholder="Add an updateâ€¦" disabled={noteBusy} aria-label="Note body" />
          {isStaff && user?.role !== 'employee' && (
            <label className="check-row">
              <input type="checkbox" checked={noteInternal} onChange={(e) => setNoteInternal(e.target.checked)} disabled={noteBusy} />
              Internal note (hidden from employees)
            </label>
          )}
          {noteError && <div className="field-error" role="alert">{noteError}</div>}
          <div className="row-end">
            <button type="submit" className="btn-secondary" disabled={noteBusy || !noteBody.trim()}>
              {noteBusy ? 'Addingâ€¦' : 'Add note'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </section>

      <section className="section">
        <h4>Attachments</h4>
        {isStaff && (
          <form onSubmit={doUpload} className="upload-row">
            <input
              type="file" onChange={(e) => setUploadFile(e.target.files?.[0] ?? null)}
              disabled={uploadBusy} aria-label="Choose a file to upload"
            />
            <button type="submit" className="btn-secondary" disabled={uploadBusy || !uploadFile}>
              {uploadBusy ? 'Uploadingâ€¦' : 'Upload'}
            </button>
          </form>
        )}
        {uploadError && <div className="field-error" role="alert">{uploadError}</div>}
        {uploadMsg && <div className="success-summary" role="status">{uploadMsg}</div>}
        {attachments.length === 0 ? <p className="muted">No attachments.</p> : (
          <ul className="file-list">

                <div className="file-main">
                  <div className="file-name">{f.original_filename || `File #${f.id}`}</div>
                  <div className="file-meta">
                    {f.created_at ? new Date(f.created_at).toLocaleString() : ''}
                  </div>

                  <button
                    type="button" className="btn-small"

        {attToDelete && (
          <ConfirmDialog
            title="Delete attachment?"

            confirmLabel="Delete attachment" danger busy={attBusy}
            onConfirm={doDeleteAttachment}
            onCancel={() => setAttToDelete(null)}
          />
        )}
      </section>

      {isStaff && history !== null && (
        <section className="section">

                      />

                      {ex.detail ? ` Â· ${ex.detail}` : ''}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="file-actions">
                    <a className="btn-small" href={`#/workflow/executions/${ex.id}`}>View run</a>
                  </div>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </section>
      )}

      {kbArticles.length > 0 && (
        <section className="section">
          <h4>Related knowledge-base articles</h4>
          <ul className="file-list">
            {kbArticles.map((link) => (
              <li key={link.id} className="file-row">
                <div className="file-main">
                  <div className="file-name">
                    <a href={`#/kb/${link.article_id}`}>{link.article_title}</a>
                  </div>
                  <div className="file-meta">
                    {link.article_status ? link.article_status.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + link.article_status.slice(1) : ''} Â· linked {link.linked_at ? new Date(link.linked_at).toLocaleDateString() : ''}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="file-actions">
                  {link.helpful === null && !isStaff && (
                    <div className="row-gap" style={{ gap: 'var(--sp-1)' }}>
                      <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => voteKb(link.id, true)}>Helped</button>
                      <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => voteKb(link.id, false)}>Not helpful</button>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {link.helpful !== null && !isStaff && (
                    <span className="badge badge-gray">
                      You voted {link.helpful ? 'helped' : 'not helpful'}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  {isStaff && (
                    <button
                      type="button" className="btn-small btn-danger"
                      onClick={() => unlinkKb(link.id)}
                      aria-label={`Unlink article ${link.article_title}`}
                    >
                      Unlink
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          {isStaff && (
            <form onSubmit={linkKb} className="form-grid" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-2)' }}>
              <Field label="Link KB article">
                <input className="input" type="text" value={newKbSlug} onChange={(e) => setNewKbSlug(e.target.value)} placeholder="Article slug (e.g. vpn-reset)" disabled={kbLinkBusy} />
              </Field>
              <button type="submit" className="btn-secondary" disabled={kbLinkBusy || !newKbSlug.trim()}>Link article</button>
            </form>
          )}
        </section>
      )}

      {confirmingDelete && (
        <ConfirmDialog
          title={`Delete ticket #${t.id}?`}
          message="This soft-deletes the ticket (it moves to the Recycle Bin and can be restored by a System Admin). History is preserved."
          confirmLabel="Delete ticket"
          danger
          busy={deleteBusy}
          onConfirm={doDelete}
          onCancel={() => setConfirmingDelete(false)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\pages\tickets\TicketTemplatesPage.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { Button, Input, Select, Alert, DataTable, EmptyState, PageHeader } from '../../components';
import { parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';

/** Ticket Templates Management Page
 * Route: #/tickets/templates
 */
export function TicketTemplatesPage() {
  useAuth();
  const [templates, setTemplates] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [, setError] = useState('');
  const [filterCategory, setFilterCategory] = useState('');
  const [activeOnly, setActiveOnly] = useState(true);
  const [page] = useState(1);
  const [pageSize] = useState(20);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);

  const fetchTemplates = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      let url = '/api/templates/';
      if (filterCategory) url += '?category=' + filterCategory;
      if (activeOnly) url += (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '') + 'is_active=true';
      if (searchQuery) url += (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '') + 'q=' + searchQuery;
      url += '&page=' + page + '&page_size=' + pageSize;
      const r = await api.get(url);
      setTemplates(r.data.results ?? r.data ?? []);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Failed to load templates.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchTemplates(); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
  }, [filterCategory, activeOnly, searchQuery, page, pageSize]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  if (isEmployee) {
    return <div className="py-4"><Alert variant="danger">Employees cannot manage ticket templates.</Alert></div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-4">
      <PageHeader title="Ticket Templates" subtitle="Manage shared and personal templates" />
      <div className="mb-4">
        <Select label="Category" value={filterCategory} onChange={(e) => setFilterCategory(e.target.value)}>
          <option value="">All categories</option>
          <option value="general">General</option>
          <option value="hardware">Hardware</option>
          <option value="software">Software</option>
        </Select>
        <Select label="Active only" checked={activeOnly} onChange={(e) => setActiveOnly(e.target.checked)}>
          <option value="true">Active only</option>
          <option value="false">All</option>
        </Select>
        <Input placeholder="Search..." value={searchQuery} onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)} />
      </div>

      {creating ? (
        <div className="mb-4">
          <PageHeader title="Create Template" subtitle="Creating new ticket template" />
          <div className="row g-3">
            <Input placeholder="Template name" />
            <Input placeholder="Description" rows={2} />
          </div>
          <Button onClick={() => setCreating(false)}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => setCreating(false)}>Save</Button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div>
          {loading ? (
            <p className="page-loading">Loading templates...</p>
          ) : templates.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState icon="ðŸ“‹" title="No Templates" text="No ticket templates found." />
          ) : (
            <DataTable
              items={templates}
              pageSize={pageSize}
              columns={[
                { key: 'name', label: 'Name', render: (t) => <strong>{t.name}</strong> },
                { key: 'category', label: 'Category', render: (t) => t.category_name ?? '-' },
                { key: 'usage_count', label: 'Uses', render: (t) => t.usage_count ?? 0 },
                { key: 'actions', label: 'Actions', render: () => (
                  <div className="row-gap">
                    <Button variant="secondary" size="small">Edit</Button>
                    <Button variant="danger" size="small">Delete</Button>
                  </div>
                ) }
              ]}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {creating && (
        <div className="mt-4">
          <Button onClick={() => setCreating(false)}>Cancel creating</Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\pages\vendors\VendorsPage.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth';
import { useTableColumns, useSort } from '../../components';
import { Badge, Field, LoadingRows, DataTable, Pager, PageHeader, ConfirmDialog, AccessDenied, PageSizeSelector } from '../../components';

/** Vendor list page with server-side data, search, filter, sorting, pagination. */
function VendorsPage() {
  const { isStaff, isAdmin, canManageVendors } = useAuth();
  // Page-size preference persisted in localStorage; fall back to DRF default 20.
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 20;
    try {
      const saved = window.localStorage.getItem('itdesk.pageSize');
      const n = Number(saved);
      return saved && Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 && n <= 100 ? n : 20;
    } catch {
      return 20;
    }
  });
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [count, setCount] = useState(null);
  const [next, setNext] = useState(null);
  const [previous, setPrevious] = useState(null);
