      const r = await api.get(`/accounts/users/${userId}/photo/`, {
        responseType: 'blob',
      });
      const cd = r.headers?.['content-disposition'] || '';
      const m = cd.match(/filename="([^"]+)"/);
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(r.data);
      setEmpPhotoPreviewUrl((prev) => {
        if (prev) URL.revokeObjectURL(prev);
        return url;
      });
      setEmpPhotoPreviewName((m && m[1]) || `photo-${userId}`);
    } catch (e) {
      setEmpPhotoPreviewError(
        e?.response?.status === 403
          ? 'You do not have permission to preview this photo.'
          : 'Photo preview failed.',
      );
    } finally {
      setEmpPhotoPreviewBusyId(null);
    }
  };
  const closeEmployeePhotoPreview = () => {
    setEmpPhotoPreviewUrl((url) => {
      if (url) URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      return null;
    });
    setEmpPhotoPreviewName('');
    setEmpPhotoPreviewError('');
  };
  const doActivate = async () => {
    if (!confirmUser || rowBusy) return;
    setRowBusy(confirmUser.user.id);
    try {
      await api.post(
        `/accounts/users/${confirmUser.user.id}/${confirmUser.activate ? 'reactivate' : 'deactivate'}/`, {});
      setMsg(`User "${confirmUser.user.employee_id}" ${confirmUser.activate ? 'reactivated' : 'deactivated'}.`);
      setConfirmUser(null);
      refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      setErr(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not update user.');
      setConfirmUser(null);
    } finally {
      setRowBusy(null);
    }
  };
  const openRoleModal = (u) => {
    setRoleForm({ role: u.role, can_create_tickets: u.can_create_tickets !== false });
    setRoleError('');
    setRoleTarget(u);
  };
  const doChangeRole = async (ev) => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    if (!roleTarget || roleBusy) return;
    setRoleBusy(true);
    setRoleError('');
    try {
      await api.post(`/accounts/users/${roleTarget.id}/change_role/`, {
        role: roleForm.role, can_create_tickets: roleForm.can_create_tickets,
      });
      setMsg(`Role for "${roleTarget.employee_id}" updated.`);
      setRoleTarget(null);
      refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      const p = parseApiError(e);
      setRoleError(p.global || p.fields.role || 'Could not change role.');
    } finally {
      setRoleBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const openResetModal = (u) => {
    setResetTarget(u);
  };
  const filtersActive = !!(f.q || f.department || f.role || f.status);
  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Employees"
        sub={count != null ? `${count} accounts` : 'Directory, creation, and bulk import.'}
        actions={<>
          {isStaff && <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={() => setShowCreate(true)}>+ Add employee</button>}
          {isStaff && <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={() => setShowImport(true)}>Bulk importâ€¦</button>}
          {isStaff && <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={() => setExportOpen(true)}>Exportâ€¦</button>}
        </>} />
        {isStaff && selUsers.size > 0 && (
          <div className="toolbar" role="toolbar" aria-label="Bulk actions">
            <span className="muted small">{selUsers.size} selected</span>
            <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => prepareBulk('activate')} disabled={bulkBusy}>
              Activate selected
            </button>
            <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => prepareBulk('deactivate')} disabled={bulkBusy}>
              Deactivate selected
            </button>
            <button type="button" className="btn-small btn-danger" onClick={() => prepareBulk('delete')} disabled={bulkBusy}>
              Delete selected
            </button>
            <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => setSelUsers(new Set())}>Clear</button>
          </div>
        )}
      {err && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{err}</div>}
      {msg && <div className="success-summary" role="status">{msg}</div>}
      <div className="filter-bar" role="search">
        <div className="field-inline grow">
          <div className="caption">Search</div>
          <input
            className="input" value={f.q}
            onChange={(e) => setF((prev) => ({ ...prev, q: e.target.value }))}
            placeholder="Employee ID, name, or emailâ€¦" aria-label="Search employees"
          />
        </div>
        <div className="field-inline">
          <div className="caption">Department</div>
          <DepartmentSelect
            value={f.department ?? ''}
            onChange={(v) => setF((prev) => ({ ...prev, department: v ?? '' }))}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="field-inline">
          <div className="caption">Role</div>
          <select
            className="input" value={f.role}
            onChange={(e) => setF((prev) => ({ ...prev, role: e.target.value }))}
            aria-label="Filter by role"
          >
            <option value="">All roles</option>
            <option value="employee">Employee</option>
            <option value="it_support">IT Support</option>
            <option value="it_manager">IT Manager</option>
            <option value="system_admin">System Admin</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div className="field-inline">
          <div className="caption">Status</div>
          <select
            className="input" value={f.status}
            onChange={(e) => setF((prev) => ({ ...prev, status: e.target.value }))}
            aria-label="Filter by account status"
          >
            <option value="">All</option>
            <option value="true">Active</option>
            <option value="false">Inactive</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        {filtersActive && (
          <button
            type="button" className="btn-ghost"
            onClick={() => setF({ q: '', department: '', role: '', status: '' })}
            aria-label="Clear all employee filters"
          >
            Clear filters
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="panel">
        {loading ? <div className="panel-pad"><LoadingRows n={6} /></div>
          : listError ? <div className="panel-pad"><div className="error-summary" role="alert">{listError} <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={refresh}>Retry</button></div></div>
          : (<>
            <TableControls tableVisible={userTableVisible} onToggleTable={toggleUserTable} columns={USER_COLUMNS} visible={visibleUserColumns} onToggleColumn={toggleUserColumn} onReset={resetUserColumns} />
            {userTableVisible ? (
              <DataTable
                columns={userColumns}
                rows={items}
                keyOf={(u) => u.id}
                selected={isStaff ? selUsers : undefined}
                onToggle={isStaff ? toggleUser : undefined}
                sort={sort}
                onSort={changeUserSort}
                emptyTitle="No employees found."
                emptyHint="Adjust the search or add a new employee."
              />
            ) : (
              <p className="muted">Table hidden.</p>
            )}
            <Pager count={count} hasNext={!!next} hasPrev={!!previous} busy={loading} onPrev={() => previous && loadUrl(previous)} onNext={() => next && loadUrl(next)} />
          </>)}
      </div>
      <p className="muted small">Import template key: employee_id â€” roles never change via bulk import.</p>
      {showCreate && <EmployeeCreateModal onClose={() => setShowCreate(false)} onCreated={refresh} />}
      {showImport && <EmployeeImportModal onClose={() => setShowImport(false)} onImported={refresh} />}
      {editingUser && (
        <EmployeeEditModal
          user={editingUser}
          onClose={() => setEditingUser(null)}
          onSaved={() => { setMsg('Employee updated.'); setEditingUser(null); refresh(); }}
        />
      )}
      {resetTarget && (
        <ResetPasswordModal
          user={resetTarget}
          onClose={() => { if (!resetBusy) setResetTarget(null); }}
          onReset={() => refresh()}
        />
      )}
      {confirmUser && (
        <ConfirmDialog
          title={`${confirmUser.activate ? 'Reactivate' : 'Deactivate'} "${confirmUser.user.employee_id}"?`}
          message={confirmUser.activate
            ? 'This restores login access for the account.'
            : 'This blocks login for the account. Their records and history are kept.'
            + (me && confirmUser.user.id === me.id ? ' WARNING: this is your own account â€” you will lock yourself out.' : '')}
          confirmLabel={confirmUser.activate ? 'Reactivate' : 'Deactivate'}
          danger={!confirmUser.activate}
          busy={rowBusy === confirmUser.user.id}
          onConfirm={doActivate}
          onCancel={() => setConfirmUser(null)}
        />
      )}
      {roleTarget && (
        <Modal title={`Change role â€” ${roleTarget.employee_id}`} onClose={() => { if (!roleBusy) setRoleTarget(null); }}>
          <form onSubmit={doChangeRole}>
            <Field label="Role">
              <select
                className="input" value={roleForm.role}
                onChange={(e) => setRoleForm((f) => ({ ...f, role: e.target.value }))}
                disabled={roleBusy}
              >
                <option value="employee">Employee</option>
                <option value="it_support">IT Support</option>
                <option value="it_manager">IT Manager</option>
                <option value="system_admin">System Admin</option>
              </select>
            </Field>
            <label className="check-row">
              <input
                type="checkbox" checked={roleForm.can_create_tickets}
                onChange={(e) => setRoleForm((f) => ({ ...f, can_create_tickets: e.target.checked }))}
                disabled={roleBusy}
              />
              Can create tickets
            </label>
            {roleError && <div className="field-error" role="alert">{roleError}</div>}
            <div className="row-end">
              <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setRoleTarget(null)} disabled={roleBusy}>Cancel</button>
              <button type="submit" className="btn-primary" disabled={roleBusy}>
                {roleBusy ? 'Savingâ€¦' : 'Change role'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Modal>
      )}
      {empPhotoPreviewUrl && (
        <Modal
          title={empPhotoPreviewName || 'Employee photo'}
          onClose={closeEmployeePhotoPreview}
        >
          <div className="preview-media">
            <img src={empPhotoPreviewUrl} alt={empPhotoPreviewName || 'Employee photo'} />
            {empPhotoPreviewError && <div className="field-error" role="alert">{empPhotoPreviewError}</div>}
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}
      {empPhotoPreviewError && !empPhotoPreviewUrl && (
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{empPhotoPreviewError}</div>
      )}
      {bulkPending && (
        <ConfirmDialog
          title={`${bulkLabel(bulkPending.action)} ${bulkPending.ids.length} user(s)?`}
          message={bulkPreviewMessage(bulkPending.preview)}
          confirmLabel={bulkLabel(bulkPending.action)}
          danger={bulkPending.action === 'delete'}
          busy={bulkBusy}
          onConfirm={executeBulk}
          onCancel={() => setBulkPending(null)}
        />
      )}
      {bulkResult && (
        <Modal title={`Bulk ${bulkResult.label}`} onClose={() => setBulkResult(null)} size="lg">
          <div className="row-gap" style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--sp-2)' }}>
            <b>{bulkResult.label} result</b>
            <span className="muted small">
              {bulkResult.successful?.length ?? 0} successful
              {bulkResult.skipped?.length ? `, ${bulkResult.skipped.length} skipped` : ''}
              {bulkResult.failed?.length ? `, ${bulkResult.failed.length} failed` : ''}
            </span>
          </div>
          <ReportTable rows={bulkResultRows(bulkResult)} />
          <div className="row-end">
            <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setBulkResult(null)}>Close</button>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}
      {exportOpen && (
        <ExportDialog
          dataset="employees"
          open={exportOpen}
          selectedIds={[...selUsers]}
          filterParams={f}
          onClose={() => setExportOpen(false)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function CategoryEditModal({ kind, cat, onClose, onSaved }) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    name: cat?.name ?? '', description: cat?.description ?? '',
  });
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState({});
  const [globalError, setGlobalError] = useState('');
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const submit = async (ev) => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    if (saving) return;
    const trimmed = form.name.trim();
    if (!trimmed) {
      setFieldErrors({ name: 'Name is required.' });
      return;
    }
    setFieldErrors({});
    setGlobalError('');
    setSaving(true);
    const base = kind === 'ticket' ? '/tickets/categories/' : '/assets/categories/';
    try {
      await api.patch(`${base}${cat.id}/`, {
        name: trimmed, description: form.description.trim(),
      });
      onSaved();
      onClose();
    } catch (e) {
      const p = parseApiError(e);
      setFieldErrors(p.fields);
      setGlobalError(p.global);
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };
  return (
    <Modal
      title={`Edit ${kind} category â€” ${cat?.name ?? ''}`}
      onClose={() => { if (!saving) onClose(); }}
    >
      <form onSubmit={submit} noValidate>
        {globalError && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{globalError}</div>}
        <Field label="Name" required error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'name')}>
          <input
            className="input input-auto" value={form.name}
            onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, name: e.target.value }))}
            disabled={saving} autoFocus maxLength={100}
          />
        </Field>
        <Field
          label="Description" error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'description')}
          hint="Shown to staff on the Categories page only."
        >
          <textarea
            className="input" rows={3} value={form.description}
            onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, description: e.target.value }))}
            disabled={saving}
          />
        </Field>
        <div className="row-end">
          <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={onClose} disabled={saving}>Cancel</button>
          <button type="submit" className="btn-primary" disabled={saving || !form.name.trim()}>
            {saving ? 'Savingâ€¦' : 'Save changes'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}

function DepartmentModal({ initial, onClose, onSaved }) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    name: initial?.name ?? '', code: initial?.code ?? '',
    description: initial?.description ?? '', head: initial?.head ?? '',
    is_active: initial?.is_active ?? true,
  });
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState({});
  const [globalError, setGlobalError] = useState('');
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const set = (k) => (v) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [k]: v }));
  const submit = async (ev) => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    if (saving) return;
    setFieldErrors({});
    setGlobalError('');
    const payload = {
      name: form.name.trim(), code: form.code.trim(),
      description: form.description.trim(), is_active: form.is_active,
    };
    if (form.head !== '' && form.head != null) payload.head = Number(form.head);
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      if (initial) await api.patch(`/accounts/departments/${initial.id}/`, payload);
      else await api.post('/accounts/departments/', payload);
      onSaved();
      onClose();
    } catch (e) {
      const p = parseApiError(e);
      setFieldErrors(p.fields);
      setGlobalError(p.global);
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };
  return (
    <Modal title={initial ? `Edit department â€” ${initial.name}` : 'New department'} onClose={() => { if (!saving) onClose(); }}>
      <form onSubmit={submit} noValidate>
        {globalError && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{globalError}</div>}
        <div className="form-grid">
          <Field label="Name" required error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'name')}>
            <input className="input" value={form.name} onChange={(e) => set('name')(e.target.value)} disabled={saving} maxLength={100} />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Code" required error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'code')} hint="Short unique code, e.g. ENG.">
            <input className="input" value={form.code} onChange={(e) => set('code')(e.target.value)} disabled={saving} maxLength={20} />
          </Field>
        </div>
        <Field label="Description" error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'description')}>
          <textarea className="input" rows={2} value={form.description} onChange={(e) => set('description')(e.target.value)} disabled={saving} />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Head (optional)" error={fieldMsg(fieldErrors, 'head')}>
          <UserSelect value={form.head} onChange={set('head')} disabled={saving} label="Department head" />
        </Field>
        <label className="check-row">
          <input type="checkbox" checked={form.is_active} onChange={(e) => set('is_active')(e.target.checked)} disabled={saving} />
          Active
        </label>
        <div className="row-end">
          <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={onClose} disabled={saving}>Cancel</button>
          <button type="submit" className="btn-primary" disabled={saving}>
            {saving ? 'Savingâ€¦' : initial ? 'Save changes' : 'Create department'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}

export function Departments() {
  const { isStaff } = useAuth();
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [count, setCount] = useState(null);
  const [next, setNext] = useState(null);
  const [previous, setPrevious] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [listError, setListError] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(null);
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(null);
  const [deleteBusy, setDeleteBusy] = useState(false);
  const [exportOpen, setExportOpen] = useState(false);

  const DEPARTMENT_COLUMNS = [
    { key: 'name', label: 'Name', sortable: 'name' },
    { key: 'code', label: 'Code' },
    { key: 'head', label: 'Head', render: (d) => d.head_email || 'Not Assigned' },
    { key: 'members', label: 'Members', render: (d) => d.member_count ?? '-' },
    { key: 'assets', label: 'Assets', render: (d) => d.asset_count ?? '-' },
    { key: 'is_active', label: 'State', render: (d) => <Badge kind="status" value={d.is_active ? 'active' : 'inactive'} /> },
  ];
  const { visibleColumns: visibleDepartmentColumns, toggleColumn: toggleDepartmentColumn, resetColumns: resetDepartmentColumns, tableVisible: departmentTableVisible, toggleTable: toggleDepartmentTable } = useTableColumns(
    'departments',
    DEPARTMENT_COLUMNS.map((c) => c.key),
    ['name', 'code', 'head', 'members', 'is_active'],
  );
  const departmentColumns = DEPARTMENT_COLUMNS.filter((c) => visibleDepartmentColumns.has(c.key));
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const [sort, changeSort, orderingParam] = useSort();

  const loadUrl = async (url) => {
    setLoading(true);
    setListError('');
    try {
      const pg = await fetchPage(url);
      setItems(pg.items);
      setCount(pg.count);
      setNext(pg.next);
      setPrevious(pg.previous);
    } catch {
      setListError('Could not load departments.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };
  const buildUrl = (over = {}, sortOverride) => {
    const p = new URLSearchParams();
    if (over.q) p.set('q', over.q);
    const ord = orderingParam(sortOverride);
    if (ord) p.set('ordering', ord);
    const qs = p.toString();
    return `/accounts/departments/${qs ? `?${qs}` : ''}`;
  };
  const qsKey = JSON.stringify([q, orderingParam(sort)]);
  const builtUrl = useMemo(() => buildUrl({ q }, orderingParam(sort)), [qsKey]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  // Debounced, server-side search across the full department dataset.
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    const t = setTimeout(async () => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      await loadUrl(builtUrl);
    }, 250);
    return () => { cancelled = true; clearTimeout(t); };
  }, [builtUrl]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  const refresh = () => loadUrl(builtUrl);
  const changeDepartmentSort = (field) => changeSort(field);

  const toggleActive = async (d) => {
    if (busy) return;
    if (!confirm(`${d.is_active ? 'Deactivate' : 'Reactivate'} department "${d.name}"?`)) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setErr('');
    setMsg('');
    try {
      await api.patch(`/accounts/departments/${d.id}/`, { is_active: !d.is_active });
      setMsg(`Department "${d.name}" ${d.is_active ? 'deactivated' : 'reactivated'}.`);
      refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      setErr(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not update department.');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const doDelete = async () => {
    if (!deleting || deleteBusy) return;
    setDeleteBusy(true);
    try {
      await api.delete(`/accounts/departments/${deleting.id}/`);
      setDeleting(null);
      setMsg(`Department "${deleting.name}" deleted.`);
      refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      const p = parseApiError(e);
      const refs = e?.response?.data?.references;
      setErr(refs
        ? `Cannot delete: still referenced (${Object.entries(refs).map(([k, v]) => `${k}: ${v}`).join(', ')}). Deactivate instead.`
        : (p.global || 'Could not delete department.'));
      setDeleting(null);
    } finally {
      setDeleteBusy(false);
    }
  };
  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Departments"
        sub={count != null ? `${count} departments` : 'Home departments, ticket routing, and membership.'}
        actions={<>
          {isStaff && <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={() => setCreating(true)}>+ New department</button>}
          {isStaff && <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={() => setExportOpen(true)}>Exportâ€¦</button>}
        </>}
      />
      {err && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{err}</div>}
      {msg && <div className="success-summary" role="status">{msg}</div>}
      <div className="filter-bar" role="search">
        <div className="field-inline grow">
          <div className="caption">Search</div>
          <input
            className="input" value={q}
            onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Department name or code" aria-label="Search departments"
            style={{ maxWidth: '320px' }}
          />
        </div>
        {q && (
          <button
            type="button" className="btn-ghost"
            onClick={() => setQ('')}
            aria-label="Clear department search"
          >
            Clear filters
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="panel">
        {loading ? <div className="panel-pad"><LoadingRows n={5} /></div>
          : listError ? <div className="panel-pad"><div className="error-summary" role="alert">{listError} <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={refresh}>Retry</button></div></div>
          : (<>
            <TableControls tableVisible={departmentTableVisible} onToggleTable={toggleDepartmentTable} columns={DEPARTMENT_COLUMNS} visible={visibleDepartmentColumns} onToggleColumn={toggleDepartmentColumn} onReset={resetDepartmentColumns} />
            {departmentTableVisible ? (
              <DataTable
                sort={sort}
                onSort={changeDepartmentSort}
                columns={[...departmentColumns, {
                  key: 'actions', label: 'Actions', thClass: 'cell-actions', render: (d) => isStaff ? (
                    <div className="cell-actions">
                      <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => setEditing(d)} disabled={busy}>Editâ€¦</button>
                      <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => toggleActive(d)} disabled={busy}>
                        {d.is_active ? 'Deactivateâ€¦' : 'Reactivateâ€¦'}
                      </button>
                      <button type="button" className="btn-small btn-danger" onClick={() => setDeleting(d)}>Deleteâ€¦</button>
                    </div>
                  ) : '-',
                }]}
                rows={items}
                keyOf={(d) => d.id}
                emptyTitle="No departments."
                emptyHint="IT staff can add the first one."
              />
            ) : (
              <p className="muted">Table hidden.</p>
            )}
            <Pager count={count} hasNext={!!next} hasPrev={!!previous} busy={loading} onPrev={() => previous && loadUrl(previous)} onNext={() => next && loadUrl(next)} />
          </>)}
      </div>
      {creating && <DepartmentModal onClose={() => setCreating(false)} onSaved={() => { setMsg('Department created.'); refresh(); }} />}
      {editing && <DepartmentModal initial={editing} onClose={() => setEditing(null)} onSaved={() => { setMsg('Department updated.'); refresh(); }} />}
      {deleting && (
        <ConfirmDialog
          title={`Delete department "${deleting.name}"?`}
          message="This soft-deletes the department. If members or tickets still reference it, deletion is blocked â€” deactivate instead."
          confirmLabel="Delete department" danger busy={deleteBusy}
          onConfirm={doDelete}
          onCancel={() => setDeleting(null)}
        />
      )}
      {exportOpen && (
        <ExportDialog
          dataset="departments"
          open={exportOpen}
          filterParams={q ? { q } : {}}
          onClose={() => setExportOpen(false)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Admin-only SLA target configuration per ticket priority. */
export function SLAConfig() {
  const { isAdmin } = useAuth();
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');
  const [editTarget, setEditTarget] = useState(null);
  const [editForm, setEditForm] = useState({
    target_resolution_hours: '', is_active: true,
  });
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState('');

  const load = async () => {
    if (!isAdmin) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const r = await api.get('/tickets/sla/');
      setItems(r.data.results ?? r.data ?? []);
    } catch {
      setError('Could not load SLA configuration.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, react/set-state-in-effect

  const openEdit = (sla) => {
    setEditTarget(sla);
    setEditForm({
      target_resolution_hours: String(sla.target_resolution_hours ?? ''),
      is_active: sla.is_active,
    });
    setSaveError('');
  };
  const saveEdit = async (ev) => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    if (!editTarget || saving || !isAdmin) return;
    setSaving(true);
    setSaveError('');
    try {
      await api.patch(`/tickets/sla/${editTarget.id}/`, {
        target_resolution_hours: Number(editForm.target_resolution_hours),
        is_active: editForm.is_active,
      });
      setMsg(`SLA for "${editTarget.priority}" updated.`);
      setEditTarget(null);
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      setSaveError(parseApiError(e).global || 'Could not update SLA.');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  if (!isAdmin) {
    return (
      <div className="form-wrap">
        <div className="error-summary" role="alert">System Admin only.</div>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (loading) return <div className="panel-pad"><LoadingRows n={3} /></div>;
  if (error) return <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="SLA configuration"
        sub="Target resolution window per ticket priority (System Admin)."
        actions={<button
          type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={load} disabled={loading}>
          {loading ? 'Loadingâ€¦' : 'Refresh'}
        </button>}
      />
      {error && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>}
      {msg && <div className="success-summary" role="status">{msg}</div>}
      <div className="panel">
        <div className="panel-title"><h4>SLA targets</h4></div>
        <div className="panel-pad">
          <DataTable
            columns={[
              {
                key: 'priority', label: 'Priority',
                render: (s) => s.priority[0].toUpperCase() + s.priority.slice(1),
              },
              { key: 'target_resolution_hours', label: 'Target (hours)' },
              {
                key: 'is_active', label: 'Active',
                render: (s) => <Badge kind="status" value={s.is_active ? 'active' : 'inactive'} />,
              },
              {
                key: 'actions', label: 'Actions', thClass: 'cell-actions',
                render: (s) => (
                  <div className="cell-actions">
                    <button type="button" className="btn-small"
                      onClick={() => openEdit(s)} disabled={saving}>
                      Editâ€¦
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ),
              },
            ]}
            rows={items} keyOf={(s) => s.priority}
            emptyTitle="No SLA configuration."
            emptyHint="Seed defaults with `python manage.py seed_defaults`."
          />
        </div>
      </div>
      {editTarget && (
        <Modal title={`SLA target â€” ${editTarget.priority}`} onClose={() => { if (!saving) setEditTarget(null); }}>
          <form onSubmit={saveEdit} noValidate>
            {saveError && <div className="field-error" role="alert">{saveError}</div>}
            <Field label="Target resolution hours" required
              error={saveError || undefined}>
              <input
                className="input" type="number" min="1"
                value={editForm.target_resolution_hours}
                onChange={(e) => setEditForm((f) => ({ ...f, target_resolution_hours: e.target.value }))}
                disabled={saving} />
            </Field>
            <label className="check-row">
              <input type="checkbox"
                checked={editForm.is_active}
                onChange={(e) => setEditForm((f) => ({ ...f, is_active: e.target.checked }))}
                disabled={saving} />
              Active
            </label>
            <div className="row-end">
              <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setEditTarget(null)} disabled={saving}>Cancel</button>
              <button type="submit" className="btn-primary" disabled={saving || !editForm.target_resolution_hours}>
                {saving ? 'Savingâ€¦' : 'Save'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/** SLA health report: overdue tickets and average resolution time by priority. */
export function SLAReport() {
  const [dateFrom, setDateFrom] = useState('');
  const [dateTo, setDateTo] = useState('');
  const [report, setReport] = useState(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const p = new URLSearchParams();
      if (dateFrom) p.set('date_from', dateFrom);
      if (dateTo) p.set('date_to', dateTo);
      const r = await api.get(`/tickets/reports/sla/?${p.toString()}`);
      setReport(r.data);
    } catch {
      setError('Could not load the SLA report.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, react/set-state-in-effect

  const applyDates = () => { load(); };
  const resetDates = () => {
    setDateFrom(''); setDateTo(''); setError(''); load();
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="SLA report"
        sub="Overdue tickets and average resolution time by priority."
        actions={<>
          <input className="input input-date" type="date" value={dateFrom}
            onChange={(e) => setDateFrom(e.target.value)} aria-label="Report start date" style={{ maxWidth: '150px' }} />
          <input className="input input-date" type="date" value={dateTo}
            onChange={(e) => setDateTo(e.target.value)} aria-label="Report end date" style={{ maxWidth: '150px' }} />
          <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={applyDates} disabled={loading}>
            {loading ? 'Loadingâ€¦' : 'Apply dates'}
          </button>
          {(dateFrom || dateTo) && (
            <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={resetDates}>Reset</button>
          )}
        </>}
      />
      {error && <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{error}</div>}
      <div className="panel">
        <div className="panel-title"><h4>SLA health</h4></div>
        <div className="panel-pad">
          {loading ? <div className="panel-pad"><LoadingRows n={3} /></div> : (
            <div className="row-gap" style={{ gap: 'var(--sp-4)', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              <div style={{ minWidth: '200px' }}>
                <div className="muted small">Overdue tickets</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--font-2xl)', fontWeight: '650' }}>
                  {report?.overdue ?? 'â€”'}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div style={{ minWidth: '200px' }}>
                <div className="muted small">Report window</div>
                <div className="muted small">
                  {(report?.filters?.date_from || 'any') + ' â†’ ' + (report?.filters?.date_to || 'any')}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          <div style={{ marginTop: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
            <DataTable
              columns={[
                { key: 'priority', label: 'Priority',
                  render: (r) => r.priority[0].toUpperCase() + r.priority.slice(1) },
                { key: 'resolved', label: 'Resolved' },
                { key: 'avg_resolution_hours', label: 'Avg resolution (hours)',
                  render: (r) => r.avg_resolution_hours == null ? 'â€”' : r.avg_resolution_hours },
              ]}
              rows={report?.by_priority ?? []}
              keyOf={(r) => r.priority}
              emptyTitle="No resolved tickets in scope."
              emptyHint="Resolve some tickets to populate resolution-time stats."
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== src\services\monitoring\monitoring-api.js =====

import api from '../../api';
import { parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';

/** Mapping constants for the monitoring services layer. Only endpoints
 *  that are registered on the backend are exposed here.
 */
const SUPPORTED_ALERT_ACTIONS = new Set([
  'acknowledge', 'suppress', 'unsuppress', 'resolve', 'close', 'reopen', 'assign',
]);

export const MonitoringEndpoints = {
  sources: '/monitoring/sources/',
  sourceRotate: (id) => `/monitoring/sources/${id}/rotate-secret/`,
  sourceDisable: (id) => `/monitoring/sources/${id}/disable/`,
  sourceEnable: (id) => `/monitoring/sources/${id}/enable/`,
  sourceTest: (id) => `/monitoring/sources/${id}/test/`,
  alertDetail: (id) => `/monitoring/alerts/${id}/`,
  alertActions: (id, action) => `/monitoring/alerts/${id}/${action}/`,
  dashboard: '/monitoring/dashboard/',
};

/**
 * List monitoring sources (GET /monitoring/sources/).
 * Backend: MonitoringSourceViewSet.list â€” MonitoringSourceListSerializer.
 * Permission: authenticated user; UI restricts this to System Admin.
 */
export async function listSources(params = {}) {
  const p = new URLSearchParams();
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) {
    if (v !== '' && v != null) p.set(k, v);
  }
  const url = `${MonitoringEndpoints.sources}?${p.toString()}`;
  const r = await api.get(url);
  return r.data;
}

/** Retrieve a single monitoring source (GET /monitoring/sources/<id>/). */
export async function getSource(id) {
  const r = await api.get(`${MonitoringEndpoints.sources}${id}/`);
  return r.data;
}

/** Enable a monitoring source (POST /monitoring/sources/<id>/enable/). */
export async function enableSource(id) {
  const r = await api.post(MonitoringEndpoints.sourceEnable(id));
  return r.data;
}

/** Disable a monitoring source (POST /monitoring/sources/<id>/disable/). */
export async function disableSource(id) {
  const r = await api.post(MonitoringEndpoints.sourceDisable(id));
  return r.data;
}

/** Rotate a source secret (POST /monitoring/sources/<id>/rotate-secret/).
 *  Returns plaintext secret once in the response.
 */
export async function rotateSourceSecret(id) {
  const r = await api.post(MonitoringEndpoints.sourceRotate(id));
  return r.data;
}

/** Test source configuration (POST /monitoring/sources/<id>/test/). */
export async function testSource(id) {
  const r = await api.post(MonitoringEndpoints.sourceTest(id));
  return r.data;
}

/** Retrieve an alert detail (GET /monitoring/alerts/<id>/).
 *  Serializer exposes: alert_number, title, severity, status, source_name,
 *  event_count.
 */
export async function getAlert(id) {
  const r = await api.get(MonitoringEndpoints.alertDetail(id));
  return r.data;
}

/** Post an alert action (POST /monitoring/alerts/<id>/<action>/).
 *  Supported actions: acknowledge, suppress, unsuppress, resolve, close,
 *  reopen, assign.
 */
export async function alertAction(id, action, payload = {}) {
  if (!SUPPORTED_ALERT_ACTIONS.has(action)) {
    throw new Error(`Unsupported alert action: ${action}`);
  }
  const r = await api.post(MonitoringEndpoints.alertActions(id, action), payload);
  return r.data;
}

/** Load monitoring dashboard (GET /monitoring/dashboard/).
 *  Backend returns a stub: { detail: "Dashboard data requires implementation." }
 *  No active caller uses it; any caller must treat the result as unavailable,
 *  never as real metrics.
 */
export async function loadDashboard() {
  const r = await api.get(MonitoringEndpoints.dashboard);
  return r.data;
}

/** Parse a monitoring API error into {fields, global}. */
export function parseMonitoringError(e) {
  return parseApiError(e);
}

  const response = await api.post(`/${resource}/${id}/${action}/`, data);
  return response.data;

===== src\services\api-context.jsx =====

import { useCallback, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../api';

export function useApi() {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  const request = useCallback(async (method, url, data) => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      return await api.request({ method, url, data });
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e?.message || 'Request failed');
      throw e;
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const success = useCallback((message) => message, []);

  return { request, loading, error, setError, success };
}

export default useApi;

export function formatDate(date) {
  if (!date) return '';
  const d = new Date(date);
  if (isNaN(d)) return String(date);
  return d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
  });
}

export function formatDateTime(dateTime) {
  if (!dateTime) return '';
  const d = new Date(dateTime);
  if (isNaN(d)) return String(dateTime);
  return d.toLocaleString(undefined, {
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit',
  });
}

export function formatDuration(minutes) {
  if (minutes === null || minutes === undefined || isNaN(minutes)) return '';
  const h = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
  const m = minutes % 60;
  if (h > 0 && m > 0) return `${h} hours ${m} minutes`;
  if (h > 0) return `${h} hours`;
  return `${m} minutes`;
}

export function statusBadgeVariant(status) {
  const terminal = ['completed', 'closed', 'rejected', 'cancelled', 'failed', 'rolled_back'];
  const inprogress = ['in_progress', 'validation'];
  const approvedish = ['approved', 'scheduled'];
  if (terminal.includes(status)) return 'danger';
  if (inprogress.includes(status)) return 'warning';
  if (approvedish.includes(status)) return 'success';
  return 'secondary';
}

export function riskBadgeVariant(riskLevel) {
  const riskMap = { low: 'success', medium: 'info', high: 'warning', critical: 'danger' };
  return riskMap[riskLevel] || 'secondary';
}

export function priorityBadgeVariant(priority) {
  const priorityMap = { low: 'secondary', normal: 'info', high: 'warning', urgent: 'danger', emergency: 'danger' };
  return priorityMap[priority] || 'secondary';
}

export function isTerminalStatus(status) {
  const terminal = ['completed', 'closed', 'rejected', 'cancelled', 'failed', 'rolled_back'];
  return terminal.includes(status);
}

export function isEditableStatus(status) {
  const editable = ['draft', 'submitted'];
  return editable.includes(status);
}

export function safeResults(arr) {
  if (!arr) return [];
  return arr;
}

export function buildChangeListUrl(filters = {}, pageSize, page) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  const orderedKeys = [
    'type', 'category', 'status', 'priority', 'risk', 'department',
    'implementation_lead', 'owner', 'emergency', 'pir_required',
    'approval_state', 'overdue', 'upcoming',
  ];
  for (const key of orderedKeys) {
    if (filters[key] !== undefined && filters[key] !== null) {
      params.append(key, String(filters[key]));
    }
  }
  if (pageSize !== undefined) params.append('page_size', pageSize);
  if (page !== undefined) params.append('page', page);
  return params.toString() ? `?${params.toString()}` : '';
}

export function parseFieldErrors(errorResponse) {
  if (!errorResponse) return {};
  const data = errorResponse.response?.data;
  if (!data) return {};
  const out = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(data)) {
    let msg = Array.isArray(v) ? v.join(' ') : (typeof v === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(v) : String(v));
    out[k] = msg;
  }
  return out;
}

export function actionAvailability(role, status, action) {
  if (!role) return false;

  const isAdmin = role === 'system_admin';
  const isManager = role === 'it_manager';
  const isSupport = role === 'it_support';
  const isEmployee = role === 'employee';

  if (isAdmin) return true;
  if (isEmployee) {
    return ['view', 'detail'].includes(action);
  }

  if (isSupport) {
    const supportActions = {
      create_draft: status === 'draft' || status === 'submitted',
      edit_own_draft: status === 'draft',
      view: true,
      detail: true,
      risk: status !== 'completed' && status !== 'closed' && status !== 'rolled_back' && status !== 'cancelled',
      tasks: status !== 'completed' && status !== 'closed' && status !== 'rolled_back' && status !== 'cancelled',
      implementation: false,
      approvals: false,
      schedule: false,
      pir: false,
      close: false,
      cancel: status === 'draft' || status === 'submitted' || status === 'on_hold',
      view_conflicts: true,
    };
    return supportActions[action] ?? false;
  }

  if (isManager) {
    const managerActions = {
      create: true,
      edit: true,
      submit: !isTerminalStatus(status),
      submit_draft: status === 'draft',
      risk: true,
      confirm_risk: status === 'risk_assessment' || status === 'submitted',
      start_technical_review: status === 'submitted',
      complete_technical_review: status === 'risk_assessment',
      request_approval: status === 'technical_review',
      approve: status === 'pending_approval',
      reject: status === 'pending_approval',
      return_correction: status === 'pending_approval',
      schedule: status === 'approved',
      reschedule: status === 'scheduled',
      hold: status !== 'closed' && status !== 'cancelled' && status !== 'failed' && status !== 'rolled_back',
      resume: status === 'on_hold',
      convert_emergency: status === 'normal' || status === 'standard',
      start_implementation: status === 'scheduled',
      begin_validation: status === 'in_progress',
      complete: status === 'validation',
      fail: status !== 'closed' && status !== 'cancelled' && status !== 'rolled_back',
      start_rollback: status === 'in_progress',
      complete_rollback: status === 'validation' || status === 'in_progress',
      request_pir: status === 'completed',
      close: status === 'completed',
      cancel: !isTerminalStatus(status),
      view_conflicts: true,
      templates: true,
      maintenance_windows: true,
    };
    return managerActions[action] ?? false;
  }

  return false;
}

// â”€â”€ Format helpers â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

export function formatDate(dateString) {
  if (!dateString) return 'â€”';
  return new Date(dateString).toLocaleDateString();
}

export function formatDateTime(dateString) {
  if (!dateString) return 'â€”';
  return new Date(dateString).toLocaleString();
}

export function formatPercent(value) {
  if (value == null) return 'â€”';
  const pct = Number(value);
  if (isNaN(pct)) return 'â€”';
  return `${pct.toFixed(1)}%`;
}

// â”€â”€ safeResults: filter null/undefined from array-like results â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
export function safeResults(arr) {
  if (!arr) return [];
  if (Array.isArray(arr)) return arr.filter((x) => x != null);
  return [arr].filter((x) => x != null);
}

// â”€â”€ URL builder helpers â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

export function buildCIListUrl(filters = {}) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  const allowed = [
    'type', 'category', 'status', 'lifecycle_state', 'criticality',
    'environment', 'department', 'location', 'owner', 'technical_owner',
    'vendor', 'source', 'verified', 'monitoring_state',
    'data_classification', 'validated_system_impact',
    'created_date_range', 'updated_date_range', 'search',
    'page', 'ordering',
  ];
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(filters)) {
    if (allowed.includes(key) && value !== '' && value != null) {
      params.append(key, String(value));
    }
  }
  return params.toString() ? `?${params.toString()}` : '';
}

export function buildRelationshipListUrl(filters = {}) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  const allowed = ['source_ci', 'target_ci', 'relationship_type', 'status'];
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(filters)) {
    if (allowed.includes(key) && value !== undefined) {
      params.append(key, String(value));
    }
  }
  return params.toString() ? `?${params.toString()}` : '';
}

export function buildDriftListUrl(filters = {}) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  const allowed = ['status', 'severity', 'type', 'ci', 'baseline', 'detected_date', 'search'];
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(filters)) {
    if (allowed.includes(key) && value !== undefined) {
      params.append(key, String(value));
    }
  }
  return params.toString() ? `?${params.toString()}` : '';
}

// â”€â”€ parseFieldErrors â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
export function parseFieldErrors(errorResponse) {
  const parsed = typeof errorResponse === 'object' && errorResponse !== null
    ? errorResponse
    : { fields: {}, global: String(errorResponse) };
  return parsed.fields || {};
}

// â”€â”€ actionAvailability â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
export function actionAvailability(userRole, action) {
  // Policy-driven availability based on role
  const isAdmin = userRole === 'system_admin';
  const isManager = userRole === 'it_manager';
  const isSupport = userRole === 'it_support';
  const isEmployee = userRole === 'employee';

  const rules = {
    view: !isEmployee,
    create: isAdmin || isManager,
    edit: isAdmin || isManager,
    verify: isAdmin || isManager || isSupport,
    retire: isAdmin || isManager,
    manage_types: isAdmin,
    manage_relationships: isAdmin || isManager,
    verify_ci: isAdmin || isManager || isSupport,
    retire_ci: isAdmin || isManager,
    manage_baselines: isAdmin || isManager,
    approve_baselines: isAdmin || isManager,
    manage_drift: isAdmin || isManager,
    view_impact: isAdmin || isManager || isSupport,
    view_reports: isAdmin || isManager || isSupport,
  };

  return rules[action] ?? false;
}

// â”€â”€ normalizeGraphResponse â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
export function normalizeGraphResponse(raw) {
  if (!raw) return { nodes: [], edges: [], metadata: {} };
  const nodes = safeResults(raw.nodes || raw.configuration_items || []);
  const edges = safeResults(raw.relationships || raw.edges || []);
  return {
    nodes,
    edges,
    metadata: {
      nodeCount: nodes.length,
      edgeCount: edges.length,
      hasCycles: !!raw.metadata?.hasCycles,
      truncated: !!raw.metadata?.truncated,
    },
  };
}

export { CMDB_API_CONTRACT } from './cmdb';

export { CMDB_ROLES, CMDB_PERMISSIONS } from './cmdb';
// â”€â”€ formatVerificationAge â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
export function formatVerificationAge(lastVerifiedAt) {
  if (!lastVerifiedAt) return 'Never verified';
  const diffMs = Date.now() - new Date(lastVerifiedAt).getTime();
  const diffDays = diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
  if (diffDays < 1) return 'Today';
  if (diffDays < 7) return `${Math.floor(diffDays)} day${Math.floor(diffDays) !== 1 ? 's' : ''} ago`;
  if (diffDays < 30) return `${Math.floor(diffDays / 7)} week${Math.floor(diffDays / 7) !== 1 ? 's' : ''} ago`;
  return `${Math.floor(diffDays / 30)} month${Math.floor(diffDays / 30) !== 1 ? 's' : ''} ago`;
}

  canAcknowledgeDrift: (role) => role === CMDB_ROLES.SYSTEM_ADMIN || role === CMDB_ROLES.IT_MANAGER,
  canResolveDrift: (role) => role === CMDB_ROLES.SYSTEM_ADMIN || role === CMDB_ROLES.IT_MANAGER,

  // Reports
  canViewReports: (role) => role !== CMDB_ROLES.EMPLOYEE,
};

 * Every entry maps a frontend operation to:
 * - endpoint: the full path (relative to /api)
 * - method: GET | POST | PUT | DELETE | POST (custom action)
 * - requestPayload: shape of data sent to backend
 * - responseShape: expected shape of backend response
 * - roles: required user role(s)
 * - successCode: expected HTTP status on success
 * - errorCodes: possible error codes
 */

const DETAIL_FIELD_LABELS = {
  reason: 'Reason', action: 'Action', notes: 'Notes', note: 'Note',
  reference: 'Reference', type: 'Type', target: 'Target',
  finding_id: 'Finding', product: 'Product', asset: 'Asset',

function humanizeValue(value) {
  return String(value ?? '').replace(/_/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase());
}

/** Human label for a status value that may come from any licensing model. */
export function historyStatusText(value) {
  if (!value) return 'â€”';
  return ALLOCATION_STATUS_LABELS[value]
    || AGREEMENT_STATUS_LABELS[value]
    || FINDING_STATUS_LABELS[value]
    || RENEWAL_STATUS_LABELS[value]
    || humanizeValue(value);
}

/** "Active â†’ Revoked" style transition for a history row. */
export function historyTransition(entry) {
  const prev = entry?.previous_status;
  const next = entry?.new_status;
  if (prev && next) return `${historyStatusText(prev)} â†’ ${historyStatusText(next)}`;
  if (next) return historyStatusText(next);
  if (prev) return historyStatusText(prev);
  return 'â€”';
}

/** Readable summary of a history detail payload (never raw JSON in the UI). */
export function historyDetailText(detail) {
  if (!detail || typeof detail !== 'object' || Array.isArray(detail)) return '';
  return Object.entries(detail)
    .filter(([, v]) => v !== null && v !== undefined && v !== '')
    .map(([k, v]) => `${DETAIL_FIELD_LABELS[k] || humanizeValue(k)}: ${typeof v === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(v) : String(v)}`)
    .join(' Â· ');
}

export function formatDate(v) { if (!v) return 'â€”'; try { return new Date(v).toLocaleDateString(); } catch { return String(v); } }
export function formatDateTime(v) { if (!v) return 'â€”'; try { return new Date(v).toLocaleString(); } catch { return String(v); } }
export function formatMoney(v, currency) { if (v === null || v === undefined || v === '') return 'â€”'; return `${currency ? currency + ' ' : ''}${v}`; }
export function formatQuantity(v) { if (v === null || v === undefined) return 'â€”'; if (v === true) return 'Unlimited'; return String(v); }
export function formatPercent(v) { if (v === null || v === undefined) return 'â€”'; return `${Number(v).toFixed(1)}%`; }
export function formatUtilization(row) {
  if (!row) return 'â€”';
  if (row.utilization_calculable === false || row.utilization_percent === null || row.utilization_percent === undefined) {
    return row.utilization_note ? 'Not calculable' : 'â€”';
  }
  return formatPercent(row.utilization_percent);
}
export function agreementStatusBadgeVariant(s) { return s === 'active' ? 'success' : s === 'expired' ? 'danger' : 'secondary'; }
export function findingSeverityBadgeVariant(s) { return s === 'critical' ? 'danger' : s === 'high' ? 'warning' : 'secondary'; }
export function findingStatusBadgeVariant(s) { return s === 'resolved' ? 'success' : s === 'false_positive' ? 'secondary' : 'warning'; }
export function allocationStatusBadgeVariant(s) { return s === 'active' ? 'success' : s === 'revoked' ? 'danger' : 'secondary'; }
export function productApprovalBadgeVariant(s) { return s === 'approved' ? 'success' : s === 'prohibited' ? 'danger' : 'secondary'; }
export function safeResults(d) { if (Array.isArray(d)) return d; return d?.results || []; }
export function buildProductListUrl(f = {}, ordering, page) {
  const p = new URLSearchParams();
  if (f.search || f.q) p.append('search', f.search || f.q);
  if (f.category) p.append('category', f.category);
  if (f.platform) p.append('platform', f.platform);
  if (f.license_model) p.append('license_model', f.license_model);
  if (f.approved_status) p.append('status', f.approved_status);
  if (f.risk_level) p.append('risk_level', f.risk_level);
  if (f.support_status) p.append('support_status', f.support_status);
  if (f.is_active !== undefined && f.is_active !== '') p.append('is_active', f.is_active);
  if (ordering) p.append('ordering', ordering);
  if (page && page > 1) p.append('page', page);
  return `/licensing/products/?${p.toString()}`;
}

  if (f.status) p.append('status', f.status);
  if (ordering) p.append('ordering', ordering);
  if (page && page > 1) p.append('page', page);
  return `/licensing/findings/?${p.toString()}`;
}
export function parseFieldErrors(err) {
  const data = err?.response?.data;
  if (!data) return {};
  const out = {};
  Object.entries(data).forEach(([k, v]) => { out[k] = Array.isArray(v) ? v.join(' ') : String(v); });
  return out;
}
export function actionAvailability() { return true; }
export function groupMoneyByCurrency(items) {
  const groups = {};
  (items || []).forEach((it) => {
    const c = it.currency || 'N/A';
    groups[c] = (groups[c] || 0) + Number(it.total_cost || 0);
  });
  return groups;
}
export function licensingCapabilities(auth) {
  return {
    canView: !!auth.canViewLicensing,
    // Backend LicenseCompliancePermission / LicenseAllocationPermission are
    // staff-only, so page-level gates use the staff flag, not canViewLicensing
    // (which is also true for employees viewing My Software).
    canViewCompliance: !!auth.isStaff,
    canViewAllocations: !!auth.isStaff,
    canManageProducts: !!auth.canManageSoftwareProducts,
    canManageAgreements: !!auth.canManageLicenseAgreements,
    canViewCosts: !!auth.canViewLicenseCosts,
    canManageAllocations: !!auth.canManageLicenseAllocations,
    canManageInstallations: !!auth.canManageLicenseInstallations,
    canManageRenewals: !!auth.canManageLicenseRenewals,
    canApproveRenewals: !!auth.canApproveLicenseRenewals,
    canViewSecrets: !!auth.canViewLicenseSecrets,
    canRevealSecrets: !!auth.canRevealLicenseSecrets,
    canManageDocuments: !!auth.canManageLicenseDocuments,
    canManageCompliance: !!auth.canManageLicenseCompliance,
    canViewReports: !!auth.canViewLicenseReports,
    canViewMySoftware: !!auth.canViewMySoftware,
  };
}

export function formatDate(value) {
  if (!value) return 'â€”';
  try {
    return new Date(value).toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
      year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric',
    });
  } catch {
    return String(value);
  }
}

export function formatDateTime(value) {
  if (!value) return 'â€”';
  try {
    return new Date(value).toLocaleString(undefined, {
      year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit',
    });
  } catch {
    return String(value);
  }
}

export function formatPercent(value) {
  const n = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return '0%';
  return `${Math.round(n)}%`;
}

export function buildLifecycleListUrl(baseParams = {}) {

}

const ACTION_LABELS = {
  plan: 'Plan',
  start: 'Start',
  mark_ready: 'Mark Ready',
  confirm_start: 'Confirm Employee Start',
  complete: 'Complete',
  block: 'Block',
  unblock: 'Unblock',
  cancel: 'Cancel',
};

// Map frontend action keys to whether they require a reason.
const ACTION_REASON_REQUIRED = {
  block: true,
  cancel: true,
};

export function actionAvailability(caseType, status, userRole) {
  const isAdmin = userRole === 'system_admin';
  const isManager = userRole === 'it_manager' || isAdmin;
  const isStaff = isManager || userRole === 'it_support';
  const isEmployee = userRole === 'employee';

  const byStatus = TRANSITION_OFFER[caseType] ?? {};
  const offered = byStatus[status] ?? [];

  const out = {};
  for (const action of offered) {
    switch (action) {
      case 'plan':
        out.plan = isManager;
        break;
      case 'start':
        out.start = isStaff;
        break;
      case 'mark_ready':
        out.mark_ready = isStaff && caseType === 'onboarding';
        break;
      case 'confirm_start':
        out.confirm_start = isStaff || isEmployee;
        break;
      case 'complete':
        out.complete = isManager;
        break;
      case 'block':
        out.block = isManager;
        break;
      case 'unblock':
        out.unblock = isManager;
        break;
      case 'cancel':
        out.cancel = isStaff;
        break;
    }
  }
  return out;
}

export function getActionLabel(action) {
  return ACTION_LABELS[action] ?? action;
}

export function isActionReasonRequired(action) {
  return !!ACTION_REASON_REQUIRED[action];
}

export function itemTypeOf(line) {
  if (!line) return 'other';
  if (line.is_serialized) return 'serialized';
  if (line.stock_item) return 'stock';
  return 'other';
}

export function formatDate(value) {
  if (!value) return '—';
  const d = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return '—';
  return d.toLocaleDateString();
}

export function formatDateTime(value) {
  if (!value) return '—';
  const d = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return '—';
  return d.toLocaleString();
}

export function formatMoney(value, currency) {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return '—';
  const raw = String(value).trim();
  const negative = raw.startsWith('-');
  const unsigned = negative ? raw.slice(1) : raw;
  const [whole, fraction = ''] = unsigned.split('.');
  const grouped = whole.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');
  const decimals = fraction.padEnd(2, '0').slice(0, 2);
  const amount = `${negative ? '-' : ''}${grouped || '0'}.${decimals}`;
  return currency ? `${currency} ${amount}` : amount;
}

export function formatQuantity(value) {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return '0';
  return String(value);
}

export function safeResults(data) {
  if (!data) return [];
  if (Array.isArray(data)) return data;
  return Array.isArray(data.results) ? data.results : [];
}

export function normalizePageUrl(url) {
  if (!url) return '';
  return String(url).replace(/^https?:\/\/[^/]+\/api/, '');
}

export async function fetchAll(url, { maxPages = 10 } = {}) {
  const rows = [];
  let next = url;
  let pages = 0;
  while (next && pages < maxPages) {
    const r = await api.get(next);
    rows.push(...safeResults(r.data));
    next = normalizePageUrl(r.data?.next);
    pages += 1;
  }
  return rows;
}

export function queryString(params = {}) {
  const search = new URLSearchParams();
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(params)) {
    if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') continue;
    search.set(key, String(value));
  }
  const text = search.toString();
  return text ? `?${text}` : '';
}

export function filenameFromContentDisposition(header, fallback = 'download') {
  if (!header) return fallback;
  const match = /filename\*?=(?:UTF-8'')?"?([^";]+)"?/i.exec(String(header));
  if (!match) return fallback;
  try { return decodeURIComponent(match[1].trim()); } catch { return match[1].trim() || fallback; }
}

function dec(value) { const n = Number(value); return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0; }
function money(value) { return value.toFixed(2); }
export function calculateDisplaySubtotal(lines, unitKey = 'estimated_unit_price') { return money((lines || []).reduce((sum, line) => sum + dec(line.quantity) * dec(line[unitKey]), 0)); }
export function calculateDisplayTax(lines) { return money((lines || []).reduce((sum, line) => sum + dec(line.tax), 0)); }
export function calculateDisplayDiscount(lines) { return money((lines || []).reduce((sum, line) => sum + dec(line.discount), 0)); }
export function calculateDisplayTotal(lines) { return money(dec(calculateDisplaySubtotal(lines)) + dec(calculateDisplayTax(lines)) - dec(calculateDisplayDiscount(lines))); }
export function estimateRequestTotal(items) { const total = (items || []).reduce((sum, line) => { const lineTotal = dec(line.estimated_total) || (dec(line.quantity) * dec(line.estimated_unit_price)); return sum + lineTotal; }, 0); return total.toFixed(2); }
export function remainingQuantity(line) { if (!line) return 0; const booked = dec(line.received_qty) + dec(line.rejected_qty) + dec(line.damaged_qty); return Math.max(0, dec(line.quantity) - booked); }
export function acceptedQuantity(line) { if (!line) return 0; return Math.max(0, dec(line.quantity_received) - dec(line.quantity_rejected) - dec(line.quantity_damaged)); }
export function receiptSummary(receipt) { const items = receipt?.items || []; return items.reduce((acc, line) => ({ received: acc.received + dec(line.quantity_received), accepted: acc.accepted + acceptedQuantity(line), rejected: acc.rejected + dec(line.quantity_rejected), damaged: acc.damaged + dec(line.quantity_damaged) }), { received: 0, accepted: 0, rejected: 0, damaged: 0 }); }
export function totalsByCurrency(rows, amountKey = 'total', currencyKey = 'currency') { const groups = new Map(); for (const row of rows || []) { const currency = row?.[currencyKey] || '—'; const current = groups.get(currency) || 0; groups.set(currency, current + dec(row?.[amountKey])); } return [...groups.entries()].map(([currency, amount]) => ({ currency, amount: amount.toFixed(2) })); }
export function moneyFor(row, key = 'total') { return formatMoney(row?.[key], row?.currency); }

export function actionAvailability({ request, purchaseOrder, caps, userId } = {}) {
  const c = caps || {};
  const isRequester = !!request && !!userId && request.requester === userId;
  const prStatus = request?.status;
  const poStatus = purchaseOrder?.status;
  const isPoCreator = !!purchaseOrder && !!userId && purchaseOrder.created_by === userId;
  return {
    submitRequest: !!c.canCreatePurchaseRequest && (isRequester || !!c.canApprovePurchaseRequest) && (prStatus === 'draft' || prStatus === 'returned_for_correction'),
    approveRequest: !!c.canApprovePurchaseRequest && prStatus === 'pending_approval' && !isRequester,
    rejectRequest: !!c.canApprovePurchaseRequest && prStatus === 'pending_approval' && !isRequester,
    returnRequest: !!c.canApprovePurchaseRequest && prStatus === 'pending_approval',
    editRequest: !!c.canCreatePurchaseRequest && (prStatus === 'draft' || prStatus === 'returned_for_correction'),
    manageQuotations: !!c.canManageQuotations && prStatus === 'approved',
    selectVendor: !!c.canSelectProcurementVendor && prStatus === 'approved',
    generateOrder: !!c.canCreatePurchaseOrder && prStatus === 'approved',
    approveOrder: !!c.canApprovePurchaseOrder && poStatus === 'pending_approval' && !isPoCreator,
    rejectOrder: !!c.canApprovePurchaseOrder && poStatus === 'pending_approval' && !isPoCreator,
    issueOrder: !!c.canIssuePurchaseOrder && poStatus === 'approved',
    createReceipt: !!c.canCreateGoodsReceipt && ['sent_to_vendor', 'partially_received', 'approved'].includes(poStatus),
  };
}

export function procurementCapabilities(auth) {
  const role = auth?.role;
  // Inactive accounts fail closed when the auth payload exposes active state.
  const inactive = auth?.user?.is_active === false;
  const isSystemAdmin = !inactive && (!!auth?.isSystemAdmin || role === 'system_admin' || !!auth?.isSuperuser);
  const isManager = !inactive && (!!auth?.isITManager || role === 'it_manager');
  const isSupport = !inactive && (!!auth?.isITSupport || role === 'it_support');
  const isKnownStaff = !inactive && (isSystemAdmin || isManager || isSupport);
  const financialControls = isSystemAdmin || isManager;
  return {
    canViewProcurement: isKnownStaff,
    canCreatePurchaseRequest: isKnownStaff,
    canApprovePurchaseRequest: financialControls,
    canManageQuotations: isKnownStaff,
    canSelectProcurementVendor: financialControls,
    canCreatePurchaseOrder: financialControls,
    canApprovePurchaseOrder: financialControls,
    canIssuePurchaseOrder: financialControls,
    canCreateGoodsReceipt: isKnownStaff,
    canPostGoodsReceipt: isKnownStaff,
    canRegisterProcurementAssets: isKnownStaff,
    canViewProcurementReports: financialControls,
    canManageProcurementFinance: financialControls,
    canApproveSupplierInvoice: financialControls,
    canMarkSupplierInvoicePaymentReady: financialControls,
    canRecordSupplierInvoicePayment: financialControls,
    canRecordPayment: financialControls,
    canApproveVendorReturn: financialControls,
    canApproveVendorCreditNote: financialControls,
    canAcceptInvoiceException: financialControls,
    canManageFinancialControls: financialControls,
  };
}

const FINANCIAL_TERMINAL = ['paid', 'closed', 'cancelled'];

/** Action availability mirrored from the backend P3 viewsets. UX only. */
export function invoiceActionState(invoice, caps = {}, userId) {
  const c = caps || {};
  const status = invoice?.status;
  const isCreator = !!invoice && userId !== undefined && invoice.created_by === userId;
  const financial = !!c.canManageProcurementFinance;
  const settled = FINANCIAL_TERMINAL.includes(status);
  return {
    canSubmit: status === 'draft',
    canMatch: !!c.canViewProcurement && !['paid', 'closed', 'cancelled', 'rejected'].includes(status),
    canApprove: financial && !isCreator && ['matched', 'exception'].includes(status),
    canReject: financial && !settled,
    canReturnForCorrection: financial && !settled,
    canPlaceHold: financial && !settled,
    canReleaseHold: financial && !!invoice?.payment_hold,
    canMarkPaymentReady: financial && status === 'approved',
    canRecordPayment: financial && status === 'payment_ready' && invoice?.payment_status === 'ready',
    canCancel: financial && !['paid', 'closed'].includes(status),
    canClose: financial && status === 'paid',
    canAddLine: status === 'draft',
    isCreator,
  };
}

export function vendorReturnActionState(vendorReturn, caps = {}, userId, isSystemAdmin = false) {
  const c = caps || {};
  const status = vendorReturn?.status;
  const isCreator = !!vendorReturn && userId !== undefined && vendorReturn.created_by === userId;
  const financial = !!c.canApproveVendorReturn;
  return {
    canSubmit: status === 'draft',
    canApprove: financial && status === 'pending_approval' && (!isCreator || !!isSystemAdmin),
    canReject: financial && ['pending_approval', 'approved'].includes(status),
    canShip: financial && status === 'approved',
    canRecordReplacement: financial && ['shipped', 'partially_resolved'].includes(status),
    canComplete: financial && ['approved', 'shipped', 'partially_resolved'].includes(status),
    canCancel: financial && !['resolved', 'shipped'].includes(status),
    canAddLine: status === 'draft',
    isCreator,
  };
}

export function vendorCreditNoteActionState(creditNote, caps = {}, userId, isSystemAdmin = false) {
  const c = caps || {};
  const status = creditNote?.status;
  const isCreator = !!creditNote && userId !== undefined && creditNote.created_by === userId;
  const financial = !!c.canApproveVendorCreditNote;
  return {
    canSubmit: status === 'draft',
    canApprove: financial && status === 'submitted' && (!isCreator || !!isSystemAdmin),
    canReject: financial && !['applied', 'cancelled'].includes(status),
    canApply: financial && status === 'approved',
    canCancel: financial && status !== 'applied',
    isCreator,
  };
}

const PERMISSION_DENIED = 'You do not have permission to perform this action.';
const RECORD_UNAVAILABLE = 'This Procurement record is unavailable or you no longer have access.';

export function procurementErrorText(error, fallback = 'Request failed.') {
  const status = error?.response?.status;
  if (status === 403) return PERMISSION_DENIED;
  if (status === 404) return RECORD_UNAVAILABLE;
  const parsed = parseFieldErrors(error);
  if (parsed?.global) return parsed.global;
  const fieldMessages = Object.entries(parsed?.fields || {}).map(([field, msg]) => `${field.replace(/_/g, ' ')}: ${msg}`);
  return fieldMessages.length ? fieldMessages.join(' ') : fallback;
}

export function recordConflictText(recordType) {
  return `This ${recordType} changed while you were working. The latest version has been loaded.`;
}

export function procurementOverview({ requests = [], orders = [], receipts = [] } = {}) {
  const discrepancies = [];
  for (const receipt of receipts) {
    for (const line of receipt.items || []) {
      if (dec(line.quantity_rejected) > 0 || dec(line.quantity_damaged) > 0) discrepancies.push({ receipt, line });
    }
  }
  const units = (rows, key) => rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + dec(row[key]), 0);
  return {
    draftRequests: requests.filter((r) => r.status === 'draft').length,
    pendingRequestApprovals: requests.filter((r) => r.status === 'pending_approval').length,
    pendingOrderApprovals: orders.filter((o) => o.status === 'pending_approval').length,
    issuedOrders: orders.filter((o) => ['sent_to_vendor', 'partially_received'].includes(o.status)).length,
    partiallyReceived: orders.filter((o) => o.status === 'partially_received').length,
    discrepancies: discrepancies.length,
    requests: requests.length,
    orders: orders.length,
    receipts: receipts.length,
    orderedUnits: units(orders.flatMap((o) => o.items || []), 'quantity'),
    acceptedUnits: units(receipts.flatMap((r) => r.items || []), 'quantity_received'),
  };
}
