import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, waitFor, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: {
    get: (...args) => mockGet(...args),
  },
}));

vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({ useAuth: (...args) => mockAuth(...args) }));

import { ApprovalCenter } from '../../pages/approvals/ApprovalCenter';

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({ isStaff: false });
  mockGet.mockResolvedValue({ data: { approvals: [], total: 0 } });
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('ApprovalCenter', () => {
  it('shows empty state when not staff', () => {
    render(<ApprovalCenter />);
    expect(screen.getByText('Approvals')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Only staff can access approvals.')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('loads and renders approval list when staff', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue({ isStaff: true });
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { approvals: [] } });
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { total_pending: 0, service_requests: 0, disposals: 0, procurement: 0, workflow: 0, knowledge_base: 0, by_type: {} } });

    render(<ApprovalCenter />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByText('No pending approvals')).toBeTruthy());
    expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/approvals/');
    expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/approvals/counts/');
  });

  it('shows error state when request fails', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue({ isStaff: true });
    mockGet.mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('network error'));

    render(<ApprovalCenter />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText('Could not load pending approvals.')).toBeTruthy());
  });
});


===== src\__tests__\assets\asset-object-urls.test.jsx =====

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockPost, mockPatch, mockDelete, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockPost: vi.fn(),
  mockPatch: vi.fn(),
  mockDelete: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: {
    get: (...a) => mockGet(...a),
    post: (...a) => mockPost(...a),
    patch: (...a) => mockPatch(...a),
    delete: (...a) => mockDelete(...a),
  },
}));

vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({
  useAuth: (...a) => mockAuth(...a),
}));

import { AssetDetail } from '../../pages/assets/Assets';

const ASSET = {
  id: 3, asset_tag: 'LT-1', name: 'ThinkPad', status: 'available',
  category: 1, category_name: 'Laptop', assigned_to: null,
  assigned_to_email: null, serial_number: '', location: '',
  purchase_date: null, warranty_expiry: null, purchase_cost: null,
  description: '',
};

const ATTACHMENTS = [
  { id: 11, original_filename: 'photo.png', created_at: '2026-01-01T09:00:00Z' },
  { id: 12, original_filename: 'photo2.png', created_at: '2026-01-02T09:00:00Z' },
];

let blobCounter = 0;
let createdUrls = [];
let revokeMock;

function route(url) {
  if (url === '/assets/3/') return { data: ASSET };
  if (url === '/assets/assignments/history/') return { data: [] };
  if (url === '/assets/attachments/') return { data: { results: ATTACHMENTS } };
  if (url === '/assets/histories/') return { data: [] };
  if (url === '/assets/maintenance/') return { data: { results: [] } };
  if (url === '/assets/disposals/') return { data: { results: [] } };
  if (/^\/assets\/attachments\/1[12]\/download\/$/.test(url)) {
    return {
      data: new Blob([url], { type: 'image/png' }),
      headers: { 'content-disposition': `attachment; filename="${url.includes('11') ? 'photo.png' : 'photo2.png'}"` },
    };
  }
  throw new Error(`unexpected GET ${url}`);
}

/** Record the delayed-revocation callbacks so tests can fire them in any order. */
let delayedCallbacks = [];
let realSetTimeout;

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({ isStaff: true, user: { role: 'it_support' } });
  mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => route(url));
  mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
  mockPatch.mockResolvedValue({ data: ASSET });
  mockDelete.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });

  blobCounter = 0;
  createdUrls = [];
  delayedCallbacks = [];
  URL.createObjectURL = vi.fn(() => {
    blobCounter += 1;
    const url = `blob:test-${blobCounter}`;
    createdUrls.push(url);
    return url;
  });
  revokeMock = vi.fn();
  URL.revokeObjectURL = revokeMock;

  vi.spyOn(HTMLAnchorElement.prototype, 'click').mockImplementation(() => {});

  realSetTimeout = globalThis.setTimeout;
  vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'setTimeout').mockImplementation((cb, delay, ...rest) => {
    if (delay === 5000) {
      delayedCallbacks.push(cb);
      return 0;
    }
    return realSetTimeout(cb, delay, ...rest);
  });
});

afterEach(() => {
  vi.restoreAllMocks();
  cleanup();
});

async function renderDetail() {
  render(<AssetDetail id="3" />);
  await screen.findByText('ThinkPad');
  await screen.findByText('photo.png');
}

describe('AssetDetail object URL lifecycle', () => {
  it('revokes a download URL exactly once after the delayed cleanup runs', async () => {
    await renderDetail();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getAllByRole('button', { name: 'Download' })[0]);

    await waitFor(() => expect(URL.createObjectURL).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    const url = createdUrls[0];
    expect(revokeMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    delayedCallbacks[0]();
    expect(revokeMock.mock.calls.filter(([u]) => u === url)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('does not let a previous download cleanup revoke a newer active download URL', async () => {
    await renderDetail();

    // Download A, then B before A's delayed cleanup fires.
    fireEvent.click(screen.getAllByRole('button', { name: 'Download' })[0]);
    await waitFor(() => expect(URL.createObjectURL).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getAllByRole('button', { name: 'Download' })[1]);
    await waitFor(() => expect(URL.createObjectURL).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2));

    const [urlA, urlB] = createdUrls;
    expect(urlA).not.toBe(urlB);

    // A's stale timer must not touch B's live URL.
    delayedCallbacks[0]();
    expect(revokeMock.mock.calls.filter(([u]) => u === urlB)).toHaveLength(0);

    // A's own URL is reclaimed (at most once per timer).
    expect(revokeMock.mock.calls.filter(([u]) => u === urlA).length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
  });

  it('revokes the preview URL when the preview is closed', async () => {
    await renderDetail();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Preview photo.png' }));

    await waitFor(() => expect(document.querySelector('.preview-media img')).toBeTruthy());
    const url = document.querySelector('.preview-media img').getAttribute('src');
    expect(revokeMock.mock.calls.filter(([u]) => u === url)).toHaveLength(0);

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Close' }));
    expect(revokeMock.mock.calls.filter(([u]) => u === url)).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(document.querySelector('.preview-media img')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('replaces a preview URL and keeps the currently displayed image on a live URL', async () => {
    await renderDetail();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Preview photo.png' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(document.querySelector('.preview-media img')).toBeTruthy());
    const firstUrl = document.querySelector('.preview-media img').getAttribute('src');

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Close' }));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Preview photo2.png' }));
    await waitFor(() => {
      const el = document.querySelector('.preview-media img');
      expect(el).toBeTruthy();
      expect(el.getAttribute('src')).not.toBe(firstUrl);
    });
    const secondUrl = document.querySelector('.preview-media img').getAttribute('src');
    expect(revokeMock.mock.calls.filter(([u]) => u === secondUrl)).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('revokes the open preview URL when the component unmounts', async () => {
    render(<AssetDetail id="3" />);
    await screen.findByText('ThinkPad');
    await screen.findByText('photo.png');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Preview photo.png' }));

    await waitFor(() => expect(document.querySelector('.preview-media img')).toBeTruthy());
    const url = document.querySelector('.preview-media img').getAttribute('src');

    cleanup();
    expect(revokeMock.mock.calls.filter(([u]) => u === url)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('revokes the pending download URL when the component unmounts before the timer fires', async () => {
    await renderDetail();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getAllByRole('button', { name: 'Download' })[0]);
    await waitFor(() => expect(URL.createObjectURL).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    const url = createdUrls[0];

    cleanup();
    expect(revokeMock.mock.calls.filter(([u]) => u === url)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('does not leave a stale busy state after a failed download', async () => {
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      if (url === '/assets/attachments/11/download/') {
        throw { response: { status: 410, data: new Blob(['{}']) } };
      }
      return route(url);
    });
    await renderDetail();
    const buttons = screen.getAllByRole('button', { name: 'Download' });
    fireEvent.click(buttons[0]);

    expect(await screen.findByText('File is missing from storage.')).toBeTruthy();
    const after = screen.getAllByRole('button', { name: 'Download' });
    expect(after[0].disabled).toBe(false);
    expect(URL.createObjectURL).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('does not leave broken object URL state after a failed preview', async () => {
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      if (url === '/assets/attachments/11/download/') {
        throw { response: { status: 403, data: new Blob(['{}']) } };
      }
      return route(url);
    });
    await renderDetail();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Preview photo.png' }));

    expect(await screen.findByText('You do not have permission to preview this file.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(document.querySelector('.preview-media img')).toBeNull();
    expect(URL.createObjectURL).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

===== src\__tests__\assets\assets-attachment-navigation.test.jsx =====

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, cleanup, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockPost, mockDelete, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockPost: vi.fn(),
  mockDelete: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: {
    get: (...a) => mockGet(...a),
    post: (...a) => mockPost(...a),
    delete: (...a) => mockDelete(...a),
  },
}));
vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({ useAuth: () => mockAuth() }));

import { AssetDetail } from '../../pages/assets/Assets';

function baseAsset(id, tag) {
  return { id, asset_tag: tag, name: `Asset ${tag}`, status: 'available' };
}

function deferred() {
  let resolve, reject;
  const promise = new Promise((res, rej) => { resolve = res; reject = rej; });
  return { promise, resolve, reject };
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({ isStaff: true, user: { role: 'it_support' } });
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('AssetDetail attachment navigation', () => {
  it('loads and displays asset A own attachment', async () => {
    const dA = deferred();
    mockGet.mockImplementation((url, cfg) => {
      if (url === '/assets/1/') return Promise.resolve({ data: baseAsset(1, 'A1') });
      if (url === '/assets/attachments/' && cfg?.params?.asset == 1) return dA.promise;
      return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [] } });
    });
    render(<AssetDetail id="1" />);
    dA.resolve({ data: { results: [{ id: 11, original_filename: 'file-a.pdf' }] } });
    expect(await screen.findByText('file-a.pdf')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('clears asset A attachment when navigating to asset B', async () => {
    const dA = deferred();
    const dB = deferred();
    mockGet.mockImplementation((url, cfg) => {
      if (url === '/assets/1/') return Promise.resolve({ data: baseAsset(1, 'A1') });
      if (url === '/assets/2/') return Promise.resolve({ data: baseAsset(2, 'A2') });
      if (url === '/assets/attachments/' && cfg?.params?.asset == 1) return dA.promise;
      if (url === '/assets/attachments/' && cfg?.params?.asset == 2) return dB.promise;
      return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [] } });
    });
    const { rerender } = render(<AssetDetail id="1" />);
    dA.resolve({ data: { results: [{ id: 11, original_filename: 'file-a.pdf' }] } });
    expect(await screen.findByText('file-a.pdf')).toBeTruthy();

    rerender(<AssetDetail id="2" />);
    expect(screen.queryByText('file-a.pdf')).toBeNull();

    dB.resolve({ data: { results: [{ id: 22, original_filename: 'file-b.pdf' }] } });
    expect(await screen.findByText('file-b.pdf')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByText('file-a.pdf')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('shows no attachments for an asset with none', async () => {
    mockGet.mockImplementation((url, cfg) => {
      if (url === '/assets/1/') return Promise.resolve({ data: baseAsset(1, 'A1') });
      if (url === '/assets/2/') return Promise.resolve({ data: baseAsset(2, 'A2') });
      if (url === '/assets/attachments/' && cfg?.params?.asset == 1) {
        return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [{ id: 11, original_filename: 'file-a.pdf' }] } });
      }
      return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [] } });
    });
    const { rerender } = render(<AssetDetail id="1" />);
    expect(await screen.findByText('file-a.pdf')).toBeTruthy();

    rerender(<AssetDetail id="2" />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByText('file-a.pdf')).toBeNull());
    expect(screen.getByText('No attachments.')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('prevents a late asset A response from overwriting asset B', async () => {
    const dA = deferred();
    const dB = deferred();
    mockGet.mockImplementation((url, cfg) => {
      if (url === '/assets/1/') return Promise.resolve({ data: baseAsset(1, 'A1') });
      if (url === '/assets/2/') return Promise.resolve({ data: baseAsset(2, 'A2') });
      if (url === '/assets/attachments/' && cfg?.params?.asset == 1) return dA.promise;
      if (url === '/assets/attachments/' && cfg?.params?.asset == 2) return dB.promise;
      return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [] } });
    });
    const { rerender } = render(<AssetDetail id="1" />);
    rerender(<AssetDetail id="2" />);
    dB.resolve({ data: { results: [{ id: 22, original_filename: 'file-b.pdf' }] } });
    expect(await screen.findByText('file-b.pdf')).toBeTruthy();

    dA.resolve({ data: { results: [{ id: 11, original_filename: 'file-a.pdf' }] } });
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 0));
    expect(screen.queryByText('file-a.pdf')).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.getByText('file-b.pdf')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('clears attachments when the request fails', async () => {
    mockGet.mockImplementation((url, cfg) => {
      if (url === '/assets/1/') return Promise.resolve({ data: baseAsset(1, 'A1') });
      if (url === '/assets/attachments/' && cfg?.params?.asset == 1) {
        return Promise.reject(new Error('boom'));
      }
      return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [] } });
    });
    render(<AssetDetail id="1" />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText('No attachments.')).toBeTruthy());
    expect(screen.queryByText('file-a.pdf')).toBeNull();
  });
});

import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockPost, mockPatch, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({

  mockPost: vi.fn(),

}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: {
    get: (...args) => mockGet(...args),

  },

vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({
  useAuth: (...args) => mockAuth(...args),
}));

import { AssetForm } from '../../pages/assets/Assets';

const CREATED = {
  id: 9, asset_tag: 'LT-9', name: 'New box', status: 'available',
  serial_number: 'SN-9', category: 1, category_name: 'Laptop',
};

function route(url) {
  if (url === '/assets/categories/') return { data: { results: [] } };
  if (url === '/accounts/departments/') return { data: { results: [] } };
  throw new Error(`unexpected GET ${url}`);
}

function fillRequiredFields() {
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByPlaceholderText(/LT-0001/), {
    target: { value: 'LT-9' },
  });
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByPlaceholderText(/ThinkPad T14/), {
    target: { value: 'New box' },
  });
}

function chooseFile(name = 'spec.pdf') {
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/attachment/i), {
    target: { files: [new File(['x'], name, { type: 'application/pdf' })] },
  });
}

const createCalls = () =>
  mockPost.mock.calls.filter(([url]) => url === '/assets/');
const uploadCalls = () =>
  mockPost.mock.calls.filter(([url]) => url === '/assets/attachments/');

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  window.location.hash = '';
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({ isStaff: true, user: { role: 'it_support' } });
  mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => route(url));
  mockPatch.mockResolvedValue({ data: CREATED });
  // Default: an attachment upload succeeds.
  mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: { id: 1, original_filename: 'spec.pdf' } });
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('AssetForm create-then-upload', () => {
  it('creates the asset first, then uploads the file to the new id', async () => {
    mockPost.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      if (url === '/assets/') return { data: CREATED };
      return { data: { id: 1, original_filename: 'spec.pdf' } };
    });
    render(<AssetForm />);
    await screen.findByText('New asset');
    fillRequiredFields();
    chooseFile();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create asset' }));

    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2));
    expect(createCalls()).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(createCalls()[0][1].asset_tag).toBe('LT-9');
    const [uploadUrl, fd] = uploadCalls()[0];
    expect(uploadUrl).toBe('/assets/attachments/');
    expect(fd).toBeInstanceOf(FormData);
    expect(fd.get('asset')).toBe('9');
    expect(fd.get('file')).toBeInstanceOf(File);
    await waitFor(() => expect(window.location.hash).toBe('#/assets/9'));
  });

  it('sends JSON with no file when none was chosen', async () => {
    mockPost.mockImplementation(async () => ({ data: CREATED }));
    render(<AssetForm />);
    await screen.findByText('New asset');
    fillRequiredFields();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create asset' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    expect(createCalls()[0][1]).toBeTypeOf('object');
    expect(uploadCalls()).toHaveLength(0);
    await waitFor(() => expect(window.location.hash).toBe('#/assets/9'));
  });

  it('reports the partial outcome and retries the upload without re-creating', async () => {
    mockPost
      .mockImplementationOnce(async () => ({ data: CREATED }))
      .mockRejectedValueOnce({
        response: { status: 500, data: { detail: 'Storage unavailable.' } },
      });
    render(<AssetForm />);
    await screen.findByText('New asset');
    fillRequiredFields();
    chooseFile();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create asset' }));

    // Banner explains both halves: asset exists, file does not.
    const banner = await screen.findByText(/was created, but/i);
    expect(banner.textContent).toMatch(/#9/);
    expect(banner.textContent).toMatch(/LT-9/);
    expect(banner.textContent).toMatch(/Storage unavailable\./);
    expect(banner.textContent).toMatch(/will not create a second asset/);
    // Stays on the form; the create button is locked so a resubmit cannot
    // produce a twin asset.
    expect(window.location.hash).toBe('');
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create asset' }).disabled).toBe(true);

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retry upload' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3));
    expect(uploadCalls()).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(createCalls()).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(uploadCalls()[1][1].get('asset')).toBe('9');
    await waitFor(() => expect(window.location.hash).toBe('#/assets/9'));
  });

  it('keeps the banner and the upload-only retry after a second failure', async () => {
    mockPost
      .mockImplementationOnce(async () => ({ data: CREATED }))
      .mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 400, data: { file: ['Too large.'] } } })
      .mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 400, data: { file: ['Too large.'] } } });
    render(<AssetForm />);
    await screen.findByText('New asset');
    fillRequiredFields();
    chooseFile('huge.pdf');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create asset' }));

    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Retry upload' }));
    const banner = await screen.findByText(/was created, but/i);
    expect(banner.textContent).toMatch(/Too large\./);
    expect(createCalls()).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(uploadCalls()).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(window.location.hash).toBe('');
  });

  it('rejects a disallowed file type before creating anything', async () => {
    render(<AssetForm />);
    await screen.findByText('New asset');
    fillRequiredFields();
    chooseFile('setup.exe');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create asset' }));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByRole('alert').textContent).toMatch(/not an allowed file type/i);
    });
    expect(mockPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('rejects an oversized file before creating anything', async () => {
    render(<AssetForm />);
    await screen.findByText('New asset');
    fillRequiredFields();
    const big = new File(['x'], 'huge.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' });
    Object.defineProperty(big, 'size', { value: 11 * 1024 * 1024 });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/attachment/i), {
      target: { files: [big] },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create asset' }));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByRole('alert').textContent).toMatch(/maximum upload size is 10 MB/i);
    });
    expect(mockPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('shows a field-level error when the server rejects the file or serial', async () => {
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({
      response: {
        status: 400,
        data: { serial_number: ["Serial number 'SN-9' is already used by another asset."] },
      },
      message: 'Request failed with status code 400',
    });
    render(<AssetForm />);
    await screen.findByText('New asset');
    fillRequiredFields();
    chooseFile();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create asset' }));
    // Nothing was created, so nothing to retry: the error lands on the field.
    expect(await screen.findByText(/already used by another asset/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(uploadCalls()).toHaveLength(0);
});

});

import { Assets } from '../../pages';

const A_AVAILABLE = {
  id: 1, asset_tag: 'PR-1', name: 'LaserJet', status: 'available',
  category_name: 'Printer', department_name: 'Finance',

const PAGE = { results: [A_AVAILABLE, A_ASSIGNED, A_RETIRED], count: 3, next: null, previous: null };

function route(url) {
  const p = String(url).split('?')[0];
  if (p === '/assets/') return { data: PAGE };
  if (p.startsWith('/assets/categories/')) return { data: { results: [{ id: 1, name: 'Hardware', is_active: true }] } };
  if (p.startsWith('/accounts/departments/')) {
    return { data: { results: [{ id: 1, name: 'Finance', code: 'FIN', is_active: true }] } };
  }
  if (p.startsWith('/accounts/users/')) {
    return { data: { results: [{ id: 4, employee_id: 'EMP-4', email: 'emp@local', is_active: true }] } };
  }
  throw new Error(`unexpected GET ${url}`);
}

function staff() {
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({ isStaff: true, user: { role: 'it_support' } });
}
function employee() {
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({ isStaff: false, user: { role: 'employee' } });
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => route(url));
  mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: A_AVAILABLE });

  });

    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Edit PR-1')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Assign PR-1')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Retire PR-1')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByLabelText('Return PR-1')).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Return LT-2')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByLabelText('Assign LT-2')).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Edit MN-3')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByLabelText('Retire MN-3')).toBeNull();
  });

  });

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retire asset' }));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/assets/1/retire/');
    });
  });

  it('assign modal submits employee id and note to the assign endpoint', async () => {
    staff();
    render(<Assets />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByLabelText('Assign PR-1')).toBeTruthy());
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByLabelText('Assign PR-1'));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.findByText('Assign PR-1')).resolves.toBeTruthy());
    // Submit stays blocked until an employee is picked.
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Assign' }));
    expect(mockPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Assignee'), { target: { value: '4' } });
    // Controlled select state flushes synchronously; confirm submit enabled.
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Assign' }).disabled).toBe(false);
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByPlaceholderText('Reasonâ€¦'), { target: { value: 'New hire setup' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Assign' }));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/assets/1/assign/', {
        assigned_to: 4, note: 'New hire setup',

  it('surfaces a failed row action as an inline alert and closes its dialog', async () => {

===== src\__tests__\assets\assets-workflow.test.jsx =====

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockPost, mockPatch, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockPost: vi.fn(),
  mockPatch: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: {
    get: (...args) => mockGet(...args),
    post: (...args) => mockPost(...args),
    patch: (...args) => mockPatch(...args),
  },
}));

vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({
  useAuth: (...args) => mockAuth(...args),
}));

import { AssetDetail, AssetForm } from '../../pages/assets/Assets';

const ASSET = {
  id: 3, asset_tag: 'LT-1', name: 'ThinkPad', status: 'available',
  category: 1, category_name: 'Laptop', assigned_to: null,
  assigned_to_email: null, serial_number: '', location: '',
  purchase_date: null, warranty_expiry: null, purchase_cost: null,
  description: '',
};

function staff() {
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({ isStaff: true, user: { role: 'it_support' } });
}

function route(url) {
  if (url === '/assets/3/') return { data: ASSET };
  if (url === '/assets/assignments/history/') return { data: [] };
  if (url === '/assets/attachments/') return { data: [] };
  if (url === '/assets/histories/') return { data: [] };
  if (url === '/assets/categories/') return { data: { results: [] } };
  throw new Error(`unexpected GET ${url}`);
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => route(url));
  mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: ASSET });
  mockPatch.mockResolvedValue({ data: ASSET });
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('Asset mark-lost workflow', () => {
  it('opens the dialog, requires a reason, and posts it', async () => {
    staff();
    render(<AssetDetail id="3" />);
    expect(await screen.findByText('ThinkPad')).toBeTruthy();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Mark lostâ€¦' }));
    const submit = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Mark lost' });
    // Required reason: blank stays disabled.
    expect(submit.disabled).toBe(true);
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByPlaceholderText(/last seen/i), {
      target: { value: 'Vanished from desk.' },
    });
    expect(submit.disabled).toBe(false);
    fireEvent.click(submit);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/assets/3/mark_lost/', {
        reason: 'Vanished from desk.',
      });
    });
  });

  it('shows backend errors without closing the dialog', async () => {

    render(<AssetDetail id="3" />);
    await screen.findByText('ThinkPad');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Mark lostâ€¦' }));

      target: { value: 'x' },

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Mark lost' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('A reason is required.')).toBeTruthy();
  });

describe('AssetForm status dropdown', () => {
  // NOTE: Field labels are not htmlFor-associated, so selects are found
  // by role order: category select first, status select second.
  const statusSelect = () => screen.getAllByRole('combobox')[1];

  it('disables dedicated-workflow statuses on edit', async () => {
    staff();
    render(<AssetForm id="3" />);
    await screen.findByText('Edit asset #3');
    const options = [...statusSelect().querySelectorAll('option')];
    const byValue = Object.fromEntries(options.map((o) => [o.value, o.disabled]));
    expect(byValue.available).toBe(false);
    expect(byValue.in_repair).toBe(false);
    expect(byValue.assigned).toBe(true);
    expect(byValue.retired).toBe(true);
    expect(byValue.lost).toBe(true);
  });

  it('keeps the current status selectable when resubmitting', async () => {
    staff();
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      if (url === '/assets/3/') {
        return { data: { ...ASSET, status: 'retired' } };
      }
      return route(url);
    });
    render(<AssetForm id="3" />);
    await screen.findByText('Edit asset #3');
    const select = statusSelect();
    const options = [...select.querySelectorAll('option')];
    const byValue = Object.fromEntries(options.map((o) => [o.value, o.disabled]));

const ATTACHMENTS = [
  { id: 11, original_filename: 'report.pdf', created_at: '2026-01-01T09:00:00Z' },
  { id: 12, original_filename: 'specs.docx', created_at: '2026-01-02T09:00:00Z' },
];

describe('AssetDetail attachment download', () => {
  let anchors;
  let clickSpy;

  const detailRoute = (url) => {
    if (url === '/assets/3/') return { data: ASSET };
    if (url === '/assets/assignments/history/') return { data: [] };
    if (url === '/assets/attachments/') return { data: { results: ATTACHMENTS } };
    if (url === '/assets/histories/') return { data: [] };
    if (url === '/assets/maintenance/') return { data: { results: [] } };
    if (url === '/assets/disposals/') return { data: { results: [] } };
    if (url === '/assets/attachments/11/download/') {
      return {
        data: new Blob(['%PDF-1.4'], { type: 'application/pdf' }),
        headers: { 'content-disposition': 'attachment; filename="report.pdf"' },
      };
    }
    throw new Error(`unexpected GET ${url}`);
  };

  const clickingDownload = async () => {
    render(<AssetDetail id="3" />);
    await screen.findByText('report.pdf');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getAllByRole('button', { name: 'Download' })[0]);
  };

  beforeEach(() => {
    staff();
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => detailRoute(url));
    anchors = [];
    const createElement = document.createElement.bind(document);
    vi.spyOn(document, 'createElement').mockImplementation((tag, ...rest) => {
      const el = createElement(tag, ...rest);
      if (String(tag).toLowerCase() === 'a') anchors.push(el);
      return el;
    });
    clickSpy = vi.spyOn(HTMLAnchorElement.prototype, 'click').mockImplementation(() => {});
    URL.createObjectURL = vi.fn(() => 'blob:mock');
    URL.revokeObjectURL = vi.fn();
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
    cleanup();
  });

  it('fetches the protected blob, clicks a temporary anchor, and revokes the object URL', async () => {
    const timeouts = vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'setTimeout');
    await clickingDownload();

    await waitFor(() => expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      '/assets/attachments/11/download/', { responseType: 'blob' },
    ));
    await waitFor(() => expect(URL.createObjectURL).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));

    const anchor = anchors.find((a) => a.download === 'report.pdf');
    expect(anchor).toBeTruthy();
    expect(anchor.href).toBe('blob:mock');
    expect(clickSpy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    // The anchor is removed from the document straight after the click.
    expect(anchor.isConnected).toBe(false);

    const revoke = timeouts.mock.calls.find(([, delay]) => delay === 5000)?.[0];
    expect(typeof revoke).toBe('function');
    revoke();
    expect(URL.revokeObjectURL).toHaveBeenCalledWith('blob:mock');
  });

  it.each([
    [410, 'File is missing from storage.'],
    [404, 'Attachment not available (deleted or no access).'],
    [403, 'You do not have permission to download this file.'],
  ])('shows a safe message for a %s download failure', async (status, message) => {
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      if (url === '/assets/attachments/11/download/') {
        throw { response: { status, data: new Blob(['{"detail":"nope"}']) } };
      }
      return detailRoute(url);
    });
    await clickingDownload();
    expect(await screen.findByText(message)).toBeTruthy();
    // No object URL or anchor is produced for a failed download.
    expect(URL.createObjectURL).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(anchors.some((a) => a.download === 'report.pdf')).toBe(false);
  });
});


===== src\__tests__\audits\audit.test.jsx =====

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';

import { AuditLogPage } from '../../pages/audits/AuditLogPage';

const ROWS = [
  {
    id: 1, actor: 9, actor_email: 'a@x', action: 'create',
    entity_type: 'tickets.Ticket', object_id: '3', object_repr: '#3 Printer',
    timestamp: '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z', reason: '', details: {},
  },

function admin() {
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({ isAdmin: true });
}

function nonAdmin() {
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({ isAdmin: false });

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  mockGet.mockResolvedValue({ data: { results: ROWS, count: 1, next: null, previous: null } });

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('AuditLogPage', () => {
  it('hides the page from non-admins without calling the API', () => {
    nonAdmin();
    render(<AuditLogPage />);
    expect(screen.getByText('System administrators only.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockGet).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('lists entries for admins', async () => {
    admin();
    render(<AuditLogPage />);
    expect(await screen.findByText('#3 Printer')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/common/audit-logs/');
    expect(screen.getByText('a@x')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('applies action and date filters to the query', async () => {
    admin();
    render(<AuditLogPage />);
    await screen.findByText('#3 Printer');
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Filter by action'), {
      target: { value: 'hard_delete' },
    });
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(
        '/common/audit-logs/?action=hard_delete&page_size=20',
      );
    });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Start date'), {
      target: { value: '2024-01-01' },
    });
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(
        '/common/audit-logs/?action=hard_delete&date_from=2024-01-01&page_size=20',
      );
    });
  });

  it('rejects an end date before the start date without calling the API', async () => {
    admin();
    render(<AuditLogPage />);
    await screen.findByText('#3 Printer');
    const calls = mockGet.mock.calls.length;
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Start date'), {
      target: { value: '2024-02-01' },
    });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('End date'), {
      target: { value: '2024-01-01' },
    });
    expect(
      await screen.findByText('End date cannot be earlier than start date.'),
    ).toBeTruthy();
    // Only the start-date change fired; the invalid pair never did.
    expect(mockGet.mock.calls.length).toBe(calls + 1);
  });

  it('shows backend validation errors', async () => {
    admin();
    mockGet.mockRejectedValueOnce({
      response: { status: 400, data: { action: ['Unknown action.'] } },
    });
    render(<AuditLogPage />);
    expect(await screen.findByText('Unknown action.')).toBeTruthy();
  });
});


===== src\__tests__\auth\auth.test.jsx =====

import { describe, it, expect, vi, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, cleanup, act } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockPost, mockGet } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockPost: vi.fn(),
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: {
    post: mockPost,
    get: mockGet,
  },
}));

import { AuthProvider, useAuth } from '../../auth';

const capturedAuth = { current: null };
function Probe() {
  capturedAuth.current = useAuth(); // eslint-disable-line immutability
  return null;
}

function mount(getImpl) {
  localStorage.clear();
  mockPost.mockReset();
  mockGet.mockReset();
  mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
  mockGet.mockImplementation(
    getImpl || (() => Promise.resolve({ data: { id: 1, role: 'employee' } })),
  );
  localStorage.setItem('access', 'acc');
  localStorage.setItem('refresh', 'ref');
  return render(<AuthProvider><Probe /></AuthProvider>);
}

afterEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.useRealTimers();
  vi.resetAllMocks();
});

describe('AuthProvider logout blacklists the refresh token', () => {
  it('calls backend /accounts/logout/ with the refresh token', async () => {
    mount();
    mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: { detail: 'Logged out.' } });
    await act(async () => {
      await capturedAuth.current.logout();
    });
    expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/accounts/logout/', { refresh: 'ref' });
    expect(localStorage.getItem('access')).toBeNull();
    expect(localStorage.getItem('refresh')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('clears tokens locally even when the backend logout fails', async () => {
    mount();
    mockPost.mockRejectedValue(new Error('backend down'));
    await act(async () => {
      await capturedAuth.current.logout();
    });
    expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(localStorage.getItem('access')).toBeNull();
    expect(localStorage.getItem('refresh')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('clears tokens without calling the backend when no refresh token exists', async () => {
    mount();
    localStorage.removeItem('refresh');
    await act(async () => {
      await capturedAuth.current.logout();
    });
    expect(mockPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(localStorage.getItem('access')).toBeNull();
    expect(localStorage.getItem('refresh')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('drops the React session immediately, before the backend answers', async () => {
    // Security: the access token must not stay usable from the UI while the
    // best-effort blacklist call is still in flight.
    let resolveLogout;
    mount();
    mockPost.mockImplementationOnce(() => new Promise((resolve) => { resolveLogout = resolve; }));
    let pending;
    await act(async () => {
      pending = capturedAuth.current.logout();
    });
    expect(capturedAuth.current.access).toBeNull();
    expect(capturedAuth.current.user).toBeNull();
    expect(capturedAuth.current.profileLoading).toBe(false);
    await act(async () => {
      resolveLogout({ data: {} });
      await pending;
    });
    expect(localStorage.getItem('access')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('clears tokens when the backend never responds', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    mount();
    mockPost.mockImplementation(() => new Promise(() => {}));
    let pending;
    act(() => {
      pending = capturedAuth.current.logout();
    });
    expect(capturedAuth.current.access).toBeNull();

    await act(async () => {
      await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(5000);
    });
    await act(async () => {
      await pending;
    });
    expect(localStorage.getItem('access')).toBeNull();
    expect(localStorage.getItem('refresh')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('does not clobber a session created while logout was in flight', async () => {
    let resolveLogout;
    mount();
    mockPost.mockImplementation((url) => {
      if (url === '/accounts/logout/') {
        return new Promise((resolve) => { resolveLogout = resolve; });
      }
      return Promise.resolve({ data: { access: 'acc-2', refresh: 'ref-2' } });
    });
    let pending;
    await act(async () => {
      pending = capturedAuth.current.logout();
    });
    await act(async () => {
      await capturedAuth.current.login('user@example.com', 'pw');
    });
    expect(capturedAuth.current.access).toBe('acc-2');

    await act(async () => {
      resolveLogout({ data: {} });
      await pending;
    });
    expect(localStorage.getItem('access')).toBe('acc-2');
    expect(localStorage.getItem('refresh')).toBe('ref-2');
    expect(capturedAuth.current.access).toBe('acc-2');
  });
});

describe('AuthProvider ignores stale async results', () => {
  it('does not restore the user when /accounts/me/ resolves after logout', async () => {
    let resolveProfile;
    mount(() => new Promise((resolve) => { resolveProfile = resolve; }));
    await act(async () => {
      await capturedAuth.current.logout();
    });
    await act(async () => {
      resolveProfile({ data: { id: 9, role: 'system_admin' } });
    });
    expect(capturedAuth.current.user).toBeNull();
    expect(capturedAuth.current.access).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('cross-tab session sync', () => {
  it('logs out when another tab removes access from localStorage', async () => {
    mount();
    await act(async () => {
      window.dispatchEvent(new StorageEvent('storage', {
        key: 'access',
        newValue: null,
        oldValue: 'acc',
      }));
    });
    expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/accounts/logout/', { refresh: 'ref' });
    expect(localStorage.getItem('access')).toBeNull();
    expect(localStorage.getItem('refresh')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('mirrors a cross-tab logout after the shared tokens are already gone', async () => {
    // localStorage is shared by every tab, so a real storage event arrives
    // after the removal is already visible here (no per-tab copy to check).
    mount();
    localStorage.removeItem('access');
    localStorage.removeItem('refresh');
    await act(async () => {
      window.dispatchEvent(new StorageEvent('storage', {
        key: 'access',
        newValue: null,
        oldValue: 'acc',
      }));
    });
    expect(capturedAuth.current.access).toBeNull();
    expect(capturedAuth.current.user).toBeNull();
    // The tab that logged out already blacklisted the token.
    expect(mockPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('does not send a second logout request when the token is already gone', async () => {
    mount();
    await act(async () => {
      await capturedAuth.current.logout();
    });
    expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    await act(async () => {
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i += 1) {
        window.dispatchEvent(new StorageEvent('storage', {
          key: 'access',
          newValue: null,
          oldValue: 'acc',
        }));
      }
    });
    expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('ignores cross-tab access removal when this tab has no session', async () => {
    localStorage.clear();
    mockPost.mockReset();
    mockGet.mockReset();
    mockGet.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
    render(<AuthProvider><Probe /></AuthProvider>);
    await act(async () => {
      window.dispatchEvent(new StorageEvent('storage', {
        key: 'access',
        newValue: null,
        oldValue: null,
      }));
    });
    expect(mockPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(capturedAuth.current.access).toBeNull();
  });

  it('does not log out when another tab touches an unrelated key', async () => {
    mount();
    await act(async () => {
      window.dispatchEvent(new StorageEvent('storage', {
        key: 'unrelated',
        newValue: null,
      }));
    });
    expect(mockPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(localStorage.getItem('access')).toBe('acc');
    expect(localStorage.getItem('refresh')).toBe('ref');
  });

  it('invalidates the local session when another tab signs in as a different user', async () => {
    mount();
    await act(async () => {
      window.dispatchEvent(new StorageEvent('storage', {
        key: 'access',
        newValue: 'other-token',
        oldValue: 'acc',
      }));
    });
    // No backend logout call (the other tab owns its own session).
    expect(mockPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    // Local React state is invalidated so this tab does not show stale data.
    expect(capturedAuth.current.access).toBeNull();
    expect(capturedAuth.current.user).toBeNull();
    expect(capturedAuth.current.profileLoading).toBe(false);
    // The refresh token belonging to the old session is dropped.
    expect(localStorage.getItem('refresh')).toBeNull();
  });
});


===== src\__tests__\auth\verify-email.test.jsx =====

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, waitFor, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';
import React from 'react';

const { mockGet } = vi.hoisted(() => ({ mockGet: vi.fn() }));

import { VerifyEmail } from '../../pages';

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  window.location.hash = '';
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('VerifyEmail', () => {
  it('shows success after valid uid and token', async () => {
    window.location.hash = '#/verify-email?uid=abc&token=xyz';
    mockGet.mockResolvedValue({ data: { detail: 'Email verified.' } });
    render(<VerifyEmail />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText('Email verified.')).toBeTruthy());
    expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/accounts/verify-email/confirm/?uid=abc&token=xyz');
  });

  it('shows invalid link on backend rejection', async () => {
    window.location.hash = '#/verify-email?uid=abc&token=bad';
    mockGet.mockRejectedValue(new Error('bad'));
    render(<VerifyEmail />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText('Invalid or expired link.')).toBeTruthy());
  });

  it('shows invalid link when uid is missing', async () => {
    window.location.hash = '#/verify-email?token=xyz';
    render(<VerifyEmail />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText('Invalid or expired link.')).toBeTruthy());
    expect(mockGet).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('shows invalid link when token is missing', async () => {
    window.location.hash = '#/verify-email?uid=abc';
    render(<VerifyEmail />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText('Invalid or expired link.')).toBeTruthy());
    expect(mockGet).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('shows invalid link on network failure', async () => {
    window.location.hash = '#/verify-email?uid=abc&token=xyz';
    mockGet.mockRejectedValue(new Error('network'));
    render(<VerifyEmail />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText('Invalid or expired link.')).toBeTruthy());
  });

  it('shows loading state while request is pending', async () => {
    window.location.hash = '#/verify-email?uid=abc&token=xyz';
    let resolve;
    mockGet.mockReturnValue(new Promise((r) => { resolve = r; }));
    render(<VerifyEmail />);
    expect(screen.getByText('Verifying...')).toBeTruthy();
    resolve({ data: { detail: 'Email verified.' } });
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText('Email verified.')).toBeTruthy());
  });

  it('does not show success before backend confirmation', async () => {
    window.location.hash = '#/verify-email?uid=abc&token=xyz';
    let resolve;
    mockGet.mockReturnValue(new Promise((r) => { resolve = r; }));
    render(<VerifyEmail />);
    expect(screen.queryByText('Email verified.')).toBeNull();
    resolve({ data: { detail: 'Email verified.' } });
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText('Email verified.')).toBeTruthy());
  });
});


===== src\__tests__\categories\categories.test.jsx =====

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockPost, mockPatch, mockDelete, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockPost: vi.fn(),
  mockPatch: vi.fn(),
  mockDelete: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: {
    get: (...args) => mockGet(...args),
    post: (...args) => mockPost(...args),
    patch: (...args) => mockPatch(...args),
    delete: (...args) => mockDelete(...args),
  },
}));

vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({
  useAuth: (...args) => mockAuth(...args),
}));

import { Categories } from '../../pages';

const TCATS = [{ id: 1, name: 'Hardware', description: 'Old text', is_active: true }];
const ACATS = [{ id: 2, name: 'Laptop', description: '', is_active: false }];

function staff() {
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({ isStaff: true, user: { role: 'it_manager' } });
}

function employee() {
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({ isStaff: false, user: { role: 'employee' } });
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  window.confirm = vi.fn(() => true);
  mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
    if (url === '/assets/categories/') return { data: { results: [...ACATS] } };
    if (url === '/tickets/categories/') return { data: { results: [...TCATS] } };
    throw new Error(`unexpected GET ${url}`);
  });
  mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: { id: 3 } });
  mockPatch.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
  mockDelete.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('Categories page', () => {
  it('edits a ticket category (prefilled name + description)', async () => {
    staff();
    render(<Categories />);
    await screen.findByText('Hardware');
    const editBtns = screen.getAllByRole('button', { name: 'Editâ€¦' });
    fireEvent.click(editBtns[0]);
    // Form is prefilled with the record's current values.
    const nameInput = screen.getByLabelText(/^Name/);
    const descInput = screen.getByLabelText(/^Description/);
    expect(nameInput.value).toBe('Hardware');
    expect(descInput.value).toBe('Old text');
    fireEvent.change(nameInput, { target: { value: 'Hardware & Network' } });
    fireEvent.change(descInput, { target: { value: 'Fix description.' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save changes' }));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockPatch).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/tickets/categories/1/', {
        name: 'Hardware & Network',
        description: 'Fix description.',
      });
    });
    expect(await screen.findByText('Category "Hardware" updated.')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('rejects blank names: disabled save + Enter still hits validation', async () => {
    staff();
    render(<Categories />);
    await screen.findByText('Hardware');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getAllByRole('button', { name: 'Editâ€¦' })[0]);
    const nameInput = screen.getByLabelText(/^Name/);
    fireEvent.change(nameInput, { target: { value: '' } });
    // Primary guard: a blank name disables the primary button.
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save changes' }).disabled).toBe(true);
    // Secondary guard: a programmatic submit (Enter) shows the field error.
    fireEvent.submit(nameInput.closest('form'));
    expect(screen.getByText('Name is required.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockPatch).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('surfaces duplicate-name errors from the API without closing', async () => {
    staff();
    mockPatch.mockRejectedValueOnce({
      response: {
        status: 400, data: { name: ['The category name must be unique.'] },
      },
    });
    render(<Categories />);
    await screen.findByText('Hardware');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getAllByRole('button', { name: 'Editâ€¦' })[0]);
    const input = screen.getByLabelText(/^Name/);
    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: 'Duplicate' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save changes' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('The category name must be unique.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save changes' })).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('deactivates an active category', async () => {
    staff();
    render(<Categories />);
    await screen.findByText('Hardware');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getAllByRole('button', { name: 'Deactivateâ€¦' })[0]);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockPatch).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/tickets/categories/1/', {
        is_active: false,
      });
    });
  });

  it('explains referenced-record conflicts on delete', async () => {
    staff();
    mockDelete.mockRejectedValueOnce({
      response: { status: 409, data: { detail: 'in use', count: 4 } },
    });
    render(<Categories />);
    await screen.findByText('Hardware');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getAllByRole('button', { name: 'Deleteâ€¦' })[0]);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Delete category' }));
    expect(
      await screen.findByText(/still used by 4 record\(s\)/),
    ).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('hides management actions from employees', async () => {
    employee();
    render(<Categories />);
    await screen.findByText('Hardware');
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Editâ€¦' })).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /eactivate/ })).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Deleteâ€¦' })).toBeNull();
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { ChangeUtils } from '../../shared/changes-utils';

describe('Change Permissions - Utilities', () => {

      expect(errors.title).toBe('Required');

  });

  describe('actionAvailability', () => {
    it('System Admin has create action', () => {
      expect(ChangeUtils.actionAvailability('system_admin', 'draft', 'create')).toBe(true);

    it('IT Support can create draft', () => {
      expect(ChangeUtils.actionAvailability('it_support', 'draft', 'create_draft')).toBe(true);
    });

    it('Employee cannot approve', () => {
      expect(ChangeUtils.actionAvailability('employee', 'draft', 'approve')).toBe(false);
    });

    it('unknown role fails closed', () => {

    });
  });

function makeAuth(role) {
  const isStaff = role === 'system_admin' || role === 'it_manager' || role === 'it_support';
  const isManagerOrAdmin = isStaff && (role === 'system_admin' || role === 'it_manager');
  const active = role !== null && role !== 'inactive';
  return {
    access: active ? 'token' : null,
    role,
    user: active ? { id: 1, email: 'u@x.io', employee_id: 'E1', role, is_active: true } : null,
    profileLoading: false,
    isSystemAdmin: role === 'system_admin',
    isITManager: role === 'it_manager',
    isITSupport: role === 'it_support',
    isStaff,
    isAdmin: role === 'system_admin',
    isManagerOrAdmin,
    canViewProcurement: isStaff,
    canViewProcurementReports: isStaff,
    canManageScheduledReports: isStaff,
    canViewVendors: isStaff,
    canManageChanges: isStaff,
    login: vi.fn(),
    logout: vi.fn(),
    refreshProfile: vi.fn(),
  };
}

describe('CMDB Baselines', () => {
  it('system_admin can create baseline', async () => {
    makeAdminAuth();
    mockPost.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: BASELINE });
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: [BASELINE] });
    render(<BaselinesPage />);
    await screen.findByRole('button', { name: /Production Baseline/i });
  });

  it('system_admin can submit baseline', async () => {
    makeAdminAuth();
    mockPost.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { ...BASELINE, status: 'pending_approval' } });
    let calls = 0;
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async () => {
      calls += 1;
      if (calls === 1) return { data: [BASELINE] };
      return { data: [{ ...BASELINE, status: 'pending_approval' }] };
    });
    render(<BaselinesPage />);
    await screen.findByRole('button', { name: /Production Baseline/i });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^Submit for Approval$/i }));
    await screen.findByRole('button', { name: /^Approve$/i });
  });

  it('system_admin can approve baseline', async () => {
    makeAdminAuth();
    mockPost.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { ...BASELINE, status: 'approved', approved_by: 1 } });
    let calls = 0;
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async () => {
      calls += 1;
      if (calls === 1) return { data: [{ ...BASELINE, status: 'pending_approval' }] };
      return { data: [{ ...BASELINE, status: 'approved', approved_by: 1 }] };
    });
    render(<BaselinesPage />);
    await screen.findByRole('button', { name: /Production Baseline/i });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^Approve$/i }));
    await screen.findByRole('button', { name: /^Supersede$/i });
  });

  it('creator cannot approve own baseline', async () => {
    makeAdminAuth();
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 403 } });
    mockGet.mockResolvedValue({ data: [{ ...BASELINE, status: 'pending_approval' }] });
    render(<BaselinesPage />);
    await screen.findByRole('button', { name: /Production Baseline/i });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^Approve$/i }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(/Forbidden: you lack permission/i)).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('system_admin can supersede baseline', async () => {
    makeAdminAuth();
    mockPost.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { ...BASELINE, status: 'superseded' } });
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      if (String(url).includes('/cmdb/items/')) return { data: [] };
      return { data: [{ ...BASELINE, status: 'approved' }] };
    });
    render(<BaselinesPage />);
    await screen.findByRole('button', { name: /Production Baseline/i });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^Supersede$/i }));
    await screen.findByText('Superseded');
  });

  it('system_admin can compare baselines', async () => {
    makeAdminAuth();
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: [BASELINE] });

      mockPost.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { ...BASELINE, status: 'pending_approval' } });
      mockPost.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { ...BASELINE, status: 'approved' } });
      mockPost.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { ...BASELINE, status: 'superseded' } });
      let getCalls = 0;
      mockGet.mockImplementation(async () => {
        getCalls += 1;
        if (getCalls === 1) return { data: [BASELINE] };
        if (getCalls === 2) return { data: [{ ...BASELINE, status: 'pending_approval' }] };
        if (getCalls === 3) return { data: [{ ...BASELINE, status: 'approved' }] };
        return { data: [{ ...BASELINE, status: 'superseded' }] };
      });
      render(<BaselinesPage />);
      await screen.findByRole('button', { name: /Production Baseline/i });
      fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^Submit for Approval$/i }));
      await screen.findByRole('button', { name: /^Approve$/i });
      fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^Approve$/i }));
      await screen.findByText(/approved/i);
      fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^Supersede$/i }));
      await screen.findByText('Superseded');
    });
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockPost, mockPatch, mockDelete, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockPost: vi.fn(),
  mockPatch: vi.fn(),
  mockDelete: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: {
    get: (...a) => mockGet(...a),
    post: (...a) => mockPost(...a),
    patch: (...a) => mockPatch(...a),
    delete: (...a) => mockDelete(...a),
  },
}));

vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({ useAuth: (...a) => mockAuth(...a) }));

import { AccessDenied } from '../../components';
import { parseApiError } from '../../api-utils';
import { CiDetail } from '../../pages/cmdb/CiDetail';
import { ImpactAnalysisPage } from '../../pages/cmdb/ImpactAnalysisPage';

const EMPTY_PAGE = { data: { results: [], count: 0, next: null, previous: null } };
const STAFF_ROLES = ['system_admin', 'it_manager', 'it_support'];

function makeAuth(role) {
  const isSystemAdmin = role === 'system_admin';
  const isITManager = role === 'it_manager';
  const isITSupport = role === 'it_support';
  const isEmployee = role === 'employee';
  const isStaff = role ? STAFF_ROLES.includes(role) : false;

  return {
    access: 'token',
    isStaff, isAdmin: isSystemAdmin, isSystemAdmin, isITManager, isITSupport, isEmployee,
    isManagerOrAdmin: isSystemAdmin || isITManager,
    isSupportOrAbove: isSystemAdmin || isITManager || isITSupport,
    canManageUsers: isSystemAdmin,
    canManageVendors: isSystemAdmin || isITManager,
    canViewVendors: isSystemAdmin || isITManager || isITSupport,
    canManageServiceCatalogue: isSystemAdmin || isITManager,
    canApproveServiceRequests: isSystemAdmin || isITManager,
    canConfigureWorkflow: isSystemAdmin || isITManager,
    canApproveDisposals: isSystemAdmin || isITManager,
    canManageInventory: isSystemAdmin || isITManager,
    canAdjustInventory: isSystemAdmin || isITManager,
    canPublishKnowledgeBase: isSystemAdmin || isITManager,
    canManageScheduledReports: isSystemAdmin || isITManager,
    canAccessAudit: isSystemAdmin,
    canAccessRecycleBin: isSystemAdmin,
    canPerformPermanentDeletion: isSystemAdmin,
    canCreateTickets: true,
    role,
    user: role ? { id: 1, employee_id: 'E1', role, email: `${role}@x` } : null,
  };
}

function authFor(role) {
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth(role));
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.resetAllMocks();
  mockGet.mockResolvedValue(EMPTY_PAGE);
  mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
  mockPatch.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
  mockDelete.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('CMDB Permissions', () => {
  describe('capability helpers', () => {
    it('system_admin has governance capabilities', () => {
      expect(makeAuth('system_admin').isSystemAdmin).toBe(true);
    });

    it('it_manager has management but not system-admin governance', () => {
      expect(makeAuth('it_manager').isSystemAdmin).toBe(false);
      expect(makeAuth('it_manager').isITManager).toBe(true);
    });

    it('it_support is read-only for vendors and cannot approve or configure workflow', () => {
      const auth = makeAuth('it_support');
      expect(auth.isSupportOrAbove).toBe(true);
      expect(auth.canViewVendors).toBe(true);
      expect(auth.canManageVendors).toBe(false);
      expect(auth.canConfigureWorkflow).toBe(false);
    });

    it('employee has no vendor, workflow, inventory or report capabilities', () => {
      const auth = makeAuth('employee');
      expect(auth.canManageVendors).toBe(false);
      expect(auth.canConfigureWorkflow).toBe(false);
    });

    it('unknown role fails closed', () => {
      expect(makeAuth(undefined).isStaff).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  describe('AccessDenied UX', () => {
    it('renders professional wording with no stack trace or raw object', () => {
      const { container } = render(<AccessDenied role="employee" />);
      const text = container.textContent || '';
      expect(text).not.toContain('[object Object]');
    });

    it('renders manager-only wording', () => {
      const { container } = render(<AccessDenied reason="manager" />);
      expect(container.textContent).toMatch(/manager/i);
    });

    it('renders action denial wording', () => {
      const { container } = render(<AccessDenied role="employee" action="create" />);
      expect(container.textContent).not.toContain('unauthorized');
    });
  });

  describe('parseApiError 403 handling', () => {
    it('produces a readable forbidden message for 403 without global detail', () => {
      expect(parseApiError({ response: { status: 403 } }).global).toMatch(/forbidden/i);
    });
  });

  describe('CI Detail role-aware UI', () => {
    it('system admin can view CI detail', () => {

      mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { id: 1, name: 'Test Server' } });

    });

    it('system admin can view CI detail', async () => {
      authFor('system_admin');
      mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { id: 1, name: 'Test Server' } });
      render(<CiDetail match={{ params: { id: 1 } }} />);
      await screen.findByText('Test Server');
    });

    it('it_manager can view CI detail', async () => {
      authFor('it_manager');
      mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { id: 1, name: 'Test Server' } });
      render(<CiDetail match={{ params: { id: 1 } }} />);
      await screen.findByText('Test Server');
    });

    it('it_support can view CI detail and verify', async () => {
      authFor('it_support');
      mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { id: 1, name: 'Test Server' } });
      render(<CiDetail match={{ params: { id: 1 } }} />);
      await screen.findByText('Test Server');
    });

    it('employee denied CI detail access', () => {
      authFor('employee');
    });
  });

  describe('CI Impact Analysis role-aware UI', () => {
    it('system admin can run impact analysis', () => {
      authFor('system_admin');
      mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: {} });
      render(<ImpactAnalysisPage match={{ params: { id: 1 } }} />);
    });

    it('it_manager can run impact analysis', () => {
      authFor('it_manager');
      mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: {} });
      render(<ImpactAnalysisPage match={{ params: { id: 1 } }} />);
    });

    it('it_support can view impact analysis', () => {
      authFor('it_support');
      mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: {} });
      render(<ImpactAnalysisPage match={{ params: { id: 1 } }} />);
    });

    it('employee denied impact analysis', () => {

      mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: {} });
      render(<ImpactAnalysisPage match={{ params: { id: 1 } }} />);
      expect(screen.getByText('Employees have no CMDB impact analysis access.')).toBeTruthy();
    });
  });

===== src\__tests__\cmdb\cmdb-relationships.test.jsx =====

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockPost, mockPatch, mockDelete, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockPost: vi.fn(),
  mockPatch: vi.fn(),
  mockDelete: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: {
    get: (...a) => mockGet(...a),
    post: (...a) => mockPost(...a),
    patch: (...a) => mockPatch(...a),
    delete: (...a) => mockDelete(...a),
  },
}));

vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({ useAuth: (...a) => mockAuth(...a) }));

import { CiRelationshipsPage } from '../../pages/cmdb/CiRelationshipsPage';

const EMPTY_PAGE = { data: { results: [], count: 0, next: null, previous: null } };

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.resetAllMocks();

  mockPatch.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
  mockDelete.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });

describe('CMDB Relationships', () => {
  const makeAdminAuth = () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue({
      access: 'token', user: { id: 1, email: 'admin@local', employee_id: 'E1', role: 'system_admin', is_active: true },
      profileLoading: false, isStaff: true, isAdmin: true,
    });
  };

  const makeManagerAuth = () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue({
      access: 'token', user: { id: 1, email: 'mgr@local', employee_id: 'E1', role: 'it_manager', is_active: true },
      profileLoading: false, isStaff: true, isAdmin: false,
    });
  };

  const makeSupportAuth = () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue({
      access: 'token', user: { id: 1, email: 'sup@local', employee_id: 'E1', role: 'it_support', is_active: true },
      profileLoading: false, isStaff: true, isAdmin: false,
    });
  };

  it('system_admin can create relationships', async () => {
    makeAdminAuth();
    mockPost.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { id: 1, relationship_type: 'parent', direction: 'upstream', target: 2 } });
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: [] });
    render(<CiRelationshipsPage match={{ params: { id: 1 } }} />);
    await screen.findByRole('button', { name: /Add Relationship/i });
  });

  it('system_admin can view inverse relationships', async () => {
    makeAdminAuth();
    mockGet
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { id: 1, ci_number: 'CI #1', name: 'A' } }) // ci detail
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: [{ id: 5, relationship_type: 'depends_on', source_ci: 2, target_ci: 1, source_ci_number: 'CI #2', status: 'active' }] }) // relationships
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { results: [{ id: 2, ci_number: 'CI #2', name: 'B' }] } }); // CI options
    render(<CiRelationshipsPage match={{ params: { id: 1 } }} />);
    expect(await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: /Incoming Relationships/i })).toBeTruthy();
    expect(await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: /Outgoing Relationships/i })).toBeTruthy();
    expect(await screen.findByRole('link', { name: /CI #2 â€” B/i })).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('system_admin can activate/deactivate relationships', async () => {
    makeAdminAuth();
    mockPost.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { id: 1, relationship_type: 'parent', direction: 'upstream', target: 2 } });
    mockGet.mockResolvedValue({ data: { results: [{ id: 1, relationship_type: 'parent', direction: 'upstream', source_ci: 1, target_ci: 2, status: 'active' }, { id: 2, relationship_type: 'parent', direction: 'upstream', source_ci: 1, target_ci: 3, status: 'inactive' }] } });
    mockPatch.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { status: 'active' } });
    render(<CiRelationshipsPage match={{ params: { id: 1 } }} />);
    await screen.findByRole('button', { name: /Activate/ });
    await screen.findByRole('button', { name: /Deactivate/ });
  });

  it('prevents self-link relationships', async () => {
    makeAdminAuth();
    mockGet
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { id: 1, ci_number: 'CI #1', name: 'A' } }) // ci detail
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: [] }) // relationships
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: [{ id: 2, ci_number: 'CI #2', name: 'B' }] }); // CI options
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 400, data: { detail: 'A CI cannot be related to itself.' } } });
    render(<CiRelationshipsPage match={{ params: { id: 1 } }} />);
    await screen.findByRole('option', { name: /CI #2/i });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Related CI/i), { target: { value: '2' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Relationship Type/i), { target: { value: 'depends_on' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Add Relationship/i }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(/cannot be related to itself/i)).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('prevents duplicate active relationships', async () => {
    makeAdminAuth();
    mockGet
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { id: 1, ci_number: 'CI #1', name: 'A' } }) // ci detail
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: [] }) // relationships
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: [{ id: 2, ci_number: 'CI #2', name: 'B' }] }); // CI options
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 409, data: { detail: 'This relationship already exists.' } } });
    render(<CiRelationshipsPage match={{ params: { id: 1 } }} />);
    await screen.findByRole('option', { name: /CI #2/i });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Related CI/i), { target: { value: '2' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Relationship Type/i), { target: { value: 'depends_on' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Add Relationship/i }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(/This relationship already exists/i)).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('shows cycle errors on create', async () => {
    makeAdminAuth();
    mockGet
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { id: 1, ci_number: 'CI #1', name: 'A' } }) // ci detail
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: [] }) // relationships
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: [{ id: 2, ci_number: 'CI #2', name: 'B' }] }); // CI options
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 409, data: { detail: 'Cycle detected' } } });
    render(<CiRelationshipsPage match={{ params: { id: 1 } }} />);
    await screen.findByRole('option', { name: /CI #2/i });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Related CI/i), { target: { value: '2' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Relationship Type/i), { target: { value: 'depends_on' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Add Relationship/i }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(/Cycle detected/i)).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('excludes inaccessible CIs from relationship selectors', async () => {
    makeAdminAuth();
    mockGet
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { id: 1, ci_number: 'CI #1', name: 'A' } }) // ci detail
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: [] }) // relationships for this CI
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { results: [{ id: 1, ci_number: 'CI #1', name: 'A', status: 'active' }, { id: 2, ci_number: 'CI #2', name: 'B', status: 'inactive' }] } }); // related CI choices
    render(<CiRelationshipsPage match={{ params: { id: 1 } }} />);
    expect(await screen.findByRole('option', { name: /CI #2/i })).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('shows error on missing related CI', async () => {
    makeAdminAuth();
    mockGet
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { id: 1, ci_number: 'CI #1', name: 'A' } }) // ci detail
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: [] }) // relationships for this CI
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { results: [{ id: 2, ci_number: 'CI #2', name: 'B' }] } }); // related CI choices
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 404, data: { detail: 'Related CI not found.' } } });
    render(<CiRelationshipsPage match={{ params: { id: 1 } }} />);
    await screen.findByRole('option', { name: /CI #2/i });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Related CI/i), { target: { value: '2' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Relationship Type/i), { target: { value: 'depends_on' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Add Relationship/i }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(/not found/i)).toBeTruthy();
  });

  describe('role gates', () => {
    it('it_manager can create and view relationships', async () => {
      makeManagerAuth();
      mockPost.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { id: 1, relationship_type: 'parent', direction: 'upstream', target: 2 } });
      mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: [] });
      render(<CiRelationshipsPage match={{ params: { id: 1 } }} />);
      await screen.findByRole('button', { name: /Add Relationship/i });
    });

    it('it_support can view relationships but not create', () => {
      makeSupportAuth();
      mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: [] });
      render(<CiRelationshipsPage match={{ params: { id: 1 } }} />);
      expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /Add Relationship/i })).toBeNull();
    });

    it('employee denied all relationship access', () => {
      mockAuth.mockReturnValue({
        access: 'token', user: { id: 1, employee_id: 'E1', role: 'employee', is_active: true },
        profileLoading: false, isStaff: false, isAdmin: false,
      });
      mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: [] });
      render(<CiRelationshipsPage match={{ params: { id: 1 } }} />);
      expect(screen.getByText(/Employees have no CMDB relationship access/)).toBeTruthy();
    });
  });
});
