===== src\__tests__\components\bulk-workflow.test.jsx =====

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockPost, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockPost: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({ default: { get: (...a) => mockGet(...a), post: (...a) => mockPost(...a) } }));
vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({ useAuth: () => mockAuth() }));

import { TicketBulkCreateModal, AssetBulkCreateModal } from '../../pages/bulk/Bulk';

function makeFile(name = 'data.csv') {
  return new File(['a,b'], name, { type: 'text/csv' });
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({ isStaff: true, user: { role: 'it_support' } });
  window.confirm = vi.fn(() => true);
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('TicketBulkCreateModal workflow', () => {
  it('previews and confirms successfully with same operation token', async () => {
    mockPost.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      if (url === '/tickets/bulk_create/') return { data: { affected: 2, invalid: [] } };
      return { data: new Blob(['row,outcome\n1,created'], { type: 'text/csv' }) };
    });
    render(<TicketBulkCreateModal onClose={() => {}} onCreated={() => {}} />);
    const input = screen.getByLabelText('Import file');
    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { files: [makeFile()] } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Preview' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText(/2 valid/)).toBeTruthy());
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Confirm create/ }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2));
    const previewFd = mockPost.mock.calls[0][1];
    const confirmFd = mockPost.mock.calls[1][1];
    expect(previewFd.get('import_token')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(confirmFd.get('import_token')).toBe(previewFd.get('import_token'));
  });

  it('prevents duplicate in-flight confirmation requests', async () => {
    mockPost.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      if (url === '/tickets/bulk_create/') return { data: { affected: 1, invalid: [] } };
      return { data: new Blob(['r'], { type: 'text/csv' }) };
    });
    render(<TicketBulkCreateModal onClose={() => {}} onCreated={() => {}} />);
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Import file'), { target: { files: [makeFile()] } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Preview' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Confirm create/ })).toBeTruthy());
    const btn = screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Confirm create/ });
    fireEvent.click(btn);
    fireEvent.click(btn);
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2));
    // Only one confirm request should have been made
    const confirmCalls = mockPost.mock.calls.filter(([u]) => String(u).includes('download=csv'));
    expect(confirmCalls.length).toBe(1);
  });

  it('reuses the same operation token when retrying confirmation after failure', async () => {
    mockPost.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      if (url === '/tickets/bulk_create/') return { data: { affected: 1, invalid: [] } };
      if (mockPost.mock.calls.filter(([u]) => String(u).includes('download=csv')).length === 1) {
        throw new Error('network down');
      }
      return { data: new Blob(['row,key,outcome,message\n1,1,successful,created'], { type: 'text/csv' }) };
    });
    render(<TicketBulkCreateModal onClose={() => {}} onCreated={() => {}} />);
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Import file'), { target: { files: [makeFile()] } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Preview' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Confirm create/ })).toBeTruthy());
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Confirm create/ }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText(/Request failed: network down/i)).toBeTruthy());
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Confirm create/ }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText(/Create result/)).toBeTruthy());
    const confirmCalls = mockPost.mock.calls.filter(([u]) => String(u).includes('download=csv'));
    expect(confirmCalls.length).toBe(2);
    expect(confirmCalls[0][1].get('import_token')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(confirmCalls[1][1].get('import_token')).toBe(confirmCalls[0][1].get('import_token'));
  });

  it('shows preview failure and allows retry', async () => {
    mockPost
      .mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('boom'))
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { affected: 1, invalid: [] } });
    render(<TicketBulkCreateModal onClose={() => {}} onCreated={() => {}} />);
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Import file'), { target: { files: [makeFile()] } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Preview' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText(/Request failed: boom/i)).toBeTruthy());
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Preview' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText(/1 valid/)).toBeTruthy());
  });
});

describe('AssetBulkCreateModal workflow', () => {
  it('previews and confirms successfully', async () => {
    mockPost.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      if (url === '/assets/bulk_create/') return { data: { preview: [{ asset_tag: 'LT-1' }], errors: [] } };
      return { data: new Blob(['row,outcome\n1,created'], { type: 'text/csv' }) };
    });
    render(<AssetBulkCreateModal onClose={() => {}} onImported={() => {}} />);
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Import file'), { target: { files: [makeFile('assets.csv')] } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Preview' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText(/would be created/)).toBeTruthy());
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Confirm create/ }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2));
  });

  it('clears preview when file changes', async () => {
    mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: { preview: [{ asset_tag: 'LT-1' }], errors: [] } });
    render(<AssetBulkCreateModal onClose={() => {}} onImported={() => {}} />);
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Import file'), { target: { files: [makeFile('a.csv')] } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Preview' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText(/would be created/)).toBeTruthy());
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Import file'), { target: { files: [makeFile('b.csv')] } });
    expect(screen.queryByText(/would be created/)).toBeNull();
  });
});


===== src\__tests__\departments\departments.test.jsx =====

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockPost, mockPatch, mockDelete, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockPost: vi.fn(),
  mockPatch: vi.fn(),
  mockDelete: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: {
    get: (...args) => mockGet(...args),
    post: (...args) => mockPost(...args),
    patch: (...args) => mockPatch(...args),
    delete: (...args) => mockDelete(...args),
  },
}));

vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({
  useAuth: (...args) => mockAuth(...args),
}));

import { Departments } from '../../pages';

const DEPTS = [
  { id: 1, name: 'Eng', code: 'ENG', head_email: null, member_count: 4, is_active: true },
];

function staff() {
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({ isStaff: true, user: { role: 'it_manager' } });
}

function employee() {
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({ isStaff: false, user: { role: 'employee' } });
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
    if (String(url).startsWith('/accounts/departments/')) {
      return { data: { results: [...DEPTS], count: 1, next: null, previous: null } };
    }
    if (String(url).startsWith('/accounts/users/')) {
      return { data: { results: [], count: 0, next: null, previous: null } };
    }
    throw new Error(`unexpected GET ${url}`);
  });
  mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: { id: 2 } });
  mockPatch.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
  mockDelete.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('Departments page', () => {
  it('lists departments', async () => {
    staff();
    render(<Departments />);
    expect(await screen.findByText('Eng')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/accounts/departments/');
  });

  it('creates a department and refreshes', async () => {
    staff();
    render(<Departments />);
    await screen.findByText('Eng');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '+ New department' }));
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/^Name/), {
      target: { value: 'Support' },
    });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Code/), {
      target: { value: 'SUP' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create department' }));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        '/accounts/departments/',
        expect.objectContaining({ name: 'Support', code: 'SUP' }),
      );
    });
    expect(await screen.findByText('Department created.')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('shows validation errors without closing', async () => {
    staff();
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({
      response: { status: 400, data: { code: ['Department with this code already exists.'] } },
    });
    render(<Departments />);
    await screen.findByText('Eng');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '+ New department' }));
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/^Name/), { target: { value: 'X' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Code/), { target: { value: 'ENG' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create department' }));
    expect(
      await screen.findByText('Department with this code already exists.'),
    ).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('edits a department with the prefilled modal and refreshes', async () => {
    staff();
    render(<Departments />);
    await screen.findByText('Eng');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Editâ€¦' }));
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/^Name/).value).toBe('Eng');
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/Code/).value).toBe('ENG');
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/^Name/), {
      target: { value: 'Engineering & Ops' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save changes' }));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockPatch).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/accounts/departments/1/', {
        name: 'Engineering & Ops', code: 'ENG',
        description: '', is_active: true,
      });
    });
    expect(await screen.findByText('Department updated.')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('surfaces edit validation errors without closing', async () => {
    staff();
    mockPatch.mockRejectedValueOnce({
      response: {
        status: 400, data: { code: ['Department with this code already exists.'] },
      },
    });
    render(<Departments />);
    await screen.findByText('Eng');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Editâ€¦' }));
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/^Name/), {
      target: { value: 'Eng' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save changes' }));
    expect(
      await screen.findByText('Department with this code already exists.'),
    ).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save changes' })).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('explains referenced-record conflicts on delete', async () => {
    staff();
    mockDelete.mockRejectedValueOnce({
      response: {
        status: 409,
        data: { detail: 'x', references: { members: 2, tickets: 1 } },
      },
    });
    render(<Departments />);
    await screen.findByText('Eng');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Deleteâ€¦' }));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Delete department' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(/still referenced/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText(/members: 2, tickets: 1/)).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('hides management actions from employees', async () => {
    employee();
    render(<Departments />);
    await screen.findByText('Eng');
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: '+ New department' })).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /Edit/ })).toBeNull();
  });
});

import App from '../../App';

function authCaps(role = 'system_admin', isActive = true) {
  const isStaff = ['system_admin', 'it_manager', 'it_support'].includes(role);
  const isAdmin = role === 'system_admin';
  const canUseMonitoring = !!isStaff && isActive;
  const canUseProblemManagement = !!isStaff && isActive;
  return {
    access: true,
    logout: vi.fn(),
    user: { employee_id: 'EMP001', role },
    profileLoading: false,
    role,
    isSystemAdmin: role === 'system_admin',
    isITManager: role === 'it_manager',
    isITSupport: role === 'it_support',
    isAdmin,
    isStaff,
    canManageScheduledReports: role === 'system_admin',
    canViewVendors: role !== 'employee',
    canViewProcurement: isStaff,
    canViewProcurementReports: role === 'system_admin' || role === 'it_manager',
    canManageUsers: role === 'system_admin' || role === 'it_manager',
    canManageServiceCatalogue: role === 'system_admin',
    canUseMonitoring,
    canUseProblemManagement,
  };
}

function renderApp(role = 'system_admin', isActive = true) {
  const isStaff = ['system_admin', 'it_manager', 'it_support'].includes(role);
  const isAdmin = role === 'system_admin';
  const canUseMonitoring = !!isStaff && isActive;
  const canUseProblemManagement = !!isStaff && isActive;
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({
    access: true,
    logout: vi.fn(),
    user: { employee_id: 'EMP001', role },
    profileLoading: false,
    role,
    isSystemAdmin: role === 'system_admin',
    isITManager: role === 'it_manager',
    isITSupport: role === 'it_support',
    isAdmin,
    isStaff,
    canManageScheduledReports: role === 'system_admin',
    canViewVendors: role !== 'employee',
    canViewProcurement: isStaff,
    canViewProcurementReports: role === 'system_admin' || role === 'it_manager',
    canManageUsers: role === 'system_admin' || role === 'it_manager',
    canManageServiceCatalogue: role === 'system_admin',
    canUseMonitoring,
    canUseProblemManagement,
  });
  return render(<App />);
}

  vi.clearAllMocks();

describe('Application sidebar navigation', () => {
  describe('Group ordering', () => {
    it('renders groups in the intended order', () => {
      renderApp('system_admin');
      const sections = Array.from(
        document.querySelectorAll('.sidenav-section-title')
      ).map((el) => (el.textContent || '').trim());
      expect(sections[0]).toBe('Overview');
      expect(sections[1]).toBe('Change Management');
      expect(sections[2]).toBe('Service Operations');
      expect(sections[3]).toBe('Asset Operations');
      expect(sections[4]).toBe('Procurement');
      expect(sections[5]).toBe('Administration');
    });
  });

  describe('Concise module labels', () => {
    it('shows concise labels without long legacy names', () => {
      renderApp('system_admin');
      const allLinks = screen.getAllByRole('link');
      // Overview + Change Management (17) + Service Operations (5) + Asset Operations (3) + Procurement (9) + Administration (14) = 47 links.
      // Overview 1 + Change Management 17 + Service Operations 5 + Asset Operations 3 + Procurement 9 + Administration 11 = 46 links.
      const linkTexts = allLinks.map((l) => l.textContent.trim());
      const dashboardLinks = allLinks.filter((l) => l.getAttribute('href') === '#/dashboard' || l.getAttribute('href') === '#/changes/dashboard');
      expect(dashboardLinks).toHaveLength(2); // Overview + Change Management
      const dashboardTexts = dashboardLinks.map((l) => l.textContent.trim());
      expect(dashboardTexts).toContain('Dashboard'); // Overview
      expect(dashboardTexts).toContain('Dashboard'); // Change Management (separate link)
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('Tickets');
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('Monitoring');
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('Problems');
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('Change Management');
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('Services');
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('Assets');
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('CMDB');
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('Procurement');
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('Users');
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('Categories');
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('Departments');
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('SLA');
      expect(linkTexts.some((t) => /Notifications/.test(t))).toBeTruthy();
      // Change Management sub-items (all inside the Change Management section)
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('New Change');
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('Calendar');
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('Dashboard');
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('Change Detail');
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('Edit Change');
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('Risk Assessment');
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('Task Checklist');
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('Approvals');
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('Conflicts');
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('Implementation');
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('PIR & Closure');
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('Change Templates');
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('Maintenance Windows');
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('Blackout Periods');
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('Scheduling Exceptions');
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('Review Meetings');
      expect(linkTexts).toContain('Outages');
    });

    it('does not show long legacy labels', () => {
      renderApp('system_admin');
      expect(screen.queryByText('Ticket Queues')).toBeNull();
      expect(screen.queryByText('Operations')).toBeNull();
      expect(screen.queryByText('Lifecycle')).toBeNull();
      expect(screen.queryByText('Workflow')).toBeNull();
      expect(screen.queryByText('Inventory')).toBeNull();
      expect(screen.queryByText('Disposals')).toBeNull();
      expect(screen.queryByText('Software Dashboard')).toBeNull();
      expect(screen.queryByText('Vendors')).toBeNull();
      expect(screen.queryByText('Employees')).toBeNull();
    });
  });

      expect(auth.isStaff).toBe(true);
      expect(auth.isAdmin).toBe(true);
      expect(auth.canUseMonitoring).toBe(false);
      expect(auth.canUseProblemManagement).toBe(false);

    it('unknown role has no staff or admin privileges', () => {

  describe('Mobile menu', () => {
    it('opens mobile menu on toggle', () => {
      renderApp('system_admin');
      const toggle = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open navigation' });
      expect(toggle).toBeTruthy();
      fireEvent.click(toggle);
      expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Close navigation' })).toBeTruthy();
    });

    it('closes mobile menu on toggle', () => {
      renderApp('system_admin');
      const toggle = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open navigation' });
      fireEvent.click(toggle);
      const closeToggle = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Close navigation' });
      fireEvent.click(closeToggle);
      expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open navigation' })).toBeTruthy();
    });

    it('closes mobile menu when selecting a destination', () => {
      renderApp('system_admin');
      const toggle = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open navigation' });
      fireEvent.click(toggle);
      expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Close navigation' })).toBeTruthy();
      const links = screen.getAllByRole('link', { name: 'Tickets' });
      const ticketsLink = links.find((l) => l.getAttribute('href') === '#/tickets');
      fireEvent.click(ticketsLink);
      // After navigation, menu should close
      expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Close navigation' })).toBeNull();
    });
  });

  describe('Section expand/collapse', () => {
    const getSectionHeader = (name) => {
      const headers = screen.getAllByRole('button', {
        className: 'sidenav-section-header',
      });
      return headers.find((h) => {
        const titleEl = h.querySelector('.sidenav-section-title');
        return titleEl ? titleEl.textContent.trim() === name : false;
      });
    };

    it('expands a collapsed section when its header is clicked', () => {
      renderApp('system_admin');
      // Overview starts collapsed (active route #/tickets is under Service Operations)
      const overviewHeader = getSectionHeader('Overview');
      expect(overviewHeader.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('false');
      fireEvent.click(overviewHeader);
      expect(overviewHeader.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('true');
    });

    it('collapses an expanded section when its header is clicked again', () => {
      renderApp('system_admin');
      // All sections start collapsed now
      const svcHeader = getSectionHeader('Service Operations');
      expect(svcHeader.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('false');
      fireEvent.click(svcHeader);
      expect(svcHeader.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('true');
      fireEvent.click(svcHeader);
      expect(svcHeader.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('false');
    });

    it('expanding one section does not affect other sections', () => {
      renderApp('system_admin');
      const overviewHeader = getSectionHeader('Overview');
      const svcHeader = getSectionHeader('Service Operations');
      // Both start collapsed
      fireEvent.click(overviewHeader); // Overview â†’ expanded
      fireEvent.click(svcHeader); // Service Operations -> expanded
      expect(overviewHeader.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('true');
      expect(svcHeader.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('true');
      // Each section maintains its own state
    });

    it('aria-expanded matches submenu visibility', () => {
      renderApp('system_admin');
      const overviewHeader = getSectionHeader('Overview');
      expect(overviewHeader.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('false');
      fireEvent.click(overviewHeader);
      expect(overviewHeader.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('true');
      fireEvent.click(overviewHeader);
      expect(overviewHeader.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('false');
    });

    it('collapsed section content has collapsed class', () => {
      renderApp('system_admin');
      const overviewHeader = getSectionHeader('Overview');
      const sectionContent = document.getElementById('sidenav-section-content-0');
      expect(sectionContent).not.toBeNull();
      expect(sectionContent.classList.contains('collapsed')).toBeTruthy();
      fireEvent.click(overviewHeader);
      expect(sectionContent.classList.contains('collapsed')).toBeFalsy();
    });
  });
});

const ROUTES = [
  '#/tickets', '#/tickets/new', '#/tickets/12', '#/tickets/12/edit',
  '#/assets', '#/assets/new', '#/assets/7', '#/assets/7/edit',
  '#/categories', '#/departments', '#/notifications', '#/users', '#/profile',
  '#/recycle', '#/audit',
  '#/inventory', '#/inventory/items', '#/inventory/items/new', '#/inventory/items/1',
  '#/inventory/items/1/edit', '#/inventory/receive', '#/inventory/reservations',
  '#/inventory/transactions', '#/inventory/fulfil',
  '#/lifecycle', '#/lifecycle/onboarding', '#/lifecycle/offboarding', '#/lifecycle/transfers', '#/lifecycle/new', '#/lifecycle/1',
];

describe('route smoke', () => {
  for (const route of ROUTES) {
    it(`renders ${route} without console errors`, async () => {
      const errors = [];
      const orig = console.error;
      console.error = (...args) => { errors.push(args.join(' ')); };
      try {
        window.location.hash = route;
        render(<App />);
        await waitFor(() => expect(document.querySelector('.page-loading, h1, .login-card')).toBeTruthy());
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300));
      } finally {
        console.error = orig;
      }
      const outline = [...document.querySelectorAll('h1,h2,h3,h4')].map((h) => `${h.tagName}:${h.textContent.trim().slice(0, 40)}`);
      const inlined = [...document.querySelectorAll('[style]')].map((n) => `${n.tagName}.${n.className}{${n.getAttribute('style')}}`);
      expect(errors, `${route} -> ${errors.join('\n')}`).toEqual([]);
      if (process.env.SMOKE_OUTLINE) {
        orig(`\n${route}\n  ${outline.join('\n  ')}`);
        if (inlined.length) orig(`  INLINE: ${[...new Set(inlined)].join(' | ')}`);
      }
    });
  }
});

function mockRoutes(routes) {
  mockGet.mockImplementation(async (u) => {
    const url = String(u);
    for (const [prefix, data] of routes) {
      if (url.startsWith(prefix)) return data;
    }
    return { data: { results: [], count: 0, next: null, previous: null } };
  });
}

/** jsdom/React does not drive controlled <select> onChange via target value, so
 *  select an option and dispatch a real change event instead. */
function setSelect(sel, value) {
  const option = Array.from(sel.options).find((o) => o.value === String(value));
  if (option) option.selected = true;
  fireEvent.change(sel);
}

describe('Stock receiving', () => {

    ]);

    mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: { id: 3 } });

    await waitFor(() => expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.stringContaining('/inventory/stock-items/?page_size=100')));
    setSelect(screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: /Vendor/ }), '1');
    setSelect(screen.getAllByRole('combobox', { name: /Stock item/ })[0], '1');
    fireEvent.change(screen.getAllByRole('spinbutton')[0], { target: { value: '10' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Confirm & receive stock/ }));
    await screen.findByRole('button', { name: /Receive stock/ });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Receive stock/ }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/inventory/purchase-receipts/', expect.objectContaining({ vendor: 1 })));
  });

  it('requires at least one line before submitting', async () => {
    mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: { id: 3 } });
    render(<ReceiveStock />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.stringContaining('/inventory/stock-items/?page_size=100')));
    setSelect(screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: /Vendor/ }), '1');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Confirm & receive stock/ }));
    expect(mockPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('prevents duplicate submission while a request is in flight', async () => {
    let resolvePost;
    mockPost.mockImplementation(() => new Promise((res) => { resolvePost = res; }));
    render(<ReceiveStock />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.stringContaining('/inventory/stock-items/?page_size=100')));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.stringContaining('/assets/vendors/')));
    setSelect(screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: /Vendor/ }), '1');
    setSelect(screen.getAllByRole('combobox', { name: /Stock item/ })[0], '1');
    fireEvent.change(screen.getAllByRole('spinbutton')[0], { target: { value: '10' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Confirm & receive stock/ }));
    await screen.findByRole('button', { name: /Receive stock/ });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Receive stock/ }));
    await screen.findByRole('button', { name: /Working/ });
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Working/ }).disabled).toBeTruthy();
    resolvePost({ data: { id: 3 } });
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
  });

  it('shows backend validation errors', async () => {
    mockPost.mockRejectedValue({ response: { status: 400, data: { vendor: ['Select a valid vendor.'] } } });
    render(<ReceiveStock />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.stringContaining('/inventory/stock-items/?page_size=100')));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.stringContaining('/assets/vendors/')));
    setSelect(screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: /Vendor/ }), '1');
    setSelect(screen.getAllByRole('combobox', { name: /Stock item/ })[0], '1');
    fireEvent.change(screen.getAllByRole('spinbutton')[0], { target: { value: '10' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Confirm & receive stock/ }));
    await screen.findByRole('button', { name: /Receive stock/ });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Receive stock/ }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText(/Select a valid vendor/)).toBeTruthy());
  });
});

describe('Service request fulfilment', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    mockRoutes([
      ['/services/requests/', REQUESTS],
      ['/inventory/stock-items/?page_size=100', STOCK_ITEMS],
    ]);
  });

  it('lists requests ready for fulfilment and excludes fulfilled ones', async () => {

    await screen.findByText('SR-41');
    expect(screen.queryByText('SR-42')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('fulfils a request from available stock', async () => {
    mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
    render(<FulfilServiceRequest />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.stringContaining('/inventory/stock-items/?page_size=100')));
    await screen.findByText('SR-41');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Fulfil/ }));
    await screen.findByLabelText(/Stock item/);
    setSelect(screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: /Stock item/ }), '1');
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: /Quantity/ }), { target: { value: '2' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Fulfil request/ }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/inventory/fulfil-service-request/', expect.objectContaining({ service_request: 41, stock_item: 1, quantity: 2 })));
  });

  it('blocks fulfilment above available stock', async () => {
    render(<FulfilServiceRequest />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.stringContaining('/inventory/stock-items/?page_size=100')));
    await screen.findByText('SR-41');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Fulfil/ }));
    await screen.findByLabelText(/Stock item/);
    setSelect(screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: /Stock item/ }), '1');
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: /Quantity/ }), { target: { value: '999' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Fulfil request/ }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText(/Only 45 unit\(s\)/)).toBeTruthy());
    expect(mockPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('shows backend rejection and disables resubmit while in flight', async () => {
    let rejectPost;
    mockPost.mockImplementation(() => new Promise((_res, rej) => { rejectPost = rej; }));
    render(<FulfilServiceRequest />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.stringContaining('/inventory/stock-items/?page_size=100')));
    await screen.findByText('SR-41');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Fulfil/ }));
    await screen.findByLabelText(/Stock item/);
    setSelect(screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: /Stock item/ }), '1');
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: /Quantity/ }), { target: { value: '2' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Fulfil request/ }));
    const fulfilling = screen.getAllByRole('button', { name: 'Fulfillingâ€¦' });
    expect(fulfilling.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(fulfilling.some((b) => b.disabled)).toBeTruthy();
    rejectPost({ response: { status: 400, data: { detail: 'Already fulfilled' } } });
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText(/Already fulfilled/)).toBeTruthy());
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor, cleanup, within } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockPatch, mockPost, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockPatch: vi.fn(),
  mockPost: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: {
    get: (...args) => mockGet(...args),
    post: (...args) => mockPost(...args),
    patch: (...args) => mockPatch(...args),
    delete: vi.fn(),
  },
}));

vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({ useAuth: (...args) => mockAuth(...args) }));

import {
  KnowledgeBase, KnowledgeBaseCompare, KnowledgeBaseDetail,
  KnowledgeBaseReviewQueue, KnowledgeBaseRevisionDetail,
} from '../../pages/kb/KnowledgeBase';

const ARTICLE = {
  id: 1,
  title: 'VPN reset',
  slug: 'vpn-reset',
  summary: 'How to reset the VPN client',
  content: 'Step one',
  category: { id: 1, code: 'networking', name: 'Networking' },
  category_name: 'Networking',
  tags: [{ id: 1, name: 'VPN', slug: 'vpn' }],
  author: 2,

  version: 3,

  submitted_at: null,
  reviewed_by: null,
  reviewed_by_name: null,

  review_decision: '',

  created_at: '2026-01-01T10:00:00Z',
  updated_at: '2026-01-02T10:00:00Z',
};

const REV2 = {
  id: 2, article: 1, revision_number: 2, title: 'VPN reset',
  slug: 'vpn-reset', summary: 'How to reset the VPN client',
  content: 'Step one\nStep two', category: 1, category_name: 'Networking',
  tags: [{ name: 'VPN', slug: 'vpn' }], status: 'draft', author: 2,
  author_name: 'Manager', editor: 2, editor_name: 'Manager',

  ...REV2,

  revision_number: 1,
  content: 'Step one',
  change_note: 'Initial version',
  is_current: false,
  created_at: '2026-01-01T10:00:00Z',

function paginated(results) {
  return { data: { results, count: results.length, next: null, previous: null } };
}

function staff() {
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({
    isStaff: true,
    isAdmin: true, isSystemAdmin: true, isITManager: false, isITSupport: false, isEmployee: false,
    isManagerOrAdmin: true, isSupportOrAbove: true,
    canManageUsers: true, canManageVendors: true, canViewVendors: true,
    canManageServiceCatalogue: true, canApproveServiceRequests: true,
    canConfigureWorkflow: true, canApproveDisposals: true,
    canManageInventory: true, canAdjustInventory: true,
    canPublishKnowledgeBase: true, canManageScheduledReports: true,
    canAccessAudit: true, canAccessRecycleBin: true, canPerformPermanentDeletion: true,
    canCreateTickets: true,
    user: { id: 9, role: 'system_admin', email: 'admin@x' },
  });
}

function employee() {
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({
    isStaff: false,
    isAdmin: false,
    user: { id: 3, role: 'employee', email: 'emp@x' },
  });
}

function defaultGet(overrides = {}) {
  mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url, config) => {
    const u = String(url);
    if (overrides[u]) return overrides[u](config);
    if (u === '/assets/knowledge-base/' || /^\/assets\/knowledge-base\/\?/.test(u)) return paginated([ARTICLE]);
    if (u === '/assets/knowledge-base/1/') return { data: ARTICLE };
    if (u === '/assets/knowledge-base/1/revisions/') {
      return { data: [REV2, REV1] };
    }
    if (u === '/assets/knowledge-base/1/revisions/1/') return { data: REV1 };
    if (u === '/assets/knowledge-base/pending_review/') {
      return { data: [] };
    }
    if (u === '/assets/knowledge-base-categories/') return { data: [] };
    if (u === '/assets/knowledge-base-tags/') return { data: [] };
    return paginated([]);
  });
}

  cleanup();
  vi.resetAllMocks();
  window.location.hash = '';
  staff();
  defaultGet();
  mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: ARTICLE });
  mockPatch.mockResolvedValue({ data: ARTICLE });
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

  it('submits a draft for review', async () => {

        return { data: { ...ARTICLE, status: 'pending_review', review_decision: 'pending', submitted_at: '2026-01-02T10:00:00Z' } };

      if (u === '/assets/knowledge-base/1/revisions/') return { data: [REV2, REV1] };

    render(<KnowledgeBaseDetail id="1" />);
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Approve' }));

    ));
    expect(await screen.findByText('Article approved.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(await screen.findByTestId('review-summary')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('requires a reason before rejecting', async () => {
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      const u = String(url);
      if (u === '/assets/knowledge-base/1/') {
        return { data: { ...ARTICLE, status: 'pending_review', review_decision: 'pending' } };
      }
      if (u === '/assets/knowledge-base/1/revisions/') return { data: [REV2, REV1] };
      return paginated([]);
    });
    mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: { ...ARTICLE, status: 'draft', review_decision: 'rejected', review_comment: 'Add screenshots' } });
    render(<KnowledgeBaseDetail id="1" />);
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Reject' }));
    const dialog = await screen.findByRole('dialog');
    const rejectButton = within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: 'Reject' });
    expect(rejectButton.disabled).toBe(true);
    fireEvent.change(within(dialog).getByLabelText('Rejection reason'), { target: { value: 'Add screenshots' } });
    fireEvent.click(rejectButton);
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      '/assets/knowledge-base/1/reject/',
      { comment: 'Add screenshots', version: 3 },
    ));
    expect(await screen.findByText(/Article rejected/)).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('renders the pending review queue and its empty state', async () => {
    defaultGet({
      '/assets/knowledge-base/pending_review/': () => ({ data: [{ ...ARTICLE, title: 'Queued article', status: 'pending_review', submitted_at: '2026-01-02T10:00:00Z' }] }),
    });
    render(<KnowledgeBaseReviewQueue />);
    expect(await screen.findByText('Queued article')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText(/1 article awaiting review/)).toBeTruthy();

    cleanup();
    defaultGet({ '/assets/knowledge-base/pending_review/': () => ({ data: [] }) });
    render(<KnowledgeBaseReviewQueue />);
    expect(await screen.findByText('Nothing pending review.')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('blocks the queue for non-staff users', async () => {
    employee();
    render(<KnowledgeBaseReviewQueue />);
    expect(await screen.findByText(/do not have permission to review/)).toBeTruthy();
  });
});

describe('KB management states and conflicts', () => {
  it('shows a conflict when a stale edit is saved and offers reload', async () => {
    render(<KnowledgeBase />);
    await screen.findByText('VPN reset');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Edit' }));
    await screen.findByRole('dialog');
    mockPatch.mockRejectedValue({
      response: { status: 409, data: { detail: 'Another user modified this article after you loaded it.' } },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save changes' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(/Another user modified this article/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reload latest' })).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockPatch).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      '/assets/knowledge-base/1/',
      expect.objectContaining({ version: 3 }),
    );
  });

  it('shows loading and error states for the article detail', async () => {
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      if (String(url) === '/assets/knowledge-base/1/') {
        throw { response: { status: 500, data: { detail: 'Server exploded' } } };
      }
      return paginated([]);
    });
    render(<KnowledgeBaseDetail id="1" />);
    expect(await screen.findByText(/Server exploded/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retry' })).toBeTruthy();
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, cleanup, fireEvent, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockPost, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockPost: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: {
    get: (...a) => mockGet(...a),
    post: (...a) => mockPost(...a),
    patch: vi.fn(),
    delete: vi.fn(),
  },
}));
vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({ useAuth: (...a) => mockAuth(...a) }));

import { LicenseAllocationsPage } from '../../pages/licensing/LicenseAllocations';

const STAFF_ROLES = ['system_admin', 'it_manager', 'it_support'];

function makeAuth(role) {
  const isSystemAdmin = role === 'system_admin';
  const isITManager = role === 'it_manager';
  const isITSupport = role === 'it_support';
  const isEmployee = role === 'employee';
  const isStaff = STAFF_ROLES.includes(role);
  return {
    access: 'token', isStaff, isAdmin: isSystemAdmin, isSystemAdmin, isITManager, isITSupport, isEmployee,
    canViewLicensing: isStaff || isEmployee,
    canManageLicenseAllocations: isStaff,
    canManageLicenseCompliance: isSystemAdmin || isITManager,
  };
}

const ALLOCATION = {
  id: 11,
  allocation_reference: 'LIC-2026-00001-SEAT-0001',
  product_name: 'Acrobat',
  agreement: 3,
  agreement_number: 'LIC-2026-00001',
  allocation_type: 'user',
  user_email: 'sam@x.io',
  asset_tag: null,
  status: 'active',
  assigned_at: '2026-01-05T10:00:00Z',
  last_verified_at: null,
};

const HISTORY = [
  {
    id: 501,
    event_type: 'allocation_revoked',
    previous_status: 'active',
    new_status: 'revoked',
    actor_email: 'manager@x.io',
    detail: { reason: 'Returned laptop' },
    created_at: '2026-02-01T09:30:00Z',
  },
];

function setupGet({ allocations = [ALLOCATION], history = HISTORY, historyError = null } = {}) {
  mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
    if (url.startsWith('/accounts/users/')) {
      return { data: { results: [{ id: 7, employee_id: 'E7', email: 'sam@x.io' }] } };
    }
    if (url.includes('/history/')) {
      if (historyError) throw historyError;
      return { data: history };
    }
    return { data: { results: allocations, count: allocations.length, next: null, previous: null } };
  });
}

function listCalls() {
  return mockGet.mock.calls.filter(([url]) => String(url).startsWith('/licensing/allocations/?'));
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  mockAuth.mockImplementation(() => makeAuth('it_manager'));
  mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
  setupGet();
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('License allocations - release workflow', () => {
  it('requires confirmation and posts the release reason to the release endpoint', async () => {
    render(<LicenseAllocationsPage />);
    await screen.findByText('Acrobat');

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Release' }));

    expect(screen.getByRole('dialog', { name: /Release allocation LIC-2026-00001-SEAT-0001/ })).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText(/marks the allocation/i)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText(/cannot be undone/i)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Release reason/i), { target: { value: 'Returned laptop' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirm release' }));

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/licensing/allocations/11/release/', { reason: 'Returned laptop' });
    });
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText(/Allocation LIC-2026-00001-SEAT-0001 released/)).toBeTruthy();
    });
    await waitFor(() => expect(listCalls().length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2));
    expect(screen.queryByRole('dialog')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('sends an empty reason when none is provided so the backend default applies', async () => {
    render(<LicenseAllocationsPage />);
    await screen.findByText('Acrobat');

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Release' }));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirm release' }));

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/licensing/allocations/11/release/', { reason: '' });
    });
  });

  it('prevents duplicate submissions while a release is in flight', async () => {
    let resolvePost;
    mockPost.mockImplementationOnce(() => new Promise((res) => { resolvePost = res; }));

    render(<LicenseAllocationsPage />);
    await screen.findByText('Acrobat');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Release' }));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirm release' }));

    const pending = await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Releasingâ€¦' });
    expect(pending.disabled).toBe(true);
    fireEvent.click(pending);
    expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);

    resolvePost({ data: {} });
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByRole('dialog')).toBeNull());
    expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('shows the backend error and keeps the dialog open when release fails', async () => {
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 400, data: { detail: 'Allocation is already revoked.' } } });

    render(<LicenseAllocationsPage />);
    await screen.findByText('Acrobat');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Release' }));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirm release' }));

    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText('Allocation is already revoked.')).toBeTruthy());
    expect(screen.getByRole('dialog', { name: /Release allocation/ })).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirm release' }).disabled).toBe(false);
  });

  it('shows a permission error for a forbidden release', async () => {
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 403 } });

    render(<LicenseAllocationsPage />);
    await screen.findByText('Acrobat');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Release' }));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirm release' }));

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText('Forbidden: you lack permission for this action.')).toBeTruthy();
    });
  });
});

describe('License allocations - employee offboarding', () => {
  const PREVIEW = {
    data: {
      user_id: 7,
      count: 2,
      allocations: [
        {
          id: 11, product_name: 'Acrobat', agreement_number: 'LIC-2026-00001',
          allocation_reference: 'LIC-2026-00001-SEAT-0001', allocation_type: 'user', status: 'active',
        },
        {
          id: 12, product_name: 'Photoshop', agreement_number: 'LIC-2026-00002',
          allocation_reference: 'LIC-2026-00002-DEV-0001', allocation_type: 'device', status: 'assigned',
        },
      ],
    },
  };
  const RESULT = {
    data: {
      user_id: 7,
      revoked_count: 1,
      total_active: 2,
      results: [
        { allocation_id: 11, product: 'Acrobat', reference: 'LIC-2026-00001-SEAT-0001', success: true },
        { allocation_id: 12, product: 'Photoshop', reference: 'LIC-2026-00002-DEV-0001', success: false, error: 'Agreement is terminated.' },
      ],
    },
  };

  async function selectEmployee() {
    render(<LicenseAllocationsPage />);
    await screen.findByText('Acrobat');
    await screen.findByRole('option', { name: /E7/ });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Employee'), { target: { value: '7' } });
  }

  it('previews affected seats without revoking anything', async () => {
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      if (url.startsWith('/accounts/users/')) return { data: { results: [{ id: 7, employee_id: 'E7', email: 'sam@x.io' }] } };
      if (url.startsWith('/licensing/allocations/offboarding-preview/')) return PREVIEW;
      return { data: { results: [ALLOCATION], count: 1, next: null, previous: null } };
    });

    await selectEmployee();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Preview affected seats' }));

    await screen.findByText(/2 active or reserved allocation\(s\) would be revoked/);
    expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/licensing/allocations/offboarding-preview/?user=7');
    expect(screen.getByText('Photoshop')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('LIC-2026-00002')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('only revokes after explicit confirmation and reports per-allocation failures', async () => {
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      if (url.startsWith('/accounts/users/')) return { data: { results: [{ id: 7, employee_id: 'E7', email: 'sam@x.io' }] } };
      if (url.startsWith('/licensing/allocations/offboarding-preview/')) return PREVIEW;
      return { data: { results: [ALLOCATION], count: 1, next: null, previous: null } };
    });
    mockPost.mockResolvedValueOnce(RESULT);

    await selectEmployee();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Preview affected seats' }));
    await screen.findByText(/would be revoked/);

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Execute offboardingâ€¦' }));
    expect(screen.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Confirm employee offboarding' })).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Revoke seats' }));

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/licensing/allocations/offboard/', { user_id: 7 });
    });
    await waitFor(() => expect(document.body.textContent).toContain('Revoked 1 of 2 allocation(s).'));
    expect(document.body.textContent).toContain('Photoshop (LIC-2026-00002-DEV-0001): Agreement is terminated.');
    // Preview is cleared so the execution cannot be repeated with stale data.
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Execute offboardingâ€¦' })).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('dialog')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('includes the offboarding reason in the execute request when provided', async () => {
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      if (url.startsWith('/accounts/users/')) return { data: { results: [{ id: 7, employee_id: 'E7', email: 'sam@x.io' }] } };
      if (url.startsWith('/licensing/allocations/offboarding-preview/')) return PREVIEW;
      return { data: { results: [ALLOCATION], count: 1, next: null, previous: null } };
    });
    mockPost.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { revoked_count: 0, total_active: 0, results: [] } });

    await selectEmployee();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Preview affected seats' }));
    await screen.findByText(/would be revoked/);

    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Offboarding reason/i), { target: { value: 'Left the company' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Execute offboardingâ€¦' }));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Revoke seats' }));

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/licensing/allocations/offboard/', {
        user_id: 7,
        reason: 'Left the company',
      });
    });
  });

  it('shows a preview error without enabling execution', async () => {
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      if (url.startsWith('/accounts/users/')) return { data: { results: [{ id: 7, employee_id: 'E7', email: 'sam@x.io' }] } };
      if (url.startsWith('/licensing/allocations/offboarding-preview/')) {
        throw { response: { status: 404, data: { detail: 'User not found.' } } };
      }
      return { data: { results: [ALLOCATION], count: 1, next: null, previous: null } };
    });

    await selectEmployee();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Preview affected seats' }));

    await screen.findByText('User not found.');
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Execute offboardingâ€¦' })).toBeNull();
    expect(mockPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

describe('License compliance - remediation', () => {
  it('records a remediation note with optional re-evaluation and reports the resulting status', async () => {
    mockPost.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { status: 'resolved' } });
    render(<LicenseCompliancePage />);
    await screen.findByText('Unlicensed Acrobat installation');

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Remediate' }));

    expect(screen.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Remediate Finding 21' })).toBeTruthy();
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Remediation notes/i), { target: { value: 'Removed the unlicensed copy' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByLabelText(/Re-evaluate compliance/));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Record Remediation' }));

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/licensing/findings/21/remediate/', {
        remediation_note: 'Removed the unlicensed copy',
        reevaluate: true,
      });
    });
    await screen.findByText(/the finding is now resolved/i);
    await waitFor(() => expect(findingListCalls().length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2));
    expect(screen.queryByRole('dialog')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('requires a remediation note before submitting', async () => {
    render(<LicenseCompliancePage />);
    await screen.findByText('Unlicensed Acrobat installation');

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Remediate' }));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Record Remediation' }));

    expect(screen.getByText('A remediation note is required.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('reports the acknowledged status when no re-evaluation changed the finding', async () => {
    render(<LicenseCompliancePage />);
    await screen.findByText('Unlicensed Acrobat installation');

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Remediate' }));
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Remediation notes/i), { target: { value: 'Documented the workaround' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Record Remediation' }));

    await screen.findByText('Remediation recorded. Finding status: Acknowledged.');
  });

  it('prevents duplicate remediation submissions', async () => {
    let resolvePost;
    mockPost.mockImplementationOnce(() => new Promise((res) => { resolvePost = res; }));
    render(<LicenseCompliancePage />);
    await screen.findByText('Unlicensed Acrobat installation');

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Remediate' }));
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Remediation notes/i), { target: { value: 'Patched' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Record Remediation' }));

    const pending = await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Savingâ€¦' });

    resolvePost({ data: { status: 'acknowledged' } });
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByRole('dialog')).toBeNull());
    expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('surfaces a permission error when the backend rejects the remediation', async () => {
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 403 } });
    render(<LicenseCompliancePage />);
    await screen.findByText('Unlicensed Acrobat installation');

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Remediate' }));
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Remediation notes/i), { target: { value: 'Tried to fix' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Record Remediation' }));

    await screen.findByText('Forbidden: you lack permission for this action.');
    expect(screen.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Remediate Finding 21' })).toBeTruthy();
  });
});

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/licensing/findings/21/resolve/', {
        resolution_note: 'Reinstalled a licensed copy',
      });
    });
    await screen.findByText('Finding 21 resolved.');
    expect(screen.queryByRole('dialog')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('marks a finding as a false positive with a justification', async () => {
    render(<LicenseCompliancePage />);
    await screen.findByText('Unlicensed Acrobat installation');

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'False Positive' }));
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Justification/i), { target: { value: 'Approved trial install' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Mark false positive' }));

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/licensing/findings/21/false-positive/', {
        resolution_note: 'Approved trial install',
      });
    });
    await screen.findByText('Finding 21 marked as a false positive.');
  });

  it('does not offer actions on closed findings', async () => {
    setupGet([{ ...FINDING, status: 'resolved' }]);
    render(<LicenseCompliancePage />);
    await screen.findByText('Unlicensed Acrobat installation');

    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Acknowledge' })).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Remediate' })).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.getByText('Closed')).toBeTruthy();
  });
});

describe('License compliance - permissions', () => {
  it('only allows IT Support to acknowledge findings', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockImplementation(() => makeAuth('it_support'));
    render(<LicenseCompliancePage />);
    await screen.findByText('Unlicensed Acrobat installation');

    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Acknowledge' })).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Remediate' })).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Resolve' })).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'False Positive' })).toBeNull();
    expect(document.body.textContent).toContain('requires IT Manager or System Admin permission');
  });

  it('denies employees and never requests findings', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockImplementation(() => makeAuth('employee'));
    render(<LicenseCompliancePage />);

    expect(screen.getByText('You do not have permission to access this page.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockGet).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';

import { LicenseAgreementDetail } from '../../pages/licensing/LicenseAgreementDetail';

function makeAuth() {
  return {
    access: 'token',
    isStaff: true,
    canViewLicensing: true,
    canViewLicenseCosts: true,
    canManageLicenseAgreements: true,
  };

const AGREEMENT = {
  id: 3,
  agreement_number: 'LIC-2026-00001',
  product_name: 'Acrobat',
  status: 'active',
  is_unlimited: false,
  quantity_allocated: 2,
  quantity_purchased: 5,
  quantity_available: 3,
  utilization_percent: 40,
  currency: 'USD',
  total_cost: '1000.00',
  expiry_date: '2027-01-01',
  renewal_date: '2026-12-01',
};

const HISTORY = [
  {
    id: 900,
    event_type: 'allocation_revoked',
    previous_status: 'assigned',
    new_status: 'revoked',
    actor_email: 'manager@x.io',
    detail: { reason: 'Returned laptop' },
    created_at: '2026-02-01T09:30:00Z',
  },
  {
    id: 899,
    event_type: 'agreement_activated',
    previous_status: '',
    new_status: 'active',
    actor_email: null,
    detail: {},
    created_at: '2026-01-02T09:30:00Z',
  },
];

function setupGet(history = HISTORY) {
  mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
    if (String(url).endsWith('/history/')) return { data: history };
    if (String(url).endsWith('/utilization/')) throw new Error('no utilization');
    return { data: AGREEMENT };
  });
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  mockAuth.mockImplementation(() => makeAuth());
  setupGet();
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('License agreement detail - history integration', () => {
  it('renders agreement and allocation lifecycle events from the history endpoint', async () => {
    render(<LicenseAgreementDetail id={3} />);

    await screen.findByText('Allocation Revoked');
    expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/licensing/agreements/3/history/');
    expect(screen.getByText('Agreement Activated')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Assigned â†’ Revoked')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('manager@x.io')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('System')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Reason: Returned laptop')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('shows an empty state when the agreement has no history', async () => {
    setupGet([]);
    render(<LicenseAgreementDetail id={3} />);

    await screen.findByText('No history recorded for this agreement.');
  });

  it('shows a permission message for a forbidden history request and still renders the agreement', async () => {
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      if (String(url).endsWith('/history/')) throw { response: { status: 403 } };
      if (String(url).endsWith('/utilization/')) throw new Error('no utilization');
      return { data: AGREEMENT };
    });
    render(<LicenseAgreementDetail id={3} />);

    await screen.findByText('You do not have permission to view this agreement history.');
    expect(screen.getByText('LIC-2026-00001')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('shows the API error detail when history fails to load', async () => {
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      if (String(url).endsWith('/history/')) {
        throw { response: { status: 500, data: { detail: 'History unavailable.' } } };
      }
      if (String(url).endsWith('/utilization/')) throw new Error('no utilization');
      return { data: AGREEMENT };
    });
    render(<LicenseAgreementDetail id={3} />);

    await screen.findByText('History unavailable.');
  });
});

describe('Role capabilities', () => {
  it('system_admin has full lifecycle access', () => {
    const a = makeAuth('system_admin');
    expect(a.canViewLifecycle).toBe(true);
    expect(a.canCreateLifecycleCase).toBe(true);
    expect(a.canManageLifecycleCase).toBe(true);
    expect(a.canManageLifecycleTemplates).toBe(true);
    expect(a.canManageLifecycleTasks).toBe(true);
    expect(a.canCompleteLifecycleCase).toBe(true);
    expect(a.canViewLifecycleDashboard).toBe(true);
  });

  it('it_manager can create and manage cases, complete and cancel', () => {
    const m = makeAuth('it_manager');
    expect(m.canCreateLifecycleCase).toBe(true);
    expect(m.canManageLifecycleCase).toBe(true);
    expect(m.canCompleteLifecycleCase).toBe(true);
    expect(m.canManageLifecycleTemplates).toBe(true);
    expect(m.canManageLifecycleTasks).toBe(true);
  });

  it('it_support has operational access but no template management', () => {
    const s = makeAuth('it_support');

    expect(s.canCreateLifecycleCase).toBe(true);
    expect(s.canManageLifecycleCase).toBe(false);
    expect(s.canCompleteLifecycleCase).toBe(false);
    expect(s.canManageLifecycleTemplates).toBe(false);
    expect(s.canManageLifecycleTasks).toBe(true);
  });

  it('employee can view own dashboard but not create or manage', () => {
    const e = makeAuth('employee');

    expect(e.canCreateLifecycleCase).toBe(false);
    expect(e.canManageLifecycleCase).toBe(false);
    expect(e.canManageLifecycleTemplates).toBe(false);
    expect(e.canManageLifecycleTasks).toBe(false);
    expect(e.canCompleteLifecycleCase).toBe(false);
    expect(e.canViewLifecycleDashboard).toBe(true);
  });

  it('unknown role fails closed', () => {
    const u = makeAuth(undefined);
    expect(u.user).toBeNull();

    expect(u.canCreateLifecycleCase).toBe(false);
    expect(u.canManageLifecycleCase).toBe(false);

  it('null user fails closed', () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue({

    const auth = makeAuth(undefined);
    expect(auth.user).toBeNull();
  });

    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^Confirm$/ })).toBeTruthy());
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^Confirm$/ }));

  it('Unblock action calls backend', async () => {
    const blockedCase = { ...CASE_DETAIL, data: { ...CASE_DETAIL.data, status: 'blocked', version: 3 } };
    authFor('it_manager');
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce(blockedCase);
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce(SUMMARY_DATA);

    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce(TASKS_PAGE);
    mockPost.mockResolvedValueOnce(CASE_DETAIL);

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Unblock/ }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^Confirm$/ })).toBeTruthy());
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^Confirm$/ }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/lifecycle/cases/100/unblock/', expect.objectContaining({ version: 3 })));
  });

  it('Complete action calls backend', async () => {
    authFor('it_manager');
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce(CASE_READY_FOR_CLOSURE);
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce(SUMMARY_DATA);
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce(HISTORY_PAGE);
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce(TASKS_PAGE);
    mockPost.mockResolvedValueOnce(CASE_READY_FOR_CLOSURE);
    render(<LifecycleDetail id="100" />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText('ONB-2026-00001')).toBeTruthy());
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Complete/ }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^Confirm$/ })).toBeTruthy());
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^Confirm$/ }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/lifecycle/cases/100/complete/', expect.objectContaining({ version: 4 })));
  });

  it('Cancel action requires reason', async () => {
    authFor('it_support');
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce(CASE_DETAIL);
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce(SUMMARY_DATA);
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce(HISTORY_PAGE);
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce(TASKS_PAGE);
    render(<LifecycleDetail id="100" />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText('ONB-2026-00001')).toBeTruthy());
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Cancel/ }));
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/Reason/)).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('409 stale version shows message and reloads', async () => {
    authFor('it_manager');
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce(CASE_DRAFT);
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce(SUMMARY_DATA);
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce(HISTORY_PAGE);
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce(TASKS_PAGE);
    const staleError = { response: { status: 409, data: { version: 'Stale version; the case was modified concurrently.' } } };
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce(staleError);
    // Reload after 409: 4 more GET calls
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce(CASE_DRAFT);
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce(SUMMARY_DATA);
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce(HISTORY_PAGE);
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce(TASKS_PAGE);
    render(<LifecycleDetail id="100" />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText('ONB-2026-00001')).toBeTruthy());
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Plan/ }));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Confirm/ }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText(/This case changed while you were working/)).toBeTruthy());
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, cleanup, waitFor, fireEvent } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockPost, mockPatch, mockDelete, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockPost: vi.fn(),
  mockPatch: vi.fn(),
  mockDelete: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: {
    get: (...a) => mockGet(...a),
    post: (...a) => mockPost(...a),
    patch: (...a) => mockPatch(...a),
    delete: (...a) => mockDelete(...a),
  },
}));
vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({
  useAuth: (...a) => mockAuth(...a),
}));

import { LifecycleDashboard } from '../../pages/lifecycle/LifecycleDashboard';
import { LifecycleCases } from '../../pages/lifecycle/LifecycleCases';

const STAFF_ROLES = ['system_admin', 'it_manager', 'it_support'];

function makeAuth(role) {
  const isSystemAdmin = role === 'system_admin';
  const isITManager = role === 'it_manager';
  const isITSupport = role === 'it_support';
  const isEmployee = role === 'employee';
  const isStaff = role ? STAFF_ROLES.includes(role) : false;
  return {
    access: 'token',
    isStaff, isAdmin: isSystemAdmin, isSystemAdmin, isITManager, isITSupport, isEmployee,
    isManagerOrAdmin: isSystemAdmin || isITManager,
    isSupportOrAbove: isSystemAdmin || isITManager || isITSupport,
    canViewLifecycle: true,
    canCreateLifecycleCase: isStaff,
    canManageLifecycleCase: isSystemAdmin || isITManager,
    canManageLifecycleTemplates: isSystemAdmin || isITManager,
    canManageLifecycleTasks: isStaff,
    canCompleteLifecycleCase: isSystemAdmin || isITManager,
    canViewLifecycleDashboard: true,
    role,
    user: role ? { id: 1, employee_id: 'E1', role, email: `${role}@x` } : null,
  };
}

function authFor(role) {
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth(role));
}

===== src\__tests__\problem-management\evidence.test.jsx =====

import { describe, test, expect, beforeEach, afterEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';
import { MemoryRouter } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Evidence } from '../../components/problem-management/evidence';
import { archiveEvidence, listEvidence } from '../../services/problem-management';

vi.mock('../../services/problem-management', () => ({
  archiveEvidence: vi.fn(),
  listEvidence: vi.fn(),
  uploadEvidence: vi.fn(),
}));

const auth = vi.hoisted(() => ({ current: { isStaff: true } }));
vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({ useAuth: () => auth.current }));

afterEach(cleanup);

const ACTIVE = {
  id: 11,
  original_filename: 'note_kBtjLl0.txt',
  file_type: 'text/plain',
  file_size: 2048,
  uploaded_at: '2026-01-01T09:00:00Z',
  archived: false,
};

const ARCHIVED = {
  id: 12,
  original_filename: 'old_2Xk9.txt',
  archived: true,
};

const renderEvidence = () => render(
  <MemoryRouter>
    <Evidence problemId="1" />
  </MemoryRouter>,
);

describe('Evidence archive contract', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    auth.current = { isStaff: true };
    listEvidence.mockResolvedValue({ results: [ACTIVE, ARCHIVED] });
  });

  test('archives through the supported endpoint without a version token', async () => {
    renderEvidence();
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByText('Archive'));
    await waitFor(() => expect(archiveEvidence).toHaveBeenCalledWith(11));
  });

  test('renders an archived item as archived and offers no unarchive action', async () => {
    renderEvidence();
    expect(await screen.findByText('old_2Xk9.txt')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getAllByText('Archived').length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(screen.queryByText(/unarchive/i)).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryAllByRole('button', { name: /unarchive/i })).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  test('never renders a private storage path and labels the stored basename', async () => {
    renderEvidence();
    expect(await screen.findByText('Stored filename')).toBeTruthy();
    renderEvidence();
    await screen.findByText('old_2Xk9.txt');
    expect(screen.queryByText(/private\//)).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByText(/secret-path/)).toBeNull();
  });

  test('renders an archive permission denial safely', async () => {
    archiveEvidence.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 403 } });
    renderEvidence();
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByText('Archive'));
    expect(await screen.findByText('You do not have permission to archive evidence.')).toBeTruthy();
  });
});

    problemDetail.mockResolvedValue(PROBLEM);
    submitProblem.mockResolvedValue({ ...PROBLEM, status: 'investigating', version: 3 });
  });

  test('renders transition buttons for staff', async () => {
    renderTransitions();
    expect(await screen.findByText('Submit')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Accept')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Reject')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  test('renders manager buttons', async () => {
    renderTransitions();
    expect(await screen.findByText('Start Investigation')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  test('handles transition clicks with the loaded record version', async () => {
    renderTransitions();
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByText('Submit'));
    await waitFor(() => expect(submitProblem).toHaveBeenCalledWith('1', { expected_record_version: 2 }));
  });

  test('surfaces a stale-version rejection without pretending it succeeded', async () => {
    submitProblem.mockRejectedValueOnce({
      response: { status: 409, data: { detail: 'This problem changed since you loaded it.' } },
    });
    renderTransitions();
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByText('Submit'));
    expect(await screen.findByText('This problem changed since you loaded it.')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  test('hides every transition control from employees', async () => {
    auth.current = { isStaff: false, isManagerOrAdmin: false };
    renderTransitions();
    expect(await screen.findByText(/PRB-2026-000001/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByText('Submit')).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByText('Start Investigation')).toBeNull();
  });
});
