===== src\__tests__\problem-management\services-contract.test.jsx =====

import { describe, test, expect, beforeEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import * as services from '../../services/problem-management';

const api = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  get: vi.fn(),
  post: vi.fn(),
  patch: vi.fn(),
  delete: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({ default: api }));

beforeEach(() => {
  Object.values(api).forEach((fn) => fn.mockReset());
  api.get.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
  api.post.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
  api.patch.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
  api.delete.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
});

const call = (fn, ...args) => {
  Object.values(api).forEach((mock) => mock.mockClear());
  return Promise.resolve(fn(...args)).then(() => {
    const entry = Object.entries(api).find(([, mock]) => mock.mock.calls.length > 0);
    if (!entry) return { method: null, url: null, body: null };
    const [method, mock] = entry;
    const [url, body] = mock.mock.calls[0];
    return { method, url, body };
  });
};

describe('canonical API prefix', () => {
  test('problem routes use a single /problems prefix', async () => {
    expect((await call(services.problemDetail, 7)).url).toBe('/problems/7/');
    expect((await call(services.problemList)).url).toBe('/problems/');
    expect((await call(services.problemReadiness, 7)).url).toBe('/problems/7/readiness/');
  });

  test('no helper requests the duplicate /problems/problems prefix', async () => {
    const fns = Object.entries(services).filter(([, fn]) => typeof fn === 'function');
    for (const [, fn] of fns) {
      try {
        await fn(1, {});
      } catch {
        // a helper may reject its arguments; only the URL matters
      }
    }
    const urls = Object.values(api).flatMap((mock) => mock.mock.calls.map(([url]) => String(url)));
    expect(urls.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    urls.forEach((url) => {
      expect(url.startsWith('/')).toBe(true);
      expect(url).not.toContain('/problems/problems/');
      expect(url).not.toContain('//');
    });
  });
});

// Route table dumped from problem_management.urls (Django resolver). Every
// frontend path below must resolve against one of these patterns; there is
// deliberately no linked-changes and no unarchive pattern.
const BACKEND_ROUTES = [
  '^problems/$', '^problems/(?P<pk>\\d+)/$',
  '^root-cause-analyses/$', '^root-cause-analyses/(?P<pk>\\d+)/$',
  '^root-cause-whys/$', '^root-cause-whys/(?P<pk>\\d+)/$',
  '^root-cause-factors/$', '^root-cause-factors/(?P<pk>\\d+)/$',
  '^evidence/$', '^evidence/(?P<pk>\\d+)/$',
  '^actions/$', '^actions/(?P<pk>\\d+)/$',
  '^workarounds/$', '^workarounds/(?P<pk>\\d+)/$',
  '^validations/$', '^validations/(?P<pk>\\d+)/$',
  '^exceptions/$', '^exceptions/(?P<pk>\\d+)/$',
  '^(?P<resource>root-cause-analyses|evidence|actions|workarounds|validations|exceptions)/(?P<pk>\\d+)/(?P<transition>[a-z_-]+)/$',
  'problems/<int:problem_id>/root-cause-analysis/',
  'problems/<int:problem_id>/five-whys/',
  'problems/<int:problem_id>/root-cause-factors/',
  'problems/<int:problem_id>/evidence/',
  'problems/<int:problem_id>/timeline/',
  'problems/<int:problem_id>/actions/',
  'problems/<int:problem_id>/workarounds/',
  'problems/<int:problem_id>/validations/',
  'problems/<int:problem_id>/exceptions/',
  'problems/<int:problem_id>/readiness/',
  'problems/<int:problem_id>/linked-tickets/',
  'problems/<int:problem_id>/linked-cis/',
  'problems/<int:problem_id>/linked-assets/',
  'problems/<int:problem_id>/linked-services/',
  'problems/<int:problem_id>/linked-products/',
];

const RESOLVERS = BACKEND_ROUTES.map((pattern) => {
  const body = pattern
    .replace('<int:problem_id>', '\\d+')
    .replace(/\(\?P<[a-z_]+>/g, '(')
    .replace(/^\^/, '')
    .replace(/\$$/, '');
  return new RegExp(`^/${body}$`);
});

const resolves = (url) => url.replace(/^\/api/, '').split('?')[0];

const FRONTEND_PATHS = [
  '/problems/', '/problems/1/', '/problems/1/readiness/', '/problems/1/timeline/',
  '/problems/1/five-whys/', '/problems/1/root-cause-factors/', '/problems/1/evidence/',
  '/problems/1/actions/', '/problems/1/workarounds/', '/problems/1/validations/',
  '/problems/1/exceptions/', '/problems/1/linked-tickets/', '/problems/1/linked-cis/',
  '/problems/1/linked-assets/', '/problems/1/linked-services/', '/problems/1/linked-products/',
  '/root-cause-analyses/', '/root-cause-analyses/2/', '/root-cause-analyses/2/approve/',
  '/root-cause-whys/', '/root-cause-whys/3/', '/root-cause-factors/', '/root-cause-factors/4/',
  '/evidence/9/archive/', '/actions/4/', '/actions/4/start/', '/actions/4/ineffective/',
  '/workarounds/6/', '/workarounds/6/publish/', '/validations/7/', '/validations/7/inconclusive/',
  '/exceptions/8/', '/exceptions/8/revoke/',
];

describe('backend route registry match', () => {
  test.each(FRONTEND_PATHS)('%s resolves to a registered backend route', (path) => {
    expect(RESOLVERS.some((re) => re.test(resolves(path)))).toBe(true);
  });

  test('no frontend path targets an unregistered relation', () => {
    FRONTEND_PATHS.forEach((path) => {
      expect(path).not.toContain('linked-changes');
      expect(path).not.toContain('unarchive');
    });
  });
});

describe('RCA contract', () => {
  test('create and retrieve hit the governed resource', async () => {
    expect(await call(services.createRCA, { problem: 1, title: 'x' }))
      .toMatchObject({ method: 'post', url: '/root-cause-analyses/' });
    expect(await call(services.getRCA, 2)).toMatchObject({ method: 'get', url: '/root-cause-analyses/2/' });
  });

  test('update sends the loaded version and no unsupported fields', async () => {
    const sent = await call(services.editRCA, 2, { title: 't', description: 'd' }, 4);
    expect(sent.url).toBe('/root-cause-analyses/2/');
    expect(sent.body).toEqual({ title: 't', description: 'd', expected_record_version: 4 });
    expect(sent.body).not.toHaveProperty('confidence');
    expect(sent.body).not.toHaveProperty('limitation');
  });

  test.each(['submit', 'approve', 'reject', 'supersede'])('transition %s uses its own endpoint', async (name) => {
    const fn = services[`${name}RCA`];
    const sent = await call(fn, 2, { expected_record_version: 1 });
    expect(sent).toMatchObject({ method: 'post', url: `/root-cause-analyses/2/${name}/` });
  });
});

describe('Five Whys and factors', () => {
  test('whys use question_number and never a version token', async () => {
    expect(await call(services.fiveWhys, 1)).toMatchObject({ method: 'get', url: '/problems/1/five-whys/' });
    const created = await call(services.createFiveWhy, {
      analysis: 2, question_number: 1, question_text: 'Why?', answer: 'Because',
    });
    expect(created.url).toBe('/root-cause-whys/');
    expect(created.body).not.toHaveProperty('expected_record_version');
    const patched = await call(services.editFiveWhy, 3, { answer: 'Because.' });
    expect(patched.url).toBe('/root-cause-whys/3/');
    expect(patched.body).toEqual({ answer: 'Because.' });
    expect((await call(services.deleteFiveWhy, 3)).method).toBe('delete');
  });

  test('factors use factor/contribution and delete without a version token', async () => {
    expect(await call(services.rootCauseFactors, 1))
      .toMatchObject({ method: 'get', url: '/problems/1/root-cause-factors/' });
    const created = await call(services.createFactor, { analysis: 2, category: 'method', factor: 'f' });
    expect(created.url).toBe('/root-cause-factors/');
    expect(created.body).toEqual({ analysis: 2, category: 'method', factor: 'f' });
    const patched = await call(services.editFactor, 5, { contribution: 'major' });
    expect(patched.body).toEqual({ contribution: 'major' });
    expect((await call(services.deleteFactor, 5)).method).toBe('delete');
  });
});

describe('Evidence contract', () => {
  test('upload is multipart and carries no version token', async () => {
    const file = new File(['x'], 'note.txt', { type: 'text/plain' });
    const sent = await call(services.uploadEvidence, 1, file, null);
    expect(sent.method).toBe('post');
    expect(sent.url).toBe('/problems/1/evidence/');
    expect(sent.body instanceof FormData).toBe(true);
    expect(sent.body.get('file')).toBeInstanceOf(File);
    expect(sent.body.has('expected_record_version')).toBe(false);
  });

  test('archive posts to the supported endpoint with no body fields', async () => {
    const sent = await call(services.archiveEvidence, 9);
    expect(sent).toMatchObject({ method: 'post', url: '/evidence/9/archive/' });
    expect(sent.body).toEqual({});
  });

  test('there is no unarchive service', () => {
    expect(Object.keys(services).some((name) => /unarchive/i.test(name))).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('Timeline contract', () => {
  test('list and create use the problem-scoped collection', async () => {
    expect(await call(services.problemTimeline, 1))
      .toMatchObject({ method: 'get', url: '/problems/1/timeline/' });
    const created = await call(services.createTimelineEvent, 1, {
      event_type: 'milestone', title: 'Kickoff',
      description: 'start', occurred_at: '2026-01-01T09:00:00.000Z',
    });
    expect(created).toMatchObject({ method: 'post', url: '/problems/1/timeline/' });
    expect(created.body).toHaveProperty('occurred_at');
  });
});

describe('Action lifecycle', () => {
  test('creation is problem-scoped and uses real fields', async () => {
    const created = await call(services.createAction, 1, {
      title: 'Replace disk', action_type: 'corrective', due_at: null,
    });
    expect(created.url).toBe('/problems/1/actions/');
    expect(created.body).not.toHaveProperty('validation_status');

  ])('%s posts to /actions/<id>/%s/', async (fnName, slug) => {

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, cleanup, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockPost, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockPost: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({ default: { get: (...a) => mockGet(...a), post: (...a) => mockPost(...a) } }));
vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({ useAuth: (...a) => mockAuth(...a) }));

import { ProcurementCreditNotesPage, ProcurementCreditNoteForm, ProcurementCreditNoteDetail } from '../../pages/procurement/ProcurementCreditNotes';

function authUser(role, id = 1) {
  return {
    access: 'token',
    role,
    user: { id, role },
    isSystemAdmin: role === 'system_admin',
    isITManager: role === 'it_manager',
    isITSupport: role === 'it_support',
    isSuperuser: false,
  };
}

const creditNote = {
  id: 2, credit_note_number: 'CN-1', vendor_name: 'Acme', invoice_number: 'INV-1', return_number: null,
  status: 'approved', total: '50.00', currency: 'NPR', applied_amount: '0.00', created_by: 2, lines: [], version: 1,
};

function mockCreditLoad(overrides = {}) {
  const cn = { ...creditNote, ...overrides };
  mockGet.mockImplementation((url) => {
    if (url === '/procurement/credit-notes/2/') return Promise.resolve({ data: cn });
    return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [] } });
  });
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.resetAllMocks();
  window.prompt = vi.fn(() => null);
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue(authUser('it_manager'));
  mockCreditLoad();
  mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
});
afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('P3 credit notes list', () => {
  it('renders the loading state and rows from the exact endpoint', async () => {
    mockGet.mockImplementation((url) => {
      if (url === '/procurement/credit-notes/?page_size=50') {
        return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [{ id: 2, credit_note_number: 'CN-1', vendor_name: 'Acme', invoice_number: 'INV-1', status: 'approved', total: '50.00', currency: 'NPR', applied_amount: '0.00' }] } });
      }
      return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [] } });
    });
    render(<ProcurementCreditNotesPage />);
    expect(screen.getByRole('status').textContent).toMatch(/Loading credit notes/);
    expect(await screen.findByText('CN-1')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'CN-1' }).getAttribute('href')).toBe('#/procurement/credit-notes/2');
    expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/procurement/credit-notes/?page_size=50');
  });

  it('shows an empty state', async () => {
    render(<ProcurementCreditNotesPage />);
    expect(await screen.findByText('No credit notes.')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('shows a standardized error with Retry', async () => {
    mockGet.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 403, data: {} } });
    render(<ProcurementCreditNotesPage />);
    expect(await screen.findByRole('alert')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('alert').textContent).toMatch(/You do not have permission/);
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { results: [{ id: 3, credit_note_number: 'CN-3', status: 'draft' }] } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retry' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('CN-3')).toBeTruthy();
  });
});

describe('P3 credit note create', () => {
  async function fillForm() {
    render(<ProcurementCreditNoteForm />);
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Credit Note Number/i), { target: { value: 'CN-9' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Vendor ID/i), { target: { value: '2' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Supplier Invoice ID/i), { target: { value: '4' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Credit Date/i), { target: { value: '2026-11-12' } });
  }

  it('posts the exact payload and uses the returned id', async () => {
    mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: { id: 9 } });
    await fillForm();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/procurement/credit-notes/', expect.any(Object)));
    expect(mockPost.mock.calls[0][1]).toMatchObject({
      credit_note_number: 'CN-9', vendor: '2', supplier_invoice: '4', vendor_return: null, currency: 'NPR',
    });
    await waitFor(() => expect(window.location.hash).toBe('#/procurement/credit-notes/9'));
  });

  it('does not navigate when the returned id is missing', async () => {
    window.location.hash = '#/procurement/credit-notes/new';
    mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
    await fillForm();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create' }));
    expect(await screen.findByRole('alert')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('alert').textContent).toMatch(/did not return the new credit note id/);
    expect(window.location.hash).toBe('#/procurement/credit-notes/new');
  });

  it('renders 400 vendor/currency/over-credit errors readably', async () => {
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 400, data: { vendor: ['Vendor must match invoice.'], detail: 'Credit amount exceeds remaining invoice balance.' } } });
    await fillForm();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create' }));
    expect(await screen.findByRole('alert')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Vendor must match invoice.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Credit amount exceeds remaining invoice balance.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('alert').textContent).not.toMatch(/[{}]/);
  });
});

  it('shows apply/reject/cancel to a non-creator manager and no approval on an approved note', async () => {

    render(<ProcurementCreditNoteDetail id={2} />);
    expect(await screen.findByText(/Credit Note CN-1/)).toBeTruthy();

  });

    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(authUser('it_manager', 2));
    mockCreditLoad({ status: 'submitted' });
    render(<ProcurementCreditNoteDetail id={2} />);
    expect(await screen.findByText(/Credit Note CN-1/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Approve' })).toBeNull();

    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(authUser('system_admin', 2));
    mockCreditLoad({ status: 'submitted' });
    render(<ProcurementCreditNoteDetail id={2} />);
    expect(await screen.findByText(/Credit Note CN-1/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Approve' })).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('posts submit, approve, apply, reject and cancel to their exact endpoints', async () => {
    mockCreditLoad({ status: 'draft' });
    render(<ProcurementCreditNoteDetail id={2} />);
    await screen.findByText(/Credit Note CN-1/);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/procurement/credit-notes/2/submit/', {}));
    cleanup();

    mockCreditLoad({ status: 'submitted' });
    render(<ProcurementCreditNoteDetail id={2} />);
    await screen.findByText(/Credit Note CN-1/);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Approve' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/procurement/credit-notes/2/approve/', {}));
    cleanup();

    mockCreditLoad({ status: 'approved' });
    render(<ProcurementCreditNoteDetail id={2} />);
    await screen.findByText(/Credit Note CN-1/);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Apply' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/procurement/credit-notes/2/apply/', {}));
    cleanup();

    window.prompt = vi.fn(() => 'Not applicable');
    mockCreditLoad({ status: 'submitted' });
    render(<ProcurementCreditNoteDetail id={2} />);
    await screen.findByText(/Credit Note CN-1/);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reject' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/procurement/credit-notes/2/reject/', { reason: 'Not applicable' }));
    cleanup();

    mockCreditLoad({ status: 'draft' });
    render(<ProcurementCreditNoteDetail id={2} />);
    await screen.findByText(/Credit Note CN-1/);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/procurement/credit-notes/2/cancel/', { reason: 'Not applicable' }));
  });

  it('reloads exactly once on a 409 conflict without retrying the action', async () => {
    mockCreditLoad({ status: 'approved' });
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 409, data: {} } });
    render(<ProcurementCreditNoteDetail id={2} />);
    await screen.findByText(/Credit Note CN-1/);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Apply' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(/This credit note changed while you were working\. The latest version has been loaded\./)).toBeTruthy();
    await waitFor(() => {
      const loads = mockGet.mock.calls.filter(([url]) => url === '/procurement/credit-notes/2/');
      expect(loads.length).toBe(2);
    });
    expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('uses credit-balance wording and never claims a refund or accounting post', async () => {
    render(<ProcurementCreditNoteDetail id={2} />);
    await screen.findByText(/Credit Note CN-1/);
    expect(screen.getByText(/Credit applied to tracked Invoice balance\./)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByText(/Refund received|Cash received|Vendor payment received|Accounting entry posted/)).toBeNull();
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';

const { mockGet, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({ mockGet: vi.fn(), mockAuth: vi.fn() }));

function makeAuth(role, id = 1, extra = {}) {
  if (role === null) return { access: 'token', user: null, role: undefined };
  return {
    access: 'token',
    role,
    user: { id, role, ...extra },
    isSystemAdmin: role === 'system_admin',
    isITManager: role === 'it_manager',
    isITSupport: role === 'it_support',
    isSuperuser: false,
  };
}

  cards: {

describe('P3 role capabilities', () => {
  it('grants System Admin full operational and financial controls', () => {
    const caps = procurementCapabilities(makeAuth('system_admin'));
    expect(caps.canViewProcurement).toBe(true);
    expect(caps.canViewProcurementReports).toBe(true);
    expect(caps.canManageFinancialControls).toBe(true);
    expect(caps.canApproveSupplierInvoice).toBe(true);
    expect(caps.canMarkSupplierInvoicePaymentReady).toBe(true);
    expect(caps.canRecordSupplierInvoicePayment).toBe(true);
    expect(caps.canApproveVendorReturn).toBe(true);
    expect(caps.canApproveVendorCreditNote).toBe(true);
    expect(caps.canAcceptInvoiceException).toBe(true);
  });

  it('grants IT Manager financial approval and reporting but not System Admin escalation', () => {
    const caps = procurementCapabilities(makeAuth('it_manager'));
    expect(caps.canManageProcurementFinance).toBe(true);
    expect(caps.canApproveVendorReturn).toBe(true);
    expect(caps.canApproveVendorCreditNote).toBe(true);
    expect(caps.canViewProcurementReports).toBe(true);
  });

  it('gives IT Support operational access with no financial controls', () => {
    const caps = procurementCapabilities(makeAuth('it_support'));
    expect(caps.canViewProcurement).toBe(true);
    expect(caps.canCreatePurchaseRequest).toBe(true);
    expect(caps.canManageProcurementFinance).toBe(false);
    expect(caps.canApproveSupplierInvoice).toBe(false);
    expect(caps.canMarkSupplierInvoicePaymentReady).toBe(false);
    expect(caps.canRecordSupplierInvoicePayment).toBe(false);
    expect(caps.canApproveVendorReturn).toBe(false);
    expect(caps.canApproveVendorCreditNote).toBe(false);
    expect(caps.canAcceptInvoiceException).toBe(false);
    expect(caps.canViewProcurementReports).toBe(false);
  });

  it('fails closed for employees, unknown roles, null users and inactive accounts', () => {
    for (const auth of [makeAuth('employee'), makeAuth('auditor'), makeAuth(null)]) {
      const caps = procurementCapabilities(auth);
      expect(caps.canViewProcurement).toBe(false);
      expect(caps.canManageProcurementFinance).toBe(false);
      expect(caps.canViewProcurementReports).toBe(false);
    }
    const inactive = procurementCapabilities(makeAuth('it_manager', 1, { is_active: false }));
    expect(inactive.canViewProcurement).toBe(false);
    expect(inactive.canManageProcurementFinance).toBe(false);
  });

  it('treats superusers as System Admin', () => {
    const caps = procurementCapabilities({ role: 'employee', isSuperuser: true, user: { id: 9, is_superuser: true } });
    expect(caps.canViewProcurement).toBe(true);
    expect(caps.canManageFinancialControls).toBe(true);
  });

  it('mirrors backend action rules for creator self-approval and source status', () => {
    const manager = procurementCapabilities(makeAuth('it_manager'));
    expect(invoiceActionState({ status: 'matched', created_by: 1 }, manager, 1).canApprove).toBe(false);
    expect(invoiceActionState({ status: 'matched', created_by: 2 }, manager, 1).canApprove).toBe(true);
    expect(invoiceActionState({ status: 'draft' }, manager, 1).canClose).toBe(false);
    expect(invoiceActionState({ status: 'paid' }, manager, 1).canCancel).toBe(false);
    expect(vendorReturnActionState({ status: 'pending_approval', created_by: 1 }, manager, 1).canApprove).toBe(false);
    expect(vendorReturnActionState({ status: 'pending_approval', created_by: 1 }, procurementCapabilities(makeAuth('system_admin')), 1, true).canApprove).toBe(true);
    expect(vendorCreditNoteActionState({ status: 'submitted', created_by: 1 }, manager, 1).canApprove).toBe(false);
    expect(vendorCreditNoteActionState({ status: 'approved' }, manager, 1).canApply).toBe(true);
    const support = procurementCapabilities(makeAuth('it_support'));
    expect(invoiceActionState({ status: 'submitted' }, support, 3).canMatch).toBe(true);
    expect(invoiceActionState({ status: 'submitted' }, support, 3).canApprove).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('P3 direct-route protection', () => {
  const routes = [
    '/procurement/invoices', '/procurement/invoices/new', '/procurement/invoices/7', '/procurement/invoices/7/match',
    '/procurement/exceptions', '/procurement/returns', '/procurement/returns/new', '/procurement/returns/7',
    '/procurement/credit-notes', '/procurement/credit-notes/new', '/procurement/credit-notes/7',
    '/procurement/financial-dashboard', '/procurement/vendor-performance',
  ];

  it.each(routes)('denies employees at %s without any API call', (route) => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth('employee'));
    render(<ProcurementRouter route={route} />);
    expect(screen.getByRole('alert').textContent).toMatch(/You do not have permission to access this page\./);
    expect(mockGet).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it.each(routes)('fails closed for unknown roles at %s', (route) => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth('auditor'));
    render(<ProcurementRouter route={route} />);
    expect(screen.getByRole('alert')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockGet).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it.each(routes)('fails closed for a null user at %s', (route) => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth(null));
    render(<ProcurementRouter route={route} />);
    expect(screen.getByRole('alert')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockGet).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('lets IT Support load operational routes', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth('it_support'));
    const { unmount } = render(<ProcurementRouter route="/procurement/invoices" />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/procurement/supplier-invoices/?page_size=50'));
    unmount();
    mockGet.mockClear();
    render(<ProcurementRouter route="/procurement/exceptions" />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/procurement/invoice-exceptions/?page_size=50'));
    cleanup();
    mockGet.mockClear();
    render(<ProcurementRouter route="/procurement/returns" />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/procurement/vendor-returns/?page_size=50'));
    cleanup();
    mockGet.mockClear();
    render(<ProcurementRouter route="/procurement/credit-notes" />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/procurement/credit-notes/?page_size=50'));
  });

  it('denies IT Support the manager-only financial dashboard and vendor performance with no API call', () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth('it_support'));
    const { unmount } = render(<ProcurementRouter route="/procurement/financial-dashboard" />);
    expect(screen.getByRole('alert').textContent).toMatch(/requires IT Manager or System Admin/);
    expect(mockGet).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    unmount();
    render(<ProcurementRouter route="/procurement/vendor-performance" />);
    expect(screen.getByRole('alert').textContent).toMatch(/requires IT Manager or System Admin/);
    expect(mockGet).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('lets a manager load the financial dashboard and vendor performance', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth('it_manager'));
    mockGet.mockImplementation((url) => {
      if (url === '/procurement/financial-dashboard/') return Promise.resolve({ data: dashboard });
      if (url === '/procurement/reports/vendor-performance/') return Promise.resolve({ data: [] });
      return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [] } });
    });
    const { unmount } = render(<ProcurementRouter route="/procurement/financial-dashboard" />);
    expect(await screen.findByText('Procurement Financial Dashboard')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/procurement/financial-dashboard/');
    unmount();
    render(<ProcurementRouter route="/procurement/vendor-performance" />);
    expect(await screen.findByText('Vendor Performance')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/procurement/reports/vendor-performance/');
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, cleanup, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockPost, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockPost: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: {
    get: (...a) => mockGet(...a),
    post: (...a) => mockPost(...a),
  },
}));
vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({ useAuth: (...a) => mockAuth(...a) }));

import { ProcurementInvoicesPage, ProcurementInvoiceExceptionsPage } from '../../pages/procurement/ProcurementInvoices';
import { ProcurementInvoiceForm } from '../../pages/procurement/ProcurementInvoiceForm';
import { ProcurementInvoiceDetail } from '../../pages/procurement/ProcurementInvoiceDetail';

function authUser(role, id = 1, overrides = {}) {
  return {
    access: 'token',
    role,
    user: { id, role, ...overrides },
    isSystemAdmin: role === 'system_admin',
    isITManager: role === 'it_manager',
    isITSupport: role === 'it_support',
    isSuperuser: false,
  };
}

const invoice = {
  id: 1, invoice_number: 'INV-1', vendor_name: 'Acme', po_number: 'PO-1', purchase_order: 5,
  invoice_date: '2026-11-01', due_date: null, currency: 'NPR', status: 'draft', payment_status: 'not_ready',
  subtotal: '100.00', grand_total: '100.00', variance_total: '0.00', payment_hold: false, payment_hold_reason: '',
  latest_match: null, lines: [], version: 2, created_by: 2,
};

function mockInvoiceLoad(overrides = {}) {
  const inv = { ...invoice, ...overrides };
  mockGet.mockImplementation((url) => {
    if (url === '/procurement/supplier-invoices/1/') return Promise.resolve({ data: inv });
    if (url === '/procurement/supplier-invoices/1/readiness/') {
      return Promise.resolve({ data: overrides.readiness || { ready: false, blockers: [{ code: 'NOT_MATCHED', message: 'Match required', severity: 'high' }] } });
    }
    if (url.startsWith('/procurement/purchase-order-items/')) return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [] } });
    if (url.startsWith('/procurement/goods-receipt-items/')) return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [] } });
    if (url === '/procurement/supplier-invoices/?page_size=50') return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [] } });
    return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [] } });
  });
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.resetAllMocks();
  window.location.hash = '#/procurement/invoices';
  window.prompt = vi.fn(() => null);
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue(authUser('it_manager'));
  mockInvoiceLoad();
  mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('P3 invoice list', () => {
  it('renders the loading state then invoices from the exact endpoint', async () => {
    mockGet.mockImplementation((url) => {
      if (url === '/procurement/supplier-invoices/?page_size=50') {
        return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [{
          id: 1, invoice_number: 'INV-1', vendor_name: 'Acme', po_number: 'PO-1', invoice_date: '2026-11-01', due_date: '2026-11-30',
          status: 'draft', payment_status: 'not_ready', grand_total: '100.00', currency: 'NPR', variance_total: '0.00', latest_match: null,
        }], count: 1 } });
      }
      return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [] } });
    });
    render(<ProcurementInvoicesPage />);
    expect(screen.getByRole('status').textContent).toMatch(/Loading invoices/);
    expect(await screen.findByText('INV-1')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'INV-1' }).getAttribute('href')).toBe('#/procurement/invoices/1');
    expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/procurement/supplier-invoices/?page_size=50');
  });

  it('shows an empty state when there are no invoices', async () => {
    render(<ProcurementInvoicesPage />);
    expect(await screen.findByText('No supplier invoices.')).toBeTruthy();

      }
      return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [] } });

    render(<ProcurementInvoiceExceptionsPage />);

    expect(screen.getByText('price_variance')).toBeTruthy();

describe('P3 invoice create', () => {
  function mockLookups() {
    mockGet.mockImplementation((url) => {
      if (url === '/procurement/purchase-orders/?page_size=100') return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [{ id: 5, po_number: 'PO-5', vendor: 2 }] } });
      if (url === '/assets/vendors/?page_size=100') return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [{ id: 2, name: 'Acme' }] } });
      return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [] } });
    });
  }

  async function fillForm(invoiceNumber = 'INV-1') {
    mockLookups();
    render(<ProcurementInvoiceForm />);
    await screen.findByRole('option', { name: 'Acme' });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Invoice Number/i), { target: { value: invoiceNumber } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/^Vendor$/i), { target: { value: '2' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Purchase Order/i), { target: { value: '5' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Invoice Date/i), { target: { value: '2026-11-10' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Received Date/i), { target: { value: '2026-11-11' } });
  }

  it('loads vendors and purchase orders and filters POs by the selected vendor', async () => {
    mockGet.mockImplementation((url) => {
      if (url === '/procurement/purchase-orders/?page_size=100') {
        return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [
          { id: 5, po_number: 'PO-5', vendor: 2 },
          { id: 6, po_number: 'PO-6', vendor: 3 },
        ] } });
      }
      if (url === '/assets/vendors/?page_size=100') {
        return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [{ id: 2, name: 'Acme' }, { id: 3, name: 'Beta' }] } });
      }
      return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [] } });
    });
    render(<ProcurementInvoiceForm />);
    await screen.findByRole('option', { name: 'Acme' });
    expect(await screen.findByRole('option', { name: /PO-5/ })).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('option', { name: /PO-6/ })).toBeTruthy();
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/^Vendor$/i), { target: { value: '2' } });
    expect(screen.queryByRole('option', { name: /PO-6/ })).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.getByRole('option', { name: /PO-5/ })).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('posts the exact payload and navigates with the returned invoice id', async () => {
    await fillForm('INV-9');
    mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: { id: 9 } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Create Invoice/i }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/procurement/supplier-invoices/', expect.any(Object)));
    const payload = mockPost.mock.calls[0][1];
    expect(payload).toMatchObject({ invoice_number: 'INV-9', vendor: '2', purchase_order: '5', currency: 'NPR', due_date: null });
    expect(payload).not.toHaveProperty('subtotal');
    expect(payload).not.toHaveProperty('grand_total');
    expect(payload).not.toHaveProperty('status');
    expect(payload).not.toHaveProperty('normalized_invoice_number');
    await waitFor(() => expect(window.location.hash).toBe('#/procurement/invoices/9'));
  });

  it('does not navigate when the server omits the new invoice id', async () => {
    await fillForm('INV-X');
    mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Create Invoice/i }));
    expect(await screen.findByRole('alert')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('alert').textContent).toMatch(/did not return the new invoice id/);
    expect(window.location.hash).toBe('#/procurement/invoices');
  });

  it('renders 400 field errors readably instead of raw JSON', async () => {
    await fillForm('INV-DUP');
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 400, data: { invoice_number: ['Duplicate invoice number.'], due_date: ['Due date cannot precede invoice date.'] } } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Create Invoice/i }));
    expect(await screen.findByRole('alert')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Duplicate invoice number.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Due date cannot precede invoice date.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('alert').textContent).not.toMatch(/[{}]/);
  });

  it('shows a permission message and prevents double submission', async () => {
    let rejectPost;
    await fillForm('INV-2');
    mockPost.mockReturnValue(new Promise((resolve, reject) => { rejectPost = reject; }));
    const button = screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Create Invoice/i });
    fireEvent.click(button);
    fireEvent.click(button);
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    rejectPost({ response: { status: 403, data: {} } });
    expect(await screen.findByRole('alert')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('alert').textContent).toMatch(/You do not have permission/);
  });
});

describe('P3 invoice detail readiness and visibility', () => {
  it('renders backend readiness blockers and only draft-relevant manager actions', async () => {
    render(<ProcurementInvoiceDetail id={1} />);
    expect(await screen.findByText(/Invoice INV-1/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText(/NOT_MATCHED/)).toBeTruthy();

describe('P3 invoice actions and errors', () => {
  it('records payment with the exact endpoint and payload after both prompts', async () => {
    window.prompt = vi.fn().mockReturnValueOnce('REF-1').mockReturnValueOnce('2026-11-10');
    mockInvoiceLoad({ status: 'payment_ready', payment_status: 'ready' });
    render(<ProcurementInvoiceDetail id={1} />);
    expect(await screen.findByText(/Invoice INV-1/)).toBeTruthy();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Mark Paid' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      '/procurement/supplier-invoices/1/mark-paid/',
      { payment_reference: 'REF-1', payment_date: '2026-11-10' },
    ));
    expect(screen.queryByText(/Payment sent|Payment transferred|Payment executed/)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('reloads exactly once on a 409 conflict without resubmitting', async () => {
    mockInvoiceLoad({ status: 'draft' });
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 409, data: {} } });
    render(<ProcurementInvoiceDetail id={1} />);
    await screen.findByText(/Invoice INV-1/);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(/This invoice changed while you were working\. The latest version has been loaded\./)).toBeTruthy();
    await waitFor(() => {
      const invoiceLoads = mockGet.mock.calls.filter(([url]) => url === '/procurement/supplier-invoices/1/');
      expect(invoiceLoads.length).toBe(2);
    });
    expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('standardizes 403 action failures', async () => {
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 403, data: {} } });
    render(<ProcurementInvoiceDetail id={1} />);
    await screen.findByText(/Invoice INV-1/);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('You do not have permission to perform this action.')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('surfaces 400 field errors from submit near the action', async () => {
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 400, data: { lines: ['At least one line is required.'], detail: 'Invalid invoice.' } } });
    render(<ProcurementInvoiceDetail id={1} />);
    await screen.findByText(/Invoice INV-1/);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('Invalid invoice.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('At least one line is required.')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('surfaces a 400 readiness/variance rejection on approve', async () => {
    mockInvoiceLoad({ status: 'matched' });
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 400, data: { detail: 'Unresolved exceptions block approval.' } } });
    render(<ProcurementInvoiceDetail id={1} />);
    await screen.findByText(/Invoice INV-1/);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Approve' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('Unresolved exceptions block approval.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/procurement/supplier-invoices/1/approve/', {});
  });
});

function mockMatchLoad({ inv = invoice, hist = history, exc = exceptions } = {}) {
  mockGet.mockImplementation((url) => {
    if (url === '/procurement/supplier-invoices/1/') return Promise.resolve({ data: inv });
    if (url === '/procurement/supplier-invoices/1/match-history/') return Promise.resolve({ data: hist });
    if (url === '/procurement/supplier-invoices/1/exceptions/') return Promise.resolve({ data: exc });
    return Promise.resolve({ data: [] });
  });
}

  it('runs the match through the exact endpoint and reloads the backend history', async () => {
    render(<ProcurementMatchingPage id={1} />);
    await screen.findByText(/Three-Way Match: INV-1/);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Run Match' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/procurement/supplier-invoices/1/match/', {}));
    await waitFor(() => {
      const historyLoads = mockGet.mock.calls.filter(([url]) => url === '/procurement/supplier-invoices/1/match-history/');
      expect(historyLoads.length).toBe(2);
    });
  });

  it('allows a repeated match request without inventing client results', async () => {
    render(<ProcurementMatchingPage id={1} />);
    await screen.findByText(/Three-Way Match: INV-1/);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Run Match' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Run Match' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2));
    expect(screen.getAllByText('abc123').length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  it('shows a 400 invalid-state message from the backend', async () => {
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 400, data: { detail: 'Invoice cannot be matched without lines.' } } });
    render(<ProcurementMatchingPage id={1} />);
    await screen.findByText(/Three-Way Match: INV-1/);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Run Match' }));
    expect(await screen.findByRole('alert')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('alert').textContent).toMatch(/cannot be matched without lines/);
  });

  it('standardizes 403 permission failures', async () => {
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 403, data: {} } });
    render(<ProcurementMatchingPage id={1} />);
    await screen.findByText(/Three-Way Match: INV-1/);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Run Match' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('You do not have permission to perform this action.')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('standardizes 404 unavailable records', async () => {
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 404, data: {} } });
    render(<ProcurementMatchingPage id={1} />);
    await screen.findByText(/Three-Way Match: INV-1/);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Run Match' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(/This Procurement record is unavailable or you no longer have access\./)).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('surfaces a 409 conflict from the backend without crashing', async () => {
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 409, data: { detail: 'Invoice changed.' } } });
    render(<ProcurementMatchingPage id={1} />);

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';

import App from '../../App';

function makeAuth(role) {
  const isStaff = role === 'system_admin' || role === 'it_manager' || role === 'it_support';
  const isManager = role === 'system_admin' || role === 'it_manager';
  const active = role !== null && role !== 'inactive';
  return {
    access: active ? 'token' : null,
    role,
    user: active ? { id: 1, email: 'u@x.io', employee_id: 'E1', role, is_active: true } : null,
    profileLoading: false,
    isSystemAdmin: role === 'system_admin',
    isITManager: role === 'it_manager',
    isITSupport: role === 'it_support',
    isStaff,
    isAdmin: role === 'system_admin',
    canViewProcurement: isStaff,
    canViewProcurementReports: isManager,
    login: vi.fn(),
    logout: vi.fn(),
    refreshProfile: vi.fn(),
  };
}

function setupApi() {
  mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
    const u = String(url);
    if (u.startsWith('/procurement/invoice-exceptions/')) return { data: { results: [], count: 0 } };
    if (u.startsWith('/procurement/')) return { data: { results: [], count: 0 } };
    return { data: { results: [], count: 0 } };
  });
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  setupApi();
  window.location.hash = '#/procurement';
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

const NAV_ITEMS = [
  'Supplier Invoices',
  'Invoice Exceptions',
  'Vendor Returns',
  'Vendor Credit Notes',
  'Procurement Financial Dashboard',
  'Vendor Performance',
];

describe('Procurement navigation visibility', () => {

    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth('system_admin'));
    render(<App />);
    for (const label of NAV_ITEMS) expect(screen.getByText(label)).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('IT Manager sees all six P3 entries', () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth('it_manager'));
    render(<App />);
    for (const label of NAV_ITEMS) expect(screen.getByText(label)).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('IT Support sees four operational entries but not financial dashboards', () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth('it_support'));
    render(<App />);
    for (const label of ['Supplier Invoices', 'Invoice Exceptions', 'Vendor Returns', 'Vendor Credit Notes']) {
      expect(screen.getByText(label)).toBeTruthy();
    }
    expect(screen.queryByText('Procurement Financial Dashboard')).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByText('Vendor Performance')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('Employee sees none of the six P3 entries', () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth('employee'));
    render(<App />);
    for (const label of NAV_ITEMS) expect(screen.queryByText(label)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('Unknown role sees none of the six P3 entries', () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth('unknown'));
    render(<App />);
    for (const label of NAV_ITEMS) expect(screen.queryByText(label)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('Null user sees none of the six P3 entries', () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth(null));
    render(<App />);
    for (const label of NAV_ITEMS) expect(screen.queryByText(label)).toBeNull();
  });

describe('Procurement breadcrumbs', () => {
  const cases = [
    ['#/procurement/invoices', 'Supplier Invoices'],
    ['#/procurement/invoices/new', 'New Supplier Invoice'],
    ['#/procurement/invoices/42', 'Supplier Invoice'],
    ['#/procurement/invoices/42/match', 'Matching'],
    ['#/procurement/exceptions', 'Invoice Exceptions'],
    ['#/procurement/returns', 'Vendor Returns'],
    ['#/procurement/returns/new', 'New Vendor Return'],
    ['#/procurement/returns/7', 'Vendor Return'],
    ['#/procurement/credit-notes', 'Vendor Credit Notes'],
    ['#/procurement/credit-notes/new', 'New Vendor Credit Note'],
    ['#/procurement/credit-notes/9', 'Vendor Credit Note'],
    ['#/procurement/financial-dashboard', 'Financial Dashboard'],
    ['#/procurement/vendor-performance', 'Vendor Performance'],
  ];

  for (const [hash, last] of cases) {
    it(`renders breadcrumb for ${hash}`, async () => {
      mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth('system_admin'));
      window.location.hash = hash;
      render(<App />);
      const nav = screen.getByLabelText('Breadcrumb');
      expect(nav.textContent).toContain('Procurement');
      expect(nav.textContent).toContain(last);
    });
  }

  it('does not treat new as an id', () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth('system_admin'));
    window.location.hash = '#/procurement/invoices/new';
    render(<App />);
    const nav = screen.getByLabelText('Breadcrumb');
    expect(nav.textContent).toContain('New Supplier Invoice');
    expect(nav.textContent).not.toContain('Supplier Invoice\n');
  });
});

describe('Procurement title fallback', () => {

    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth('system_admin'));
    window.location.hash = '#/procurement/invoices';
    render(<App />);
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Breadcrumb').textContent).toContain('Supplier Invoices');
  });
});

describe('Purchase order documents and closure', () => {
  const orderRoutes = (order = PO) => (url) => {
    const text = String(url);
    if (text === '/procurement/purchase-orders/4/') return Promise.resolve({ data: order });
    if (text.endsWith('/pdf/')) {
      return Promise.resolve({
        data: new Blob(['pdf'], { type: 'application/pdf' }),
        headers: { 'content-disposition': 'attachment; filename="PO-2026-00004.pdf"' },
      });
    }
    return Promise.resolve(page([]));
  };

  it('downloads the PDF as an authenticated blob and revokes the object URL', async () => {
    mockGet.mockImplementation(orderRoutes());
    render(<PurchaseOrderDetail id="4" />);

    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Download PDF' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(window.URL.createObjectURL).toHaveBeenCalled());
    expect(window.URL.revokeObjectURL).toHaveBeenCalledWith('blob:mock');
    const urls = mockGet.mock.calls.map((c) => String(c[0]));
    expect(urls).toContain('/procurement/purchase-orders/4/pdf/');
    expect(urls.some((u) => u.includes('token='))).toBe(false);
  });

  it('closes an order with a reason and expected version', async () => {
    mockGet.mockImplementation(orderRoutes({ ...PO, status: 'partially_received' }));
    render(<PurchaseOrderDetail id="4" />);

    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Close order' }));
    const dialog = screen.getByRole('dialog');
    fireEvent.change(within(dialog).getByLabelText('Closure reason'), {
      target: { value: 'Vendor cannot supply the remainder' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: 'Close order' }));

    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      '/procurement/purchase-orders/4/close/',
      { reason: 'Vendor cannot supply the remainder', version: 4 },
    ));
  });

  it('does not expose direct purchase order creation', async () => {
    mockGet.mockResolvedValue(page([PO]));
    render(<PurchaseOrdersPage />);
    await screen.findByText('PO-2026-00004');
    expect(screen.queryByRole('link', { name: /new order/i })).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /create order/i })).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('Protected attachments', () => {
  const ATTACHMENT = {
    id: 5, purchase_request: 1, document_type: 'specification',
    original_filename: 'spec.pdf', description: 'Spec', status: 'active',
    uploaded_by_name: 'manager@x', created_at: '2026-11-02T10:00:00Z',
  };

  it('downloads through the protected endpoint as a blob and revokes the URL', async () => {
    mockGet.mockImplementation((url) => {
      if (String(url).includes('/download/')) {
        return Promise.resolve({
          data: new Blob(['x'], { type: 'application/pdf' }),
          headers: { 'content-disposition': 'attachment; filename="spec.pdf"' },
        });
      }
      return Promise.resolve(page([ATTACHMENT]));
    });
    render(<ProcurementAttachments parentType="purchase_request" parentId={1} />);

    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Download' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      '/procurement/attachments/5/download/', { responseType: 'blob' },
    ));
    expect(window.URL.revokeObjectURL).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('uploads with the parent and file in a multipart body', async () => {
    mockGet.mockResolvedValue(page([]));
    render(
      <ProcurementAttachments parentType="purchase_request" parentId={1} canUpload />,
    );
    fireEvent.change(await screen.findByLabelText('Attachment file'), {
      target: { files: [new File(['spec'], 'spec.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' })] },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Upload attachment' }));

    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      '/procurement/attachments/', expect.any(FormData),
    ));
    const body = mockPost.mock.calls[0][1];
    expect(body.get('purchase_request')).toBe('1');
    expect(body.get('file').name).toBe('spec.pdf');
  });
});

  const ITEM = {
    id: 9, goods_receipt: 7, gr_number: 'GR-2026-00007',
    purchase_order: 4, po_number: 'PO-2026-00004',
    purchase_order_item: 21, item_name: 'Laptop', vendor_name: 'Acme Supplies',
    sequence: 1, status: 'pending_registration', purchase_cost: '50.00',
    expected_purchase_date: '2026-11-05', asset_category: 2, asset: null,
  };

  it('registers through the atomic receipt-item endpoint', async () => {
    mockGet.mockImplementation((url) => {
      const text = String(url);
      if (text.startsWith('/procurement/asset-receipt-items/')) return Promise.resolve(page([ITEM]));
      if (text.startsWith('/assets/categories/')) {
        return Promise.resolve(page([{ id: 2, name: 'Laptop', is_active: true }]));
      }
      return Promise.resolve(page([]));
    });
    mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: { ...ITEM, status: 'registered', asset: 99, asset_tag: 'AT-1' } });
    render(<ProcurementAssetsPage />);

    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Register asset' }));
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Asset tag'), { target: { value: 'AT-1' } });
    fireEvent.click(within(screen.getByRole('dialog')).getByRole('button', { name: 'Register asset' }));

    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      '/procurement/asset-receipt-items/9/register-asset/',
      expect.objectContaining({ asset_tag: 'AT-1', name: 'Laptop', category: 2 }),
    ));
    expect(mockPost.mock.calls.every((c) => !String(c[0]).startsWith('/assets/'))).toBe(true);
  });

===== src\__tests__\procurement\procurement-permissions.test.jsx =====

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockPost, mockPatch, mockDelete, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockPost: vi.fn(),
  mockPatch: vi.fn(),
  mockDelete: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: {
    get: (...a) => mockGet(...a),
    post: (...a) => mockPost(...a),
    patch: (...a) => mockPatch(...a),
    delete: (...a) => mockDelete(...a),
  },
}));
vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({ useAuth: (...a) => mockAuth(...a) }));

import { ProcurementRouter } from '../../pages/procurement';
import { procurementCapabilities } from '../../shared/procurement-utils';

function makeAuth(role) {
  if (role === null) return { access: 'token', user: null, role: undefined };
  return {
    access: 'token',
    role,
    user: { id: 1, email: `${role}@x`, role },
    isStaff: ['system_admin', 'it_manager', 'it_support'].includes(role),
    isSystemAdmin: role === 'system_admin',
    isITManager: role === 'it_manager',
    isITSupport: role === 'it_support',
    isManagerOrAdmin: ['system_admin', 'it_manager'].includes(role),
  };
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.resetAllMocks();
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth('it_manager'));
  mockGet.mockResolvedValue({ data: { results: [], count: 0, next: null, previous: null } });
  mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
  mockPatch.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
  mockDelete.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('procurementCapabilities', () => {
  it('grants System Admin every capability', () => {
    const caps = procurementCapabilities(makeAuth('system_admin'));
    expect(Object.values(caps).every(Boolean)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('gives IT Manager approval, vendor and order authority', () => {
    const caps = procurementCapabilities(makeAuth('it_manager'));
    expect(caps.canApprovePurchaseRequest).toBe(true);
    expect(caps.canSelectProcurementVendor).toBe(true);
    expect(caps.canApprovePurchaseOrder).toBe(true);
    expect(caps.canIssuePurchaseOrder).toBe(true);
    expect(caps.canViewProcurementReports).toBe(true);
  });

  it('gives IT Support operational access without approvals', () => {
    const caps = procurementCapabilities(makeAuth('it_support'));
    expect(caps.canViewProcurement).toBe(true);
    expect(caps.canCreatePurchaseRequest).toBe(true);
    expect(caps.canCreateGoodsReceipt).toBe(true);
    expect(caps.canApprovePurchaseRequest).toBe(false);
    expect(caps.canSelectProcurementVendor).toBe(false);
    expect(caps.canApprovePurchaseOrder).toBe(false);
    expect(caps.canIssuePurchaseOrder).toBe(false);
    expect(caps.canViewProcurementReports).toBe(false);
  });

  it('fails closed for employees, unknown roles and a null user', () => {
    for (const auth of [makeAuth('employee'), makeAuth(undefined), makeAuth(null)]) {
      const caps = procurementCapabilities(auth);
      expect(Object.values(caps).some(Boolean)).toBe(false);
    }
  });
});

describe('procurement routes', () => {
  it('renders the dashboard at #/procurement', async () => {
    window.location.hash = '#/procurement';
    render(<ProcurementRouter route="/procurement" />);
    expect(await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: 'Procurement' })).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('denies employees with AccessDenied and makes no API call', () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth('employee'));
    render(<ProcurementRouter route="/procurement/requests" />);
    expect(screen.getByText('You do not have permission to access this page.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockGet).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('denies an unknown role and a null user', () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth(undefined));
    const first = render(<ProcurementRouter route="/procurement/orders" />);
    expect(screen.getByText('You do not have permission to access this page.')).toBeTruthy();
    first.unmount();
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth(null));
    render(<ProcurementRouter route="/procurement" />);
    expect(screen.getByText('You do not have permission to access this page.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockGet).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('handles invalid record ids without calling the API', () => {
    render(<ProcurementRouter route="/procurement/requests/not-a-number" />);
    expect(screen.getByText('This purchase request does not exist.')).toBeTruthy();
    cleanup();
    render(<ProcurementRouter route="/procurement/orders/abc" />);
    expect(screen.getByText('This purchase order does not exist.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockGet).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('routes nested request pages to the right component', async () => {
    mockGet.mockImplementation((url) => {
      if (String(url).startsWith('/procurement/purchase-requests/5/')) {
        return Promise.resolve({
          data: {
            id: 5, pr_number: 'PR-2026-00005', requester: 2, requester_name: 'r@x',
            department: null, status: 'approved', reason: 'Reason', notes: '',
            estimated_total: '10.00', requires_system_admin_approval: false,
            approver: null, approver_name: null, approval_decision: '', approval_reason: '',
            approved_at: null, created_at: '2026-11-01T10:00:00Z',
            updated_at: '2026-11-01T10:00:00Z', items: [], quotations: [], history: [],
          },
        });
      }
      return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [], count: 0, next: null } });
    });
    render(<ProcurementRouter route="/procurement/requests/5/quotations" />);
    expect(await screen.findByText('Quotations Â· PR-2026-00005')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockGet.mock.calls.some((c) => String(c[0]).startsWith('/api/'))).toBe(false);
  });

  it('requires manager rights for reports', () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth('it_support'));
    render(<ProcurementRouter route="/procurement/reports" />);
    expect(screen.getByText('Reports are restricted')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockGet).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('renders asset registration for support staff', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth('it_support'));
    render(<ProcurementRouter route="/procurement/assets" />);
    expect(await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: 'Pending asset registration' })).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('uses only procurement and asset endpoints without a duplicate /api prefix', async () => {
    render(<ProcurementRouter route="/procurement" />);
    await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: 'Procurement' });
    const urls = mockGet.mock.calls.map((call) => String(call[0]));
    expect(urls.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    for (const url of urls) {
      expect(url.startsWith('/procurement/')).toBe(true);
      expect(url.includes('/api/api/')).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  it('shows an honest not-found state for unknown procurement pages', () => {
    render(<ProcurementRouter route="/procurement/nope" />);
    expect(screen.getByText('This procurement page does not exist.')).toBeTruthy();
  });
});

    expect(screen.getByText('Quoted amount must be greater than zero.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('compares quotations and links back to the request', async () => {
    routeGet({ ...REQUEST, quotations: QUOTATIONS });
    render(<PurchaseRequestQuotations id="1" />);

    expect((await screen.findAllByText('Acme Supplies')).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(screen.getAllByText('Second Vendor').length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(screen.getByText(/Best price/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText(/Price is only one selection factor/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'Back to request' }).getAttribute('href'))
      .toBe('#/procurement/requests/1');
  });

  it('selects a vendor with a required reason through the real endpoint', async () => {
    routeGet({ ...REQUEST, quotations: QUOTATIONS });
    render(<PurchaseRequestQuotations id="1" />);

    const secondRow = (await screen.findAllByText('Second Vendor'))[0].closest('tr');
    fireEvent.click(within(secondRow).getByRole('button', { name: 'Select vendor' }));
    const dialog = screen.getByRole('dialog');
    const confirm = within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirm selection' });
    expect(confirm.disabled).toBe(true);

    fireEvent.change(within(dialog).getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Selection reason' }), {
      target: { value: 'Faster delivery' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(confirm);

    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      '/procurement/quotations/41/select/', { reason: 'Faster delivery' },
    ));
  });

  it('does not let IT Support select a vendor', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth('it_support'));
    routeGet({ ...REQUEST, quotations: QUOTATIONS });
    render(<PurchaseRequestQuotations id="1" />);
    await screen.findAllByText('Acme Supplies');
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Select vendor' })).toBeNull();
  });

  it('updates an existing quotation through PATCH', async () => {
    routeGet({ ...REQUEST, quotations: QUOTATIONS });
    render(<PurchaseRequestQuotations id="1" />);
    const rows = await screen.findAllByRole('button', { name: 'Edit' });
    fireEvent.click(rows[0]);
    const dialog = screen.getByRole('dialog');
    fireEvent.change(within(dialog).getByRole('spinbutton', { name: 'Quoted amount' }), {
      target: { value: '95000' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: 'Save quotation' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPatch).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      '/procurement/quotations/40/',
      expect.objectContaining({ quoted_amount: '95000.00' }),
    ));
  });

  it('refuses quotations until the request is approved', async () => {
    routeGet({ ...REQUEST, status: 'pending_approval', quotations: [] });
    render(<PurchaseRequestQuotations id="1" />);
    expect(await screen.findByText(/Quotations can only be recorded for an approved request/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Add quotation' })).toBeNull();
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, cleanup, waitFor, within } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockPost, mockPatch, mockDelete, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockPost: vi.fn(),
  mockPatch: vi.fn(),
  mockDelete: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: {
    get: (...a) => mockGet(...a),
    post: (...a) => mockPost(...a),
    patch: (...a) => mockPatch(...a),
    delete: (...a) => mockDelete(...a),
  },
}));
vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({ useAuth: (...a) => mockAuth(...a) }));

import { GoodsReceiptForm } from '../../pages/procurement/GoodsReceiptForm';

function makeAuth(role) {
  return {
    access: 'token',
    role,
    user: { id: 1, email: `${role}@x`, role },
    isStaff: ['system_admin', 'it_manager', 'it_support'].includes(role),
    isSystemAdmin: role === 'system_admin',
    isITManager: role === 'it_manager',
    isITSupport: role === 'it_support',
    isManagerOrAdmin: ['system_admin', 'it_manager'].includes(role),
  };
}

  id: 4,
  po_number: 'PO-2026-00004',
  purchase_request: 1,
  vendor: 3,
  vendor_detail: { id: 3, name: 'Acme Supplies' },

  items: [

      rejected_qty: 0, damaged_qty: 0, is_serialized: true, stock_item: null, notes: '',
    },
  ],
  goods_receipts: [],
  history: [],
};

const RECEIPT = {
  id: 7,
  gr_number: 'GR-2026-00007',
  purchase_order: 4,
  delivery_note_number: 'DN-1',
  invoice_number: 'INV-1',
  received_by: 1,
  received_by_name: 'staff@x',
  received_at: '2026-11-05T09:00:00Z',
  notes: '',
