  updated_at: '2026-11-05T09:00:00Z',
  items: [{
    id: 31, goods_receipt: 7, purchase_order_item: 21, quantity_received: 2,
    quantity_rejected: 1, quantity_damaged: 0, notes: 'Rejection reason: dented case',
    created_at: '',
  }],
};

function routeGet() {
  mockGet.mockImplementation((url) => {
    if (String(url) === '/procurement/purchase-orders/4/') return Promise.resolve({ data: ORDER });
    if (String(url) === '/procurement/goods-receipts/7/') return Promise.resolve({ data: RECEIPT });
    if (String(url).startsWith('/procurement/purchase-orders/')) {
      return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [ORDER], count: 1, next: null } });
    }
    return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [], count: 0, next: null } });
  });
}

async function openReceiptForm() {
  routeGet();
  render(<GoodsReceiptForm poId="4" />);
  return screen.findByRole('spinbutton', { name: 'received quantity for Laptop' });
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.resetAllMocks();
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth('it_support'));
  mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: { id: 12, gr_number: 'GR-2026-00012' } });
  mockPatch.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
  mockDelete.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('Goods receipt form', () => {
  it('shows the outstanding balance from the server', async () => {
    await openReceiptForm();
    expect(screen.getByText(/previously accepted 1/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText(/remaining 2/)).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('refuses an over-receipt before calling the API', async () => {
    const input = await openReceiptForm();
    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: '5' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Review and record receipt' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(/Only 2 unit\(s\) remain/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('requires a reason for rejected units', async () => {
    const input = await openReceiptForm();
    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: '2' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: 'rejected quantity for Laptop' }), {
      target: { value: '1' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Review and record receipt' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('A reason is required for rejected units.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('requires damage notes for damaged units', async () => {
    const input = await openReceiptForm();
    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: '2' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: 'damaged quantity for Laptop' }), {
      target: { value: '1' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Review and record receipt' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('Describe the damage for damaged units.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('cannot book rejected plus damaged above the received quantity', async () => {
    const input = await openReceiptForm();
    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: '1' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: 'rejected quantity for Laptop' }), {
      target: { value: '1' },
    });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: 'damaged quantity for Laptop' }), {
      target: { value: '1' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Review and record receipt' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(/cannot exceed the quantity received/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('posts a full receipt and each receipt line', async () => {
    const input = await openReceiptForm();
    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: '2' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Delivery note number' }), {
      target: { value: 'DN-9' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Review and record receipt' }));

    const dialog = screen.getByRole('dialog');
    expect(within(dialog).getByText(/2 accepted, 0 rejected, 0 damaged/)).toBeTruthy();
    fireEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: 'Record receipt' }));

    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/procurement/goods-receipts/', {
      purchase_order: 4,
      delivery_note_number: 'DN-9',
      invoice_number: '',
      notes: '',
    }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      '/procurement/goods-receipt-items/',
      expect.objectContaining({
        goods_receipt: 12,
        purchase_order_item: 21,
        quantity_received: 2,
        quantity_rejected: 0,
        quantity_damaged: 0,
        accepted_quantity: 2,
      }),
    ));
  });

  it('records a partial receipt with a rejected quantity and notes', async () => {
    const input = await openReceiptForm();
    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: '2' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: 'rejected quantity for Laptop' }), {
      target: { value: '1' },
    });
    fireEvent.change(await screen.findByRole('textbox', { name: 'Rejection reason for Laptop' }), {
      target: { value: 'Dented case' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Review and record receipt' }));
    fireEvent.click(within(screen.getByRole('dialog')).getByRole('button', { name: 'Record receipt' }));

    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      '/procurement/goods-receipt-items/',
      expect.objectContaining({
        quantity_received: 2,
        quantity_rejected: 1,
        quantity_damaged: 0,
        notes: 'Rejection reason: Dented case',
      }),
    ));
  });

  it('reloads balances when the server reports a conflict', async () => {
    const input = await openReceiptForm();
    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: '1' } });
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 409, data: {} } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Review and record receipt' }));
    fireEvent.click(within(screen.getByRole('dialog')).getByRole('button', { name: 'Record receipt' }));

    expect(await screen.findByText(/This order changed while you were working/)).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('renders a posted receipt with discrepancy follow-up text', async () => {
    routeGet();
    render(<GoodsReceiptForm id="7" />);
    expect(await screen.findByText('GR-2026-00007')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText(/Discrepancy recorded for follow-up/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getAllByText(/Rejection reason: dented case/).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Record receipt' })).toBeNull();
  });
});


===== src\__tests__\procurement\procurement-returns.test.jsx =====

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, cleanup, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockPost, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockPost: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({ default: { get: (...a) => mockGet(...a), post: (...a) => mockPost(...a) } }));
vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({ useAuth: (...a) => mockAuth(...a) }));

import { ProcurementReturnsPage, ProcurementReturnForm, ProcurementReturnDetail } from '../../pages/procurement/ProcurementReturns';

function authUser(role, id = 1) {
  return {
    access: 'token',
    role,
    user: { id, role },
    isSystemAdmin: role === 'system_admin',
    isITManager: role === 'it_manager',
    isITSupport: role === 'it_support',
    isSuperuser: false,
  };
}

const vendorReturn = {
  id: 1, return_number: 'VR-1', vendor_name: 'Acme', po_number: 'PO-1', goods_receipt: 9, supplier_invoice: 4,
  status: 'draft', reason: 'damaged', return_method: 'physical_return', authorization_reference: 'AUTH-1',
  created_by: 2, lines: [], version: 1,
};

function mockReturnLoad(overrides = {}) {
  const vr = { ...vendorReturn, ...overrides };
  mockGet.mockImplementation((url) => {
    if (url === '/procurement/vendor-returns/1/') return Promise.resolve({ data: vr });
    return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [] } });
  });
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.resetAllMocks();
  window.prompt = vi.fn(() => null);
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue(authUser('it_manager'));
  mockReturnLoad();
  mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
});
afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('P3 vendor returns list', () => {
  it('renders the loading state and rows from the exact endpoint', async () => {
    mockGet.mockImplementation((url) => {
      if (url === '/procurement/vendor-returns/?page_size=50') {
        return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [{ id: 1, return_number: 'VR-1', vendor_name: 'Acme', po_number: 'PO-1', status: 'draft', reason: 'damaged', return_method: 'physical_return' }] } });
      }
      return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [] } });
    });
    render(<ProcurementReturnsPage />);
    expect(screen.getByRole('status').textContent).toMatch(/Loading vendor returns/);
    expect(await screen.findByText('VR-1')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'VR-1' }).getAttribute('href')).toBe('#/procurement/returns/1');
    expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/procurement/vendor-returns/?page_size=50');
  });

  it('shows an empty state', async () => {
    render(<ProcurementReturnsPage />);
    expect(await screen.findByText('No vendor returns.')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('shows a standardized error with Retry', async () => {
    mockGet.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 403, data: {} } });
    render(<ProcurementReturnsPage />);
    expect(await screen.findByRole('alert')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('alert').textContent).toMatch(/You do not have permission/);
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { results: [{ id: 2, return_number: 'VR-2', status: 'approved' }] } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retry' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('VR-2')).toBeTruthy();
  });
});

describe('P3 vendor return create', () => {
  async function fillForm() {
    render(<ProcurementReturnForm />);
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Vendor ID/i), { target: { value: '2' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Purchase Order ID/i), { target: { value: '5' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Return Date/i), { target: { value: '2026-11-12' } });
  }

  it('posts the exact payload and uses the returned id', async () => {
    mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: { id: 3 } });
    await fillForm();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Create Return/i }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/procurement/vendor-returns/', expect.any(Object)));
    expect(mockPost.mock.calls[0][1]).toMatchObject({
      vendor: '2', purchase_order: '5', reason: 'damaged', return_method: 'physical_return',
      goods_receipt: null, supplier_invoice: null, replacement_due_date: null, return_date: '2026-11-12',
    });
    await waitFor(() => expect(window.location.hash).toBe('#/procurement/returns/3'));
  });

  it('does not navigate when the returned id is missing', async () => {
    window.location.hash = '#/procurement/returns/new';
    mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
    await fillForm();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Create Return/i }));
    expect(await screen.findByRole('alert')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('alert').textContent).toMatch(/did not return the new return id/);
    expect(window.location.hash).toBe('#/procurement/returns/new');
  });

  it('renders 400 field errors readably', async () => {
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 400, data: { quantity: ['Return quantity exceeds eligible quantity.'] } } });
    await fillForm();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Create Return/i }));
    expect(await screen.findByRole('alert')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Return quantity exceeds eligible quantity.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('alert').textContent).not.toMatch(/[{}]/);
  });
});

describe('P3 vendor return actions', () => {
  it('shows approval controls to a non-creator manager for a pending return', async () => {
    mockReturnLoad({ status: 'pending_approval' });
    render(<ProcurementReturnDetail id={1} />);
    expect(await screen.findByText(/Return VR-1/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Approve' })).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reject' })).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel' })).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Ship' })).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Complete' })).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.getByText(/does not automatically create a refund; credit notes are tracked separately\./)).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('hides approval from IT Support and issues no privileged request', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(authUser('it_support', 3));
    mockReturnLoad({ status: 'pending_approval' });
    render(<ProcurementReturnDetail id={1} />);
    expect(await screen.findByText(/Return VR-1/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Approve' })).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Reject' })).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Ship' })).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel' })).toBeNull();
    expect(mockPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('never offers self-approval to the creator, except a System Admin', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(authUser('it_manager', 2));
    mockReturnLoad({ status: 'pending_approval' });
    render(<ProcurementReturnDetail id={1} />);
    expect(await screen.findByText(/Return VR-1/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Approve' })).toBeNull();
    cleanup();

    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(authUser('system_admin', 2));
    mockReturnLoad({ status: 'pending_approval' });
    render(<ProcurementReturnDetail id={1} />);
    expect(await screen.findByText(/Return VR-1/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Approve' })).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('posts approval with the authorization reference', async () => {
    window.prompt = vi.fn(() => 'AUTH-NEW');
    mockReturnLoad({ status: 'pending_approval' });
    render(<ProcurementReturnDetail id={1} />);
    await screen.findByText(/Return VR-1/);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Approve' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      '/procurement/vendor-returns/1/approve/',
      { authorization_reference: 'AUTH-NEW' },
    ));
  });

  it('posts ship, complete and cancel to their exact endpoints', async () => {
    mockReturnLoad({ status: 'approved' });
    render(<ProcurementReturnDetail id={1} />);
    await screen.findByText(/Return VR-1/);
    window.prompt = vi.fn(() => 'SHIP-1');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Ship' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/procurement/vendor-returns/1/ship/', { shipping_reference: 'SHIP-1' }));
    cleanup();

    mockReturnLoad({ status: 'shipped' });
    render(<ProcurementReturnDetail id={1} />);
    await screen.findByText(/Return VR-1/);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Complete' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/procurement/vendor-returns/1/complete/', {}));
    cleanup();

    window.prompt = vi.fn(() => 'No longer needed');
    mockReturnLoad({ status: 'pending_approval' });
    render(<ProcurementReturnDetail id={1} />);
    await screen.findByText(/Return VR-1/);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/procurement/vendor-returns/1/cancel/', { reason: 'No longer needed' }));
  });

  it('adds a return line through the exact endpoint while draft', async () => {
    mockReturnLoad({ status: 'draft' });
    render(<ProcurementReturnDetail id={1} />);
    await screen.findByText(/Return VR-1/);
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Goods Receipt Item ID/i), { target: { value: '11' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Purchase Order Item ID/i), { target: { value: '5' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/^Quantity$/i), { target: { value: '2' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add Line' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/procurement/vendor-return-lines/', expect.any(Object)));
    expect(mockPost.mock.calls[0][1]).toMatchObject({ vendor_return: 1, goods_receipt_item: '11', purchase_order_item: '5', quantity: '2' });
  });

  it('reloads exactly once on a 409 conflict without retrying the action', async () => {
    mockReturnLoad({ status: 'draft' });
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 409, data: {} } });
    render(<ProcurementReturnDetail id={1} />);
    await screen.findByText(/Return VR-1/);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(/This return changed while you were working\. The latest version has been loaded\./)).toBeTruthy();
    await waitFor(() => {
      const loads = mockGet.mock.calls.filter(([url]) => url === '/procurement/vendor-returns/1/');
      expect(loads.length).toBe(2);
    });
    expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('surfaces backend blockers on submit as a clear message', async () => {
    mockReturnLoad({ status: 'draft' });
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 400, data: { detail: 'At least one return line is required.' } } });
    render(<ProcurementReturnDetail id={1} />);
    await screen.findByText(/Return VR-1/);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('At least one return line is required.')).toBeTruthy();
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';

const { mockGet, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),

function makeAuth(role) {

    logout: vi.fn(),

/** All supported Procurement routes that must NOT show the fallback. */
const VALID_ROUTES = [
  '#/procurement',
  '#/procurement/requests',
  '#/procurement/requests/new',
  '#/procurement/requests/1',
  '#/procurement/requests/1/edit',
  '#/procurement/requests/1/quotations',
  '#/procurement/orders',
  '#/procurement/orders/1',
  '#/procurement/receipts',
  '#/procurement/receipts/new',
  '#/procurement/receipts/1',
  '#/procurement/assets',
  '#/procurement/vendor-performance',
  '#/procurement/invoices',
  '#/procurement/exceptions',
  '#/procurement/returns',
  '#/procurement/credit-notes',
  '#/procurement/financial-dashboard',
  '#/procurement/reports',
];

describe('Procurement route resolution', () => {
  for (const route of VALID_ROUTES) {
    it(`does not show "does not exist" fallback for ${route}`, () => {
      mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth('system_admin'));
      window.location.hash = route;
      render(<App />);

      expect(screen.queryByText('This procurement page does not exist.')).toBeNull();
    });
  }

  it('shows fallback for unknown procurement route', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth('system_admin'));
    window.location.hash = '#/procurement/bogus';
    render(<App />);

    expect(await screen.findByText('This procurement page does not exist.', {}, { timeout: 10_000 })).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('renders dashboard content for bare #/procurement', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth('system_admin'));
    window.location.hash = '#/procurement';
    render(<App />);

    expect(screen.queryByText('This procurement page does not exist.')).toBeNull();
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText('Pending asset registration')).toBeTruthy();
    }, { timeout: 10_000 });
  });

  it('renders vendor performance content for #/procurement/vendor-performance', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth('system_admin'));
    window.location.hash = '#/procurement/vendor-performance';
    render(<App />);

    expect(screen.queryByText('This procurement page does not exist.')).toBeNull();
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getAllByText('Vendor Performance').length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
    });
  });

  it('navigates from dashboard to requests via sidebar link click', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth('system_admin'));
    window.location.hash = '#/procurement';
    render(<App />);

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText('Pending asset registration')).toBeTruthy();
    });

    const requestsLink = screen.getByText('Purchase requests');
    requestsLink.click();

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText('Purchase requests')).toBeTruthy();
    });
    expect(screen.queryByText('This procurement page does not exist.')).toBeNull();
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, cleanup, waitFor, within } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockPost, mockPatch, mockDelete, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockPost: vi.fn(),
  mockPatch: vi.fn(),
  mockDelete: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({

import { PurchaseRequestDetail } from '../../pages/procurement/PurchaseRequestDetail';

function makeAuth(role, id = 1) {

  return { data: { results, count: results.length, next: null, previous: null } };

  id: 1,

function routeGet(map) {
  mockGet.mockImplementation((url) => {
    const key = Object.keys(map).find((prefix) => String(url).startsWith(prefix));
    if (!key) return Promise.resolve(page([]));
    return Promise.resolve(map[key]);
  });
}

describe('Purchase request wizard', () => {
  it('creates a draft request and its line items', async () => {
    mockPost
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { id: 9, pr_number: 'PR-2026-00009' } })
      .mockResolvedValue({ data: { id: 90 } });
    render(<PurchaseRequestForm />);

    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Business justification' }), {
      target: { value: 'Need replacement laptops for the service desk' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Continue' }));

    fireEvent.change(await screen.findByRole('textbox', { name: 'Item name line 1' }), {
      target: { value: 'Laptop' },
    });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: 'Quantity line 1' }), {
      target: { value: '2' },
    });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: 'Estimated unit price line 1' }), {
      target: { value: '75000' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Continue' }));

    expect(await screen.findByText('Review')).toBeTruthy();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save draft' }));

    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2));
    expect(mockPost.mock.calls[0][0]).toBe('/procurement/purchase-requests/');
    expect(mockPost.mock.calls[0][1]).toMatchObject({
      reason: 'Need replacement laptops for the service desk',
      estimated_total: '150000.00',
    });
    expect(mockPost.mock.calls[1][0]).toBe('/procurement/purchase-request-items/');
    expect(mockPost.mock.calls[1][1]).toMatchObject({
      purchase_request: 9,
      item_name: 'Laptop',
      quantity: 2,
      estimated_unit_price: 75000,
    });
    expect(mockPost.mock.calls.some((c) => String(c[0]).includes('/submit/'))).toBe(false);
  });

  it('creates and submits in one flow when requested', async () => {
    mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: { id: 9 } });
    render(<PurchaseRequestForm />);

    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Business justification' }), {
      target: { value: 'Printer toner' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Continue' }));
    fireEvent.change(await screen.findByRole('textbox', { name: 'Item name line 1' }), {
      target: { value: 'Toner' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Continue' }));
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Save and submit for approval' }));

    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      '/procurement/purchase-requests/9/submit/', {},
    ));
  });

  it('blocks the first step without a business justification', async () => {
    render(<PurchaseRequestForm />);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Continue' }));
    expect(await screen.findByRole('alert')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Business justification is required.')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('blocks the line step without an item name', async () => {
    render(<PurchaseRequestForm />);
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Business justification' }), {
      target: { value: 'Reason' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Continue' }));
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Continue' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('Item name is required.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('supports multiple line items', async () => {
    render(<PurchaseRequestForm />);
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Business justification' }), {
      target: { value: 'Bulk order' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Continue' }));
    await screen.findByRole('textbox', { name: 'Item name line 1' });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add another line' }));
    expect(screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Item name line 2' })).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('shows the informational estimate without posting totals as authoritative', async () => {
    render(<PurchaseRequestForm />);
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Business justification' }), {
      target: { value: 'Estimate check' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Continue' }));
    fireEvent.change(await screen.findByRole('textbox', { name: 'Item name line 1' }), {
      target: { value: 'Thing' },
    });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: 'Quantity line 1' }), { target: { value: '3' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: 'Estimated unit price line 1' }), { target: { value: '10' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Continue' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(/informational/)).toBeTruthy();
  });
});

describe('Purchase request detail and actions', () => {
  const detailRoutes = (request) => ({
    '/procurement/purchase-requests/1/': { data: request },
    '/procurement/purchase-orders/': page([]),
    '/procurement/goods-receipts/': page([]),
  });

  it('submits a draft request through the real endpoint', async () => {
    routeGet(detailRoutes(BASE_REQUEST));
    render(<PurchaseRequestDetail id="1" />);

    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Submit for approval' }));
    const dialog = screen.getByRole('dialog');
    fireEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }));

    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      '/procurement/purchase-requests/1/submit/', { reason: '' },
    ));
  });

  it('shows approval only for a manager who is not the requester', async () => {
    routeGet(detailRoutes({ ...BASE_REQUEST, status: 'pending_approval' }));
    render(<PurchaseRequestDetail id="1" />);
    expect(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Approve' })).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reject' })).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Return for correction' })).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('never exposes self-approval', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth('it_manager', 2));
    routeGet(detailRoutes({ ...BASE_REQUEST, status: 'pending_approval' }));
    render(<PurchaseRequestDetail id="1" />);
    await screen.findByText('PR-2026-00001');
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Approve' })).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Reject' })).toBeNull();
  });

  it('does not expose approval to IT Support', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth('it_support'));
    routeGet(detailRoutes({ ...BASE_REQUEST, status: 'pending_approval' }));
    render(<PurchaseRequestDetail id="1" />);
    await screen.findByText('PR-2026-00001');
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Approve' })).toBeNull();
  });

  it('requires a reason to reject and posts the decision', async () => {
    routeGet(detailRoutes({ ...BASE_REQUEST, status: 'pending_approval' }));
    render(<PurchaseRequestDetail id="1" />);

    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Reject' }));
    const dialog = screen.getByRole('dialog');
    const confirm = within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirm' });
    expect(confirm.disabled).toBe(true);

    fireEvent.change(within(dialog).getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Reason' }), {
      target: { value: 'Budget freeze this quarter' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(confirm);
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      '/procurement/purchase-requests/1/reject/', { reason: 'Budget freeze this quarter' },
    ));
  });

  it('returns a request for correction with a reason', async () => {
    routeGet(detailRoutes({ ...BASE_REQUEST, status: 'pending_approval' }));
    render(<PurchaseRequestDetail id="1" />);

    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Return for correction' }));
    const dialog = screen.getByRole('dialog');
    fireEvent.change(within(dialog).getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Reason' }), {
      target: { value: 'Add the vendor quotation' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirm' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      '/procurement/purchase-requests/1/return_for_correction/',
      { reason: 'Add the vendor quotation' },
    ));
  });

  it('surfaces a 409 and reloads the record instead of retrying', async () => {
    routeGet(detailRoutes({ ...BASE_REQUEST, status: 'draft' }));
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 409, data: {} } });
    render(<PurchaseRequestDetail id="1" />);

    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Submit for approval' }));
    fireEvent.click(within(screen.getByRole('dialog')).getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }));

    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText(/This request changed while you were working/)).toBeTruthy());
    expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
});

===== src\__tests__\procurement\purchase-orders.test.jsx =====

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, cleanup, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockPost, mockPatch, mockDelete, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockPost: vi.fn(),
  mockPatch: vi.fn(),
  mockDelete: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: {
    get: (...a) => mockGet(...a),
    post: (...a) => mockPost(...a),
    patch: (...a) => mockPatch(...a),
    delete: (...a) => mockDelete(...a),
  },
}));
vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({ useAuth: (...a) => mockAuth(...a) }));

import { PurchaseOrdersPage } from '../../pages/procurement/PurchaseOrders';

const PO = {
  id: 4,
  po_number: 'PO-2026-00004',
  purchase_request: 1,
  vendor: 3,
  vendor_detail: { id: 3, name: 'Acme Supplies' },
  created_by: 2,
  status: 'pending_approval',
  subtotal: '100000.00',
  tax: '13000.00',
  discount: '0.00',
  shipping: '0.00',
  total: '113000.00',
  currency: 'NPR',
  delivery_address: 'Head office',
  terms: 'Net 30',
  notes: '',
  requires_system_admin_approval: false,
  approver: null,
  approver_name: null,
  approval_decision: '',
  approval_reason: '',
  approved_at: null,
  sent_at: null,
  completed_at: null,
  created_at: '2026-11-02T10:00:00Z',
  updated_at: '2026-11-02T10:00:00Z',
  items: [],
  goods_receipts: [],
  history: [],
};

function makeAuth(role = 'it_manager') {
  return {
    access: 'token',
    role,
    user: { id: 1, email: `${role}@x`, role, is_active: true },
    isStaff: true,
    isSystemAdmin: role === 'system_admin',
    isITManager: role === 'it_manager',
    isITSupport: role === 'it_support',
    isManagerOrAdmin: ['system_admin', 'it_manager'].includes(role),
  };
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.resetAllMocks();
  localStorage.clear();
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth('it_manager'));
  mockGet.mockImplementation((url) => {
    if (String(url).includes('/procurement/purchase-orders/')) {
      return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [PO], count: 45, next: null, previous: null } });
    }
    return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [], count: 0 } });
  });
  mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
  mockPatch.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('PurchaseOrdersPage reliability', () => {
  it('renders the initial list', async () => {
    render(<PurchaseOrdersPage />);
    expect(await screen.findByText('PO-2026-00004')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Acme Supplies')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('uses the default page size of 20 when nothing is saved', async () => {
    render(<PurchaseOrdersPage />);
    await screen.findByText('PO-2026-00004');
    expect(mockGet.mock.calls.some((c) => String(c[0]).includes('page_size=20'))).toBe(true);
  });

  it('uses a saved page size on initial render', async () => {
    localStorage.setItem('itdesk.pageSize', '25');
    render(<PurchaseOrdersPage />);
    await screen.findByText('PO-2026-00004');
    expect(mockGet.mock.calls.some((c) => String(c[0]).includes('page_size=25'))).toBe(true);
  });

  it('changes page size and reloads with page 1', async () => {
    render(<PurchaseOrdersPage />);
    await screen.findByText('PO-2026-00004');
    const select = screen.getByLabelText('Rows per page');
    fireEvent.change(select, { target: { value: '50' } });
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockGet.mock.calls.some((c) => String(c[0]).includes('page_size=50'))).toBe(true);
    });
    expect(screen.getByText(/Page 1 of/)).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('paginates after a page size change', async () => {
    render(<PurchaseOrdersPage />);
    await screen.findByText('PO-2026-00004');
    const select = screen.getByLabelText('Rows per page');
    fireEvent.change(select, { target: { value: '10' } });
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockGet.mock.calls.some((c) => String(c[0]).includes('page_size=10'))).toBe(true);
    });
    // 45 items / 10 = 5 pages, so next is enabled
    const next = screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Next/ });
    expect(next.disabled).toBe(false);
    fireEvent.click(next);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockGet.mock.calls.some((c) => String(c[0]).includes('page=2') && String(c[0]).includes('page_size=10'))).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  it('unmounts and remounts without crashing', async () => {
    const { unmount } = render(<PurchaseOrdersPage />);
    await screen.findByText('PO-2026-00004');
    unmount();
    render(<PurchaseOrdersPage />);
    expect(await screen.findByText('PO-2026-00004')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('falls back to the default page size when localStorage throws', async () => {
    const throwingStorage = {
      getItem: () => { throw new Error('boom'); },
      setItem: () => {},
      removeItem: () => {},
      clear: () => {},
    };
    const original = window.localStorage;
    Object.defineProperty(window, 'localStorage', { value: throwingStorage, configurable: true });
    render(<PurchaseOrdersPage />);
    await screen.findByText('PO-2026-00004');
    expect(mockGet.mock.calls.some((c) => String(c[0]).includes('page_size=20'))).toBe(true);
    Object.defineProperty(window, 'localStorage', { value: original, configurable: true });
  });
});


===== src\__tests__\profile\profile.test.jsx =====

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockPost, mockPatch, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockPost: vi.fn(),
  mockPatch: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: {
    get: vi.fn(),
    post: (...args) => mockPost(...args),
    patch: (...args) => mockPatch(...args),
    delete: vi.fn(),
  },
}));

vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({
  useAuth: (...args) => mockAuth(...args),
}));

import { Profile } from '../../pages';

function user(over = {}) {
  return {
    employee_id: 'E1', email: 'e@x', role: 'employee',
    email_verified: false, receive_ticket_emails: true, ...over,
  };
}

function ctx(over = {}) {
  return {
    user: user(), refreshProfile: vi.fn(), isStaff: false, isAdmin: false,
    canCreateTickets: true, ...over,
  };
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  window.confirm = vi.fn(() => true);
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('Profile page', () => {
  it('shows unverified status from the server flag', () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(ctx());
    render(<Profile />);
    expect(screen.getByText('Unverified')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('shows verified status when the flag is true', () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(ctx({ user: user({ email_verified: true }) }));
    render(<Profile />);
    expect(screen.getByText('Verified')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByText('Unverified')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('changes password with current + validated new password', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(ctx());
    mockPost.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { detail: 'Password updated.' } });
    render(<Profile />);
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/^Current password/), {
      target: { value: 'old-pass-123' },
    });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/^New password/), {
      target: { value: 'brand-new-pass-99' },
    });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/^Confirm new password/), {
      target: { value: 'brand-new-pass-99' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Change password' }));
    await screen.findByText('Password updated.');
    expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/accounts/change-password/', {
      current_password: 'old-pass-123', new_password: 'brand-new-pass-99',
    });
  });

  it('blocks mismatched confirmation client-side', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(ctx());
    render(<Profile />);
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/^Current password/), {
      target: { value: 'old-pass-123' },
    });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/^New password/), {
      target: { value: 'brand-new-pass-99' },
    });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/^Confirm new password/), {
      target: { value: 'different-pass-99' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Change password' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('New passwords do not match.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('surfaces wrong-current-password errors', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(ctx());
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({
      response: { status: 400, data: { detail: 'Current password is incorrect.' } },
    });
    render(<Profile />);
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/^Current password/), {
      target: { value: 'wrong' },
    });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/^New password/), {
      target: { value: 'brand-new-pass-99' },
    });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/^Confirm new password/), {
      target: { value: 'brand-new-pass-99' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Change password' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('Current password is incorrect.')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('surfaces policy validation errors', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(ctx());
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({
      response: { status: 400, data: { new_password: ['Too short.'] } },
    });
    render(<Profile />);
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/^Current password/), {
      target: { value: 'old-pass-123' },
    });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/^New password/), {
      target: { value: 'short' },
    });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/^Confirm new password/), {
      target: { value: 'short' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Change password' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('Too short.')).toBeTruthy();
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

  default: {
    get: (...args) => mockGet(...args),
    post: vi.fn(),
    patch: vi.fn(),
  },

  useAuth: (...args) => mockAuth(...args),
}));

  TicketBulkCreateModal: () => null,
}));

import { Tickets } from '../../pages';

function staff() {
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({ canCreateTickets: true, isStaff: true });
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
    if (String(url).startsWith('/tickets/')) {
      return { data: { results: [], count: 0, next: null, previous: null } };
    }
    if (String(url).startsWith('/accounts/departments/')) {
      return { data: { results: [] } };
    }
    if (String(url).startsWith('/tickets/categories/')) {
      return { data: { results: [] } };
    }
    throw new Error(`unexpected GET ${url}`);
  });
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('Tickets report date filters', () => {
  it('passes exact date_from/date_to params on apply', async () => {
    staff();
    render(<Tickets />);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Category report' }));
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Report start date'), {
      target: { value: '2024-01-01' },
    });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Report end date'), {
      target: { value: '2024-02-01' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Apply dates' }));
    expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(
      '/tickets/reports/by-category/?date_from=2024-01-01&date_to=2024-02-01',
    );
  });

  it('rejects an end date before the start date without calling the API', async () => {
    staff();
    render(<Tickets />);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Category report' }));
    const calls = mockGet.mock.calls.length;
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Report start date'), {
      target: { value: '2024-02-01' },
    });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Report end date'), {
      target: { value: '2024-01-01' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Apply dates' }));
    expect(
      await screen.findByText('Report end date cannot be earlier than start date.'),
    ).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockGet.mock.calls.length).toBe(calls);
  });

  it('reset clears the dates', async () => {
    staff();
    render(<Tickets />);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Category report' }));
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Report start date'), {
      target: { value: '2024-01-01' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reset' }));
    expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith('/tickets/reports/by-category/');
  });
});

import { Retention } from '../../pages/retention/Retention';

function ctx(over = {}) {
  return { isAdmin: false, ...over };
}

const POLICY = {
  id: 4, name: 'Old notifications', data_category: 'notifications',
  retention_duration: 30, enabled: true, conditions: {}, description: '',
  last_run_at: null, next_run_at: null, responsible_admin: 1,
  responsible_admin_email: 'admin@example.com',
};

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  window.location.hash = '#/retention';
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('Data retention page', () => {
  it('restricts access to non-admins', () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(ctx({ isAdmin: false }));
    render(<Retention />);
    expect(screen.getByText('Access restricted')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('lists retention policies for admins', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(ctx({ isAdmin: true }));
    mockGet.mockResolvedValue({ data: { results: [POLICY], count: 1, next: null, previous: null } });
    render(<Retention />);
    await screen.findByText('Data retention policies');
    expect(screen.getByText('Old notifications')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('notifications')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('30')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('shows preview and marks audit logs as excluded', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(ctx({ isAdmin: true }));
    const preview = {
      policy_id: 4, policy_name: 'Old notifications', data_category: 'security_events',
      retention_duration_days: 1, total_eligible: 0, can_execute: false,
      excluded: [{ model: 'common.AuditLog', reason: 'Audit logs are protected historical records.' }],
      notes: ['Security events (AuditLog) are retained permanently; no automated deletion applies.'],
    };
    mockGet.mockImplementation((url) => {
      if (url.includes('retention-policies/4/preview/')) return Promise.resolve({ data: preview });
      return Promise.resolve({ data: { results: [POLICY], count: 1, next: null, previous: null } });
    });
    render(<Retention />);
    await screen.findByText('Old notifications');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Preview' }));
    await screen.findByText('Preview: Old notifications');
    expect(screen.getByText(/common\.AuditLog/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText(/protected historical records/)).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('executes a retention policy', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(ctx({ isAdmin: true }));
    mockGet.mockResolvedValue({ data: { results: [POLICY], count: 1, next: null, previous: null } });
    mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: { executed: true, records_affected: 2, records_excluded: 1 } });
    render(<Retention />);
    await screen.findByText('Old notifications');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Execute' }));
    await screen.findByText(/Executed: 2 record\(s\)/);
    expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/common/retention-policies/4/execute/', {});
  });

  it('creates a retention policy', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(ctx({ isAdmin: true }));
    mockGet.mockResolvedValue({ data: { results: [], count: 0, next: null, previous: null } });
    mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: { id: 9, name: 'New policy' } });
    render(<Retention />);
    await screen.findByText('Data retention policies');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '+ Add policy' }));
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Name/), { target: { value: 'New policy' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Retention duration/), { target: { value: '60' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save' }));
    expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/common/retention-policies/', {
      name: 'New policy', data_category: 'notifications', retention_duration: 60,
      enabled: true, conditions: {}, description: '', responsible_admin: null,
    });
  });

  it('deletes a retention policy', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(ctx({ isAdmin: true }));
    mockGet.mockResolvedValue({ data: { results: [POLICY], count: 1, next: null, previous: null } });
    mockDelete.mockResolvedValue({});
    window.confirm = vi.fn(() => true);
    render(<Retention />);
    await screen.findByText('Old notifications');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Delete' }));
    await screen.findByText(/Data retention policies/);
    expect(mockDelete).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/common/retention-policies/4/');
  });
});

  data: {

      {

        summary: 'How to reset the VPN client', content: 'Step one',
        category: { id: 1, name: 'Networking', code: 'networking' },
        tags: [{ name: 'VPN', slug: 'vpn' }],
        status: 'published', author: 2, author_name: 'Manager',
        created_at: '2026-01-01T10:00:00Z',

      },
      {
        id: 2, title: 'Database backup', slug: 'db-backup',
        summary: 'Run pg_dump nightly.', content: 'pg_dump -F db',
        category: { id: 1, name: 'Networking', code: 'networking' },
        tags: [], status: 'published', author: 2,
        author_name: 'Manager', created_at: '2026-01-03T10:00:00Z',
        updated_at: '2026-01-03T11:00:00Z', revision_number: 1,
      },
    ],
    count: 2, next: null, previous: null,
  },
};

const EMPTY_RESULTS = {
  data: { results: [], count: 0, next: null, previous: null },
};

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  window.location.hash = '';
  employee();
  mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
    const u = String(url);
    if (u === '/common/knowledge-base/') return KB_RESULTS;
    if (u === '/tickets/') return EMPTY_RESULTS;
    if (u === '/assets/') return EMPTY_RESULTS;
    return EMPTY_RESULTS;
  });
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('Self-service Knowledge Base search', () => {
  it('searches published articles and renders results', async () => {
    render(<SelfService />);
    const input = screen.getByPlaceholderText(/Search articles/);
    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: 'vpn' } });
    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        '/common/knowledge-base/',
        expect.objectContaining({ params: { q: 'vpn' } }),
      ),
    );
    expect(await screen.findByText('VPN reset')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getAllByText('Category: Networking').length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
  });

  it('renders an empty state when nothing matches', async () => {
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      if (url === '/common/knowledge-base/') return EMPTY_RESULTS;
      return EMPTY_RESULTS;
    });
    render(<SelfService />);
    const input = screen.getByPlaceholderText(/Search articles/);
    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: 'zzz-no-match' } });
    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(screen.getByText(/No articles found/)).toBeTruthy(),
    );
  });

  it('links each article to its detail page', async () => {
    render(<SelfService />);
    const input = screen.getByPlaceholderText(/Search articles/);
    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: 'vpn' } });
    await screen.findByText('VPN reset');
    const articleLinks = Array.from(
      document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#/kb/"]'),
    ).map((a) => a.getAttribute('href'));
    expect(new Set(articleLinks)).toEqual(new Set(['#/kb/1', '#/kb/2']));
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockPost, mockPatch, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockPost: vi.fn(),
  mockPatch: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: {
    get: (...args) => mockGet(...args),
    post: (...args) => mockPost(...args),
    patch: (...args) => mockPatch(...args),
    delete: vi.fn(),
  },
}));

vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({
  useAuth: (...args) => mockAuth(...args),
}));

import { NotificationSettings } from '../../pages/settings/Settings';

function user(over = {}) {
  return { id: 7, employee_id: 'E7', email: 'e@x', role: 'employee', ...over };
}

function ctx(over = {}) {
  return { user: user(), ...over };
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('Notification settings page', () => {
  it('loads preferences and renders toggles', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(ctx());
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce({
      data: {
        results: [{
          id: 3, user: 7, email_enabled: true,
          categories: {
            ticket_assignment: true, ticket_status_change: false, ticket_reply: true,
            sla_escalation: true, maintenance_reminder: true, asset_assignment: true, system_alert: true,
          },
          email_categories: [
            { key: 'ticket_assignment', label: 'Ticket assigned to me', enabled: true },
            { key: 'ticket_status_change', label: 'Ticket status changed', enabled: false },
            { key: 'ticket_reply', label: 'New reply or note on my ticket', enabled: true },
            { key: 'sla_escalation', label: 'SLA escalation / breach', enabled: true },
            { key: 'maintenance_reminder', label: 'Maintenance reminder', enabled: true },
            { key: 'asset_assignment', label: 'Asset assigned or returned', enabled: true },
            { key: 'system_alert', label: 'System alerts', enabled: true },
          ],
        }],
      },
    });
    render(<NotificationSettings />);
    await screen.findByText('Notification settings');
    expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/common/notification-preferences/');
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Enable email notifications').checked).toBe(true);
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/Email notifications for Ticket status changed/).checked).toBe(false);
  });

  it('uses sensible defaults when no preference record exists', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(ctx());
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: [] });
    render(<NotificationSettings />);
    await screen.findByText('Notification settings');
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Enable email notifications').checked).toBe(true);
    // All category toggles checked by default.
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/Email notifications for Ticket assigned to me/).checked).toBe(true);
  });

  it('saves via PATCH when a preference record exists', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(ctx());
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce({
      data: { results: [{ id: 3, user: 7, email_enabled: true, categories: {} }] },
    });
    mockPatch.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { id: 3 } });
    render(<NotificationSettings />);
    await screen.findByText('Notification settings');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save changes' }));
    await screen.findByText('Notification preferences saved.');
    expect(mockPatch).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/common/notification-preferences/3/', {
      email_enabled: true, categories: expect.any(Object),
    });
  });

  it('saves via POST when no preference record exists', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(ctx());
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: [] });
    mockPost.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { id: 9 } });
    render(<NotificationSettings />);
    await screen.findByText('Notification settings');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save changes' }));
    await screen.findByText('Notification preferences saved.');
    expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/common/notification-preferences/', {
      email_enabled: true, categories: expect.any(Object),
    });
  });

  it('keeps unsaved edits and shows error when save fails', async () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(ctx());
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce({
      data: { results: [{ id: 3, user: 7, email_enabled: true, categories: {} }] },
    });
    mockPatch.mockRejectedValueOnce({
      response: { status: 400, data: { detail: 'Invalid category key.' } },
    });
    render(<NotificationSettings />);
    await screen.findByText('Notification settings');
    // Flip the master switch off.
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByLabelText('Enable email notifications'));
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Enable email notifications').checked).toBe(false);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save changes' }));
    await screen.findByText('Invalid category key.');
    // The unsaved edit (off) is still in place.
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Enable email notifications').checked).toBe(false);
  });

  it('shows loading state while fetching', () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue(ctx());
    mockGet.mockReturnValue(new Promise(() => { /* never resolves */ }));
    render(<NotificationSettings />);
    expect(screen.getByText(/Loading notification preferences/)).toBeTruthy();
  });
});


===== src\__tests__\shared\api-utils.test.js =====

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({ default: {} }));

import { parseApiError, blobErrorMessage, fieldMsg } from '../../api-utils';

const HTML_PAGE = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en"><head><title>OperationalError at /api/assets/attachments/</title></head>
<body><h1>Traceback (most recent call last)</h1><p>no such table: assets_assetattachment</p></body></html>`;

let warn;
beforeEach(() => {
  warn = vi.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => {});
});
afterEach(() => warn.mockRestore());

describe('parseApiError with non-JSON (HTML) responses', () => {
  it('turns a Django error page into a friendly message', () => {
    const p = parseApiError({ response: { status: 500, data: HTML_PAGE } });
    expect(p.global).toMatch(/Server error \(HTTP 500\)/);
    expect(p.global).not.toMatch(/<html|Traceback|no such table/i);
    // The raw body still reaches the console for debugging.
    expect(warn).toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(String(warn.mock.calls[0][1])).toContain('no such table');
  });

  it('keeps ordinary DRF strings untouched', () => {
    const p = parseApiError({ response: { status: 404, data: 'Not found.' } });
    expect(p.global).toBe('Not found.');
    expect(warn).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('maps field errors and details exactly as before', () => {
    const p = parseApiError({
      response: { status: 400, data: { serial_number: ['Already used.'], detail: 'Bad.' } },
    });
    expect(p.fields.serial_number).toBe('Already used.');
    expect(p.global).toBe('Bad.');
    expect(warn).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('replaces an HTML value nested inside a JSON body', () => {
    const p = parseApiError({ response: { status: 500, data: { detail: HTML_PAGE } } });
    expect(p.global).toMatch(/Server error \(HTTP 500\)/);
    expect(p.global).not.toMatch(/Traceback/);
  });

  it('falls back to a generic message when the request never reached the server', () => {
    const p = parseApiError(new Error('Network Error'));
    expect(p.global).toMatch(/Network Error/);
  });
});

describe('blobErrorMessage with non-JSON (HTML) responses', () => {
  it('returns a friendly message for an HTML blob', async () => {
    const e = {
      response: { status: 502, data: new Blob([HTML_PAGE], { type: 'text/html' }) },
    };
    const msg = await blobErrorMessage(e, 'Upload failed.');
    expect(msg).toMatch(/Server error \(HTTP 502\)/);
    expect(msg).not.toMatch(/Traceback/);
    expect(warn).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('still surfaces JSON blobs as field messages', async () => {
    const e = {
      response: { status: 400, data: new Blob([JSON.stringify({ file: ['Too large.'] })]) },
    };
    const msg = await blobErrorMessage(e, 'Upload failed.');
    expect(msg).toBe('Too large.');
  });

  it('returns the generic message when the error carries nothing readable', async () => {
    // No response, no message: parseApiError still produces its generic text.
    const msg = await blobErrorMessage({}, 'Upload failed.');
    expect(msg).toBe('Request failed.');
  });
});

describe('fieldMsg', () => {
  it('reads a field message and tolerates missing keys', () => {
    expect(fieldMsg({ file: 'Nope.' }, 'file')).toBe('Nope.');
    expect(fieldMsg({ file: 'Nope.' }, 'other')).toBe('');
    expect(fieldMsg(undefined, 'file')).toBe('');
  });
});


===== src\__tests__\shared\api.test.js =====

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';

const { mockPost, handlers, instance } = vi.hoisted(() => {
  const mockPost = vi.fn();
  const handlers = {};
  const instance = vi.fn(async (cfg) => ({ data: 'retried', config: cfg }));
  instance.interceptors = {
    request: {
      use: vi.fn((fn) => {
        handlers.request = fn;
      }),
    },
    response: {
      use: (ok, err) => {
        handlers.ok = ok;
        handlers.err = err;
      },
    },
  };
  instance.defaults = { baseURL: 'http://x/api' };
  return { mockPost, handlers, instance };
});

vi.mock('axios', () => ({
  default: {
    create: () => instance,
    post: (...args) => mockPost(...args),
  },
}));

import '../../api';
import { resetApiState } from '../../api';

const err401 = (url = '/tickets/') => ({
  config: { url, headers: {} },
  response: { status: 401 },
});

beforeEach(() => {
  localStorage.clear();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  resetApiState();
  localStorage.setItem('access', 'old-access');
  localStorage.setItem('refresh', 'good-refresh');
});

describe('auth interceptor', () => {
  it('attaches the stored access token to requests', () => {
    const out = handlers.request({ headers: {} });
    expect(out.headers.Authorization).toBe('Bearer old-access');
  });

  it('refreshes once and retries the original request', async () => {
    mockPost.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { access: 'new-access' } });
    const res = await handlers.err(err401());
    expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'http://x/api/token/refresh/',
      { refresh: 'good-refresh' },
    );
    expect(localStorage.getItem('access')).toBe('new-access');
    expect(instance).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(instance.mock.calls[0][0].headers.Authorization).toBe(
      'Bearer new-access',
    );
    expect(instance.mock.calls[0][0]._retry).toBe(true);
    expect(res).toEqual({ data: 'retried', config: expect.anything() });
  });

  it('never retries more than once', async () => {
    const err = err401();
    err.config._retry = true;
    await expect(handlers.err(err)).rejects.toBe(err);
    expect(mockPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(localStorage.getItem('access')).toBe('old-access');
  });

  it('shares one refresh across concurrent 401s', async () => {
    let resolvePost;
    mockPost.mockImplementationOnce(
      () => new Promise((resolve) => { resolvePost = resolve; }),
    );
    const p1 = handlers.err(err401('/tickets/'));
    const p2 = handlers.err(err401('/assets/'));
    await Promise.resolve();
    await Promise.resolve();
    expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    resolvePost({ data: { access: 'shared-access' } });
    await expect(p1).resolves.toBeTruthy();
    await expect(p2).resolves.toBeTruthy();
    expect(instance).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    expect(localStorage.getItem('access')).toBe('shared-access');
  });

  it('clears auth and notifies on failed refresh', async () => {
    const seen = [];
    const onExpired = () => seen.push(true);
    window.addEventListener('auth-expired', onExpired);
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('refresh gone'));
    const err = err401();
    await expect(handlers.err(err)).rejects.toBe(err);
    expect(localStorage.getItem('access')).toBeNull();
    expect(localStorage.getItem('refresh')).toBeNull();
    expect(seen).toEqual([true]);
    window.removeEventListener('auth-expired', onExpired);
  });

  it('clears auth when no refresh token exists', async () => {
    localStorage.removeItem('refresh');
    const err = err401();
    await expect(handlers.err(err)).rejects.toBe(err);
    expect(mockPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(localStorage.getItem('access')).toBeNull();
  });

  it.each([400, 403, 404, 500])('does not refresh on %i', async (code) => {
    const err = { config: { url: '/tickets/', headers: {} }, response: { status: code } };
    await expect(handlers.err(err)).rejects.toBe(err);
    expect(mockPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it.each([
    '/token/',
    '/token/refresh/',
    '/accounts/password-reset/confirm/',
    '/accounts/verify-email/confirm/?uid=x&token=y',
  ])('does not loop on auth endpoint %s', async (url) => {
    const err = err401(url);
    await expect(handlers.err(err)).rejects.toBe(err);
    expect(mockPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(localStorage.getItem('access')).toBe('old-access');
  });
});

describe('logout / refresh races', () => {
  const flush = async () => {
    await Promise.resolve();
    await Promise.resolve();
  };

  it('does not restore tokens or retry when logout happens mid-refresh', async () => {
    let resolveRefresh;
    mockPost.mockImplementationOnce(
      () => new Promise((resolve) => { resolveRefresh = resolve; }),
    );
    const err = err401();
    const pending = handlers.err(err);
    await flush();

    // Logout (same tab or mirrored from another tab) clears both tokens.
    localStorage.removeItem('access');
    localStorage.removeItem('refresh');

    resolveRefresh({ data: { access: 'late-access' } });
    await expect(pending).rejects.toBe(err);
    expect(localStorage.getItem('access')).toBeNull();
    expect(instance).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('starts a fresh refresh for a new session instead of reusing the old one', async () => {
    let resolveOldRefresh;
    mockPost.mockImplementationOnce(
      () => new Promise((resolve) => { resolveOldRefresh = resolve; }),
    );
    const err1 = err401('/tickets/');
    const first = handlers.err(err1);
    await flush();
    expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);

    // Logout + login as another user while the first refresh is in flight.
    localStorage.setItem('access', 'new-access');
    localStorage.setItem('refresh', 'new-refresh');

    mockPost.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { access: 'new-refreshed' } });
    const second = handlers.err(err401('/assets/'));
    expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    expect(mockPost.mock.calls[1]).toEqual([
      'http://x/api/token/refresh/',
      { refresh: 'new-refresh' },
    ]);

    resolveOldRefresh({ data: { access: 'old-minted' } });
    await expect(first).rejects.toBe(err1);
    await expect(second).resolves.toBeTruthy();

    // Only the new session's token is replayed; the stale one is discarded.
    expect(instance).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(instance.mock.calls[0][0].headers.Authorization).toBe('Bearer new-refreshed');
    expect(localStorage.getItem('access')).toBe('new-refreshed');
  });

  it('does not clear a newer session when an older refresh fails', async () => {
    let rejectOldRefresh;
    mockPost.mockImplementationOnce(
      () => new Promise((_resolve, reject) => { rejectOldRefresh = reject; }),
    );
    const seen = [];
    const onExpired = () => seen.push(true);
    window.addEventListener('auth-expired', onExpired);

    const err = err401();
    const pending = handlers.err(err);
    await flush();

    localStorage.setItem('access', 'new-access');
    localStorage.setItem('refresh', 'new-refresh');
    rejectOldRefresh(new Error('old refresh rejected'));

    await expect(pending).rejects.toBe(err);
    expect(localStorage.getItem('access')).toBe('new-access');
    expect(localStorage.getItem('refresh')).toBe('new-refresh');
    expect(seen).toEqual([]);
    window.removeEventListener('auth-expired', onExpired);
  });
});

===== src\__tests__\shared\photo-thumbnail.test.jsx =====

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: {
    get: mockGet,
  },
}));

function makeBlob(b = 'x', type = 'application/pdf') {
  return new Blob([b], { type });
}

function awaited(p) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const t = setTimeout(() => { clearTimeout(t); resolve(p); }, 0);
  });
}

describe('PhotoThumbnail', () => {
  let anchors = [];
  let createObjectUrl;

  beforeEach(() => {
    cleanup();
    vi.clearAllMocks();

    global.URL.createObjectURL = vi.fn(() => {
      createObjectUrl();
      return `blob:mock-${createObjectUrl.mock.calls.length}`;
    });
    global.URL.revokeObjectURL = vi.fn();

    const originalCreate = document.createElement.bind(document);
    vi.spyOn(document, 'createElement').mockImplementation(function (tag, ...rest) {
      const el = originalCreate.call(this, tag, ...rest);
      if (String(tag).toLowerCase() === 'a') anchors.push(el);
      return el;
    });

    vi.spyOn(HTMLAnchorElement.prototype, 'click').mockImplementation(() => {});

    anchors = [];
    createObjectUrl = vi.fn();
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
    cleanup();
  });

  it('renders a native button with a meaningful accessible name', async () => {
    mockGet.mockResolvedValue({ data: makeBlob() });
    vi.resetModules();
    const { PhotoThumbnail } = await import('../../components');
    render(<PhotoThumbnail id={7} getUrl={() => '/x'} onPreview={() => {}} label="Photo of LT-1" />);

    expect(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Photo of LT-1' })).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('renders a loading state while the blob is in flight', async () => {
    mockGet.mockImplementation(() => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(() => resolve({ data: makeBlob() }), 50)));
    vi.resetModules();
    const { PhotoThumbnail } = await import('../../components');
    render(<PhotoThumbnail id={7} getUrl={() => '/x'} onPreview={() => {}} label="Photo of LT-1" />);

    // The control is a button with a meaningful accessible name during loading.
    const button = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Photo of LT-1' });
    expect(button).toBeTruthy();

    // Loading is shown as an aria-hidden spinner, so we assert that the
    // button contains a spinner descendant rather than coupling to a test id.
    const spinner = button.querySelector('span.spinner[aria-hidden="true"]');
    expect(spinner).toBeTruthy();
    expect(button.querySelector('img')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('loads the image and renders it with a neutral alt text for the thumbnail', async () => {
    mockGet.mockResolvedValue({ data: makeBlob() });
    vi.resetModules();
    const { PhotoThumbnail } = await import('../../components');
    render(<PhotoThumbnail id={7} getUrl={() => '/x'} onPreview={() => {}} label="Photo of LT-1" />);

    const button = await waitFor(() => screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Photo of LT-1' }));
    expect(button.querySelector('img')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(button.querySelector('img').hasAttribute('alt')).toBe(true);
    expect(button.querySelector('img').className).toContain('photo-thumb');
  });

  it('shows a placeholder on failed image load and keeps the button reachable', async () => {
    mockGet.mockRejectedValue(new Error('network'));
    vi.resetModules();
    const { PhotoThumbnail } = await import('../../components');
    render(<PhotoThumbnail id={7} getUrl={() => '/x'} onPreview={() => {}} label="Photo of LT-1" />);

    const button = await waitFor(() => screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Photo of LT-1' }));
    expect(button).toBeTruthy();
    expect(button.textContent).toContain('ðŸ™');
  });

  it('activates on Enter and Space, and prevents default scroll behavior on Space', async () => {
    mockGet.mockResolvedValue({ data: makeBlob() });
    vi.resetModules();
    const { PhotoThumbnail } = await import('../../components');
    const onPreview = vi.fn();
    render(<PhotoThumbnail id={7} getUrl={() => '/x'} onPreview={onPreview} label="Photo of LT-1" />);

    const button = await waitFor(() => screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Photo of LT-1' }));
    expect(button.querySelector('img')).toBeTruthy();

    await fireEvent.keyDown(button, { key: 'Enter' });
    expect(onPreview).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);

    await fireEvent.keyDown(button, { key: ' ' });
    expect(onPreview).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);

    expect(button.getAttribute('onclick')).toBeNull();
    expect(button.hasAttribute('disabled')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('renders a disabled button when the image cannot be loaded', async () => {
    mockGet.mockRejectedValue(new Error('network'));
    vi.resetModules();
    const { PhotoThumbnail } = await import('../../components');
    render(<PhotoThumbnail id={7} getUrl={() => '/x'} onPreview={() => {}} label="Photo of LT-1" />);

    const button = await waitFor(() => screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Photo of LT-1' }));
    expect(button.hasAttribute('disabled')).toBe(true);
    expect(button.textContent).toContain('ðŸ™');
  });

  it('replaces the previous preview URL and revokes it when refreshed', async () => {
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: makeBlob('a') });
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: makeBlob('b') });
    vi.resetModules();
    const { PhotoThumbnail } = await import('../../components');
    render(<PhotoThumbnail id={7} getUrl={() => '/x'} onPreview={() => {}} label="Photo of LT-1" />);

    await waitFor(() => screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Photo of LT-1' }));
    expect(global.URL.createObjectURL).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);

    // Re-render with a fresh module instance to re-run the effect.
    cleanup();
    anchors = [];
    vi.resetModules();
    const { PhotoThumbnail: PhotoThumbnail2 } = await import('../../components');
    render(<PhotoThumbnail2 id={7} getUrl={() => '/y'} onPreview={() => {}} label="Photo of LT-1" />);

    await waitFor(() => screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Photo of LT-1' }));
    expect(global.URL.createObjectURL).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    expect(global.URL.revokeObjectURL).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(global.URL.revokeObjectURL).toHaveBeenCalledWith('blob:mock-1');

    // The newly displayed thumbnail is not revoked.
    const refreshedButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Photo of LT-1' });
    expect(refreshedButton.querySelector('img').src).toBe('blob:mock-2');
  });

  it('revokes the current preview URL on unmount', async () => {
    mockGet.mockResolvedValue({ data: makeBlob() });
    vi.resetModules();
    const { PhotoThumbnail } = await import('../../components');
    const { unmount } = render(<PhotoThumbnail id={7} getUrl={() => '/x'} onPreview={() => {}} label="Photo of LT-1" />);

    await waitFor(() => screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Photo of LT-1' }));
    const displayedSrc = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Photo of LT-1' })
      .querySelector('img')?.getAttribute('src');
    expect(displayedSrc).toBeTruthy();

    unmount();
    expect(global.URL.revokeObjectURL).toHaveBeenCalledWith(displayedSrc);
  });

  it('does not leak object URLs across repeated refreshes', async () => {
    let callIndex = 0;
    mockGet.mockImplementation(() => awaited({ data: makeBlob(String(++callIndex)) }));
    vi.resetModules();
    const { PhotoThumbnail } = await import('../../components');
    const { rerender } = render(<PhotoThumbnail id={7} getUrl={() => '/x'} onPreview={() => {}} label="Photo of LT-1" />);

    await waitFor(() => screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Photo of LT-1' }));
    expect(global.URL.createObjectURL).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);

    // Three more re-renders should create three URLs and revoke three old ones.
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i += 1) {
      rerender(<PhotoThumbnail id={7} getUrl={() => `/x-${i}`} onPreview={() => {}} label="Photo of LT-1" />);
      await waitFor(() => expect(global.URL.createObjectURL).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2 + i));
    }

    const creates = global.URL.createObjectURL.mock.calls.length;
    const revokes = global.URL.revokeObjectURL.mock.calls.length;
    expect(revokes).toBe(creates - 1);
  });
});


===== src\__tests__\shared\role-access.test.jsx =====

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockPost, mockPatch, mockDelete, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockPost: vi.fn(),
  mockPatch: vi.fn(),
  mockDelete: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: {
    get: (...a) => mockGet(...a),
    post: (...a) => mockPost(...a),
    patch: (...a) => mockPatch(...a),
    delete: (...a) => mockDelete(...a),
  },
}));
vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({ useAuth: (...a) => mockAuth(...a) }));

import { AccessDenied } from '../../components';
import { VendorsPage, VendorForm } from '../../pages/vendors/VendorsPage';
import { LifecycleDashboard } from '../../pages/lifecycle/LifecycleDashboard';
import { LifecycleCases } from '../../pages/lifecycle/LifecycleCases';
