const STAFF_ROLES = ['system_admin', 'it_manager', 'it_support'];

function makeAuth(role) {
  const isSystemAdmin = role === 'system_admin';
  const isITManager = role === 'it_manager';
  const isITSupport = role === 'it_support';
  const isEmployee = role === 'employee';
  const isStaff = role ? STAFF_ROLES.includes(role) : false;
  return {
    access: 'token',
    isStaff, isAdmin: isSystemAdmin, isSystemAdmin, isITManager, isITSupport, isEmployee,
    isManagerOrAdmin: isSystemAdmin || isITManager,
    isSupportOrAbove: isSystemAdmin || isITManager || isITSupport,
    canManageUsers: isSystemAdmin,
    canManageVendors: isSystemAdmin || isITManager,
    canViewVendors: isSystemAdmin || isITManager || isITSupport,
    canManageServiceCatalogue: isSystemAdmin || isITManager,
    canApproveServiceRequests: isSystemAdmin || isITManager,
    canConfigureWorkflow: isSystemAdmin || isITManager,
    canApproveDisposals: isSystemAdmin || isITManager,
    canManageInventory: isSystemAdmin || isITManager,
    canAdjustInventory: isSystemAdmin || isITManager,
    canPublishKnowledgeBase: isSystemAdmin || isITManager,
    canManageScheduledReports: isSystemAdmin || isITManager,
    canAccessAudit: isSystemAdmin,
    canAccessRecycleBin: isSystemAdmin,
    canPerformPermanentDeletion: isSystemAdmin,
    canCreateTickets: true,
    role,
    user: role ? { id: 1, employee_id: 'E1', role, email: `${role}@x` } : null,
  };
}

function authFor(role) {
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue(makeAuth(role));
}

const EMPTY_PAGE = { data: { results: [], count: 0, next: null, previous: null } };

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.resetAllMocks();
  mockGet.mockResolvedValue(EMPTY_PAGE);
  mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
  mockPatch.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
  mockDelete.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('capability helpers', () => {
  it('system_admin has governance capabilities', () => {
    const a = makeAuth('system_admin');
    expect(a.canManageVendors).toBe(true);
    expect(a.canConfigureWorkflow).toBe(true);
    expect(a.canAccessAudit).toBe(true);
    expect(a.canAccessRecycleBin).toBe(true);
    expect(a.canPerformPermanentDeletion).toBe(true);
    expect(a.canManageUsers).toBe(true);
  });

  it('it_manager has management but not system-admin governance', () => {
    const m = makeAuth('it_manager');
    expect(m.canManageVendors).toBe(true);
    expect(m.canConfigureWorkflow).toBe(true);
    expect(m.canApproveServiceRequests).toBe(true);
    expect(m.canAccessAudit).toBe(false);
    expect(m.canAccessRecycleBin).toBe(false);
    expect(m.canPerformPermanentDeletion).toBe(false);
    expect(m.canManageUsers).toBe(false);
  });

  it('it_support is read-only for vendors and cannot approve or configure workflow', () => {
    const s = makeAuth('it_support');
    expect(s.canViewVendors).toBe(true);
    expect(s.canManageVendors).toBe(false);
    expect(s.canManageServiceCatalogue).toBe(false);
    expect(s.canApproveServiceRequests).toBe(false);
    expect(s.canConfigureWorkflow).toBe(false);
    expect(s.canApproveDisposals).toBe(false);
    expect(s.isStaff).toBe(true);
  });

  it('employee has no vendor, workflow, inventory or report capabilities', () => {
    const e = makeAuth('employee');
    expect(e.canViewVendors).toBe(false);
    expect(e.canManageVendors).toBe(false);
    expect(e.canConfigureWorkflow).toBe(false);
    expect(e.canManageInventory).toBe(false);
    expect(e.canManageScheduledReports).toBe(false);
    expect(e.isStaff).toBe(false);
  });

  it('unknown role fails closed', () => {
    const u = makeAuth(undefined);
    expect(u.user).toBeNull();
    expect(u.canManageVendors).toBe(false);
    expect(u.canConfigureWorkflow).toBe(false);
    expect(u.canApproveServiceRequests).toBe(false);
    expect(u.isStaff).toBe(false);
  });
});

===== src\__tests__\shared\sorting.test.jsx =====

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: { get: vi.fn(), post: vi.fn(), patch: vi.fn(), delete: vi.fn() },
}));
vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({
  useAuth: () => ({ canCreateTickets: true, isStaff: true }),
}));
vi.mock('../../pages/bulk/Bulk', () => ({
  AssetBulkCreateModal: () => null,
  EmployeeCreateModal: () => null,
  EmployeeImportModal: () => null,
  TicketBulkCreateModal: () => null,
}));

import api from '../../api';
import { Tickets } from '../../pages';

const ROWS = [
  { id: 1, title: 'B ticket', status: 'open', priority: 'low', category_name: 'C', assignee_email: null, created_at: '2024-01-02T00:00:00Z', updated_at: '2024-01-02T00:00:00Z' },
  { id: 2, title: 'A ticket', status: 'closed', priority: 'critical', category_name: 'C', assignee_email: null, created_at: '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z', updated_at: '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z' },
];

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  api.get.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
    if (String(url).startsWith('/tickets/')) {
      return { data: { results: [...ROWS], count: 2, next: null, previous: null } };
    }
    return { data: { results: [] } };
  });
});
afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('Tickets list sorting', () => {
  it('sorts ascending then descending then clears', async () => {
    render(<Tickets />);
    await screen.findByText('B ticket');
    const calls = api.get.mock.calls.length;

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sort by Priority' }));
    expect(api.get).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith('/tickets/?ordering=priority');
    expect(api.get.mock.calls.length).toBe(calls + 1);

    // Header clicks reload the list; wait for rows to come back first.
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Sort by Priority' }));
    expect(api.get).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith('/tickets/?ordering=-priority');

    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Sort by Priority' }));
    expect(api.get).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith('/tickets/');
  });

  it('marks the active sort direction for assistive tech', async () => {
    render(<Tickets />);
    await screen.findByText('B ticket');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sort by Created' }));
    const th = (await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Sort by Created' })).closest('th');
    expect(th.getAttribute('aria-sort')).toBe('ascending');
  });

  it('keeps filters when sorting', async () => {
    render(<Tickets />);
    await screen.findByText('B ticket');
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Filter by status'), {
      target: { value: 'open' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Sort by Created' }));
    expect(api.get).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith('/tickets/?status=open&ordering=created_at');
  });
});


===== src\__tests__\shared\table-prefs.test.jsx =====

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: {
    get: (...args) => mockGet(...args),
    post: vi.fn(),
    patch: vi.fn(),
    delete: vi.fn(),
  },
}));

vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({ useAuth: (...args) => mockAuth(...args) }));

vi.mock('../../pages/bulk/Bulk', () => ({
  AssetBulkCreateModal: () => null,
  EmployeeCreateModal: () => null,
  EmployeeImportModal: () => null,
  TicketBulkCreateModal: () => null,
}));

import { useTableColumns } from '../../components';
import { Tickets, Assets } from '../../pages';

const PREFIX = 'itdesk.tableprefs.';

/** Hook harness: one toggle button per column + table toggle + reset. */
function PrefsHarness({ tableKey, columns, defaultKeys }) {
  const { visibleColumns, toggleColumn, resetColumns, tableVisible, toggleTable } =
    useTableColumns(tableKey, columns, defaultKeys ?? columns.slice(0, 1));
  return (
    <div>
      <output data-testid="visible">{[...visibleColumns].sort().join(',')}</output>
      <button type="button" onClick={toggleTable}>toggle table</button>
      <button type="button" onClick={resetColumns}>reset</button>
      {columns.map((c) => (
        <button key={c} type="button" onClick={() => toggleColumn(c)}>
          toggle {c}
        </button>
      ))}
      <output data-testid="table-visible">{String(tableVisible)}</output>
    </div>
  );
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  Object.keys(localStorage)
    .filter((k) => k.startsWith(PREFIX))
    .forEach((k) => localStorage.removeItem(k));
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('useTableColumns persistence', () => {
  it('saves toggles to per-table storage and survives a re-mount (refresh)', () => {
    const cols = ['a-toggle', 'b-tag', 'c-user'];
    const { unmount } = render(<PrefsHarness tableKey="assets" columns={cols} />);
    expect(screen.getByTestId('visible').textContent).toBe('a-toggle');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'toggle b-tag' }));
    expect(screen.getByTestId('visible').textContent).toBe('a-toggle,b-tag');
    unmount();
    // Fresh mount = same as loading the page after a refresh.
    render(<PrefsHarness tableKey="assets" columns={cols} />);
    expect(screen.getByTestId('visible').textContent).toBe('a-toggle,b-tag');
    expect(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(`${PREFIX}assets`))).toMatchObject({
      v: 1,
      columns: ['a-toggle', 'b-tag'],
      table: true,
    });
  });

  it('keeps tables independent (one storage key per table)', () => {
    const cols = ['a-toggle', 'b-tag'];
    render(<PrefsHarness tableKey="assets" columns={cols} />);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'toggle b-tag' }));
    cleanup();
    render(<PrefsHarness tableKey="tickets" columns={cols} />);
    // The tickets table never saw the assets change.
    expect(screen.getByTestId('visible').textContent).toBe('a-toggle');
    localStorage.removeItem(`${PREFIX}tickets`);
    expect(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(`${PREFIX}assets`)).columns)
      .toEqual(['a-toggle', 'b-tag']);
  });

  it('resets only the one table to its defaults', () => {
    const cols = ['a-toggle', 'b-tag', 'x-extra'];
    const defaults = ['a-toggle', 'b-tag'];
    render(<PrefsHarness tableKey="assets" columns={cols} defaultKeys={defaults} />);
    expect(screen.getByTestId('visible').textContent).toBe('a-toggle,b-tag');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'toggle x-extra' }));
    expect(screen.getByTestId('visible').textContent).toBe('a-toggle,b-tag,x-extra');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'reset' }));
    expect(screen.getByTestId('visible').textContent).toBe('a-toggle,b-tag');
    // The reset only wrote this table's preference.
    expect(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(`${PREFIX}assets`)))
      .toEqual({ v: 1, columns: ['a-toggle', 'b-tag'], known: cols, table: true });
  });

  it('persists the table show/hide state', () => {
    render(<PrefsHarness tableKey="tickets" columns={['a-toggle', 'b-tag']} />);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'toggle table' }));
    expect(screen.getByTestId('table-visible').textContent).toBe('false');
    cleanup();
    render(<PrefsHarness tableKey="tickets" columns={['a-toggle', 'b-tag']} />);
    expect(screen.getByTestId('table-visible').textContent).toBe('false');
  });

  it('recovers safely from malformed saved preferences', () => {
    localStorage.setItem(`${PREFIX}assets`, 'not-json{{');
    const cols = ['a-toggle', 'b-tag'];
    render(<PrefsHarness tableKey="assets" columns={cols} />);
    expect(screen.getByTestId('visible').textContent).toBe('a-toggle');
    expect(screen.getByTestId('table-visible').textContent).toBe('true');
  });

  it('ignores non-object / wrong-schema payloads', () => {
    localStorage.setItem(`${PREFIX}assets`, JSON.stringify([1, 2]));
    const cols = ['a-toggle', 'b-tag'];
    render(<PrefsHarness tableKey="assets" columns={cols} />);
    expect(screen.getByTestId('visible').textContent).toBe('a-toggle');
    expect(screen.getByTestId('table-visible').textContent).toBe('true');
  });

  it('gives newly introduced columns a sensible default visibility', () => {
    // Saved before a future update added `c-new` as a default column: the
    // user's own selection is untouched, and the never-seen column shows
    // because the CURRENT defaults list it as visible.
    localStorage.setItem(`${PREFIX}assets`, JSON.stringify({
      v: 1,
      columns: ['a-toggle'],
      known: ['a-toggle', 'b-tag'],
      table: true,
    }));
    render(<PrefsHarness
      tableKey="assets"
      columns={['a-toggle', 'b-tag', 'c-new']}
      defaultKeys={['a-toggle', 'c-new']}
    />);
    expect(screen.getByTestId('visible').textContent).toBe('a-toggle,c-new');
  });

  it('recovers from an all-false stored set instead of rendering none', () => {
    localStorage.setItem(`${PREFIX}assets`, JSON.stringify({
      v: 1, columns: [], known: ['a-toggle', 'b-tag'], table: true,
    }));
    const cols = ['a-toggle', 'b-tag'];
    // Defaults are the first column: an all-false payload falls back to them.
    render(<PrefsHarness tableKey="assets" columns={cols} />);
    expect(screen.getByTestId('visible').textContent).toBe('a-toggle');
  });

  it('drops stale keys that no longer exist in the current table', () => {
    localStorage.setItem(`${PREFIX}assets`, JSON.stringify({
      v: 1,
      columns: ['a-toggle', 'gone-column'],
      known: ['a-toggle', 'b-tag', 'gone-column'],
      table: false,
    }));
    const cols = ['a-toggle', 'b-tag'];
    render(<PrefsHarness tableKey="assets" columns={cols} />);
    expect(screen.getByTestId('visible').textContent).toBe('a-toggle');
    expect(screen.getByTestId('table-visible').textContent).toBe('false');
  });
});

describe('Tables use persisted prefs (page level)', () => {
  function staff() {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue({
      isStaff: true, isAdmin: true, canCreateTickets: true,
      user: { id: 1, role: 'system_admin' },
    });
  }

  beforeEach(() => {
    staff();
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      const u = String(url);
      if (u.startsWith('/assets/')) {
        return {
          data: {
            results: [{
              id: 1, asset_tag: 'LT-1', name: 'ThinkPad', status: 'available',
              category_name: 'Laptop', department_name: null,
              assigned_to_email: null, serial_number: '', location: 'HQ',
              description: '', purchase_date: null, warranty_expiry: null,
              purchase_cost: null, photo_attachment_id: null, created_at: null,
            }],
            count: 1, next: null, previous: null,
          },
        };
      }
      if (u.startsWith('/tickets/')) {
        return {
          data: {
            results: [{
              id: 2, title: 'T', status: 'open', priority: 'low',
              category_name: 'C', assignee_email: null, requester_email: null,
              department_name: null, asset_tag: null, asset: null,
              description: '', on_behalf_reason: '', resolution_notes: '',
              created_at: null, updated_at: null, resolved_at: null,
              closed_at: null,
            }],
            count: 1, next: null, previous: null,
          },
        };
      }
      return { data: { results: [], count: 0, next: null, previous: null } };
    });
  });

  it('restores hidden columns after a remount and keeps tables separate', async () => {
    const { unmount } = render(<Assets />);
    await screen.findByText('LT-1');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Columns' }));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByLabelText('Show Name column'));
    expect(
      JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(`${PREFIX}assets`)).columns,
    ).not.toContain('name');
    expect(screen.queryByRole('columnheader', { name: 'Name' })).toBeNull();
    unmount();

    render(<Tickets />);
    await screen.findByText('T');
    expect(screen.getByRole('columnheader', { name: 'Subject' })).toBeTruthy();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Columns' }));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByLabelText('Show Subject column'));
    expect(
      JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(`${PREFIX}tickets`)).columns,
    ).not.toContain('title');
    cleanup();

    // Closing the browser / returning to the page: prefs load again.
    render(<Assets />);
    await screen.findByText('LT-1');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Columns' }));
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Show Name column').checked).toBe(false);
    expect(
      JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(`${PREFIX}tickets`)).columns,
    ).not.toContain('title');
  });

  it('resets only the assets table to its defaults', async () => {
    const ticketsSaved = JSON.stringify({
      v: 1, columns: ['subject-only'], known: ['title'], table: true,
    });
    localStorage.setItem(`${PREFIX}tickets`, ticketsSaved);
    render(<Assets />);
    await screen.findByText('LT-1');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Columns' }));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByLabelText('Show Name column'));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reset columns' }));
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Show Tag column').checked).toBe(true);
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Show Name column').checked).toBe(true);
    // Reset did not disturb the tickets preference.
    expect(localStorage.getItem(`${PREFIX}tickets`)).toBe(ticketsSaved);
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockPost, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockPost: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: {
    get: (...a) => mockGet(...a),
    post: (...a) => mockPost(...a),
  },
}));
vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({ useAuth: () => mockAuth() }));

import { TicketBulkImportDetailPage, TicketBulkImportsPage } from '../../pages/tickets/TicketBulkImportsPage';

const baseOp = {
  id: 7,
  user: 2,
  user_email: 'mgr@example.com',
  status: 'failed',
  total_rows: 2,
  processed_count: 2,
  successful_count: 1,
  failed_count: 1,
  result_format: '',
  result_status_code: 200,
  result_available: false,
  error_detail: 'interrupted',
  is_expired: false,
  is_stale_processing: false,
  created_at: '2026-11-21T10:00:00Z',
  updated_at: '2026-11-21T10:05:00Z',
  started_at: '2026-11-21T10:01:00Z',
  completed_at: null,
  expires_at: '2026-11-22T10:00:00Z',
};

const eligibleAssessment = {
  operation_id: 7,
  current_status: 'failed',
  expected_row_count: 2,
  actual_outcome_count: 2,
  succeeded_outcome_count: 1,
  failed_outcome_count: 1,
  unprocessed_row_count: 0,
  duplicate_or_inconsistent_evidence: [],
  missing_ticket_references: [],
  counter_inconsistencies: [],
  legacy_or_ambiguous_indicators: [],
  reasons: [],
  eligible_for_finalization: true,
  proposed_status: 'completed',
  proposed_result_status_code: 200,
  evidence_digest: 'digest-abc123',
  result_stored: false,
  result_conflicts: [],
  has_row_level_evidence: true,
  is_stale_processing: false,
};

function ineligibleAssessment(overrides = {}) {
  return {
    ...eligibleAssessment,
    eligible_for_finalization: false,
    proposed_status: null,
    reasons: ['unprocessed_or_unrecorded_rows'],
    unprocessed_row_count: 1,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function setupDetail({ op = baseOp, assessment = eligibleAssessment, audit = [] } = {}) {
  mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
    if (url === `/tickets/bulk-imports/${op.id}/`) return { data: op };
    if (url === `/tickets/bulk-imports/${op.id}/reconciliation/`) return { data: assessment };
    if (url === `/tickets/bulk-imports/${op.id}/reconciliation/audit/`) return { data: { operation_id: op.id, audit } };
    throw new Error(`unexpected GET ${url}`);
  });
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({ isStaff: true, user: { role: 'it_manager' } });
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('TicketBulkImportsPage', () => {
  it('renders staff-only list and loads operations', async () => {
    mockGet.mockResolvedValueOnce({
      data: { count: 1, next: null, previous: null, results: [baseOp] },
    });
    render(<TicketBulkImportsPage />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText('#7')).toBeTruthy());
    expect(screen.getByText('mgr@example.com')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'Inspect' }).getAttribute('href')).toBe('#/tickets/bulk-imports/7');
  });

  it('shows loading and empty states', async () => {
    let resolve;
    mockGet.mockImplementationOnce(() => new Promise((r) => { resolve = r; }));
    render(<TicketBulkImportsPage />);
    expect(screen.getByRole('status')).toBeTruthy();
    resolve({ data: { count: 0, next: null, previous: null, results: [] } });
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText('No bulk import operations')).toBeTruthy());
  });

  it('shows API failure', async () => {
    mockGet.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { data: { detail: 'boom' } } });
    render(<TicketBulkImportsPage />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('alert').textContent).toContain('boom'));
  });

  it('blocks non-staff users', () => {
    mockAuth.mockReturnValue({ isStaff: false, user: { role: 'employee' } });

  });

    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Finalize operation' })).toBeNull();
  });

  it('shows assessment failure', async () => {
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {

describe('TicketBulkImportDetailPage finalization', () => {
  async function openFinalize() {
    setupDetail();
    render(<TicketBulkImportDetailPage id={7} />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Finalize operation' })).toBeTruthy());
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Finalize operation' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('dialog', { name: /Finalize import operation #7/ })).toBeTruthy());
  }

  it('requires a reason and rejects whitespace-only reason', async () => {
    await openFinalize();
    const reason = screen.getByLabelText('Reason for finalization');
    fireEvent.change(reason, { target: { value: '   ' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirm finalization' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText('A reason is required for finalization.')).toBeTruthy());
    expect(mockPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('submits exact digest and expected status binding', async () => {
    await openFinalize();
    mockPost.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { finalized: true, idempotent: false, status: 'completed' } });
    // refresh after finalize
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      if (url.endsWith('/7/')) return { data: { ...baseOp, status: 'completed' } };
      if (url.endsWith('/reconciliation/')) return { data: ineligibleAssessment({ reasons: ['already_finalized'], current_status: 'completed', result_stored: true }) };
      if (url.endsWith('/reconciliation/audit/')) return { data: { operation_id: 7, audit: [{ id: 1, timestamp: '2026-11-21T10:10:00Z', actor_email: 'admin@example.com', action: 'update', finalization_outcome: 'finalized', previous_operation_state: 'failed', resulting_operation_state: 'completed', expected_row_count: 2, succeeded_row_count: 1, failed_row_count: 1, reason: 'ok', evidence_digest: 'digest-abc123' }] } };
      throw new Error(url);
    });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Reason for finalization'), { target: { value: 'Reviewed evidence' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirm finalization' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    expect(mockPost.mock.calls[0][0]).toBe('/tickets/bulk-imports/7/reconciliation/finalize/');
    expect(mockPost.mock.calls[0][1]).toEqual({
      reason: 'Reviewed evidence',
      evidence_digest: 'digest-abc123',
      expected_status: 'failed',
    });
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText(/Finalization completed/)).toBeTruthy());
  });

  it('handles idempotent success', async () => {
    await openFinalize();
    mockPost.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { finalized: true, idempotent: true, status: 'completed' } });
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      if (url.endsWith('/7/')) return { data: { ...baseOp, status: 'completed' } };
      if (url.endsWith('/reconciliation/')) return { data: ineligibleAssessment({ reasons: ['already_finalized'], current_status: 'completed', result_stored: true }) };
      if (url.endsWith('/reconciliation/audit/')) return { data: { operation_id: 7, audit: [] } };
      throw new Error(url);
    });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Reason for finalization'), { target: { value: 'retry' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirm finalization' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText(/Operation was already finalized\. Showing the current recorded state\./i)).toBeTruthy());
  });

  it('prevents duplicate in-flight submissions', async () => {
    await openFinalize();
    let resolve;
    mockPost.mockImplementation(() => new Promise((r) => { resolve = r; }));
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Reason for finalization'), { target: { value: 'once' } });
    const btn = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirm finalization' });
    fireEvent.click(btn);
    fireEvent.click(btn);
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    resolve({ data: { finalized: true, idempotent: false } });
  });

  it('does not auto-retry stale evidence and refreshes assessment', async () => {
    await openFinalize();
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 409, data: { code: 'stale_evidence', detail: 'stale' } } });
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      if (url.endsWith('/7/')) return { data: baseOp };
      if (url.endsWith('/reconciliation/')) return { data: ineligibleAssessment({ reasons: ['missing_ticket_reference'], missing_ticket_references: [{ row_index: 0, outcome_id: 1, ticket_id: null, issue: 'missing' }] }) };
      if (url.endsWith('/reconciliation/audit/')) return { data: { operation_id: 7, audit: [] } };
      throw new Error(url);
    });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Reason for finalization'), { target: { value: 'stale test' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirm finalization' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText(/not applied because evidence changed/i)).toBeTruthy());
    // Only the initial finalize POST; no auto-retry.
    expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText(/Missing ticket references \(finalization blocked\)/)).toBeTruthy());
  });

  it('handles 403/404/500 errors', async () => {
    for (const [status, detail] of [[403, 'Forbidden'], [404, 'Not found'], [500, 'Server error']]) {
      cleanup();
      vi.clearAllMocks();
      mockAuth.mockReturnValue({ isStaff: true, user: { role: 'it_manager' } });
      await openFinalize();
      mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status, data: { detail } } });
      fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Reason for finalization'), { target: { value: 'reason' } });
      fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirm finalization' }));
      await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('alert').textContent).toMatch(new RegExp(detail, 'i')));
    }
  });
});

describe('TicketBulkImportDetailPage audit history', () => {

===== src\__tests__\tickets\tickets-attachments.test.jsx =====

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';
const { mockGet, mockPost, mockDelete, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockPost: vi.fn(),
  mockDelete: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: {
    get: (...args) => mockGet(...args),
    post: (...args) => mockPost(...args),
    delete: (...args) => mockDelete(...args),
  },
}));

vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({
  useAuth: (...args) => mockAuth(...args),
}));

import { TicketDetail } from '../../pages/tickets/Tickets';

const TICKET = {
  id: 7, title: 'Printer down', status: 'open', priority: 'high',
  category_name: 'Hardware', department_name: 'IT', requester_email: 'e@x',
  assignee_email: null, assignee: null, asset: null,
  created_at: '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z', description: 'No power.',
  on_behalf_reason: '', resolution_notes: '',
};
const ATTS = [
  { id: 11, original_filename: 'spec.pdf', created_at: '2024-01-02T00:00:00Z' },
];

function staff() {
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({ isStaff: true, user: { role: 'it_support' } });
}

function employee() {
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({ isStaff: false, user: { role: 'employee' } });
}

function route(url) {
  if (url === '/tickets/7/') return { data: TICKET };
  if (url === '/tickets/7/notes/') return { data: [] };
  if (url === '/tickets/histories/') return { data: [] };
  if (url === '/tickets/attachments/') return { data: [...ATTS] };
  throw new Error(`unexpected GET ${url}`);
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => route(url));
  mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
  mockDelete.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
  global.URL.createObjectURL = vi.fn(() => 'blob:fake');
  global.URL.revokeObjectURL = vi.fn();
});

describe('TicketDetail attachments', () => {
  it('lists attachments for staff', async () => {
    staff();
    render(<TicketDetail id="7" />);
    expect(await screen.findByText('spec.pdf')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      '/tickets/attachments/', { params: { ticket: '7' } },
    );
  });

  it('shows upload and delete controls only to staff', async () => {
    employee();
    render(<TicketDetail id="7" />);
    expect(await screen.findByText('spec.pdf')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByLabelText('Choose a file to upload')).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /delete/i })).toBeNull();
    expect(
      screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Download' }),
    ).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('uploads a file and refreshes the list', async () => {
    staff();
    mockPost.mockResolvedValueOnce({
      data: { id: 12, original_filename: 'a.pdf' },
    });
    render(<TicketDetail id="7" />);
    await screen.findByText('spec.pdf');
    const input = screen.getByLabelText('Choose a file to upload');
    fireEvent.change(input, {
      target: { files: [new File(['x'], 'a.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' })] },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Upload' }));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    });
    const [url, body] = mockPost.mock.calls[0];
    expect(url).toBe('/tickets/attachments/');
    expect(body).toBeInstanceOf(FormData);
    expect(await screen.findByText(/Uploaded "a.pdf"/)).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('shows backend validation errors on rejected upload', async () => {
    staff();
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({
      response: { status: 400, data: { file: ['Executable files are blocked.'] } },
    });
    render(<TicketDetail id="7" />);
    await screen.findByText('spec.pdf');
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Choose a file to upload'), {

    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Upload' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('Executable files are blocked.')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('deletes an attachment after confirmation', async () => {
    staff();
    render(<TicketDetail id="7" />);
    await screen.findByText('spec.pdf');
    fireEvent.click(
      screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Delete attachment spec.pdf' }),
    );
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Delete attachment' }));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockDelete).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/tickets/attachments/11/');
    });
  });

  it('downloads through the protected endpoint as a blob', async () => {
    staff();
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url, _cfg) => {
      if (String(url).endsWith('/download/')) {
        return { data: new Blob(['x']), headers: { 'content-disposition': 'attachment; filename="spec.pdf"' } };
      }
      return route(url);
    });
    const clickSpy = vi.spyOn(HTMLAnchorElement.prototype, 'click').mockImplementation(() => {});

    await screen.findByText('spec.pdf');

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockPatch, mockPost, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockPatch: vi.fn(),
  mockPost: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

  default: {
    get: (...args) => mockGet(...args),
    post: (...args) => mockPost(...args),
    patch: (...args) => mockPatch(...args),
    delete: vi.fn(),
  },
}));

vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({
  useAuth: (...args) => mockAuth(...args),
}));

import { TicketForm, TicketDetail } from '../../pages/tickets/Tickets';

const OPEN_TICKET = {
  id: 7, title: 'Printer down', description: 'No power.', priority: 'high',
  category: 2, department: 1, on_behalf_reason: '', asset: null,
  assignee: null, status: 'open', resolution_notes: '',
};
const RESOLVED_TICKET = { ...OPEN_TICKET, status: 'resolved' };

const TICKET_DETAIL = {
  ...OPEN_TICKET, category_name: 'Hardware', department_name: 'IT',
  requester_email: 'e@x', assignee_email: null,
  created_at: '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z',
};

function staff() {
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({
    isStaff: true, canCreateTickets: true,
    user: { role: 'it_support', home_department: 1 },
  });
}

function employee() {
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({
    isStaff: false, canCreateTickets: true,
    user: { role: 'employee', home_department: 1 },
  });
}

function formRoute(url) {
  if (url === '/tickets/7/') return { data: OPEN_TICKET };
  if (url === '/tickets/categories/') return { data: { results: [] } };
  if (url === '/accounts/departments/') return { data: { results: [] } };
  if (url === '/assets/') return { data: { results: [] } };
  if (url === '/accounts/users/') return { data: { results: [] } };
  throw new Error(`unexpected GET ${url}`);
}

function detailRoute(url) {
  if (url === '/tickets/7/') return { data: TICKET_DETAIL };
  if (url === '/tickets/7/notes/') return { data: [] };
  if (url === '/tickets/histories/') return { data: [{ id: 1, action: 'created', note: '' }] };
  if (url === '/tickets/attachments/') return { data: [] };
  throw new Error(`unexpected GET ${url}`);
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  window.location.hash = '';
  mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => formRoute(url));
  mockPatch.mockResolvedValue({ data: { ...OPEN_TICKET, id: 7 } });
  mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('TicketForm staff-only fields on edit', () => {
  it('disables priority and category for employees and omits them from the payload', async () => {
    employee();
    render(<TicketForm id="7" />);
    await screen.findByText('Edit ticket #7');
    // The category select stays disabled while its options load.
    await screen.findByText('Select a categoryâ€¦');
    const priority = screen.getByLabelText(/priority/i);
    const category = screen.getByLabelText(/^category/i);
    expect(priority.disabled).toBe(true);
    expect(category.disabled).toBe(true);
    expect(screen.getByText(/Only IT staff can change priority/i)).toBeTruthy();

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save changes' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPatch).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    const payload = mockPatch.mock.calls[0][1];
    expect(payload).not.toHaveProperty('priority');
    expect(payload).not.toHaveProperty('category');
    expect(payload).not.toHaveProperty('status');
    expect(payload).not.toHaveProperty('assignee');
    expect(payload.title).toBe('Printer down');
  });

  it('keeps priority and category editable for staff and sends them', async () => {
    staff();
    render(<TicketForm id="7" />);
    await screen.findByText('Edit ticket #7');
    await screen.findByText('Select a categoryâ€¦');
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/priority/i).disabled).toBe(false);
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/^category/i).disabled).toBe(false);

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save changes' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPatch).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    const payload = mockPatch.mock.calls[0][1];
    expect(payload.priority).toBe('high');
    expect(payload.status).toBe('open');
    expect(payload.assignee).toBeNull();
  });

  it('lets employees choose priority at creation', async () => {
    employee();
    mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: { ...OPEN_TICKET, id: 12 } });
    render(<TicketForm />);
    await screen.findByText('New ticket');
    const priority = screen.getByLabelText(/priority/i);
    expect(priority.disabled).toBe(false);
    fireEvent.change(priority, { target: { value: 'critical' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByPlaceholderText(/Brief summary/i), {
      target: { value: 'Mailbox full' },
    });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByPlaceholderText(/Steps to reproduce/i), {
      target: { value: 'Cannot send.' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create ticket' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    expect(mockPost.mock.calls[0][1].priority).toBe('critical');
  });
});

describe('TicketForm status dropdown', () => {
  it('only offers the current status and its valid successors', async () => {
    staff();
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      if (url === '/tickets/7/') return { data: RESOLVED_TICKET };
      return formRoute(url);
    });
    render(<TicketForm id="7" />);
    await screen.findByText('Edit ticket #7');
    const options = [...screen.getByLabelText(/^status/i).querySelectorAll('option')].map(
      (o) => o.value,
    );
    // Mirrors Ticket.VALID_TRANSITIONS.resolved
    expect(options.sort()).toEqual(['closed', 'reopened', 'resolved']);
    expect(options).not.toContain('in_progress');
    expect(options).not.toContain('archived');
  });

  it('offers every move from an open ticket', async () => {
    staff();
    render(<TicketForm id="7" />);
    await screen.findByText('Edit ticket #7');
    const options = [...screen.getByLabelText(/^status/i).querySelectorAll('option')].map(
      (o) => o.value,
    );
    expect(options.sort()).toEqual(['archived', 'closed', 'in_progress', 'open', 'resolved']);
  });
});

describe('TicketDetail history visibility', () => {
  it('hides History from employees and never requests it', async () => {
    employee();
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => detailRoute(url));
    render(<TicketDetail id="7" />);
    await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: /Printer down/ });
    expect(screen.queryByText('History')).toBeNull();
    expect(
      mockGet.mock.calls.filter(([url]) => url === '/tickets/histories/'),
    ).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('shows History to staff', async () => {
    staff();
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => detailRoute(url));
    render(<TicketDetail id="7" />);
    await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: /Printer down/ });
    await screen.findByText('History');
    expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      '/tickets/histories/', { params: { ticket: '7' } },
    );
  });
});

    user: { role: 'it_support', home_department: 1, email: 'tech@x' },
  });
}

function employee() {
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({
    isStaff: false, canCreateTickets: true,
    user: { role: 'employee', home_department: 1, email: 'r@x' },
  });
}

// Shared route handler for TicketForm/TicketDetail child-component API calls.
function ticketRoutes(url) {
  const u = String(url);
  if (u === '/tickets/') return { data: LIST_PAGE };
  if (u === '/tickets/7/') return { data: DETAIL_TICKET };
  if (u === '/tickets/categories/') return { data: { results: [] } };
  if (u === '/accounts/departments/') return { data: { results: [] } };
  if (u === '/assets/') return { data: { results: [] } };
  if (u === '/accounts/users/') return { data: { results: [] } };
  if (u === '/tickets/7/notes/') return { data: [] };
  if (u === '/tickets/attachments/') return { data: [] };
  if (u === '/tickets/histories/') return { data: [] };
  if (u === '/tickets/kb-articles/') return { data: [] };
  if (u === '/workflow/approval-requests/') return { data: [] };
  if (u === '/workflow/rule-executions/') return { data: [] };
  if (u === '/tickets/7/watchers/') return { data: [] };
  return { data: {} };
}

  window.location.hash = '';

describe('Ticket list â€” pagination and filtering', () => {
  it('paginates using next URL', async () => {
    staff();
    const page2 = {
      results: [{ id: 3, title: 'Third ticket', status: 'open', priority: 'low',
        category_name: 'C', assignee_email: null, requester_email: 'r@x',
        department_name: 'IT', asset_tag: null, sla_due_at: null,
        is_overdue: false, created_at: '2024-01-03T00:00:00Z',
        updated_at: '2024-01-03T00:00:00Z', description: '', on_behalf_reason: '',
        resolution_notes: '', resolved_at: null, closed_at: null }],
      count: 3, next: null, previous: '/tickets/?page=1',
    };
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      const u = String(url);
      if (u === '/tickets/') return { data: { ...LIST_PAGE, next: '/tickets/?page=2' } };
      if (u === '/tickets/?page=2') return { data: page2 };
      return ticketRoutes(url);

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Next/ }));

  });

  it('applies search filter', async () => {
    staff();
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      const u = String(url);
      if (u.includes('q=Printer')) {
        return { data: { ...LIST_PAGE, results: [LIST_PAGE.results[0]], count: 1 } };
      }
      return ticketRoutes(url);
    });
    render(<Tickets />);
    await screen.findByText('Printer down');
    const search = screen.getByLabelText(/Search tickets/);
    fireEvent.change(search, { target: { value: 'Printer' } });
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockGet.mock.calls.some(
      ([u]) => String(u).includes('q=Printer'))).toBe(true));
  });

  it('applies status filter and shows empty state', async () => {
    staff();
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      const u = String(url);
      if (u.includes('status=closed')) {
        return { data: { ...LIST_PAGE, results: [], count: 0 } };
      }
      return ticketRoutes(url);
    });
    render(<Tickets />);
    await screen.findByText('Printer down');
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Filter by status/), { target: { value: 'closed' } });
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText('No tickets match.')).toBeTruthy());
  });

describe('Ticket update â€” successful', () => {
  it('PATCHes supported fields', async () => {
    staff();
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => ticketRoutes(url));
    mockPatch.mockResolvedValue({
      data: { ...DETAIL_TICKET, status: 'resolved', priority: 'critical' },
    });
    render(<TicketForm id="7" />);
    await screen.findByText('Edit ticket #7');
    await screen.findByText('Select a categoryâ€¦');
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/^status/i), { target: { value: 'resolved' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save changes' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPatch).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    const payload = mockPatch.mock.calls[0][1];
    expect(payload.status).toBe('resolved');
    expect(mockPatch.mock.calls[0][0]).toBe('/tickets/7/');
  });

  it('prevents duplicate submissions while saving', async () => {
    staff();
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => ticketRoutes(url));
    let resolvePatch;
    mockPatch.mockImplementation(() => new Promise((r) => { resolvePatch = r; }));
    render(<TicketForm id="7" />);
    await screen.findByText('Edit ticket #7');
    await screen.findByText('Select a categoryâ€¦');
    const submit = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save changes' });
    fireEvent.click(submit);
    // Button is disabled while the first request is in flight.
    await waitFor(() => expect(submit.disabled).toBe(true));
    // A second click while submitting must not trigger another PATCH.
    fireEvent.click(submit);
    resolvePatch({ data: DETAIL_TICKET });
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPatch).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
  });
});

describe('Ticket update â€” failed', () => {
  it('shows meaningful error from backend validation', async () => {
    staff();
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => ticketRoutes(url));
    mockPatch.mockRejectedValueOnce({
      response: { status: 400, data: { status: ['Invalid transition.'] } },
    });
    render(<TicketForm id="7" />);
    await screen.findByText('Edit ticket #7');
    await screen.findByText('Select a categoryâ€¦');
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/^status/i), { target: { value: 'closed' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save changes' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText(/Invalid transition./)).toBeTruthy());
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save changes' })).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('handles server error on update', async () => {
    staff();
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => ticketRoutes(url));
    mockPatch.mockRejectedValueOnce({
      response: { status: 500, data: { detail: 'Server error.' } },
    });
    render(<TicketForm id="7" />);
    await screen.findByText('Edit ticket #7');
    await screen.findByText('Select a categoryâ€¦');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save changes' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText(/Server error/)).toBeTruthy());
  });
});

describe('Ticket update â€” state refresh after mutation', () => {
  it('navigates to detail after successful update', async () => {
    staff();
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => ticketRoutes(url));
    mockPatch.mockResolvedValue({
      data: { ...DETAIL_TICKET, status: 'resolved' },
    });
    render(<TicketForm id="7" />);
    await screen.findByText('Edit ticket #7');
    await screen.findByText('Select a categoryâ€¦');
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/^status/i), { target: { value: 'resolved' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save changes' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPatch).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    await waitFor(() => expect(window.location.hash).toBe('#/tickets/7'));
  });
});

describe('Ticket form request lifecycle', () => {
  it('does not let an older knowledge-base search replace newer suggestions', async () => {
    employee();
    const pendingSearches = [];
    mockGet.mockImplementation((url) => {
      if (url === '/assets/knowledge-base/') {
        return new Promise((resolve) => pendingSearches.push(resolve));
      }
      return Promise.resolve(ticketRoutes(url));
    });

    render(<TicketForm />);
    const subject = () => screen.getByPlaceholderText('Brief summary of the issue');
    fireEvent.change(subject(), { target: { value: 'Printer issue' } });
    await waitFor(() => expect(pendingSearches).toHaveLength(1));
    fireEvent.change(subject(), { target: { value: 'Monitor issue' } });
    await waitFor(() => expect(pendingSearches).toHaveLength(2));

    await act(async () => pendingSearches[1]({ data: { results: [{ id: 2, title: 'Monitor help' }] } }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('Monitor help')).toBeTruthy();
    await act(async () => pendingSearches[0]({ data: { results: [{ id: 1, title: 'Printer help' }] } }));

    expect(screen.getByText('Monitor help')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByText('Printer help')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('ignores a ticket detail response after the form switches records', async () => {
    staff();
    let resolveFirstTicket;
    mockGet.mockImplementation((url) => {
      if (url === '/tickets/7/') return new Promise((resolve) => { resolveFirstTicket = resolve; });
      if (url === '/tickets/8/') {
        return Promise.resolve({ data: { ...DETAIL_TICKET, id: 8, title: 'Ticket eight' } });
      }
      return Promise.resolve(ticketRoutes(url));
    });

    const view = render(<TicketForm id="7" />);
    view.rerender(<TicketForm id="8" />);
    const subject = await screen.findByPlaceholderText('Brief summary of the issue');
    await waitFor(() => expect(subject.value).toBe('Ticket eight'));
    await act(async () => resolveFirstTicket({ data: { ...DETAIL_TICKET, title: 'Stale ticket seven' } }));

    expect(subject.value).toBe('Ticket eight');
  });
});

    if (url === '/accounts/departments/') return { data: { results: [] } };
    if (url === '/assets/') return { data: { results: [] } };

      return { data: { results: [] } };
    });

    expect(area.value).toBe('Replaced toner.');

    employee();
    render(<TicketForm id="7" />);
    await screen.findByText('Edit ticket #7');
    expect(screen.queryByLabelText(/resolution notes/i)).toBeNull();
  });
});

function route(url) {
  if (url === '/tickets/7/') return { data: TICKET };
  if (url === '/tickets/7/notes/') return { data: [] };
  if (url === '/tickets/histories/') return { data: [] };
  if (url === '/tickets/attachments/') return { data: [] };
  if (url === '/tickets/kb-articles/') return { data: [] };
  if (url === '/workflow/approval-requests/') return { data: { results: APPROVALS } };
  if (url === '/workflow/rule-executions/') return { data: { results: EXECUTIONS } };
  throw new Error(`unexpected GET ${url}`);
}

    expect(screen.getByText('Approval #6: Reassign')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getAllByText('Approved').length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(screen.getAllByText('Pending approval').length).toBeGreaterThan(0);

      params: { ticket: '7', page_size: 10 },
    });

  it('never requests or displays execution history for employees', async () => {
    employee();

    await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: /Broken laptop/ });

    // Employees may see approvals on tickets they can see...

      if (url === '/workflow/rule-executions/') return { data: { results: [] } };

    });

    expect(await screen.findByText('No approval requests for this ticket.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(await screen.findByText('No automation rules have run for this ticket.')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  });

  it('shows assigned assets and requested tickets with links', async () => {
    staff();
    render(<EmployeeDetail id={5} />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText('L1')).toBeTruthy());
    expect(screen.getByText('Broken monitor')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'L1' })).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: '#3' })).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('shows an error when the detail request fails', async () => {
    staff();
    mockGet.mockRejectedValueOnce({
      response: { status: 403, data: { detail: 'Forbidden.' } },
    });
    render(<EmployeeDetail id={5} />);
    expect(await screen.findByText(/Forbidden/i)).toBeTruthy();
  });

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockPost, mockPatch, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockPost: vi.fn(),
  mockPatch: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: {
    get: (...args) => mockGet(...args),
    post: (...args) => mockPost(...args),
    patch: (...args) => mockPatch(...args),
    delete: vi.fn(),
  },
}));

vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({
  useAuth: (...args) => mockAuth(...args),
}));

vi.mock('../../pages/bulk/Bulk', () => ({
  AssetBulkCreateModal: () => null,
  EmployeeCreateModal: () => null,
  EmployeeImportModal: () => null,
  TicketBulkCreateModal: () => null,

import { Users } from '../../pages';

  id: 5, employee_id: 'E5', email: 'e5@x', role: 'employee',
  home_department: 1, home_department_name: 'Eng', is_active: true,
  first_name: '', last_name: '', phone: '', job_title: '',
};
const INACTIVE = { ...ACTIVE, id: 6, employee_id: 'E6', is_active: false };

function staff() {
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({ isStaff: true, isAdmin: false, user: { id: 1 } });
}

function admin() {
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({ isStaff: true, isAdmin: true, user: { id: 1 } });
}

function employee() {
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({ isStaff: false, isAdmin: false, user: { id: 9 } });
}

function list(...rows) {
  mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
    if (String(url).startsWith('/accounts/users/')) {
      return { data: { results: rows, count: rows.length, next: null, previous: null } };
    }
    if (String(url).startsWith('/accounts/departments/')) {
      return { data: { results: [], count: 0, next: null, previous: null } };
    }
    throw new Error(`unexpected GET ${url}`);
  });
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  window.confirm = vi.fn(() => true);
  list(ACTIVE, INACTIVE);
  mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reactivate' }));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/accounts/users/6/reactivate/', {});
    });
  });

  it('shows role changes only to admins', async () => {

    render(<Users />);

    // Prefilled with the record's current values ('Email *' has a required star).
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/^Email/).value).toBe('e5@x');
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/^Email/), {
      target: { value: 'new@x' },

    staff();
    mockPatch.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: ACTIVE });
    render(<Users />);
    await screen.findByText('E5');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getAllByRole('button', { name: 'Editâ€¦' })[0]);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save changes' }));

    const payload = mockPatch.mock.calls[0][1];

    expect(payload).not.toHaveProperty('can_create_tickets');
    expect(payload).not.toHaveProperty('employee_id');

    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save changes' })).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('surfaces backend errors', async () => {
    staff();
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({
      response: { status: 409, data: { detail: 'Blocked.' } },

    render(<Users />);
    await screen.findByText('E5');

  it('shows the reset password action only to admins', async () => {

    staff();
    cleanup();
    render(<Users />);
    await screen.findByText('E5');
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /Reset password/ })).toBeNull();
  });

  it('opens the reset password modal and submits a new password', async () => {
    admin();
    mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: { detail: 'Password reset for "E5" completed.' } });
    render(<Users />);
    await screen.findByText('E5');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getAllByRole('button', { name: 'Reset password' + String.fromCharCode(8230) })[0]);
    expect(screen.getByText('Reset password for E5')).toBeTruthy();
    const pwInput = screen.getByLabelText('New password for E5');
    const confirmInput = screen.getByLabelText('Confirm new password for E5');
    const submit = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reset password' });
    expect(submit.disabled).toBe(true);
    fireEvent.change(pwInput, { target: { value: 'brand-new-pass-99' } });
    fireEvent.change(confirmInput, { target: { value: 'brand-new-pass-99' } });
    expect(submit.disabled).toBe(false);
    fireEvent.click(submit);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/accounts/users/5/reset_password/', {
        new_password: 'brand-new-pass-99', confirm: 'brand-new-pass-99',
      });
    });
    expect(await screen.findByText('Password reset for "E5" completed.')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('surfaces reset password errors', async () => {
    admin();
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({
      response: { status: 400, data: { new_password: ['This password is too short. It must contain at least 8 characters.'] } },
    });
    render(<Users />);
    await screen.findByText('E5');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getAllByRole('button', { name: 'Reset password' + String.fromCharCode(8230) })[0]);
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('New password for E5'), { target: { value: 'brand-new-pass-99' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Confirm new password for E5'), { target: { value: 'brand-new-pass-99' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reset password' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(/too short/i)).toBeTruthy();

  it('applies role and status filters to the list request', async () => {
    admin();
    render(<Users />);
    await screen.findByText('E5');
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Filter by role'), {
      target: { value: 'it_support' },
    });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Filter by account status'), {
      target: { value: 'false' },
    });
    await waitFor(() => {
      const calls = mockGet.mock.calls.filter(([url]) =>
        String(url).startsWith('/accounts/users/'));
      const last = String(calls[calls.length - 1][0]);
      expect(last).toContain('role=it_support');
      expect(last).toContain('status=false');
    });
  });

  it('applies the department filter to the list request', async () => {
    admin();
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      if (String(url).startsWith('/accounts/users/')) {
        return {
          data: { results: [ACTIVE], count: 1, next: null, previous: null },
        };
      }
      if (String(url).startsWith('/accounts/departments/')) {
        return {
          data: {
            results: [{ id: 7, name: 'Eng', code: 'ENGX', member_count: 1 }],
            count: 1,
          },
        };
      }
      throw new Error(`unexpected GET ${url}`);
    });
    render(<Users />);
    await screen.findByText('E5');
    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(screen.getAllByRole('option', { name: 'Eng' })).toHaveLength(1),
    );
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Department'), {
      target: { value: '7' },
    });
    await waitFor(() => {
      const calls = mockGet.mock.calls.filter(([url]) =>
        String(url).startsWith('/accounts/users/'));
      expect(String(calls[calls.length - 1][0])).toContain('department=7');
    });
  });

  it('clears filters and re-requests the full list', async () => {
    admin();
    render(<Users />);
    await screen.findByText('E5');
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Filter by role'), {
      target: { value: 'it_support' },
    });
    await waitFor(() => {
      const calls = mockGet.mock.calls.filter(([url]) =>
        String(url).startsWith('/accounts/users/'));
      expect(String(calls[calls.length - 1][0])).toContain('role=it_support');
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Clear all employee filters/ }));
    await waitFor(() => {
      const calls = mockGet.mock.calls.filter(([url]) =>
        String(url).startsWith('/accounts/users/'));
      const last = String(calls[calls.length - 1][0]);
      expect(last).not.toContain('role=');
      expect(last).not.toContain('status=');
      expect(last).not.toContain('department=');
    });
  });
});


===== src\__tests__\vendors\vendors.test.jsx =====

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, cleanup, fireEvent, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockPost, mockPatch, mockDelete, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockPost: vi.fn(),
  mockPatch: vi.fn(),
  mockDelete: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: {
    get: (...a) => mockGet(...a),
    post: (...a) => mockPost(...a),
    patch: (...a) => mockPatch(...a),
    delete: (...a) => mockDelete(...a),
  },
}));
vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({ useAuth: (...a) => mockAuth(...a) }));

import { VendorsPage, VendorForm, VendorDetail } from '../../pages/vendors/VendorsPage';

function makeAuth() {
  return { isStaff: true, isAdmin: true, canManageVendors: true };
}

const VENDORS = [
  {
    id: 1,
    name: 'Acme Corp',
    code: 'ACME',
    contact_person: 'Dana Reed',
    email: 'dana@acme.io',
    phone: '555-0100',
    website: 'https://acme.io',
    address: '1 Main St',
    tax_registration: 'TAX-1',
    notes: 'Preferred supplier',
    is_active: true,
    asset_count: 2,
    stock_item_count: 1,
    updated_at: '2026-02-01T00:00:00Z',
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    name: 'Beta LLC',
    code: 'BETA',
    contact_person: '',
    email: '',
    phone: '',
    is_active: false,
    asset_count: 0,
    stock_item_count: 0,
    updated_at: '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z',
  },
];

const ASSETS = [
  { id: 10, asset_tag: 'AST-001', name: 'Laptop 1', status: 'in_use', purchase_cost: '1200.00' },
  { id: 11, asset_tag: 'AST-002', name: 'Laptop 2', status: 'in_stock', purchase_cost: null },
];

const PAGE_1 = {
  results: VENDORS,
  count: 45,
  next: 'http://testserver/api/assets/vendors/?page=2',
  previous: null,
};

const PAGE_2 = {
  results: [
    {
      id: 3, name: 'Gamma Inc', code: 'GAMMA', contact_person: '', email: '',
      phone: '', is_active: true, asset_count: 0, stock_item_count: 0,
      updated_at: '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z',
    },
  ],
  count: 45,
  next: null,
  previous: 'http://testserver/api/assets/vendors/?page=1',
};

/** Default API mock: vendor list, vendor detail, related assets, stock items. */
function installDefaultGet() {
  mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
    const u = String(url);
    if (u === '/assets/vendors/1/') return { data: VENDORS[0] };
    if (u.startsWith('/assets/vendors/')) {
      return { data: { results: VENDORS, count: VENDORS.length, next: null, previous: null } };
    }
    if (u.startsWith('/assets/?vendor=1')) {
      return { data: { results: ASSETS, count: ASSETS.length, next: null, previous: null } };
    }
    if (u.startsWith('/inventory/stock-items/')) return { data: { results: [], count: 0 } };
    return { data: { results: [], count: 0, next: null, previous: null } };
  });
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  mockAuth.mockImplementation(() => makeAuth());
  mockPost.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
  mockPatch.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
  installDefaultGet();
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('Vendors page - table rendering', () => {
  it('renders a non-empty vendor list with row keys derived from each vendor', async () => {
    render(<VendorsPage />);

    await screen.findByText('Acme Corp');
    expect(screen.getByText('Beta LLC')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('ACME')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Dana Reed')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('dana@acme.io')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Acme Corp').closest('a').getAttribute('href')).toBe('#/vendors/1');
    expect(screen.getByText('Beta LLC').closest('a').getAttribute('href')).toBe('#/vendors/2');
  });

  it('renders the vendor detail related-assets table with non-empty data', async () => {
    render(<VendorDetail id={1} />);

    await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: 'Acme Corp' });
    const heading = await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: /Related Assets/ });
    expect(heading.textContent).toContain('Related Assets (2)');
    expect(screen.getByText('AST-001')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('AST-002')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Laptop 1')).toBeTruthy();
  });
});

describe('Vendors page - pagination', () => {
  function installPagedGet() {
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      const u = String(url);
      if (u.includes('page=2')) return { data: PAGE_2 };
      if (u.includes('q=')) {
        return { data: { ...PAGE_1, results: [VENDORS[0]] } };
      }
      return { data: PAGE_1 };
    });
  }

  it('renders pager metadata and next/previous controls', async () => {
    installPagedGet();
    render(<VendorsPage />);

    await screen.findByText('Acme Corp');
    expect(document.body.textContent).toContain('45 items');
    expect(document.body.textContent).toContain('Page 1');
    const prev = screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Prev/ });
    const next = screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Next/ });
    expect(prev.disabled).toBe(true);
    expect(next.disabled).toBe(false);
  });

  it('requests the next page URL and updates controls and rows', async () => {
    installPagedGet();
    render(<VendorsPage />);
    await screen.findByText('Acme Corp');

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Next/ }));

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith(PAGE_1.next);
    });
    await screen.findByText('Gamma Inc');
    expect(document.body.textContent).toContain('Page 2');
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Next/ }).disabled).toBe(true);
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Prev/ }).disabled).toBe(false);
  });

  it('returns to the previous page without rebuilding the URL', async () => {
    installPagedGet();
    render(<VendorsPage />);
    await screen.findByText('Acme Corp');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Next/ }));
    await screen.findByText('Gamma Inc');

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Prev/ }));

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith(PAGE_2.previous);
    });
    await screen.findByText('Acme Corp');
    expect(document.body.textContent).toContain('Page 1');
  });

  it('disables paging controls when the list response has no next/previous links', async () => {
    mockGet.mockResolvedValue({ data: VENDORS });
    render(<VendorsPage />);

    await screen.findByText('Acme Corp');
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Next/ }).disabled).toBe(true);
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Prev/ }).disabled).toBe(true);
  });

  it('returns to page 1 when the search filter changes', async () => {
    installPagedGet();
    render(<VendorsPage />);
    await screen.findByText('Acme Corp');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Next/ }));
    await screen.findByText('Gamma Inc');
    expect(document.body.textContent).toContain('Page 2');

    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Search'), { target: { value: 'acme' } });

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockGet).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/assets/vendors/?q=acme&page_size=20');
    }, { timeout: 2000 });
    await screen.findByText('Acme Corp');
    expect(document.body.textContent).toContain('Page 1');
  });
});

describe('Vendors page - loading and empty states', () => {
  it('shows a loading skeleton while the list request is pending', async () => {
    let resolveList;
    mockGet.mockImplementation(() => new Promise((res) => { resolveList = res; }));
    render(<VendorsPage />);

    await screen.findByRole('status', { name: 'Loading' });

  it('submits the existing form payload on create', async () => {

        address: '',
        tax_registration: '',
        notes: '',

      }));
    });
    await waitFor(() => expect(onSave).toHaveBeenCalled());
  });

  it('shows backend validation errors and re-enables submission', async () => {
    mockPost.mockRejectedValueOnce({
      response: { status: 400, data: { name: ['This field is required.'] } },
    });
    render(<VendorForm onSave={vi.fn()} onClose={vi.fn()} />);

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create' }));

    await screen.findByText(/name: This field is required\./);
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create' }).disabled).toBe(false);
  });

  it('disables the submit button and prevents duplicate create requests', async () => {
    let resolvePost;
    mockPost.mockImplementationOnce(() => new Promise((res) => { resolvePost = res; }));
    render(<VendorForm onSave={vi.fn()} onClose={vi.fn()} />);

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create' }));
    const pending = await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Savingâ€¦' });
    expect(pending.disabled).toBe(true);
    fireEvent.click(pending);
    expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);

    resolvePost({ data: {} });
    await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Create' });
    expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('loads existing values and patches them in edit mode', async () => {
    const onSave = vi.fn();
    render(<VendorForm vendorId={1} onSave={onSave} onClose={vi.fn()} />);

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByLabelText(/^Name/).value).toBe('Acme Corp');
    });
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Edit Vendor' })).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/^Code/).value).toBe('ACME');
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/^Email/).value).toBe('dana@acme.io');
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/^Address/).value).toBe('1 Main St');
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/^Notes/).value).toBe('Preferred supplier');
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/^Active/).checked).toBe(true);

    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/^Name/), { target: { value: 'Acme Corp Ltd' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Update' }));

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockPatch).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/assets/vendors/1/', expect.objectContaining({
        name: 'Acme Corp Ltd',
        code: 'ACME',
      }));
    });
    await waitFor(() => expect(onSave).toHaveBeenCalled());
  });

  it('shows a loading state while edit data is fetched', async () => {
    let resolveVendor;
    mockGet.mockImplementationOnce(() => new Promise((res) => { resolveVendor = res; }));
    render(<VendorForm vendorId={1} onSave={vi.fn()} onClose={vi.fn()} />);

    expect(screen.getByRole('status', { name: 'Loading' })).toBeTruthy();
    resolveVendor({ data: VENDORS[0] });

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByLabelText(/^Name/).value).toBe('Acme Corp');
    });
  });

  it('shows a load error when edit data cannot be fetched', async () => {
    mockGet.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 404, data: { detail: 'Not found.' } } });
    render(<VendorForm vendorId={1} onSave={vi.fn()} onClose={vi.fn()} />);

    await screen.findByText(/Could not load vendor data\. Not found\./);
  });
});


===== src\__tests__\workflow\workflow-approvals.test.jsx =====

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockPost, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockPost: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: {
    get: (...args) => mockGet(...args),
    post: (...args) => mockPost(...args),
    patch: vi.fn(),
    delete: vi.fn(),
  },
}));

vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({ useAuth: (...args) => mockAuth(...args) }));

import Workflow from '../../pages/workflow/Workflow';

const BASE = {
  id: 5,
  ticket: 7,
  ticket_title: 'Broken laptop',
  requested_by: 3,
  requested_by_email: 'employee@x',
  approver: null,
  approver_email: null,
  operation: 'change_priority',
  operation_display: 'Change priority',
  context: { priority: 'critical' },
  reason: 'Vendor confirmed emergency',
  status: 'pending',
  status_display: 'Pending',
  decision_comment: '',
  decided_by: null,
  decided_by_email: null,
  decided_at: null,
  created_at: '2024-01-01T10:00:00Z',
  updated_at: '2024-01-01T10:00:00Z',
};

let decisionState;

function currentApproval() {
  if (decisionState === 'pending') return { ...BASE };
  return {
    ...BASE,
    status: decisionState,
    status_display: decisionState === 'approved' ? 'Approved' : 'Rejected',
    decision_comment: 'Emergency confirmed',
    decided_by: 2,
    decided_by_email: 'manager@x',
    decided_at: '2024-01-02T10:00:00Z',
  };
}

function approver(id = 2) {
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({
    isStaff: true, isAdmin: false, isSystemAdmin: false, isITManager: true, isITSupport: false, isEmployee: false,
    isManagerOrAdmin: true, isSupportOrAbove: true,
    canManageUsers: false, canManageVendors: true, canViewVendors: true,
    canManageServiceCatalogue: true, canApproveServiceRequests: true,
    canConfigureWorkflow: true, canApproveDisposals: true,
    canManageInventory: true, canAdjustInventory: true,
    canPublishKnowledgeBase: true, canManageScheduledReports: true,
    canAccessAudit: false, canAccessRecycleBin: false, canPerformPermanentDeletion: false,
    canCreateTickets: true,
    user: { id, role: 'it_manager' },
  });
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  decisionState = 'pending';
  approver(2);
  window.location.hash = '';
  mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
    if (String(url) === '/workflow/approval-requests/5/') return { data: currentApproval() };
    return { data: { results: [], count: 0, next: null, previous: null } };
  });
  mockPost.mockImplementation(async () => {
    decisionState = 'approved';
    return { data: currentApproval() };
  });
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('approval detail and decisions', () => {
  it('shows the complete approval request', async () => {
    render(<Workflow approvalId="5" />);
    await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: 'Approval #5' });

    expect(screen.getByText('#7 Broken laptop')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('employee@x')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getAllByText('Change priority').length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(screen.getAllByText('Pending approval').length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(screen.getByText('Priority: critical')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText(/Vendor confirmed emergency/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Any IT staff')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('approves with a comment after confirmation and refreshes the detail', async () => {
    render(<Workflow approvalId="5" />);
    await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: 'Approval #5' });

    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Decision comment'), {
      target: { value: 'Emergency confirmed' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Approveâ€¦' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('Approve this request?')).toBeTruthy();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Approve request' }));

    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      '/workflow/approval-requests/5/approve/',
      { comment: 'Emergency confirmed' },
    ));
    expect(await screen.findByText(/Approval recorded/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Approveâ€¦' })).toBeNull();
    // The detail was re-fetched after the decision.
    expect(mockGet.mock.calls.filter(([url]) => url === '/workflow/approval-requests/5/').length)
      .toBeGreaterThan(1);
  });

  it('rejects with a decision comment', async () => {
    mockPost.mockImplementationOnce(async () => {
      decisionState = 'rejected';
      return { data: currentApproval() };
    });
    render(<Workflow approvalId="5" />);
    await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: 'Approval #5' });

    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Decision comment'), {
      target: { value: 'Not justified' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Rejectâ€¦' }));
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Reject request' }));

    await waitFor(() => expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      '/workflow/approval-requests/5/reject/',
      { comment: 'Not justified' },
    ));
    expect(await screen.findByText('Approval request rejected.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Rejectâ€¦' })).toBeNull();
  });

  it('prevents duplicate submissions while a decision is in flight', async () => {
    let resolvePost;
    mockPost.mockImplementationOnce(() => new Promise((resolve) => { resolvePost = resolve; }));
    render(<Workflow approvalId="5" />);
    await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: 'Approval #5' });

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Approveâ€¦' }));
    const confirm = await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Approve request' });
    fireEvent.click(confirm);
    fireEvent.click(confirm);
    expect(mockPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);

    decisionState = 'approved';
    resolvePost({ data: currentApproval() });
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Approve request' })).toBeNull());
  });

  it('handles a request already decided by another user', async () => {
    mockPost.mockImplementationOnce(async () => {
      decisionState = 'approved';
      throw {
        response: {
          status: 409,
          data: { detail: 'This approval has already been decided by another user.' },
        },
      };
    });
    render(<Workflow approvalId="5" />);
    await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: 'Approval #5' });

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Approveâ€¦' }));
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Approve request' }));

    expect(await screen.findByText(/already been decided by another user/i)).toBeTruthy();
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Approveâ€¦' })).toBeNull());
    // Stale decision reloads the latest state.
    expect(mockGet.mock.calls.filter(([url]) => url === '/workflow/approval-requests/5/').length)
      .toBeGreaterThan(1);
  });

  it('does not offer decision controls to the requester', async () => {
    approver(3);
    render(<Workflow approvalId="5" />);
    await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: 'Approval #5' });
    expect(screen.getByText('You cannot decide your own approval request.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Approveâ€¦' })).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Rejectâ€¦' })).toBeNull();
  });

  it('shows an error state for an unavailable approval', async () => {
    mockGet.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 404, data: { detail: 'Not found.' } } });
    render(<Workflow approvalId="5" />);
    expect(await screen.findByText('Not found.')).toBeTruthy();
  });
});

  // No buttons or creation text anywhere in the rendered tree.

import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGet: vi.fn(),
  mockAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../../api', () => ({
  default: {
    get: (...args) => mockGet(...args),

    delete: vi.fn(),
  },
