vi.mock('../../auth', () => ({ useAuth: (...args) => mockAuth(...args) }));

import Workflow from '../../pages/workflow/Workflow';

const RULE = {
  id: 1,
  name: 'Auto note',
  trigger: 'ticket_created',
  trigger_display: 'Ticket Created',
  is_enabled: true,
  conditions: { priority: 'high' },
  actions: [{ type: 'note', text: 'Auto triage' }],
};

const EXECUTION = {
  id: 9,
  rule: 1,
  rule_name: 'Auto note',
  ticket: 7,
  ticket_title: 'Broken laptop',
  success: false,
  detail: 'ValueError: user #99 not found or inactive',
  created_at: '2024-01-03T10:00:00Z',
};

const PAGE_1 = {
  results: [EXECUTION],
  count: 2,
  next: '/workflow/rule-executions/?page=2',
  previous: null,
};
const PAGE_2 = {
  results: [{ ...EXECUTION, id: 10, success: true, detail: 'note #2 created' }],
  count: 2,
  next: null,
  previous: '/workflow/rule-executions/',
};

function staff() {
  mockAuth.mockReturnValue({
    isStaff: true, isAdmin: true, user: { id: 1, role: 'system_admin' },
  });
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  staff();
  mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
    const u = String(url);
    if (u === '/workflow/automation-rules/') {
      return { data: { results: [RULE], count: 1, next: null, previous: null } };
    }
    if (u === '/workflow/automation-rules/1/') return { data: RULE };
    if (u === '/workflow/rule-executions/9/') return { data: EXECUTION };
    if (u.includes('page=2')) return { data: PAGE_2 };
    if (u.startsWith('/workflow/rule-executions/')) return { data: PAGE_1 };
    return { data: { results: [], count: 0, next: null, previous: null } };
  });
});

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('execution history', () => {
  it('filters by rule and status using the API query parameters', async () => {
    render(<Workflow tab="executions" />);
    await screen.findByRole('link', { name: 'Auto note' });

    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Filter executions by rule'), { target: { value: '1' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Filter executions by status'), { target: { value: 'failure' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Apply filters' }));

    await waitFor(() => {
      const urls = mockGet.mock.calls.map(([url]) => String(url));
      expect(urls.some((u) => u.includes('rule=1') && u.includes('status=failure'))).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  it('sends an inclusive date range (end date covers the whole day)', async () => {
    render(<Workflow tab="executions" />);
    await screen.findByRole('link', { name: 'Auto note' });

    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Execution start date'), { target: { value: '2024-01-01' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Execution end date'), { target: { value: '2024-01-31' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Apply filters' }));

    await waitFor(() => {
      const urls = mockGet.mock.calls.map(([url]) => decodeURIComponent(String(url)));
      expect(urls.some((u) => u.includes('date_from=2024-01-01')
        && u.includes('date_to=2024-01-31T23:59:59'))).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  it('paginates through next and previous links', async () => {
    render(<Workflow tab="executions" />);
    await screen.findByText('ValueError: user #99 not found or inactive');

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Next/ }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(
      mockGet.mock.calls.some(([url]) => String(url).includes('page=2')),
    ).toBe(true));
    expect(await screen.findByText('note #2 created')).toBeTruthy();

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Prev/ }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(
      mockGet.mock.calls.some(([url]) => String(url) === '/workflow/rule-executions/'),
    ).toBe(true));
  });

  it('shows execution details with rule, trigger, result and failure information', async () => {
    render(<Workflow executionId="9" />);
    await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: 'Execution #9' });

    expect(screen.getByText('#7 Broken laptop')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Ticket Created')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getAllByText('Failed').length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(screen.getByText('Failure information')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText(/user #99 not found or inactive/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Priority = High')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Add internal note: â€œAuto triageâ€')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('shows an empty state when filters match nothing', async () => {
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      const u = String(url);
      if (u === '/workflow/automation-rules/') return { data: { results: [RULE] } };
      if (u.startsWith('/workflow/rule-executions/')) {
        return { data: { results: [], count: 0, next: null, previous: null } };
      }
      return { data: { results: [] } };
    });
    render(<Workflow tab="executions" />);
    expect(await screen.findByText('No executions match.')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('shows an error state with retry when history cannot load', async () => {
    mockGet.mockImplementation(async (url) => {
      const u = String(url);
      if (u === '/workflow/automation-rules/') return { data: { results: [RULE] } };
      throw { response: { status: 500, data: { detail: 'Server exploded' } } };
    });
    render(<Workflow tab="executions" />);
    expect(await screen.findByText('Server exploded')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retry' })).toBeTruthy();
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';

const { mockGet, mockPatch, mockPost, mockAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({

===== src\api-utils.js =====

import api from './api';

// Django/DRF can answer with an HTML page instead of JSON (e.g. an unhandled
// OperationalError or a DEBUG traceback). Showing that markup in the UI is
// meaningless, so we detect it, keep the raw body in the console for
// debugging, and surface a short human message instead.
const LOOKS_LIKE_HTML = /^\s*<(!doctype|html|head|body|pre|table|div)\b/i;

function isHtmlBody(s) {
  return typeof s === 'string' && LOOKS_LIKE_HTML.test(s);
}

function serverErrorMessage(status) {
  const code = status ? ` (HTTP ${status})` : '';
  return `Server error${code}. The request could not be completed - please try again. If it keeps happening, report it to support.`;
}

function warnRawBody(status, body) {
  try {
    console.warn(`[api] Non-JSON error response (HTTP ${status}); raw body follows for debugging:`, String(body).slice(0, 5000));
  } catch { /* console unavailable */ }
}

/** Flatten a DRF error response to {fields: {name: msg}, global: msg}. */
export function parseApiError(e) {
  const data = e?.response?.data;
  const status = e?.response?.status;
  const out = { fields: {}, global: '' };
  if (!data) {
    if (status === 403) {
      out.global = 'Forbidden: you lack permission for this action.';
      return out;
    }
    out.global = e?.message ? `Request failed: ${e.message}` : 'Request failed.';
    return out;
  }
  if (typeof data === 'string') {
    if (isHtmlBody(data)) {
      warnRawBody(status, data);
      out.global = serverErrorMessage(status);
    } else {
      out.global = data;
    }
    return out;
  }
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(data)) {
    let msg = Array.isArray(v) ? v.join(' ') : (typeof v === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(v) : String(v));
    if (isHtmlBody(msg)) {
      warnRawBody(status, msg);
      msg = serverErrorMessage(status);
    }
    if (k === 'detail' || k === 'non_field_errors') out.global = out.global ? `${out.global} ${msg}` : msg;
    else out.fields[k] = msg;
  }
  if (e?.response?.status === 403 && !out.global) out.global = 'Forbidden: you lack permission for this action.';
  if (!out.global && Object.keys(out.fields).length === 0) out.global = 'Request failed.';
  return out;
}

export function fieldMsg(fieldErrors, name) {
  return fieldErrors?.[name] ?? '';
}

/** Paginated GET helper returning {items, count, next, previous}. */
export async function fetchPage(url, options) {
  const r = options ? await api.get(url, options) : await api.get(url);
  const d = r.data;
  if (Array.isArray(d)) return { items: d, count: d.length, next: null, previous: null };
  return { items: d.results ?? [], count: d.count, next: d.next, previous: d.previous };
}

/** Trigger a browser download for a Blob with a filename. */
export function downloadBlob(blob, filename) {
  // Revoke the old object URL from any previous call in this tab so
  // temporary blobs do not accumulate across repeated downloads.
  if (downloadBlob._lastUrl) {
    try { URL.revokeObjectURL(downloadBlob._lastUrl); } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  downloadBlob._lastUrl = url;
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  a.rel = 'noopener';
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();
  setTimeout(() => {
    try { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); } catch { /* ignore */ }
    if (downloadBlob._lastUrl === url) downloadBlob._lastUrl = null;
  }, 5000);
}

/** Minimal CSV parser honoring quotes/escaped quotes/commas/newlines. */
export function parseCSV(text) {
  const rows = [];
  let row = [];
  let field = '';
  let quoted = false;
  const pushField = () => { row.push(field); field = ''; };
  const pushRow = () => { rows.push(row); row = []; };
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
    const ch = text[i];
    if (quoted) {
      if (ch === '"') {
        if (text[i + 1] === '"') { field += '"'; i++; }
        else quoted = false;
      } else field += ch;
    } else if (ch === '"') quoted = true;
    else if (ch === ',') pushField();
    else if (ch === '\r') { /* wait for \n */ }
    else if (ch === '\n') { pushField(); pushRow(); }
    else field += ch;
  }
  pushField();
  if (row.length > 1 || (row.length === 1 && row[0] !== '')) pushRow();
  return rows;
}

/** Extract a readable message when an error response arrived as a Blob. */
export async function blobErrorMessage(e, fallback) {
  try {
    const blob = e?.response?.data;
    if (blob instanceof Blob) {
      const text = await blob.text();
      try {
        const p = parseApiError({ ...e, response: { ...e.response, data: JSON.parse(text) } });
        if (p.global) return p.global;
        const fieldMsgs = Object.values(p.fields).filter(Boolean);
        if (fieldMsgs.length) return fieldMsgs.join(' ');
      } catch { /* not JSON; fall through */ }
      // An HTML/debug page in a Blob is just as unreadable as in JSON:
      // log it, return a friendly message.
      if (isHtmlBody(text)) {
        warnRawBody(e?.response?.status, text);
        return serverErrorMessage(e?.response?.status);
      }
      if (text.trim()) return text.trim().slice(0, 500);
    }
  } catch { /* ignore */ }
  return parseApiError(e).global || fallback;
}


===== src\api.js =====

import axios from 'axios';

const VITE_API_BASE_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL ?? 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api';
// When true, the refresh token is expected to live in an httpOnly cookie
// (backend JWT_REFRESH_COOKIE_ENABLED=true). The frontend then keeps only the
// access token in localStorage (for page-reload boot) and refreshes via the
// cookie (empty-body POST, browser sends the cookie automatically). When false
// (default, including tests), the body-based refresh path is used.
const USE_REFRESH_COOKIE = !!(import.meta.env.VITE_USE_REFRESH_COOKIE);

const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: VITE_API_BASE_URL,
  timeout: 30000,
});

api.interceptors.request.use((cfg) => {
  const t = localStorage.getItem('access');
  if (t) cfg.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${t}`;
  // axios auto-set `Content-Type: application/json` only when there is no
  // existing Content-Type. FormData needs a multipart boundary, so we must
  // never let the request interceptor stamp JSON on a multipart body.
  if (cfg.data instanceof FormData && cfg.headers['Content-Type'] === undefined) {
    // Remove any inherited JSON content type so axios leaves the boundary
    // alone and the browser sends the correct multipart envelope.
    delete cfg.headers['Content-Type'];
  }
  return cfg;
});

// In-flight refresh promises. In body mode, keyed by the refresh token so
// concurrent 401s sharing the same refresh token do one refresh. In cookie
// mode (no readable refresh token), a single in-flight promise dedupes.
let bodyRefreshPromise = null;
let bodyRefreshToken = null;
let cookieRefreshPromise = null;

function isAuthUrl(url = '') {
  return (
    url.includes('/token/')
    || url.includes('/password-reset/')
    || url.includes('/verify-email/')
  );
}

function clearAuth() {
  localStorage.removeItem('access');
  localStorage.removeItem('refresh');
  bodyRefreshPromise = null;
  bodyRefreshToken = null;
  cookieRefreshPromise = null;
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event('auth-expired'));
}

function refreshFromBody(refresh) {
  if (!refresh) return Promise.reject(new Error('No refresh token to refresh with.'));
  if (bodyRefreshPromise && bodyRefreshToken === refresh) {
    return bodyRefreshPromise;
  }
  bodyRefreshToken = refresh;
  const base = (api.defaults && api.defaults.baseURL) || '';
  bodyRefreshPromise = axios
    .post(`${base}/token/refresh/`, { refresh })
    .then((r) => {
      if (localStorage.getItem('refresh') === refresh) {
        localStorage.setItem('access', r.data.access);
      }
      return r.data.access;
    })
    .finally(() => {
      if (bodyRefreshToken === refresh) {
        bodyRefreshPromise = null;
        bodyRefreshToken = null;
      }
    });
  return bodyRefreshPromise;
}

function refreshFromCookie() {
  if (cookieRefreshPromise) return cookieRefreshPromise;
  const base = (api.defaults && api.defaults.baseURL) || '';
  cookieRefreshPromise = axios
    .post(`${base}/token/refresh/`, {})
    .then((r) => {
      const access = r.data && r.data.access;
      if (access) localStorage.setItem('access', access);
      return access;
    })
    .finally(() => {
      cookieRefreshPromise = null;
    });
  return cookieRefreshPromise;
}

api.interceptors.response.use(
  (res) => res,
  async (error) => {
    const { config, response } = error || {};
    const url = (config && config.url) || '';
    if (
      !config ||
      !response ||
      response.status !== 401 ||
      config._retry ||
      isAuthUrl(url)
    ) {
      return Promise.reject(error);
    }
    config._retry = true;
    const refresh = localStorage.getItem('refresh');
    try {
      let token;
      if (USE_REFRESH_COOKIE && !refresh) {
        // Cookie mode: refresh token lives in an httpOnly cookie; refresh with
        // an empty body and let the browser send the cookie.
        token = await refreshFromCookie();
        config.headers = { ...(config.headers || {}), Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` };
        return api(config);
      }
      if (!refresh) {
        if (onApiError) {
          try { onApiError(error, response && response.status); } catch { /* ignore */ }
        }
        clearAuth();
        return Promise.reject(error);
      }
      // Body mode: we have a localStorage refresh token.
      token = await refreshFromBody(refresh);
      if (localStorage.getItem('refresh') !== refresh) {
        // Logged out (or signed in as someone else) while refreshing; never
        // replay the request with a token minted for the previous session.
        return Promise.reject(error);
      }
      config.headers = { ...(config.headers || {}), Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` };
      return api(config);
    } catch {
      if (onApiError) {
        try { onApiError(error, response && response.status); } catch { /* ignore */ }
      }
      if (USE_REFRESH_COOKIE && !refresh) {
        clearAuth();
        return Promise.reject(error);
      }
      if (localStorage.getItem('refresh') !== refresh) {
        return Promise.reject(error);
      }
      clearAuth();
      return Promise.reject(error);
    }
  },
);

export default api;

/** Optional callback set by the UI layer (ToastProvider) so the response
 *  interceptor can surface API errors as toasts. Signature: (error, status). */
let onApiError = null;

export function setApiErrorHandler(handler) {
  onApiError = handler;
}

/** Reset in-flight refresh promises and module state. For test isolation only;
 *  call in test beforeEach so one test's pending refresh never leaks into the
 *  next. Safe to call in production (no-op unless a refresh is mid-flight). */
export function resetApiState() {
  bodyRefreshPromise = null;
  bodyRefreshToken = null;
  cookieRefreshPromise = null;
}

/** Drop staff-only entries, capability-gated entries, and any section left
 *  with no visible items. `caps` is the set of boolean capability helpers
 *  from `useAuth()` (isStaff, canManageVendors, ...). Unknown capabilities
 *  fail closed (entry hidden). */
function visibleNav(nav, caps) {
  const kept = nav.filter((n) => {
    if (n.section) return true;
    if (n.staffOnly) return !!caps.isStaff;
    if (n.cap) return !!caps[n.cap];
    return true;
  });
  const out = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < kept.length; i += 1) {
    if (!kept[i].section) {
      out.push(kept[i]);
      continue;
    }
    let j = i + 1;
    while (j < kept.length && !kept[j].section) j += 1;
    if (j > i + 1) out.push(kept[i]);
  }
  // Collapsible sections stay collapsed on load. The Change Management section
  // is the largest section by far (17 routes) and would otherwise take the
  // entire sidebar; keep it collapsed and let the user expand it.
  return out;
}

/** Sticky-header breadcrumb: parent -> record -> action. */
function crumbs(hash) {
  const h = hash.split('?')[0];
  let m;
  if ((m = h.match(/^#\/(tickets|assets)\/(\d+)(?:\/(edit))?$/))) {
    const trail = [m[1] === 'tickets' ? 'Tickets' : 'Assets', `#${m[2]}`];
    if (m[3]) trail.push('Edit');
    return trail;
  }
  if (h === '#/tickets/bulk-imports') return ['Tickets', 'Import operations'];
  if ((m = h.match(/^#\/tickets\/bulk-imports\/(\d+)$/))) return ['Tickets', 'Import operations', `#${m[1]}`];
  if (h === '#/tickets/new') return ['Tickets', 'New'];
  if (h === '#/assets/new') return ['Assets', 'New'];
  if (h === '#/assets/reports' || h.startsWith('#/assets/reports?')) return ['Assets', 'Asset Reports'];
  if (h === '#/vendors/new') return ['Vendors', 'New'];
  if (h === '#/recycle' || h === '#/audit') return ['Administration', TITLES[h]];
  if (h === '#/privacy') return ['Administration', 'Privacy erasure'];
  if (h.startsWith('#/privacy/')) return ['Administration', 'Privacy erasure'];
  if (h === '#/monitoring') return ['Administration', 'Monitoring'];
  if (h.startsWith('#/monitoring/')) return ['Administration', 'Monitoring'];
  if (h === '#/problem-management') return ['Service Operations', 'Problems'];
  if (h.startsWith('#/problem-management/')) return ['Service Operations', 'Problems', 'Problem'];
  if (h === '#/backup') return ['Administration', 'Backup & DR'];
  if (h.startsWith('#/backup/')) return ['Administration', 'Backup & DR'];
  if (h === '#/retention') return ['Administration', 'Data retention'];
  if (h.startsWith('#/retention/')) return ['Administration', 'Data retention'];
  if (h.startsWith('#/workflow')) return ['Workflow'];
  if (h.startsWith('#/reports/')) return ['Reports', TITLES[h]];
  if (h.startsWith('#/settings/')) return ['Settings', TITLES[h]];
  if ((m = h.match(/^#\/users\/(\d+)$/))) return ['Employees', `Employee #${m[1]}`];
  if (h === '#/cmdb') return ['CMDB'];
  if (h.startsWith('#/cmdb/items/new')) return ['CMDB', 'Configuration Items', 'New'];
  if ((m = h.match(/^#\/cmdb\/items\/(\d+)\/edit$/))) return ['CMDB', 'Configuration Items', `CI #${m[1]}`, 'Edit'];
  if ((m = h.match(/^#\/cmdb\/items\/(\d+)\/impact$/))) return ['CMDB', 'Configuration Items', `CI #${m[1]}`, 'Impact'];
  if ((m = h.match(/^#\/cmdb\/items\/(\d+)\/dependencies$/))) return ['CMDB', 'Configuration Items', `CI #${m[1]}`, 'Dependencies'];
  if ((m = h.match(/^#\/cmdb\/items\/(\d+)\/relationships$/))) return ['CMDB', 'Configuration Items', `CI #${m[1]}`, 'Relationships'];
  if ((m = h.match(/^#\/cmdb\/items\/(\d+)$/))) return ['CMDB', 'Configuration Items', `CI #${m[1]}`];
  if (h.startsWith('#/cmdb/items')) return ['CMDB', 'Configuration Items'];
  if (h.startsWith('#/cmdb/types')) return ['CMDB', 'CI Types'];
  if (h.startsWith('#/cmdb/baselines')) return ['CMDB', 'Baselines'];
  if (h.startsWith('#/cmdb/drift')) return ['CMDB', 'Drift Findings'];
  if (h.startsWith('#/cmdb/verification')) return ['CMDB', 'Verification Queue'];
  if (h.startsWith('#/cmdb/reports')) return ['CMDB', 'Reports'];
  if (h.startsWith('#/cmdb/services')) return ['CMDB', 'Service Mapping'];
  if (h.startsWith('#/cmdb/relationships')) return ['CMDB', 'Relationships'];
  if (h.startsWith('#/cmdb')) return ['CMDB'];
  if (h === '#/services') return ['Services'];
  if (h === '#/service-requests') return ['Service requests'];
  if ((m = h.match(/^#\/service-requests\/(\d+)$/))) return ['Service requests', `Request #${m[1]}`];
  if (h === '#/approvals') return ['Approvals'];
  if (h === '#/inventory' || h === '#/inventory/items') return ['Inventory'];
  if ((m = h.match(/^#\/inventory\/items\/(\d+)(?:\/(edit))?$/))) return ['Inventory', `Item #${m[1]}`, m[3] ? 'Edit' : null].filter(Boolean);
  if (h.startsWith('#/inventory/receive')) return ['Inventory', 'Receive stock'];
  if (h.startsWith('#/inventory/reservations')) return ['Inventory', 'Reservations'];
  if (h.startsWith('#/inventory/transactions')) return ['Inventory', 'Transaction history'];
  if (h.startsWith('#/inventory/fulfil')) return ['Inventory', 'Fulfil request'];
  if (h === '#/kb/pending') return ['Knowledge Base', 'Pending review'];
  if (h.startsWith('#/kb/')) return ['Knowledge Base', 'Article'];
  if (h === '#/lifecycle') return ['Lifecycle', 'Dashboard'];
  if (h === '#/lifecycle/onboarding') return ['Lifecycle', 'Onboarding'];
  if (h === '#/lifecycle/offboarding') return ['Lifecycle', 'Offboarding'];
  if (h === '#/lifecycle/transfers') return ['Lifecycle', 'Transfers'];
  if (h === '#/lifecycle/new') return ['Lifecycle', 'New Case'];
  if (h.startsWith('#/lifecycle/') && h.match(/\/(\d+)$/)) return ['Lifecycle', 'Case'];
  if (h === '#/procurement/invoices/new') return ['Procurement', 'Supplier Invoices', 'New Supplier Invoice'];
  if ((m = h.match(/^#\/procurement\/invoices\/(\d+)\/match$/))) return ['Procurement', 'Supplier Invoices', 'Supplier Invoice', 'Matching'];
  if ((m = h.match(/^#\/procurement\/invoices\/(\d+)$/))) return ['Procurement', 'Supplier Invoices', 'Supplier Invoice'];
  if (h === '#/procurement/invoices') return ['Procurement', 'Supplier Invoices'];
  if (h === '#/procurement/exceptions') return ['Procurement', 'Invoice Exceptions'];
  if (h === '#/procurement/returns/new') return ['Procurement', 'Vendor Returns', 'New Vendor Return'];
  if ((m = h.match(/^#\/procurement\/returns\/(\d+)$/))) return ['Procurement', 'Vendor Returns', 'Vendor Return'];
  if (h === '#/procurement/returns') return ['Procurement', 'Vendor Returns'];
  if (h === '#/procurement/credit-notes/new') return ['Procurement', 'Vendor Credit Notes', 'New Vendor Credit Note'];
  if ((m = h.match(/^#\/procurement\/credit-notes\/(\d+)$/))) return ['Procurement', 'Vendor Credit Notes', 'Vendor Credit Note'];
  if (h === '#/procurement/credit-notes') return ['Procurement', 'Vendor Credit Notes'];
  if (h === '#/procurement/financial-dashboard') return ['Procurement', 'Financial Dashboard'];
  if (h === '#/procurement/vendor-performance') return ['Procurement', 'Vendor Performance'];
  if (h === '#/procurement') return ['Procurement', 'Dashboard'];
  if (h.startsWith('#/procurement/requests')) return ['Procurement', 'Purchase Requests'];
  if (h.startsWith('#/procurement/orders')) return ['Procurement', 'Purchase Orders'];
  if (h.startsWith('#/procurement/receipts')) return ['Procurement', 'Goods Receipts'];
  if (h.startsWith('#/procurement/assets')) return ['Procurement', 'Asset registration'];
  if (h.startsWith('#/procurement/reports')) return ['Procurement', 'Reports'];
  // Change Management breadcrumbs
  if (h === '#/changes') return ['Change Management', 'Changes'];
  if (h === '#/changes/new') return ['Change Management', 'New Change'];
  if (h === '#/changes/calendar') return ['Change Management', 'Calendar'];
  if (h === '#/changes/schedule') return ['Change Management', 'Schedule'];
  if (h === '#/changes/dashboard') return ['Change Management', 'Dashboard'];

      tasks: 'Tasks',
      approvals: 'Approvals',
      conflicts: 'Conflicts',
      implementation: 'Implementation',
      pir: 'Post-Implementation Review',
    };

  }

  if (h === '#/change-templates') return ['Change Management', 'Templates'];
  if (h === '#/maintenance-windows') return ['Change Management', 'Maintenance Windows'];
  if (h === '#/blackout-periods') return ['Change Management', 'Blackout Periods'];
  if (h === '#/scheduling-exceptions') return ['Change Management', 'Scheduling Exceptions'];
  if (h === '#/change-review-meetings') return ['Change Management', 'Review Meetings'];
  if (h === '#/outages') return ['Change Management', 'Outages'];
  return [TITLES[h] ?? 'Tickets'];
}

function AccessDenied() {
  return <div className="access-denied" role="alert">You do not have permission to access this page.</div>;
}

function matchRoute(hash, auth) {
  let route = hash.split('?')[0];
  let m;
  if (route.startsWith('#/monitoring')) {
    if (!auth.canUseMonitoring) return <AccessDenied />;
    if (route === '#/monitoring') return <Monitoring />;
    if (route === '#/monitoring/overview') return <MonitoringOverview />;
    if (route === '#/monitoring/sources') return auth.isAdmin ? <SourceManagement /> : <AccessDenied />;
    if (route === '#/monitoring/alerts') return <AlertList />;
    if ((m = route.match(/^#\/monitoring\/alerts\/(\d+)$/))) return <AlertDetail alertId={m[1]} />;
    if (route === '#/monitoring/policies') return auth.canUseMonitoring ? <PolicyManagement /> : <AccessDenied />;
  }
  if (route === '#/reports/coverage') return <AssetReportsPage />;
  if (route === '#/reports/verification_age') return <VerificationQueuePage />;
  if (route === '#/reports/orphans') return <AssetReportsPage />;
  if (route === '#/reports/ownership_gaps') return <AssetReportsPage />;
  if (route === '#/reports/relationship_coverage') return <AssetReportsPage />;
  if (route === '#/reports/drift') return <DriftFindingsPage />;
  if (route === '#/reports/critical_deps') return <AssetReportsPage />;
  if (route === '#/reports/asset_sync') return <AssetReportsPage />;
  if (route === '#/reports/software_sync') return <AssetReportsPage />;
  if (route === '#/verification') return <VerificationQueuePage />;

  // --- Service detail routes ---


  // --- CMDB dashboard and items ---
  if (route === '#/cmdb') return <CmdbDashboard />;
  if (route === '#/cmdb/items') return <CmdbItemsList />;
  if (route === '#/cmdb/items/new') return <CiForm />;
  if ((m = route.match(/^#\/cmdb\/items\/(\d+)$/))) return <CiDetail id={m[1]} />;
  if ((m = route.match(/^#\/cmdb\/items\/(\d+)\/edit$/))) return <CiForm id={m[1]} />;
  if ((m = route.match(/^#\/cmdb\/items\/(\d+)\/impact$/))) return <ImpactAnalysisPage id={m[1]} />;
  if ((m = route.match(/^#\/cmdb\/items\/(\d+)\/dependencies$/))) return <DependencyMap id={m[1]} />;
  if ((m = route.match(/^#\/cmdb\/items\/(\d+)\/relationships$/))) return <CiRelationshipsPage id={m[1]} />;
  if (route === '#/cmdb/types') return <CiTypesPage />;
  if (route === '#/cmdb/baselines') return <BaselinesPage />;
  if (route === '#/cmdb/drift') return <DriftFindingsPage />;
  if (route === '#/cmdb/verification') return <VerificationQueuePage />;
  if (route === '#/cmdb/reports') return <CmdbReports />;
  if (route === '#/cmdb/services') return <ServiceMappingPage />;
  if (route === '#/cmdb/relationships') return <CmdbItemsList />;

  if (route.startsWith('#/problem-management')) {
    if (!auth.canUseProblemManagement) return <AccessDenied />;
    if (route === '#/problem-management') return <ProblemList />;
    if ((m = route.match(/^#\/problem-management\/(\d+)$/))) return <ProblemDetail problemId={m[1]} />;
  }
  if (route === '#/tickets/bulk-imports') return auth.isStaff ? <TicketBulkImportsPage /> : <AccessDenied />;
  if ((m = route.match(/^#\/tickets\/bulk-imports\/(\d+)$/))) return auth.isStaff ? <TicketBulkImportDetailPage id={m[1]} /> : <AccessDenied />;
  if ((m = route.match(/^#\/tickets\/(\d+)\/edit$/))) return <TicketForm id={m[1]} />;
  if (route === '#/tickets/new') return <TicketForm />;
  if ((m = route.match(/^#\/tickets\/(\d+)$/))) return <TicketDetail id={m[1]} />;
  if ((m = route.match(/^#\/tickets\/(\d+)\/timeline$/))) return <TicketTimeline id={m[1]} />;
  if (route === '#/tickets/queues') return <TicketQueuesPage />;
  if (route === '#/tickets/operations') return <TicketOperationsDashboard />;
  if (route === '#/tickets/canned-responses') return <CannedResponsesPage />;
  if (route === '#/tickets/templates') return <TicketTemplatesPage />;
  if (route === '#/tickets/saved-views') return <SavedTicketViews />;
  if (route === '#/tickets/satisfaction') return <TicketSatisfactionSurvey />;
  if ((m = route.match(/^#\/tickets\/(\d+)\/merge$/))) return <TicketMergeDialog id={m[1]} />;
  if ((m = route.match(/^#\/assets\/(\d+)\/edit$/))) return <AssetForm id={m[1]} />;
  if (route === '#/assets/new') return <AssetForm />;
  if ((m = route.match(/^#\/assets\/(\d+)$/))) return <AssetDetail id={m[1]} />;
  if ((m = route.match(/^#\/vendors\/(\d+)\/edit$/))) return <VendorForm vendorId={m[1]} />;
  if (route === '#/vendors/new') return <VendorForm />;
  if ((m = route.match(/^#\/vendors\/(\d+)$/))) return <VendorDetail id={m[1]} />;
  if ((m = route.match(/^#\/users\/(\d+)\/?$/))) return <EmployeeDetail id={m[1]} />;
  if (route === '#/kb') return <KnowledgeBase />;
  const changeManagementRoutes = [
    '#/change-templates',
    '#/maintenance-windows',
    '#/blackout-periods',
    '#/scheduling-exceptions',
    '#/change-review-meetings',
    '#/outages',
  ];
  if (
    route === '#/changes' ||
    route.startsWith('#/changes/') ||
    changeManagementRoutes.includes(route)
  ) return <ChangesPage />;
  if (route === '#/kb/pending') return <KnowledgeBaseReviewQueue />;
  if ((m = route.match(/^#\/kb\/(\d+)\/revisions\/(\d+)$/))) return <KnowledgeBaseRevisionDetail id={m[1]} number={m[2]} />;
  if ((m = route.match(/^#\/kb\/(\d+)\/revisions$/))) return <KnowledgeBaseRevisions id={m[1]} />;

  if (route === '#/workflow/rules') return <Workflow tab="rules" />;
  if (route === '#/workflow/approvals') return <Workflow tab="approvals" />;
  if (route === '#/workflow/executions') return <Workflow tab="executions" />;
  if (route === '#/privacy' || route.startsWith('#/privacy/')) return <Privacy />;

  if ((m = route.match(/^#\/service-requests\/(\d+)$/))) return <ServiceRequestDetail id={m[1]} />;
  if ((m = route.match(/^#\/inventory\/items\/(\d+)\/edit$/))) return <StockItemForm id={m[1]} />;

  if (route === '#/lifecycle/transfers') return <LifecycleCases caseType="transfer" />;

  if (route === '#/procurement' || route.startsWith('#/procurement/')) {
    return <ProcurementRouter route={hash} />;
  }
  if (route === '#/software' || route.startsWith('#/software/') || route === '#/licenses' || route.startsWith('#/licenses/') || route === '#/license-allocations' || route.startsWith('#/license-allocations/') || route === '#/license-installations' || route.startsWith('#/license-installations/') || route === '#/license-renewals' || route.startsWith('#/license-renewals/') || route === '#/license-compliance' || route.startsWith('#/license-compliance/') || route === '#/license-calendar' || route === '#/license-utilization' || route === '#/my-software') {

  }
  const routes = {

function isActive(hash, h) {
  return h === hash || (h !== '#/tickets' && hash.startsWith(h + '/'));
}

function Shell() {
  const { access, logout, user, profileLoading, isAdmin, isStaff, canManageScheduledReports, canViewVendors, canViewProcurement, canViewProcurementReports, canAccessRecycleBin } = useAuth();
  const canUseMonitoring = !!isStaff && user?.is_active !== false;
  const canUseProblemManagement = !!isStaff && user?.is_active !== false;
  const caps = useMemo(() => ({
    isStaff, isAdmin, canManageScheduledReports, canViewVendors,
    canViewProcurement, canViewProcurementReports, canUseMonitoring,
    canUseProblemManagement, canAccessRecycleBin,
  }), [isStaff, isAdmin, canManageScheduledReports, canViewVendors,
    canViewProcurement, canViewProcurementReports, canUseMonitoring,
    canUseProblemManagement, canAccessRecycleBin]);
  const routerLocation = useLocation();
  const hash = '#' + routerLocation.pathname + routerLocation.search;
  const nav = useMemo(() => visibleNav(NAV, caps), [caps]);
  const [navOpen, setNavOpen] = useState(false);
  // Collapsible sections are collapsed by default. Only sections the user has
  // explicitly expanded are tracked here, so late-loading navigation data
  // cannot accidentally leave sections open.
  const [expandedSections, setExpandedSections] = useState(() => new Set());

  // Toggle a module section open/closed. Clicking one section never affects others.
  const toggleSection = (sectionName) => {
    setExpandedSections((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(sectionName)) next.delete(sectionName);
      else next.add(sectionName);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const isSectionCollapsed = (sectionName) => !expandedSections.has(sectionName);
  if (!access) {
    if (hash.startsWith('#/verify-email')) return <VerifyEmail />;
    if (hash.startsWith('#/reset-password')) return <ResetPassword />;
    return <Login />;
  }
  if (profileLoading) {
    return (
      <p className="page-loading" role="status">
        <span className="spinner" aria-hidden="true" />Loading your workspace{'\u2026'}
      </p>
    );
  }
  const el = matchRoute(hash, { isStaff, isAdmin, canUseMonitoring, canUseProblemManagement });
  const active = (h) => isActive(hash, h) ? 'active' : '';
  return (
    <div className="shell">
      <a className="skip-link" href="#main-content">Skip to main content</a>
      <aside className={`sidebar${navOpen ? ' nav-open' : ''}`}>
        <a className="brand" href="#/tickets">
          <span className="brand-mark">IT</span>
          <span className="brand-name">Service Desk<small>Ticket &amp; Asset</small></span>
        </a>
        <nav className="sidenav" aria-label="Primary">
          {nav.map((n, i) => n.section
            ? (
              <React.Fragment key={i}>
                <button
                  className="sidenav-section-header"
                  type="button"
                  aria-expanded={!isSectionCollapsed(n.section)}
                  aria-controls={`sidenav-section-content-${i}`}
                  onClick={() => toggleSection(n.section)}
                >
                  <span className="sidenav-section-title">{n.section}</span>
                  <span
                    className="sidenav-section-chevron"
                    aria-hidden="true"
                  >
                    {isSectionCollapsed(n.section) ? '\u25B6' : '\u25BC'}
                  </span>
                </button>
                <div
                  id={`sidenav-section-content-${i}`}
                  className={`sidenav-section-content${
                    isSectionCollapsed(n.section) ? ' collapsed' : ''
                  }`}
                >
                  {(() => {
                    const items = [];
                    let j = i + 1;
                    while (j < nav.length && !nav[j].section) {
                      items.push(nav[j]);
                      j += 1;
                    }
                    return items.map((item) => (
                      <a
                        key={item.hash}
                        href={item.hash}
                        className={active(item.hash)}
                        aria-current={isActive(hash, item.hash) ? 'page' : undefined}
                        onClick={() => setNavOpen(false)}
                      >
                        <span className="nav-label">{item.label}</span>
                        {item.badge && <NotifBadge />}
                      </a>
                    ));
                  })()}
                </div>
              </React.Fragment>
            )
            : null
          )}
        </nav>
        <div className="sidebar-foot">
          <span className="user-chip">
            {user ? <a href="#/profile">{user.employee_id}</a> : ''}
            <small>{user ? user.role.replace('_', ' ') : ''}</small>
          </span>
          <button className="btn-ghost btn-block" onClick={logout}>Log out</button>
        </div>
      </aside>
      <div className={`sidebar-scrim${navOpen ? ' nav-open' : ''}`} onClick={() => setNavOpen(false)} aria-hidden="true" />
      <div className="main-col">
        <div className="topbar">
          <button type="button" className="nav-toggle" onClick={() => setNavOpen((v) => !v)} aria-label={navOpen ? 'Close navigation' : 'Open navigation'} aria-expanded={navOpen}>{'\u2630'}</button>
          <nav className="crumbs" aria-label="Breadcrumb">
            {crumbs(hash).map((c, i, arr) => (
              <span key={i}>
                {i > 0 && <span className="crumb-sep" aria-hidden="true">/</span>}
                <span className={i === arr.length - 1 ? 'crumb-current' : undefined}>{c}</span>
              </span>
            ))}
          </nav>
        </div>
        <main className="content" id="main-content">
          <ErrorBoundary
            fallback={
              <div className="panel panel-pad" role="alert">
                <h2>Something went wrong</h2>
                <p>This page encountered an error and could not render.</p>
              </div>
            }
          >
            <Suspense fallback={<p className="page-loading" role="status"><span className="spinner" aria-hidden="true" />Loading page{'\u2026'}</p>}>
              {el}
            </Suspense>
          </ErrorBoundary>
        </main>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function App() {
  const { push } = useToast();
  // Surface unhandled API errors (4xx/5xx that reach the interceptor catch) as toasts.
  React.useEffect(() => {
    import('./api').then(({ setApiErrorHandler }) => {
      setApiErrorHandler((err, status) => {
        const msg = err?.message || 'Request failed';
        push(`${status ? `${status} - ` : ''}${msg}`, 'error');
      });
    });
    // Give ErrorBoundary access to the toast push function.
    import('./ErrorBoundary').then(({ setToastContext }) => {
      setToastContext({ push });
    });
  }, [push]);

  return (
    <HashRouter>
      <AuthProvider>
        <ToastProvider>
          <DirtyProvider>
            <Shell />
            <ToastList />
            <DirtyBlocker />
          </DirtyProvider>
        </ToastProvider>
      </AuthProvider>
    </HashRouter>
  );
}


===== src\auth.jsx =====

import { createContext, useContext, useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import api from './api';

const AuthCtx = createContext(null);
export const useAuth = () => useContext(AuthCtx); // eslint-disable-line react/only-export-components

const STAFF_ROLES = ['system_admin', 'it_manager', 'it_support'];

// SECURITY NOTE (frontend token storage).
// Access tokens are kept in React state + localStorage (for page-reload boot);
// refresh tokens are stored in localStorage by default (body-based refresh).
// When the backend is configured with JWT_REFRESH_COOKIE_ENABLED=true, the
// refresh endpoint returns the refresh token as an httpOnly/secure/sameSite
// cookie and omits it from the JSON body, and the api layer switches to
// cookie-based refresh (no localStorage refresh token, no body refresh).
// Either way, the access token is still readable by script, so same-origin
// XSS can still exfiltrate it; short lifetimes (1h) + blacklist-on-logout +
// rate-limited auth + Secure cookies + a strict CSP are the mitigation.
// See backend/docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md (Authentication / authorization).
//
// Upper bound on the best-effort backend blacklist call. The request has no
// axios timeout, so without this a hung connection would keep the refresh
// token in localStorage and block logout indefinitely.
const LOGOUT_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000;

function withTimeout(promise, ms) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Logout request timed out.')), ms);
    promise.then(
      (value) => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        resolve(value);
      },
      (error) => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        reject(error);
      },
    );
  });
}

export function AuthProvider({ children }) {
  const [access, setAccess] = useState(localStorage.getItem('access'));
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [profileLoading, setProfileLoading] = useState(!!localStorage.getItem('access'));

  // Bumped on every session change (login/logout). Async work that started
  // for an older session must not write state into the newer one.
  const sessionGen = useRef(0);
  // Whether this tab currently believes it has a session. localStorage is
  // shared by all tabs of this origin, so by the time a "storage" event fires
  // the token is already gone and cannot be used to detect that here.
  const sessionActive = useRef(!!localStorage.getItem('access'));

  const fetchProfile = async () => {
    const generation = sessionGen.current;
    try {
      const res = await api.get('/accounts/me/');
      if (sessionGen.current !== generation) return;
      setUser(res.data);
    } catch {
      if (sessionGen.current !== generation) return;
      localStorage.removeItem('access');
      localStorage.removeItem('refresh');
      sessionActive.current = false;
      setAccess(null);
      setUser(null);
    } finally {
      if (sessionGen.current === generation) setProfileLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const logout = useCallback(async () => {
    // Invalidate in-flight profile/auth work and drop the React session now:
    // the UI must not stay authenticated while the network call runs.
    sessionGen.current += 1;
    sessionActive.current = false;
    setAccess(null);
    setUser(null);
    setProfileLoading(false);
    // Body-based path: send the localStorage refresh so the backend can
    // blacklist it and (in cookie mode) clear the refresh cookie.
    const refresh = localStorage.getItem('refresh');
    if (refresh) {
      try {
        await withTimeout(api.post('/accounts/logout/', { refresh }), LOGOUT_TIMEOUT_MS);
      } catch {
        // Backend unreachable, timed out or token already invalid: still log
        // out locally so the user cannot keep using a stale session.
      }
    }
    // Clear local artifacts. Do not clobber tokens belonging to a session
    // created while this call was in flight (logout -> login before the
    // request settled).
    if (localStorage.getItem('refresh') === refresh) {
      localStorage.removeItem('access');
      localStorage.removeItem('refresh');
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (access) fetchProfile();
    else setProfileLoading(false);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Session recovery: the API layer dispatches this when a refresh
    // fails; follow the same path as an explicit logout.
    const onExpired = () => logout();
    window.addEventListener('auth-expired', onExpired);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('auth-expired', onExpired);
  }, [logout]);

  // Cross-tab session sync: if another tab logs out (clears the access token
  // in localStorage), mirror that logout here so this tab's React state does
  // not stay authenticated. localStorage is shared, so the token is already
  // gone by the time the event fires; `sessionActive` records whether this
  // tab was still using it.
  useEffect(() => {
    // Cross-tab session sync: localStorage is shared across tabs, so when
    // another tab logs out (clears the access token) or logs in as a different
    // user (replaces the access token), mirror that here. This tab's React
    // state must never stay authenticated with a token that no longer belongs
    // to this session.
    const onStorage = (e) => {
      if (e.key !== 'access' || !sessionActive.current) return;
      const next = e.newValue;
      if (next === null) {
        // Another tab logged out. Mirror locally (best-effort backend
        // blacklist already attempted by the other tab).
        logout(); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
      } else if (next !== access) {
        // Another tab logged in as a different user. Invalidate this session
        // without hitting the backend (the other tab owns its own session).
        sessionGen.current += 1;
        sessionActive.current = false;
        setAccess(null);
        setUser(null);
        setProfileLoading(false);
        localStorage.removeItem('refresh');
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('storage', onStorage);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('storage', onStorage);
  }, [logout, access]);

  const login = async (email, password) => {
    // Backend USERNAME_FIELD is 'email', so SimpleJWT's token endpoint
    // requires {email, password} (not {username, password}).
    const res = await api.post('/token/', { email, password });
    sessionGen.current += 1;
    sessionActive.current = true;
    // Access token: keep in memory + localStorage (so a page reload boots
    // authenticated without needing a refresh round-trip).
    localStorage.setItem('access', res.data.access);
    setAccess(res.data.access);
    // Refresh token: store in localStorage only when the backend returned it
    // in the body. When JWT_REFRESH_COOKIE_ENABLED is on, the refresh token
    // is served as an httpOnly cookie and omitted from the body, so we must
    // not store it here (the api layer will refresh from the cookie instead).
    if (res.data.refresh !== undefined) {
      localStorage.setItem('refresh', res.data.refresh);
    } else {
      localStorage.removeItem('refresh');
    }
    setProfileLoading(true);
    await fetchProfile();
  };
  const role = user?.role;
  const isSuperuser = !!user?.is_superuser;
  const isSystemAdmin = role === 'system_admin' || isSuperuser;
  const isITManager = role === 'it_manager';
  const isITSupport = role === 'it_support';
  const isEmployee = role === 'employee';
  const isStaff = !!user && (STAFF_ROLES.includes(role) || isSuperuser);
  const isAdmin = isSystemAdmin;
  // NOTE: IT Manager and IT Support currently share the same capability
  // surface in most areas (the backend IsITStaff permission treats them
  // identically). The it_support role exists for future segregation but is not
  // yet assigned distinct capabilities. Until that changes, IT Manager-only
  // gates below intentionally include IT Support as well â€” splitting them is a
  // backend permission + frontend-capability change, not a one-line rename.
  const isManagerOrAdmin = isSystemAdmin || isITManager;
  const isSupportOrAbove = isSystemAdmin || isITManager || isITSupport;
  const canCreateTickets =
    !!user && (isStaff || role === 'system_admin' || !!user.can_create_tickets || isSuperuser);
  const canManageUsers = isSystemAdmin;
  const canManageVendors = isSystemAdmin || isITManager;
  const canViewVendors = isSupportOrAbove;
  const canManageServiceCatalogue = isSystemAdmin || isITManager;
  const canApproveServiceRequests = isSystemAdmin || isITManager;
  const canConfigureWorkflow = isSystemAdmin || isITManager;
  const canApproveDisposals = isSystemAdmin || isITManager;
  const canManageInventory = isSystemAdmin || isITManager;
  const canAdjustInventory = isSystemAdmin || isITManager;
  const canPublishKnowledgeBase = isSystemAdmin || isITManager;
  const canManageScheduledReports = isSystemAdmin || isITManager;
  const canAccessAudit = isSystemAdmin;
  const canAccessRecycleBin = isSystemAdmin;
  const canPerformPermanentDeletion = isSystemAdmin;
  const canViewLifecycle = isAdmin || isManagerOrAdmin || isStaff || isEmployee;
  const canCreateLifecycleCase = isStaff;
  const canManageLifecycleCase = isManagerOrAdmin;
  const canManageLifecycleTemplates = isManagerOrAdmin;
  const canManageLifecycleTasks = isStaff;
  const canCompleteLifecycleCase = isManagerOrAdmin;
  const canViewLifecycleDashboard = isAdmin || isManagerOrAdmin || isStaff || isEmployee;
  const canViewProcurement = isStaff;
  const canCreatePurchaseRequest = isStaff;
  const canApprovePurchaseRequest = isManagerOrAdmin;
  const canManageQuotations = isStaff;
  const canSelectProcurementVendor = isManagerOrAdmin;
  const canCreatePurchaseOrder = isManagerOrAdmin;
  const canApprovePurchaseOrder = isManagerOrAdmin;
  const canIssuePurchaseOrder = isManagerOrAdmin;
  const canCreateGoodsReceipt = isStaff;
  const canPostGoodsReceipt = isStaff;
  const canRegisterProcurementAssets = isStaff;
  const canViewProcurementReports = isManagerOrAdmin;
  const canViewLicensing = isStaff || isEmployee; // My Software for employees
  const canManageSoftwareProducts = isManagerOrAdmin;
  const canManageLicenseAgreements = isManagerOrAdmin;
  const canViewLicenseCosts = isManagerOrAdmin;
  const canManageLicenseAllocations = isStaff;
  const canManageLicenseInstallations = isStaff;
  const canManageLicenseRenewals = isStaff;
  const canApproveLicenseRenewals = isManagerOrAdmin;
  const canViewLicenseSecrets = isSupportOrAbove;
  const canRevealLicenseSecrets = isSystemAdmin;
  const canManageLicenseDocuments = isStaff;
  const canManageLicenseCompliance = isManagerOrAdmin;
  const canViewLicenseReports = isManagerOrAdmin;
  const canViewMySoftware = isEmployee || isStaff;
  return (
    <AuthCtx.Provider value={{ access, user, profileLoading, login, logout, isStaff, isAdmin, canCreateTickets, refreshProfile: fetchProfile, role, isSuperuser, isSystemAdmin, isITManager, isITSupport, isEmployee, isManagerOrAdmin, isSupportOrAbove, canManageUsers, canManageVendors, canViewVendors, canManageServiceCatalogue, canApproveServiceRequests, canConfigureWorkflow, canApproveDisposals, canManageInventory, canAdjustInventory, canPublishKnowledgeBase, canManageScheduledReports, canAccessAudit, canAccessRecycleBin, canPerformPermanentDeletion, canViewLifecycle, canCreateLifecycleCase, canManageLifecycleCase, canManageLifecycleTemplates, canManageLifecycleTasks, canCompleteLifecycleCase, canViewLifecycleDashboard, canViewProcurement, canCreatePurchaseRequest, canApprovePurchaseRequest, canManageQuotations, canSelectProcurementVendor, canCreatePurchaseOrder, canApprovePurchaseOrder, canIssuePurchaseOrder, canCreateGoodsReceipt, canPostGoodsReceipt, canRegisterProcurementAssets, canViewProcurementReports, canViewLicensing, canManageSoftwareProducts, canManageLicenseAgreements, canViewLicenseCosts, canManageLicenseAllocations, canManageLicenseInstallations, canManageLicenseRenewals, canApproveLicenseRenewals, canViewLicenseSecrets, canRevealLicenseSecrets, canManageLicenseDocuments, canManageLicenseCompliance, canViewLicenseReports, canViewMySoftware }}>
      {children}
    </AuthCtx.Provider>
  );
}

const STATUS_TONE = {
  open: 'blue', in_progress: 'amber', resolved: 'green', closed: 'gray',
  reopened: 'purple', archived: 'gray',
  available: 'green', assigned: 'blue', in_repair: 'amber', retired: 'gray',
  lost: 'red', overdue: 'red', active: 'green', inactive: 'gray',
  disposed: 'purple', scheduled: 'blue', completed: 'green', cancelled: 'gray',

const STATUS_LABELS = {
  open: 'Open', in_progress: 'In progress', resolved: 'Resolved', closed: 'Closed',
  reopened: 'Reopened', archived: 'Archived', available: 'Available', assigned: 'Assigned',
  in_repair: 'In repair', retired: 'Retired', lost: 'Lost', active: 'Active', inactive: 'Inactive',
  disposed: 'Disposed', scheduled: 'Scheduled', completed: 'Completed', cancelled: 'Cancelled',
  pending: 'Pending approval', approved: 'Approved', rejected: 'Rejected',
  pending_review: 'Pending review',
  low_stock: 'Low stock', out_of_stock: 'Out of stock', in_stock: 'In stock',
};
const PRIORITY_LABELS = { low: 'Low', medium: 'Medium', high: 'High', critical: 'Critical' };

/** Human-readable label for status/priority values (kind: 'status' | 'priority'). */
function prettyValue(kind, value) {
  const key = String(value ?? '');
  const map = kind === 'priority' ? PRIORITY_LABELS : STATUS_LABELS;
  const hit = map[key];
  if (hit) return hit;
  return key.replace(/_/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase());
}

/** Small status/priority indicator. kind: 'status' | 'priority'. */
export function Badge({ kind, value, label }) {
  const tone = kind === 'priority'
    ? (PRIORITY_TONE[value] ?? 'gray')
    : (STATUS_TONE[value] ?? 'gray');
  const text = label ?? prettyValue(kind, value);
  return <span className={`badge badge-${tone}`}>{text}</span>;
}

/**
 * Secure inline photo thumbnail.
 *
 * Fetches the image as a blob through the permission-checked download
 * endpoint (never a public storage URL), shows it as a small inline image,
 * and falls back to a placeholder on missing/failed images. Clicking opens
 * the larger preview via `onPreview(id)`.
 *
 * Props:
 *   id        - record/attachment id used to build the download url
 *   getUrl    - (id) => download endpoint url string
 *   onPreview - (id) => called to open the larger secure preview
 *   label     - accessible label
 */
export function PhotoThumbnail({ id, getUrl, onPreview, label }) {
  const [src, setSrc] = useState(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(!!id);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id) { setBusy(false); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
      return; }
    let cancelled = false;
    setBusy(true);
    api.get(getUrl(id), { responseType: 'blob' })
      .then((r) => {
        if (!cancelled) {
          // Replacement is handled by the cleanup effect below: it runs when
          // `src` changes (revoking the superseded URL exactly once) and on
          // unmount (revoking the last one). Revoking here as well would
          // revoke every superseded URL twice.
          setSrc(URL.createObjectURL(r.data));
          setError(false);
        }
      })
      .catch(() => { if (!cancelled) setError(true); })
      .finally(() => { if (!cancelled) setBusy(false); });
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [id, getUrl]);

  useEffect(() => () => { if (src) { try { URL.revokeObjectURL(src); } catch { /* ignore */ } } }, [src]);

  const open = () => { if (onPreview) onPreview(id); };
  const content = busy ? (
    <span className="spinner" aria-hidden="true" />
  ) : error ? (
    <span className="photo-placeholder" aria-hidden="true">ðŸ™</span>
  ) : (
    <img src={src} alt="" className="photo-thumb" />
  );
  return (
    <button type="button" className="photo-cell" onClick={open}
      onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); open(); } }}
      aria-label={label || 'Photo'}
      title={label || 'Photo'}
      disabled={error && !src}>
      {content}
    </button>
  );
}

/**
 * Compact data table. columns: [{key, label, render?(row), thClass?}].
 * Selectable via selectKey + selected Set + onToggle(id).
 */
/** Sort state for server-side sorted tables. Cycles asc â†’ desc â†’ none.
 * Returns [sort, changeSort, orderingParam]. changeSort(field) updates
 * state and returns the next value synchronously for immediate loads;
 * orderingParam() yields the `ordering` query value ("" when unset). */
export function useSort() { // eslint-disable-line react/only-export-components
  const [sort, setSort] = useState(null);
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const changeSort = (field) => {
    const cur = ref.current;
    const next = !cur || cur.field !== field ? { field, dir: 'asc' }
      : cur.dir === 'asc' ? { field, dir: 'desc' } : null;
    ref.current = next;
    setSort(next);
    return next;
  };
  const orderingParam = (s) => {
    const v = s === undefined ? ref.current : s;
    return !v ? '' : (v.dir === 'desc' ? `-${v.field}` : v.field);
  };
  return [sort, changeSort, orderingParam];
}

/* Per-table UI preferences (non-sensitive): visible column keys and the
 * table show/hide toggle. Stored in localStorage under
 * `${TABLE_PREFS_PREFIX}<tableKey>` â€” one entry per table so resetting
 * one table never touches another. Payload shape (v1):
 *   { v: 1, columns: [...visible keys], known: [...all keys at save time],
 *     table: true|false }
 * `known` lets later app updates add columns with their current default
 * visibility (a column the saved file never saw is neither "hidden by the
 * user" nor forced into an old layout). Stored titles are pure UI
 * metadata â€” no credentials, personal data, or record content.
 */
const TABLE_PREFS_PREFIX = 'itdesk.tableprefs.';

function defaultColumnSet(allKeys, defaultKeys) {
  return new Set(defaultKeys || allKeys);
}

function loadTablePrefs(tableKey, allKeys, defaultKeys) {
  const defaults = defaultColumnSet(allKeys, defaultKeys);
  const fallback = { visible: defaults, tableVisible: true };
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.localStorage) return fallback;
  let raw;
  try {
    raw = window.localStorage.getItem(TABLE_PREFS_PREFIX + tableKey);
  } catch {
    return fallback; // storage unavailable (private mode, security policy)
  }
  if (!raw) return fallback;
  let saved;
  try {
    saved = JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch {
    return fallback; // malformed JSON â†’ defaults, page still renders
  }
  if (!saved || typeof saved !== 'object' || Array.isArray(saved)
      || saved.v !== 1
      || !Array.isArray(saved.columns)
      || !Array.isArray(saved.known)) {
    return fallback; // missing/invalid/outdated schema â†’ defaults
  }
  const known = new Set(saved.known.filter((k) => typeof k === 'string'));
  const storedVisible = saved.columns.filter((k) => typeof k === 'string');
  // Saved selection is authoritative for keys that existed at save time;
  // unknown stale keys are dropped. New columns (never seen by this
  // preference file) follow their current default visibility.
  const visible = new Set(storedVisible.filter((k) => allKeys.includes(k)));
  for (const k of allKeys) {
    if (!known.has(k) && defaults.has(k)) visible.add(k);
  }
  if (!visible.size) return fallback; // all-false payloads recover safely
  return {
    visible,
    tableVisible: typeof saved.table === 'boolean' ? saved.table : true,
  };
}

function saveTablePrefs(tableKey, visible, known, tableVisible) {
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(
      TABLE_PREFS_PREFIX + tableKey,
      JSON.stringify({ v: 1, columns: [...visible], known: [...known], table: tableVisible }),
    );
  } catch {
    // Quota/blocked storage: preferences simply stay in-memory for the
    // session â€” never worth crashing a page over a layout preference.
  }
}

/** `known` records every column key the preference file has seen, so a
 * later app update can tell "the user hid this column" apart from
 * "this column did not exist when the preference was saved" and give
 * never-seen columns their current default visibility. */
export function useTableColumns(tableKey, allKeys, defaultKeys) { // eslint-disable-line react/only-export-components
  // Synchronous load on first render: no frame ever shows an
  // incorrect default column while saved preferences load.
  const [state, setState] = useState(() => loadTablePrefs(tableKey, allKeys, defaultKeys));
  const persist = (next) => {
    setState(next);
    saveTablePrefs(tableKey, next.visible, allKeys, next.tableVisible);
  };
  const toggleColumn = (key) => {
    const next = new Set(state.visible);
    if (next.has(key)) {
      if (next.size > 1) next.delete(key);
    } else {
      next.add(key);
    }
    persist({ ...state, visible: next });
  };
  const resetColumns = () => {
    persist({ ...state, visible: defaultColumnSet(allKeys, defaultKeys) });
  };
  const toggleTable = () => {
    persist({ ...state, tableVisible: !state.tableVisible });
  };
  return {
    visibleColumns: state.visible,
    toggleColumn,
    resetColumns,
    tableVisible: state.tableVisible,
    toggleTable,
  };
}

export function TableControls({ tableVisible, onToggleTable, columns, visible, onToggleColumn, onReset }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div className="panel-title">
      <h4 className="panel-title-text">{columns[0]?.label ?? 'Table'}</h4>
      <div className="panel-actions">
        {open && (
          <div className="column-chooser">
            {columns.map((c) => (
              <label key={c.key} className="check-row">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={visible.has(c.key)}
                  disabled={visible.size <= 1 && visible.has(c.key)}
                  onChange={() => onToggleColumn(c.key)}
                  aria-label={`Show ${c.label} column`}
                />
                {c.label}
              </label>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
        <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={onToggleTable}>
          {tableVisible ? 'Hide table' : 'Show table'}
        </button>
        <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)} aria-expanded={open}>
          Columns
        </button>
        <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={onReset}>
          Reset columns
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function DataTable({ columns, rows, keyOf, selected, onToggle, emptyTitle, emptyHint, sort, onSort }) {
  if (!rows.length) return <EmptyState title={emptyTitle ?? 'Nothing here yet.'} hint={emptyHint} />;
  const selectable = typeof onToggle === 'function';
  const sortable = typeof onSort === 'function';
  const arrow = (field) => {
    if (!sort || sort.field !== field) return '';
    return sort.dir === 'desc' ? ' â–¼' : ' â–²';
  };
  return (
    <div className="table-wrap">
      <table className="grid">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            {selectable && <th className="th-select"><span className="visually-hidden">Select rows</span><span className="muted small" aria-hidden="true">âœ“</span></th>}
            {columns.map((c) => (
              <th
                key={c.key}
                className={c.thClass}
                aria-sort={sort && sort.field === c.sortable ? (sort.dir === 'desc' ? 'descending' : 'ascending') : undefined}
              >
                {sortable && c.sortable ? (
                  <button
                    type="button" className="th-sort"
                    onClick={() => onSort(c.sortable)}
                    aria-label={`Sort by ${c.label}`}
                  >
                    {c.label}{arrow(c.sortable)}
                  </button>
                ) : c.label}
              </th>
            ))}
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {rows.map((r) => {
            const k = keyOf(r);
            const isSel = selected?.has(k);
            return (
              <tr key={k} className={isSel ? 'selected' : ''}>
                {selectable && (
                  <td className="select-cell">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox" checked={!!isSel} onChange={() => onToggle(k)}
                      aria-label={`Select row ${k}`}
                    />
                  </td>
                )}
                {columns.map((c) => (
                  <td key={c.key}>{c.render ? c.render(r) : String(r[c.key] ?? 'â€”')}</td>
                ))}
              </tr>
            );
          })}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

export function Pager({ count, hasNext, hasPrev, onPrev, onNext, busy, pageLabel }) {
  if (count == null && !hasNext && !hasPrev && !pageLabel) return null;
  return (
    <div className="pager">
      <span>{count != null ? <><span className="page-count">{count}</span> {count === 1 ? 'item' : 'items'}</> : ''}</span>
      {pageLabel ? <span className="muted">{pageLabel}</span> : null}
      <span className="spacer" />
      <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={onPrev} disabled={!hasPrev || busy}>&larr; Prev</button>
      <button type="button" className="btn-small" onClick={onNext} disabled={!hasNext || busy}>Next &rarr;</button>
    </div>
  );
}

export function Field({ label, error, hint, required, children }) {
  const control = error && children && typeof children === 'object' && 'props' in children
    ? { ...children, props: { ...children.props, 'aria-invalid': 'true' } }
    : children;
  return (
    <div className="form-field">
      <label className="form-label">
        <span>
          {label}
          {required && <span className="required" aria-hidden="true"> *</span>}
        </span>
        {control}
      </label>
      {error ? <div className="field-error" role="alert">{error}</div> : null}
      {!error && hint ? <div className="field-hint">{hint}</div> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

export function ErrorSummary({ parsed }) {
  if (!parsed?.global) return null;
  return <div className="error-summary" role="alert">{parsed.global}</div>;
}

export function Modal({ title, onClose, children, size }) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose(); };
    addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [onClose]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const first = document.querySelector('.modal .input, .modal button');
    if (first) first.focus();
  }, []);
  return (
    <div className="modal-overlay" onMouseDown={(e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose(); }}>
      <div className={`modal${size ? ` modal-${size}` : ''}`} role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={title}>
        <div className="modal-head">
          <h3>{title}</h3>
          <button type="button" className="btn-close" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close">âœ•</button>
        </div>
        <div className="modal-body">{children}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Reusable confirmation dialog. Message must describe the actual operation. */
export function Button({ kind = 'primary', size = 'medium', children, className = '', disabled = false, onClick, type = 'button' }) {
  const base = 'btn';
  const kindClass = {
    primary: 'btn-primary',
    danger: 'btn-danger',
    ghost: 'btn-ghost',
    small: 'btn-small',
  }[kind] || 'btn-primary';
  const sizeClass = {
    small: 'btn-small',
    medium: '',
  }[size] || ''; return (
    <button type={type} className={`${base} ${kindClass} ${sizeClass} ${className}`} disabled={disabled} onClick={onClick}>
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}
export function ConfirmDialog({ title, message, children, confirmLabel = 'Confirm', danger = false, busy = false, onConfirm, onCancel }) {
  return (
    <Modal title={title} onClose={onCancel}>
      <p style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>{message}</p>
      {children}
      <div className="row-end">
        <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={onCancel} disabled={busy}>Cancel</button>
        <button
          type="button"
          className={danger ? 'btn-danger' : 'btn-primary'}
          onClick={onConfirm}
          disabled={busy}
        >
          {busy ? 'Workingâ€¦' : confirmLabel}
        </button>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
}

/**
 * Reusable export dialog connecting to the backend multi-format export API.
 * Supports CSV / XLSX / PDF / DOCX and scopes: all / selected / filtered.
 * The backend streams the file; we download it via a blob with a proper
 * filename taken from the Content-Disposition header.
 */
export function ExportDialog({
  dataset,
  open,
  onClose,
  selectedIds = [],
  filterParams = {},
}) {
  const [format, setFormat] = useState('csv');
  const [scope, setScope] = useState('all');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');

  const doExport = async (ev) => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError('');
    setMsg('');
    try {
      const p = new URLSearchParams();
      p.set('format', format);
      p.set('scope', scope);
      if (scope === 'selected' && selectedIds.length) {
        p.set('ids', selectedIds.join(','));
      }
      if (scope === 'filtered') {
        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(filterParams)) {
          if (v !== '' && v != null) p.set(k, v);
        }
      }
      const r = await api.get(
        `/common/exports/${dataset}/?${p.toString()}`,
        {
          responseType: 'blob',
          headers: { Accept: 'application/octet-stream, */*' },
        },
      );
      const cd = r.headers?.['content-disposition'] || '';
      const m = cd.match(/filename="([^"]+)"/);
      const filename = (m && m[1]) || `${dataset}_export.${format}`;
      downloadBlob(r.data, filename);
      setMsg(`Downloaded ${filename}.`);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(await blobErrorMessage(e, 'Export failed.'));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  if (!open) return null;
  const canSelected = selectedIds.length > 0;
  return (
    <Modal title={`Export ${dataset}`} onClose={onClose} size="lg">
      <form onSubmit={doExport} noValidate>
        <Field label="Format">
          <select
            className="input"
            value={format}
            onChange={(e) => setFormat(e.target.value)}
            disabled={busy}
          >
            <option value="csv">CSV</option>
            <option value="xlsx">Excel (XLSX)</option>
            <option value="pdf">PDF</option>
            <option value="docx">Word (DOCX)</option>
          </select>
        </Field>
        <Field label="Scope">
          <select
            className="input"
            value={scope}
            onChange={(e) => setScope(e.target.value)}
            disabled={busy}
          >
            <option value="all">All permitted records</option>
            {canSelected ? (
              <option value="selected">
                Selected records ({selectedIds.length})
              </option>
            ) : null}
            <option value="filtered">Filtered records</option>
          </select>
          {scope === 'selected' && !canSelected && (
            <div className="field-error" role="alert">
              No records selected.
            </div>
          )}
        </Field>
        {error && <div className="field-error" role="alert">{error}</div>}
        {msg && <div className="success-summary" role="status">{msg}</div>}
        <div className="row-end">
          <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={onClose} disabled={busy}>
            Cancel
          </button>
          <button
            type="submit"
            className="btn-primary"
            disabled={busy || (scope === 'selected' && !canSelected)}
          >
            {busy ? 'Exportingâ€¦' : 'Export'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}

async function fetchAllPages(url) {
  let items = [];
  let next = url;
  while (next) {
    const r = await api.get(next.replace('http://127.0.0.1:8000/api', ''));
    const d = r.data;
    if (Array.isArray(d)) return [...items, ...d];
    items = [...items, ...(d.results ?? [])];
    next = d.next;
  }
  return items;
}

/**
 * Managed category dropdown. kind: 'ticket' | 'asset'.
 * Inline creation is an asset-page affordance only: ticket categories are
 * managed on the dedicated Categories page, so every ticket-kind selector
 * (filters, ticket create/edit forms) omits the "+ Add" trigger unless a
 * call site explicitly opts back in with allowCreate={true}. After
 * creation the new entry is auto-selected.
 */
export function CategorySelect({ kind, value, onChange, error, disabled, allowCreate = kind !== 'ticket' }) {
  const { isStaff } = useAuth();
  const base = kind === 'ticket' ? '/tickets/categories/' : '/assets/categories/';
  const canCreate = allowCreate && isStaff;
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState('');
  const [modalOpen, setModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState('');

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setLoadError('');
    try {
      setItems(await fetchAllPages(base));
    } catch {
      setLoadError('Could not load categories.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, react/set-state-in-effect

  const submit = async (ev) => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    if (saving) return;
    const trimmed = name.trim();
    if (!trimmed) {
      setSaveError('Name is required.');
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    setSaveError('');
    try {
      const r = await api.post(base, { name: trimmed, description: description.trim() });
      await load();
      onChange(r.data.id); // auto-select the newly created category
      setName('');
      setDescription('');
      setModalOpen(false);
    } catch (e) {
      const p = parseApiError(e);
      setSaveError(p.global || p.fields.name || 'Could not create category.');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="row-gap">
        <select
          className="input input-auto"
          value={value ?? ''}
          onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value ? Number(e.target.value) : '')}
          disabled={disabled || loading}
          aria-label={kind === 'ticket' ? 'Ticket category' : 'Asset category'}
        >
          <option value="">{loading ? 'Loadingâ€¦' : 'Select a categoryâ€¦'}</option>
          {items.filter((c) => c.is_active !== false).map((c) => (
            <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.name}</option>
          ))}
        </select>
        {canCreate && (
          <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={() => { setSaveError(''); setModalOpen(true); }} disabled={disabled}>
            + Add
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
      {loadError ? <div className="field-error" role="alert">{loadError}</div> : null}
      {error ? <div className="field-error" role="alert">{error}</div> : null}
      {modalOpen && (
        <Modal title={kind === 'ticket' ? 'Add ticket category' : 'Add asset category'} onClose={() => { if (!saving) setModalOpen(false); }}>
          <form onSubmit={submit}>
            <Field label="Name" required>
              <input className="input input-auto" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Hardware" disabled={saving} autoFocus />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Description">
              <input className="input input-auto" value={description} onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)} placeholder="Optional" disabled={saving} />
            </Field>
            {saveError && <div className="field-error" role="alert">{saveError}</div>}
            <div className="row-end">
              <button type="button" className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => setModalOpen(false)} disabled={saving}>Cancel</button>
              <button type="submit" className="btn-primary" disabled={saving || !name.trim()}>
                {saving ? 'Savingâ€¦' : 'Create category'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function DepartmentSelect({ value, onChange, error, disabled }) {
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState('');
  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      try {
        setItems(await fetchAllPages('/accounts/departments/'));
      } catch {
        setLoadError('Could not load departments.');
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
  }, []);
  return (
    <div>
      <select
        className="input"
        value={value ?? ''}
        onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value ? Number(e.target.value) : '')}
        disabled={disabled || loading}
        aria-label="Department"
      >
        <option value="">{loading ? 'Loadingâ€¦' : 'Select a departmentâ€¦'}</option>
        {items.filter((d) => d.is_active !== false).map((d) => (
          <option key={d.id} value={d.id}>{d.name}</option>
        ))}
      </select>
      {loadError ? <div className="field-error" role="alert">{loadError}</div> : null}
      {error ? <div className="field-error" role="alert">{error}</div> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Optional related-asset picker for ticket forms (search + dropdown). */
export function AssetSelect({ value, onChange, error, disabled }) {
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    setLoading(true); // eslint-disable-line react/set-state-in-effect
    const t = setTimeout(async () => {
      try {
        const r = await api.get('/assets/', { params: q ? { q } : {} });
        if (!cancelled) setItems(r.data.results ?? r.data ?? []);
      } catch {
        if (!cancelled) setItems([]);
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      }
    }, q ? 300 : 0);
    return () => { cancelled = true; clearTimeout(t); };
  }, [q]);
  const selected = items.find((a) => a.id === Number(value));
  return (
    <div>
      <div className="row-gap">
        <select
          className="input"
          value={value ?? ''}
          onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value ? Number(e.target.value) : '')}
          disabled={disabled}
          aria-label="Related asset (optional)"
        >
          <option value="">No asset</option>
          {selected ? <option value={selected.id}>{selected.asset_tag} â€” {selected.name}</option> : null}
          {items.filter((a) => a.id !== Number(value)).slice(0, 30).map((a) => (
            <option key={a.id} value={a.id}>{a.asset_tag} â€” {a.name}</option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <input
          className="input input-search"
          value={q}
          onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Search tag/nameâ€¦"
          disabled={disabled}
          aria-label="Search assets"
        />
      </div>
      {loading ? <div className="field-hint">Loading assetsâ€¦</div> : null}
      {error ? <div className="field-error" role="alert">{error}</div> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

export function Alert({ variant = 'info', children }) {
  const cls = variant === 'danger' ? 'error-summary' : variant === 'success' ? 'success-summary' : 'muted';
  return <div className={cls} role={variant === 'danger' ? 'alert' : 'status'}>{children}</div>;
}
