  return <div className="form">{children}</div>;
}

export function Textarea({ rows, placeholder, ...props }) {
  return <textarea rows={rows} placeholder={placeholder} {...props} />;
}export function Row({ children, className }) {
  return <div className={`row${className ? ` ${className}` : ''}`}>{children}</div>;
}
export function Col({ children, sm, md, lg, xl, className }) {
  const size = { sm: 'sm-', md: 'md-', lg: 'lg-', xl: 'xl-' };
  const cls = size[sm] ? `${size[sm]}${sm}` : ''; // eslint-disable-line no-unused-vars
  const cls2 = size[md] ? `${size[md]}${md}` : '';
  const cls3 = size[lg] ? `${size[lg]}${lg}` : '';
  const cls4 = size[xl] ? `${size[xl]}${xl}` : '';
  return <div className={`col ${cls2} ${cls3} ${cls4}${className ? ` ${className}` : ''}`}>{children}</div>;
}
export function Card({ children, className }) {
  return <div className={`card${className ? ` ${className}` : ''}`}>{children}</div>;
}
export function Input({ label, ...props }) {
  const el = (props.rows || props.type === 'textarea')
    ? <textarea className="input" {...props} rows={props.rows || 3} />
    : <input className="input" {...props} />;
  return label ? <label className="field"><span>{label}</span>{el}</label> : el;
}
export function Select({ label, children, ...props }) {
  const el = <select className="input" {...props}>{children}</select>;
  return label ? <label className="field"><span>{label}</span>{el}</label> : el;
}

export function Option(props) {
  return <option {...props} />;
}

/** Page-size selector for server-paginated tables.
 *  Shows standard options (10/25/50/100) and a custom input.
 *  onChange receives either '' (unspecified/back to default),
 *  a number, or the current value on invalid input.
 *  value: current page size number or '' for default.
 *  maxPageSize: maximum allowed value (default 100, matching DRF).
 */
export function PageSizeSelector({ value, onChange, showCustom = true, maxPageSize = 100 }) {
  const handleChange = (e) => {
    const raw = e.target.value.trim();
    if (raw === '') {
      onChange('');
      return;
    }
    if (/^\d+$/.test(raw)) {
      const num = Number(raw);
      if (num <= 0) {
        onChange(value);
        return;
      }
      if (num > maxPageSize) {
        onChange(value);
        return;
      }
      onChange(num);
    } else {
      onChange(value);
    }
  };

  if (value === '') {
    return (
      <div className="form-field form-field-small">
        <label className="form-label">Rows per page</label>
        <select className="input" onChange={handleChange} aria-label="Rows per page">
          <option value="">Custom...</option>
          <option value={10}>10</option>
          <option value={20}>20</option>
          <option value={25}>25</option>
          <option value={50}>50</option>
          <option value={100}>100</option>
        </select>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const numValue = Number(value);
  return (
    <div className="form-field form-field-small">
      <label className="form-label">Rows per page</label>
      <select className="input" value={String(value)} onChange={handleChange} aria-label="Rows per page">
        <option value={10}>10</option>
        <option value={25}>25</option>
        <option value={50}>50</option>
        <option value={100}>100</option>
      </select>
      {showCustom && (
        <input
          type="number"
          className="input"
          min="1"
          max={maxPageSize}
          step="1"
          value={numValue !== numValue ? '' : String(numValue)}
          onChange={handleChange}
          aria-label="Custom rows per page"
          placeholder="Enter custom value"
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


===== src\dirty-form.jsx =====

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState, createContext, useContext } from 'react';

const DirtyCtx = createContext({ isDirty: false, markDirty: () => {}, markClean: () => {}, setDirty: () => {} });

export function DirtyProvider({ children }) {
  const [isDirty, setIsDirty] = useState(false);
  const markDirty = useCallback(() => setIsDirty(true), []);
  const markClean = useCallback(() => setIsDirty(false), []);
  const setDirty = useCallback((v) => setIsDirty(!!v), []);
  return (
    <DirtyCtx.Provider value={{ isDirty, markDirty, markClean, setDirty }}>
      {children}
    </DirtyCtx.Provider>
  );
}

export function useDirty() { // eslint-disable-line react/only-export-components
  const ctx = useContext(DirtyCtx);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useDirty must be used within a DirtyProvider');
  return ctx;
}

/** Hook for tracking field-level dirtiness against initial values.
 *  Returns { isDirty, setField, markClean, reset, values }. */
export function useDirtyForm(initialValues) { // eslint-disable-line react/only-export-components
  const [values, setValues] = useState(initialValues);
  const initialKeys = Object.keys(initialValues);
  const { markDirty, markClean } = useDirty();

  const isDirtyValue = useMemo(() => {
    const cur = values;
    const keys = new Set([...Object.keys(cur), ...initialKeys]);
    return [...keys].some((k) => cur[k] !== initialValues[k]);
  }, [values]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  const setField = useCallback((k, v) => {
    setValues((prev) => ({ ...prev, [k]: v }));
    if (v !== initialValues[k]) markDirty();
    else {
      if (!isDirtyValue) markClean();
    }
  }, [isDirtyValue, markDirty, markClean, initialValues]);

  const reset = useCallback(() => {
    setValues(initialValues);
    markClean();
  }, [markClean, initialValues]);

  return { values, setField, isDirty: isDirtyValue, reset };
}

/** Registers a beforeunload warning when dirty. Place once per page/shell. */
export function DirtyBlocker() {
  const { isDirty } = useDirty();
  useEffect(() => {
    const onBeforeUnload = (e) => {
      if (isDirty) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.returnValue = 'You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?';
      }
    };
    const onHashChange = () => {
      if (isDirty) {
        // Cannot programmatically block hash navigation via beforeunload.
        // Warn via toast instead if the UI layer handles it.
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', onBeforeUnload);
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', onHashChange);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', onBeforeUnload);
      window.removeEventListener('hashchange', onHashChange);
    };
  }, [isDirty]);
  return null;
}


===== src\ErrorBoundary.tsx =====

import { Component, ReactNode, useState, createContext } from 'react';

const ToastCtx = createContext<{ push: (m: string, s?: string) => number } | null>(null);

export function setToastContext(ctx: { push: (m: string, s?: string) => number }) { // eslint-disable-line react/only-export-components
  // no-op, kept for type stability
  Object.assign(ToastCtx, { _ctx: ctx });
}

interface State {
  hasError: boolean;
  error: Error | null;
  info: string | null;
}

interface Props {
  children: ReactNode;
  fallback?: ReactNode;
}

/** Catches render errors in the subtree so a crashing page never blanks the
 *  whole app. Shows a friendly inline fallback with a "Try again" button that
 *  remounts the boundary's children from scratch. */
export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<Props, State> {
  state: State = { hasError: false, error: null, info: null };

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): State {
    return { hasError: true, error };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: { componentStack?: string }): void {
    this.setState({ info: errorInfo.componentStack ?? null });
    try {
      console.error('[ErrorBoundary] caught render error:', error);
      console.error('[ErrorBoundary] component stack:', errorInfo.componentStack);
      const toastCtx = (ToastCtx as any)._ctx;
      if (toastCtx?.push) {
        toastCtx.push(`Page error: ${error?.message || 'Unknown error'}`, 'error');
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }

  reset = () => {
    this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null, info: null });
  };

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      const fallback = this.props.fallback ?? (
        <div className="panel panel-pad" role="alert">
          <h2>Something went wrong</h2>
          <p>This page encountered an error and could not render.</p>
          {this.state.error?.message && (
            <p className="muted small">{this.state.error.message}</p>
          )}
          <button type="button" className="btn-primary" onClick={this.reset}>
            Try again
          </button>
        </div>
      );
      return <>{fallback}</>;
    }
    return this.props.children;
  }
}

/** Hook-based variant for function components that prefer not to use a class. */
export function useErrorBoundary() { // eslint-disable-line react/only-export-components
  const [state, setState] = useState<State>({ hasError: false, error: null, info: null });

  const onError = (error: Error, info: { componentStack?: string }) => {
    setState({ hasError: true, error, info: info.componentStack ?? null });
    try {
      console.error('[ErrorBoundary] caught render error:', error);
      console.error('[ErrorBoundary] component stack:', info.componentStack);
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  };

  const reset = () => setState({ hasError: false, error: null, info: null });

  return { state, onError, reset };
}

===== src\toast.jsx =====

import { createContext, useContext, useCallback, useState, useRef } from 'react';

/** Severity levels for toasts. */
export const ToastSeverity = { // eslint-disable-line react/only-export-components
  info: 'info',
  success: 'success',
  warning: 'warning',
  error: 'error',
};

const ToastCtx = createContext({
  toasts: [],
  push: () => {},
  dismiss: () => {},
  dismissAll: () => {},
  ToastSeverity,
});

/** Provider that owns the toast queue. Wrap the app shell so any component
 *  can push a toast via useToast(). */
export function ToastProvider({ children }) {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState([]);
  const nextId = useRef(0);

  const push = useCallback((message, severity = ToastSeverity.info, ttlMs = 5000) => {
    const id = ++nextId.current;
    setToasts((prev) => [...prev, { id, message, severity, ttlMs }]);
    return id;
  }, []);

  const dismiss = useCallback((id) => {
    setToasts((prev) => prev.filter((t) => t.id !== id));
  }, []);

  const dismissAll = useCallback(() => setToasts([]), []);

  const value = { toasts, push, dismiss, dismissAll, ToastSeverity };
  return <ToastCtx.Provider value={value}>{children}</ToastCtx.Provider>;
}

/** Hook to push and dismiss toasts. Returns { push, dismiss, ToastSeverity }. */
export function useToast() { // eslint-disable-line react/only-export-components
  const ctx = useContext(ToastCtx);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useToast must be used within a ToastProvider');
  return ctx;
}

/** Presentational toast list. Renders each toast as a dismissible alert. */
export function ToastList() {
  const ctx = useContext(ToastCtx);
  if (!ctx) return null;
  const { toasts, dismiss, ToastSeverity } = ctx;
  const tone = {
    [ToastSeverity.error]: 'danger',
    [ToastSeverity.warning]: 'warning',
    [ToastSeverity.success]: 'success',
    [ToastSeverity.info]: 'info',
  };
  if (!toasts.length) return null;
  return (
    <div className="toast-container" role="region" aria-label="Notifications">
      {toasts.map((t) => (
        <div
          key={t.id}
          className={`toast toast--${tone[t.severity] ?? tone.info}`}
          role="alert"
          aria-live="polite"
        >
          <span className="toast-message">{t.message}</span>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="toast-close"
            onClick={() => dismiss(t.id)}
            aria-label="Dismiss notification"
          >
            Ã—
          </button>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Convenience wrapper: show an error toast for a failed API error. */
export function toastError(message) { // eslint-disable-line react/only-export-components
  return message;
}
